jobs.title: Deputy Director: Administration Support
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), (all-inclusive remuneration package to be structured in accordance with the rules for MMS)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director: Administration Support role in Pretoria offering R932,292 per annum, requiring a National Diploma and three years of junior management experience in administration.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management. Minimum of 3 years’ experience at junior management level in administration environment. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Supply Chain Management process. Knowledge of government systems and structure. Public Service Regulations. Treasury Regulations. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Knowledge on Departmental transversal system (Basic Accounting System (BAS), Personnel and Salary Administration (PERSAL), Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Knowledge of legislation, policies and procedure: The Constitution, Good governance and Batho-Pele principles, Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Regulations, Government decision making processes, Government systems and structures. Job related skills: Planning and organising skills. Analytical skill. Document management skills. Office management skills. Financial Management skills. Interpersonal skills. Computer skills. Resource planning skills. Problem solving and decision- making skills. Time management skills. Communication skills. A valid driver’s licence. Willingness to travel and / or work irregular hours. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Manage the coordination of financial management services. Ensure sufficient budget for expenditure incurred. Certify correctness of invoices. Compile budget inputs. Ensure Medium Term Expenditure Framework processes are adhered to. Ensure that expenditure is within the correct allocation. Take precaution of unauthorised, wasted or fruitless irregular expenditure. Manage the administration support services. Coordinate the development/reviewal of operational / strategic plan. Oversee logistical arrangements. Manage office accommodation. Manage registry services. Compile reports. Attend to queries from Internal Audit. Provide secretariat support services. Oversee the drafting of minutes and signing off where applicable. Manage the procurement of goods and services. Manage the compilation of Demand Management Plan. Facilitate supply chain management services. Facilitate monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting on SCM related matters. Manage the safekeeping, utilisation and maintenance of all assets. Ensure proper administration of sourcing and evaluation of quotations. Handle queries from internal and external clients relating to supply chain matters. Manage compliance with regards to the implementation, interpretation and application of administration policies. Promote adherence to policies such as Public Finance Management Act, Procurement, Human Resource, Transport and Records management policies. Develop administrative policies procedures and provide inputs for policy development. Manage the coordination of human resources support services. Manage all training requirement and activities. Manage the component equity plan and ensure vacancies are filled accordingly. Manage recruitment process. Manage leave record. Ensure that quarterly and annual Employee Performance Management and Development System evaluations for the component are done.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Chris Khonkwane at (069) 007 9989 APPLICATIONS Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email DDASrecruit66@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: African Female and Persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. IMPORTANT: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. ERRATUM: The Department of Agriculture wishes to inform the public about the withdrawal of the advertisement for two (02) positions. Chief Director: Cooperatives Development with Ref No: 3/3/1/67/2025, advertised in the Public Service Vacancy Circular 11 dated 27 March 2026, and Scientific Technician Production Grade A with Ref No: 3/3/1/37/2026, advertised in the Public Service Vacancy Circular 18 dated 29 May 2027. The Department likes to apologise for any inconvenience this withdrawal might cause. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Administratiewe Ondersteuning
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur: Administratiewe Ondersteuning-pos in Pretoria teen R932,292 per jaar, waarvoor 'n Nasionale Diploma en drie jaar se juniorbestuurservaring in administrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur / Besigheidsadministrasie / Besigheidsbestuur hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op junior bestuursvlak in 'n administratiewe omgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van die Toevoerkettingbestuursproses. Kennis van regeringstelsels en -strukture. Openbare Diensregulasies. Tesourie Regulasies. Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet (PFMA). Voorkeurverkrygingsbeleidraamwerkwet. Kennis van departementale transaktiewe stelsel (Basiese Rekenkundige Stelsel (BAS), Personeel- en Salarisadministrasie (PERSAL), Logistiese Inligtingstelsel (LOGIS). Kennis van wetgewing, beleide en prosedures: Die Grondwet, Goeie bestuur en Batho-Pele-beginsels, Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet, Openbare Diensregulasies, Regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse, Regeringstelsels en -strukture. Werksverwante vaardighede: Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Analitiese vaardigheid. Dokumentbestuursvaardighede. Kantoorbestuursvaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede. Hulpbronbeplanningsvaardighede. Probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Tydbestuursvaardighede. Kommunikasievaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en / of onreëlmatige ure te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Bestuur die koördinering van finansiële bestuursdienste. Verseker voldoende begroting vir uitgawes aangegaan. Sertifieer die korrektheid van fakture. Stel begrotingsinvoere op. Verseker dat Medium Term Expenditure Framework-prosesse nagekom word. Verseker dat uitgawes binne die korrekte toekenning is. Neem voorbuard teen ongemagtigde, vermorsde of ondoeltreffende onreëlmatige uitgawes. Bestuur die administratiewe ondersteuningsdienste. Koördineer die ontwikkeling/hersiening van operasionele / strategiese plan. Hou toesig oor logistiese reëlings. Bestuur kantoorakkommodasie. Bestuur registerdienste. Stel verslae op. Handel navrae van Interne Oudit af. Verskaf sekretariatsdienste. Hou toesig oor die opstel van notules en ondertekening waar van toepassing. Bestuur die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Bestuur die opstel van die Vraagbestuursplan. Fasiliteer toevoerkettingbestuursdienste. Fasiliteer maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslagdoening oor toevoerkettingbestuursverwante aangeleenthede. Bestuur die veilige bewaring, benutting en onderhoud van alle bates. Verseker behoorlike administrasie van die sourcing en evaluering van kwotasies. Hanteer navrae van interne en eksterne kliënte met betrekking tot toevoerkettingaangeleenthede. Bestuur voldoening ten opsigte van die implementering, interpretasie en toepassing van administratiewe beleide. Bevorder nakoming van beleide soos die Openbare Finansiesbestuurswet, Verkryging, Menslike Hulpbronne, Vervoer en Rekordbestuursbeleid. Ontwikkel administratiewe beleidsprosedures en verskaf insette vir beleidsontwikkeling. Bestuur die koördinering van menslike hulpbronondersteuningsdienste. Bestuur alle opleidingsvereistes en -aktiwiteite. Bestuur die komponent se billikheidsplan en verseker dat vakatures dienooreenkomstig gevul word. Bestuur die werweringsproses. Bestuur verlofrekords. Verseker dat kwartaallikse en jaarlikse Werknemerprestasiebestuurs- en Ontwikkelingstelsel-evaluerings vir die komponent gedoen word.

zu.title: Deputy Director: Administration Support
zu.summary: Isikhundla sika-Deputy Director: Administration Support ePretoria esinikeza iholo le-R932,292 ngonyaka, sidinga i-National Diploma kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava ophathi abancase kolawulo.
zu.requirements: Abafakizicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye i-National Diploma Public Administration / Public Management / Business Administration / Business Management. Umkhawulo weminyaka engu-3 yohlu lwamava kulevelo yabaphathi abancane enkundleni yolawulo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngokwenqubo ye-Supply Chain Management. Ulwazi ngohlelo lwahulumeni kanye nobunjiniyela bawo. Public Service Regulations. Treasury Regulations. Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act. Ulwazi ngohlelo lwesinyanya sefophi (Basic Accounting System (BAS), Personnel and Salary Administration (PERSAL), Logistical Information System (LOGIS). Ulwazi ngemithetho, izinqubomgimo kanye noshintsho: Umtsetfo sisekelo, Good governance kanye Batho-Pele principles, Public Finance Management Act, Public Service Regulations, Uhlelo lwesinqumo lwahulumeni, Izinhlelo kanye nozakwabo bahulumeni. Amandla okusebenza: Amandla okuhlela futhi uhlele. Isipiliyono samandla. Amandla okuphatha imibhalo. Amandla okuphatha ihhovisi. Amandla okuphatha imali. Amandla obudlelwano abantu. Amandla ekhompyutha. Amandla okuhlela izinsiza. Isipiliyono sokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Amandla okuphatha isikhathi. Amandla okuxhumana. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ukwaziseka ukuvakasha futhi / noma ukusebenza amahora angajwayelekile. Amandla okusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Phatha ukulungiselelana kwezinsizakalo zezimali. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunemali elinganiselwe ngokwanele yezindleko ezenziwayo. Qinisekisa ukulingana kweziku-mfayili. Hlela izinhlaka zemali. Qinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwa inqubo ye-Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Qinisekisa ukuthi izindleko zingaphakathi kokuhlelewa okufanele. Gatula ngemithetho yezindleko ezingagunyaziwe, ezingasetshenziswanga noma eze ngaphandle kwenqubo. Phatha izinsizakalo zokwesekwa kolawulo. Lungiselelanisa ukuthuthukiswa/ukubuyekezwa kweplani yokusebenza / yesu ndlela. Buka izinhlela zezezimali ezidingekayo. Phatha izindawo zokusingatha amahhovisi. Phatha izinsizakulo zesbhalo zohlu lwamafayela. Hlela imibiko. Phendula imibuzo evela ku-Internal Audit. Nikeza izinsizakulo zesbhalo zababili. Buka ukubhalwa kwemizuzu nokusayina lapho kufanele khona. Phatha ukuthenga izimpahla kanye nezinsizakalo. Phatha ukuhlelwa kwe-Demand Management Plan. Sikhuthaza izinsizakalo zokulawula ukuhlinzeka. Sikhuthaza ukubika ngamanye amanye, ngokwesikhashana, kanye nakho njalo ngonyaka ngemayelana nezindaba ze-SCM. Phatha ukugcinwa, ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqashelwa kwazo zonke izimpahla. Qinisekisa ukulawula okufanele kokutholwa kanye nokuqathaniswa kwezintengo. Phatha imibuzo evela kabalayeke banganhle kanye nalabo bangaphandle ngemayelana nezindaba zokuqashelwa. Phatha ukulandelwa kwemithetho mayelana nokusetshenziswa, ukuhumusha nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo zolawulo. Khuthaza ukulandelwa kwezinqubomgomo ezifana ne-Public Finance Management Act, Procurement, Human Resource, Transport kanye Records management. Hlola izinqubomgimilo zalawulo ibe ngamaphuzu abaliwe noma ngokusesikweni uma kunesidingo.

xh.title: Isekela Mongamzi: Inkxaso yolawulo
xh.summary: Isikhundla sikaSekela Mongamzi: Inkxaso yolawulo ePretoria sikhawuleza ngumvuzo we-R932,292 ngonyaka, sifuna i-National Diploma neminyaka emithathu yamava abaphathi abanganamvuzo omncinci kulawulo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka abafaki izicelo banesebe nabaphathi abasemva kwesidanga, kwaye bafake izicelo kwindlela elandela inqanaba lesidanga kwilabhorathi yamava kwilabhathi yolawulo lokubonelela ngolwazi. Isaziso sokusebenza ngokwemigaqo: Ukwazi ngakumbi ngakumbi ngakumbi ngakumbi ngakumbi ngakumbi ngakumbi.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuhlanganiselwa kweenkonzo zolawulo lwemali. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho isabelo esaneleyo sokuchithwa okwenziweyo. Qinisekisa ukulungileyo kweenkcitha. Hlanganisa iingeniso zesabelo. Qinisekisa ukuba kusetyenziswa iinkqubo ze-Medium Term Expenditure Framework. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuchithwa kusakulungelelaniswa kakuhle. Phatha ukusingathwa kokungalingani, ukutshatyalaliswa okungalutho noma ukuchithwa okungalunganga. Lawula iinkonzo zokuxhasa kolawulo. Hlanganisa ukuphuhliswa/okuqwalaselwa kweplani yokusebenza / yokuceba. Qhagamshelana ngezinto ezibekwe ngakumbi. Lawula izinto ezizodibana nendawo yolawulo. Lawula iinkonzo zokubhaliswa kwemibhalo. Hlanganisa iingxelo. Phendula imibuzo evela kwi-Audit yangaphakathi. Zise inkxaso kumalungu abakomiti. Qhagamshelana nokubhala kwemizuzu nokusayina apho kufuneka khona. Lawula ukufunyanwa kwemiba kunye neenkonzo. Lawula ukuhlanganiswa kwe-Demand Management Plan. Khuthaza iinkonzo zolawulo lwentengiso. Khuthaza iingxelonye ezibhalwa ngonyaka, kwitonela, nangenyanga malunga nezinto ezichwayiweyo ku-SCM. Lawula ukugcina, ukusebenzisa, kunye nokugcina ngokupheleleyo onke amaxhoba. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngokulungileyo kokufumanwa kweendleko zokulinganisa nokunika izicelo. Phatha imibuzo evela kubathengi bangaphakathi nangaphandle malunga nezinto ezichwayiweyo. Lawula ukwamkelwa kokwenziwa ngokweenkqubo, ukutolikwa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo. Khuthaza ukusetyenziswa ngokweenkqubo ezinjenge-Public Finance Management Act, Procurement, Human Resource, Transport kunye ne-Records management policies. Phuhlisa iinkqubo zolawulo lweenkqubo kwaye uze neengeniso kumapolicy ethutywa ngokweemfuno. Lawula ukuhlanganiselwa kweenkonzo zokuxhasa abantu. Lawula zonke iimfuno nemisebenzi yokuzilolonga. Lawula iplani yalawulo lokulingana kwaye uqinisekise ukuba izithuba ezikhoyo zigcwaliswa ngokulungileyo. Lawula inkqubo yokuba ngumntu ovelisa imveliso. Lawula ukubhaliswa kwemvume yokuhamba. Qinisekisa ukuba kuqwalaselwa ngokupheleleyo i-Employee Performance Management and Development System kwitonela nangonyaka kwindawo ekuyo.

jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed to oversee asset management practices, advise staff, and develop policies and systems for the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Logistics Management/ Supply Chain Management/ Public Management (NQF Level 6). Minimum of 3 years’ supervisory level in Asset Management. Job related knowledge: Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations. Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment. LOGIS (Logistic Information Systems). BAS (Basic Accounting System). BAUD (Asset Register System) Modified Cash Standards. Accounting Manual for Departments. Job related skills: Leadership skills. Management skills, Computer skills, Project Management skills and a valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Promote correct implementation of sound asset management practices. Inform, guide and advise departmental employees on asset management matters. Contribute to the design and development of asset management systems, policies, strategic and annual physical asset management planning. Monitor and review the progress of the asset verification. Compile and manage the asset verification in the Department. Capture asset information on the inventory list (room list) of the asset holder and in the relevant registers. Issue assets and inventory list (room list) list of asset holders. Ensure the movement of assets in the register. Monitor assets for physical condition, utilization functionality and financial performance. Manage the bar coding of all movable assets. Approve of the movable asset register updates. Manage the disposal of assets in the department. Manage the disposal and transfer of assets process in the department. Supervise the receipt and issue of all movable assets in the department. Perform quantity and quality control. Ensure that assets are removed from the register after approval. Compile memorandums and reports on the disposals to the Disposal Committee. Ensure correct financial reporting. Manage the additions and reconciliation process between BAS and the Asset Register. Ensure journals are requested to amend misclassifications. Prepare financial information for financial statement purposes. Supervise employees to ensure sound physical asset management. This would, inter alia, entail the following: General supervision of employees. Allocate duties and do quality control of the work delivered by supervisees. Advise and lead supervisors regarding all aspects of the work. Manage performance, conduct and discipline of supervisors. Ensure that all supervisors are trained and developed to be able to deliver work of the required standard efficiently and effectively. Develop, implement and monitor work systems and processes to ensure efficient and effective functioning. Address enquiries and provide advice and guidance on asset allocation and control.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Batebestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur benodig om batebestuurpraktyke te beheer, personeel te adviseer, en beleide en stelsels vir die Department of Agriculture in Pretoria te ontwikkel.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Logistieke Bestuur/ Voorraadkettingbestuur/ Openbare Bestuur (NQF Level 6) hê. Minimum van 3 jaar se toesighoudende vlak in Batebestuur. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Public Finance Management Act. Kennis van Treasury Regulations. Broad Based Black Economic Empowerment. LOGIS (Logistic Information Systems). BAS (Basic Accounting System). BAUD (Asset Register System) Modified Cash Standards. Accounting Manual for Departments. Werksverwante vaardighede: Leierskapsvaardighede. Bestuursvaardighede, Rekenaarvaardighede, Projekbestuursvaardighede en 'n geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Bevorder korrekte implementering van gesonde batebestuurpraktyke. Inlig, lei en adviseer departementele werknemers oor batebestuursaangeleenthede. Dra by tot die ontwerp en ontwikkeling van batebestuurstelsels, beleide, strategiese en jaarlikse fisiese batebestuurbeplanning. Monitor en hersien die vordering van die bateverifikasie. Stel op en bestuur die bateverifikasie in die departement. Vang bate-inligting op die voorraadlys (kamerlys) van die batehouer en in die relevante registers. Reeik bates en voorraadlys (kamerlys) van batehouers uit. Verseker die beweging van bates in die register. Monitor bates vir fisiese toestand, benuttingfunksionaliteit en finansiële prestasie. Bestuur die strepieskodering van alle mobiele bates. Keur die opdaterings van die mobiele bateregister goed. Bestuur die wegdoening van bates in die departement. Bestuur die wegdoenings- en oordragsproses van bates in die departement. Hou toesig oor die ontvangs en uitreiking van alle mobiele bates in die departement. Voer kwantiteits- en kwaliteitskontrole uit. Verseker dat bates na goedkeuring uit die register verwyder word. Stel memorandums en verslae oor die wegdoenings aan die Disposal Committee op. Verseker korrekte finansiële verslagdoening. Bestuur die toevoegings en afstemmingsproses tussen BAS en die Asset Register. Verseker dat joernale aangevra word om verkeerde klassifikasies reg te stel. Berei finansiële inligting vir finansiële state voor. Hou toesig oor werknemers om gesonde fisiese batebestuur te verseker. Dit sal onder meer die volgende behels: Algemene toesig oor werknemers. Wijs pligte toe en doen kwaliteitskontrole van die werk wat deur toesighouers gelewer word. Adviseer en lei toesighouers rakende alle aspekte van die werk. Bestuur prestasie, gedrag en dissipline van toesighouers. Verseker dat alle toesighouers opgelei en ontwikkel word om werk van die vereiste standaard doeltreffend en effektief te kan lewer. Ontwikkel, implementeer en monitor werkstelsels en prosesse om doeltreffende en effektiewe funksionering te verseker. Hanteer navrae en verskaf advies en leiding oor bate-toewysing en -beheer.

zu.summary: Kudingwa i-Assistant Director ukuba alawule izindlela zokuphathwa kwamafa, anikeze izeluleko abasebenzi, azuze izinto ezintsha ekubeni ngumuntu ongahleli kahle ekubeni ngumuntu ongaziwa kahle ekubeni ngumuntu ongathandi ukubeka kahle izinto zakhe e-Agriculture e-Pretoria.

Yiba negalelo ekwakhiweni nasekuphuhliseni iinkqubo, iinkqaselwano, iinqubo ezibalulekileyo kunye nenyanga zolawulo lwamafa. Qwalasela kwaye ujonge intshukela yokuqinisekisa amafa. Qamba kwaye ulawule ukuqinisekiswa kwamafa kwisebe. Faka iinkcukacha zamafa kuluhlu lwebhedi (uluhlu lwendlu) lomthathi-mafa nakwizikhululo ezifanelekileyo. Yabelana ngamafa noluhlu lwebhedi (uluhlu lwendlu) labo bathathi-mafa. Qinisekisa ukutyholwa kwamafa kwisikhululo. Lawula ukususwa kwamafa kwisebe. Lawula inkqubo yokususwa kunye nokudluliswa kwamafa kwisebe. Tyhala ukwamkelwa nokwabelwa kwawo onke amafa ajikelezayo kwisebe. Yenza ulawulo loluhlu kunye nomgangatho. Qinisekisa ukuba amafa asuswa kwisikhululo emva koku vunyelwa. Qamba iimemo kunye neengxelo ngokususwa kwamafa kwiKomiti Yokususa Amafa. Tyhala abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ulawulo olulungileyo lwamafa ngokomzimba. Oku kuya, phakathi kwezinye, kuquka oku kulandelayo: Ukutyhala ngokubanzi abasebenzi. Yabelana imisebenzi kwaye wenze ulawulo loluhlu komgangatho womsebenzi owenziwe ngabatyhalwa. Xelele ngelungiso kwaye uqhube abatyhali ngakuzo onke iindawo zomsebenzi. Lawula inkqubo, ukuziphatha kunye nenkundla yabatyhali. Qinisekisa ukuba onke abatyhali baqeqeshwa baphuhliswa bakwazi ukuyalela umsebenzi womgangatho ofunekayo ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangokusebenzisekayo. zu.title: Umuntu ophethe ezomthetho we Supply Chain oPhakeme: Izinjabulo
zu.summary: Umuntu ophethe ezomthetho we Supply Chain oPhakeme obophethe ulawulo lwezinjabulo nezinkonzo zokweluleka kuMnyango weZolimo ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kumele babe nesiQikizi/Diploma yezwe ngokuThengisa/kuLawulwa kwe Supply Chain/kuLawulwa kweZomphakathi (okuLawulwa) / ukuHlelwa kwezokuthutha / ukuLawulwa kwezoshibuli (okuLawulwa). U mkhulo wezinsuku ezi-2 wokuhlanganyela ekuLawulweni kweSidingo nasekuLawulweni kokuTholwa. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: uMthetho wokuLawulwa kweMali yomPhakathi. Izimiso zeNdheshisi. uMthetho weNkambiso yeNqongo yokuThenga (PPPFA) nezimiso ezihlotshaniswe nayo. Izinhlaka zomsebenzi kanye nezinkambiso zeMnyango weSCM. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono okuxhumanisa nabantu. Amakhono okulawula. Amakhono okuxhumana okubhalwayo nakokukhulunwayo. Amakhono okuhola abasebenzi. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkulu. Ilayisense esemthethweni yokuqhuba.
zu.duties: Qalisa izinhlaka zomsebenzo ezijwayelekile, inkambiso yeSCM nalamandla okwenza izinqumo kwinhhengo yezinjabulo: Zimathele kumthetho weSCM kuyo yonke imiqhubano yezinjabulo. Nikeza izinkonzo zokweluleka nokuba yibhalansi kwarihulu labakhethwayo kwezinkambiso kanye namahlelo abuka izinjabulo. Lawula izinjabulo: Nikeza izinkonzo zokweluleka nokuba yibhalansi kwarihulu labakhethwayo kwezinkambiso kanye namahlelo abuka izinjabulo. Lungiselela amadokhumenti wezinjabulo. Zibandakanye uqiniseke ukuzimathela kumthetho weSCM ngesikhathi kwahlelwa izinkambiso. Hlela ubuyele emhlanganweni wolwazi. Vala bese uvula izinjabulo. Hlolisisa ukuziphendulela kumapulezi wokuthengisa atholakalayo. Hlela ubuyele emhlanganweni wokuqonda. Lungiselela imibiko yokuqonda izinjabulo. Phatha imibiko yokuqonda izinjabulo kuBhalansi yokuqinisa Izinjabulo (BAC). Lungiselela ukwaziswa kwabaphathi, izibalo nokubika ngezinjabulo: Nikeza imibiko yansoni zonke ngokuqhubeka kwephrojekthi. Buyekeza irekhodi lezinjabulo. Zenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo edingekayo ngokuphathelene nokuLawulwa kweMali nabantu: Qondise abasebenzi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukuthenga kwehhengo kwenziwa ngokweNkambiso yokuLawulwa iSidingo.

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Practitioner: Asset Management
jobs.summary: Manage departmental assets, maintain the asset register and ensure compliance with asset management policies for the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and National Diploma in Logistic Management/ Supply Chain Management/ Public Management (NQF Level 6). Minimum of 2 years’ experience working in Asset Management. Job-related knowledge: Knowledge of Treasury Regulations. Knowledge of Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) and its associated regulations. Knowledge of Departmental SCM procedures and policy. Knowledge of Asset management prescripts and procedures. Job related skills: Communication skills (verbal and written), Management skills, Interpersonal skills, Organising skills, Teamwork, Working under pressure, LOGIS, A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: Ensure effective management of assets. Conduct training in assets management. Provide support to client offices. Ensure compliance with Departmental asset management policies and procedures. Maintain the departmental asset register. Compile and maintain asset register in the Department. Ensure bar coding of assets. Capture newly acquired asset according to the set standard. Ensure movement of assets is properly recorded and processed. Retire assets from the asset register due to disposals, thefts and losses. Reconcile between asset register and BAS on monthly basis. Ensure effective filling system of all asset management records. Perform assets verification and spot checks. Verify assets of the Department annually. Ensure spot checks quarterly. Reconcile assets on the floor with the asset register according to the verification plan. Identify obsolete and redundant assets for disposal as per standards. Recommend redundant assets for disposal. Maintain the barcoded asset system/register. Ensure that all procured assets are barcoded for identification purposes. Keep proper register for barcoding. Conduct backups. Provide monthly, quarterly and annual reports for financial reporting.
jobs.enquiries: Ms R Goolam Tel No: (012) 312 8395
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email SSCPAMrecruit68@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: African Male and Female and Coloured female and Persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. IMPORTANT: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. ERRATUM: The Department of Agriculture wishes to inform the public about the withdrawal of the advertisement for two (02) positions. Chief Director: Cooperatives Development with Ref No: 3/3/1/67/2025, advertised in the Public Service Vacancy Circular 11 dated 27 March 2026, and Scientific Technician Production Grade A with Ref No: 3/3/1/37/2026, advertised in the Public Service Vacancy Circular 18 dated 29 May 2027. The Department likes to apologise for any inconvenience this withdrawal might cause. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Senior Bevoorraadingskettingpraktisyn: Batebestuur
af.summary: Bestuur departementele bates, hou die bateregister by en verseine nakoming van batebestuursbeleid vir die Departement van Landbou in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Logistieke Bestuur/ Bevoorraadingskettingbestuur/ Openbare Bestuur (NQF Level 6). Minimum van 2 jaar se ervaring in batebestuur. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van Tesourie Regulasies. Kennis van die Wet op Openbare Finansies Bestuur. Voorkeur Aanbestedingsbeleid Raamwerk Wet (PPPFA) en sy gepaardgaande regulasies. Kennis van departementele BKV-prosedures en beleid. Kennis van batebestuur voorskrifte en prosedures. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasievaardighede (mondeling en skriftelik), Bestuursvaardighede, Interpersoonlike vaardighede, Organisasievaardighede, Spanwerk, Werk onder druk, LOGIS, 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verseker effektiewe bestuur van bates. Voer opleiding in batebestuur uit. Verskaf ondersteuning aan kliëntkantore. Verseker nakoming van departementele batebestuursbeleid en prosedures. Onderhou die departementele bateregister. Stel die bateregister in die Departement op en onderhou dit. Verseker stafkodering van bates. Vang nuutverworwe bates volgens die vasgestelde standaard vas. Verseker dat beweging van bates behoorlik aangeteken en verwerk word. Trek bates uit die bateregister weens beskikking, diefstal en verliese. Versoen maandeliks die bateregister met BAS. Verseker 'n effektiewe liasseerstelsel van alle batebestuursrekords. Voer bateverifikasie en steekproewe uit. Verifieer jaarliks die bates van die Departement. Voer kwartaallik steekproewe uit. Versoen bates op die vloer met die bateregister volgens die verifikasieplan. Identifiseer verouderde en oortollige bates vir beskikking volgens standaarde. Beveel oortollige bates aan vir beskikking. Onderhou die gestafkodeerde batestelsel/register. Verseker dat alle ingekoopte bates gestafkodeer word vir identifikasiedoeleindes. Hou 'n behoorlike register vir stafkodering. Voer rugsteune uit. Verskaf maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse verslae vir finansiële verslagdoening.

zu.title: Senqamliyesiqu Se-Supply Chain: Asset Management
zu.summary: Phatha izimpahla zomnyango, gcina ibhalansiyezimpahla futhi qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlatshiywa ngemikhuleqango yokuphathwa kwezimpahla ye-Department of Agriculture e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye ne-Diploma Yezwe e-Logistic Management/ Supply Chain Management/ Public Management (NQF Level 6). Umkhulu we-2 iminyaka yokuhlola ekusebenzeni e-Asset Management. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi mayelana ne-Treasury Regulations. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Public Finance Management Act. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA) kanye nomthetho ohlobene nawo. Ulwazi mayelana nemikhuleqango kanye nomkhuba we-Departmental SCM. Ulwazi mayelana nemiyalo kanye nomkhuba wokuphathwa kwezimpahla. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okuxhumana (elomlomo nokuqoshiwe), amakhono okuphatha, amakhono abantu, amakhono okuhlela, ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegembu, LOGIS, ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezimpahla ngendlela esebenzayo. Yenza isiqeqeshe mayelana nokuphathwa kwezimpahla. Nikeza inkxaso emahhovisi abathengi. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlatshiywa ngemikhuleqango yezimpahla nomkhuba wokuphathwa kwezimpahla komnyango. Gcina ibhalansiyezimpahla yomnyango. Hlola futhi gcina ibhalansiyezimpahla kumnyango. Qinisekisa ukubhala kwekhodi ezimpahleni. Faka izimpahla ezitholwe kamuva ngokusho komgomo osetshenzisiwe. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukunyakaza kwezimpahla kurekhodwa kanye nokucutshungulwa kahle. Khupha izimpahla ebhalansiyezimpahla ngenxa yokususwa, izinkohliso nokulahleka. Linganisela phakathi kwebhalansiyezimpahla ne-BAS nyanga zonke. Qinisekisa isimiso esiphumelelayo soguqulo lwawo wonke amarekhodi okuphathwa kwezimpahla. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwezimpahla kanye nokuhlola okungalindelwe. Qinisekisa izimpahla zomnyango ngonyaka. Qinisekisa ukuhlola okungalindelwe kwamakhwatha. Linganisela izimpahla eziseduze nebhalansiyezimpahla ngokusho kohlelo lokuqinisekisa. Hlonza izimpahla eziselapsi nangaphandle kokusetshenziselwa ukususwa ngokusho kwemigomo. Phakamisa izimpahla ezingasetshenziselwa ukususwa. Gcina isimiso/ibhalansiyezimpahla yezimpahla ezinamakhodi ezimpahla. Qinisekisa ukuthi wonke izimpahla ezithengiwe zinamakhodi ezimpahla ngenjongo yokuhlonza. Gcina ibhalansiyesinyathelo esifanele samakhodi ezimpahla. Yenza amakhophi. Nikeza imibiko yenyanga, yamakhwatha kanye namanyaka ngenjongo yemibiko yezimali.

xh.title: Umpraktishani oPhakamileyo woGunya lokuthengisa: uLawulo lwePahamokile
xh.summary: Lawula ipahamokile yesebe, gcina irejista yepahamokile uze qinisekise ukuthobela iinkqubela-mthetho zolawulo lwepahamokile kwisebe loLimo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seGredy 12 kunye neDiploma yaseLwizwe kwiMan ejenti/ ulawulo lwesikhuseli seZitoke/ ulawulo LukaRhulumente (NQF Level 6). Iminyaka engu-2 yamava yokusebenza kwiMan eje yepahamokile. Ulwazi olusesimweni: Ulwazi ngeSikhululo seeMigangatho yoMvuzo. Ulwazi ngeSilo soLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente. I-Simo-mthetho soKukhetha iNkqubo kaRhulumente (PPPFA) neemigangatho edibana nayo. Ulwazi ngeenkqubela-mthetho zeSCM zesebe nengqwalasela-mthetho. Ulwazi ngemiyalelo nolawulo yepahamokile. Amandla okusebenza: Amandla okunxibelelana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe), amandla okulawula, amandla obuntu phakathi kwabanye, amandla okuququzelela, ukusebenza ngokubambisana, ukusebenza ngantsimbi, i-LOGIS, ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo lwepahamokile. Yenza imfundiso ngolawulo lwepahamokile. Yela inkxaso kwiiofisi zabathengi. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubela-mthetho nezithembiso zegatya ekulawuleni ipahamokile. Gcina irejista yepahamokile yesebe. Lungiselela igcine irejista yepahamokile kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukubakwa kwamakhodi epahamokile. Faka ipahamokile entsha efunyenwe ngokwemigangatho emiselweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba iintshukumo zepahamokile zibhalwe ngokuchanekileyo kwaye ziqhutywe. Susa ipahamokile kwirejista ngenxa yokuwohloka, ukweba nokulahleka. Linganisa irejista yepahamokile ne-BAS nyanga zonke. Qinisekisa inkqubo echanekileyo yogcino lwamaxwebhe onke amarekhodi olawulo lwepahamokile. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwepahamokile nokukhangela ngokungqubana. Qinisekisa ipahamokile yesebe ngonyaka. Qinisekisa ukukhangela ngokungqubana kwikota. Linganisa ipahamokile esekugqundeni nerejista yepahamokile ngokwecandelo lokuyiqinisekisa. Chonga ipahamokile engasasebenzi nengongenelo ukuze igqitywe njengoko kumiselwe. Phakamisa ipahamokile engongenelo ukuze igqitywe. Gcina inkqubo/irejista yepahamokile enamakhodi. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke ipahamokile ethengiwe inamakhodi ngenjongo zokuqondwa. Gcina irejista efanelekileyo yamakhodi. Yenza iibhakhapu. Zela iingxelo zeminye, zekota nangaphezu kwengxelo yonyaka ngenjongo zexinzo lemali.

Izikhokelo eziqhathaniselwe nomsebenzi: Ubungcweti bokukhuluma okukhulumwayo nokuqoshiwe, Ulwazi lokuqondisa abanye, Izikhokelo ezinhle zokuxhumanana, Isikhokelo sokulawula isikhathi, Ubungcweti bokuhlela nokuqasha kanoma uphi owoyedwa, Ubungcweti bokulwazi ikhompyutha, Amakhono okubhala imibiko. Amakhono okubhala imibiko, Ukusebenza njengenhlangano, Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegcushu, Amakhono okugcina amapheni, Amakhono okuphatha abantu, Amakhono okuhlola nokuqoqisa, Amakhano okucombisisa nokuxazulula izinkinga, Amakhano anehlayo ekuzelelweni ngabathengi, Amakhano okulwazi ikhompyutha. Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayela.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kwempahla. Qasha ukuzilolonga ekuqoqweni kwempahla. Nikeza ukusekela ezikhungweni eziklayient. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezinqubomgomo nezinqubo zokuphathwa kwempahla zomnyango. Gcina umhlahlandlela wempahla womnyango. Hlola futhi gcina umhlahlandlela wempahla oqoqiwe eNyuvazini yamaphupho ethu. Qinisekisa ukukhomba ngekhodi yempahla. Thutha impahla entsha etholwe njengoba kumiswe isitayela. Qinisekisa ukuthi ukunyakaza kwempahla kuqoshiwe futhi kuhlelwe. Khipha impahla kumhlahlandlela ngenxa yokulahlekelwa, ukweba nokulahleka. Linganisa phakathi komhlahlandlela we-asset register kanye ne-BASNyanga ngalunye. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinto zokulawuleka imiphumela egcinwe ngokuphelethekileyo. Zenza ukuqinisekiswa kwempahla okungajwayelekile nokuhlolwa kwezinye izinto. Qinisekisa zonke izinto zomnyango njalo ngonyaka. Hlola kakhulu izindikimaba njalo kwekota. Hlalisa kwezinye izindikimaba nomhlahlandlela emhlabathini ngokwehlelo lokuhlolwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi izimpahla ezingasebenza futhi ezingadingeki zitholakale njengoba kumiswe. Qinisekisa ukuthi impahla ezingadingeki zithunyelwe ekuqoqweni kwempahla. Hlala ugcina umhlahlandlela wempahla ebhalwe ngekhowadi. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke impahla ethengiwe ibhalwe ngekhodi ukuze kuhlonzeke. Gcina ngokuphelele umhlahlandlela wekhodi yempahla. Qondisa umhlahlandlela wempahla wesikhungo.

xh.title: UmPractitioner weNkqubo yoMthengiso: uLawulo lweeAseti
xh.summary: Lawula iiaseti zesebe, zigcine irekhodi ye aseti kuze kuqinisekiswe ukuvuselelwa kweenkqubo zolawulo lweeaseti kwiSebe leZoLimo ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Abafakeli kufuneka babe nesiQinisekiso seQela le-12 kunye neDiploma yesiZwe kwiLogistic Management / Supply Chain Management / Public Management (NQF Level 6). Unyaka w-1 woluhlu lokusebenza kwiLawulo lweeAseti. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngeeNdlela zoLawulo zeTreasury. Ulwazi ngeTreasury Act yokuLawula iimali zeRhulumente. Ulwazi nokuLawula iNkqubo yoMthengiso kunye neNkqubo yeRhulumente yeSeti. Ulwazi ngeeNkqubo zeBAS. Ulwazi ngeLOGIS (Irekhodi yeAsenti). Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Amakhono oThetho (ethethwayo nokuBhalwa), Amakhono oKulawula abantu, Amakhono amabalwe ahlonelwayo nabantu, Amakhono oLawulo lwexesha, Amakhono oKuhlelwa kolwango lolawulo lweofisi, Amakhono oKusebenza ngeKhompyutha, Amakhono oBhala iingxelo. Amakhono oBhala iingxelo, Ukusebenza njengeqela, Ukusebenza ngaphantsi kwedabadingele, Amakhono oGcina amagunya, Amakhono oLawulo abantu, Amakhono oQwalasela nokuHlahlwa, Amakhono oThath'igqwetha nokuSombulula iingxabano, Amakhono oZinikela kumthengi kunye namakhono oKusebenza ngekhompyutha. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokusebenza kakuhle kweeaseti. Yenza ukhetho kulawulo lweeaseti. Nikela ngenkxaso kwiiofisi zabathengi. Qinisekisa ukuvuselelwa kweenkqubo kunye neendlela zolawulo lweeaseti zesebe. Zigcine iirekhodi zeeaseti kwisebe. Qamba uze uligcine irekhodi ye aseti kwisebe. Qinisekisa ukubekwa iikhowudi zeecode kweeaseti. Faka iiaseti ezithathiweyo kutsha ngokweyona ndlela ilungileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba inyathelo lweeaseti luyabhalwa ngokuchanileyo ludluliselwa. Tyikitya iiaseti kwirekhodi ye aseti ngenxa yokuyishiyisa, ukurhweba nokulahleka. Linganisa phakathi kwerekkodi ye aseti kunye neBAS nyaka ngamnye. Qinisekisa ukugcwa kakuhle kweenkqubo zolawulo lwazo zonke iirekhodi zolawulo lweeaseti. Yenza uqinisekiso lweeaseti nemihlahlwa. Qwalasa iiaseti zesebe ngamnyaka. Qinisekisa imihlahlwa ngesihelegi. Linganisa iiaseti eziseziko nerekhodi ye aseti ngokwekhalenda yeqinisekiso. Phawula iiaseti ezizele ngokumelene nokugqithisayo ukutshiya njengoko kumiselwe. Fulumela iiaseti ezingasebenzisekiyo ezizele. Gcina irekhodi ye aseti ngeecode ezichaziweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke iiaseti ezithunyiweyo zinamakhowudi eecode. Gcina ukuchaneka kakuhle kwerekhodi yeecode. Lawula irekhodi ye aseti zesebe.

jobs.title: Vetting Investigator
jobs.summary: Conduct vetting fieldwork investigations and compile reports for the Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, requiring a relevant diploma or degree and Top Security Clearance.
jobs.requirements: Applicants must be in possession of grade 12 Certificate. A Bachelor’s Degree / National Diploma in Security Risk Management, Police Science and Policing (NQF6). Must obtain a Top Security Clearance within a year of appointment. Minimum of 2 years of experience in the field of security vetting. Job related knowledge: Knowledge on security vetting administration. Extensive knowledge in general administration. Job related skills: Communication skills, Facilitation skills, Computer literacy, Report writing skills, Presentation skills, Listening skills and Interpersonal relations skills. A valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel on a regular basis.
jobs.duties: Conduct vetting fieldwork investigations. Gather relevant information. Conduct proper analysis and quality checks on the information. Compile and submit reports to management and State Security Agency (SSA) on all vetting files and reports completed on a regular basis. Conduct vetting investigations in respect of confidential and secret levels. Provide inputs for the development and implementation of policies, guidelines, norms and standards in vetting investigations. Analyse, research and evaluate all vetting related information. Provide advice and guidance on the interpretation and application of legislation, policies and procedures. Provide effective communication channels and systems between the Department and the State Security Agency (SSA) and other related agencies. Liaise regularly with State Security Agency (SSA), South African Police Service (SAPS), South African Secret Service (SASS), Defence, Department of Home Affairs and other critical stakeholders for advice and assistance to obtain additional information. Administer vetting files and reports.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Mandla Mnguni Tel No: (012) 319 7127
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to 20 Steve Biko Street, Agriculture Place, Arcadia, Pretoria, 0002 or by email VIrecruit72@nda.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Target: African Male and Female and Persons with disability. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme. Appointment is subject to successful competition of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Due to high volumes, the Department will not acknowledge receipt of applications. Communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. IMPORTANT: DOA is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. af.title: Veiligheidsondersoekonderzoeker
af.summary: Voer veiligheidsondersoek-veldwerkondersoeke uit en stel verslae op vir die Department of Agriculture in Pretoria, wat 'n tersaaklike diploma of graad en Top Security Clearance vereis.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat hê. 'n Bachelor's Degree / National Diploma in Security Risk Management, Police Science and Policing (NQF6). Moet binne 'n jaar na aanstelling 'n Top Security Clearance verkry. Minimum van 2 jaar se ondervinding in die veld van veiligheidsondersoek. Werksverwante kennis: Kennis van veiligheidsondersoekadministrasie. Uitgebreide kennis van algemene administrasie. Werksverwante vaardighede: Kommunikasievaardighede, fasiliteringsvaardighede, rekenaarvaardigheid, verslagskryfvaardighede, aanbiedingsvaardighede, luistervaardighede en interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om gereeld te reis.
af.duties: Voer veiligheidsondersoek-veldwerkondersoeke uit. Versamel tersaaklike inligting. Voer behoorlike ontleding en gehaltekontrole op die inligting uit. Stel verslae op en dien dit gereeld by bestuur en die State Security Agency (SSA) in vir alle voltooide veiligheidsondersoeklêers en verslae. Voer veiligheidsondersoeke uit ten opsigte van vertroulike en geheime vlakke. Verskaf insette vir die ontwikkeling en implementering van beleid, riglyne, norme en standaarde in veiligheidsondersoeke. Ontleed, ondersoek en evalueer alle veiligheidsondersoekverwante inligting. Verskaf advies en leiding oor die interpretasie en toepassing van wetgewing, beleid en prosedures. Verskaf doeltreffende kommunikasiekanale en -stelsels tussen die Department en die State Security Agency (SSA) en ander verwante agentskappe. Skakel gereeld met State Security Agency (SSA), South African Police Service (SAPS), South African Secret Service (SASS), Defence, Department of Home Affairs en ander kritieke belanghebbendes vir advies en bystand om addisionele inligting te verkry. Administreer veiligheidsondersoeklêers en verslae.

zu.title: Umphenyi Wokuhlola
zu.summary: Ukwenza imibiko yokuhlola emkhakheni kanye nokuqoqa imibuko kuDepartment of Agriculture ePretoria, okudinga iziqu noma iziploma ezihambisanayo kanye netimishi Yokuhlola Okuphezulu.
zu.requirements: Abafakwayo kufanele babe nesatifikethi sebanga lesi-12. I-Bachelor's Degree / National Diploma kwi-Security Risk Management, Police Science and Policing (NQF6). Kufanele bathole Itimishi Yokuhlola Okuphezulu kuso isikhathi sonyaka osuku bethunyelwa. Ukwaziswa okungenani eminyaka eyi-2 kumkhakha wokuqinisekisa ukuvikeleka. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi ngokuqinisekisa ukuphatwa kokuvikeleka. Ulwazi olunzulu ekuphatweni jikelele. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Amakhono okuxoxa, amakhono okwenza kwenzeke, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okwethula, amakhono okulalela kanye namakhono obudlelwano bobuntu. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile kanye nesithakazelo sokuhamba njalo.
zu.duties: Ukwenza ukuphenya emkhakheni wokuqinisekisa. Ukuqoqa ulwazi oluhlobene. Ukwenza ukuhlazulwa okufanele kanye nokuhlola izinga kwi-information. Ukuqoqa kanye nokuhambisa imibiko kubaphathi kanye ne-State Security Agency (SSA) kumafayili wokuqinisekisa wonke kanye nemibiko eqediwe njalo. Ukwenza ukuphenya kwokuqinisekisa mayelana namazinga abimbi kanye namafihlo. Nikela ngeminikelo ekuthuthukisweni nasekuqatshweni kwezinqumiso, iziqondiso, izilinganiso kanye namazinga ekupheni ukuqinisekisa. Hlaziya, futhi ucwaninge futhi uhlola lonke ulwazi oluhlobene nokuqinisekisa. Nikeza izeluleko kanye nokuqondisa ekuhumusheni nasekuqatshweni kwemithetho, izinqumiso kanye nokuqhubeka. Nikeza izigaba zokuxhumana eziyingozi kanye namasistimu phakathi koMnyango kanye ne-State Security Agency (SSA) kanye nezinye izikhungo ezihlobene. Xhumana njalo ne-State Security Agency (SSA), South African Police Service (SAPS), South African Secret Service (SASS), i-Defence, i-Department of Home Affairs kanye nabanye abaphathwa ababalulekile ngezeluleko kanye nansonzo ukuze uthole ulwazi olungeziwe. Phatha amafayili wokuqinisekisa kanye nemibiko.

xh.title: Mphandi Wokutyholwa Kolwazi
xh.summary: Qhuba iindwendwe zokutyholwa kolwazi endle kwaye uhlenge iiriphozi ze-Department of Agriculture ePretoria, kufuneka kubekho i-diploma okanye i-degree efanayo kunye ne-Top Security Clearance.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Certificate yesi grade 12. I-Bachelor's Degree / National Diploma kwi-Security Risk Management, Police Science and Policing (NQF6). Kufuneka afumane i-Top Security Clearance ngaphakathi konyaka okusukela kumhla kanemisebenzi. Ubuncinane i-2 years amava ohlotywa kolwazi. Ulwazi oluxhomekeke kumsebenzi: Ulwazi ngolawulo lwe-vetting. Ulwazi olubanzi ngolawulo jikelele. Amakhono axhomekeke kumsebenzi: Amakhono okunxibelelana, Amakhono okusabela njengesiphithiphathi, Ulwazi lwekhompyutha, Amakhono ebhalwa iiriphozi, Amakhono okubonisa, Amakhono okumamela kunye namakhono abakho nabantu.
xh.duties: Qhuba iindwendwe zokutyholwa kolwazi endle. Qokelela ulwazi olufaneleyo. Yenza uphononongo lulungileyo nenkcumla komgangatho kolwazi oluqokelelweyo. Hlenga kwaye uthumela iiriphozi kurhulumente nakwi-State Security Agency (SSA) ngeefayile zonke ze-vetting neeriphozi ezigqityiweyo njalo. Qhuba iindwendwe zokutyholwa kulwazi kwizinga lobuxoki nolufihliweyo. Nikela ngemibongo ekwakhiweni nokuqatshweni kwemigaqo, iinkqobo, iindlela ezisemgangathweni kwiindwendwe zokutyholwa kulwazi. Phonononga, kuphande kwaye ulinganise zonke iinkcukacha ezinxulumene nokutyholwa kulwazi. Nikela ngengcebiso nokuqondisa ngokutolikwa nokusebenzisa umthetho, imigaqo neenkqubo. Bonelela ngeenqwelo ezisebenzayo zolwazi neenkqubo phakathi kwe-Department kunye ne-State Security Agency (SSA) nakwezinye iindwendwe ezinxulumene. Thintana njalo ne-State Security Agency (SSA), South African Police Service (SAPS), South African Secret Service (SASS), Defence, Department of Home Affairs nakwezinye iindwendwe eziyimfuno ngeengcebiso kunye noncedo ukuze ufumane olunye ulwazi. Lawula iifayile ze-vetting neeriphozi.

jobs.title: Director: SOC Governance and Legal Assurance
jobs.closing_date_text: 24 August 2026 at 16h00 (Walk-in) 23h59 (online). N.B: It is the sole responsibility of an applicant to ensure that their application reaches the Department on or before the set deadline.
jobs.summary: Director role overseeing SOC governance and legal assurance for the Department of Electricity and Energy, requiring legal or governance experience and SMS pre-entry certification.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate degree in Business Administration and/or Legal Studies at NQF level 7 recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), plus the pre-entry certificate for SMS (Nyukela). Plus 5 years of experience at the middle/senior managerial level in Legal or Corporate Governance. Knowledge of: Legislative and policy prescripts relevant to the Department and its SOE’s. Corporate governance as it applies to the public and private sector, Company law, PFMA, Project Management, Strategic Planning, Risk Management and strong legal background. Skills: Communication, Financial Management, Problem-solving and Analytical skills. Honesty and integrity; change management, strategic capability and leadership. Service delivery innovation, people management and empowerment. Thinking Demand: Information evaluation; decision-making, creativity, Tact, work individuality and in a group.
jobs.duties: Undertake the development of standardised SOC governance review and reporting instruments. Lead or partake in SOC governance assurance projects to assess compliance and enable DEE management structures to facilitate corrective action where required. Provide technical advisory services to executive management and the shareholder on the appointment and dismissal of SOC Board Members. Develop coordinate the implementation of the DEE’s legal assurance policy regime and standardised legal instrument assurance framework for the SOC Group. Align existing and/or develop legal instruments for the governance of SOC’s in the group. Draft legal opinions on the shareholder interface process with SOC Boards. Manage the Directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Mr James Dlamini Tel No: (012) 406 7577
jobs.applications: Email to Vacancies1@dee.gov.za

af.title: Direkteur: SBW-Bestuur en Regversekering
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat toezig hou oor SBW-bestuur en regversekering vir die Department of Electricity and Energy, wat reg- of bestuurservaring en SMS-voorinrysertifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: An appropriate degree in Business Administration and/or Legal Studies at NQF level 7 recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), plus the pre-entry certificate for SMS (Nyukela). Plus 5 years of experience at the middle/senior managerial level in Legal or Corporate Governance. Knowledge of: Legislative and policy prescripts relevant to the Department and its SOE's. Corporate governance as it applies to the public and private sector, Company law, PFMA, Project Management, Strategic Planning, Risk Management and strong legal background. Skills: Communication, Financial Management, Problem-solving and Analytical skills. Honesty and integrity; change management, strategic capability and leadership. Service delivery innovation, people management and empowerment. Thinking Demand: Information evaluation; decision-making, creativity, Tact, work individuality and in a group.
af.duties: Onderneem die ontwikkeling van gestandaardiseerde SBW-bestuurs hersiening en verslagdoeningsinstrumente. Lei of neem deel aan SBW-bestuursversekeringsprojekte om nakoming te beoordeel en DEE-bestuursstrukture in staat te stel om regstellende maatreëls te tref waar vereis. Verskaf tegniese adviesdienste aan uitvoerende bestuur en die aandeelhouer oor die aanstelling en ontslag van SBW-raadslede. Ontwikkel en koördineer die implementering van die DEE se regversekeringsbeleidregime en gestandaardiseerde regsinstrumentversekeringsraamwerk vir die SBW-groep. Belyn bestaande en/of ontwikkel regsinstrumente vir die bestuur van SBW's in die groep. Op stel regsmenings oor die aandeelhouer-koppelvlakproses met SBW-rade. Bestuur die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi: SOC Ukuphathwa Kwezomthetho Nokuqinisekiswa Komthetho
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi sokuhlola ukuphathwa kwe-SOC nokuqinisekiswa komthetho koMnyango we-Electricity and Energy, esidinga ulwazi lomthetho noma lokuphathwa nokuthi ube nesitifikedi se-SMS sokungena ngaphambili.
zu.requirements: I-degree efanelekileyo kwi-Business Administration kwayo noma kwi-Legal Studies kwazinga le-NQF level 7 eseqiniswe yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), kanye nesitifikedi sokuqalisa i-SMS (Nyukela). Kantsi kudingeka futhi unamava eminyaka eyi-5 ezingeni eliphakathi/phezulu lemanagement kulomthetho noma e-Corporate Governance. Ulwazi ngemithetho kanye nemithetho yepolisi ehlobene noMnyango kanye ne-SOE yakhe. Ukuphathwa koshintsho (corporate governance) njengoba kusetshenziswa emkhakheni womphakathi nangasese, Company law, PFMA, Project Management, Strategic Planning, Risk Management kanye nesisekelo esiqinileyo somthetho. Amakhono: Ukuxhumana, Financial Management, Problem-solving kanye namakhono okuhlaziya. Ukuqiniseka nokuba thembekile; change management, strategic capability kanye nobuqhawe. Service delivery innovation, people management kanye nokukhululiswa. Thinking Demand: Ukuhlola ulwazi; ukwenza izinqumo, ukubumba, Tact, ukusebenza ngabanye kanye nokuqembu.
zu.duties: Yenza intuthuko yamathuluzi ajwayelekilewe wokuqinisekisa nokubika ngokuphathwa kwe-SOC. Qhatha noma thatha inxaxheba emaphrojekthiniokuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwe-SOC ukuze uhloliswe ukuvumelana bese kunikwa amandla izakhiwo zokuqondisa i-DEE ukuba zikwazi ukuthatha izinyathelo zokulungisa lapho kudingeka. Nikeza izindlela zokweluleka ngezobuchwepheshe kubaphathi abaphezulu nakumsokeli ngesikhathi sokumiswa nokukhishwa kwamalungu eBhodi ye-SOC. Tuthaza ukuhlelwa nokusetshenziswa kwendlela yomthetho we-DEE wokuqinisekisa kanye nensimbi ejwayelekilewe wokuqinisekisa izithuli zomthetho zoqembu le-SOC. Linganisa okukhona kwayo noma tuthaza izithuli zomthetho zokuphathwa kwe-SOC eqenjini. Bhalla imibono yomthetho ngendlela yokuxhumana komsokeli namabhodi e-SOC. Phatha iDirectorate.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ulawulo lwe-SOC nokuQinisekisa ngokomthetho
xh.summary: Inkundla yomphathi ephethe ulawulo lwe-SOC nokuqinisekisa ngokomthetho kwisebe le-Electricity and Energy, ifuna amava othetha ngomthetho okanye ulawulo nesatifikethi sokuqala saba-ngaphakathi kwi-SMS.
xh.requirements: Idegree efanelekileyo kwi-Business Administration nakanye kwi-Legal Studies kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7 elivunyiweyo yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), kunye nesatifikethi sokuqala saba-ngaphakathi kwi-SMS (Nyukela). Kananjalo 5 years amava kwinqanaba lalawulo eliphakathi/eliphezulu kumthetho okanye ulawulo lweshishini. Ulwazi nge: Imithetho kunye namagqabantshintshi kolawulo ahambelana nesebe kunye ne-SOE'salo. Ulawulo lweshishini njengoko lusetyenziswa kwicala lokawonke-wonke nasekwinxaleni yabucala, umthetho wamashishini, i-PFMA, ulawulo lweProject, uqoqosho lweStrategic, ulawulo lweengozi nembeko ngokomthetho. Amakhono: Ukunxibelelana, ulawulo lweemali, ukuxazulula iingxaki kunye namakhono okuhlalutya. Umanyano nokuqinisekisa; ulawulo lwezoshintsho, amakhono oqoqosho kwaye nolawulo obukhulu. Intsingiselo yokutshintsha indlela yokunika abantu inkonzo, ulawulo lweemfuneko zokulinganisela, ulawulo lwabantu nokuzinceda. Iimfuno zokucinga: Ukuxoxwa kolwazi; ukwenza izigqibo, ukuyila, isakhelo, ukusebenza ngabnye nakwindlu.
xh.duties: Yenza uphuhliso lwezixhobo zokuhlola ulawulo lwe-SOC ezingagqibekanga nezokubika. Yiba ngumphathi okanye uthathe inxaxheba kumaphulo e-SOC governance assurance ukuvavanya ukuzaliseka kolweso ube ukuvumela izakhiwo zalawulo zedephathments ukukhokelela ukulungiswa apho kudingeka khona. Nikeza iinkonzo zokucebisa ngezobuchwepheshe kubaphathi abaphezulu nakubanikaziNxaxheba ngokuqabizelwa nokukhutshwa kwabamalunga aboBhunga be-SOC. Phuhlisa ulawulo lokwenza umsebenzi kakhulu lwezixhobo ezisemthethweni ze-DEE legal assurance policy regime nangokulawula ngokumthetho iinkqubo ezingagqibekanga ze-SOC Group. Qondanisa okukho nakanye yenza izixhobo ezisemthethweni zolawulo lwe-SOC group. Bhala iingcamango ngokomthetho mayelana nenkqubo yokuxhumana namagunyazwe nabaseBhungeni be-SOC. Lawula iNgangala.

af.title: Administratiewe Ondersteunings- en Koördinasiebeampte
af.summary: Verskaf administratiewe koördinasie en uitvoerende ondersteuning by die Department of Electricity and Energy Hoofkantoor in Pretoria, hou toesig oor personeel en skakel met belanghebbendes.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike Diploma/ Graad in Openbare Bestuur op NQF Level 6 erken deur die South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Ervaring in die Regerings- en/of NGO/CBO-sektor en voordeelervaring van Parlementêre/wetgewingsprosesse en voordeelnavorsing as 'n bykomende voordeel. Kennis van: Ministeriële bedrywighede, politieke en parlementêre prosesse in die South African Board. Kennis en begrip van die funksionele areas wat deur die portefeulje van die uitvoerende gesag gedek word. Kennis van openbare diensbeleid en Energy Sector voorskrifte. zu.title: Inkulu Yomsebenzi Wokusekelwa Nokuhlanganiswa Kokuphathekayo
zu.summary: Nikela ngokuhlanganiswa kokuphathekayo nokusekelwa kokuphatha eNdiropmenti Yangeze kanye Nolwandle eNtlikontloko ePretoria, baphathe abasebenzi bahlanganye nabahlanganyeli.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma/ Degree elifanele kwi-Public Administration ngazinga NQF 6 elamukelekwa yi-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA), okuhle ukuba namava sebhu waqhutshwa umbuso, okanye i-NGO/CBO kanye namava okuphathwa kwezindlu zokomelwa nemiThetho, iphuzu elingezelelwaleyo kanti nokuphando kuphawu lokube ngaphandle kolwazi. Ukuqonda ngokwendlela yokusebenza koBaphathi, iinkqubo zolwandle noMbeleko wezindlu zokumelwa eNtlaka yoluntu. Ulwazi nokugqithisa kumanqanaba abalawu ukusetyenziswa kolawulo ngokusetyenziswa kwabantu ngokumisela imithetho yombuso nolwandle. Amaphuhla: ukuzisombulula iingxaki, ukuqukuqela (ngomlomo, ngokubhaliweyo), amaphuhla amaninzi wokuhlela nokuchwela iintlanga zonke nabantu abangazali, kwayo nethemba lokuba nalomdla wokubhalisa. Iimfuno zokucinga: unxibelelwano nokugqiba izigqibo.
zu.duties: Qhube amashishini olawulo ngaphakathi kwe-ofisi yolawulo. Qhagamshelana nabathathi nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle mayela nemiba ethintela ulawulo. Nikezela ngkonzo lusekelo lwesigqeba karhulumente kumlawuli. Qondise abasebenzi.

xh.title: I-ofisi yoLwazi loLawulo kunye noLungelelwano
xh.summary: Nikeza inkqubo yolawulo lwesiphakamiso kunye nenkxaso yabaphathi koRhulumante we-Electricity and Energy Head Office ePretoria, ulawule abasebenzi ube nethuba ngeentlanganiso nabathintekayo.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma/ Degree elifanelekileyo kwiiNkcukacha zoLawulo lukaRhulumante ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 ezaziwayo yiSouth African Qualification Authority (SAQA). Uluny经验u kwingingqi yengcwele eRhulumante yaNamathuba/i-NGO/i-CBO ibe ngumonde ongenzuzo, inyisela olutsha lungumbono onokubakho olutsha kubomi bepalamente ne nkqubo yokudlula inyisela yenceph eswaye inkqubo evimba phakathi kubuphulu nebongwe kwaye ibe ngumonde onomonde olungeqanganye. Ukuqonda ngokuqonda: Ngabasebenzi bekhuselwa lolushishi ezweni zaseSouth African Board. Ulwazi nokuqonda iindawo ezinkonkothwa koomanyano bakaRhulumante ezinyulwa kwindawo enkulu yolawulo yabakwaRhukwana. Ulwazi lwe-Sipili esihambe ngokubakho sazebe ekuqonda nasekuqeni iindlela zamaqumnguza abakwaRhulumante.
xh.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yolawulo ngaphakathi kwiofisi yogunyazwe oluphambili. Thath'inxaxheba nabaphathi abangaphakathi nangaphandle ngokwemiba echlotywe kwisikhundla sogunyazwe oluphambili. Nikeza inkonzo yenkxaso yekhabhinethi/bengamzi bomzimba kugunyazwe oluphambili. Lawula abasebenzi.

zu.title: Umkekeli: Izibalo Zamandla
zu.summary: Phatha ukuqoqwa kokuwazi ngamandla, ukugcinwa nokuqinisekisa izinga ukwakha imibiko yezibalo yeDepartment of Electricity and Energy.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma/Digri ephuthumayo ezibalo, ezomnotho, ekuqashweni kwezibalo, kuzibalo, ekuqashweni kwezinto ezingasabeki, ezifundweni zamandla nase-Datametrics ezingeni le-NQF Level 7 evunyiwe yi-South African Qualification Authority (SAQA), okuhambisana neminyaka eyi-3 yohlelo oluhambisana nalokhu. Ulwazi mayelana nomsebenzi wamandla, ekuqashweni kokuwazi, nasemigomeni yokuphatha imiklamo. Ukuqonda ukuthola nokuthola izindlela zokuwazi (isb. izindlela ezahlukene zokusampula ezingasetshenziswa ukwenza inhlobo ezahlukene zocwaningo), uHlelo lokubeka izinga kokuwazi, ukuhlaziwa kokuwazi nezibalo. Amakhono: Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu, okuphatha imiklamo nokuxoxisana, ekhompyutha, okuphatha isikhathi nokuhlaziya izibalo. Izidingo zokucabanga: Ukucabanga okuqinile ngenkathi kungabi khona ukukhwabanisa, umbono wokucahlaza nokuba nobusazi bezindaba zomhlaba mayelana namandla.
zu.duties: Qoqa onke amawazi nolwazi aludingekayo ukuhlela nokubika kubanikezi bekwazi abahlukene. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa okuhle, ukuphathwa nokutholwa kokuwazi. Ukuqinisekisa nokuqapha izinga kokuwazi. Hlela imibuzo/imibiko yanyanga zonke. Hlela ukugeleza kwemikhiqizo yamandla yamalahle, kagesi, imikhiqizo yamafutha kanye negesi evamile. Nikeza imisebenzi yokuphatha.

xh.title: Umcedisi weNkundla: iNkcazelo yamandla
xh.summary: Lawula ukuqokelelwa kwamanani amandla, ukugcinwa noqinisekiso lokungathandabuzekiyo ukuze kwenziwe iingxelo ngenani lamandla ezele iNkundla yoMthendereka nokuQinisekisa ukuba ngumntu ofanelekileyo ukuba ngumLawuli weSikhululo seSebe lezeMali.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma/Digrii ethembekileyo ephilileyo kwesiXhosa nangeli NgesiNgesi kwiiNkcazelo ezingowabo, ukuba ngumntu onelungelo lokungena kwiSayensi yeeNkxwaleko nokuqonda izigidi zabantu abahlala kwindawo ethileyo ngexesha elifanayo ekwiNqanaba le-NQF Level 7 elivunywe yiSouth African Qualification Authority (SAQA), kunye neminyaka emi-3 yamava ahambelanayo. Ukuqonda ngaloo nto: Ushishino lomthiliso, ulawulo lolwazi, iinkqubo zoLawulo lweProjehti. Ukuqonda iindlela zokufumana nokuqokelela ulwazi (umz. iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokusingatha ezinokusettyenziswa ukuqhuba iindidi ezahlukeneyo zovavanyo), uLawulo Lwolwazi olungathandabuzekiyo, uVavanyo nokuqokelelwa kwamanani. Ikhono: Ikhono lokunxibelelana nabantu, iinkqubo zoLawulo lweProjehti nentshiniselwano, iKhompyutha, iNgcinelela nexesha nokuguquguquka kumanani.
xh.duties: Qokelela onke amanani olwazi nemininingwane efuneka kwicandelo lolulo nokuvelisa iingxelo kumanani abanikezeli ahlukeneyo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa ngokufanelekileyo, ulawulo nokubuyiselwa kwamanani. Ukuqinisekisa ngangomsebenzi nolawulo lwengenelo yamanani. Ukuhlanganisa iintlu ezinyatheliswa ngezinyanga/iingxelo. Ukuhlanganisa ukusuka nokubuyela kwamandla amaminerali amabala amalahle, umbane, iimveliso zepetroleum negazi eliluhlazana. Ukuze abe nemisebenzi yobulungisa.

jobs.summary: Director position managing state-owned plantations and forests across Limpopo and Mpumalanga, requiring a forestry qualification and five years of managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification in Forestry or Natural Resource Management (NQF 7) or relevant qualification within the related field recognized by SAQA. A minimum of Five (5) years of experience in Commercial Forestry or related field at middle / senior managerial level within the related field. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) must be submitted prior to appointment. Furthermore, all shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Knowledge of relevant policies, legislations and frameworks relating to Forestry e.g. National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No 84 of 1998) (NFA) and the National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No 101 of 1998) (NVFFA). Knowledge and understanding of all relevant legislation and regulations that govern the Public Service including Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and treasury regulations, Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act etc. Knowledge and understanding of National Priorities of government e.g. National Development Plan 2030, Commercial Forestry Sector Master Plan, Accelerated and shared growth Initiative South Africa. Knowledge and understanding of Silviculture and Harvesting practices in relation to sustainable management of biological assets. Skills: Programme and Project Management, Financial Management, Change Management, Knowledge Management and People Management and Empowerment. Ability to negotiate in difficult situations and to resolve conflict. Good interpersonal relations skills. Good Communication skills. A valid Driving license and willingness to travel.

Develop and implement Fire Management Plans, Ensure the implementation of Sustainable Forest Management in line with the National Forest Act and National Veld and Forest Fire Act. Proactive mitigation of audit risks, develop and implement audit interventions. Stakeholder Liaison. Provide post settlement support and support state forest Land administration and State Forest Land transfer programmes. Plan and initiate EPWP to serve as force multiplier for commercial forestry operations.

Short-listed candidates will be expected to avail themselves at the Department’s convenience. Entry level requirements for SMS posts: In terms of the Directive on Compulsory Capacity Development, Mandatory Training Days & Minimum Entry Requirements for SMS that was introduced on 1 April 2015, a requirement for all applicants for SMS posts from 1 April 2020 is a successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG) prior to appointment. The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into SMS and the full details can be obtained by following the below link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training- course/sms-pre-entryprogramme.
