af.title: Direkteur: Staatsbosbestuur
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat staatsbesitte plantasies en bosse regoor Limpopo en Mpumalanga bestuur, waarvoor 'n bosboukwalifikasie en vyf jaar bestuurservaring vereis word.
af.requirements: n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Bosbou of Natuurlike Hulpbronbestuur (NQF 7) of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld wat deur SAQA erken word. n Minimum van Vyf (5) jaar ervaring in Kommersiële Bosbou of verwante veld op middel-/seniorbestuursvlak binne die verwante veld. Voltooiing van die Senior Management Pre-entry Programme soos onderskryf deur die National School of Government (NSG) moet voor aanstelling ingedien word. Verder moet alle gekorte lys kandidate, insluitend die SMS, twee voor-toelating assessments onderneem. Die een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes en die ander moet 'n integriteit (etiese gedrag) assessering wees. Kennis van tersaaklike beleide, wetgewing en raamwerke wat op Bosbou betrekking het, bv. National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No 84 of 1998) (NFA) en die National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No 101 of 1998) (NVFFA). Kennis en begrip van alle tersaaklike wetgewing en regulasies wat die Openbare Diens regeer, insluitend Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en tesourie-regulasies, Public Service Act, Labour Relations Act ens. Kennis en begrip van Nasionale Prioriteite van regering, bv. National Development Plan 2030, Commercial Forestry Sector Master Plan, Accelerated and shared growth Initiative South Africa. Kennis en begrip van Silvikultuur en Oespraktyke in verband met volhoubare bestuur van biologiese bates. Vaardighede: Program- en Projektbestuur, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur, Kennisbestuur en Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging. Vermoë om in moeilike situasies te onderhandel en konflik op te los. Goeie interpersoonlike verwantskapsvaardighede. Goeie Kommunikasievaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Bestuur die staatsbesitte plantasies en implementeer die jaarlikse operasionele plan vir die plantasies. Bestuur Staatsbosse, personeel en gepaardgaande bates. Ontwikkel en implementeer Brandbestuursplanne, verseker die implementering van Volhoubare Bosbestuur in ooreenstemming met die National Forest Act en National Veld and Forest Fire Act. Proaktiewe mitigering van ouditrisiko's, ontwikkel en implementeer ouditintervensies. Belanghebbende-skakeling. Verskaf post-skikkingsteun en steun staatsboslandadministrasie en staatsboslandoordragprogramme. Beplan en inisieer EPWP om as kragvermenigvuldiger vir kommersiële bosbouoperasies te dien.

zu.title: Umuntu ophethe: Ukuphathwa kwezihlahla zikahulumende
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuphatha izihlahla n amahlathi ohulumende kuwo wonke amayunithi ahlotshaniswa nezihlahla e Limpopo nase Mpumalanga, sifuna iziqu ze Forestry kanye neminyaka emihlanu yemisebenzi yokuphatha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-undergraduate kwi Forestry noma ukuphathwa kwemithombo yemvelo (NQF 7) noma iziqu ezihlotshaniswa nale ndawo ezinkomokhwe yi SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka emihlanu (5) yemisebenzi kwi Commercial Forestry noma indawo ehlotshaniswa naleyo ezingeni eliphakathi / eliphezulu lokuphatha kuleyo ndawo. Ukuqedwa okupumelelayo kwe Senior Management Pre-entry Programme njengoba kugunyazwe i National School of Government (NSG) kufanele kuhlolwe ngaphambi kokuba kumiwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, bonke abagqokiwe ababhaliswe ohlwini, kubhalwe ne SMS, bazokwenza ukuvivinywa okubili ngaphambi kokuqala. Okunye kuzokuba ukuzijwayeza okusebenzayo ukuze kutholwe ukufaneleka komuntu okhethiwe ngokususwa kwezidingo ezikhethekile nangokujwayelekile zesikhundla, okunye kumele kubhe ukubuyekezwa kobulungiswa (ukuziphatha ngokomthetho). Ulwazi ngemigomo, izimiso nezakhiwo ezihlotshaniswa ne Forestry njengoko kuyi National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No 84 of 1998) (NFA) kanye ne National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No 101 of 1998) (NVFFA). Ulwazi nokuqonda kothe yonke imithetho nemithethonqubo ephatha Inkonzo Yomphakathi kubandakanya i Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) kanye nemithethonqubo yobuhlwempu, i Public Service Act, i Labour Relations Act njll. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezinto ezibalulekile kahulumende njengoku: i National Development Plan 2030, i Commercial Forestry Sector Master Plan, i Accelerated and shared growth Initiative South Africa. Ulwazi nokuqonda kwezidingo ze Silviculture ne Harvesting ngokuphathwa okomi kweso empilweni kwempahla ephilayo. Amakhono: Ukuphathwa kwe Programmes kanye nezinhlelo kanye ne Project Management, i Financial Management, i Change Management, i Knowledge Management nokuPeople Management and Empowerment. Ukukwazi ukuxoxisana ezimeni ezinzima kanye nokulungisa izinkinga. Amakhono amahle obudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana. Ilayisensi yokushayela ehambisana nemithetho kanye nesithakazelo sokuhamba.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha izihlahla zikahulumende nokusebenzisa isu sonyaka semisebenzi yezihlahla. Ukuphatha i State Forests, abasebenzi kanye nempahla ehlotshaniswa nayo. Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuPhatha i Fire Management, Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kokuphathwa kwezihlahla eziyisisekelo ngokuvumelana ne National Forest Act ne National Veld and Forest Fire Act. Ukukhipha izinsizi ngaphambili ezingabangela ubungozi bokuhlola, ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa izinyathelo zokuhlola. Ukuxhumana nabalingani. Ukunika inkxaso emva kokuxazululwa kwezinto kanye nokusekela ukuphathwa kwe State Forest Land kanye nezinhlelo zokusuka kwe State Forest Land transfer. Ukuhlela kanye noqaliso lwe EPWP ukuthi yenze njengensiza ekwandiseni amandla emisebenzi ye Commercial Forestry.

xh.title: UmLawuli: Ukulawula kwezeMizi yeSizwe yeMithi
xh.summary: Isithuba somLawuli sokulawula iindawo zokulima nemizi yemithi ezimele koluntu kwayo yonke indawo kwi-Limpopo nase-Mpumalanga, kufuneka ncedane nesidanga kwezohambo lwemithi neminye imisebenzi yokulawula yeminyaka emihlanu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esiyingunya kwi-Forestry okanye kwi-Natural Resource Management (NQF 7) okanye isidanga esihambelana nendawo ethize esaye sakugqunywa yi-SAQA. Ayisi mva kwenyanga eziFive (5) zemisebenzi kwi-Commercial Forestry okanye kwelinye igatya njengomphathi kwindawo ezinganga ephakathi / ephezulu. Ukuphumelela kokuqeda i-Senior Management Pre-entry Programme njengoko yayamkele i-National School of Government (NSG) kufuneka kunikwe ngaphambi kokuba kwenziwe isikhundla. Ngaphezu koko, onke amagosa abekwe kuluhlu, kuquka ne-SMS, kuya kwenza iintshekelo zibe zimbini ezangaphambi kokungena. Enye iba lumnthambo wokuzilolonga ukuze kusetyenziswe ngokuquka kumthunzi wokulawula nobuchule obungenamthengi, lomnye ube lutshevo lokulinganisa isimo sophatho lolungelelwaniso. Ulwazi ngeendabazebhunga, ngemithetho nangendlela ezokulawula i-Forestry, umzekelo i-National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No 84 of 1998) (NFA) le-National Veld and Forest Fire Act, 1998 (Act No 101 of 1998) (NVFFA). Ulwazi nokuqonda yonke imithetho nengqikithi yamagosa olawula inkonzo ekaRhulumente, kuquka i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) nemithetho yoMgcinelo weZimali, i-Public Service Act, i-Labour Relations Act naxa. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngamagunya esiNkokheli karhulumente, umzekelo i-National Development Plan 2030, i-Commercial Forestry Sector Master Plan, i-Accelerated and shared growth Initiative South Africa. Ulwazi nokuqonda ngezobugcisa bokulima nokukhetha kwemithi ngokuxhomekeke kumthetho wobugcisa boluntu bokulawula izinto ezikhoyo. Amakhono: uLawulo lweNkqubo noLawulo loMsebenzi, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lokuTshintsha, uLawulo loLwazi nokuLawula abaBantu noKubakhulisa. Ukuba nokhono lokuxoxisana ngezinto ezinzima nokuwasonjulula izinto ezingavumelani. Ukuba nobunyeni bokukhwela ithuba elihle kwizithethi. Ukuba namakhono obuNobumnini ngokwakuwe. I-Layisensi yokuba yisiKhokelo etsha nakwemoto ekhoyo nomtshato wokwazi ukuhamba kwindawo. Umgangatho omhle weemfuno.
xh.duties: Lawula imizi yohambo lwezityalo nezakuzimila ezingekho ngaphantsi koluntu, ilawule kwaye yifake inkqubo yokuvela kwimisebenzi yeminyaka yehulu yohambo. Lawula iziHlala zohambo, abantu nangaphezu kolawulo lwezityalo ezikwindalo ekude kakhulu. Ziqulunqe zifake inkqubo yokulawula iMlilo, kuqinisekiswe ukuba kufakwa inkqubo yolawulo lokuQhuba imithi ngokwemigaqo yoMthetho weSizwe weMithi noMthetho weSizwe weVeld noMlilo. Vakalisa ngaphambili nokubucela kubakho umngeni wezimoto zokukhangela, uqulunqele afake inkqubo yokulawula imiba ehambisa iliso. Ukubambisana nentlangano yamangemikhosi. Kufumanise inkxaso evela kwisigqeba esincinane sentsapho ehlangabezwa ngokwemfuno yangaphambili nangokubandakanya ulawulo lweNtsimbi ekaRhulumente kubekelwe iSizwe nemihla yokunika iSizwe ulawulo nentsimbi nenkozo yokwazi isithuthi. Cwangcisa ukuqalise inkqubo ye-EPWP ukwenzela ukwakha inkxaso ngokwazi nokulawula izandla kuluntu kwimisebenzi yokusebenza imizi.

Provide support in the development of guidelines to ensure that engineering designs and drawings meet engineering standards. Process registration for National Norms and Standards and exclusion authorisation. Review of Geotech Studies and climate change studies for submitted waste applications. Develop guidelines for climate change studies in connection with waste activities.

af.title: Produksie-ingenieur Graad A: Geotegniese Ingenieur
af.summary: Geotegniese ingenieur benodig om geotegniese inligting te hersien en te analiseer ter ondersteuning van afvalbestuurslisensie-aansoeke, met ECSA-registrasie as vereiste.
af.requirements: Baccalaureusgraad in Ingenieurswese of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, plus drie (3) jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring in 'n verwante veld. Verpligte registrasie by ECSA as 'n professionele Ingenieur. Moet die beleids- en wetgewende raamwerk wat besoedeling en afvalbestuur regeer, verstaan. Deeglike analitiese en navorsingsvaardighede. Vermoë om aktiwiteite, insluitend projekte en beleidsaangeleenthede, te bestuur en te beplan. Kennis van die Nasionale Afvalbestuurstrategie. Vermoë om beleide, strategieë en wetgewing te ontwikkel, te interpreteer en toe te pas. Kennis en ervaring in watergebruik, afvalbestuur, ontwerp van waterhulpbroninfrastruktuur en ontwerp, bedryf en hersieningsprosedures van mynfasiliteite. Kennis van die Afvalklassifikasie- en Bestuursregulasies. Kennis van Nasionale Norme en Standaarde vir die Assessering van Afval vir Stortingsterreinverwydering. Kennis van Norme en Standaarde vir die Verwydering van Afval na 'n Stortingsterrein. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede. Kennis van tersaaklike ingenieursstandaarde. Die ampsdraer moet in staat wees om onafhanklik en doeltreffend onder druk sowel as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Hersien en analiseer geotegniese inligting om die goedkeuring van ingenieurswerktekeninge en ontwerpe wat vir afvalbestuurslisensie-aansoeke, wysigings en 24G-aansoeke ingedien is, te ondersteun. Ontwikkel en implementeer metodologieë, beleide, stelsels en prosedures vir geotegniese inligtingsprodukte en toepassings wat gebruik sal word in die hersiening en ontleding van geotegniese studies. Versamel, analiseer en versprei geotegniese inligting om die Direktoraat te ondersteun in die hersiening van aansoeke en die evaluering van die prestasie van gelisensieerde terreine. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n siftingsinstrument vir tekeninge en ontwerpe wat by afvalaansoeke gevoeg word. Sif ingenieurswerktekeninge en ontwerpe wat by afvalaansoeke by die departement ingedien word. Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n saakbestuurstelsel vir ingenieurswerktekeninge wat met afvalaansoeke ingedien word. Verwerk registrasies ooreenkomstig die Nasionale Norme en Standaarde vir Afval. Verskaf ondersteuning by die ontwikkeling van riglyne om te verseker dat ingenieursontwerpe en -tekeninge aan ingenieursstandaarde voldoen. Verwerk registrasie vir Nasionale Norme en Standaarde en uitsluitingsmagtiging. Hersiening van Geotegnieke studies en klimaatsveranderingsstudies vir ingediende afvalaansoeke. Ontwikkel riglyne vir klimaatsveranderingsstudies in verband met afvalaktiwiteite.

zu.title: Production Engineer Grade A: Geotechnical Engineer
zu.summary: Kudingeka injiniyela yezomhlaba ukuba ibuke futhi ihlaziye ulwazi lwezobunjiniyela zomhlaba olusekela izicelo zelayisensi yokuphathwa kokuhlakaza, kadinga ukubhaliswa kuECSA.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeBachelor's degree kuEngineering noma isiqu esihambisanayo njengoba setshunyiwe yiSAQA, kanye namaphesenti amathathu (3) amava emva kweziqu enkundleni ehlobene. Ukubhalisa ngamagalelo kuECSA njengenjiniyela ogunyaziwe kuyaphoqelelwa. Kumele kuqondwe inqubomgomo nesakhiwo sezomthetho siphatha ukungcoliswa nokuphathwa kokuhlakaza. Amakhono ahle okuhlaziya nokucwaninga. Ikhono lokuphatha nokuhlela imisebenzi, okuhlanganisa amaphrojekthi nezindaba zenhqubomgomo. Ulwazi ngeNational Waste Management Strategy. Ikhono lokuthuthukisa, ukuhumusha nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izindlela nezomthetho. Ulwazi namava ekusetshenziseni amanzi, ukuphathwa kokuhlakaza, ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezingenamanzi, ukwakhiwa kwemisebenzi yokuthi mina, imisebenzo namaphrosedha okubuka. Ulwazi ngeWaste Classification and Management Regulations. Ulwazi ngeNational Norms and Standards for the Assessment of Waste for Landfill Disposal. Ulwazi ngeNorms and Standard for Disposal of Waste to Landfill. Amakhono amahle obudlelwano abantu, ukuxhumana nabandulelabantu, Ikhono le Strategic Capability kanye nobuholo. Ulwazi ngamazinga wobunjiniyela ahlobene. Umuntu oqashiwe kumele akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa futhi ngokusebenza kahle ngaphansi koxhumo kanye nokuba yingxenye yeqembu elinemihlangano eyahlukene. Ilayisensi yomshayeli egunyaziwe nokulungela ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Buka futhi uhlaziye ulwazi lwezobunjiniyela zomhlaba ukuze useke ukugunyazwa kwezithombe nezakhiwo zobunjiniyela ezithunyelwe ezimweni zezicelo zelayisensi yokuphatha okuhlakazekile, izinguquko nezicelo ze-24G. Hlola futhi usebenzise izindlela, izinqubomgomo, izimiso namaphrosedha yezinto ezitholakala kulwazi lwezobunjiniyela zomhlaba nokuzezisetshenziswa ekubukeni nokuhlaziyeni izifundo zezobunjiniyela zomhlaba. Qoqa, hlaziye futhi sasaza ulwazi lwezobunjiniyela zomhlaba ukuze useke iDirectorate ekubukeni izicelo nokuhlola ukusebenza kwesitesi ezinelayisensi. Hlola futhi usebenzise isithulusi sokuhlola izithombe nezakhiwo ezelezwa nezicelo zokuhlakaza. Hlola izithombe nezakhiwo zobunjiniyela ezithunyelwe kumnyango ngezicelo zokuhlakaza. Hlola futhi usebenzise isimiso sokuphatha amacala ezithombe zobunjiniyela ezithunyelwe ngezicelo zokuhlakaza. Phatha izibhalo ngokwezindinganiso Namasiko Avezwe Isizwe ngokuHlakaza. Nikeza inkxaso ekuthuthukisweni kwemiqathango ukuzeqinisekisa ukuthi izakhiwo nezithombe zobunjiniyela zihambisana namazinga wobunjiniyela. Phatha izibhalo zeziZinga Namasiko Avezwe Isizwe negunya lokukhishwa. Buka izifundo zeGeotech nemfundo yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu ezicelweni zokuhlakaza ezithunyelwe. Hlola imiqathango yemfundo yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu ehambisana namasebenzo okuhlakaza.

xh.title: Injiniere Yokukhiqiza Inqanaba A: Injiniere yeGeotechnical
xh.summary: Kufunekwa injiniere yegeotechnical ukuphonononga nokuhlalutya ulwazi lwegeotechnical oluxhasa iifom zezicelo zelayisenensi zolawulo lwenkunkuma, kwaye kufuneka abhalwe kwi-ECSA.
xh.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's degree kwi-Engineering okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo njengoko somzekelwa i-SAQA, kananjalo unamashumi amathathu (3) eminyaka yamava emva kweziqu kwinkwinqe egqithiselwe kuyo. Kuyinyani ukubhalwa kwi-ECSA njengenjiniere yobuchwepheshe. Kufuneka ayiqonde i-police nendlela yomthetho elawula ukungcolisa nolawulo lwenkunkuma. Iimakhono ezilungileyo zohlalutyo nophando. Ikhono lokulawula nokuqamba iindlela zemisebenzi, kuquka iiprojekthi neendaba zomthetho wolawulo. Ulwazi lwe-National Waste Management Strategy. Ikhono lokuphuhlisa, ukutolika nokuvela iimalathiso, iindlela zomthethowolawulo nomthetho. Ulwazi namava ekusebenziseni amanzi, kulawulo lwenkunkuma, kwakwiqondo leesiseko zamanzo nasekuyilweni kweziseko zokhathazo, ekusebenziseni nasekuhlahlumbeni iinkqubo. Ulwazi nge-Waste Classification and Management Regulations. Ulwazi nge-National Norms and Standards for the Assessment of Waste for Landfill Disposal. Iakhondo yokuyila, ukucazulisa nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zomgaqo-nkqubo, iindlela ezilungileyo namalungu. Amakhondo amabalawuni omanyano wabantu, ukubandakanya abathintileyo, amandla esicwangciso nokuBusa. Ulwazi ngezenzo zodidi lwenjiniyezo. Lo mntu kufuneka akwazi ukuzisebenzela yena ngenkqubo echanekileyo nakwezinye iingxwaka ekhathalelo yomsebenzi, kwanakwindima eqeqeshe abantu abanodidi olwahlukileyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni nentando yokuhamba.
xh.duties: Lawula nokuqhathanisa iimizamu yonjiniyezo nemigangatho eyilweyo evakalelwe izicelo ezintsha zelayisensi yokulawula inkunkuma, iinguqu ngezicelo ezilungana i-24G nolawulo lwenkunkuma. Lawula inqubo yokuvuma ukhathalelo lwedatha yolwakhiwo nombiko wokugqibela kolwakhiwo iindawo zokulahla inkunkuma ezifakwe kwindawo yolawulo. Hlola, uphonononge uvume ukhathalelo lwedatha yolwakhiwo nombiko wokugqibela kolwakhiwo. Lawula ukuvunywa kwemveliso esebenza ngokutshintsha imithi yedayim ezingqimbiweyo okuyimveliso entsha ngokwemigaqo yokuqhwesha. Lawula uqambe inkqubo yophando yamacala ukuxhasa iSebe ekulawulweni kwezom Mandla zoLwazi lweNjiniyezo nemizami yonjiniyezo. Zela inkxaso ngokubuchwepheshe nophando. Qhuba upando ngemveliso yenkunkuma entsha enokusetyenziswa kwinto yonjiniyezo. Qamba iindlela eziluncediso ezinjiniyezo kwaye nemizami yoMandla ukuqinisekisa ukuba kuhlangatselwa iinkqubo zezenzo zemiyalezo yemveliso. Qamba iindlela zoluncediso ngeelwango-nyezi zotshintsho lwesimo sezulu ngokubalana nentwenkunkuma yemisebenzi.

xh.title: Injinieri Yokwenziwa Inqanaba A: Ukulinganisa Iingozi
xh.summary: Kufuneka injinieri yokwenziwa e Pretoria ukuze ahlolishe iingxelo zokulinganisa iingozi aziveze iintsingiselo zokuvala imigqa ezahlula iiqhalo kwisebe le Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se Bachelor kwisinjenzo zamachiza okanye izifundo ezifanelekile njengoko zivunywe yi SAQA, kwaye nezixhenye (3) zeminyaka yamava emva kwezifundo kwisinjenzo zamamanzi, isinjenzo yemizekelo kunye nosenjenzo yamapali. Kuyimfuneko ukubhalisa kwi ECSA njengenjenieri yobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa okuvela kumgca oyiyo weeqlahlo kunye neNdlela yeliZwe yokulawula imigca oyiyo. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulinganisa iingozi ngokwenani nangokuhlobo. Ulwazi ngokuchaza imigca oyiyo nokumila kweenkohlakalo. Kufuneka aqonde iinkqubo zemigaqo nomthetho ophatha ukungcola nolawulo loogwayi. Amava amabalwa okuhlola nophando. Isakhono sokulawula kunye nokuqamba iindlenla zemisebenzi, kuquka iiprojekthi neemiba zemigaqo. Ulwazi namava ekulawulweni kweenkonzo. Isakhono sokuphuhiza, ukutolika nokusebenzisa iimigaqo, iindlela nomthetho. Amakhono amabalwe abantu bokuxhumana nabo, ungenelelo kwabathathi-nxaxheba, isakhono soBuchule bokuziphatha nokuBeka ngaphambili. Ulwazi ngeendulamthetho ezifanelekile zosenjenzo. Umntu oze kule sithuba kufuneka akwazi ukusebenza yedwa ngokusebenza kakuhle ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nakwindalo yeqela elinabantu abanemimangalo ehlukileyo. Ilayiseni yedrayiva esemthethweni nentshisekelo yokuhamba.
xh.duties: Hlola ingxelo yokulinganisa iingozi nendlela yokulawula iingozi ngokuvumelana neendulamthetho zokuvala imigqa. Phuhiza iNkatha yesiZweeeMilinganiselo yokwazisa izinga lomgca oyiyo onqwenwa ukuba uvalwe ukusetyenziswa okuvela kuyo. Phuhiza indlela nendlela yokwenza imisebenzi ukumisela umgca oyiyo kwaye kulinganise ingozi komgqa oyiyo onqwenwa ukuba uvalwe. Phuhiza isiseko sedata esinxulumene nosetyenziso oluvela kumigca oyiyo ehlukileyo. Yingisa ukubhalisa kwiZiqikelelo neMilinganiselo yeliZwe yooMgca. Phuhiza ungenise isixhobo sokulinganisa iingozi ngokwenani nangokuhlobo kwicelo lokuvalwa kwemigqa. Nikeza inkxaso yobuchwepheshe nophando kuNdaba oLawulayo kwindalo yenkatha yemveliso evela koomgca oyiyo. Phuhiza imilinganiselo yemigaqo yokhuselekileyo le kompost kumgca oyiyo ondalo. Phanda ngeemveliso ezivela koomgca oyiyo nangokudidi iimfuno ngeemfuno ezigcinwa inxaxheba ukuqinisekisa ukuba imveliso ayitshatyzelwa. Phuhiza imigaqo yokulondoloza ngesiseko sendlela yokulondoloza nokuphatha umgca oyiyo onengozi. Phuhiza ungenise isikhokelo sendlela yokusebenza ngeemfuno kumakhaladi asetyenziswa ekungeniseni iicelo zokuvalwa kwemigqa.

jobs.title: Scientist Production Grade A: Geohydrology
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Produce geohydrological analysis to support waste management licensing applications at the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor’s of Science Honours degree as recognised by SAQA, plus three (3) years’ post qualification experience in natural science. Compulsory registration with SACNASP as a professional Natural Science. Knowledge of Climate Change adaptation and mitigation. Must understand the policy and legislative framework governing pollution and waste management. Sound analytical and research skills. Ability to manage and plan for activities, including projects and policy matters. Knowledge and experience in contract management. Ability to develop, interpret and apply polices, strategies and legislation. Good interpersonal relations skills, Stakeholder engagement, Strategic Capability and Leadership skills. Knowledge of National Waste Management Strategy. The incumbent must be able to work independently and efficiently under pressure as well as part of a multidisciplinary team. A valid Driver’s license and willingness to travel.
jobs.duties: Review and analyse geohydrological information to support the approval of engineering drawing and designs submitted for new waste management license applications, variations and 24G applications. Develop and implement methodologies, policies, system and procedures for geohydrological information products and applications to be utilised in the review and analysis of geohydrological studies. Gather, analyse and disseminate geohydrological information to support the Directorate in reviewing applications and assessing the performance of licensed sites. Provide support in approving design drawings and engineering for expansion of listed waste activity or any modification on licensed facilities. Process registration in terms of National Norms and Standards and the exclusion authorisation. Reviews climate change geohydrology and climate change studies that accompanies waste licence applications.

af.title: Wetenskaplike Produksie Graad A: Geohidrologie
af.summary: Produseer geohidrologiese ontleding om afvalbestuurslisensie-aansoeke by die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria te ondersteun.
af.requirements: Bachelor's of Science Honours-graad soos deur SAQA erken, plus drie (3) jaar se ervaring na kwalifikasie in die natuurwetenskappe. Verpligte registrasie by SACNASP as 'n professionele Natuurwetenskaplike. Kennis van klimaatsverandering-aanpassing en -versagting. Moet die beleids- en wetgewingsraamwerk wat besoedeling en afvalbestuur reël, verstaan. Degelijke analitiese en navorsingsvaardighede. Vermoë om aktiwiteite, insluitend projekte en beleidsake, te bestuur en te beplan. Kennis en ervaring in kontrakbestuur. Vermoë om beleide, strategieë en wetgewing te ontwikkel, te interpreteer en toe te pas. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, strategiese vermoë en leierskapsvaardighede. Kennis van National Waste Management Strategy. Die ampsdraer moet in staat wees om onafhanklik en doeltreffend onder druk te werk, sowel as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis.
af.duties: Hersien en ontleed geohidrologiese inligting ter ondersteuning van die goedkeuring van ingenieurstekeninge en -ontwerpe wat vir nuwe afvalbestuurslisensiesies, variasies en 24G-aansoeke ingedien word. Ontwikkel en implementeer metodes, beleide, stelsels en prosedures vir geohidrologiese inligtingsprodukte en -aansoeke wat gebruik moet word in die hersiening en ontleding van geohidrologiese studies. Versamel, ontleed en versprei geohidrologiese inligting om die Direktoraat te ondersteun in die hersiening van aansoeke en die assessering van die prestasie van gelisensieerde terreine. Verskaf ondersteuning by die goedkeuring van ontwerptekeninge en ingenieurswese vir die uitbreiding van gelysde afvalbedrywighede of enige wysiging aan gelisensieerde fasiliteite. Verwerk registrasie in terme van National Norms and Standards en die uitsluitingsmagtiging. Hersien klimaatsverandering-geohidrologie en klimaatsveranderingstudies wat afvallisensie-aansoeke vergesel.

zu.title: Isayensi Yokuvelisa Izinga A: Igeohydrology
zu.summary: Kukhiwe uphando lwegeohydrology ukuze kusekelwe izicelo zelayisensi zokuphathwa kwezinkingi eDepartment of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zeBachelor's of Science Honours ezivunywe yiSAQA, kanye neminyaka emithathu (3) yemisebenzi ngemva kokuthola iziqu kwesayensi yemvelo. Ukuqanjuliswa okuyisibopho kwiSACNASP njengomuntu osebenzayo kwiSayensi Yemvelo. Ulwazi ngokuqondana nokubhekana noshintsho lwesimo sezulu. Kumele kuqonde uhlelo lwezinqubomgomo nezomthetho oluphatha ukungcoliswa nokuphathwa kwezinkingi. Amakhono aphelele okuhlola uphando nabakwazi ukuphatha nokuhlela imisebenzi, okuhlanganosa amaphrojekthi nezezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi nolwazi kumiswa wesivumelwano. Ukuba nakhono ukwakha, ukuhumusha nokusebenzisa izinqubomgomo, izindlela zokusebenza nomthetho. Amakhono amahle okuxhumanisa abantu, ukuthintana nabalalele, amakhono obuqhawe bokuhlela nokuba ngumholi. Ulwazi lweNational Waste Management Strategy. Umentshiwe kumele akwazi ukusebenza eyedwa ngesiphephelo ngaphansi kwenkuthazo kanye nokuba yingxenye eqoqweni elinemikhakha ehlukene. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile nokuzithoba ukuhamba.
zu.duties: Buka uphondo uhlolisise ulwazi lwegeohydrology ukuze usekele ukugqwethwa kwezithombe ezinjengoplani nezakhiwo ezithunyelwe izicelo ezintsha zelayisensi yokuphathwa kwezinkingi, izinto ezintsha nezicelo zika24G. Yakha uzuze izindlela, izinqubomgomo, izimiso nezinqubo zokukhiqiza ukusetshenziswa kolwazi lwegeohydrology kanye nezicelo ezizosetshenziswa ekubukeni nasekuhloliseni izifundo zegeohydrology. Qoqa, hlola ulwazi futhi lwabelwe abanye ukuze usekele iDirectorate ekubukeni izicelo nasekuqoqeni ukusebenza kwamasayithi alayisensi. Nikeza inkuseleko ekugqwetheni izithombe ezinjengoplani nakwizakhiwo zokwandiswa kokusebenza okubaliwe noma naliphi na ishintsho ezindaweni ezinelayisensi. Lungisa ukuqanjuliswa ngokweNational Norms and Standards nelayisensi yokukhishwa. Buka izifundo zegeohydrology zoshintsho lwesimo sezulu kanye nezifundo zoshintsho lwesimo sezulu ezihambisana nezicelo zelayisensi zezinkingi.

xh.title: Uphononongo lwe-Geohydrology: Iqela le-A: Inzululwazi lwemveli
xh.summary: Kwenze isigqibo solwazi lwe-geohydrology ukuxhasa iiaplikheshini zelayisensi yophando lwemfalanga kurhulumente wasePretoria.
xh.requirements: I-degree ye-Bachelor of Science Honours esemthethweni ngokwe-South African Qualifications Authority, kwaye ubenehlahlumba yangemva kokufumana isidanga kwi-natural science. Ukuze kubekho ukubhaliswa kwi-SACNASP njengomsebenzi we-Natural Science. Ukuyazi i-Climate Change adaptation and mitigation. Kufuneka uqonde iinqulo zolwazi kunye nemiqathango yolawulo ezilawula ukungcoliswa nokulawulwa kwe-falanga. Ikhono elilungeleleneyo lokwahlula-hlula nophando. Ikhono lokuphatha iindalo ezahlukeneyo, kuquka neeprojekthi neendaba zenqulo. Ulwazi nohlahlumba lohlalo lwemithetho ekulawuleni kontrakthi. Ikhono lokuphuhlisa, lokuqonda nokusebenzisa iinqulo, iindlela ezahlukeneyo nemithetho. Ikhono elilungeleleneyo lokuziphatha kakuhle nabantu, uluntu kwindibano nokuqonda iindlela ezahlukeneyo kunye nekhono lokulawula. Ulwazi nge-National Waste Management Strategy. Isebenza ngokuthe ngqo, lulwazi oluqondileyo, lusebenze ngaphantsi komgca wolwazi Iayisensi yokushayela ewusemthethweni nokulungela ukuhamba.
xh.duties: Phonononga lulwazi nge-geohydrology ngenxaso yemvume yokwamkelwa kweekharitha zofako kunye neendlela zolwenziwo ezithunyelwe kwiaplikheshini zitsha zelayisensi yokulawula imfalanga, iinguqu kunye ne-24G applications. Phuhlisa kunye nokusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo, iinqulo, iinkqubo kunye neenqubo zokwenza iimveliso zolwazi nge-geohydrology kunye neaplikheshini ezizakusetyenziswa ekuphononongeni nokusetyenziswa kwefundo nge-geohydrology. Qokelela, uluhlelo lulwazi ngophononongo lwe-geohydrology ukuxhasa iDirektorate ekuphononongeni iiaplikheshini nakuhlolweni komthamo wemisebenzi kwiindawo ezinelayisensi. Nikela ngenxaso ekuvumeleni amakhadi ayilwe kufako kunye nophando lwezo-fwalo kwandiso lomsebenzi wefalanga obhalisiweyo nanayo nayiphi na enye into_utshintsho kwiindawo ezinelayisensi. Qhubelela ubhaliso ngokomthetho we-Departments of National Norms and Standards kunye nevume yokukhutshwa kwayo. Phongononga i-climate change geohydrology nane-fundo ezidityaniswa ne-climate change ezingasebenza nayiphi na iaplikheshini zelayisensi yefalanga.

jobs.summary: Non-spatial Information Specialist role in Pretoria requiring a National Diploma in IT and three years' application and systems development experience.
jobs.requirements: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Information Technology or relevant qualification within the related field as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of three (3) years' experience in the in application and systems development or related experience. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Monitor and evaluate the implementation of change requests to ensure successful deployment and compliance with business requirements. Develop, test, and maintain database backup and disaster recovery plans to ensure business continuity. Provide staff supervision, technical guidance, and support while promoting knowledge sharing and adherence to best practices.

af.title: Nie-ruimtelike Inligtingspesialis
af.summary: Nie-ruimtelike Inligtingspesialis-pos in Pretoria wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in IT en drie jaar se toepassings- en stelselontwikkelingservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) in Inligtingstegnologie of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van drie (3) jaar se ervaring in toepassings- en stelselontwikkeling of verwante ervaring. Alle gekorte lys kandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voor-toetreedingsassesserings onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteits- (etiese gedrag) assessering wees. Bedrewe in Ruimtelike Data-analise-tegnieke. Kennis van IT-stelselsondersteuningsdienste, ITV-bestuur se wetgewende raamwerke, en die Stelselontwikkelingslewensiklus (SDLC). Kennis van datavisualiseringsinstrumente, outomatisering van kantoor en databasisbestuur. Kennis van projekbestuur. Deeglike kennis van besigheidsprosesanalise en besigheidsvereiste-analise. Probleemoplossing en analitiese metodes. Uitstekende organisatoriese en beplanningsvaardighede. Kommunikasievermoë met sterk mondelingse en skriftelike vaardighede. Vermoë om inligting doeltreffend in te samel, te ontleed en te interpreteer. Vermoë om beleide en prosedures te ontwikkel, te implementeer en toe te pas. In staat om selfstandig sowel as saam met 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Ontwerp, ontwikkel en onderhou tegniese spesifikasies vir besigheidstoepassings. Voer besigheidsvereiste-analise uit en vertaal vereistes in funksionele en tegniese spesifikasies. Opstel, hersien en finaliseer stelselintegrasievereistes en toepassingsfunksionaliteit. Ontwikkel, onderhou en verbeter toepassingsstelselkoppelvlakke om naatlose integrasie tussen stelsels te verseker. Voer voorkomende instandhouding op bestaande toepassings uit om stelselstabiliteit te verbeter en toekomstige probleme te voorkom. Inisieer, ontwikkel en onderhou geoutomatiseerde statistiese verslagdoeningsoplossings om besigheidsbesluitneming te ondersteun. Verskaf innoverende IT-oplossings om besigheidsuitdagings aan te spreek en operasionele doeltreffendheid te verbeter. Monitor en evalueer die implementering van veranderingsversoeke om suksesvolle ontplooiing en nakoming van besigheidsvereistes te verseker. Monitor, ondersoek en los stelselfoute en foubemeldings op om stelselbeskikbaarheid en prestasie te handhaaf. Administreer gebruikerstoegang, sekuriteitsregte en stelselbeheer in ooreenstem met organisatoriese sekuriteitsbeleide. Evalueer sterktes, swakhede, risiko's en integrasievermoëns van die stelsel om geleenthede vir deurlopende verbetering te identifiseer. Evalueer die voordele en nadele van pasgemaakte ontwikkelde oplossings teenoor kommersiële van-die-rak (COTS) produkte en verskaf aanbevelings. Ontwerp en implementeer databasisstrategieë, monitor databasisgesondheid, optimiseer prestasie, en beplan vir toekomstige kapasiteits- en skaalbaarheidsvereistes. Werk saam met die GIS-span om ruimtelike en nie-ruimtelike data te integreer. Bestuur databasismigrasies, opgraderings en data-integriteit deurlopend tydens die migrasieproses. Ontwikkel, toets en onderhou databasisrugsteun- en rampherstelplanne om besigheidskontinuïteit te verseker. Verskaf personeeltoesig, tegniese leiding en ondersteuning terwyl kennisdeling en nakoming van beste praktyke bevorder word.

zu.summary: Isikhundla se-Non-spatial Information Specialist ePretoria esidinga i-National Diploma kwi-IT kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava ekuthuthukisweni kwezinhlelomshini nakwezinhlelo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwe-Information Technology noma isiqu esihambelanayo ezinkundleni eziyisidingo njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Umkhawulo ongaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) yamava enkundleni yohlelo lwezinhlelomshini noma amava ahambelanayo. Bonke abagqajiwe, kuhlanganise ne-SMS, bazodinga ukwenza izivivinyo ezimbili zangaphambilini kokuqasha. Esinye sizonjululwa ngomzamo wokwenza okubonisa ukufaneleka komuntu oqashiwe ngokusobekile nokuhlelwa kwemisebenzi yobuchwepheshe, okunye kumele kubwe ukuvivinywa kobuqotho (ukuziphatha ngokwenene). Ubuchwepheshe bokuhlaziya amasu olwazi lwesikhala. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yensisesekho ye-Supply Management Information systems; guqula imithetho yokuphatha le ICT; futhi inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwezinhlele (SDLC). Ulwazi ngamathuluzi okubuka idatha, ukuzenzakalela kohlelo futhi ulawulo lwamathuluzi amakhulu amakhulu olwazi. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwepulojekthi. Ulwazi oluhle lokuhlaziya inqubo yebhizinisi, kanye nokuhlaziya izidingo zebhizinisi. Indlela zokuxazulula izinkinga nenzela yokuhlaziya. Amakhono amahle okuhleleza nokuqamba. Amakhono okuxhumana anzela ethukuthele nangokubhala. Ikono lokuthola, ukuhlaziya, nokuhumusha imininingwane ngempumelelo. Ikono lokwakha, ukusebenzisa, futhi ukusebenzisa izinto ezidingwa ukuzenzele. Ikono lokusebenza nokubumbene kuye ngokufuna inhlangano ekhonza isidingo sokuphendula kwezidingo eziyingxenye yomtholampilo wezinsizakalo.
zu.duties: Hlola, uthuthukise futhi agcine izinkomba zobuchwepheshe zezinhlelomshini zebhizinisi. Qamba ukuhlaziya izidingo zebhizinisi uze uhumushe izidingo zibe yizinkomba ezisebenzayo nangobuchwepheshe. Bhala, uhlole, futhi uqedele izidingo zokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlele nezinkomba zokusebenza kwezinhlelomshini. Thuthukisa, gcina, futhi uthuthukise amaphuzu ahlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhlanganiswa okuhamba kahle phakathi kwezinhlele. Yenza ukugcinwa okuvikelayo kwezinhlelo ezikhona ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuzinza kwezinhlele kugwenywe izinkinga zomphela. Qala, thuthukisa, futhi gcine izixazululo zokubika izibalo ezenziwe ngokuzenzakalela ukuze sekela ukuthathwa kwezinqumo zebhizinisi. Nika izixazululo zobuchwepheshe be-IT ezintsha ukuze ziphathwe izinkinga zebhizinisi futhi kuthuthukiswe ukusebenza kahle. Bheka futhi uhlole ukuphathwa kwezicelo zoshintsho ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufakwa okupumelelo nokuhambisana nezidingo zebhizinisi. Bheka, phenya, futhi uxazulule amaphutha ezinhlele namaphutha okubika ukuze kugcinwe ukutholakala nokusebenza kwezinhlele. Phatha ukufinyelela komsebenzisi, izimvume zokuphepha, futhi ulawule izinhlele ngokuhambisana namapholisi wezokuphepha entshweni. Linganisa amandla, izobuciko, imingcele yokusingathwa kolwazi, namakhono okuhlanganisa ibhizinisi ukuze kutholwe amathuba okuthuthukiswa ngokukuqhubekayo. Hlola izinzuzo nobubi bezixazululo ezenziwe ngokwezifiso uma kuqathaniswa nemikhiqizo yokuthengwa ebhokisini (COTS) futhi unike izr axazululo. Hlola futhi usebenzise izindlela zokulawula idatha yamathenotha, bheka impilo yedatha yamathenotha, uthuthukise ukusebenza kahle, futhi uhlelele amandla okwamukeleka kanye nolwazi oludingekayo kwesikhathi esizayo. Sebenzisana neqembu le-GIS ukuze kuhlanganiswe idatha yesikhala nengesikhala. Phatha ukudlulisa, ukuthuthukisa futhi ugcine ukuqiniseka kwedatha kuyo yonke inqubo yokuhamisa idatha. Thuthukisa, hlola, futhi gcine amaphulani okulondoloza imibuyiso yedatha yamathenotha kanye nokuqhubekela phambili kwentela kokwenza ibhizinisi liphile lokuqinisekisa ukuthi ibhizinisi liyaqhubeka. Nika abasebenzi ukuhlakanipha, iholelo lobuchwepheshe, kanye nensesekelo kuyilawula futhi kukhuthaza ukwabelana ngolwazi kanye nokuhambisana ngendlela ezilandelwayo ezinhle.

xh.title: Isikhoki Seenkcazolo Ezingeyo yendawo
xh.summary: Indima yesikhoki seenkcazolo ezingeyo yendawo ePretoria efuna iNational Diploma kwi-IT namashumi amathathu eminyaka yamava ngokusetyenziswa nentluthazo yeenkqubo.
xh.requirements: National Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwiteknoloji yolwazi okanye izifundo ezithinteleleyo kummandla onxulumene nalo njengoko zivunywa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane beminyaka emithathu (3) yamava ekusetyenzisweni nasekuntluthazweni kweenkqubo okanye amava ahambelana nalo. Onke amagqabantshintshi aluhlwayo, kuquka ne-SMS, kuya kwenza iziphononongo ezimbini zangaphambi kongeno. Enya kuya kuba bubuzima obuzilolongo ukumisela ukufaneleka kagqabantshintshi ngokusekwe kwiimfuno ezibuchwepheshhe nobungathanga zenkundla, kwaye enye kufuneka ibe siphononongo sokuziphatha (ngokwenene). Ukukrelekhona kwiSpatial Data Analysis Techniques. Ulwazi ngamasebenzi oxhaso lweenkqabo ze-IT, iindlela zomthetho zolawulo lwe-ICT, kunye neSystems Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Ulwazi ngeeData visualisation tools, office automation nokulawula idatabase. Ulwazi ngolawulo lweenqobo. Ulwazi olusulungekileyo ngokuhlalutywa kweenkqubo zoshishino, naku hlalutywa kweemfuno zoshishino. Iindlela zoku solving iziphinxo nezenkqubo zohlalutyo. Amabugu aguquguqukileyo akuqhelaniso nokuqamba. Amandla okunxibelelana anamandla okuthetha nokubhalayo. Amandlaokuqokelela, ukuhlalutya, nokutolika inkcazelo ngokusebenzayo. Amandla okuqamba, okusebenzisa, nokusebenzisa iindlela zokusebenza neenkqubo. Amandla okusebenza kodwa kunye nalowo osebenzisana nabakunye qela.
xh.duties: Yila, yahlaze, kwaye ugcine izicatshulwa zobuchwephetshe zokusebenziswa kobushishino. Yenza uhlalutyo lweemfuno zoshishino uze uwaguqulelele kumgca wamagqabantshintshi ngemisebenzi. Yahlathanisa, uqamba, kwaye ugqibe ngemigaqo yokudityaniswa kweenkqubo namandla okusebenza okusetyenziswa. Yila, ugcine, kwaye uphucule iindlela zodityaniso lwenkqubo ukuqinisekisa ukuba kudityaniswa ngokulula phakathi kweenkqubo. Yenza ulondolozo olungangeni kubucala kwimisebenzi ekhoyo ukuphucula ukuzinza kwenkqubo nokuthintela iingxaki eziza. Qalisa, yila, kwaye ugcine izisombululo ezizilolongo zokubika izibalo ngokuzenzekelayo ukuxhasa izigqibo zoshishino. Yezela iindlela ezintsha ze-IT ukuyakuliswa iingxaki zoshishino nokuphucula ukusebenza kakuhle. Qaphela kwaye uhlola ukusebenza kwezicelo zoshintsho ukuqinisekisa ukuziswa ngempumelelo nokuhambelana neemfuno zoshishino. Qaphela, uphande, kwaye usombulule iimpazamo zenkqubo neendaba zempazamo ukugcina ukubakho kwenkqubo ncedo. Lawula ukufikelela kumsebenzisi, iimvume zokhuseleko, kwaye ulawule inkqabo ngokwemigaqo yokhuseleko yoshishino. Hlola amandla nokungakhuseleki kwenkqubo, iingozi, namandla okudityanisa ukumisela ithuba elihle lokuziphucela. Hlola iingenelo kunye neembuyamongo zemiselwe ezisombululwa kumthengi kunezingeniso zemveliso ezifumaneka kwindlu kwaye unike iingcebiso. Yila kwaye usebenzise iindlela ze-database, qaphela impilo ye-database, wenze ukusebenza kuhle, kwaye ulungiselela izikhululo zomthengi (3) namashumi amathathu (3) kwixa elizayo. Sebenzisana neqela le-GIS ukuzidibanisa i-data engeyondawo nendawo. Lawula iindlela zokudlulisa idatha, ukuphucula idatha, kwaye ugcine ukusebenziseka kwayo ngalo lonke ixesha lodluliso. Yila, uvavanye, kwaye ugcine iindlela zokulondoloza idatha zodwa ezigqibeleleyo zokulawulo iingxaki zekhaya zoshishino nokuqinisekisa ukusuka kubomi. Xinzelela kuqeqesho labasebenzi, inika isalathiso sobuchwephetshe, naxhaso ngelixa ukhuthaza ukwabelwana kolwazi nokuthobela imigaqo yezona ndlela.

jobs.title: Environmental Officer Specialised Production: Licensing
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Manage waste management licences and associated applications within the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate Honours degree (NQF8) in Natural/Environmental Sciences or relevant qualification as recognised by SAQA coupled with a minimum of three (3) years’ experience in the relevant field. Knowledge of environmental policies, legislation and regulation development, including waste and pollution policies. Understanding of licensing processes and National Waste Management Strategy. Understanding of registration processes in terms National Norms and Standards for Waste. Ability to apply environmental policies. Understanding of EIA regulations and Waste Information Regulations. Ability to work independently and in a team. Ability to lead multidisciplinary team. Good interpersonal relations skills. Ability to work under extreme pressure. Conflict management and resolution. Ability to organize and plan under pressure. Ability to collect and interpret information and reports.
jobs.duties: Process/ manage waste management licences and associated applications; registrations and exclusion authorisation. Ensure that licences and associated decisions, exclusion authorisations and registrations are loaded on the EDMS, SAWIC and any platform made available. Report on performance of directorate. Screening of licence applications, registration request in terms of National Norms and Standards and exclusions applications. Maintain and Keep record of all registration request, exclusions and licence application and associated reports. Maintain and keep all the records of decisions and correspondence that relate to licensing system. To support directorate in the implementation of Standard Operating Procedure for managing applications. Manage schedule for reviews, site visits, Monitoring Committee Meeting; preapplication meeting, PAIA request and 24G Fine Committee meetings. Develop and implement tracking tool for waste applications.

af.title: Omgewingsbeampte Gespesialiseerde Produksie: Lisensiëring
af.summary: Bestuur afvalbestuurlisensies en gepaardgaande aansoeke binne die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Toepaslike Honneursgraad (NQF8) in Natuur-/Omgewingswetenskappe of 'n relevante kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken, tesame met 'n minimum van drie (3) jaar se ondervinding in die tersaaklike veld. Kennis van omgewingsbeleid, wetgewing en regulasie-ontwikkeling, insluitend afval- en besoedelingsbeleid. Begrip van lisensiëringsprosesse en die Nasionale Afvalbestuurstrategie. Begrip van registrasieprosesse in terme van Nasionale Norme en Standaarde vir Afval. Vermoë om omgewingsbeleid toe te pas. Begrip van EIA-regulasies en Afvalinligtingsregulasies. Vermoë om onafhanklik en in 'n span te werk. Vermoë om 'n multidissiplinêre span te lei. Goed interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Vermoë om onder uiterste druk te werk. Konflikbestuur en -oplossing. Vermoë om onder druk te organiseer en te beplan. Vermoë om inligting en verslae in te samel en te interpreteer.
af.duties: Verwerk en bestuur afvalbestuurslisensies en gepaardgaande aansoeke; registrasies en uitsluitingsmagtiging; Verseker dat lisensies en gepaardgaande besluite, uitsluitingsmagtigings en registrasies op die EDMS, SAWIC en enige beskikbare platform gelaai word; Rapporteer oor die prestasie van die direktoraat; Sif van lisensie-aansoeke, registrasieversoeke in terme van Nasionale Norme en Standaarde en uitsluitingsaansoeke; Onderhou en bewaar rekord van alle registrasieversoeke, uitsluitings en lisensie-aansoeke en gepaardgaande verslae; Onderhou en bewaar alle besluit- en korrespondensierekords wat op die lisensiëringsstelsel betrekking het; Ondersteun die direktoraat met die implementering van Standaardbedryfsprosedures vir die bestuur van aansoeke; Bestuur skedule vir hersienings, terreinbesoeke, Moniteringskomiteevergaderings, voor-aansoekvergaderings, PAIA-versoeke en 24G-boetekomiteevergaderings; Ontwikkel en implementeer 'n opsporingstrument vir afvalaansoeke.

zu.title: Ononothi Bemovalo Ekhiqizweni Okukhethekile: Amalayisense
zu.summary: Phatha amalayisense okuphathwa kwemfucu nezinye izicelo ezihambisana nawo ngaphakathi kwabakwa-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Honours ezifanelekile (NQF8) kwezEzenzululwazi zemvelo/Kwezemovalo noma noma yisiphi isiqu esihambisana nesithandwa i-SAQA kanye nokuthola okungaphansi kweminyaka emithathu (3) yamava enkundleni ehambisana naleyo. Ulwazi ngemigomo yemovalo, umthetho nentuthuko yemithetho yokuqondisa, okuhlanganisa imigomo yemfucu nokungcoliswa. Ukuqonda izinqubo zamalayisense kanye ne-National Waste Management Strategy. Ukuqonda izinqubo zokubhalisa ngokuka-National Norms and Standards for Waste. Ikono lokusebenzisa imigomo yemovalo. Ukuqonda imithetho ye-EIA Regulations ne-Waste Information Regulations. Ikono lokusebenza ngodwa nangaphakathi kwethimba. Ikono lokuhola ithimba elinezinhlobo ezahlukene zobuchwepheshe. Amakhono amahle wobudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo olumangalisayo. Ukuphatha nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikono lokuhlela futhi ucubungule ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ikono lokuqoqa futhi uchaze ulwazi namabhaphothe.
zu.duties: Hlela/ phatha amalayisense okuphathwa kwemfucu nezinye izicelo ezihambisana nawo; ubhaliso negunya lokukhansela. Qinisekisa ukuthi amalayisense nezinqumo ezihambisana nawo, amagunya okukhansela noyajwayele ubhaliso kufakwa ku-EDMS, i-SAWIC nakuyo yonke enye inkundla etholakalayo. Mbika ngemisebenzi yeqoqo lezindaba. Hlola izicelo zamalayisense, izicelo zokubhalisa ngokuka-National Norms and Standards kanye nezicelo zokukhansela. Gcina ulwazi mayelana nazo zonke izicelo zokubhalisa, ukukhansela nezicelo zamalayisense kanye namabhaphothe ahambisana nawo. Gcina zonke izinto zebhaphothe zezinqumo nokuxhumana ezithinta isistimu yamalayisense. Ukusekela iqoqo lezindaba ekusetshenzisweni kwe-Standard Operating Procedure ekuphathweni kwezicelo. Phatha uhlelo lokubuyekeza, ukuvakashela izindawo, amaqoqo okubuka ngemihlangano; imihlangano yangaphambi kokufaka isicelo, izicelo ze-PAIA namahlelo e-24G Fine Committee. Yakha futhi usebenzise ithuluzi lokulandelisa izicelo zemfucu.

xh.title: IOfisa yendalo ekukhiqizeni ngendlela ezijwayelekileyo: Ukunika ilayisenisi
xh.summary: Phatha iilayisenisi zolawulo lwegbagba nemiselo ephantsi kwesebe le-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ePretoria.
xh.requirements: I Degree yesidanga (NQF8) kwiiZayensi eZilozendalo/Zendalo okanye nangomfuno ofaneleyo njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA ekunye naminimbatho yeminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kwinkundla efaneleyo. Ulwazi lweenqobo zemigaqo zendalo, umthetho nentluko yokuqamba, kuquka neenqobo zemigaqo zogqitho lwegbagba nolwahluzo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokunika ilayisenisi neNamahla wesiZwe ngolawulo lwegbagba. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zokubhalisa ngokwemiGaqo nemiZalathiso yesiZwe ngeGbagba. Ukuba nakho ukusebenzisa iinqobo zemigaqo zendalo. Ukuqonda imigaqo ye-EIA nemiQaliso yolwazi ngeGbagba. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza kodwa nangaphakathi kwiqela. Ukuba nakho ukulatha iqela elinabasebenzi abanemimandla eyahlukeneyo. Amaphezulu amava obudlelwane phakathi kwabantu. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo olumandla. UkuLawula nokusombulula iingxabano. Ukuba nakho ukulungelelanisa nokuqamba ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ukuba nakho ukuqokelela nokutolika inkcazelo nemiQaliso.
xh.duties: Ukuqhuba/ukulawula iilayisenisi zolawulo lwegbagba nemiselo ephantsi; ukubhalisa nokuqinisekisa ukutshiya. Qinisekisa ukuba iilayisenisi nezigqibo eziphantsi, iziqinisekiso zokutshiya nokubhalisa zifakelwa ku-EDMS, SAWIC nakuliphi na ijelo elifumanekayo. Mela ngemisebenzi yedirectorate. Ukucwangcisa iimiselo yelayisenisi, izicelo zokubhalisa ngokwemiGaqo nemiZalathiso yesiZwe nezenzo zokutshiya. Ukugcina nokulondoloza irekhodi yazo zonke iisicelo zokubhalisa, izicelo zokutshiya nezicelo zelayisenisi nokuzele iimveliso. Ukugcina nokuzelela zonke iirekhodi zeSigqibo nolwabaxhaso olunxulumene nenkqubo yelayisenisi. Ukuxhasa idirectorate ekusebenzeni kwenkqubo yeStandard Operating Procedure ngokuphatha iimiselo. Phatha uluhlu lokuqamba, iindwendwe zasendaweni, iintlanganiso ze-Monitoring Committee; iintlanganiso zangaphambi kwe-application, iisicelo ze-PAIA nentlangano ye-24G Fine Committee. Yakha uze usebenzise isixhobo sokulandela iimiselo yegbagba.

jobs.title: Legal Administration Officer (MR3): Fisheries Policy and
jobs.department: Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment
jobs.summary: Legal Administration Officer needed to process fishing rights transfer applications, conduct legal research and draft reports for the Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
jobs.requirements: LLB Degree or relevant equivalent qualification as recognized by SAQA. Two (2) years appropriate post qualification legal experience. Knowledge of the Marine Living Resources Act, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Protection of Personal Information Act, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, Administrative Law and Constitution and constitutional law. Knowledge and experience in drafting legal documents. Applicant must have knowledge of laws of contract and delict, principles of interpretation of statutes. Skills in dispute resolution, case flow management and innovative and analytical thinking.
jobs.duties: Process transfer of Fishing Rights or Rights applications in terms of section 21 of the MLRA. Receive, examine and validate applications for the transfer of fishing rights. Conduct legal research to gather relevant information and case laws. Draft reports as provided for in terms of Regulation 5(3) of the Regulations promulgated under the Marine Living Resources Act, 1998 (Act No. 18 of 1998). Draft requests for legal opinions and liaise with Legal Services. Provide legal guidance to stakeholders on the fisheries legal framework and respond to enquiries. Provide legal advice and legal administrative support to review and develop Fisheries Policies. Conduct legal research and analysis to inform the review and the drafting of fisheries policies. Provide legal guidance in drafting of fisheries policies for public comments and participate in stakeholders’ consultation processes. Provide legal guidance during the drafting of Socio-Economic Impact Analysis (SEIAS). Provide legal guidance in consideration of comments and responses on the draft fisheries policies and compile final fisheries policies for approval. Provide legal coordination and legal administrative support on Fishing Rights Allocation process. Provide legal guidance during the review and drafting of application forms for fishing rights in accordance with applicable legislation and legal principles. Provide legal support on performance of reviews of fisheries post the allocation of fishing rights. Provide legal guidance in drafting briefing notes and presentations for Minister, Portfolio Committee and Senior Management. Provide legal administrative support to Consultative Advisory Forum (CAF) and/or Fisheries Transformation Council (FTC). Render legal support to implement recommendations of the CAF and/or FTC.

af.title: Regadministratiewe Beampte (MR3): Visseryebeleid en
af.summary: Regadministratiewe Beampte benodig om oordragtoepassings vir visregte te verwerk, regsnavorsing te doen en verslae op te stel vir die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
af.requirements: LLB-graad of relevante gelykwaardige kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Twee (2) jaar toepaslike postkwalifikasie regterlike ervaring. Kennis van die Marine Living Resources Act, Promotion of Access to Information Act, Protection of Personal Information Act, Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, Administratiewe Reg en die Grondwet en grondwetlike reg. Kennis en ervaring in die opstel van regsdokumente. Aansoeker moet kennis hê van kontrakte- en delikreg, en beginsels van die interpretasie van wette. Vaardighede in geskillebeslegting, sakevloei-bestuur en inniewatiewe en analitiese denke.
af.duties: Verwerk die oordrag van Visregte of Regte-toepassings ingevolge artikel 21 van die MLRA. Ontvang, ondersoek en bevestig toepassings vir die oordrag van visregte. Doen regsnavorsing om tersaaklike inligting en gevallereg te versamel. Stel verslae op soos voorsien in terme van Regulasie 5(3) van die Regulasies afgekondig onder die Marine Living Resources Act, 1998 (Act No. 18 of 1998). Stel versoeke vir regsmenings op en skakel met Regsdiens. Verskaf regterlike leiding aan belanghebbendes oor die regskader vir visserye en reageer op navrae. Verskaf regadvies en regadministratiewe ondersteuning om Visseryebeleide te hersien en te ontwikkel. Doen regsnavorsing en -analise om die hersiening en opstel van visseryebeleide in te lig. Verskaf regterlike leiding by die opstel van visseryebeleide vir openbare kommentaar en neem deel aan konsultasieprosesse met belanghebbendes. Verskaf regterlike leiding tydens die opstel van Sosio-ekonomiese Impakanalise (SEIAS). Verskaf regterlike leiding by die oorweging van kommentaar en terugvoer oor die konsepvisseryebeleide en stel finale visseryebeleide vir goedkeuring op. Verskaf regterlike koördinering en regadministratiewe ondersteuning by die toedelingsproses van Visregte. Verskaf regterlike leiding tydens die hersiening en opstel van aansoekvorms vir visregte ooreenkomstig toepaslike wetgewing en regsbeginsels. Verskaf regsondersteuning by die uitvoering van hersienings van visserye na die toedeling van visregte. Verskaf regterlike leiding by die opstel van kennigsgewende notas en aanbiedings vir die Minister, Portefeuljekomitee en Senior Bestuur. Verskaf regadministratiewe ondersteuning aan die Consultative Advisory Forum (CAF) en/of Fisheries Transformation Council (FTC). Lewer regsondersteuning om aanbevelings van die CAF en/of FTC te implementeer.

zu.title: I-Legal Administration Officer (MR3): Fisheries Policy and
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Legal Administration Officer ukucubungula izicelo zokudluliswa kwamalungelo okwelashwa, ukuqhuba uphando lomthetho futhi abhale imibiko umnyango we-Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment.
zu.requirements: I-degree ye-LLB noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezifanele njengoba zihlonipha i-SAQA. Iminyaka emibili (2) yohlelo lokusebenza olufanele emthethweni ngemva kweziqu. Ulwazi nge-Marine Living Resources Act, i-Promotion of Access to Information Act, i-Protection of Personal Information Act, i-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, i-Administrative Law ne-Constitution kanye nomthetho we-constitution. Ulwazi noluhlelokusebenza ekubhaleni amadokhumenti omthetho. Umfundi kumele abe lolwazi ngemithetho yekhonthuleka nedelict, imigomo yokuhumusha izinqomu somthetho. Amakhono ekuxazululen imikhabela, ekuphathweni kokuqhubeka kwamache kanye nokucabanga okutsha nokuqondo.
zu.duties: Cubungula izicelo zokudluliswa kwamalungelo okuba noma amalungelo okwelashwa ngokusho kwesigaba 21 se-MLRA. Yamukela, hlola futhi qinisekise izicelo zokudluliswa kwamalungelo okwelashwa. Yenza uphando lomthetho ukuze uqoqe ulwazi olufanele namacala. Bhala imibiko njengoba kuhlinzekwe ngokusho kuka-Regulation 5(3) we-Regulations ashumiwe ngaphansi kwe-Marine Living Resources Act, 1998 (Act No. 18 of 1998). Bhala izicelo zemibono yomthetho uxhumane ne-Legal Services. Nikeza iseluleko somthetho kubathintekayo ngohlelo lomthetho lokwelashwa uphendule imibuzo. Nikeza izeluleko zomthetho nokwesekwa kokuphathwa komthetho ukuze uhlolo uthuthukise izinqubomgomo ze-Fisheries. Yenza uphando lomthetho nanhlaziya ukuze wazise ukubuyekezwa nokubhala kwezinqubomgomo ze-fisheries. Nikeza iseluleko somthetho ekubhaleni izinqubomgomo ze-fisheries ezimayelana nezimemo zomphakathi futhi uthathe inhlalo enkombandlela yokuxhumana nabathintekayo. Nikeza iseluleko somthetho ngesikhathi sokubhala kwe-Socio-Economic Impact Analysis (SEIAS). Nikeza iseluleko somthetho ekucubungulweni kwemibiko nezimpendulo ezinqubomgomo zokuqamba ze-fisheries uhlanganise izinqubomgomo zokugcina ze-fisheries zokuqinisekiswa. Nikeza ukuhleleka komthetho nokwesekwa kokuphathwa komthetho enkombandleleni yokwabiwa kwamalungelo okwelashwa. Nikeza iseluleko somthetho ngesikhathi sokubuyekezwa nokubhala kwamafomu izicelo amalungelo okwelashwa ngokuvumelana nomthetho osebenzayo nemigomo yomthetho. Nikeza okwesekwa komthetho ekubuyekezweni kwe-fisheries emva kokwabiwa kwamalungelo okwelashwa. Nikeza iseluleko somthetho ekubhaleni amanota okwazisa nemibukiso engxoxweni ye-Minister, i-Portfolio Committee ne-Senior Management. Nikeza okwesekwa kokuphathwa komthetho i-Consultative Advisory Forum (CAF) noma i-Fisheries Transformation Council (FTC). Nikeza okwesekwa komthetho ukuze kusetshenziswe izincomo ze-CAF noma i-FTC.

xh.title: iNgqaqa yoLawulo lweNkundla yoMthetho (MR3): iNgqango nokuSebenza kweNtlanzi kunye
xh.summary: Kufunekwa iNkundla yoLawulo lomthetho ukwenza iingeniselo eziskenza kwamalungelo okudweba iintlanzi, ilandelwe uphando lomthetho ize ibhale iingxelo kwiSebe leMihlathi, iNtlanzi neNdalo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-LLB okanye isiqu esihambelana neso esivunywa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka emibini (2) yamava obuchwephesha emthethweni emva kokufumana isidanga. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weziLwanyana eziPhilayo naManzi, uMthetho wokuPhanguliswa kwelwazi, uMthetho woKhuselo lweNkcazelo yokuNgqina, uMthetho woPhuhliso lwoBulungisa bolawulo, uMthetho woLawulo kunye noMthethosiseko nomthetho womthethosiseko. Ulwazi namava ekubhaliweni koxwebhu lomthetho. Kufuneka umkhuphi anelwe ulwazi ngomthetho wekontraki nongonyelwa, nemigaqo yokuconconisa iimithetho. Amandla ekuxazululeni iingxabano, ekulawuleni ukuhamba kwamacala nokuqamba ngakumbi nokuhlalutya iingcinga.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa iingeniselo zokuskenza kwamalungelo okudweba iintlanzi okanye iingeniselo zamalungelo ngokwesigaba se-21 se-MLRA. Wamkela, uphando uze uqinisekise iingeniselo ezikuskenza kwamalungelo okudweba iintlanzi. Yenza uphando lomthetho ukuze uqoke ulwazi oluhambelana nolamacala. Bhala iingxelo njengoko kuchazwa kwisigaba se-5(3) seZiguqulo ezishicilelwe ngaphantsi koMthetho wezeZilwanyana zasemanxwemeni, 1998 (uMthetho uNo. 18 ka-1998). Bhala iicelo ezifuna izimvo ngomthetho uze uxhumane neNkonzo yoMthetho. Nikeza inkathazo-ngqondo malunga nolwakhiwo lomthetho obalulekileyo kubathathi-nxaxheba kumthetho weentlanzi uphendule kwimibuzo. Nikeza ingcebiso ngomthetho inkxaso yentengiso yolawulo komthetho ukuphonononga nokuvelisa iNgqango zeentlanzi. Yenza uphando nokuhlalutya komthetho ukunikela isikhokelo ekuphononongeni nakubhalweni kweziguqo zeengqango zeentlanzi. Nikeza inkathazo-ngqondo ekubhalweni kweengqango zeentlanzi eziza kuziswa iingcinga zabantu nikwathi ubathathe inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuxoxisana nabathathi-nxaxheba. Nikeza inkathazo-ngqondo ngelixa kubhalwa isahlaziyo sokunzondo-ntlalwazi-nentsomi (SEIAS). Nikeza inkathazo-ngqondo kwisalathiso kuqwalaselo lweingcinga iimpendulo nasekuhlenzeni iingqango zokugqibela ukuvunywa. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo lomthetho kumachoko onokuskenza nokwabiwa kwamalungelo okudweba iintlanzi. Nikeza inkathazo-ngqondo ngelixa kokuphonononga nokubhala amafomu eengeniselo angamalungelo okudweba iintlanzi ngokwemithetho esebenzayo nemigaqo yomthetho. Nikeza inkxaso yomthetho ekwenzeni iindleko zophononongo lwezinthlanzi emva kokwabiwa kwamalungelo okudweba iintlanzi. Nikeza inkathazo-ngqondo ekubhalweni kwamanothi okunceda neemboniso ezenzelwa uNgqungqoshe, iKomiti yamagatya kunye noLawulo eliphezulu. Nikeza inkxaso yolawulo lomthetho kwiZiko loDibano eziLulekayo (CAF) nakwiBhunga lokuGuqula iNdlela ekuZingcwini (FTC). Nikeza inkxaso yomthetho ekusebenziseni iingcebiso ze-CAF kwaye nakwei-FTC.

af.title: Rekordklerk: Fasiliteite- en Administrasiedienste (X3
af.summary: Die Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment soek drie rekordklerke om inkomende lêers, posadministrasie en registrasieprosesse oor verskeie liggings te bestuur.

Kennis van dokumentbestuur, registrasieprosesse, lêeradministrasie en rekenaarpakkette. Vermoë om individueel en in 'n span te werk. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. zu.title: Inhloli Yamarekhodi: Izenzo Zokwakela Izinto Nezinkonzo Zokuphathwa (X3
zu.summary: I-Department of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment ifuna abahloli bamarekhodi abathathu ukuze babheke amafayela ase ngaphakathi, uphathwa kwemeli, kanye nenqubo ye-registry kuzo zonke izindawo ezahlukene.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aba-12. Ithuba lokuba nemitshikisibo emva kwesikolo samabanga aba-12 namava njengenhloli yamarekhodi kuzoba yinzuzo. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwamadokhumenti, inqubo ye-Registry, ukuphathwa kwezinto ezibhalwe phansi, namaphakheji wokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha. Ikono lokusebenza ngabanye nangaphakathi kwethimba. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Ikono lokusebenza nabantu abanzima, ubuqotho, nokwethembeka, kanye nekono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokuphathwa okusebenzayo kwamafayela ase ngaphakathi nokuvezwa kwamafayela. Vala ifayela lomsebenzi lapho umsebenzi eshintshelwa esinye isikhundla, eshothiwe noma esishiya umsebenzi. Mbuluza ikhasi lokulawula bese ubeka amadokhumenti ngokwenani. Uphathe ngokusebenzayo nangasesikhathini imeli ese ngaphakathi nese phandle. Tshepha yonke imeli namafomu anenani elibonakalayo ngaphambi kokuba asatshalaliswe. Sika imeli ukuze uninze intengo usebenzisa izinani ezibekiwe ezisetshenziswa uhlelo lweposi. Faka izinto zokuthunyelwa ngesikhungo somthunyazi kwabhaliwe bese uthuma kwesiteshi sokwamukela abantu ukuze ziyokolwa. Phatha amafayela aphuma ngaphandle. Faka amafayela aphuma ngaphandle encwadini yokubhalisa bese uqinisekisa ukuthi abathengi bayasayina. Uphatha ukulahwa nokususwa kwamafayela. Yamukela amadokhumenti okwesikhashana emahlebeni. Hlela ohlwini amafayela anenani lokulondoloza ezobe esethunyelwa ku-National Archive.

xh.summary: Isebe lezoLwathi, zoLwandle nendalo lifuna abahlali weerhe abathathu ukulawula iifayile ezingena, ulawulo lweposi nakunqubo yeregistri kwindawo ngeendawo ezahlukeneyo.

Tyala yonke iposti namaxwebhu abonisa ixabiso ngaphambi kokuba ahambiswe. Pesa iposti ukumisela ixabiso kusetyenziswa iinkqubo zemilinganiselo yophoso leposi. jobs.title: Assistant Director: Student Registration Services
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role managing student registration services, policies and procedures at the Department of Higher Education and Training Central Office.
jobs.requirements: An undergraduate qualification National Diploma (NQF Level 6) in Business Administration, Public Management/ administration or relevant qualification as recognized by SAQA. A minimum of 3-5 years in administration department. Driver’s license: Code B. Experience in the post schooling education and training (PSET) sector will be an added advantage. Competencies, Knowledge and Skills: Indicate the appropriate broad and specific knowledge required: Knowledge of registry duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, and operate computer. Working knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Knowledge of storage and retrieval procedures in terms of the working environment. Indicate the appropriate skill and level required: Proven report writing and presentation skills in the public sector and its legislation framework. Good communication skills and people Empowerment. Planning and execution. Proven computer literacy, including advanced MSWord, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint. Proven ability to effectively manage change. Leadership skill.
jobs.duties: Manage the administration of the overall student registration. Develop, review and monitor the implementation of policies and procedures in relation to student registration, admission, scheduling and records. Provides workshops on the implementation of policies and procedures in relation to student registration, admission, scheduling and records. Manage student registration and ensure proper procedures are followed. Develop and review registration documents for accuracy. Manage the database for new graduates and alumni into the job market. Maintain and update database of students enrolled within programmes. Ensure that student orientations are conducted into college and campuses. Ensure that learner’s information is captured on Information Technology System (ITS). Plan, coordinate, and manage the end-to-end student registration process for all programmes (NC(V), Report 191/NATED, Occupational, and Skills programmes). Develop and implement annual registration schedules, timelines, and procedures. Ensure compliance with DHET enrolment targets, reporting requirements, and NSFAS regulations. Oversee online and manual registration platforms and troubleshoot system issues. Manage student data capturing and verification on the ITS or equivalent Student Information System (SIS). Student Records and Data Integrity. Ensure the accuracy, completeness, and security of all student registration data and records. Maintain and update the Student Information System (SIS) in compliance with DHET EMIS reporting requirements. Compile and submit accurate student headcount, FTE, and enrolment reports to DHET, SETA, and other stakeholders. Manage the archiving and retrieval of student registration records in compliance with POPIA and institutional records management policies. Policy Compliance and Quality Assurance. Ensure all registration activities comply with DHET norms, standards, and relevant legislation (Skills Development Act, TVET Act, POPIA, etc.). Implement and monitor quality assurance processes for registration and student records management. Liaise with QCTO, Umalusi, SETAs, and DHET regarding programme registration and certification compliance. Conduct regular audits of student files and registration records to ensure accuracy and compliance. Staff Supervision and Development. Supervise, coach, and develop registration and records management staff. Conduct performance assessments and manage staff performance in line with PMDS/IQMS requirements. Assign duties and manage workloads within the registration unit. Identify training needs and facilitate development opportunities for subordinate staff. Reporting and Administration. Prepare and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual registration reports to management. Provide registration statistics and data analysis to support strategic planning and decision-making. Manage the registration unit budget and procurement of required resources. Attend and participate in relevant committees, management meetings, and planning sessions.
