af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Studenteregistrasiedienste
af.summary: Assistent-direkteurpos wat studenteregistrasiedienste, beleide en prosedures by die Departement of Higher Education and Training Sentrale Kantoor bestuur.
af.requirements: n Voorgraadse kwalifikasie Nasionale Diploma (NQF Vlak 6) in Besigheidsadministrasie, Publieke Bestuur/administrasie of 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 3-5 jaar in die administrasiedepartement. Bestuurslisensie: Kode B. Ervaring in die post-skoolse opvoeding en opleiding (PSET) sektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Bevoegdhede, Kennis en Vaardighede: Dui die toepaslike breë en spesifieke kennis aan wat vereis word: Kennis van registerpligte en -praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê en rekenaar te bedryf. Werkende kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Staatsdiens regeer. Kennis van berging en onttrekkingsprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing. Dui die toepaslike vaardigheid en vlak aan wat vereis word: Bewese verslagskryf- en voorleggingsvaardighede in die openbare sektor en sy wetgewende raamwerk. Goeie Kommunikasievaardighede en mensebemagtiging. Beplanning en uitvoering. Bewese rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend gevorderde MSWord, MS Excel en MS PowerPoint. Bewese vermoë om verandering doeltreffend te bestuur. Leierskapsvaardigheid.
af.duties: Bestuur die administrasie van die algehele studenteregistrasie. Ontwikkel, hersien en monitor die implementering van beleide en prosedures met betrekking tot studenteregistrasie, toelating, skedulering en rekords. Verskaf werkswinkels oor die implementering van beleide en prosedures met betrekking tot studenteregistrasie, toelating, skedulering en rekords. Bestuur studenteregistrasie en verseker dat behoorlike prosedures gevolg word. Ontwikkel en hersien registrasiedokumente vir akkuraatheid. Bestuur die databasis vir nuwe gegradueerdes en alumni in die arbeidsmark. Onderhou en dateer die databasis van studente wat binne programme ingeskryf het, op. Verseker dat studenteoriëntasies by kolleges en kampusse uitgevoer word. Verseker dat leerderinligting op die Inligtingstegnologië-stelsel (ITS) vasgelê word. Beplan, koördineer en bestuur die end-tot-end studenteregistrasieproses vir alle programme (NC(V), Report 191/NATED, Occupationele, en Vaardigheidsprogramme). Ontwikkel en implementeer jaarlikse registrasieskedules, tydlyne en prosedures. Verseker nakoming van DHET-inskrywingsteikens, verslagdoeningsvereistes en NSFAS-regulasies. Hou toesig oor aanlynskemaanse en handmatige registrasie-platforms en los stelselprobleme op. Bestuur studentedata-vastlegging en -verifikasie op die ITS of ekwivalente Studentinligtingstelsel (SIS). Studenterekords en data-integriteit. Verseker die akkuraatheid, volledigheid en sekuriteit van alle studenteregistrasiedata en -rekords. Onderhou en dateer die Studentinligtingstelsel (SIS) op in ooreenstemming met DHET EMIS-verslagdoeningsvereistes. Stel akkurate studentkopgetalle, FTE en inskrywingsverslae aan DHET, SETA en ander belanghebbendes op en dien dit in. Bestuur die argief en onttrekking van studenteregistrasierekords in ooreenstemming met POPIA en institusionele rekordbestuursbeleide. Beleidsnakoming en gehalteversekering. Verseker dat alle registrasie-aktiwiteite voldoen aan DHET-norme, standaarde en toepaslike wetgewing (Skills Development Act, TVET Act, POPIA, ens.). Implementeer en monitor gehalteversekeringsprosesse vir registrasie en studenterekordebestuur. Skakel met QCTO, Umalusi, SETAs en DHET rakende programregistrasie en sertifiseringsnakoming. Voer gereelde oudite van studentelêers en registrasierekords uit om akkuraatheid en nakoming te verseker. Personeeltoesig en -ontwikkeling. Hou toesig oor, afrig en ontwikkel registrasie- en rekordbestuurspersoneel. Voer prestasie-evaluerings uit en bestuur personeelprestasie in ooreenstemming met PMDS/IQMS-vereistes. Wys pligte toe en bestuur werkladings binne die registrasie-eenheid. Identifiseer opleidingsbehoeftes en fasiliteer ontwikkelingsgeleenthede vir ondergeskikte personeel. Verslagdoening en administrasie. Berei maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse registrasieverslae aan bestuur voor en dien dit in. Verskaf registrasie-statistiek en data-ontleding om strategiese beplanning en besluitneming te ondersteun. Bestuur die begroting van die registrasie-eenheid en die verkryging van benodigde hulpbronne. Woon toepaslike komitees, bestuursvergaderings en beplanningssessies by en neem daaraan deel.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlanganyele: Izinsizakusebenza Zokubhalisa Kwabafundi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi ohlanganyele esiphatha izinsizakusebenza, izinqubomgomo nenqubo yokubhalisa kwabafundi eKantolo LoMphakathi leDepartment of Higher Education and Training.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zezinga eliphansi i-National Diploma (NQF Level 6) ku-Business Administration, i-Public Management/administration noma iziqu ezifanele njengoba zivunyelwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3-5 esimnyangweni wokuphatha. Ilayisensi yokushayela: i-Code B. Uqeqesho esikhundleni se-post schooling education and training (PSET) kuzoba yinzuzo eyongeke. Ikhono, ulwazi namakhono abalulekile: Khombisa ulwazi olubanzi noluchaziwe olufunekayo: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokulondoloza amafayela, izindlela zokwenza kanye nesono sokufaka idatha, nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi olusebenzayo nokuqonda uhlelo lomthetho oluphethe Imphakathi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi lwenqubo yokugcina nokubuyisela ulwazi ngokwesimo sokusebenza. Khombisa ikhono elifanele nelinga elidingekayo: Amandla abonakalayo ekubhaleni imibiko nokubamba izinkulumo esikhundleni sabantu bomphakathi nolwesiqondiso lomthetho walo. Amandla angcono okuxhumana nokuqusasa abantu. Ukucubungula nokuphumeza. Ukusebenzisana ngekhompyutha okubonakalayo, okuhlanganisa i-MSWord ethuthukisiwe, i-MS Excel ne-MS PowerPoint. Ikhono elibonakalayo lokulawula izinguquko ngempumelelo. Ikhono lokubusa.
zu.duties: Phatha ukulawulwa kokubhalisa kwabafundi ngokuphelele. Hlola,buya ubuhele futhi ulawule ukuphunywa kwezinqubomgomo nenqubo ebandakanya ukubhalisa, ukwamukelwa, ukuhlela isikhathi namarekhodi abafundi. Hlinza izinkundla zokuhlangana ngokuphunywa kwezinqubomgomo nenqubo ebandakanya ukubhalisa kwabafundi, ukwamukelwa, ukuhlela isikhathi namarekhodi abafundi. Phatha ukubhalisa kwabafundi futhi uqiniseke ukuthi kulandelwa izinqubo ezifanele. Hlola kabusha futhi uhlole amadokhoda wokubhalisa ukuze abe nokuhamba kahle. Phatha idathabhesi yeziqu ezintsha nabanye abaphothule abangena emsebenzini. Gcina futhi ubuyekeze idathabhesi yabafundi ababhaliwe kumuhlelo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kwenziwa umqondo wokungena kwabafundi emakholiji nakwizikhungo. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwabafundi lifakwa kusistimu ye-Information Technology System (ITS). Hlela, hambisanisa, futhi uphathe inqubo yokubhalisa kwabafundi ngokuphelele yonke imihlelo (NC(V), Report 191/NATED, Occupational, kanye namuhlelo wamakhono). Hlola futhi uphumeze isikhathi sonyaka sokubhalisa, izikhathi nezinqubo. Qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemigomo yokubhalisa ye-DHET, izidingo zokubika, kanye nomthetho we-NSFAS. Qapha izinkundla zokubhalisa eziku-inthanethi nangokwesandla futhi ulungise izinkinga zesistimu. Phatha ukufakwa kohluko lwabafundi nokuhlolwa kwe-ITS noma isistimu efanayo yokuhlola ulwazi lwabafundi (SIS). Amarekhodi abafundi nokuzinza kohluko. Qinisekisa ukuhamba kahle, ukuphelela nokuphepha kwayo yonke idatha namarekhodi okubhalisa abafundi. Gcina futhi ubuyekeze i-Student Information System (SIS) ngokulandela izidingo zokubika ze-DHET EMIS. Qamba futhi uhlope imibiko eqinisekisiwe yabayini bengi, abayini abahamba isikhathi (FTE), kanye nemibiko yokubhalisa ebuyelwa ku-DHET, i-SETA, kubanye balabo abahilelekile. Phatha ukuqoshwa nokubuyiswa kwamarekhodi wokubhalisa ngokuthobela umthetho we-POPIA kanye nezinqubomgomo zasikhungo sokulawula amafayela. Ukuthobela inqubomgomo nokuqinisekiswa kwekhwalithi. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imisebenzi yokubhalisa ithobela imigomo, izindinganiso nomthetho othintekayo we-DHET (Skills Development Act, TVET Act, POPIA, njl.). Phumeza futhi ulawule izinqubo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yokubhalisa nokulawula amarekhodi abafundi. Xhumana ne-QCTO, i-Umalusi, i-SETA, ne-DHET ngenkomba yokubhalisa kumuhlelo nokuthobela imigomo yamakhadi. Yenza ukuhlolwa njalo kwamafayela abafundi namarekhoda wokubhalisa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ayahamba kahle futhi athobela imigomo. Ukubusa nokuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi. Phatha, uqeqeshe futhi uphuhlise abasebenzi bokubhalisa nokulawula amarekhodi. Yenza ukuhlolwa kokusebenza futhi ulawule ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokuvumelana nezidingo ze-PMDS/IQMS. Nikeza imisebenzi futhi ulawule isikhathi sabasebenzi ngaphakathi komnyango. Hlola izidingo zokuqeqeshwa futhi wenze izikhathi zokuphuhlisa abasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Ukubika nokuphatha. Lungisa futhi uhlope imibiko yokubhalisa nyanga zonke, kota, futhi yonk’ unyaka othunyelwa kubaphathi. Nikeza izibalo zokubhalisa nanalayizizi yedatha ukuze kusekela ukuhlela ngobuchule nokuthatha izinqumo. Phatha imali yokubhalisa yesikhungo kanye nokuthola izinsiza ezingezile. Hlangana futhi ubambe iqhaza emakomidi ahambisanayo, emihlanganweni yokuphatha nasemikhosini yokuha.

xh.title: Assistant Director: Student Registration Services
xh.summary: Indima ka Assistant Director yokulawula iinkonzo zobhaliso lwabafundi, iinkqubo neendlela kwi Department of Higher Education and Training Central Office.
xh.requirements: Iminikelo ngaphantsi kwesidanga se National Diploma (NQF Level 6) kwi Business Administration, Public Management/administration okwesidanga esiqondene nalo njengoko samkelwa yi SAQA. Iqondo elingaphantsi kweminyaka eli-3-5 kwisebe lolawulo. Ilayisensi yomqhubi: Code B. Amava kwesebe lefundo nokolungelelweni lokusebenza (PSET) kuya kuba luncedo elongezelekileyo. Ikhono, ulwazi nemakhono: Phawula ulwazi olubanzi neluchanekayo olufunekayo: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yerekhodo, iinkqubo, kunye namandla okusingatha iidata, ukusebenza ngokomnatha. Ulwazi olusebenzayo kuqonda kwesiseko somthetho silawula inkonzo kaRhulumente. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zogcino nokubuyiswa kwerekhodo ngokobeka bendawo yokusebenza. Phawula ikhono eluchanekayo nelulingeneyo elidingekayo: Ulwazi olubonisiweyo lokuvelisa iingxelo nobuchule bokubonisa ngaphakathi koluntu nokwesiseko somthetho waso. Ikhono elilungileyo lokunxibelelwana namandla okunkqublisa abantu. Ucwangciso nokwenza. Ulwazi olubonisiweyo lokusebenza ngomnatha, kuquka i MSWord, MS Excel kunye ne MS PowerPoint ngamandla aphezulu. Amandla abonisiweyo okulawula utshintsho ngokusebenzayo. Ikhono lokulawula.
xh.duties: Phatha ulawulo lobhaliso jikelele lwabafundi. Yenza, phinda uqwalasele kwaye ulawule ukusebenza kweenkqubo neendlela ezimalana nobhaliso lwabafundi, namkelo, uluhlu lwexesha kunye nerekhodo. Yaza iindaba ezimalana nokusebenza kweenkqubo neendlela ezimalana nobhaliso lwabafundi, namkelo, uluhlu lwexesha kunye nerekhodo. Lawula ubhaliso lwabafundi kuze kuqinisekiswe ukulandelwa kwendlela elungileyo. Yenza uphinda uqwalasele amaxwebhu obhaliso ukuze abe nochokoza. Lawula idatabase yabaqedyi abasha kunye nabangaphambili kwinkqubo yokungenisa kwiinkalo zamsebenzi. Gcina uhlaziye idatabase yabafundi ababhalisileyo kwiinkqubo. Qinisekisa ukuba abafundi bahanjiswa benziwa isikhululo kwikholeji nakwikhampasi. Qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi lwabafundi lusingathwa kwiNkqubo yeTeknoloji yolwazi (ITS). Cwangcisa, lungiselela, uphathe inkqubo yobhaliso jikelele yabafundi kuzo zonke iinkqubo (NC(V), Report 191/NATED, Occupational, kunye neenkqubo ze Skills). Yenza uze usebenzise iinxelo zobhaliso zonyaka, iindawo zexesha, kunye neendlela. Qinisekisa ukuguquguquka nemigangatho yokubhalisa kwi DHET, iimfuno zokuvelisa iingxelo, kunye nemigaqo ye NSFAS. Lawula iinkqubo zobhaliso kwi-intanethi nangentsiwa kwaye uxilise izisombulu ngexa le nkqubo. Lawula ukusingathwa ukuqinisekiswa kolwazi lwabafundi kwi ITS okanye iNkqubo efanayo yolwazi lwabafundi (SIS). Iirekhodo zabafundi kunye nokuchaneka kolwazi. Qinisekisa ukuchaneka, ukupela, kunye nokhuseleko lonke ulwazi nerekhodo yobhaliso lwabafundi. Gcina uhlaziye iNkqubo yolwazi lwabafundi (SIS) ngokuguquguquka nemigaqo yokuvelisa iingxelo ze DHET EMIS. Qokelela uze unikeze iingxelo ezichanekileyo zabaliso abafundi, i FTE, kunye nokubhalisa kwi DHET, SETA, nakunye namachweba. Lawula ugcinio nokubuyiswa kweekhodo zobhaliso lwabafundi ngokuguquguquka nemigaqo ye POPIA kunye neenkqubo zogcino lweerekhodo zenkcubeko. Ukuhambelana neenkqubo kunye noqinisekiso lomgangatho. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi yobhaliso ihambelana nemigangatho ye DHET, iindlela ezisemgangathweni, kunye nomthetho ofanelekileyo (Skills Development Act, TVET Act, POPIA, nokunye). Sebenzisa kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zoqinisekiso lomgangatho wobhaliso nogcino lweerekhodo zabafundi. Thintana ne QCTO, Umalusi, SETA, kunye ne DHET ngokubhaliswa kweekhwayiso kunye nokuhambelana. Yenza iindleko zesiqEND ezihlala zenzeka kwifayile zabafundi kunye nerekhodo yobhaliso ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuchaneka nokuhambelelana. Ulawulo kokhathalelo nophuhliso lwabasebenzi. Lawula, qeqesha, uphuhlise abasebenzi bobhaliso kunye nogcino lweerekhodo. Yenza iqondo lomsebenzi ulawule ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ngokuhambelana neemfuno ze PMDS/IQMS. Yabela imisebenzi ulawule umthwalo wemisebenzi kwittalente yobhaliso. Chonga iimfuno zeqeqesho uze ukhuthaze amathuba ophuhliso abasebenzi abangaphantsi. Iingxelo nolawulo. Lungiselela unikeze iingxelo zobhaliso ezinyanga, eziheshe, kunye nezonyaka kulawulo. Yenza izibalo zobhaliso ukuze ixhasa ucwangciso oluhleliweyo kunye nokuqwalasela izigqibo. Lawula imali ehleliwe yeyunithi yobhaliso yonke yokuthenga iimpahlu efunekayo. Hamba ubandakanye kumagqabantshintshi, kwindibano yolawulo, nakuwoonke amaxesha ocwangciso.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Internal Audit & Quality Management
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.summary: Assistant Director role at the Department of Higher Education and Training responsible for internal audit and quality management at Central Office.
jobs.requirements: B-Tech Internal Auditing/Degree (NQF Level 7) in Internal Auditing. A post graduate qualification in internal auditing, forensic auditing or a relevant postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage. Registered member of the institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA). Certified Internal Auditor or Professional Internal Auditor designations or relevant professional designations will be an added advantage. Minimum 5 years’ relevant experience in an internal auditing environment. Minimum 3 years’ relevant supervisory experience in internal auditing environment. Computer literacy (MS Office – advanced Excel preferred). Valid driver’s license. Competencies, Knowledge and Skills: Sound knowledge of internal auditing principles and practices. Knowledge of the CET Act, Public Audit Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, and public sector governance frameworks. Understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) and Global Internal Audit Standards. Knowledge and understanding of risk management, internal control frameworks, and corporate governance principles (King IV/V report). Understanding of public sector policies, including DHET/TVET regulatory and compliance requirements. Understanding of Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001:2015). Strong analytical, investigative, and problem-solving skills. Excellent report writing, presentation, and communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls. Strong planning, coordination, and organisational skills. Ability to interpret legislation, policies, and procedures and apply them during audits. Proficiency in compiling audit working papers and maintaining quality audit files. High attention to detail, accuracy, and compliance with auditing standards. Ability to work independently and under pressure while meeting strict audit timelines. Professionalism, accountability, and ethical conduct. Sound judgement and objectivity. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion.
jobs.duties: Prepare audit notification letters in line with the approved Annual Audit Plan. Conduct preliminary surveys to gain an understanding of systems, processes, and controls. Prepare Audit Planning Memoranda (APMs). Perform risk assessments and develop risk-based audit programmes. Identity control weaknesses and areas of improvement. Prepare and maintain quality audit files in compliance with Global Internal Audit Standards. Conduct audits in accordance with approved audit programmes and methodologies. Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls. Compliance and maintenance of the ISO 9001 standards. Assess safeguarding of assets against fraud, irregularities, and losses. Review compliance with the CET Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations, and Institutional policies. Engage auditees during fieldwork and discuss preliminary findings. Perform follow-up audits on previously reported findings and recommendations. Draft clear, accurate, and evidence-based audit reports. Identity root causes and provide practical, value- adding recommendations. Conduct exit meetings and prepare minutes. Submit audit reports within agreed timelines. Support reporting to Executive Management and the Audit and Risk and Management Committee. Maintain effective professional relationships with internal stakeholders. Provide advisory input on governance, risk management, and internal control matters, where required. Guide and support management in addressing audit findings and management action plan.

jobs.applications: Email to asdinternalaudit@tnc.edu.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be submitted on the New Z83 which must be fully completed, obtainable from any Public Service Department and must be accompanied by a comprehensive Curriculum Vitae. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications including academic records, driver’s license, and identity document. Please take note that communication in relation to the process will be limited to the short-listed candidates. If you have not received any correspondence within three (3) months after the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Note: Please quote the relevant reference number of the post you are applying for. Applications received after the closing date will not be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a vetting process: criminal record checks, citizenship, credit record checks, and qualifications. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. The College/DHET reserves the right not to make appointments. Preference will be given to African male, African female, Coloured male, Coloured female, White male, Indian male and White female as per the EE targets of the College. People with disability are encouraged to apply. All costs incurred due to your application and interviews will be at your own expense. Tshwane North TVET College would like to invite suitably qualified, innovative, result-orientated and self–driven candidates to apply for their vacant positions.

af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Interne Oudit en Kwaliteitsbestuur
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur-pos by die Department of Higher Education and Training verantwoordelik vir interne oudit en kwaliteitsbestuur by die Hoofkantoor.
af.requirements: B-Tech Interne Oudit/Graad (NQF Level 7) in Interne Oudit. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in interne oudit, forensiese oudit of 'n relevante nagraadse kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Geregistreerde lid van die institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA). Certified Internal Auditor- of Professional Internal Auditor-benamings of relevante professionele benamings sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Minimum 5 jaar se relevante ervaring in 'n interne ouditomgewing. Minimum 3 jaar se relevante toesigervaring in 'n interne ouditomgewing. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office – gevorderde Excel verkies). Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede, Kennis en Vaardighede: Deeglike kennis van interne ouditbeginsels en -praktyke. Kennis van die CET Act, Public Audit Act, Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, en openbare-sektor-bestuursraamwerke. Begrip van die International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards) en Global Internal Audit Standards. Kennis en begrip van risikobestuur, interne beheerraamwerke, en korporatiewe bestuursbeginsels (King IV/V-verslag). Begrip van openbare-sektorbeleid, insluitend DHET/TVET-regulerings- en nakomingsvereistes. Begrip van Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001:2015). Sterke analitiese, ondersoekende en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Uitstekende verslagskryf-, voorleggings- en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondelings). Vermoë om die toereikendheid en doeltreffendheid van interne kontroles te evalueer. Sterke beplannings-, koördinerings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Vermoë om wetgewing, beleid en prosedures te interpreteer en gedurende oudite toe te pas. Bedrywigheid in die opstel van ouditwerkpapiere en die handhawing van gehalte-ouditlêers. Hoë aandag aan detail, akkuraatheid en nakoming van ouditstandaarde. Vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk terwyl streng oudittydlyne nagekom word. Professionalisme, verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Deeglike oordeel en objektiwiteit. Vermoë om vertroulikheid te handhaaf en diskresie toe te pas.
af.duties: Berei ouditkennisgewingsbriewe voor in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde Jaarlikse Ouditplan. Voer voorlopige opnames uit om 'n begrip van stelsels, prosesse en kontroles te verkry. Berei Audit Planning Memoranda (APM's) voor. Voer risikobevaluings uit en ontwikkel risikogebaseerde ouditprogramme. Identifiseer beheerswakhede en areas vir verbetering. Berei voor en handhaaf gehalte-ouditlêers in ooreenstemming met Global Internal Audit Standards. Voer oudite uit in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde ouditprogramme en -metodologieë. Evalueer die toereikendheid en doeltreffendheid van interne kontroles. Nakoming en handhawing van die ISO 9001-standaarde. Beoordeel die beskerming van bates teen bedrog, onreëlmatighede en verliese. Hersien nakoming van die CET Act, PFMA, Treasury Regulations en Institusionele beleid. Betrek ouditees gedurende veldwerk en bespreek voorlopige bevindings. Voer opvolgoudite uit op voorheen gerapporteerde bevindings en aanbevelings. Opstel van duidelike, akkurate en bewysgebaseerde ouditverslae. Identifiseer grondoorssake en verskaf praktiese, waarde-toevoegende aanbevelings. Voer afsluitvergaderings en berei notule voor. Dien ouditverslae binne ooreengekome tydlyne in. Ondersteun verslagdoening aan Uitvoerende Bestuur en die Audit and Risk and Management Committee. Handhaaf effektiewe professionele verhoudinge met interne belanghebbendes. Verskaf advisering insette oor bestuur, risikobestuur en interne beheeraangeleenthede, waar vereis. Lei en ondersteun bestuur in die aanpak van ouditbevindings en bestuursaksieplan.

zu.title: Umlobi Omqondisi: Ukuhlolwa Kwangaphakathi & Ukuqashwa Kokuhle
zu.summary: Isikhundla somlobi oqondisa eDepartment of Higher Education and Training esibhekele ukuhlolwa kwangaphakathi nokuqashwa kokuhle eCentral Office.
zu.requirements: I-B-Tech Internal Auditing/Degree (NQF Level 7) kokuhlolwa kwangaphakathi. Isiqu esiphakeme senyanga kamuva ekuloleni kwangaphakathi, ekuloleni kokubhujiswa noma isiqu esihambisanayo senyanga kamuva sizoba yinzuzo. Ilungu elibhalisiwe lesikhungo sabaloli bangaphakathi baseNingizimu Afrika (IIASA). Amagugu ebhodi eqinisekiswe njengombhalo wangaphakathi noma umbhalu oqashiwe njengomuntu oqashiwe ngaphakathi noma amagugu aqashiwe ahambisanawo azoba yinzuzo. Okungenani ungamakhulu eminyaka eyi-5 wokuhlangenwe nakho okuhlobene nendawo yokuqashwa kokuhlola kwangaphakathi. Okungenani ungamakhulu eminyaka eyi-3 wokuhlangenwe nakho okuhlobene nokuhlola kokuphatha ekuloleni kwangaphakathi. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompuyutha (MS Office – okuthandwa kakhulu i-Excel eyisilinganiso esiphezulu). Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono, Ulwazi Nobukhoni: Ulwazi oluhle ngemigomo nokuqashwa kokuhlola kwangaphakathi. Ulwazi ngesiCET Act, i-Public Audit Act, i-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), izinqamuleli zeTreasury, nezimiso zokuqashwa komphakatsi.ukuqonda emazingeni amakhulu. Ukuqonda izindinganiso zamazwe ngamazwe zokuqashwa kokwenza umsebenzi wokuhlola kwangaphakathi (IIA Standards) nezindinganiso zamazwe ngamazwe zokuqashwa kokuhlola kwangaphakathi. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphathwa kwezingozi, izimiso zokulawula kwangaphakathi, nezimiso zokuphatha inkampani (umbiko weKing IV/V). Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo zomphakatsi, okuhlanganisa izidingo zokuqasha nezimiso ze-DHET/TVET. Ukuqonda izimiso zokuqashwa kokuhle (ISO 9001:2015). Amandla okuhlaziya, ukuphenya, nokuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono aphakeme okubhala imibiko, okubhaka, nokuthuthukisa (okubhaliwe nokukhulunwayo). Ikono elokuhlola okwanele nokusebenza kahle kokuqashwa kwangaphakathi. Amakhono aphakeme okucubungula, ukuhlanganisa, nokuhlela. Ikono elokutolikha umthetho, izinqubomgomo, nokuqashwa, nokusebenzisa kokuphila ngesikhathi sokuhlola. Ukukhanya ekwakheni amaphepha okusebenza ekuqashweni nokugcina amafayela okuhlola okuhle. Ukuqathaniswa okuphezulu kwemininingwane, ukuqinisekiswa kokuqinile, nokuqinisekisa izindinganiso zokuqashwa. Amandla okusebenzela ngabodwa nangaphansi koxhaxha ngenkathi uhambisana nesikhathi esibekiwe sokuhlola. Ukusebenza ngobungcweti, ukubhekana, nokuziphatha ngokuzethemba. Ukubeka ngokuhlakaniphile nokungakhethi. Ikono elokugcina inkulumo eyimfihlo nokuqhuba ngokukhetha.
zu.duties: Lungiselela amagunya okuhlola ngemiyalezo yesaziso ngokuhambisana nendlela eyamukelekile yokuhlela ukuhlola kwangonyaka. Yenza izinsiza zokuqasha ukwazi okuhle ezimiso, izinqubo, nokulawula. Lungiselela imibhalo yokuhlela ukuhlola (APMs). Yenza isilinganiso sezingozi ukuze uhlele imiyalela yokuqashwa kokuhlola izengozi. Hlola amaphuzu amablukufu okuqashwa nendawo ezingathuthukiswa. Lungiselela futhi ugcine amafayela okuhlola amakhulu ohambisana nezindinganiso zamazwe ngamazwe zokuqashwa kokuhlola kwangaphakathi. Yenza ukuhlola ngokuhambisana nemiyalela eyamukelekile yokuhlola nokuqashwa kokuhle. Qaphele ukulungele nokusebenza kahle kwamaphuzu okuqashwa kokuhlola kwangaphakathi. Ukuvumelana nokulondolozwa kwezindinganiso ze-ISO 9001. Hlola ukukhululeka kwempahla ngokumelene nenngebo, okungalungile, nokulahlekelwa. Buka ukuvumelana nesiCET Act, i-PFMA, izinqamuleli zeTreasury, nezinqubomgomo zenhlangano. Thinta abahlolwa ngesikhathi senza umsebenzi futhi ukhulume ngemiphumela ekuqaleni. Yenza ukuhlola okulandelwa kumiphumela futhi ngeminikelo emibhalwe ngaphambilini. Hlela imibiko eqonde, eqinisekisiwe futhi evela emaphepheni okuseskhathini esihle. Ithole imibiko yokubanga okuyisizinda futhi nikeze izincomo ezisetshenziswayo, ezenza inzuzo. Yenza izinkampani ezimpumalanga ezibhalwe futhi lungiselela imizuzu. Thumela imibiko yokuhlola ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esivunyelwe. Sekela umbiko ekuqondisweni kokuqashwa kokuphatha kweNkulu kanye neKomidiyo Yokuqashwa Kwezingozi kokuqashwa. Gcina ubuhlobo obuhle nobungcweti nabantu abashukumisayo bangaphakathi. Nikeze okokubhalayo kokuhola okuphathwayo, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, nezindaba zokuqashwa kwangaphakathi, lapho kudingeka khona. Hola futhi usekele ukuphatha ekuxazululeni imiphumela yokuhlola uhlelo lokusebenza nokuphatha.

xh.title: UMniki-miselwa: Ukululwa komSebenzi ngaseSese noLawulo loBungcali
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaMniki-miselwa kuSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, ophethe ukululwa komsebenzi ngasese kunye nolawulo lobungcali kwiSikhululo esiPhakathi.
xh.requirements: I-B-Tech Internal Auditing/Isidanga (NQF Level 7) kwi-Internal Auditing. Isidanga sesiqu sengangaphambili kwi-internal auditing, i-forensic auditing okanye isidanga esithandathu sengangaphambili siza kuba yintoni ephucula. Lilungu elibhalisiweyo le-institute of Internal Auditors South Africa (IIASA). Ukuba ngumqinisekisiyo olinganiselweyo ngaphakathi okanye oyi-Professional Internal Auditor okanye ukuba namagqabantshintshi obungcali aqhelekileyo siza kuba yintoni ephucula. Iminyaka engu-5 ubudala yamava aqhelekileyo kwindawo yokululwa komsebenzi ngasese. Iminyaka engu-3 ubudala yamava okulawula abantu aqhelekileyo kwindawo yokululwa komsebenzi ngasese. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office – i-Excel esemgangathweni ophezulu iyathandwa). Ilayisensi yokuqhuba egunyaziweyo. Iimpawu zokuzenza, ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olululo ngemigaqo nendlela zokusebenza zokululwa komsebenzi. Ulwazi ngoMthetho weCET, uMthetho woQinisekiso lukaRhulumente, uMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA), iwolezo zeTreasury, kunye namakonkqo worhulumente karhulumente kwingxoxo-mthetho yoluntu. Ukuqonda kwemigaqo yeSizwe jikelele eMalunga noQeqesho loLululwa lokuQinisekisa (IIA Standards) kunye neMigangatho yeSizwe jikelele yoLululwa lokuQinisekisa. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawula iingozi ziphetho, amakonkqo wolawulo lwangaphakathi, kunye nemigaqo yolawulo lwentshulumbiso (ingxelo ka-King IV/V). Ukuqonda amagqabantshintsi karhulumente karhulumente, kuquuka iingquku zomthetho nokuhambelana kwe-DHET/TVET. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zoLawulo loLinganiselwa loBungcali (ISO 9001:2015). Amakhono anamandla okuqhuba inxubomphakama, ukuphande, nokusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono amanje obuchwepheshe bokubhala iingxelo, okubonisa, nakunxibelelwano (elubhaliweyo nokuThethwa). Ukuba nokwazi ukuqwalasela ukwaneleka nokusebenza kwezilawuli zangaphakathi. Amakhono anamandla okucwangcisa, ukuhambelana, nakulawula isikhungo. Ukuba nokwazi ukuqonda umthetho, amagqabantshintsi, nendlela zokwenza izinto kwaye uzisebenzise ngexesha lokululwa umsebenzi. Ukwazi ukuqamba iiphepha zokuqinisekisa nokulondoloza iifayile zokuqinisekisa ezilinganiselweyo ngokuchanekileyo. Ingqwalasela echanekileyo iingcango, ukuchaneka, nokuhambelana namagqabantshintsi wolululwa lokuQinisekisa. Ukuba nokwazi ukusebenza ngokwakho nakunoxinzelelo xa uzifezekisa iinxelo zokuqinisekisa. Ukuba ngumntu osemgangathweni, othatha iinxaxheba, kwaye ethanda umonde nesithembiso. Isigqibo esimileyo nobugqwetha. Ukuba nokwazi ukugcina iyimfihlo kwaye aze achonge.
xh.duties: Lungiselela iileta zokuqwalanisa ngokusesikweni ngokwale Ndalo yoKwolulwa nokuQinisekiswa iMisebenzi yaQonyulweyo. Qhuba izifundo ezingaphambili ukuze uqonde iinkqubo, iinkqubo zokusebenza, kunye nezilawuli. Lungiselela iMemo zoCwangciso lokuQinisekiswa (APMs). Qhuba ukuqwalaselwa kweengozi ziphetho kunye nokuphuhlisa iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ezingokweengozi ziphetho. Qaphela iintshova ezikhoyo kwiinkqubo zolawulo nendawo zokuphucula. Lungiselela kwaye ulondoloze iifayile zokuqinisekisa ezilinganiselweyo ngokuchanekileyo ngokwemigangatho yeSizwe jikelele yoKusesikweni koLululwa nokuQinisekiswa. Qhuba izimo zokuqinisekisa ngokwemigaqo yokuqinisekisa egunyaziweyo nendlela zokusebenza. Qwalasela ukwaneleka nokusebenza kwezilawuli zangaphakathi. Ukuhambelana nokulondoloza iwolezo ze ISO 9001. Qwalasela ukugcina izinto ezixhobileyo ukuchasene nokrakula, okungalunganga, nokulahleka. Qwalasela ukuhambelana noMthetho weCET, iPFMA, iwolezo zeTreasury, kunye namagqabantshintshi esikhungo. Xhumana nabo bafundwa kwixesha lokwenza imisebenzi yomhlaba ucace iziphumo ezingaphambili. Qhuba izimo zokuqinisekisa ezilandelayo kule nto evelwe ngaphambili kunye neengcebiso. Bhala iingxelo zokuqinisekiswa ezicacileyo, ezichanekileyo, ezisezinyanweni ezisqulathi-bakufundo. Qaphela iimbangela eziphetho kwaye unike iingcebiso ezisetyenzisekayo, ezongeza ixabiso. Qhuba iintlanganiso zokuphuma kwaye ulungiselela amaminethi. Thumela iingxelo zokuqinisekiswa kwixesha elivunyelweyo. Xhasa ukunikwa iingxelo kuQobo luBaphathi kunye neKomiti yoQolulwa lweengozi nokuLawulwa. Londoloza ubudlelwane obusebenzayo obungcali kunye nabathintekayo bangaphakathi. Nike isalathiso-mboniso kumacandelo okulawula, kulawulo lweengozi, nakunokulinganiselwa kolawulo kwangaphakathi, apho kufuneka khona. Nceda uxhase ulawulo ekusingatheni iziphumo zokuqinisekiswa nendlela yokuqwalaselwa imisebenzi yolawulo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Human Resources Management and
jobs.department: Department of Higher Education and Training
jobs.salary_text: R487 197 per annum (Level 09), plus benefits as applicable in the Public Service
jobs.summary: Oversee human resources management and administration services including conditions of service, recruitment, and selection at the Department of Higher Education and Training central office in Malmesbury.
jobs.requirements: Matric /Grade 12 plus a recognised 3- years’ National Diploma in Human Resources Management or a 4 - years’ Degree. A minimum of 5 years in Human Resource Management environment of which three (03) years should be management experience. A Post Degree qualification will be an added advantage. PERSAL Certificates. Computer literacy. Knowledge of MS Software applications such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook. Current and previous work experience endorsed by Human Resource (Not certificate of service). Valid Driver’s license. Knowledge of Public Services legislations and policies related to Human Resource Management. Knowledge and understanding of the TVET/ CET Administration. Knowledge and understanding of the Higher Education sector. Knowledge of PERSAL and Job Evaluation. In-depth knowledge of BCEA, LRA, EEA, COIDA, OHSA, employee wellness and benefits. Excellent understanding of HR Risk and Compliance Knowledge of CCMA/Labour Court/Bargaining processes.
jobs.duties: Oversee Human Resource Management and Administration services - Render conditions of services (Leave, Housing, Medical, Injury on duty, Long service recognition, overtime, relocation, pensions, transfers, allowances etc.); Oversee the recruitment and selection processes as per departmental delegation (advert, shortlisting, interviews, security vetting, competency test, reference check, verification of qualifications) are coordinated within the stipulated timelines); Management of HR Personnel records. Oversee Human Resource Development services - Render Bursaries administration; Render Internship and Work Integrated Learning (WIL); Conduct Induction; Coordinate and facilitate the Training interventions. Develop and implement Workplace Skills Plan (WSP); Administration of Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) and Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS). Coordinate and facilitate Organizational Development, services - Coordinate the design, review and implementation of the college organizational structure; Facilitate the development of Job Descriptions; Coordinate the Job Evaluation of posts/jobs and submit to Head Office; Conduct work-study and business process re-engineering; Facilitate change management and organizational transformation services. Coordinate and facilitate Human Resource Planning (HRP) and Employment Equity (EE) services - Coordinate, develop, review, implement and monitor the college HR plan; Submit college HR plan to Regional and Head Office for integration of the departmental plan; Coordinate, develop, review, implement and monitor the college EE plan; Submit college EE plan to Regional and Head Office for integration of the departmental plan; Employment Equity (EE) data for submission to Regional and Head Office; Ensure the implementation of HR and EE Plan. Provide Employee Health and Wellness (EHW) services - Implement wellness programmes and service for the college; Coordinate and manage HIV, AIDS, STI and TB services; Coordinate and manage health productivity programmes; Implement health and safety working environment programmes; Promotion of sport activities to encourage physical fitness and healthy lifestyle. Develop and implement Human Resource policies and manuals. Management of all Human, Financial, and other resources of the unit. Advanced skill: Administrative; Planning and organizing; Financial management; Report writing, Communication and interpersonal; Problem solving; Computer literacy; Analytical; Client oriented; Project management; Team leadership; People management. Labour Relations Management - Provide advisory services on all employee relations policies, procedures, strategies, agreements, and legislation. Conduct daily employee relations operations specifically in the areas of disciplinary hearing, grievances, absenteeism, performance improvement and collective bargaining; Partner with management in driving fair labour relations within the business Represent the company in dispute resolution process including mediation, arbitration and negotiation; Partner with management in driving fair labour relations within the business Values/ attributes - Client service focus; Integrity; Committed; Proactive and loyal.

jobs.notes: Please click on the vacancies tab, fully complete the online Z83 application form, and attach a recently updated detailed CV with (years of experience, the start and the end date, the duties and three contactable references with email addresses for the previous and current employers). It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender, and disability) in the Department through the filling of the post(s) with a candidate whose appointment will promote representatively in line with the numerical targets as contained in our Employment Equity Plan. The Employer reserves the right not to make an appointment, to withdraw, and / or amend the adverts for the post(s) and retains the right not to fill the posts as determined by the Director - General or the delegated authority. Where applicable, candidates will be subjected to a skills test. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates. All short- listed candidates will be subjected to a qualifications and citizen verification; criminal record and financial/asset record checks. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Menslike Hulpbronnebestuur en
af.summary: Oorsig oor menslike hulpbronnebestuur en administratiewe dienste, insluitend diensvoorwaardes, werwing en keuring by die Department of Higher Education and Training se sentrale kantoor in Malmesbury.
af.requirements: Matric /Grade 12 plus 'n erkende 3- years' National Diploma in Human Resources Management of 'n 4 - years' Degree. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar in 'n Menslike Hulpbronbestuursomgewing waarvan drie (03) jaar bestuurservaring moet wees. 'n Postgraduate kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. PERSAL-sertifikate. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Kennis van MS-sagtewaretoepassings soos Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook. Huidige en vorige werkervaring wat deur Menslike Hulpbronne onderteken is (nie 'n dienssertifikaat nie). Geldige bestuurslisensie. Kennis van openbare dienswetgewing en beleide wat verband hou met Menslike Hulpbronbestuur. Kennis en begrip van TVET/CET-administrasie. Kennis en begrip van die hoëronderwyssektor. Kennis van PERSAL en Job Evaluation. Diepgaande kennis van BCEA, LRA, EEA, COIDA, OHSA, werknemerwelstand en voordele. Uitstekende begrip van HR-risiko en nakoming. Kennis van CCMA/Labour Court/Bargaining-prosesse.
af.duties: Oorsig oor Menslike Hulpbronbestuurs- en Administratiewe dienste - Lewer diensvoorwaardes (verlof, behuising, medies, besering op diens, erkenning van langdiens, oortyd, hervestiging, pensioene, oorplasings, toelaes ens.); Oorsig oor die werwing en keuringsprosesse volgens departementele delegering (advertensie, kortlyssamestelling, onderhoude, sekuriteitsondersoek, bevoegdheidstoets, verwysingsnagaan, verifikasie van kwalifikasies) word binne die vasgestelde tydlyn gekoördineer); Bestuur van HR-personeeldossiers. Oorsig oor Menslike Hulpbronontwikkelingsdienste - Lewer beursadministrasie; Lewer internskap en Work Integrated Learning (WIL); Voer induksie uit; Koördineer en fasiliteer opleidingsintervensies. Ontwikkel en implementeer Workplace Skills Plan (WSP); Administrasie van Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) en Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS). Koördineer en fasiliteer Organisasie-ontwikkelingsdienste - Koördineer die ontwerp, hersiening en implementering van die kollege se organisasiestruktuur; Fasiliteer die ontwikkeling van posbeskrywings; Koördineer die Job Evaluation van poste/werk en stuur dit na Head Office; Voer werkstudie en besigheidsproesheringenieuring uit; Fasiliteer veranderingsbestuur en organisatoriese transformasiedienste. Koördineer en fasiliteer Menslike Hulpbronbeplanning (HRP) en Indiensnemegelykheid (EE)-dienste - Koördineer, ontwikkel, hersien, implementeer en monitor die kollege se HR-plan; Stuur die kollege se HR-plan na Regional en Head Office vir integrasie van die departementele plan; Koördineer, ontwikkel, hersien, implementeer en monitor die kollege se EE-plan; Stuur die kollege se EE-plan na Regional en Head Office vir integrasie van die departementele plan; Indiensnemegelykheid (EE)-data vir indiening by Regional en Head Office; Verseker die implementering van die HR- en EE-plan. Verskaf Employee Health and Wellness (EHW)-dienste - Implementeer welstandsprogramme en dienste vir die kollege; Koördineer en bestuur MIV, VIGS, SOI en TB-dienste; Koördineer en bestuur gesondheidsproduktiwiteitsprogramme; Implementeer gesondheids- en veiligheidswerksomgewingsprogramme; Bevordering van sportaktiwiteite om fisieke fiksheid en 'n gesonde leefstyl aan te moedig. Ontwikkel en implementeer Menslike Hulpbronbeleid en handleidings. Bestuur van alle menslike, finansiële en ander hulpbronne van die eenheid. Gevorderde vaardighede: Administratief; Beplanning en organisering; Finansiële bestuur; Verslagskrywing, Kommunikasie en interpersoonlik; Probleemoplossing; Rekenaargeletterdheid; Analities; Kliëntgerig; Projekbestuur; Spanleierskap; Mensebestuur. Arbeidsverhoudingsbestuur - Verskaf adviesdienste oor alle werknemerverhoudingsbeleid, prosedures, strategieë, ooreenkomste en wetgewing. Voer daaglikse werknemerverhoudingsoperasies uit veral op die gebiede van disiplinêre verhore, griewe, afwesigheid, prestasieverbetering en kollektiewe bedinging; Werk met bestuur saam om billike arbeidsverhoudings binne die besigheid te bevorder; Verteenwoordig die maatskappy in geskillebeslegtingsprosesse insluitend bemiddeling, arbitrasie en onderhandeling; Werk met bestuur saam om billike arbeidsverhoudings binne die besigheid te bevorder Waardes/ eienskappe - Kliëntdiensfokus; Integriteit; Toegewyd; Proaktief en lojaal.

zu.title: Assistant Director: Human Resources Management and
zu.summary: Qondisa ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zabantu kanye nezinsizakolo zokuphatha okuhlanganisa izimo zenzinsizakalo, ukubika, nokukhethwa e Department of Higher Education and Training central office e Malmesbury.
zu.requirements: I-Matric /Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma yeminyaka engu-3 ekutholeniwe kwe-Human Resources Management noma i-Degree yeminyaka engu-4. Okungenani iminyakaengu-5 esimweni se-Human Resource Management lapho iminyaka eyinthathu (03) kufanele ibe ngokuhlolwa kokuphatha. I-Post Degree qualification izoba yinzuzo. I-PERSAL Certificates. Ukubhalisele ikhompuyutha. Ulwazi ngamahlelo we-MS Software afana ne-Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook. Okuhlolwa kwangalesi sikhathi kanye nokusebenza kakhulu kuqinisekiswe ngu-Human Resource (Akuyona isatifikethi sezenkonzo). i-Driver’s license esebenzayo. Ulwazi ngomthetho kanye nezinqubomgomo ze-Public Services ezihlobene ne-Human Resource Management. Ulwazi kanye nekuqonda ukuphathwa kwe-TVET/ CET. Ulwazi kanye nekuqonda i-Higher Education sector. Ulwazi nge-PERSAL kanye no-Job Evaluation. Ulwazi olujulile nge-BCEA, LRA, EEA, COIDA, OHSA, impilo yonke kanye nezinzuzo. Ukuqonda kakhulu nge-HR Risk and Compliance Ulwazi ngemikhuba ye-CCMA/Labour Court/Bargaining.
zu.duties: Qondisa izinsizakalo zokuqondisa nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo zabantu - Nikeza izimo zenzinsizakalo (Ukulaleka, Izindlu, Ezesayensi, Ukulimala emsebenzini, Ukubalwa kweminyaka yokusebenza, ukusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi, ukushintshela kwelinye indawo, imipesheni, ukudluliselwa, izimali mboleko, nokunye); Qondisa inqubo yokubika nokukhethwa njengoba kuholelwe umnyango (ukumemeza, ukwenza uhlu olufushane, izingxoxo, ukuhlola ukuvikeleka, ukuhlolwa kukhono, ukuhlola inkomba, ukuqinisekisa izifundo zomuntu) zihlelwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibaluliwe); Ukuphathwa kwerekhodi zabasebenzi be-HR. Qondisa izinsizakalo zokuqondisa abantu - Nikeza ukuphathwa kwezibhalo zemfundo; Nikeza i-Internship ne-Work Integrated Learning (WIL); Qamba ukuqondiswa; Hlela futhi siza ukuqeqeshwa. Bumba futhi usebenzise i-Workplace Skills Plan (WSP); Ukuphathwa kwe-Performance Management and Development Systems (PMDS) kanye ne-Integrated Quality Management System (IQMS). Hlela futhi siza i-Organizational Development, izinsizakalo - Hlela ukwakhiwa, ukubuyekeza nokusebenzisa isakhiwo sezinhlangano zesikole; Siza ukwakhiwa kwezinkomba zomsebenzi; Hlela ukuhlolwa komsebenzi wezikhundla futhi wethule eNdlunkulu; Yenza isifundo somsebenzi futhi wakhe kabusha inqubo yebhizinisi; Siza ukuphathwa koshintsho kanye noshintsho olwenziwa kwizinhlangano. Hlela futhi siza i-Human Resource Planning (HRP) kanye ne-Employment Equity (EE) izinsizakalo - Hlela, yakha, buyekeza, usebenzise futhi ulawule ikesikole i-HR plan; Yethula ikesikole i-HR plan esifundeni naseNdlunkulu ukuze kuhlanganiswe uhlelo lomnyango; Hlela, yakha, buyekeza, usebenzise futhi ulawule ikesikole i-EE plan; Yethula ikesikole i-EE plan esifundeni naseNdlunkulu ukuze kuhlanganiswe uhlelo lomnyango; Imininingwane ye-Employment Equity (EE) okuthunyelwa esifundeni naseNdlunkulu; Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-HR kanye ne-EE Plan. Nikeza izinsizakalo ze-Employee Health and Wellness (EHW) - Sebenzisa izinhlelo kanye nensizakalo yezempilo yomsebenzi wesikole; Hlela futhi ulawule izinsizakalo ze-HIV, AIDS, STI kanye ne-TB; Hlela futhi ulawule izinhlelo zempilo yemikhiqizo; Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphepha kanye nezemvelo yokusebenza; Ukukhuthaza izinkalo zemidlalo ukuze kukhuthazwe ukuzivocavoca umzimba kanye nesimo sempilo esihle. Bumba futhi usebenzise izinqubomgomo zokuqondisa abantu. Ukuphathwa kwawo wonke amandla, izimali, kanye nezinye izinsiza yeqoqo. Isikhundla esiphezulu: Ezelwe ukulawula, ukuhlela futhi uhlole; Ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana kanye nabanye; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha; Ukuhlaziya; Ukuqondiswe iklayenti; Ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi; Ukuphatha iqembu; Ukuphatha abantu. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlangano zabasebenzi - Nikeza izeluleko ezinhlanganweni zomsebenzi zezinqubomgomo, inqubo, amasu, izivumelano, kanye nomthetho. Yensa imisebenzi yansuku zonke yezinhlangano zabasebenzi ikakhulukazi kwindawo yokuzwa icala, izikhalazo, ukungahambi emsebenzini, ukuthuthukiswa kokusebenza kanye nokuxoxisana ngokuhlanganyela; Hlanganyela nomphathi ekugcineni izinhlangano zobusebenzi zilungile ngaphakathi kwebhizinisi Mimele inkampani ekuxazululeni izingxabano kuhlanganise ukulinganisela, ukuphathwa kocala, kanye nokuxoxa; Hlanganyela nomphathi ekugcineni izinhlangano zobusebenzi zilungile ngaphakathi kwebhizinisi Amagugu/izibalomgomo - Ukuqondiswa iklayenti; Ukuqotho; Ukithe; Ukuba nesibongo esihle kanye nothando.

xh.title: Umncedisi weDirektha: ulawulo lweMisebenzi yabantu kunye
xh.summary: Ukuqonda ulawulo lweMisebenzi yabantu nezinkonzo zolawulo kuquka iimeko zomsebenzi, ukwamkelwa komsebenzi, nokukhethwa kwisebe leMfundo ePhakamileyo nokuQeqeshwa kwindlu enkulu yesebe eMalmesbury.
xh.requirements: Matric /Grade 12 plus a recognised 3- years' National Diploma in Human Resources Management or a 4 - years' Degree. Ubuncinci beminyaka eli-5 kwindawo yoLawulo lweMisebenzi yabantu apho kubikho iminyaka emithathu (03) ekufuneka ibe yimfundo yolawulo. Isidanga sePost Degree kuya kuba lusizo. Iifom zokuqinisekisa iPERSAL. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa izicelo zeSofthiwe ze-MS njengeWord, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook. Amava akho wangaphambili nawangoku omsebenzi eqinisekiswe yiMisebenzi yabantu (Asilona isatifikethi senkonzo). Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi ngemithetho neenkqubo zeZikhonzo zoLuntu ezinxulumene noLawulo lweMisebenzi yabantu. Ulwazi nekuqonda iNtengiso yeTVET/ CET. Ulwazi nekuqonda leNqanaba leMfundo ePhakamileyo. Ulwazi ngePERSAL nokulinganiselwa kwemisebenzi. Ulwazi oluphakamileyo ngeBCEA, LRA, EEA, COIDA, OHSA, impilo yonakele nabasebenzi kunye nezibonelelo. Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo ngeengozi ze-HR noLawulo oluziinkqubo Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zeCCMA/Nkantolo yoBasebenzi/Izindaba ezincwadiswanayo.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda izinkonzo zoLawulo lweMisebenzi yabantu nezinkonzo zolawulo - Kubonelela ngeemeko zenkonzo (Ikaloku, Izindlu, Eyonyango, Ikwonzakalo ngomsebenzi, Imbonakaliso yenkonzo yexesha elide, ukugqitha kwexesha, ukutshintshela, iipenshini, iindlu ezitshintshwayo, ezinye iimali ezongezelelweyo njl.); Qonda iinkqubo zokwamkelwa komsebenzi nokuwukhethwa njengoko kumiselwe yisebe (isaziso, ukwenza uluhlu olufutshane, iintevyu, ukuhlolwa kwezokhuseleko, uvavairo lwamakhono, ukuqinisekiswa kweesalathiso, ukuqinisekiswa kwezidanga) zihlelwa ngaphakathi kweexesha elimisiweyo); Ulawulo lwerekhodi zabasebenzi ze-HR. Qonda izinkonzo zoPhuhliso lweMisebenzi yabantu - Hlenga ulawulo lweBhasari; Hlenga iNtlalo yokusebenza nokuFunda okuHlanganisweyo (WIL); Qhuba iNgeniso; Hlela kwaye uluncede eNkqubo yoQeqesho. Yakha kwaye usebenzise iNdlela yeNkqubo yeKhwebu yoMsebenzi (WSP); Ulawulo lweNdlela yoLawulo lweNkqubo yeMisebenzi nokuPhuhliso (PMDS) neNkqubo yoLawulo oluhleliweyo loMgangatho (IQMS). Hlela kwaye uluncedo eNkqubeni yoPhuhliso loBuntu, izinkonzo - Hlela ukuyila, ukuphonononga nokuqhuba isakhiwo se-organisation we-kholeji; Uncedo ekwenzeni iincazelo zeMisebenzi; Hlela ukuLinganiselwa koMsebenzi wamakhosi/omsebenzi kwaye uzinike eNdlini enkulu; Qhuba isifundo somsebenzi nokuqulunqwa kwendlela entsha yeshishini; Uncedo ekutshintshweni kolawulo nokuqhuba izinkonzo zokuguqulwa koluntu. Hlela kwaye uluncedo ekucwangcisweni kweMisebenzi yabantu (HRP) nasekuLungelelweni koMsebenzi (EE) - Hlela, yakha, phonononga, qhuba kwaye ulawule iplani ye-HR yekholeji; Nikeza iplani ye-HR yekholeji kwiNgingqi naseNdlini enkulu ukuze kwenziwe uhlelo olulunye lwesebe; Hlela, yakha, phonononga, qhuba kwaye ulawule iplani ye-EE yekholeji; Nikeza iplani ye-EE yekholeji kwiNgingqi naseNdlini enkulu ukuze kwenziwe uhlelo olulunye lwesebe; Iingcombolo ze-Employment Equity (EE) ezinikelwa kwiNgingqi naseNdlini enkulu; Qinisekisa ukusebenza kwe-HR neplani ye-EE. Bonezela izinkonzo ze-Employee Health and Wellness (EHW) - Qhuba iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zemiphefumlo nezinkonzo zekholeji; Hlela kwaye ulawule izinkonzo ze-HIV, i-AIDS, i-STI ne-TB; Hlela kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zemisebenzi ephakamileyo yempilo; Qhuba iinkqubo zendalo yokusebenza ekhuselekileyo nekusempilweni; Ukukhuthaza imikhosi yezemidlalo ukukhuthaza ukuzilolonga ngokomzimba nepilo elungileyo. Yakha kwaye usebenzise iinkqubo nezincwadiso zeMisebenzi yabantu. Ulawulo lweMisebenzi yabantu, zezeMali, nalezinye izixhobo zeqela. Amakhono aphakamileyo: Olulawulo; Ukuqamba iindlela nekulungelelanisa; Ulawulo lweMali; Ukubhala iingxelo, Unxibelelwano nobantu; Ukusombulula iingxaki; Ulwazi lwekhompyutha; Ukuhlalutywa; Ukujoliswe kumxhasi; Ulawulo lweProjekthi; Ukukhokela iqela; Ulawulo labantu. Ulawulo lweNxulumano zoBasebenzi - Nikeza ngezeliso kuzo zonke iinkqubo, iindlela, iindlela zokusombulula iingxaki, iingqinisekiso, kunye nemithetho yonxibelelwano wabasebenzi. Qhuba iindaba zangemini zonxibelelwano wabasebenzi ngokukodwa kummandla wokuzwa kwamacala, iingxaki, ukungabi kolawulo, ukuphucula imisebenzi kwaye wenze isivumelwano sodidi; Dibana nabaphathi ekukhuthazeni ulawulo olulungeneyo lonxibelelwano wabasebenzi ngaphakathi kweshishini Mela inkampani kwindlela yokusombulula iingxabano kuquka uxolelwaniso, isixhobo sokunika isigqibo nokuthengiselana; Dibana nabaphathi ekukhuthazeni ulawulo olulungeneyo lonxibelelwano wabasebenzi ngaphakathi kweshishini Iindlela/Iimpawu - Ukugxila ekukhonzeni umxhasi; Ukuqinisekisa; Uzinikelo; Ukuzithanda ngaphambili nokuqina.

jobs.title: Legal Administration Officer (MR1-MR5)
jobs.salary_text: R262 968 - R1 155 777 per annum (MR1-MR5), (A basic salary package). Salary will be in accordance with the OSD determination for Legally Qualified Personnel.
jobs.summary: Legal Administration Officer at the Department of Home Affairs Head Office in Tshwane, requiring an LLB degree to handle legislation drafting and litigation for the Refugee Appeals Authority.
jobs.requirements: An LLB degree or equivalent 4 (four) year legal qualification at NQF level 7 (seven) as recognized by SAQA. MR1: No previous legal experience is required. MR 2: 1 (one) years’ relevant post-qualification legal experience in a drafting and litigation environment. MR 3: 2 (two) years’ relevant post- qualification legal experience in a litigation environment. MR 4: 4 (four) years’ appropriate post qualification legal experience in a litigation environment. MR 5: 6 (six) years’ relevant post-qualification legal experience in a litigation environment. Admission as an Attorney or Advocate is required for MR 2-5. A valid Driver's License. Knowledge of Workflow planning and capacity planning. Knowledge of all Civic Services Regulations. Basic knowledge of the Immigration Act and Refugee Act. Knowledge of the Public Service Regulatory Framework. Extensive knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) and Treasury regulations. Knowledge of the South African Constitution. Understanding of departmental legislation and Human Resources legislation and prescripts. Knowledge of the South African Constitution Knowledge of the Public Service Regulations Act. Knowledge of occupation Health and Safety Act. Required skills and competencies: Strategic capability and leadership. Service delivery innovation, client orientation and customer focus. People management and empowerment. Financial Management and Administration. Accountability. Program and project management. Budget Administration. Financial Risk Management. Legal writing, drafting of Legal documents skills. Process analysis and improvement. Attention to details. Ability to install appropriate processes and systems, as well as enabling technology, to support the Department in efficiently and effectively managing the required work. Support with digital transformation. Excellent verbal and written communication, as well as presentation skills. Problem-solving and analysis. Conflict management and resolution. Interpersonal skills. Computers and Networks. Engineering and technology. Technology design (Networks). Influencing, networking, conflict management and negotiation skills. Decision making and initiating action. Planning, organising and time management. Policy development, coaching and facilitating. Business report writing. Computer literacy. Patriotism, Honesty and Integrity.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for, amongst others, the following specific tasks: Facilitate the daily operation of the Legal unit of Refugee Appeals Authority. Draft new and amend existing legislation administered by the Refugee Appeals Authority. Provide verbal and written legal opinions relating to all pieces of legislation administered by the Refugee Appeal Authority and any other relevant Legislations. Conduct well-structured research and substantiated legal advice and legal opinions on daily basis verbally and in writing. Provide legal advice and prepare legal documents for the unit. Facilitate input in legislation and provide advice to Refugee Reception Offices. Liaise with other state departments and institutions regarding legislatives matters. Attend to litigation matters against the Authority and liaise with the Department’s legal service directorate on such matters. Participate in seeing Bills through the legislative drafting and Parliamentary process, and the drafting of legal documents on behalf of the Refugee Appeals Authority. Participate in scrutinizing and drafting international agreements and Memoranda of Understanding. Attend to requests in terms of Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 (Act No. 2 of 2000). Ensure the implementation of effective risk and compliance management. Implementation of policies, procedures, directives, acts and regulations. Ability to instill appropriate processes and systems, as well as enabling technology, to support the Department in efficiently and effectively managing the required work. Support digital transformation.
jobs.enquiries: Head Office: Ms B Kabinde Tel No: (012) 406 4239
jobs.applications: Applications compliant with the “Directions to Applicants” above, must be submitted online at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za or raasarecruitment@dha.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications:       Applications     must       be      submitted   online    at https://erecruitment.dha.gov.za sent to the correct address specified at the bottom of the posts, on or before the closing date, accompanied by a fully completed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021), obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za, citing the correct post number and job title, and a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date dd/mm/yy), job title, duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of at least two contactable employment references (as recent as possible), regardless of online or manual submission. Where a valid Driver's License and a Professional Driving Permit (PDP) is a requirement, this must be indicated on the CV. All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Shortlisted candidates will also be required to submit a copy of their ID document, a valid driver’s license (if specified as a job requirement), relevant educational qualifications / RPL certificates / Academic Transcripts of completed qualifications, and Acting letters as directed. Furthermore, applicants who possess (a) foreign qualification(s) are required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications, as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA); for SMS posts, they will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity, will be subjected to an interview, various relevant tests and assessments, and employment suitability checks (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, and employment references including verification of exit reasons, and conducting business with State). Once appointed, serving of a prescribed probation period, and obtaining of a security clearance appropriate to the post, will be required. Correspondence between the Department and candidates will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. The DHA complies with the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2013 (Act No. 4 of 2013). Applicants’ personal information will be used for recruitment purposes, retained where required for audit, and safeguarded against unauthorised disclosure, except where legally required. Submission of an application constitutes consent to such processing. OTHER POST

af.title: Regsdienste-administrasiebeampte (MR1-MR5)
af.summary: Regsdienste-administrasiebeampte by die Department of Home Affairs Hoofkantoor in Tshwane, wat 'n LLB-graad vereis om wetgewing op te stel en litigasie vir die Refugee Appeals Authority te behartig.
af.requirements: An LLB degree or equivalent 4 (four) year legal qualification at NQF level 7 (seven) as recognized by SAQA. MR1: No previous legal experience is required. MR 2: 1 (one) years' relevant post-qualification legal experience in a drafting and litigation environment. MR 3: 2 (two) years' relevant post- qualification legal experience in a litigation environment. MR 4: 4 (four) years' appropriate post qualification legal experience in a litigation environment. MR 5: 6 (six) years' relevant post-qualification legal experience in a litigation environment. Toelating as 'n prokureur of advokaat word vereis vir MR 2-5. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Kennis van werkvloeibeplanning en kapasiteitsbeplanning. Kennis van alle Civic Services-regulasies. Basiese kennis van die Immigration Act en Refugee Act. Kennis van die Openbare Diens Reguleringsraamwerk. Uitgebreide kennis van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) en Tesourie-regulasies. Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Grondwet. Begrip van departementele wetgewing en Menslike Hulpbronne-wetgewing en voorskifte. Kennis van die Suid-Afrikaanse Grondwet. Kennis van die Public Service Regulations Act. Kennis van die Occupational Health and Safety Act. Vereiste vaardighede en bevoegdhede: Strategiese vermoë en leierskap. Dienslewering-inovasie, kliëntoriëntasie en klantefokus. Mensebestuur en bemagtiging. Finansiële bestuur en administrasie. Verantwoordelikheid. Program- en projekbestuur. Begrotingsadministrasie. Finansiële risikobestuur. Regskryfwerk, opstel van regsdokumente-vaardighede. Prosesanalise en -verbetering. Aandag aan besonderhede. Vermoë om toepaslike prosesse en stelsels, asook onderskragende tegnologie, te installeer om die departement te ondersteun om die vereiste werk doeltreffend en effektief te bestuur. Ondersteun met digitale transformasie. Uitstekende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasie, asook aanbiedingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en analise. Konflikbestuur en -oplossing. Interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekenaars en netwerke. Ingenieurswese en tegnologie. Tegnologie-ontwerp (netwerke). Beïnvloeding, netwerkbou, konflikbestuur en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Besluitneming en inisiëring van aksie. Beplanning, organisering en tydbestuur. Beleidontwikkeling, afrigting en fasilitering. Besigheidsverslagskryfwerk. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Patriotisme, eerlikheid en integriteit.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal onder andere vir die volgende spesifieke take verantwoordelik wees: Fasiliteer die daaglikse werking van die regseenheid van die Refugee Appeals Authority. Stel nuwe wetgewing op en wysig bestaande wetgewing wat deur die Refugee Appeals Authority geadministreer word. Verskaf mondelinge en skriftelike regsmenings rakende alle stukke wetgewing wat deur die Refugee Appeals Authority geadministreer word en enige ander tersaaklike wetgewing. Voer goed gestruktureerde navorsing en onderboude regsadvies en regsmenings op 'n daaglikse basis mondelings en skriftelik uit. Verskaf regsadvies en berei regsdokumente vir die eenheid voor. Fasiliteer insette in wetgewing en verskaf advies aan Refugee Reception Offices. Skakel met ander staatsdepartemente en instellings rakende wetgewende aangeleenthede. Rig litigasie-aangeleenthede teen die Outoriteit en skakel met die departement se direktoraat vir regsdienste oor sulke aangeleenthede. Neem deel om Wetsontwerpe deur die wetgewende opstel- en Parlementêre proses te neem, en die opstel van regsdokumente namens die Refugee Appeals Authority. Neem deel aan die deursoek en opstel van internasionale ooreenkomste en Memoranda van Ooreenkoms. Skenk aandag aan versoeke ingevolge die Promotion of Access to Information Act, 2000 (Act No. 2 of 2000). Verseker die implementering van doeltreffende risiko- en nakomingsbestuur. Implementering van beleide, prosedures, direktiewe, wette en regulasies. Vermoë om toepaslike prosesse en stelsels, asook onderskragende tegnologie, in te stel om die departement te ondersteun om die vereiste werk doeltreffend en effektief te bestuur. Ondersteun digitale transformasie.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezomthetho Wengqungqulu Yezomthetho (MR1-MR5)
zu.summary: Umphathi Wezomthetho Wengqungqulu Yezomthetho ehhovisi eliyinhloko le-Department of Home Affairs eTshwane, ofuna iziqu ze-LLB ukuphatha ukubhalwa kwemithetho kanye nezinkantilo ze-Refugee Appeals Authority.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-LLB noma isiqu esilingana semithetho seminyaka e-4 (four) ezingeni le-NQF 7 (seven) njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. MR1: Akukho mcilingo wemithetho wangaphambilini odingekayo. MR 2: Unyaka o-1 (one) wokuhlolwa kwemithetho okuhambisana neso ngemuva kweziqu emkhakheni wokubhalwa kwemithetho kanye nenzinkantilo. MR 3: Iminyaka e-2 (two) yokuhlolwa kwemithetho okuhambisana neso ngemuva kweziqu emkhakheni wenzinkantilo. MR 4: Iminyaka e-4 (four) yokuhlolwa kwemithetho okufanele ngemuva kweziqu emkhakheni wenzinkantilo. MR 5: Iminyaka e-6 (six) yokuhlolwa kwemithetho okuhambisana neso ngemuva kweziqu emkhakheni wenzinkantilo. Kudingeka ukuba uyilunga njengoMmeli noma iNdvuna Yomthetho njengoba kudingeka ku-MR 2-5. Ilayisensi evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi ngokuhlela ukusebenza kwezinyathelo kanye nokuhlela amandla okuqasha. Ulwazi ngazo zonke imithetho yesevisi yamakhamula. Ulwazi oluwulula ngoMthetho Wokungena Kwabavela Emakhaya omakhelwane kanye noMthetho Wabagibeli. Ulwazi ngesakhiwo somthetho wokulawula Imisebenzi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi olubanzi ngoMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwezimali Zomphakathi (PFMA) kanye nemithetho yobulungu bephesheya. Ulwazi ngeMthethosisekelo yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuqonda ukuthi kubhalwe kanjani umthetho wesigaba samathuluzi abakha inqubo yomthetho. Ulwazi ngeMthethosisekelo yaseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi ngeMthetho Wokulawulwa Kwemisebenzi Yomphakathi. Ulwazi ngoMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Komsebenzi. Amakhono okulingana kanye nokwazi okudingekayo: Ukukwazi ukubuka kude kanye nokuba ngumbono. Ukuthuthukiswa kokuletha izinsiza entsha, ukuzinikelwa kumakhasimende kanye nokugxila kumakhasimende. Ukuphathwa kwabantu kanye nokuqashwa kwamandla. Ukuphathwa kwezimali nokulawulwa kohlelo. Ubophezelo. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo nokuqashwa kwamaphrojekthi. Ukuphathwa kobudgethi. Ukuphathwa kokuphephela emngcele wokungalungelelwanga. Ukubhala izinto ezihlobene nomthetho, amakhono okubhala amafayela omthetho. Ukuhlaziwa kwezinqubo nokuthuthukiswa kwayo. Ukuqasha amakhono. Ukuphathwa komthelela wokungalungi. Ukuthobela imiyalelo nokuqashwa kokuhambisana kwayo. Amakhono. Ukuba nokwazi nge-netwekhi. Amakhono okwenza ubuchwepheshe (Amangcolosi). Amakhono okuhlela ubuchwepheshe (Amangcolosi). Ukwenza ubuchwepheshe bedijithali. Ukuba nokwazi ngeqhinga lokwenza. Ukulawula nokuthathwa kwezinqumo. Ukubandakanywa kwezimiso. Ukugxila ezintweni eziphephile.
zu.duties: Umuntu ophumelelayo uzoba nesibopho sokwenza, kwezinye, okulandelayo okuyimisebenzi ethize: Ukubeka amathuba emisweni wokusebenza nsuku zonke kwephakhe lezomthetho le-Refugee Appeals Authority. Ukubhala imithetho entsha kanye nokulungisa imithetho ephila efakwa emaphakethe le-Refugee Appeals Authority. Ukunikeza izinkulumo ezivela emlonyeni nangezibhalo mayelana yonke imithetho ephethwe yi-Refugee Appeals Authority. Ukuba namandla nolwazi oluwululile kakhulu ngomthetho oyimithetho esekwa ikhaya phakathi nakwamanye amaphathi. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesiZulu mayelana namalungiselelo ehhovisi elifakwa emthethweni. Ulwazi olubanzi lweSigungu Sokuqasha Ithuluzi LesiZulu kanye nokuqashwa kwamathuluzi. Ulwazi oluphelele lweSigungu Sokwenza Ithuluzi LesiZulu. Ukuba namandla nolwazi ngezenzo ezihlukene kanye nezidingo ezikhona ezihlukene ezihlobene nemithetho yezikoleji. Ukuba nolwazi ngezindinganayo zezinsiza zezimali. Ukuba nolwazi olunzulu ngamaphoyisa abantu abangakwazi ukuziphilisa nokuphepha. Ukuba nokwazi okuhambisana nokuqashwa kwamathuluzi. Ukuba namakhono okuqamba izigqibo. Ukuphathwa kwemigqaqo nokuthi kwenziwe ngokusimama komthetho wezimali. Ukuphathwa kokungabi nalunga. Amakhono okuqonda. Ulwazi oluningiliziwe. Ukuba nokwazi nokuqonda okungenangono kanye noMthetho Wokuthathwa Kwesigqi Somsebenzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda imithetho enelayisense kanye namagunya okusebenza ngawo. Amakhono okulawula imigqa yemithetho nesigqi somsebenzi. Ukuba nokwazi nokuqonda imithetho yamakhasimende nezakhiwo zamakhasimende. Ukulandelwa kwezinqubo eziphepha kakhulu kubalulekile. Ulwazi oluzungezile ngezivumelwano zangaphandle. Amakhono okubhala izigqibo. Amakhono okubhala imibhalo yamagunya. Amakhono okubhala amafayela ephunga. Ulwazi lwegama nokuqonda imithetho. Ukuba nokwazi okukhulu ngokwakha imigqaqo. Ukulawula ukusetshenziswa kolimi. Amakhono okuba nokwazi konke ngempilo. Ulwazi ngamathuluzi wokuphumeza amathuluzi.

xh.title: I-ofisa yoLawulo lweMthetho (MR1-MR5)
xh.summary: I-ofisa yoLawulo lweMthetho kwiSebe leZabahlali ihovili elikulu eTshwane, elifuna isidanga seLLB ukuphatha ukuqamba kwemithetho nokusetyenziswa komthetho kwiBhunga leZophulo labaGxothiweyo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seLLB okanye isifaniso soqeqesho lwezomthetho lweminyaka eli-4 (kune) kwinqanaba le-NQF elingu-7 (sisixhenxe) njengokuqatshiwe yi-SAQA. MR1: Akukho nako yomthetho yangaphambili efunwayo. MR 2: Umva weminyaka eli-1 (nye) wokugqiba uqeqesho oluhambelana nomthetho kwindawo yokuqamba nokusetyenziswa komthetho. MR 3: Umva weminyaka emi-2 (mbini) wokugqiba uqeqesho oluhambelana nomthetho kwindawo yokusetyenziswa komthetho. MR 4: Umva weminyaka emi-4 (kune) wokugqiba uqeqesho oluhambelana nomthetho kwindawo yokusetyenziswa komthetho. MR 5: Umva weminyaka emi-6 (thandathu) wokugqiba uqeqesho oluhambelana nomthetho kwindawo yokusetyenziswa komthetho. Kufuneka ubhaliswe njengogqetha okanye njengommeli kwi-MR 2-5. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ulwazi ngokuqwalasela ukuhamba komsebenzi nokuqwalasela amandla okusebenza. Ulwazi ngawo onke amacebo oLawulo lweZabahlali. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngoMthetho wokuNgena kwelinye ilizwe noMthetho wabaGxothiweyo. Ulwazi ngeSiseko soLawulo loLuntu lweNkonzo. Ulwazi olubanzi ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoLuntu (PFMA) nangamacebo oLawulo lweNdlu yegcinwa mali. Ulwazi ngeSodo-mthetho saseMzantsi Afrika. Ukuqonda ngemithetho yesebe nangemithetho yoLawulo lweZemisebenzi yabantu nangemithetho. Ulwazi ngeSodo-mthetho saseMzantsi Afrika Ulwazi ngeMithetho yoLawulo lweNkonzo yoLuntu. Ulwazi ngeMithetho yeMisebenzi yoLawulo lweMpilo nokuKhuseleka. Amakhono namandla afunekayo: Ikhono lokubakho istrategi nokubekwa iindlela. Uqwalaselo lokufaka izinto ezintsha kwinkonzo, ukuqwalasela abathengi nogqaliselo kubathengi. Ulawulo lwabantu noku banika amandla. ULawulo loMali nokuLawulwa kwayo. Ixabiso lokwenzela iziphakamiso. ULawulo lweNkqubo namanqanaba. ULawulo lweNgxowa-mali. ULawulo lweengozi zemali. Ikhono lokubhala ngomthetho, nokuqamba amaxwebhu omthetho. Ukuqwalasela nokuphucula iinkqubo. Kuqwalaselo kwiinkcukacha. Ikhono lokufaka iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo nezixhobo, kunye neteknoloji encedisayo, ukuxhasa iSebe ekulawuleni ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanekileyo umsebenzi ofunekayo. Ixhaso ngokutshintshwa kwedijithali. Unxibelelwano olubalaseleyo ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo, kunye namakhono okubonisa. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela. ULawulo nokuxazulula iingxabano. Amakhono okuziphatsha nabantu. Iikhompyutha namanethiwekhi. Uyilo lweNzululwazi nentengiso. Uyilo lweteknoloji (amanethiwekhi). Amakhono okuchukumisa, ukwenza inethiwekhi, ulawulo lweengxabano nokuqhubana ngokucinga. Ukwenza izigqibo nokuqalisa izenzo. Ulawulo, ukuhlela nolawulo lwexesha. Ukuphuhlisa iinkqubo, ukuqeqesha nokuqhuba iintlanganiso. UkuBhala iingxelo zoshishino. Ukuqonda ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Uthando lwelizwe, uQinisileyo nokuZithembeka.
xh.duties: Umphathi opumelelayo uya kuba uyakuxhomekeka koku, phakathi kwabanye, kule misebenzi elandelayo: Ukulawula imisebenzi yemihla ngemihla yeqela lomthetho leBhunga leZophulo labaGxothiweyo. Ukuqamba umthetho omtsha nokuqwalasela umthetho osele ukhona olawulwa yiBhunga leZophulo labaGxothiweyo. Ukunika izimvo ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo malunga nawo onke amathungo omthetho alawulwa yiBhunga leZophulo labaGxothiweyo nako nalunye na umthetho oqhagamshelana nalo. Ukuqhuba uphando olulungileyo oluqinisekisiweyo kunye nengcebiso yomthetho neemvo zomthetho nsuku zonke ngomlomo nakubhalwe. Ukunika ingcebiso yomthetho kwaye ulungise amaxwebhu omthetho weqela. Ukulawula iingcali kumthetho kunye nokunika ingcebiso kwiOfisi ezamkela abaGxothiweyo. Ukuhamba nxulumana namanye amasebe karhulumente nemiqathango malunga nemithetho. Ukujongana nemithetho yokusetyenziswa ichwayo ibhunga kwaye uhambisane nedirekhate yesebe yemisebenzi yomthetho kule meko. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekudluliseni amabhiliq embhedeni wokuqamba umthetho nakuqhubeka kwiNdlu yoWiso-mthetho, nasekuqambeni amaxwebhu omthetho ngenkathalo yeBhunga leZophulo labaGxothiweyo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuqwalaselweni nasekuqambeni iivumelwano zamazwe ngamazwe nemiQathano yokuQonda. Ukujongana neesicelo ngokukaMthetho wokuPhakamisa uFikelelo lwolwazi, 2000 (uMthetho uNombolo 2 ka-2000). Ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kokulawulwa okusebenzayo kweengozi nokuqwalasela ukuzithobela. Ukusebenzisa iinkqubo, iindlela, imiyalelo, imithetho nangamacebo. Ikhono lokufaka iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo nezixhobo, kunye neteknoloji encedisayo, ukuxhasa iSebe ekulawuleni ngokusebenza kakuhle nangokuchanekileyo umsebenzi ofunekayo. Ixhaso lokutshintshwa kwedijithali.

Kufanele babe nokuhlolwa okungu-3-5 eminyakeni ekubhalweni ngaphansi kokuba ngumqashi ohlela izinsebenleko ngemikhakha yokuqonda inkinobho yomsebenzi kahulumeni njengoko kumthethosisekelo wethu ilanga elinzima lokuziphendulela komphakathi ngokwenza imithetho yethu yomsebenze. Kufanele babe nobuqwqwe obukhulu bokuhlolwa kolwazi kuhlelelwe ngokwemithetho nemithetho ehlongeze iholo le-Department of International Relations and Cooperation njengoba kuhlongozwe ngumthethosisekelo wethu ohlinzeka ngendlela zokusungula izakhamzimba ezisebenza kahulumeni njengoba kwenziwa ngumthetho kanye nabakwemikhakha yokwelashwa kwengqondo ekhombisa ukuthi izinhlobo zemisebenzi ezingakusizi ukuthi othisha abakwazi ukusebenzisa izinhlelo ezinhle zokwenza imisebenzi yabo. Iziqu ekubhaleni izikhundla zokusebenza ziyotholakala ngokuthi abafakeli bakhombise ukuthi bakwazi ukusebenza ngokwezidingo zomthetho ohlongeza ngemisebenzi kahulumeni ekhonza izidingo zomphakathi. Ukuqonda ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlobo zemisebenzi kanye nokuqonda izindlela ezisetshenziswa ekuthuthukisweni kwamandla okuqonda inkinobho yomsebenzi. Ulwazi lwesimiso sokulawula izinhlobo zemisebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zokwenza imisebenzi kahulumeni. Ulwazi mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamathuluzi okulinganisela ukusebenza kahle kwemisebenzo kahulumeni. Ukubona inkinga nokuxazulula inkinga; Amakhono okuhlola, amakhono okuphenya; Amakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe, okuthethwayo nokusebenzisa ikhompuyutha); Ukuhlaziya nokuthuthukisa izinqubomgomo, amakhono okubeka izinkomba ngokusimama, ukubhala umbiko, Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokuphephansi. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ohlanganyeni noma ngabanye, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukuphatha abantu nokuqinisa abantu; Ukuqiniseka nokungakhohlisi, ukuba noso lwazi ngopolitiki nangamasiko, nokuhlomula izinkinga ngobuhlakani.
zu.duties: Phatha ukwakhiwa nokuhambisanisa isakhiwo sesimiso sokusebenza nomgomo nezinhloso zomnyango, Phatha futhi unikeze izinsiza zokusekela ukulinganiswa kwezikhundla, Phatha futhi wenze ukulinganiswa kokusebenza kahle kwesimiso ukuze kuqiniseke ukuba isimiso sisebenza kahle futhi ngempumelelo. xh.title: Phakathi kukomiti othatha izigqibo: Ukuziphilisa kweziko
xh.summary: Umphathi othatha izigqibo ophethe ukuziphilisa kweziko nokuqwalaselwa kwemisebenzi kwiSebe leZiQhoboshelo zamazwe ngamazwe nokuSebenzisana ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe ne-Diploma/ Degree ye-NQF Level 6 esezantsi kwesidanga se-digri kwiNkonzo zoLawulo, uLawulo loMsebenzi, iPsikholoji yoNyango/ ndimu ephathelene nayo. Kubafuneka babe nokuhlubelelo okungu-3-5 unyaka bokuba ngumlawuli omncinci kokuZiphilisa kweziko nakuQwalaselwa kwemisebenzi. Isatifikethi sokuQwalaselwa kwemisebenzi siza kuba luncedo elongezelelekileyo. Ikhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda kohlobo lwemithetho olulawula iNkonzo kaZwe njengoko kubhalwe kuMgaqo-siseko kuriphabhlikhi yaseMzantsi Afrika, uMthetho weNkonzo kaZwe, iimithetho yolawulo yeNkonzo kaZwe, i-PFMA, njl. Ulwazi ngokuqhuba uQwalaselwa lwemisebenzi nemigaqo. Ulwazi lophuhliso lwezibhalo zemisebenzi. Ulwazi nokuqonda kweekhadi, iintsingiselo neelayisensi kwinkalo yokuZiphilisa kweziko. Ulwazi ngeNkululeko yoPhuhliso koLuntu izigqibo eziphambili zeSebe. Ulwazi ngokuqwalaselwa kolawulo lokuSebenza ibali iSebe (OFA). Ulwazi ngokuqwalaselwa kolawulo lweSixhobo sokuQinisekisa ukusebenza kweziko (OFA). Ulwazi loLawulo lweeprojekthi, iindlela, izixhobo nezigaba zomso wokuphila kweprojekthi. Ukuqamba ngokulungiselela nokuqamba ngokuhamba, ulwazi nokusetyenziswa kokuqamba kwenkqubo yeNkqubo yoLawulo, ujongano kumxhasi nokuqwalaselwa kumthengi; Ulawulo lwesixoxo soluvo, ulwazi lokuhlalutya, iindlela ezisetyenziswa ekuphenweni, iindlela zokuzingisa; amakhono okuqhuba iindlela zokuba ngumuntu onamakhono (ekubhalweni, ekuThetheni nakusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha); ukuhlalutya nophuhliso lweNkqubo, ulwazi lokuqhuba iindlela zokwenza izinto, iindlela zokubhala iingxelo, ukwazi ukusebenza ngenkxaso eqinileyo, ukwazi ukusebenza njengelungu elizimeleyo, ulawulo lwexesha, ulawulo nabantu abakhuthazwa; ukuba nyaneko nokwazi ukuzithembisa, ukuziphepha kwezopolitiko nakulwalamano lwamasiko nokuNcokola ngokubalulekileyo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ukwakhiwa nokuqwalaselwa ukuvumelana kohlobo lweziko nokuqwalaselwa ngenkqubo nangemigqabo yesebe. Ulawula nokuqaqambisa iNkonzo ngenkxaso ekubekeni kwezibalo ezisebenzayo ezahlukeneyo. Ulawula nokuqhuba uQwalaselwa lolawulo lokuSebenza ibali iSebe (OFA) ngokuqinisekisa ukuba lisebenza kakuhle nelusebenzayo. Kufuneka kuqinisekiswe ukusebenza kakuhle nokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwentengiso. Nikela ngentshinga yophuhliso kwinkqubo yokuqhuba imisebenzi ngenkxaso yolawulo, Ulawula iSebe ngaphantsi neprojekthi yenkqubo yomsebenzi. Ulawula iSebe esithili neprojekthi ngokunika inkxaso ngokusetyenziswa kweekhadi nabantu abakule nhlangano.
