jobs.notes: Applicants are invited to submit applications, quoting the relevant reference number to the link and or address indicated in each specific advertisement. Applications should be accompanied by a fully completed and signed Application for Employment Form (New Z83, effective from 1 January 2021, obtainable at www.dpsa.gov.za), citing the correct post number and job title; a comprehensive CV (citing the start and end date (dd/mm/yy), job title, detailed duties performed and exit reason for each employment period to be considered, as well as the details of three contactable employment references and copies of educational qualifications. Applicants who possess foreign qualification(s), are furthermore required to submit the evaluated results of such qualifications as received from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre- entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. These assessments are aimed at assessing candidate’s professional and technical competency against the job requirements and duties, general job fit, integrity and digital literacy). Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) candidates will undergo psychometric assessment to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural, emotional intelligence and integrity. All suitable candidates will be subjected to mandatory pre-employment screening/ suitability checks/ verification (credit, criminal, citizenship, qualifications, employment pending disciplinary action and professional registration. Suitable candidates for Senior Management Service positions will also be required to successfully complete the online Nyukela Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services course, which can be accessed via: http://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Candidates wishing to be considered for appointment, are encouraged to enroll for the course as soon as possible. Due to high volumes anticipated, communication will be limited to shortlisted candidates. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development (DOJ&CD) seeks to appoint exceptional, ethical and visionary leaders to join its executive leadership team in advancing constitutional democracy. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered. The Department is committed to providing equal opportunities and affirmative action employment. It is our intention to promote representativity in terms of (race, gender, and disability). MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Regadministrasiebeampte: Regsproses (MR1-MR5)
af.summary: Administreer presidensiële kwytskeldings, uitwissing en artikel 327-aansoeke by die Department of Justice Nasionale Kantoor in Pretoria, wat 'n LLB of NQF vlak 7-regskwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: An NQF level 7-regskwalifikasie/LLB-graad soos deur SAQA erken. Minimum ervaring wat wissel van nul tot agt (8) jaar se kwalifikasie-ervaring ooreenkomstig die tersaaklike MR-graad. Toelating as 'n prokureur of advokaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Degelike kennis en begrip van die Grondwet, Administratiefreg en die Strafregstelsel. Kennis van die Openbare Diens se Wetgewings- en Bestuursraamwerk. Kennis van die Public Finance Management Act en Tesourie-regulasies. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Vaardighede en Bevoegdhede: Regsnavorsing en opstel van dokumente; Skikking van geskille; Analitiese denke; Kommunikasievaardighede (geskryf en mondeling); Voorleggings- en fasiliteringsvaardighede; Saakvloei-bestuur. Rekenaarvaardigheid; Uitstekende interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om as 'n span, individueel en onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Verwerk die ontvangs van presidensiële kwytskeldings. Verwerk uitwissing en artikel 327-aansoeke. Verskaf verslae en terugvoer oor presidensiële kwytskeldings, uitwissing en artikel 327-aansoeke. Voer regsnavorsing en kasreg uit wat relevant is tot die presidensiële kwytskelding, uitwissing en artikel 327-aansoeke. Stel regsdokumente op en prosesseer vir goedkeuring oor presidensiële kwytskeldings, uitwissing en artikel 327-aansoeke.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokuphathwa Komthetho: Inqubo Yomthetho (MR1-MR5)
zu.summary: Ukuphatha izicelo zoxolo lukamongameli, zokususwa kurekhodi nezika-umthetho 327 ehhovisi lesizwe le-Department of Justice ePretoria, kudingeka iziqu ze-LLB noma iziqu zomthetho zazinga le-NQF 7.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zomthetho zazinga le-NQF 7/ LLB Degree njengoba zithathwa ngokusemthethweni yi-SAQA. Okuncane ukuhlangenwe nakho kusukela kuzero kuye kwayeyisikhombisa (8) iminyaka yokuhlangenwa nakho ngemva kweziqu ngokuvumelana neninga le-MR elifanele. Ukamiselwa njengommeli noma njengesikhulumi kuzoba yinzuzo enkulu. Ukwazi okuhle nokukuqonda ngomthethosisekelo, umthetho wokuphathwa kwezindaba kanye nesistimu yokuphatha ecaleni yobugebengu. Ulwazi lwe-Cadre Womthetho Wezinkonzo Zomphakathi Nesakhiwo Sokubusa. Ulwazi ngomthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali Yomphakathi nemithetho ye-Treasury. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono Namakhono Okusebenza: Ucupo lomthetho nokubhala; Ukuxazulula izinkinga; Ukucabanga ngokuhlola; Amakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nokukhulunywa); Amakhono okubonisa nokuhola; Ukuphathwa kokuhamba kwezicala. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha; Amakhono Ohlu Oluhle Sokuxhumana Nabantu. Isikhulo sokusebenza njengqembu, ngabanye naphansi kwezinkinga.
zu.duties: Ukucubungula ukwamukelwa kwezicelo zoxolo lukamongameli. Ukucubungula izicelo zokususwa kurekhodi nezika-umthetho 327. Ukunikeza imibiko nempendulo ngezicelo zoxolo lukamongameli, zokususwa kurekhodi nezika-umthetho 327. Ukuqhuba ucupo lomthetho nemithetho yamacala ehlobene nezicelo zoxolo lukamongameli, zokususwa kurekhodi nezika-umthetho 327. Ukubhala amadokhumenti omthetho kanye nenqubo yokuvuma izicelo zoxolo lukamongameli, zokususwa kurekhodi nezika-umthetho 327.

xh.title: Mphathi wezaba zemigangatho: Inkqubo yamagazincwadi (MR1-MR5)
xh.summary: Lawula izicelo zothetho olutsha kolawulo olusuka kumthetho, ukutyhapha kunye namagazincwadi wesiqleru esi-327 kwiziwo zikarhulumente kuNdulantsi aphila iNdlu yeNgqungquthela yamathetho, izizathu, iinkululeko zokuziphilisa kunye namaphethu womthetho kaRhulumente weNyanelo leRiphabiliko yomzantsi Afrika, ngokusemthethweni kukamthetho wonyaka ka-2016.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-7 lemfundo ephantsi komthetho i-LIB Degree njengoko kuchazwe yi-SAQA. iNqanaba lesiphiwo neI-LIB Degree njengoko ivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Indalo yonke iminyaka yohlobo lwesikhundla sokulinganiselwa ngokwemfuneko kweliNqanaba le-7 lokuvavanya nenyani engazange ibe naliso isicelo seNqanaba le-7 seMandla woqeqesho kwi-LIB Degree njengoko kufunwa ngumthetho. Ukungcatshelwa njengomthunywa wezamagazincwadi okanye isigqoki kuya kuba luncedo. Ulwazi olubanzi kwaye uqonde uMthethosiseko, uMthetho woLawulo kunye nendlela efunwa kukaMthetho weNyanelo. Ulwazi lweNyanelo yeNyanelo yoLawulo lomthetho kunye neziseko zoLawulo. Ulwazi loMthetho woLawulo lweMali yeNyanelo kunye noMthetho weliqhinga. Ileloti yokushukuma egunyazisiweyo. Amandla nobutyhala: Ulwazi kulwazi nokuqhuba imigangatho; iNkqubo yomthetho; Ukucabanga ngokudibanisa ulwazi; Amandla okuthetha (okubhalwayo nentetho); iNdlela yokubonisa nokuqhuba inkqubo; ulawulo lohambo lwezityholo. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha; Obukhulu bukaLuntu. Amandla okusebenza njengesiqhulo, sodwa nangaphantsi komthwalo.
xh.duties: Umsebenzi wokwenza iiNkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokuLawula iNqanaba le-7 lemfundo ephantsi komthetho njengoko kuchazwe nguMthetho. Ulwazi lomthetho kwiNqanaba lesi-7 kwesiNqanaba ngokuvunywa nguMthetho. Ukungcatshelwa njengomthunywa wezamagazincwadi okanye isigqoki kuya kubakho luncedo olukhulu. Ulwazi olukhulu kwaye uqonde uMthethosiseko, uMthetho woLawulo kunye noMthetho weNyanelo. Ulwazi loMthetho wokuLawulwa koluntu kunye noMthetho woLawulo. Ulwazi loMthetho woLawulo lweMali yokuziphilisa kunye noMthetho. Ileloti yokushukuma egunyazisiweyo. Amandla nobukhali: Ulwazi lokuqhuba iindaba ezahlukeneyo; Ukusombulula iingxaki; Ukucenga ngokubukhali; Amandla okuthetha (okubhalwayo nentetho); Amandla okubonisa nokuqinisekisa; ulawulo lohambo lwezityholo. Ukwazi ukusebenzela iikhompyutha; Obukhulu bokuziphatha kwabanye. Amandla okusebenza ngomanyano, ngokwakho nangaphantsi komthwalo.

jobs.reference_number: 3/1/1/1/2026/205 Chief Directorate: Cadastral Advisory and Research Services
jobs.title: Chief Director: Cadastral Advisory and Research Services
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS).
jobs.summary: Chief Director overseeing cadastral survey research and development, leading transformation of South Africa's cadastral and tenure systems based in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of Grade 12 Certificate and a four-year Bachelor’s Degree or Bachelor of Science Degree in Geomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) as recognised by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) and a Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor or Geomatics Professional: Land Surveying, with the South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Registered as a Sectional Titles Practitioner in terms of Section 5(2) of the Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum of 5 years’ experience at a senior managerial level in a land surveying environment. Appropriate post registration experience in cadastral surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Cadastral surveying. Technical system. Cadastral Spatial Information. Land Information Systems. Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral Survey System. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with misconduct. Internal control and risk management. Project management principles and tools. Budget systems. Financial Accounting Systems. Public Finance Management. Job related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business and Communication (verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Manage and oversee the research and development of cadastral surveys. Research ways of transforming, improving and rationalising the South African Cadastral and Tenure Systems. Study world trends, legislative framework, compare with other systems, propose amendments and report on findings. Research and investigate ways of improving cadastral practices in South Africa. Manage development towards amendment and streamlining of legislation. Coordinate and develop tender specifications. Manage and oversee the provision of internal and external professional advisory and support services. Research, compile reports and supply information in respect of internal and external cadastral matters and requests from State Organs, Parastatals, Courts and Private Sector, in accordance with relevant legislation and time frames, client’s request as well as within targets set by the Service Delivery Improvement Programme. Render management and research for state surveys, rural development and land tenue reform projects in accordance with relevant legislation, terms of reference, pre-determined standards and treasury instructions. Provide professional services to the public and government departments on the surveys of state and trust land and state domestic facilities undertaken by the private sector. Manage and oversee the administration of international boundaries. Manage the administration of South Africa international boundaries, in compliance with South African and international legislation in as far as delineation and delimitation thereof. Manage the research, investigation and finding solutions to anomalies in Republic of South Africa international boundaries in conjunction with representatives from the neighbouring states. Manage advisory services on Republic of South Africa international boundary issues affecting State Organs and Parastatals. Manage the physical delineation of international borders and record keeping. Manage and oversee the registration of Sectional Title Practitioners. Monitor Sectional Titles Practical Training Programme in accordance with the Sectional Titles Act and training schedule. Provide secretariat services for the registration of Sectional Titles Practitioners in compliance with requirements of the Sectional Titles Act and regulations. Maintain and update the register for Sectional Title Practitioners. Manage and oversee the preparation of technical procedures and standards. Ensure management of updating Surveyor’s General procedures and standards, in compliance with legislation and in consultation with stakeholders. Investigate effects of technological advancement on technical procedures and standards and transform accordingly. Manage the preparation and implementation of new legislation and review of regulations in terms of the Land Survey Act and any other relevant legislation. Manage the implementation of new legislation. Provide support to the Survey Regulations Board (SRB) for review of regulations framed under the Act. Assist the Chief Surveyor-General with administration and control of the Survey Regulations Board (SRB) and provide secretariat thereto. Provide support to the Chief Surveyor-General in respect of administration of the Geomatics Profession Act. Research and advise on new legislation that has an effect on geomatics matters.

jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males and African, Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Kadastrale Adviserings- en Navorsingsdienste
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur wat toesig hou oor kadastrale opmetingsnavorsing en -ontwikkeling, en transformasie van South Africa se kadastrale en besitregstelsels lei, gebaseer in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n vierjaar Bachelorsgraad of Bachelorsgraad in Wetenskap in Geomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) soos deur die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) erken besit, asook 'n Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) wat voor aanstelling ingedien moet word. Geregistreer as 'n Professional Land Surveyor of Geomatics Professional: Land Surveying by die South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Geregistreer as 'n Sectional Titles Practitioner ooreenkomstig Section 5(2) van die Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Minimum van 5 jaar se ondervinding op 'n senior bestuursvlak in 'n landmeter-omgewing. Toepaslike ondervinding na registrasie in kadastrale opmeting. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Kadastrale opmeting. Tegniese stelsel. Kadastrale Ruimtelike Inligting. Land Information Systems. Land Administration Systems en Geographical Information Management. Kennis van tegnologiese vooruitgang wat nuttig is vir die Cadastral Survey System. Prestasiebestuur en monitering. Regeringstelsels en -strukture. Regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse. Programopstelproses. Begrip van die bestuursinligting- en formele verslagdoeningstelsel. Hantering van wangedrag. Interne beheer en risikobestuur. Projekbestuursbeginsels en -instrumente. Begrotingstelsels. Finansiële rekenkundige stelsels. Openbare finansiële bestuur. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projekbestuur. Spanbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Hulpbronbeplanning. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Tydsbestuur. Besigheids- en Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik).
af.duties: Bestuur en hou toesig oor die navorsing en ontwikkeling van kadastrale opmetings. Ondersoek maniere om die South Africa Cadastral and Tenure Systems te transformeer, te verbeter en te rasionaliseer. Bestudeer wêreldtendense, die wetgewende raamwerk, vergelyk met ander stelsels, stel wysigings voor en doen verslag oor bevindings. Ondersoek en ondersoek maniere om kadastrale praktyke in South Africa te verbeter. Bestuur ontwikkeling ten opsigte van wysiging en stroomlyning van wetgewing. Koördineer en ontwikkel tender spesifikasies. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die voorsiening van interne en eksterne professionele advies- en ondersteuningsdienste. Doen navorsing, stel verslae op en verskaf inligting ten opsigte van interne en eksterne kadastrake aangeleenthede en versoeke van State Organs, Parastatals, Courts en Private Sector, ooreenkomstig tersaaklike wetgewing en tydraamwerke, die kliënt se versoek asook binne teikens wat deur die Service Delivery Improvement Programme gestel is. Verskaf bestuur en navorsing vir staatsopmetings, landelike ontwikkeling en grondbesitthervormingsprojekte ooreenkomstig tersaaklike wetgewing, terme van verwysing, vooraf bepaalde standaarde en tesourie-instruksies. Verskaf professionele dienste aan die publiek en regeringsdepartemente oor opmetings van staats- en trustgrond en staatsbinnehuishoudelike fasiliteite wat deur die private sektor onderneem word. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die administrasie van internasionale grense. Bestuur die administrasie van South Africa se internasionale grense, in ooreenstemming met South African en internasionale wetgewing vir sover dit die afbakening en vastelling daarvan aangaan. Bestuur die navorsing, ondersoek en vind van oplossings vir anomalieë in Republic of South Africa se internasionale grense in samewerking met verteenwoordigers van die buurstate. Bestuur adviesdienste oor Republic of South Africa internasionale grensaangeleenthede wat State Organs en Parastatals raak. Bestuur die fisiese afbakening van internasionale grense en rekordhouding. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die registrasie van Sectional Title Practitioners. Monitor die Sectional Titles Practical Training Programme ooreenkomstig die Sectional Titles Act en opleidingskedule. Verskaf sekretariatsdienste vir die registrasie van Sectional Titles Practitioners in ooreenstemming met vereistes van die Sectional Titles Act en regulasies. Onderhou en dateer die register vir Sectional Title Practitioners op. Bestuur en hou toesig oor die voorbereiding van tegniese prosedures en standaarde. Verseker bestuur van die opdatering van Surveyor's General prosedures en standaarde, in ooreenstemming met wetgewing en in oorleg met belanghebbendes. Ondersoek die uitwerking van tegnologiese vooruitgang op tegniese prosedures en standaarde en transformeer dienooreenkomstig. Bestuur die voorbereiding en implementering van nuwe wetgewing en hersiening van regulasies ooreenkomstig die Land Survey Act en enige ander tersaaklike wetgewing. Bestuur die implementering van nuwe wetgewing. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die Survey Regulations Board (SRB) vir hersiening van regulasies kragtens die Act. Ondersteun die Chief Surveyor-General met die administrasie en beheer van die Survey Regulations Board (SRB) en verskaf sekretariatsdienste daarvoor. Verskaf ondersteuning aan die Chief Surveyor-General ten opsigte van die administrasie van die Geomatics Profession Act. Doen navorsing en gee advies oor nuwe wetgewing wat 'n uitwerking op geomatics-aangeleenthede het.

zu.title: Chief Director: Cadastral Advisory and Research Services
zu.summary: Omkhulu we-Director obhekene nocwaningo lwe-cadastral survey kanye nenjabulo, ehola intuthuko ye-cadastral and tenure systems zaseningizimu Afrika asePretoria.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ebankatha: Abafake izicelo kumele babe nesi-Certificate sama-Grade 12 kanye ne-Degree yesamba seminyaka emine ye-Bachelor noma i-Degree ye-Bachelor of Science ku-Geomatics / Land Surveying (NQF Level 7) njengoba kuqashwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kanye ne-Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) ethunyelwe ngaphambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Kufanele abhalwe njengo-Professional Land Surveyor noma i-Geomatics Professional: Land Surveying, ne-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Kufanele abhalwe njengo-Sectional Titles Practitioner ngokwe-Section 5(2) yoMthetho we-Sectional Titles, 1986. Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-5 yokusebenza ezingeni lomphathi ophakeme emkhakheni we-Land Surveying. Okuhlobene nocwaningo olwenziwe emva kobhaliso kwi-cadastral surveying. Ilayisense yokushayela evumelekile. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Cadastral surveying. Technical system. Cadastral Spatial Information. Land Information Systems. Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Ulwazi ngentuthuko kubuchwepheshe ewusizo ku-Cadastral Survey System. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with misconduct. Internal control and risk management. Project management principles and tools. Budget systems. Financial Accounting Systems. Public Finance Management. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business and Communication (verbal and written).
zu.duties: Phatha futhi qaphule ucwaningo kanye nenjabulo yezivivinyo ze-cadastral. Cwaninga izindlela zokushintsha, ukuthuthukisa nokwenza ngokwezinye izinhlelo ze-Cadastral and Tenure Systems zaseningizimu Afrika. Funda ngamathrendi emhlabeni, uhlelo olomthetho, qathanisa nezinye izinhlelo, phakamisa izinguquko futhi umbike ngemiphumela. Cwaninga futhi uphenye izindlela zokuthuthukisa izenzele ze-cadastral eNingizimu Afrika. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwenguquko kanye nokwenza ngokusemthethweni komthetho. Lynchaza futhi uthuthukise izinkomba zethenda. Phatha futhi qaphule ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokweluleka ngobungcweti ezingaphakathi nangaphandle kanye nezinsiza zokusekela. Cwaninga, hlanganisa imibiko futhi nike ulwazi mayelana nezindaba ze-cadastral ezingaphakathi nangaphandle kanye nezicelo ezivela Kumabhemi Kazwelonke, Amaphelasathalente, Iinkundla kanye NezeMikhakha Yeminingi, ngokuhambisana nomthetho ohlobene kanye nesikhathi, nesicelo somthengi kanye nanomgomo ohlelwe Uhlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kokulethwa Kwezinsiza. Nikeza uphatho kanye nocwaningo lwezivivinyo zombuso, ukuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yasemakhaya kanye namaphrojekthi okushintsha ubuhlalo bomhlaba ngokuhambisana nomthetho ohlobene, imigomo yomsebenzi, izinga elicandwe ngaphambilini kanye nemiyalo yesidlavela. Nikeza izinsiza zobungcweti kumphakathi kanye neminyango kahulumeni ezivivinyweni zomhlaba webuso nangokwesabhalala kanye nezinto zangaphakathi zombuso ezenziwa umkhakha weziminingi. Phatha futhi qaphule uphatho lwemikhawulo yamazwe omhlaba. Phatha uphatho lwemikhawulo yamazwe omhlaba yaseningizimu Afrika, ngokuvumelana nomthetho waseningizimu Afrika kanye nowamazwe omhlaba kubo bonke ukumiswa kanye nokubeka kwawo. Phatha ucwaningo, uphenyo kanye nokuqhamula izixazululo ezingajwayelekile emikhawulweni yamazwe omhlaba yeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ngokubambisqa nameluleki abavela eziveni ezincelayo. Phatha izinsiza zokweluleka ezindabeni zemikhawulo yamazwe omhlaba yeRiphabhulikhi yaseNingizimu Afrika ezithinta Umabhemi Kazwelonke kanye namaphelasathalente. Phatha ukumiswa ngokomzimba kwemikhawulo yamazwe nomgomo wokugcina irekhodi. Phatha futhi qaphule ubhaliso kwabasebenza nge-Sectional Titles. Qapha Uhlelo Lokuqeqeshwa Ngokobusebenze be-Sectional Titles ngokuhambisana noMthetho we-Sectional Titles kanye neshejuli yokuqeqeshwa. Nikeza izinsiza zesikretari wobhaliso lwabasebenza nge-Sectional Titles ngokuvumelana nezidingo zoMthetho we-Sectional Titles kanye nemithetho. Gcina futhi uvuselela irekhodi labasebenza nge-Sectional Titles. Phatha futhi qaphule ukulungiswa kwezindlela zobuchwepheshe kanye namazinga. Qinisekisa uphatho lwokuvuselela izindlela kanye namazinga e-Surveyor's General, ngokuvumelana nomthetho futhi ngokubonisana nabahlanyele. Phenya imiphumela yentuthuko yobuchwepheshe kuzindlela zobuchwepheshe kanye namazinga bese ushintsha ngokufanele. Phatha ukulungiswa kanye nokuphatha umthetho omusha kanye nokubuyekeza imithetho ngokomthetho we-Land Survey Act kanye nomunye umthetho ohlobene. Phatha ukuphathwa komthetho omusha. Nikeza isekelo ku-Survey Regulations Board (SRB) ukubuyekeza imithetho ehlakahlwe ngaphansi koMthetho. Siza i-Chief Surveyor-General ngophatho kanye nolawulo lwe-Survey Regulations Board (SRB) futhi nikeza izinsiza zesikretari. Nikeza isekelo i-Chief Surveyor-General mayelana nophatho lo-Mthetho we-Geomatics Profession. Cwaninga futhi weluleke ngomthetho omusha onomthelela ezindabeni ze-geomatics.

xh.title: UMlawuli Omkhulu: Iinkonzo zoBugcisa boMthetho weeNkxalabo nokuPhonononga
xh.summary: UMlawuli Omkhulu oqhayisela uphononongo nentluko kwiindawo zesurvey ze-cadastral, ehola uguqulo lwemiba ye-cadastral kwaye nendlela yabini nayo yokuqamba ubukho base South Africa ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi kwako: Kufuneka abafaki-isicelo babe nesatifikethi seGreymiya 12 kwaye neNqanaba le-4 ye-Bachelor's Degree okanye i-Bachelor of Science Degree kwi-Geomatics / i-Land Surveying (i-NQF Level 7) njengoko kwamkelwa yi-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) kwaye neNyukela (i-Pre-entry Certificate kwi-SMS) esinikelwe phambi kokuba kwenzike isikhundla. Makabhaliswe njengomculi we-Professional Land Surveyor okanye i-Geomatics Professional: i-Land Surveying, kwi-South African Geomatics Council (SAGC). Makabhaliswe njenge-Sectional Titles Practitioner ngokomthetho wesection 5(2) we-Sectional Titles Act, 1986. Kufuneka abe nenqanaba lokuba nokuhlolwa kweminyaka engu-5 endaweni yekhaka eliphezulu lokulawula kwemeko yomhlaba. Kufuneka abe namava okusebenza edangatya wokubhalisa kwi-cadastral surveying. Isityhala-moto esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluxhumaniswa nomsebenzi: I-Cadastral surveying. I-Technical system. I-Cadastral Spatial Information. Iinkqubo ze-Land Information Systems. Iinkqubo zoLawulo loMhlaba nokuLawulwa kwe-Geographical Information Management. Ulwazi ngophuhliso kwitechnology ongenela nzuzo kwenkqubo ye-Cadastral Survey System. uLawulo loQwalaselo loMsebenzi nokuQwalasela. Iinkqubo neengqwalasela zahulumeni. Iinkqubo zokwenza izigqibo kahulumeni. Inkonzo yohlelo lwe-programme. Ukuqonda inkqubo yolwazi lolawulo nendlaliso ngokusesidlangalweni. Ukupatha ngokubiya edangatya. Ulawulo lwangaphakathi nolawulo lwengozi. Iingcamango zemisebenzi ngenkqubo yolawulo lwemikhwa nemixhobo. Iinkqubo zebhajethi. Iinkqubo ze-Financial Accounting Systems. uLawulo lwe-Mali kaRhulumende. Amandla axhumaniswa nomsebenzi: uLawulo lomsebenzi. uLawulo lweqela. Iintlangano phakathi kwabantu. Iimvumbo zebhajethi. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha. uQhagamshelo lwamandla abakho. uLusu-ngxaki nokwenza isigqibo. uLawulo lwexesha. iNkqubo nokuXhumana (kolunye nelungisiweyo).
xh.duties: uLawula noqhayisa uphononongo nentluko kwiindawo zesurvey ze-cadastral. Phonononga iindlela zoguqulo, ukuphucula nokuqamba ngokutsha iinkqubo ze-cadastral nendlela yabini yayo e-South Africa. Zingcela iidembe zehlabathi, umthetho ongundoqo, iqhathanise nezinye iinkqubo, ziphakamise ukutshintshwa komyalelo kwaye zenze ingxelo ngemiphumo. Phonononga nophando iindlela zokuphucula iindlela zokusebenza ze-cadastral kumazantsi e-Afrika. Lawula uphuhliso ngokwenzela ukutshintshwa kolunye umyalelo nokuqhwesha komthetho. Linganisa nophuhlize iinkqazo zemixhaso-mali. Lawula noqhayisa ukwabiwa kweenkonzo zengcebiso ezibungileyo nezazisi-ngxaki ezingaphakathi nangaphandle. Phonononga, uqulunqe iingxelo waze unike ulwazi ngokumayelana nendawo ye-cadastral yangaphakathi nangaphandle nemibuzo evela kwi-State Organs, i-Parastatals, iinkundla ne-Sephu yabucala, ngokomthetho ongundoqo nasemva kwexesha elifunwayo, imibuzo yamakhasimba njengoko nekumgca onqamileyo osekwe kuhlelo lokuPhucula iNkonzo. Zonke iinkonzo zolawulo nophononongo ziya kwenziwa ngenjongo yamawele ahulumenti, uphuhliso lwemiphakathi yemiphakathi nemisebenzi yokulungiswa yegunya lomhlaba ngokomthetho ozenza isiseko, iintsingiselo zemigca, izimo ezicwangqwe ngaphambili nomyalelo wekhosi yamali. Nikezela iinkonzo ngobuchwephesha kuzo zombini urhulumente nabantu abaqhuba iindawo zolwazi kazwelonke, iindawo zomhlaba kolunye nelungiselelo lo rhulumente olwenziwa ngumbutho wabucala. Lawula noqhayisa ukusingathwa kwemida yamazwe ngamazwe. Lawula ukusingathwa kwemida yamagunya yonkqo eSouth Africa, ngokuzithobileyo ngokuthobela umthetho wase South Africa nowamanye amazwe njengoko kuchazwa ngokomthetho. Lawula nophonononga nophando ezindleleni zokuyifumana isisombululo kumagunya angahambelaniyo ngokomthetho ohlala matasa a-South Africa ngokusebenzisana namagosa amele imida yawo. Lawula iinkonzo zengcebiso ngamagunya aphakamileyo aphathelene namagunya amazwe ahambelana neentlobo karhulumente ne-Parastatals. Lawula umgca ophathwa ngokwakha imida yamanye amazwe nokubeka ngokulandelelana. Lawula noqhayisa ukubhaliswa kwe-Sectional Title Practitioners. Qwalasela iinkqubo zoQeqesho lokwenza umsebenzi we-Sectional Titles ngokwe-Sectional Titles Act nosuku lokuqeqesha. Nikezela iinkonzo ngenjongo yokubhaliswa kwe-Sectional Titles Practitioners ngokuthobela iimfuno ze-Sectional Titles Act nomthetho ohambelana nayo. Gcina uvuselele irekhodi yokubhaliswa kwe-Sectional Title Practitioners. Lawula noqhayisa ukuqulunqa iinkqubo nezinga ezibhaliweyo. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kokuvuselelwa kweenkqubo nezinga ze-Surveyor's General, ngokuthobela umthetho nasekuqwaleliseni namaqabane. Phanda ngemiphumela yophuhliso lwesithuba setechnology kwiinkqubo nezinga ezibhaliweyo ze-tech kwaye uguqule ngokuhambelana noko. Lawula ukuqulunqa nokusebenzisa umthetho omtsha nokuphinda uqwalasele imimiselo ngokomthetho we-Land Survey Act nakweminye imithetho ehambelana nayo. Lawula ukusebenzisa umthetho omtsha. Nikezela inkxaso kwi-Survey Regulations Board (SRB) ngokusayitwa kwemimiselo eyakhiwe ngaphansi koMthetho. Sika ngesandluli uChief Surveyor-General ngokuphatha nokuqwalasela i-Survey Regulations Board (SRB) kwaye unikezele ngexabiso eliya kusetyenziswa. Nikezela inkxazo kuChief Surveyor-General ngokuphathwa komthetho we-Geomatics Profession Act. Phanda ungeze nengcebiso ngomthetho omtsha onomphumela kumaphupha we-Geomatics.

jobs.reference_number: 3/1/1/1/2026/206 Directorate: Geo-Spatial Information and Professional Support
jobs.title: Director: Geo-spatial Information and Professional
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Director position managing geo-spatial information products and services for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mowbray, Western Cape.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of Grade 12 Certificate and an undergraduate qualification (NQF Level 7) in Geomatics / Surveying / Geographical Information Science / Geo-informatics or related equivalent qualifications recognised by the South African Geomatics Council and a Nyukela (Pre-entry Certificate to the SMS) submitted prior to appointment. Registered as a Geomatics Professional with the South African Geomatics Council. Minimum of 5 years’ experience at a middle / senior managerial level in the geomatics environment. Appropriate post registration experience in surveying and / or geo-spatial information management. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Geospatial Information Management. Land Surveying knowledge. Knowledge of research methodology. Technical System knowledge. Spatial Data Infrastructure. Geographic Information Systems. Geospatial Information knowledge. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with Misconduct. Internal Control and Risk Management. Project management principles and tools. The political landscape of South Africa. Spatial Data Infrastructure Act 54 of 2003. Land Survey Act, Act 8 of 1997. Geomatics Profession Act, Act 19 of 2013. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, Act 16 of 2013. Protection of Personal Information Act, Act 4 of 2013. Promotion of Access to Information Act, Act 2 of 2000. Public Finance Management Act, Act 1 of 1999. Public Service Act Proclamation No. 103 of 1994 (as amended). Copyright Act, Act 98 of 1978. National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act, Act 43 of 1996. Electronic Communications and Transactions Act, Act 25 of 2002. National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act, Act 43 of 1996. Civil Aviation Act, Act 13 of 2009 (read together with the Civil Aviation Regulations, 2011, including Part 101 relating to Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems). United Nations Integrated Geospatial Information Framework (IGIF) of 2018. Job related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business. Communication (both verbal and written). Customer focus and responsiveness. Innovation and creativity. Planning and organising. Collaboration partnership. Negotiation. Conflict management. Data and information management. Facilitation. Analytical thinking. Contract management.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of geo-spatial information products and services. Supply geo-spatial products and services. Maintain information on products and ensure availability. Manage established outlets for products and services to make information more accessible, including Service Level Agreements with District Municipalities. Provide aerial photographic reproduction services. Provide reproduction services. Print maps. Produce aerial photo mosaics. Manage the provision or provide professional advisory services and undertake relevant research and development. Oversee Professional Land Surveyors in the performance of their duties. Provide professional advisory and support services. Undertake relevant research and development. Plan and supervise special projects. Support implementation of new systems and equipment. Provide survey support to land reform programmes of the Department. Provide training for SAGC registration in Professional and Technologist category (non- employees). Manage the provision of technical training. Assist with the geomatics officer certificate training. Provide experiential training for diploma students. Provide a specialised library and museum service. Develop and present technical training courses. Undertake development projects. Plan and execute projects in accordance with best practice for project management as required.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Kekana Tel No: (012) 312 8344
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 4th floor, No 2 Riebeeck Street, ABSA Building, Cape Town or by email to Post206@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured and White Males and African, Coloured and Indian Females and Persons with disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. af.title: Direkteur: Geo-spatial Information and Professional
af.summary: Direkteurspos wat geo-ruimtelike inligtingsprodukte en -dienste vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mowbray, Western Cape, bestuur.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF Level 7) in Geomatics / Surveying / Geographical Information Science / Geo-informatics of verwante ekwivalente kwalifikasies erken deur die South African Geomatics Council en 'n Nyukela (Voor-toelingsertifikaat tot die SMS) voor aanstelling ingedien. Geregistreer as 'n Geomatics Professionele by die South African Geomatics Council. Minimum van 5 jaar se ervaring op 'n middel- / senior bestuursvlak in die geomatica-omgewing. Toepaslike na-registrasie-ervaring in landmeting en / of geo-ruimtelike inligtingsbestuur. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Geospatial Information Management. Kennis van Land Surveying. Kennis van navorsingsmetodologie. Kennis van tegniese stelsels. Spatial Data Infrastructure. Geographic Information Systems. Kennis van geospatiale inligting. Performance Management and Monitoring. Regeringstelsels en -strukture. Regeringsbesluitnemingsprosesse. Programopstelproses. Begrip van die bestuursinligting- en formele verslagdoeningstelsel. Hantering van wangedrag. Internal Control and Risk Management. Beginsels en gereedskap van projekbestuur. Die politieke landskap van South Africa. Spatial Data Infrastructure Act 54 of 2003. Land Survey Act, Act 8 of 1997. Geomatics Profession Act, Act 19 of 2013. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, Act 16 of 2013. Protection of Personal Information Act, Act 4 of 2013. Promotion of Access to Information Act, Act 2 of 2000. Public Finance Management Act, Act 1 of 1999. Public Service Act Proclamation No. 103 of 1994 (as amended). Copyright Act, Act 98 of 1978. National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act, Act 43 of 1996. Electronic Communications and Transactions Act, Act 25 of 2002. National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act, Act 43 of 1996. Civil Aviation Act, Act 13 of 2009 (read together with the Civil Aviation Regulations, 2011, including Part 101 relating to Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems). United Nations Integrated Geospatial Information Framework (IGIF) of 2018. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projekbestuur. Spanbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudings. Begrotingsvoorspelling. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Hulpbronbeplanning. Probleemoplossing en besluitneming. Tydbestuur. Besigheid. Kommunikasie (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Kliëntfokus en responsiwiteit. Innovasie en kreatiwiteit. Beplanning en organisering. Samewerkingsvennootskap. Onderhandeling. Konflikbestuur. Data- en inligtingsbestuur. Fasilitering. Analitiese denke. Kontrakbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur die verskaffing van geo-ruimtelike inligtingsprodukte en -dienste. Verskaf geo-ruimtelike produkte en -dienste. Handhaaf inligting oor produkte en verseker beskikbaarheid. Bestuur gevestigde afsetpunte vir produkte en dienste om inligting meer toeganklik te maak, insluitend Diensvlakooreenkomste met Distriksmunisipaliteite. Verskaf lugfotoreproduksiedienste. Verskaf reproduksiedienste. Druk kaarte. Vervaardig lugfotomosaïeke. Bestuur die verskaffing of verskaf van professionele voorligtingsdienste en onderneem tersaaklike navorsing en ontwikkeling. Hou toesig oor Professionele Landmeter in die uitvoering van hul pligte. Verskaf professionele voorligtings- en ondersteuningsdienste. Onderneem tersaaklike navorsing en ontwikkeling. Beplan en hou toesig oor spesiale projekte. Ondersteun die implementering van nuwe stelsels en toerusting. Verskaf landmeetkundige ondersteuning aan grondhervormingsprogramme van die Department. Verskaf opleiding vir SAGC-registrasie in die Professionele en Tegnoloog-kategorie (nie-werknemers). Bestuur die verskaffing van tegniese opleiding. Bystand verleen met die opleiding vir die geomatica-amptenaarsertifikaat. Verskaf ervaringsopleiding vir diploma-studente. Verskaf 'n gespesialiseerde biblioteek- en museumdiens. Ontwikkel en bied tegniese opleidingskursusse aan. Onderneem ontwikkelingsprojekte. Beplan en voer projekte uit ooreenkomstig beste praktyk vir projekbestuur soos vereis.

zu.title: Umphathi: Ulwazi Lwe-Geo-spatial Nabalulekile
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi siphatha imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zelwazi le-geo-spatial kuMnyango WezokuLungiswa Komhlaba NokuThuthukiswa Kwemiphakathi eMowbray, Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 nefundo yesiqu esingaphansi (NQF Level 7) kuGeomatics / Surveying / Geographical Information Science / Geo-informatics noma iziqu ezihlobene ezifana neziluamukelekayo ngemuva kweSouth African Geomatics Council kanye neNyukela (Isitifiketi sokuqala sokungena kuSMS) esinikezwa ngaphambi kokuqashwa. Babhalwe njengabaGundane beGeomatics neSouth African Geomatics Council. Ukwazi okuncane iminyaka engu-5 yohlu lomsebenzi ezingeni lomphathi ohlangeneyo / ophezulu emkhakheni wegeomatics. Uphile iminyaka efanele yokusebenza emkhakheni wesurveying nangaphezulu / noma ekuphathweni kwelwazi le-geo-spatial. Ilayisense evumelekile yokushayela. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphatwa Kwelwazi LeGeospatial. Ulwazi Lokuqashwa Komhlaba. Ulwazi lwendlela yocwaningo. Ulwazi Lwesistimu Ebonakalayo. Umphakathi Wezolwazi Ebonakalayo. Amasistimu Wolwazi Lwendawo. Ulwazi lolwazi lweGeospatial. Ukuphathwa Kokuqeqeshwa Nokuqapha. Amasistimu nobakhe beNkantolo. Izinqamulelo zokuqumba kwenhlangano. Inqubo yokubumba imigomo. Ukuqonda isistimu yegceke ukuqonda ukubika ngemuva kokusebenza. Ukulungelelana ngokushiswa kobumsila bobuntu. Ukulawulwa Kwangaphakathi Nokuphathwa Koingozi. Izindlela nobuso bephrojekthi. Ukuphila Kwephulime lenhlangano yaseNingizimu Afrika. Iphulime Yesi-54 Se-2003 SeSpatial Data Infrastructure. Iphulime Yesi-8 Se-1997 SeLand Survey. Iphulime Yesi-19 Se-2013 SeGeomatics Profession. Iphulime Yesi-16 Se-2013 SeSpatial Planning and Land Use Management. Iphulime Yesi-4 Se-2013 SeProtection of Personal Information. Iphulime Yesi-2 Se-2000 SePromotion of Access to Information. Iphulime Yesi-1 Se-1999 SePublic Finance Management. Iphulime Yesi-103 Se-1994 SePublic Service Act (njengokulungisiwe). Iphulime Yesi-98 Se-1978 SeCopyright. Iphulime Yesi-43 Se-1996 SeNational Archives and Records Service of South Africa. Iphulime Yesi-25 Se-2002 SeElectronic Communications and Transactions. Iphulime Yesi-43 Se-1996 SeNational Archives and Records Service of South Africa. Iphulime Yesi-13 Se-2009 SeCivil Aviation (efundwe kanye neCivil Aviation Regulations, 2011, kubandakanya inxenye ye-101 ehlobene neRemotely Piloted Aircraft Systems). I-United Nations Integrated Geospatial Information Framework (IGIF) ka-2018. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa Kwephrojekthi. Ukuphathwa Kwethimba. Ukuhlobana Komuntu Nomuntu. Ukubukeka kwebhajethi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukucubungula imithombo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi. Ibhuloho lezindaba. Ukuthumela imilayezo (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukuqonda ukubaluleka kwezithakazelo kanye nokuqonda ukuphendula. Ukudalwa nezimangalo ezintsha. Ukuhlela nokuqamba izindlela. Ukusebenzisana. Ukuxhumana kanye nokungabakhona. Ukuphathwa kwempi yenhlalo. Ukuphathwa kwemininingwane nolwazi. Ukwenza kube lula. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kwe-ikhontrakthi.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kwemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zelwazi le-geo-spatial. Nikela ngemikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ze-geo-spatial. Gcina ulwazi ngemikhiqizo futhi qinisekisa ukuthi lutholakala. Phatha izikhungo ezisemthethweni ezimikhiqizweni nezinsizakalweni ukuze ulwazi lutholakale lula, kubandakanya izivumelwano Zenhlobonhlobo YeNkonzo namaMasipala Wezithili. Nikeza ngensizakalo yokudluliswa kwezithombe ezidutshulwe emoyeni. Nikeza ngensizakalo yokudluliswa. Shicilela izime. Dala izithombe ezinhlanganiswe ezidutshulwe emoyeni. Phatha ukunikezwa noma nikeza ngensizakalo yokuweluleka ngendlela yomsebenzi futhi wenze ucwaningo nokuqeqesha oluhlobene. Qaphela oGqwini BakaZwe Ngesikhathi Benza Imisebenzi Yabo. Nikeza ngensizakalo yokuweluleka ngendlela yomsebenzi kanye nensizakalo yokwesekwa. Yenza ucwaningo nokuqeqesha oluhlobene. Cwangcisa futhi ulawule imisebenzi ekhethekile. jobs.title: Director: Surveys Services

jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (all-inclusive package). The package includes a basic salary (70% of package), and a flexible portion that may be structured in accordance with the rules for Senior Management Services (SMS)
jobs.summary: Lead survey services for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Mowbray, managing geodetic, photogrammetric and topographic field surveys.

Registered as a Professional Land Surveyor with the South African Geomatics Council. Minimum of 5 years’ experience at a middle / senior managerial level in Land Surveying environment. Appropriate post registration experience in land surveying. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Geo-spatial Information Management. Geodesy and Geodetic surveying. Topographic surveying. Spatial Data Infrastructures. Cadastral Spatial Information knowledge. Geographical Information Systems. Knowledge of Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems and Geographical Information Management. Knowledge of advances in technology useful to the Cadastral, Geodetic, Photogrammetric, Topographic and Cartographic Survey Systems. Performance Management and Monitoring. Government systems and structures. Government decision making processes. Programme setting process. Understanding of the management information and formal reporting system. Dealing with Misconduct. Internal Control and Risk Management. Project management principles and tools. The political landscape of South Africa. Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, Act 54 of 2003. Land Survey Act, Act 8 of 1997. Geomatics Profession Act, Act 19 of 2013. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, Act 16 of 2013. Protection of Personal Information Act, Act 4 of 2013. Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000. Public Finance Management Act, Act 1 of 1999. Public Service Act Proclamation No. 103 of 1994 (as amended). Copyright Act, Act 98 of 1978. National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act, Act 43 of 1996. Electronic Communications and Transactions Act, Act 25 of 2002. National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act, Act 43 of 1996. Civil Aviation Act, Act 13 of 2009 (read together with the Civil Aviation Regulations, 2011, including Part 101 relating to Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems). United Nations Integrated Geospatial Information Framework (IGIF) of 2018. United Nations Global Geodetic Reference Frame Roadmap. Job related skills: Project management. Team management. Interpersonal relations. Budget forecasting. Computer literacy. Resource planning. Problem solving and decision-making. Time management. Business. Communication (verbal and written). Customer focus and responsiveness. Innovation and creativity. Planning and organising. Collaboration partnership. Negotiation. Conflict management. Data and information management. Facilitation. Analytical thinking. Contract management. The ability to work efficiently and effectively at all times.
jobs.duties: Manage the undertaking of field surveys. Manage the undertaking of field surveys for geodetic surveys in accordance with the annual production plan. Manage the undertaking of filed surveys for photogrammetric and topographic surveys in accordance with the annual production plan. Manage the undertaking of field surveys for land cover and land use mapping in accordance with the annual production plan. Manage the acquisition of ancillary geo-spatial data. Engage with various data custodians and other stakeholders on the need for fundamental geo-spatial information. Manage the collection and processing of ancillary geo-spatial information for mapping purposes in accordance with the annual production plan. Manage the establishment and maintenance of spatial reference framework (National Control Survey System) of South Africa. Provide strategic leadership in national spatial reference frameworks. Manage the establishment and maintenance of reference stations in accordance with the annual production plan. Manage the horizontal control survey network at all times. Manage the vertical control survey network at all times. Manage the network of continuously operating GNSS reference stations (TrigNet). Provide professional and technical support and client services to all spheres of government including Rural Development and Land Reform programmes and other organs of state. Provide advisory services, as required. Provide professional and technical support and client services to all spheres of government including rural development and land reform programmes and other organs of state, as required, in accordance with the best practices for project management and user needs. Participate in geodetic surveying and geo-spatial information development projects in Africa. Participate in development projects in Africa as approved. Plan and execute projects in accordance with best practices for project management, as required.

xh.title: Umphathi: Iinkonzo Zovavanyo
xh.summary: Macala iinkonzo zovavanyo ze Department of Land Reform and Rural Development kwi Mowbray, ulawula uluvo olwemilinganiselo yemihlaba, uluvo lweefoto nolulinganiselo lweendawo zasemhlabeni.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinci: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se Grade 12 nangendlela ephantsi kwesidanga (NQF 7), ngokukodwa kwi Geomatics / Surveying okanye izifanekiso ezinxulumene ezeqiniswayo ezivunyelwe yi South African Geomatics Council kwaye i Nyukela (Isatifikethi sokungena phambili kwi SMS) mafuneka singeniswe phambi kokubekwa esikhundleni. Mabe urejistiwe njengomProfessional Land Surveyor kwi South African Geomatics Council. Iimfuno zokuba nobugcisa obungaphezulu kwe 5 eminyaka kwinqanaba labaphathi abaphakathi / abaphezulu kwindawo yovavanyo lomhlaba. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo emva korejista kuvavanyo lomhlaba. Ilayiseni yomqeshi esebenzayo. Ulwazi oluxhumanene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo Lolwazi ngeendawo ezijikelezwe. IGeodesy kunye novavanyo lwe Geodetic. Ulavanyo lweendawo zasemhlabeni. Iinfrastructures yedata yamaphulo. Ulwazi ngeCadastral Spatial Information. Izinkqubo ze Geographical Information Systems. Ulwazi nge Land Information Systems, Land Administration Systems kunye noLawulo Lolwazi ngeGeographical. Ulwazi ngashukuma phambili kwitechnnoloji eluncedo kwi Cadastral, Geodetic, Photogrammetric, Topographic kunye nezinkqubo zovavanyo ze Cartographic. Uqwalaselo nokulandela inkqubo yemisebenzi. Izinkqubo neendawo zikarhulumente. Iinkqubo zokwenza iigqibo karhulumente. Inkqubo yokuseka iinkqubo. Ukuqonda inkqubo yolwazi lolawulo nendlela efanelekileyo yokuchaza. Ukupatha iimfazo. Ulawulo lwangaphakathi nolawulo loyingozi. Iinkqubo nezixhobo zolawulo lwamaphulo. Isimo sezopolitiki sase South Africa. Spatial Data Infrastructure Act, Act 54 of 2003. Land Survey Act, Act 8 of 1997. Geomatics Profession Act, Act 19 of 2013. Spatial Planning and Land Use Management Act, Act 16 of 2013. Protection of Personal Information Act, Act 4 of 2013. Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000. Public Finance Management Act, Act 1 of 1999. Public Service Act Proclamation No. 103 of 1994 (as amended). Copyright Act, Act 98 of 1978. National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act, Act 43 of 1996. Electronic Communications and Transactions Act, Act 25 of 2002. National Archives and Records Service of South Africa Act, Act 43 of 1996. Civil Aviation Act, Act 13 of 2009 (read together with the Civil Aviation Regulations, 2011, including Part 101 relating to Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems). United Nations Integrated Geospatial Information Framework (IGIF) of 2018. United Nations Global Geodetic Reference Frame Roadmap. Amandla axhumanene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lwamaphulo. Ulawulo lweqela. Unxibelelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ukubikezela ibhajethi. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ucwangciso lwamathuba. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokwenza iigqibo. Ulawulo lwexesha. Ibhizinisi. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangobhalo). Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokuphendula. Iingqwalasela nobudala bokwenza izinto. Ucwangciso nokuqamba. Unxibelelwano ngenxibelelwano. Iinkqubo zokusombulula iingxabano. Ulawulo lolwazi nedata. Ulawulo lwemivuzo. Ukucoca nokuqonda ngokuthe ngqo. Ukuphatha iinkqubo. Amandla okusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nangempumelelo ngalo lonke ixesha.
xh.duties: Lawula ukwenza kuvavanywe izinkalo zasemhlabeni. Lawula ukwenza kuvavanywe izinkalo zasemhlabeni zovavanyo lwe geodetic ngokubhekiselele kwinkqubo yemveliso yonyaka. Lawula ukwenza kuvavanywe izinkalo zovavanyo lweefoto nelinganiso leendawo ngokubhekiselele kwinkqubo yemveliso yonyaka. Lawula ukwenza kuvavanywe izinkalo zovavanyo zokubhala iindawo zendalo nendlulo yoluhla ngokubhekiselele kwinkqubo yemveliso yonyaka. Lawula ukufumana idatha ebonelela ngeendawo. Nxibelelanisa nobalawuli badata abahluvahlukeneyo nabanye abathintekayo ngemfuno yolwazi oluqulunqwe ngokufanelekileyo ngeendawo. Lawula ukuqokelelwa nokucutshungulwa kolwazi ngokwemilinganiselo yeendawo ngenjongo yokubhala iimephu ngokubhekiselele kwinkqubo yemveliso yonyaka. Lawula ukusekwa nokuqulunqwa kwenkqubo yokubhekisa kumaphulo (National Control Survey System) e South Africa. Nikezela ngengqesho ephawulekayo kwinkqubo yokubhekisa kumaphulo karhulumente. Lawula ukusekwa nokuqulunqwa kwezitalishi zokubhekisa ngokubhekiselele kwinkqubo yemveliso yonyaka. Lawula inethiwekhi yolawulo lovavanyo lweqondo ngalo lonke ixesha. Lawula inethiwekhi yolawulo lovavanyo lokuqonda ngobude ngalo lonke ixesha. Lawula inethiwekhi yamasteshini e GNSS abasebenza ngokuqhubekayo (TrigNet). Nikezela ngenkxaso yomphathi nobuchwepheshe kunye nkonzo kumaxesha onke karhulumente kuquka iinkqubo zokuthuthukiswa kwamaphulo karhulumente namaphulo okuvuselela kwaye ezinye iindawo zikarhulumente. Nikezela ngeenkonzo zokucelela izindaba, njengoko kufuneka. Nikezela ngenkxaso yomphathi nobuchwepheshe kunye nkonzo kumaxesha onke karhulumente kuquka iinkqubo zokuthuthukiswa kwamaphulo karhulumente namaphulo okuvuselela kwaye ezinye iindawo zikarhulumente, njengoko kufuneka, ngokubhekiselele kwiinkqubo ezilungileyo zolawulo lwamaphulo nemfuno yomsebenzisi. Thatha inxaxheba kuvavanyo lwe geodetic kunye namaphulo okuthuthukiswa kolwazi ngeendawo e Africa. Thatha inxaxheba kwamaphulo okuthuthukiswa e Africa njengoko kuvunyelwe. Cwangcisa uphumeze amaphulo ngokubhekiselele kwiinkqubo ezilungileyo zolawulo lwamaphulo, njengoko kufuneka.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Coordinate land claim lodgement, validation, and settlement processes with municipalities for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Polokwane.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and Bachelor’s Degree / National Diploma in Agriculture / Development Studies / Social Science / Law (NQF Level 6) or any related equivalent qualification. Minimum 3 years’ experience in land reform environment. A valid driver’s licence. Job related knowledge: Development management including strategic management. Research methods and techniques. Community facilitation. Knowledge of land redistribution and development related issues. Development management including strategic management. Understanding and interpret Business Plan. Job related skills: Project management. Negotiation. Contract management. Leadership. Communication (verbal and written). Ability to draft terms of reference for service providers. Ability to manage consultants. Excellent report writing. Initiative, able to take responsibility and meet deadlines. Computer literacy. Ability to produce report. Ability to facilitate community meetings. Good networking. Willingness to travel, to spend extended periods in the field and work irregular hours.
jobs.duties: Coordinate the lodgement of land claims. Categorise claims per local municipality. Engage municipalities on claims to be settled. Validate land claims. Conduct oral and archival research. Conduct site inspection process (Mapping). Identify homestead. Partaking in analysis of aerial photograph reports. Facilitate where there are overlapping land claims. Facilitate separation of tenants, beneficial of occupation and registered land rights. Verify lodged claim. Conduct in loco inspection. Produce in loco inspection report. Assist in closing of commitment register. Coordinate clearance of suspense account. Manage payment of beneficiaries. Negotiate the settlement of claims. Conduct option exercise with claimants. Identify claims for historical and current valuation by the Office of the Valuer General. Escalate historical valuation for offers. Settle the claims. Conduct verification process. Conduct analysis of family tree. Sign off completed name verification report. Draft Section 42d submission.
jobs.enquiries: Mr KE Senosha Tel No: (015) 495 1905
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 61 Biccard street, Polokwane, 0700 or by email to Post204@dlrrd.gov.za

af.title: Projekkoördineerder
af.summary: Koördineer die indiening, validering en skikking van grondeise by munisipaliteite vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Polokwane.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Baccalaureusgraad / Nasionale Diploma in Landbou / Ontwikkelingstudies / Sosiale Wetenskappe / Regte (NQF Vlak 6) of enige verwante equivalente kwalifikasie hê. Minimum 3 jaar ervaring in 'n gronderhervormingsomgewing. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Werksverwante kennis: Ontwikkelingsbestuur insluitend strategiese bestuur. Navorsingsmetodes en -tegnieke. Gemeenskapsfasilitering. Kennis van gronderherverspreiding en ontwikkelingsverwante aangeleenthede. Ontwikkelingsbestuur insluitend strategiese bestuur. Begrip en interpretasie van 'n besigheidsplan. Werksverwante vaardighede: Projektbestuur. Onderhandeling. Kontrakbestuur. Leierskap. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Vermoë om terme van verwysing vir diensverskaffers op te stel. Vermoë om konsultante te bestuur. Uitstekende verslagskryfwerk. Inisiatief, in staat om verantwoordelikheid te neem en sperdatums te haal. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om verslag te lewer. Vermoë om gemeenskapsvergaderings te fasiliteer. Goeie netwerkwerk. Bereidwilligheid om te reis, om lang periodes in die veld deur te bring en onreëlmatige ure te werk.
af.duties: Koördineer die indiening van grondeise. Kategoriseer eise per plaaslike munisipaliteit. Betrek munisipaliteite oor eise wat geskik moet word. Valideer grondeise. Voer mondelinge en argivale navorsing uit. Voer terreininspeksieproses uit (Kartering). Identifiseer woning. Neem deel aan ontleding van lugfotoverslae. Fasiliteer waar daar oorvleuelende grondeise is. Fasiliteer skeiding van huurders, bevoordeeldes van besetting en geregistreerde grondregte. Verifieer ingediende eise. Voer in loco-inspeksie uit. Lewer in loco-inspeksieverslag. help met die sluiting van verpligtingsregister. Koördineer skikking van hangrekening. Bestuur betaling van begunstigdes. Onderhandel die skikking van eise. Voer opsie-oefening met eisders uit. Identifiseer eise vir historiese en huidige waardasie deur die Office of the Valuer General. Eskaleer historiese waardasie vir aanbiedings. Skik die eise. Voer verifikasieproses uit. Voer ontleding van stamboom uit. Teken voltooide naamverifikasieverslag af. Stel Section 42d-voorlegging op.

zu.title: Umuhandli Wezinhlelo
zu.summary: Ukuhlanganisa inqubo yokufaka izimango zendawo, ukuqinisekisa, kanye nokuqedela kwezinqubo namasipalathi kuMnyango Wezokulungiswa Kwendawo Nentuthuko Yasemakhaya ePolokwane.
zu.requirements: Izidingo okuncane: Abafakisi kufanele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree / i-National Diploma kwezolimo / Izifundo Zentuthuko / Isayensi Yezomphakathi / Umthetho (i-NQF Level 6) noma noma yisiphi isimiso esifanayo esihlobene nalokhu. Ukuhlala okungu-3 iminyaka ngaphambili emkhakheni wezokulungiswa kwendawo. Ilayisense yokushayela okusebenzayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwentuthuko okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa okushibhile. Izindlela namasu okucwaninga. Ukusiza umphakathi. Ulwazi ngenqubo yokwabelwa kabusha kwendawo kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nentuthuko. Ukuphathwa kwentuthuko okuhlanganisa nokuphathwa okushibhile. Ukuqonda nokutolikha i-Business Plan. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo. Ukuxoxisana. Ukuphathwa kwezinkontileka. Ukubusa. Ukuthumela imiyalezo (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ikhono lokubhala izigaba zomsebenzi zabanikeli benkonzo. Ikhono lokuphatha abaqophi. Ukwazi okuhle ukubhala imibiko. Ukuzethemba, ukwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba nokuhlangabezana namasikhathi. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokukhiqiza imibiko. Ikhono lokuhlanganisa izinkomfa zomphakathi. Ukuxhumana kahle. Ukuzithoba ekwendwendwela, ukuhlala isikhathi eside ensimini nokusebenza amahora angajwayelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuhlanganisa ukufakwa kwemango zendawo. Ukuhlukanisa imango ngasasipalathi endawo. Ukuhlangana namasipalathi mayelana namango okuqedela. Ukuqinisekisa imango zendawo. Ukuqhuba ucwaningo olubhaliwe nolwegugu. Ukuqhuba inqubo yokuhlolwa kwendawo (Ukumapa). Ukuhlonza ikhaya. Ukuthatha inxaxheba ekuhlaziyeni imibiko yezithombe ezivela esibhakabhakeni. Ukusiza lapho kunemango zendawo ephindaphindayo. Ukusiza ekuhlukaniseni abahlayisi, abazuza ngesikhundla kanye namalungelo abhalisiwe endaweni. Ukuqinisekisa imango efakiwe. Ukuqhuba ukuhlolwa kwindawo. Ukukhiqiza imibiko yokuhlolwa kwindawo. Ukusiza ekuvalweni kwesibuko sezibopho. Ukuhlanganisa ukususwa kwe-akhawunti yokulindile. Ukuphatha inkokhelo yabazuza. Ukuxoxa ngekuqedelwa kwemango. Ukuqhuba ukuzivocavoca kokukhetha nabafaki bomango. Ukuhlonza imango yokubungwa kobungako bemali ngokomlando okwamanje yi-Office of the Valuer General. Ukuphakamisa ukubungwa kobungako bemali ngokomlando amanikelo. Ukuqedela imango. Ukuqhuba inqubo yokuqinisekisa. Ukuhlaziya isihlahla sezndaba. Ukuqinisekisa imibiko egqamile yokubungwa kwegama. Ukubhala inikelo le-Section 42d.

xh.title: Mqondanisi weProjektheyi
xh.summary: Qondanisa inkqubo yokungenisa, ukuqinisekisa, nokusetyenziswa kweeminyezelo zamablaba namasipala kwiSebe leZolimo iNtshukumo ePolokwane.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezincinane: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethde seQela le-12 kunye neDegree yeBachelor / iDiploma yeSizwe kwiZolimo / uPhononongo lweNtshukumo / iSayensi yeZentlalo / uMthetho (iNqanaba le-6 le-NQF) okanye nayiphi na ifanelekileyo eqamileyo. Ubuncinane iiminyaka esi-3 yamava kwimeko yokulungisa indawo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lwentshukumo kuquka ulawulo lwamaqondo. Iindlela namacebo ephononongo. Ukukhokela uluntu. Ulwazi ngenkqubo yokwahlahlula nokuhlengwa kwamahlaba ngenkqubo ezihlobene nentshukumo. Ulawulo lwentshukumo kuquka ulawulo lwamaqondo. Ukuqonda nokutolika iQhosha leShishini. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ulawulo lweprojektheyi. Ukuxoxisana. Ulawulo lweqhosha. Ukuba ngumkhokeli. Unxibelelwano (olusemilomzinyo nolubhalwayo). Ikhaliphu lokubhala iindlela zomsebenzi kubaphathi beadva. Ikhaliphu lokulawula abacebayo. Ukubhala kwemibiko emnandi. Isazela, nakhaliphu ukuthabatha ixanduva nokuhlangabezana namaxesha wokuvala. Ulwazi ngekhompyutha. Ikhaliphu lokwenza umbiko. Ikhaliphu lokukhokela iintlangano zoluntu. Unxibelelwano oluhle lwakho konke konke. Ukulungele ukuhamba, ukuhlala ixesha elide endleeni nokusebenza amaxesha angaqhelekanga.
xh.duties: Qondanisa ukungenisa iindawo eziyiminyezelo. Hlulahlula iiminyezelo ngomasipala wendawo. Nxibelelanise namasipala ngeeminyezelo eziza kusetyenziswa. Qinisekisa iindawo eziyiminyezelo. Yenza uphononongo olusemilomzinyo nolwezixhobo zembali. Yenza inkqubo yokukhangela indawo (Ukuzoba umzobo). Bonakalisa amakhaya asekhaya. Thatha inxaxheba kwahlulohlulwo lwemibiko yezifoto ezithathwa esibhakabhakeni. Khokela apho kukho iindawo eziyiminyezelo ezihlangabezayo. Khokela ukuhlukaniswa kwabahlali, abazuza ngokuhlala kunye namalungelo okubhalisa kwendawo. Qinisekisa iminyezelo engenisiweyo. Yenza ukukhangela kwindawooyo. Yenza umbiko wokukhangela kwindawooyo. Nceda kuvalwa kweregista yamathembu. Qondanisa ukucoca i-akhawunti yokurhuqwayo. Lawula ukuhlinzwa kwabazuza. Nengoxina ukusetyenziswa kweeminyezelo. Yenza inkqubo yokukhetha kunye nabenzi beminyezelo. Phawula iiminyezelo zokuqwalaselwa ngokomlando nangokwamanje liSebe leNjengele iNtengiso. Phakamisa intengiso yomlando ngeentengiso. Setyenzise iiminyezelo. Yenza inkqubo yoqinisekiso. Yenza uhlalutyo lwesithiya senzala. Sayina umbiko oqediweyo woqinisekiso lwamagama. Bhala isalathiso soCandelo 42d.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Public Private Partnerships
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed in Pretoria to monitor capital works maintenance projects and coordinate with Public Works on project progress.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate and a National Diploma in Public Management / Supply Chain Management / Business Management / Office Management and Technology / Project Management / Property Management and / or in Built environment (NQF Level 6) or related qualification. A valid driver's licence. Minimum of 3 years’ experience at supervisory level in Public-Private Partnerships environment. Job related knowledge: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Treasury regulations. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Asset Management Framework. Job related skills: Computer literacy. Communication (verbal and written). Planning and organising. Analytical thinking. Problem solving. Negotiations. Project management. Interpersonal relations.
jobs.duties: Monitor the execution of capital works planned maintenance project within DLRRD. Ensure intervention follow up of projects with Department of Public Works and Infrastructure (DPWI) for progress made. Ensure the Project Management System / Project Execution Plan / Procurement Instructions from Key Accounts Manager (Head Office) are requested monthly to prepare reports to the Director: Facilities Management Services. Attend walk abouts / briefing meetings / inspections and practical completion / handover meetings with Department of Public Works and Infrastructure and follow up on snags with the Project Manager. Attend the client forum meetings / allocation meetings / twice a year / technical meeting where the need arises and attending the handover meetings. Management and administer capital works planned maintenance projects within DLRRD. Identify and control capital works planned maintenance projects. Prioritise capital works / planned maintenance projects. Compile and verify needs assessment and submit verified needs assessment to Director: Facilities Management Services for certification. Compile inputs regarding User Asset Management Plan in terms of capital works and planned maintenance. Reporting on capital infrastructure projects currently in progress and finalised project. Render management of financial reporting and financial management services. Manage and compile the monthly financial statements, interim financial statements, and annual statements of capital works for submission to the Deputy Director: Facilities Management. Analyse the financial report and respond to enquiries by the Deputy Director: Accounting Management and Internal and external Auditors. Respond to all enquiries relating to capital works projects relating to financial statements. Manage capital works pace payment to Department Public Works and Infrastructure. Process payments of projects to Department Public Works and Infrastructure via sundry payment request to the Directorate: Financial Accounting. Liaise with the Budget Controller of the Directorate for confirmation of funds. Liaise with DPWI after payment has been done and ensuring that proof of payment is submitted to Department Public Works and Infrastructure. Provide technical assistance, support and advice for Public Private Partnership (PPP) Infrastructure projects. Support the execution of detailed financial analysis of PPP’s projects. Provide assistance with project inceptions register. Provide input in the assessment of value-for-money criterion. Participate in budget related meetings. Prepare budget inputs and expenditure reports for the unit. Provide support in the implementation of PPP infrastructure project. Assist in monitoring the project contract management schedules. Ensure cooperative governance of PPP concessions. Facilitate communication between the Department and PPP. Assist in implementation of partnership agreement. Assist in implementation of the PPP agreement from inception to termination. Assist in managing the work of the Private Party. Certification of invoices and supporting documents prior to payment. Keep changing request register. Ensure compliance with output specification and PPP agreement. Filling of the PPP documents.
