af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Openbare-Privaatvennootskappe
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur benodig in Pretoria om kapitale instandhoudingsprojekte te monitor en met Public Works oor projekvoortgang te koördineer.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n Nasionale Diploma in Public Management / Supply Chain Management / Business Management / Office Management and Technology / Project Management / Property Management en / of in die geboude omgewing (NQF Level 6) of 'n verwante kwalifikasie. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring op toesigvlak in 'n Openbare-Privaatvennootskap-omgewing. Werksverwante kennis: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Tesourie-regulasies. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Batebestuursraamwerk. Werksverwante vaardighede: Rekenaargeletterdheid. Kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Beplanning en organisering. Analitiese denke. Probleemoplossing. Onderhandelings. Projekbestuur. Interpersoonlike verhoudings.
af.duties: Monitor die uitvoering van kapitale beplande instandhoudingsprojekte binne DLRRD. Verseker opvolg van ingryping by projekte met Department of Public Works and Infrastructure (DPWI) vir vordering gemaak. Verseker dat die Project Management System / Project Execution Plan / Procurement Instructions van die Key Accounts Manager (Head Office) maandeliks aangevra word om verslae aan die Director: Facilities Management Services voor te berei. Neem deel aan wandelrondtes / voorligtingsvergaderings / inspeksies en praktiese voltooiing / oorhandigingsvergaderings met Department of Public Works and Infrastructure en volg snaglyste met die Project Manager op. Neem deel aan kliëntforumvergaderings / toekenningvergaderings / tweemaal per jaar / tegniese vergaderings waar die behoefte ontstaan en neem deel aan oorhandigingsvergaderings. Bestuur en administreer kapitale beplande instandhoudingsprojekte binne DLRRD. Identifiseer en beheer kapitale beplande instandhoudingsprojekte. Prioritiseer kapitale / beplande instandhoudingsprojekte. Stel behoeftebepalings op en verifieer dit en dien geverifieerde behoeftebepalings by Director: Facilities Management Services vir sertifisering in. Stel insette op ten opsigte van die User Asset Management Plan in terme van kapitale werke en beplande instandhouding. Rapporteer oor kapitale infrastruktuurprojekte wat tans aan die gang is en gefinaliseerde projekte. Lewer bestuur van finansiële verslagdoening en finansiële bestuursdienste. Bestuur en stel die maandelikse finansiële state, tussentydse finansiële state en jaarstate van kapitale werke op vir voorlegging aan die Deputy Director: Facilities Management. Ontleed die finansiële verslag en reageer op navrae deur die Deputy Director: Accounting Management en interne en externe ouditeure. Reageer op alle navrae met betrekking tot kapitale werkeprojekte wat verband hou met finansiële state. Bestuur die pas van betalings vir kapitale werke aan Department Public Works and Infrastructure. Verwerk betalings van projekte aan Department Public Works and Infrastructure via verskeie betalingsversoeke aan die Directorate: Financial Accounting. Skakel met die Begrotingsbeheerder van die Direktoraat vir bevestiging van fondse. Skakel met DPWI nadat betaling gedoen is en verseker dat bewys van betaling aan Department Public Works and Infrastructure voorgelê word. Verskaf tegniese bystand, ondersteuning en advies vir Public Private Partnership (PPP) infrastruktuurprojekte. Ondersteun die uitvoering van gedetailleerde finansiële ontleding van PPP-projekte. Verskaf hulp met 'n projekaanvangsregister. Verskaf insette by die assessering van waarde-vir-geld-kriteria. Neem deel aan begrotingverwante vergaderings. Berei begrotingsinsette en bestedingsverslae vir die eenheid voor. Verskaf ondersteuning by die implementering van PPP-infrastruktuurprojekte. Help met die monitering van die projekkontrakbestuurskedules. Verseker samewerkende bestuur van PPP-konsessies. Fasiliteer kommunikasie tussen die Departement en PPP. Help met die implementering van vennootskapooreenkomste. Help met die implementering van die PPP-ooreenkoms vanaf aanvang tot beëindiging. Help met die bestuur van die werk van die Private Party. Sertifisering van fakture en ondersteunende dokumente voor betaling. Hou 'n register van veranderingversoeke by. Verseker nakoming van uitsetspesifikasie en PPP-ooreenkoms. Invul van die PPP-dokumente.

zu.title: Umncedisi Weqhaza: Ababhangiwe Bucala
zu.summary: Kudingeka umncedisi weqhaza ePretoria ukuze alawule imisebenzi yokulungiswa okuhleliwe kwezimali kanti futhi ahambisanane nezeZimo Kawonkewonke mayelana nokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi kwalezi: Abafakwayo kumele babe nesitifiketi seGrade 12 kanye neDiploma Yezwe kwiZimbabwe / Yokuqasha amahlelokusebenza / Yokuqasha izindlu / KobuNgqoshi bokusebenza / NobuChwepheshe bokusebenza / Yokuphatha imisebenzi / Yokuphatha izimpahla kanye / noma endaweni yakhiwe (NQF Level 6) noma iziqu ezihlobene naleyoc. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazisa okungenani kweminyaka engu-3 ngokuba ngumphathi emkhakheni wababhangiwe Bucala Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: uMthetho WokuPhatha Imali Yomphakathe (PFMA). Izilawulo zeNdlu yamagugu. uMthetho Wokusungula Inqubomgomo Yokuthenga Ngokuthandwa (PPPFA). Isakhiwo Sokuphatha izimpahla. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhaliwe). Ukucubungula futhi uhlele. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukuxazulula izinkinga. Izinkulumo zokubulisisana. Ukuphatha imisebenzi. Ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu.
zu.duties: Qapha ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi yokulungiswa okuhleliwe kwezimali ngaphakathi kweDLRRD. Qiniseka ukulandelwa kokungenelela kwemisebenzi kanye nezeZimo Kawonkewonke nezinsiza (DPWI) ngenxa yokuqhubeka okwenziwe. Qiniseka ukuthi Isimiso Sokuphatha Imisebenzi / Icebo Lokuphatha Ukuphunywa kwemisebenzi / Iyimiyalezo Yokuthenga evela Kumphathi Wezinsiza ezibalulekile (Hhovisi Elikhulu) iyacelwa nyanga zonke ukuze kwenziwe okubikwa kuMqondisi: Imisebenzi Yokuphatha Izindlu. Zonke izinsuku zokuhamba / imihlangano yokwazisa / ukucwaninga kanye neyokugqamuka / imihlangano yokunikezwa ngemisebenzi kanye nezeZimo Kawonkewonke nezinsiza bese kulandelwa izinkinga ngomphathi womsebenzi. Khonza kumihlangano yohlelo lwamakhasimende / imihlangano yokwabelwa / kathathu ngonyaka / umhlangano ochwepheshe lapho kudingeka khona futhi ukukhonza emihlanganweni yokunikezwa ngemisebenzi. Ukuphatha nokulawula imisebenzi yokulungiswa okuhleliwe kwezimali ngaphakathi kweDLRRD. Hlakanipha futhi ulawule imisebenzi yokulungiswa okuhleliwe kwezimali. Dlulise phambili imisebenzi yokulungiswa okuhleliwe kwezimali. Hlela futhi uqinisekise ukucwaningwa kwezidingo bese unikeza izidingo eziqinisekisiwe kuMqondisi: Imisebenzi Yokuphatha Izindlu ukuze atshonise. Hlela okungenayo ngokuphathwa kweMthetho Wokuphatha Izimpahla Zomsebenzisi mayelana nokulungiswa okuhleliwe kwezimali. Ukubika ngokuqhubeka kwemisebenzi yolwakhiwo lwamahashe ekuqhubekayo nangemisebenzi eqedwe. Nikeza ukuphathwa kokubikwa kwemali kanye nosebenzo lokuphatha imali. Phatha futhi uhlakule izitatimende zemali ezenyanga zonke, izitatimende ezitholakala phakathi kwenyanga, kanye nezitatimende zonyaka zemisebenzi yokulungiswa okuhleliwe ukuzinikeza kuMqondisi Ongenele: Ukuphatha Izindlu. Hlaziya umbiko wezimali futhi uphendule imibuzo ngumqondisi ongenela: Ukuphatha Izibhalo kanye Nocwaningi bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Phendula yonke imibuzo ehlobene nemisebenzi yokulungiswa okuhleliwe mayelana nezitatimende zemali. Phatha inhlawulo yokulungiswa okuhleliwe eyahlonywa kuHhovisi LwezeZimo Kawonkewonke Nezinsiza. Hlela imali yemisebenzi eya kuHhovisi LwezeZimo Kawonkewonke Nezinsiza ngesicelo esahlukahlukene sokukhokha esiya Kuhhovisi: UkuHlola Imali. Thinta umphathi weSabelo seHhovisi ukuze aqinisekise ngemali. Thinta iDPWI emva kokuhlinzekwa ngemali futhi uqinisekise ukuthi isibonakaliso sokukhokha sinikezwa kuHhovisi LwezeZimo Kawonkewonke Nezinsiza. Nikeza usizo ngamandla, ukwesekwa kanye neluleko lezinhlelo zolwakhiwo zababhangiwe Bucala (PPP). Sekela ukuphathwa kochwepheshe bokuhlaziya imali yamaphrojekthi ePPP. Nikeza ngesibonelo ngesabelo samaphrojekthi. Nikeza ngemibono ekuqoqweni kwemigomo ethatha ixabiso. Ukubamba iqhaza emihlanganweni ehlobene nesabelo. Hlela imibono yesabelo kanye nemibiko yokuchitha imali yegumbi. Nikeza ngesekelo ekuphothulweni kwezinhlelo zolwakhiwo zePPP. Siza ekulawuleni okuhleliwe kokuphatha isivumelwano. Qiniseka ngokuphatha kahle ubulungu bePPP. Khuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi Komnyango nePPP. Siza ekuphothulweni kohlangothi oluwiswe isivumelwano. Siza ekuphothulweni kwesivumelwano sePPP kusukela ekuqaleni kuye ekupheleni. Siza ekuphathweni komsebenzi weqembu Labucala. Ukuqinisekisa amafomu kanye namaphepha okusekaya ngaphambi kokukhokha. Gcina isabelo sokushintsha. Qinisezisa ukulandelwa imiyalelo ephuma kumkhiqizo nesivumelwano sePPP. Ukuze izixhobo zePPP zigcineke.

xh.title: Umncedisi weKomkhulu: UManyano phakathi koRhulumente noBuntu
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umncedisi womkhulu e Pretoria ukuba ajonge izicwangciso zokwakha nokulondoloza izinto ezixabisekileyo nokucothisana nabasebenzi be Public Works ngaphakathi kwendlela ezihamba ngayo iiprojekthi.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisezantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi se Grade 12 kwaye babe ne National Diploma kwi Public Management / Supply Chain Management / Business Management / Office Management and Technology / Project Management / Property Management naphakathi kwendawo e sakhiweyo (NQF Level 6) okanye nesiqualification esinxulumene neso. Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-3 yamava kwinqanaba lomphathi wojongi kwindawo yokubakho ko Manyano phakathi koRhulumente no Bantu. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: I Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Iimigaqo ye Treasury. I Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act (PPPFA). Isiseko se Asset Management. Amaxabiso anxulumene nomsebenzi: Ukuziba nakhompyutha. Unxibelelwano (ngomlomo nangokubhaliweyo). Uqeqesho lolwe lo. Ukucinga ngokuhlalutya. Ukusombulula iingxaki. Iinkqubela phakathi kwabathengisi. Ulawulo lwe Projekthi. Unxibelelwano phakathi koluntu.
xh.duties: Qaphela ukwenziwa kwe projekthi yesicwangciso sokwakha nokulondoloza izinto ezixabisekileyo ngaphakathi kwi DLRRD. Qinisekisa ukulandela unyango lwe projekthi nama Departments we Public Works and Infrastructure (DPWI) nge ndlela ephumeleleyo e yenziweyo. Qinisekisa ukuba i Project Management System / Project Execution Plan / Procurement Instructions ezivela kwi Key Accounts Manager (Head Office) zicelwa nyanga zonke ukulungiselela iingxelo kwi Director: Facilities Management Services. Zithathe iintshukumookuhamba ngesicelo / iinkqubo zokwazisa / ukuhlola nokugqiba ngokwenyani / iinkqubo zokuqhuba nokunika nge Departments Public Works and Infrastructure ulandele iingxaki nge Project Manager. Zithathe iinkqubo zokuthetha no mntu ongumxhasi / iinkqubo zokwaba / kabini ngonyaka / iinkqubo zezobuchwephesha apho kufuneka khona nasekuweni iinkqubo zokuqhuba nokunika. Ulawulo lolawula izicwangciso zokwakha nokulondoloza izinto ezixabisekileyo ngaphakathi kwi DLRRD. Qaphela ulawule izicwangciso zokwakha nokulondoloza izinto ezixabisekileyo. Phawula ngaphezulu izicwangciso zokwakha / ezo kulondolozo e zicwangcisweyo. Hlanganisela qinisekisa isicwangciso esiboniswa ngemfuneko kwaye uzithumele eqinisekisiweyo ku Director: Facilities Management Services ukuze asiqinisekise. Hlanganisela izigqibo malunga nesicwangciso se User Asset Management Management ngokwemigaqo yezicwangciso zokwaksha nokulondoloza. Iingxelo nge projekthi zezixhobo ezixa phakathi kwendlela eziza ngaphambili ne project ephumelelweyo. Nikeza ulawulo lweengxelo zezimali nolawulo ngezimali. Lawula uze uhlanganise iinkqubo zezimali zenyanga zonke, iinkqubo zexesha eliphakathi, neenkqubo zonyaka zezinto ezixabisekileyo ezisakhiwayo ukuze zithunyelwe kwi Deputy Director: Facilities Management. Hlalutya ingxelo yamahlulo kwaye uphendule imibuzo i Deputy Director: Accounting Management naba scholar ba bendawo / besangaphakathi nangaphandle. Phendula onke amabuzo anxulumene ne projekthi zokwakha izinto ezixabisekileyo ezinamandla kumabanga amaninzi. Lawula ngenkqubo yokuhlawulela izinto ezixabisekileyo kwisebe Public Works and Infrastructure. Bhala iinkqubo zokuhlawulela kwisebe Public Works and Infrastructure nge sebe ngesicelo sokuhlawulela i Financial Accounting. Thethathu nabaphathi be Budget be Directorate ukurhweba ngokuqinisekiswa kweemali. Thetha ne DPWI emva kokuba kuhlawuliwe kwaye uqinisekise ukuba isiqinisekiso sokuhlawulela sithunyelwe kwi Department Public Works and Infrastructure. Nikeza uluncedo lwe nyuselelo, ngenkxaso nangengcebiso malunga ne Public Private Partnership (PPP) Infrastructure projects. Xhasa ukwenziwa koku chaza amandla iingxelo malunga ne PPP projects. Nikeza ngenkxaso kwirejista e suswa kwi project. Inika izigqibo kwi sivakalisi sokuxabisa isixa semali. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezinxulumene ne budget. Lungiselela izigqibo ze budget neengxelo zentswalo i unit. Nikeza ngenkxaso ekusebenziseni i PPP infrastructure project. Yenza uncedo ekulawulekeni iinkqubo zolawulo lwe contract ye project. Qinisekisa ulawulo oluhlangeneyo lwe concession ze PPP. Yenza unxibelelwano phakathi kwe Departments ne PPP. Yenza uncedo ekusebenziseni isivumelwano so Manyano. Yenza uncedo ekusebenziseni isivumelwano se PPP ukususela ekuqaleni kuye kugqibele. Yenza uncedo ekulawuleni umsebenzi we Private Party. Isiqinisekiso se invoices namaxwebhu axhasayo phambi kokuhlawula. Hlala utshintshe i cache esicelo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela kwemigaqo ye output nesivumelwano se PPP. Kugcwaliswe amaxwebhu e PPP.

jobs.title: Secretary
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Provide secretarial and reception support to a Director at the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in possession of a Grade 12 Certificate. Job related knowledge: Computer literacy (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) Job related skills: Good telephone etiquette. Sound organisational ability. Good people skills. Computer literacy. Ability to communicate well with people at different levels and from different backgrounds (both written and verbal). Ability to act with tact and discretion.
jobs.duties: Provide a secretariat / receptionist support service to the Director. Receive telephone calls and refer the calls to the correct role players if not meant for the relevant senior manager. Record appointments and events in the diary. Type documents for the senior manager and other staff within the unit. Operate office equipment e.g. computers and photocopiers. Provide a clerical support service to the Senior Manager. Liaise with travel agencies to make travel arrangements. Check arrangements when relevant documents are received. Arrange meetings and events for the senior manager and the staff in the unit. Identifies venues, invite role players, organise refreshments and sets up schedules for meeting and events. Process the travel and subsistence claims for the unit. Process all invoices that emanate from the activities of the work of the senior manager. Records basic minutes of meetings of the senior manager where required. Draft routine correspondence and reports. Do filing of documents for the senior manager and the unit where necessary. Administer matters like leave registers and telephonic accounts. Handle the procurement of standard items like stationary, refreshments etc. Collects all relevant documents to enable the Director to prepare for meetings. Remains up to date with regard to prescripts / policies and procedures applicable to her / his work environment to ensure efficient and effective support to the senior manager. af.title: Sekretaresse
af.summary: Verskaf sekretariaats- en ontvangsondersteuning aan 'n Direkteur by die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development in Pretoria.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, ens.) Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie telefoonetiket. Bevoegde organisatoriese vermoë. Goeie mensevaardighede. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Vermoë om goed met mense op verskillende vlakke en uit verskillende agtergronde te kommunikeer (sowel geskrewe as mondeling). Vermoë om met takt en diskresie op te tree.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n sekretariaats- / ontvangsondersteuningsdiens aan die Direkteur. Neem telefoonoproepe in verwys die oproepe na die korrete rolspelers indien nie vir die betrokke senior bestuurder bedoel nie. Skryf afsprake en gebeurtenisse in die dagboek. Tik dokumente vir die senior bestuurder en ander personeel binne die eenheid. Bedryf kantoortoerusting bv. rekenaars en fotokopieerders. Verskaf 'n administratiewe ondersteuningsdiens aan die Senior Bestuurder. Skakel met reisagentskappe om reiereëlings te tref. Kontroleer reëlings wanneer relevante dokumente ontvang word. Reël vergaderings en gebeurtenisse vir die senior bestuurder en die personeel in die eenheid. Identifiseer plekke, nooi rolspelers, organiseer verversings en stel skedules vir vergaderings en gebeurtenisse op. Verwerk die reis- en verblyflewings vir die eenheid. Verwerk alle fakture wat voortspruit uit die aktiwiteite van die werk van die senior bestuurder. Neem basiese notule van vergaderings van die senior bestuurder waar nodig. Opstel van roetinekorrespondensie en verslae. Doen liasseer van dokumente vir die senior bestuurder en die eenheid waar nodig. Administreer sake soos verlofregisters en telefoonrekenings. Ontvang, teken aan en versprei alle inkomende en uitgaande dokumente. Behartig die verkryging van standaarditems soos skryfbehoeftes, verversings ens. Versamel alle relevante dokumente om die Direkteur in staat te stel om vir vergaderings voor te berei. Bly op hoogte van voorskrifte / beleide en prosedures wat op haar / sy werkomgewing van toepassing is om doeltreffende en effektiewe ondersteuning aan die senior bestuurder te verseker. Bestudeer die betrokke openbare diens- en departementele voorskrifte / beleide en ander dokumente om te verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word. Hou tred met die prosedures en prosesse wat in die kantoor van die senior bestuurder van toepassing is.

zu.title: Unobhala
zu.summary: Zinikela ngokusekela ngokomsebenzi wephutha kanye nokwamukela abantu kwiDirektha e Department of Land Reform and Rural Development e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Abaqwayiso abafanele: Kumele abafundi babe nesiQiniseko seGraji 12. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) Izindlela zokusebenza: Ukuhlonipha kolunyuso. Ukuthungatha kabi. Ukubeka kanjani izinto ezibalulekile. Isibonelo: ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuthungatha amafayela, ukulawula ixesha.
zu.duties: Nikeza insiza yabasekeli / abamamukela abantu kuDirektha. Yamukela amakholi efoni futhi aphatha amakholi abantu abafanele uma engabekelwe umphathi ophakeme ohlobene. Bhalise ithuba nemikhosi ohlwini lwamaphupha. Thayipha amafomu abalulekile ku Director. Sebenzisa izinto zokusebenza efihini njengekhompyutha namaphothokophi. Bhalise ithuba nemikhosi ohlwini lwamaphupha. Thayipha amafomu abalulekile komphathi ophakeme nakubanye abasebenza bahlabathi. Sebenzisa izinto zokusebenza ofisini njengekhompyutha namaphothokophi. Nikeza insiza yomsebenzi wolunyuso ku Senior Manager. Xhumana namabalasi okuhamba ukuze ulungise izinhlela zokuhamba. Hlola izinhlela lapho ethola amafomu abalulekile. Hlela imihlangano nemikhosi komphathi ophakeme nakubasebenzi bahlabathi. Khetha izindawo, mema abantu abafanele, hlela ukudla futhi uhlele amashejula emihlanganweni nemikhosi. Thola amafomu abalulekile we travel and subsistence claims kwilabathi. Thola wonke amafomu okuthintana nemisebenzi yomphathi ophakeme. Bhalise amaminithi emihlanganweni komphathi ophakeme lapho kudingeka khona. Bhala imiyalezoyadayili namarepo. Gcina amafomu komphathi ophakeme kwilabathi. Phatha izindaba ezifana namarejista weloveshe nobhalo lwefoni. Yamukela, bhalise futhi wabelane ngawo wonke amafomu abalulekile abuyelayo. Sebenzisa izinto zokuthenga ezifana nesitishi, ukudla etc. Qoqa wonke amafomu abalulekile ukuze kwakube lula ku Direktha ukulungiselela imihlangano. Gcina ulwazi ngamaphupha / amapholisi noma amaphrosesa okusebenza kuso ohlelo lokusebenza kwakho ukuze uqiniseke insiza ephumelelayo nangempumelelo komphathi ophakeme. Funda imiQulu yomphakathi kanye namapholisi omnyango namanye amafomu abalulekile ukuze uqiniseke ukuthi ayasebenza. Gcina ulwazi lwakho ngamaphrosesa namapholisi ohlelo lokusebenza komphathi ophakeme.

xh.title: Unobhala
xh.summary: Kunika inkxaso yomsebenzi wobhala nokwamkela abantu kumlawuli kwiSebe leZolimo, loLwazi ngoMhlaba nokuPhuhliswa kwamaphandle ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikethi seGrade 12. Ulwazi oluxhomekeke kumsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (iMicrosoft Word, iMicrosoft Excel, iPowerPoint, njl.). Amakhono axhomekeke kumsebenzi: Amakhono amabalawulweyo okuthetha kufowuni. Ikhono lokuhamba lulawulo. Amakhono amabalawulweyo yokusebenza nabantu. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ikhono lokunxibelelana kakuhle nabantu abakwinqanaba elahlukileyo kunye nabalawulweyo abavela kumagumbi amahlongo (kokubhalayo nokuthethwayo). Ikhono lokuziphatha ngokuqhwesileyo nangokubhityileyo.
xh.duties: Kunika inkxaso yomsebenzi wobhala / yokwamkela abantu kwisikhululo kumlawuli. Kwamkela iifowuni kwaye uzidlulisele kubathathi-nxaxheba abafanelekileyo ukuba azizanga komlawuli ophakamileyo ogqithiselayo. Kubhalise iindibano nezenzo kwidayari. Kubhala amaxwebhu omlawuli ophakamileyo kunye noother abasebenzi kwilaphu. Kusebenzisa izixhobo zofisi njengakho iikhompyutha kunye neziqhotyoshiswa zamaxwebhu. Kunika inkxaso yomsebenzi wolawulo kumlawuli ophakamileyo. Kuxhumana neeenkampani zokuhamba ukwenza izicwangciso zokuhamba. Kuphonononga izicwangciso xa amaxwebhu afanelekileyo efumanisiwe. Kulungelelanisa iindibano nezenzo kumlawuli ophakamileyo kunye noo-basebenzi kwilaphu. Kuthatha iindawo zokuqokelelwa, Kumema abathathi-nxaxheba, Kulungelelanisa iziselo kwaye Kucwangcisa iinkqubo zengcashela zendibano nezenzo. Kucubungula iingxelo zokuhamba nokuhlala ezenzelwa ilaphu. Kucubungula onke amaxwebhu okuthengisa aphuma kwiinkalo zomsebenzi womlawuli ophakamileyo. Kubhala imizuzu yendibano yomlawuli ophakamileyo xa kufuneka. Kubhala iindaba ezidityaniswe nomsebenzi namaxwebhu. Kugcina amaxwebhu omlawuli ophakamileyo kunye nelaphu apho kufuneka khona. Kulawula izinto ezinjengokubhaliswa kwabasebenzi kunye ne-akhawunti zefowuni. Kwamkela, Kubhala kwaye Kwahlula ngokwabanzi nawapha ngaphandle onke amaxwebhu angena nakuphuma. Kuphatha ukuthengiswa kwezinto ezifanayo ezinjengokubhala, iziselo njl. Kuqokelela onke amaxwebhu afanelekileyo ukwenza umlawuli akulungele iindibano. Kuhlala ekwindawo yamava ngemigaqo / iinkqubo ezikumthetho wezicwangciso nakwindawo yakhe ukuba kuqinisekiswe inkxako ekwinkqubo yomsebenzi kumlawuli ophakamileyo. Kufunda imigaqo / iinkqubo yolawulo lothurhisidi yamakhaya kunye neyesebe namaxwebhu amaninzi ukuba kuqinisekiswe ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwayo kuyaqondwa ngokuchanekileyo. Kuzigcina esitoko ekwindawo yamava ngeenkqubo namaqhinga omlawuli ophakamileyo.

af.title: Hulptiensbeampte
af.summary: Hulptiensbeampte by Mowbray wat Graad 12 en rekenaarvaardigheid vereis om elektroniese ondersteuningstelsels te onderhou en rekords van reproduuksieversoeke saam te stel.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Geen ervaring vereis. Werksverwante kennis: Rekenaarvaardigheid. Basiese begrip van kaarte en kadastrale dokumente. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik). Rekenaarsagtewarevermoë. Goeie organiseervermoë. Bokantgemiddelde aandag aan detail.
af.duties: Onderhou elektroniese ondersteuningstelsel vir komponent. Stel 'n portfolio van bewyse saam van alle versoeke wat per e-pos van kliënte en die kliëntediensbank ontvang is. Stel akkurate rekords op van alle reproduuksieversoeke wat ontvang en versend is. Stel maandelikse verslagdoening vir die kliëntediens- en reproduksiekomponente op. Finansiële bestuur vir betalings wat van kliënte ontvang is. Skakel met die finansiesafdelings vir betalings ontvang. Wys en raming van betalings met kliënte se bestellings toe. Skakel met die finansiesafdeling vir die voorbereiding van fakture. Bestelling van kaartvoorraad vir die reproduksiekomponent en die kaartwinkel. Bestel kaarte vir komponente om te verseker dat die minimum drempel vir kliënte beskikbaar is. Bystand om te verseker dat die versendingsomgewing nie onbeman gelaat word nie. Bestuur ontvangs van kliëntetoestelle vir dataoordragte. Stel 'n register op van kliëntedataoordragtoestelle wat ontvang en versend is. Stel kliënte dienooreenkomstig in kennis. Voltooi verschillende administratiewe take. Voltooi en dien verlofvorms in ooreenkomstig departementele beleid. Beantwoord telefone met betrekking tot kliëntversoeke in die kliëntedienskomponent. Onderneem prestasiebestuur.

zu.title: Onozimele Abayinkomba
zu.summary: Isikhundla sonozimele abayinkomba e Mowbray sifuna ibanga lesi-12 kanye nokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ukuze kugcinwe izinhlelo zokusekela ezibhalwe ngokufakwayo kanye nokuqoqa amarekhodi wemibhalo eceliwe.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ebangaphantsi: Abafaka izicelo kumele babe nesithifikathi se-Banga lesi-12. Akukho mkhosi odingekayo. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda okuyisiseko ngamamephu namadokhumenti e-cadastral. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle (olwenziwayo nolubhalwayo). Ikhono lokusebenzisa isofthiwe yekhompyutha. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela. Ukuqashela imininingwane ngaphezulu kwesilinganiso.
zu.duties: Gcina isindlela sokusekela esibhalwe ngokufakwayo sohlobo. Qoqa imfuyo yezibonakaliso zamawoso wonke atholwe nge-imeyili kubathile kanye nenhlelo yesevisi yabathile. Qoqa amarekhodi afanele amawoso onke okuphindwa ulwazi atholwe adluliswe. Qoqa ukubika kwanyanga zonke kuhlelo lwisevisi yabathile kanye namaphuzu e-reprographics. Cabangela imali yemipholo etholwe kubathile. Xhumana nezigaba zemali mayelana nemipholo etholwe. Abela futhi uhlanganise imipholo nemawoso yabathile. Xhumana nesigaba semali ukuze kulungiselelwe izikweletu. Odela isitoko samamephu sohlobo i-reprographics nendawo yokugcina amamephu. Odela amamephu ohlelweni ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kunesisindo esingaphantsi esitholakalayo kubathile. Siza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo yokuthumela ayiyekiwa inganakekelwa. Phatha ukutholwa kwamadivaysi abathile ukudlulisa idatha. Qoqa irekhodi lamadivaysi okudluliswa idatha abathile atholakele adluliswe. Yezisa abathile ngokuhlobene nalokho. Qedela imisebenzi eyahlukene yentengiselwano. Qedela futhi uhambise amafomu eholo ngokuvumelana nenqubomgomo yomnyango. Phendula ucingo mayelana namawoso abathile ohlelweni lweisevisi yabathile. Thatha umsebenzi wokuphathwa kokusebenza.

xh.title: Iofisa lezeNkonzo eNxambele
xh.summary: Iofisa lezeNkonzo eNxambele e Mowbryaelifuna iGreydi yeshumi kunye nokusebenzisa ikhompyutha ukugcina iinkqubo zikrofondo ezezikhongozeli kunye nokuqulunqa irekhodi lemibuzo yokuphindaphinda.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe neSatifikethi seGraji 12. Akukho mfundo yamava idingekayo. Ulwazi oluhambelana nomsebenzi: Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuqonda okusesisekelu kwamapu namaxwebhu oqikeqelo lomhlaba. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Izibongozelana ezilungileyo phakathi kwabantu. Unxibelelwano oluhle (oluthethwayo nolubhalwayo). Ikakhulu ukusebenzisa isoftware yekhompyutha. Ikakhonye lokuhlela oluhle. Ukunakisisa iinkcukacha ngaphezulu kwamazinga amatyeni.
xh.duties: Phatha inkqubo yokrofondo ezezakhono lealathiso ezingqonge ukuba inkqubo ekuhleliweyo. Qulunqa umboniso wezazisi zazo zonke iimfuno ezamkelwa nge-imeyile kumaxhaswa nasezikhongzeli ezingqonge ukukhonza iindaba. Qulunqa iirekhodi ezichanekileyo zazo zonke iimfuno zokuphindaphinda ezamkelweye nasezithunyelwayo. Qulunqa iingxelonye zenyanga ezingqonge ukukhonza iindaba kunye neenkqubo zokuphindaphinda. Ukulawula ezezimali ekuhlawulenwe ngamaxhaswa. Thintana neendawo ezingezemali malunga nemali ehlawulwe ngo. Misela ulwalamano ngokuhlawula ngamaxhaswa. Yenza izikqulu ezindlela ze-mali ukuze zihlaziye iinkqubo ezingamajoni ekuhlawulweni. Xelela indawo yezezimali ngokulungiselelwa kwemali. Kulawula iinkqubo zokusebenza iziko elizokwazi ukuphatha iinkqubo ezingqonge. Thumela iingxelo ezahlukeneyo kuqoqosho olune nkqubo yeqela. Qulunqa iingxelo zenyanga zeqela lokukhululeka kwabathengi neziko elizalathisa ekuqoqweni kwenkqubo yokuphindaphindisa. Thintana neqela lezemali malunga nemali ethunyelwe. Misela ulwalamano ngokuhlawula ngamaxhaswa. Thintana neqela lezemali ngokulungiselela kwemali. Kulawula izicelo zamapu eqela eliphindaphindayo nendlalashe ekhankanya amapu. Faka iinkqubo ukuya kumaxhaswa ngendlela yokuba bayazi ukuba inkqubo iphelile. Yenza isicelo selevhu malunga nemigaqo-nkqubo yecandelo. Phendula iingxelo ezimalunga nemicimbi yekhompyutha. Qulunqa uludwe lwezixhobo ezamkelwe nokuqhutywa kwezixhobo zabaxhasi. Qulunqa uludwe lwesoftware namaxwebhu abaxhasi aphelele. Qulunqa uludwe lwazo zonke iindawo ezamkelwayo eziswa kumaxhasi. Yenza iingxelo ezinkqubo ngamaxesha. Qeda kwaye ugcine imimiselo yocingo nakwindlu yophando. Yenza umsebenzi wokulungelelanisa imali eza kwindlu yophando.

af.summary: Administratiewe Klerk benodig in Nelspruit om algemene klerklike ondersteuning te bied, registers te onderhou en roetine-navrae te hanteer. Vereis Graad 12.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat. Werksverwante vaardighede: Goeie kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik. Beplanning en organisasie. Rekenaargeletterdheid. Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om binne 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Lewer algemene klerklike ondersteuningsdienste. Rekordig, organiseer, stoor, vasleg en onttrek korrespondensie en data (lynfunksie). Werk registers en statistieke by. Amakhono okusebenza ngaphansi komsindvo: Ukusebenza kahle nabantu. Ukusebenza kahle kwetimu. Amakhono obuchwepheshe. Amakhono okuhlelokwenzi. Isidingo sokuqeda inqubo yokuhlela kusetshenziswa ubunikazi bobuntu.
zu.duties: Kudingeka ukuba nomkhandlu wezobuqeqeshi bomtlati ophumelelisa. Ukuqeqesha izindlu ezingezona ezimaphakathi. Ukuhlola nokuphotha okungenwa ekhasini lezinto ezingathunyelwa. Ukwenza amakhophi bese ethumela noma esemukela amafeksi. Ukusabalalisa imibhalo iphakethe kwabahlobene njengoba kudingeka. Ukugcina nokulondoliza isiqu sesistimu. Thayipha izincwadi nemibhalo evela kulabo ababuyela ngemibuzo. Ukugcina nokulondolola ukubhaliswa kwemibhalo engena noma ephuma komkhakha. Ukwenza nokususa izinkulumo zokuhlangana. Ukunikela ngokulalela izwi abantu abakhulemo ngokusiza abantu ukuthola izidingo. Ukuhlanganyela nabantu bengaphakathi kwilabo abangeaphandle ukwenzela ukuthola izidingo nezinsiza. Ukuqasha amakhasimende okuthenga izinto eziyisizingathiswa. Ukubeka nokulondolaza izinto ezihlotshaniswa nesikhungo. Ukubala isibalo sezinto ezingangeni noma ezingaphuma ekhasini lesikhungo. Ukubala isibalo sabantu. Ukugcina amarekhodi wobuntu bokuhlangana. Ukubala ukubhaliswa kwabantu. Uhlelo lokuhamba nokulala. Ukunikela ngesikhulu esibusisayo ngokuphatwa kwezezimali. Ukufaka izimali ezingangeni noma eziguquliwe kulesikhungo. Ukubala ukuhamba nokuhlola ukuthi izimali ezisetshenziswe zingangeni ziyayenza emsebenzini bese zithunyelwa komphathi. Ukuphatha imali yokubeka ngekhompyutha yezikhungo ezinkhulu ezimalini esemgwaqeni.

xh.title: Iklek kunye Nolawulo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa iklek kunye Nolawulo eNelspruit ukunika inkxaso yemisebenzi yeklerikhi jikelele, ukugcina iirejista nokuphatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Kufuneka abe noGraji ye 12.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho: Abafaka isicelo kufuneka babe nesatifikathe seGraji ye 12. Amakhono ahambelana nomsebenzi: Bukelana kakuhle (ngemilomo nangokubhalwa). Uculo kunye nolungiselelo. Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Iindibaniselwano phakathi kwabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphakathi kwethim.
xh.duties: Nika iinkonzo zeklerikhi jikelele. Bhala, hlela, gcina, thatha kwaye ubuyisele oonxibelelwano nedatha (umsebenzi womgca). Hlaziya iirejista n izibalo. Phatha imibuzo eqhelekileyo. Yenza iikhopi kwaye wamkele okanye uthumele iifeksi. Yahlula amaxwebhu / amaphakheji kumabanzi abahlukahlukenyo njengoko kuyimfuneko. Gcina kwaye ulawule inkqubo yoku-vala nelayini yeqela. Chwetheza iileta kwaye / okanye elunye unxibelelwano xa kuyimfuneko. Gcina kwaye ulawule irejista yamaxwebhu angenayo naphephayo eqela. Thatha kwaye uphando iinqobo. Yinkonzo zenkxaso yeklerikhi yohambo lwezibonelelo ngaphakathi kweqela. Dibana nabathathi-nxaxheba bangaphakathi nangaphandle malunga nokuthengwa kwempahla neenkonzo. Thatha izicelo kwaye ugcwalise iifomu zokuthenga ukuremeka izinto zofisi eziqhelekileyo. Lawula isitokhwe sezixhobo zofisi. Gcina kwaye ulawule irejista yempahla yeqela. Nikeza iinkonzo zenkxaso yeklerikhi yolawulo lwabantu ngaphakathi kweqela. Gcina irejista yokuphumla yeqela. Gcina kwaye ulawule irekhodi lwabantu eqela. Gcina kwaye ulawule irejista yokubakho yeqela. Cwangcisa ukuhamba nendawo yokuhlala. Nikeza iinkonzo zenkxaso yolawulo lweemali eqela. Thatha kwaye uhlaziye izindleko eqela. Hangisa ukuchaneka kwezicelo zokuziphilisa nezokuhamba zabasebenzi kwaye uzithumele kumphathi ukuvunywa. Phatha iiaxa yefowuni nensimbi yemali encinci yeqela.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Clerk
jobs.department: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
jobs.summary: Supply Chain Clerk needed in Pietermaritzburg to provide asset management clerical support, maintain records, and issue equipment for the Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirements: Applicants must be in a possession of a Grade 12 Certificate or related equivalent qualification. Job related knowledge: Basic knowledge of supply chain duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate a computer and collecting statistics. Basic knowledge and understanding of legislative framework governing the Public Service. Basic knowledge of work procedures in terms of the working environment. Job related skills: Planning and organisation. Computer literacy. Communication (verbal and written). Interpersonal relations. Ability to work within a team.
jobs.duties: Render asset management clerical support. Compile and maintain records (e.g. asset records / databases). Check and issue furniture, equipment and accessories to components and individuals. Identify redundant, non- serviceable and obsolete equipment for disposal. Verify asset register. Render demand and acquisition clerical support. Update and maintain a supplier (including contractors) database. Register suppliers on LOGIS or similar system. Request and receive quotations. Capture specification on the electronic purchasing system. Place orders. Issue and receive bid documents. Provide secretariat or logistical support during the bid consideration and contracts process. Compile draft documents as required. Render logistical support services. Place orders for goods. Receive and verify goods from suppliers. Capture goods in registers databases. Receive request for goods from end users. Issue goods to end users. Maintain goods register. Update and maintain register of suppliers.
jobs.enquiries: Ms F Mathonsi Tel No: (033) 264 9500
jobs.applications: Applications can be submitted by hand delivery during office hours to: 1st Floor, 270 Jabu Ndlovu Street (formerly known as Loop Street), Pietermaritzburg, 3200 or by email to Post209@dlrrd.gov.za
jobs.notes: EE Targets: Coloured, Indian and White Males and Coloured and White Females and Persons with Disabilities. To apply, submit a completed Z83 form and detailed Curriculum Vitae (PDF document to a maximum of 10 megabytes) via e-mail or hand delivery. The Department will not be held responsible for server delays. Late applications due to technical issues will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates must provide certified copies of required documents (Identity Document, qualifications, etc) where necessary and service certificates to support senior management experience to Human Resources before the interviews, including South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) evaluation reports for foreign qualifications. Failure to comply will result in disqualification. To be appointed at Senior Management Service (SMS) level, you must complete the SMS Pre- entry programme offered by the National School of Government (NSG). Find course details here: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/ appointment is subject to successful completion of the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to SMS and submission of proof. Shortlisted applicants for the advertised vacancies will undergo two pre-entry assessments: a practical assessment and an integrity assessment, both of which form part of the selection criteria after the interview. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. NB: Please note that false or fraudulent qualifications submitted by applicants will be reported to the South African Police Services (SAPS), and a criminal case shall be opened. Applications: Please submit your application before the closing date as late applications will not be considered. Do not submit duplicate applications. If applying for multiple posts, submit separate applications for each post. Applications submitted via email will be acknowledged via an automated response. Applications received manually will not be acknowledged due to high volumes of applications received. If you have not heard from us within 3 months, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. Should, during any stage of the recruitment process, a moratorium be placed on the filling of posts or the Department is affected by any process such as, but not limited to, restructuring or reorganisation of posts, the Department reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process and re- advertise the post at any time in the future. Important: DLRRD is an equal opportunity employer committed to promoting representivity and affirmative action. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates. The Department reserves the right not to fill vacancies. By applying you consent to the collection and processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes. Shortlisted candidates will be required to be available for assessments and interviews at a date and time as determined by the Department. Shortlisted candidates will undergo personnel suitability checks, security vetting and reference checks (including social media profiles). Applications must declare any pending criminal, disciplinary or any other allegations or investigations. Successful candidates must pass security clearance, sign an employment contract, sign an annual performance agreement and disclose financial interests. All applicants are required to declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest, to disclose memberships of Boards and directorships that they may be associated with. Failure to disclose relevant information may result in disqualification or termination. af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk
af.summary: Voorsieningskettingklerk word in Pietermaritzburg benodig om klerklike ondersteuning vir batebestuur te verskaf, rekorde te onderhou, en toerusting vir die Department of Land Reform and Rural Development uit te reik.
af.requirements: Minimum vereistes: Aansoekers moet in besit wees van 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat of 'n verwante equivalente kwalifikasie. Werksverwante kennis: Basiese kennis van voorsieningskettingpligte, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedryf en statistiek te versamel. Basiese kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Basiese kennis van werksprosedures ten opsigte van die werksomgewing. Werksverwante vaardighede: Beplanning en organisering. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kommunikasie (mondeling en skriftelik). Interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om in 'n span te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning vir batebestuur. Stel rekorde op en onderhou dit (bv. baterekords / databasisse). Kontroleer en reik meubels, toerusting en bybehore aan komponente en individue uit. Identifiseer oortollige, onbruikbare en verouderde toerusting vir wegdoening. Verifieer bateregister. Verskaf klerklike ondersteuning vir vraag en verkryging. Werk die verskaffer- (insluitend kontrakteurs) databasis by en onderhou dit. Registreer verskaffers op LOGIS of 'n soortgelyke stelsel. Versoek en ontvang kwotasies. Lui spesifikasies op die elektroniese aankoopstelsel vas. Plaas bestellings. Reik bod dokumente uit en ontvang dit. Verskaf sekretariaat of logistieke ondersteuning tydens die bodoorweging en kontrakproses. Stel konsep dokumente op soos vereis. Verskaf logistieke ondersteuningsdienste. Plaas bestellings vir goedere. Ontvang en verifieer goedere van verskaffers. Lui goedere in register databasisse vas. Ontvang versoeke vir goedere van eindgebruikers. Reik goedere aan eindgebruikers uit. Onderhou goedere register. Werk die register van verskaffers by en onderhou dit.

zu.title: Umlobi we-Supply Chain
zu.summary: Kudingeka umlobi we-Supply Chain e-Pietermaritzburg ukunikeza inkonzolo yokuloba ekuqpheni kwamasheya, ukugcina imibhalo, kanye nokukhiqiza izinsiza zomnyango i-Department of Land Reform and Rural Development.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezingaphansi: Abafakelimelye kumele babe nesitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma isiqu esihlobene nesilinganiso. Ulwazi oluhlobene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olusisekelo ngemisebenzi ye-supply chain, izinqubo kanye nakhono okubamba idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuthola izibalo. Ulwazi olusisekelo nokuqonda umthetho ophatha i-Public Service. Ulwazi olusisekelo ngeminqubo yomsebenzi ngokohlelo lokusebenza. Amakhono ahlobene nomsebenzi: Ukuhlela nokuqamba. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala). Izinhlangano zobuntu. Ikakhulu ukuba nakho ukusebenza ohlwini.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkonzolo yokuloba ekuqpheni kwamasheya. Hlanganisa futhi ugcinimibhalo (isb. imibhalo / amadatabase wamashizi). Hlola futhi ukhiqize impahla, izinsiza nezinsiza eziseduze nakwelabantu. Hlaziya izinsiza ezingasadingekile, ezingasebenzi noma eziseduze ngokulahla. Qinisekisa ibhuku lamashizi. Nikeza inkonzolo yokuloba kwezidingo nokutholwa. Buyekeza futhi ugcinise idatha labakhi (okuhlanganisa nama-contractor). Bhalisa abakhi ku-LOGIS noma ohlelo olufanayo. Cela futhi uthole izincomo. Bathi imininingwane kuhlelo lokuthenga ngamakhompyutha. Faka amadolobha. Khupha futhi uthole amadokhumenti wemibuzo. Nikeza inkonzolo noma ukwesekwa ngesikhathi sokuqwalasela imibuzo kanye nenqubo yamaselawundi. Hlanganisa amadrafti njengoba kudingeka. Nikeza inkonzolo yokwesekwa kwezinsiza. Faka amadolobha ezimpahla. Thola futhi qinisekisa impahla kubakhi. Faka impahla kumabhuku amadatabase. Thola izikweletu zezimpahla kubasebenzisi abaphelayo. Khupha impahla kubasebenzisi abaphelayo. Gcina ibhuku lezimpahla. Buyekeza futhi ugcinise ibhuku labakhi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi weShishini lokuhambisa izinto
xh.summary: Kufunekwa umsebenzi weshishini lokuhambisa izinto ePietermaritzburg ukunikela inkxaso yolulo lolawulo lwempahla, ukugcina iirekhodi, nokunikela isixhobo kwiSebe leLand Reform and Rural Development.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingaphantsi: Abafaka izicelo kufuneka babe nesatifiketi seGrade 12 okanye isiqu esithotho. Ulwazi olunxulumene nomsebenzi: Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo ngemisebenzi yeshishini lokuhambisa izinto, iindlela zokwenza umsebenzi nakho nokuqonda kokuqokelela iidata, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibaliso. Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo nokuqonda inkqubo yomthetho elawula inkonzo kahulumeni. Ulwazi olusetyenzwayo ngemigaqo yomsebenzi ngokwemoyili yomsebenzi. Amakhono anxulumene nomsebenzi: Ukuqamba iindlela nokuqamba. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukunxibelelana (ngolwimi nangokubhalwe). Unxibelelwano nabantu. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ngolulo lolawulo lwempahla. Qamba zigcine iirekhodi (umz. iirekhodi / iidata yempahla). Jonga nikela iifanitsha, isixhobo neempawu kumacandelo nakuqabanayo. Phawula isixhobo esingasafanelekanga, esingasasebenziyo nendalo idluleyo ukuze siphatwe. Qinisekisa irekhodi yempahla. Nika inkxaso ngolulo lwesicelo nokuqokelela izinto. Hlaziya ugcine idata yabahlinzeki (kuquka nabayi contractor). Bhalisa abahlinzeki kwiLOGIS okanye inkqubo efanayo. Celde wamkele iiquotations. Qamba iispecification kwinkqubo yethengiso elektronik. Faka iiodo. Nikela wamkele amaxwebhu ebid. Nikela inkxaso yeseleteriat okanye yokuhambisa izinto ngexesha lenkqubo yokuqwalasela ibid nesenzo ngokubhaliswa kwekontrakti. Qamba amaxwebhu abhalwa njengoko kufuneka. Nika iinkxaso zokuhambisa izinto. Faka iiodo izinto. Amkele uqinisekise izinto ezisuka kubahlinzeki. Qamba izinto kwii databases zerekhodi. Amkele izicelo ezisuka kubasebenzisi ekupheleni. Nike izinto abasebenzisi ekupheleni. Gcina ukugcina irekhodi ezinto. Hlaziya ugcine irekhodi yabahlinzeki.

jobs.reference_number: NSG 13 /2026 Job Purpose: To lead and manage business development and specialised programmes implementation that support the co-creation and facilitation of education, training, and development
jobs.title: Chief Director: Business Development and Specialised
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), an inclusive remuneration package commencing
jobs.summary: Chief Director: Business Development and Specialised role at the National School of Government in Pretoria, offering R1,554,696 per annum at Level 14.
jobs.requirements: A tertiary qualification at (NQF level 7) as recognized by SAQA in Business Administration / Management or Marketing Communication / Management. Registration with a relevant professional body will also be an added advantage. The job holder will be subjected to a security vetting process, the clearance level of which will be determined. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela). Experience: five years of proven experience at the senior management level. Proven experience in business development, contract negotiations and stakeholder management. Knowledge: In-depth theoretical and practical knowledge of the education, training, and development environment, in particular business development. In depth understanding of the public sector, relevant policies and applicable legislative frameworks (including but not limited to: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Knowledge of professional bodies and regulatory body requirements (South African Qualifications Authority, Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, Council for Higher Education) Policy development, analysis and implementation. Advanced computer literacy, including excellent working knowledge of MS Office suite and relevant software for data analysis. Knowledge on assessing the effects of projects, applying new developments and innovation. Batho Pele principles. Skills: Proven advanced writing skills, proofreading, editing, including report writing, submissions and articles. Digital skills to work in digital environments with digital systems, management and reporting tools. Good conflict management skills. Advanced Computer skills in MS Office Suite. Creative and analytical skills. Competencies: Must be able to provide a vision, set the direction for the unit and inspire others to deliver on the organisational mandate. Plan, manage, monitor and evaluate specific activities to deliver the desired outputs. Compile and manage budgets, control cash flow, institute risk management and administer tender procurement processes by generally recognised financial practices to ensure the achievement of strategic organisational objectives. Promote the generation and sharing of knowledge and learning to enhance the organisation's collective knowledge. High standards of ethical and moral conduct. Personal Attributes: Participate in professional development growth activities and stay up to date with business solutions and trends. Ability to multi-task, organise, prioritise and pay attention to detail. Work independently while contributing to a team environment. Problem solving and conflict resolution skills. Establish and maintain effective working relationships with management, employees, stakeholders and the public. Integrity and honesty. Travel and work extended hours.
jobs.duties: Lead in generating market intelligence and diagnostic information that will inform demand for new product/business development opportunities and initiatives. Lead and manage marketing and visibility of NSG products and services (advocacy programmes) and provide support to piloting new products. Collaborate with business units and work in integrated teams to determine ETD interventions. Lead and manage the initiation and conclusion of MoUs /MoAs with identified clients and partners. Lead and manage implementation plans related to signed MoUs/ MoAs, in liaison with internal business units. Monitor ETD delivery and performance against signed MoUs/ MoAs, as well as post- delivery support. Manage collaborative review and feedback sessions with clients and stakeholders. Build and sustain client loyalty and NSG brand through client support and liaison. Identify and incubate innovative specialised programmes, projects and partnerships to support ETD delivery and attract new clients. Conduct feasibility assessments and develop business cases for specialised programmes and projects. Develop project and programme plans, including objectives, deliverables, milestones and resource requirements. Coordinate and manage the implementation of specialised programmes and projects in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders. Support curriculum development, learning content design and partnership arrangements for specialised programmes. Monitor, evaluate and report on programme and project performance, risks, sustainability and implementation progress. Identify and foster opportunities to support increased market share (training uptake numbers and revenue generated). Establish and manage networks and multi-sector relationships that serve the interests of the NSG. Support other public sector institutions through partnerships in building capacity. Chair/ oversee relevant internal business development committee structures. Participate in strategic external and internal forums including NSG- led forums. Participate in capacity building interventions, including facilitation of ETD interventions, publications and presentation of papers. Lead, direct and manage the resources (people, finance, systems, assets) allocated within the chief directorate. Implement operations management within the business unit, including determination of service standards, standard operating procedures, business process management, total quality management and digital transformation. Manage the strategic planning and performance of the chief directorate. Manage the budget allocated to the business unit. Identify and manage strategic and operational risks within the business unit, as well as mitigation plans, including business continuity plans.
jobs.enquiries: Mpho Mugodo Tel No: (012) 441 6017
jobs.applications: CHIEF DIRECTOR: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND SPECIALISED PROGRAMME REF NO: NSG 13/2026 – Fill out form
jobs.notes: Applications must consist of: A fully completed and signed new Z83 form with a comprehensive CV containing contactable references. Use of the old Z83 Form will result in disqualification. Candidates should not attach certified documents to the application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview. The relevant reference number must be written on the application form. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. All appointments are subject to personnel suitability checks such as security vetting, citizen verification, financial records check, and qualifications verifications. Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements as well as applications that are received late, will not be considered. The selection process of the SMS post will be in line with the Senior Management Service requirements. The successful candidate will be expected to sign a performance agreement within three months from the date of assumption of duties and where applicable to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests within a month. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its employment equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender, and disability) through the filling of this post. The NSG reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) is required for appointment to the SMS posts. Enrolment for the course should be          made          on         the          NSG’s           website       at https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry-programme.
