af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Besigheidsontwikkeling en Gespesialiseerd
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur: Besigheidsontwikkeling en Gespesialiseerd pos by die National School of Government in Pretoria, wat R1,554,696 per jaar teen Vlak 14 bied.
af.requirements: 'n Tertiaire kwalifikasie op (NQF vlak 7) soos deur SAQA erken in Besigheidsadministrasie / Bestuur of Bemarkingskommunikasie / Bestuur. Registrasie by 'n tersaaklike professionele liggaam sal ook 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Die posbekleër sal aan 'n sekuriteitsondersoekproses onderwerp word, waarvan die ondersoekvlak bepaal sal word. Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela). Ervaring: vyf jaar se bewese ervaring op seniorbestuursvlak. Bewese ervaring in besigheidsontwikkeling, kontrakonderhandelings en belanghebbende-bestuur. Kennis: Diepgaande teoretiese en praktiese kennis van die onderwys-, opleidings- en ontwikkelingsomgewing, veral besigheidsontwikkeling. Diepgaande begrip van die openbare sektor, tersaaklike beleide en toepaslike wetgewende raamwerke (insluitend maar nie beperk tot: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Kennis van professionele liggame en vereistes van regulerende liggame (South African Qualifications Authority, Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, Council for Higher Education) Beleidsontwikkeling, -analise en -implementering. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend uitstekende werkkennis van die MS Office Suite en tersaaklike sagteware vir data-analise. Kennis van die assessering van die effekte van projekte, die toepassing van nuwe ontwikkelings en innovasie. Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardighede: Bewese gevorderde skryfvaardighede, proeflees, redigering, insluitend verslagskryf, voorleggings en artikels. Digitale vaardighede om in digitale omgewings met digitale stelsels, bestuurs- en verslagdoeningsnutsmiddels te werk. Goeie konflikbestuursvaardighede. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardighede in MS Office Suite. Kreatiewe en analitiese vaardighede. Bevoegdhede: Moet in staat wees om 'n visie te bied, die rigting vir die eenheid vas te stel en ander te inspireer om die organisatoriese mandaat na te kom. Spesifieke aktiwiteite plan, bestuur, monitor en evalueer om die verlangde lewerings te lewer. Begrotings opstel en bestuur, kontantvloei beheer, risikobestuur instel en tenderverkrygingsprosesse administreer volgens algemeen erkende finansiële praktyke om die bereiking van strategiese organisatoriese doelwitte te verseker. Die generering en deling van kennis en leer bevorder om die organisasie se kollektiewe kennis te verbeter. Hoë standaarde van etiese en morele gedrag. Persoonlike eienskappe: Neem deel aan professionele ontwikkelings- en groeiaktiwiteite en bly op hoogte van besigheidsoplossings en tendense. Vermoe om veelvuldige take uit te voer, te organiseer, prioriteite te stel en aandag aan besonderhede te gee. Onafhanklik werk terwyl bygedra word tot 'n spanomgewing. Probleemoplossings- en konflikbeslegtingsvaardighede. Effektiewe werksverhoudings met bestuur, werknemers, belanghebbendes en die publiek opbou en handhaaf. Integriteit en eerlikheid. Reis en werk buite gewone ure.
af.duties: Neem die leiding in die generering van markintelligensie en diagnostiese inligting wat vraag na nuwe produk-/besigheidsontwikkelingsgeleenthede en -inisiatiewe sal inlig. Neem die leiding by en bestuur bemarking en sigbaarheid van NSG-produkte en -dienste (voorspraakprogramme) en bied ondersteuning vir die loods van nuwe produkte. Werk saam met besigheidsseenhede en in geïntegreerde spanne om ETD-ingrypings te bepaal. Neem die leiding by en bestuur die inisiering en afsluiting van MoU's/MoA's met geïdentifiseerde kliënte en vennote. Neem die leiding by en bestuur implementeringsplanne verbonde aan getekende MoU's/MoA's, in oorleg met interne besigheidsseenhede. Monitor ETD-lewerings en -prestasie teenoor getekende MoU's/MoA's, asook na-leweringsondersteuning. Bestuur gesamentlike hersienings- en terugvoersessies met kliënte en belanghebbendes. Bou en handhaaf kliëntgetrouheid en die NSG-handelsmerk deur kliëntondersteuning en -skakeling. Identifiseer en broei innoverende gespesialiseerde programme, projekte en vennootskappe uit om ETD-lewering te ondersteun en nuwe kliënte te lok. Voer haalbaarheidsassesserings uit en ontwikkel besigheidsgevalle vir gespesialiseerde programme en projekte. Ontwikkel projek- en programplanne, insluitend doelwitte, lewerings, mylpale en hulpbronvereistes. Koördineer en bestuur die implementering van gespesialiseerde programme en projekte in samewerking met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Ondersteun kurrikulumontwikkeling, leerinhoudontwerp en vennootskapsreëlings vir gespesialiseerde programme. Monitor, evalueer en rapporteer oor program- en projekprestasie, risiko's, volhoubaarheid en implementeringsvoortgang. Identifiseer en bevorder geleenthede om verhoogde markaandeel (opleidingsopneemgetalle en gegenereerde inkomste) te ondersteun. Bou en bestuur netwerke en multisektor-verhoudings wat die belange van die NSG dien. Ondersteun ander openbare-sektorinstellings deur vennootskappe om kapasiteit op te bou. Voorsit/oorsee tersaaklike interne besigheidsontwikkelingskomiteestrukture. Neem deel aan strategiese eksterne en interne forums, insluitend NSG-geleide forums. Neem deel aan kapasiteitsbou-ingrypings, insluitend fasilitering van ETD-ingrypings, publikasies en voorlegging van referate. Neem die leiding by, rig en bestuur die hulpbronne (mense, finansies, stelsels, bates) wat binne die hoofdirektoraat toegeken is. Implementeer bedryfsbestuur binne die besigheidsseenheid, insluitend die bepaling van diensstandaarde, standaardbedryfsprosedures, besigheidsprosesbestuur, totale gehaltebestuur en digitale transformasie. Bestuur die strategiese beplanning en prestasie van die hoofdirektoraat. Bestuur die begroting wat aan die besigheidsseenheid toegeken is. Identifiseer en bestuur strategiese en operasionele risiko's binne die besigheidsseenheid, asook mitigasieplanne, insluitend besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwebhizinisi Nakwezikhundla Eziyisisekelo
zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi oMkhulu: Ukuthuthukiswa Kwebhizinisi Nakwezikhundla Eziyisisekelo e-National School of Government e-Pretoria, kunikeza i-R1,554,696 ngonyaka e-Level 14.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole samabanga aphakeme e-(NQF level 7) njengoba kuqashelwe yi-SAQA ku-Business Administration / Management noma i-Marketing Communication / Management. Ukwabiwa kunhlangano yezobungcali ehambisana nalesi sikhundla kuzoba yinuzuzo. Umdidiyeli wesikhundla uzobe ehlotshaniswa nenqubo yokuhlolwa kwezokuphepha, lapho izinga lokuhlolwa kuzoqunywa. Ukugqiba ngemphumelelo i-Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela). Isipiliyoni: iminyaka emihlanu yesipiliyoni esiqinisekisiwe esigabeni sabaphathi abaphakeme. Isipiliyoni esiqinisekisiwe ekuthuthukisweni kwebhizinisi, ekuhlanganiseni izinkontilaka nasekuphathweni kwabahlanganyeli. Ulwazi: Ukuqonda ngokujulile kokwesikhathi nokobunzulu imisebenzi emkhakheni wezemfundo, ukuqeqeshwa, kanye nentuthuko, ikakhulukazi ekuthuthukisweni kwebhizinisi. Ukuqonda ngokujulile umkhakha kahulumeni, izinqubomgomo ezihambisana nalo kanye nezakhiwo zomthetho ezisebenzayo (okuhlanganisa kodwa ezingagqamisi: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Ulwazi ngemihlangano yezobungcali nezidingo zenhlangano ezilawulayo (South African Qualifications Authority, Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, Council for Higher Education). Ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlaziwa nokuphathwa kwezinqubomgomo. Ukusebenziswana ngekhompyutha ngomzamo ophezulu, okuhlanganisa ukuqonda okuhle ukusebenza nge-MS Office suite kanye nesofthiwe ehambisana nokuhlaziwa kwemininingwane. Ulwazi ngokuqinisekisa imithelela yamaphrojekthi, ukusetshenziswa kokuthuthukiswa okusha kanye nokuba yintokoma. Izimiso ze-Batho Pele. Amakhono: Amakhono obuhlakaniphile obhalwayo aqinisekisiwe, ukulungiswa kwemibhalo, ukuhlela, okuhlanganisa ukubhala imibiko, izincomo kanye namarhadiwe. Amakhono wemithombo yezobuchwepheshe ukusebenza emihlolambili yezobuchwepheshe ngezinhlelo zezobuchwepheshe, ukuphathwa kanye namathuluzi okubika. Amakhono amahle okuphathwa kwezinkinga. Amakhono aphakeme ekusetshenzisweni ngekhompyutha nge-MS Office Suite. Amakhono wokuba yintokoma kanye nokucazulula. Ukukwazi: Kufanele ukwazi ukunikeza isibono, ukumisa isiqondiso seyuniti kanye nokhwaza abanye ukuba basize ekuqedeni imayelana nemfuneko yenhlangano. Cwangcisa, phatha, hlola kanye neqinisekise imisebenzi ethize ukuze ukwazi ukufeza okuhlosiwe. Hlela bese uyiphatha izabelo zemali, ulawule ukuhamba kwemali, usekele ukuphathwa kwezinsongo bese uphatha inqubo yokuthengwa izinkonzo ngokwesiko eliqinisekisiwe emalini ukuze uqinisekise ukufeza izinjongo ezibalulekile zenhlangano. Khuthaza ukukhiqizwa kokwaziswa nokuhlanganyelwa kolwazi nokufunda ukuze kuthuthukiswe olunye ulwazi lwenhlangano. Amazinga aphezulu okuziphatha ngokusesibiyeni nangokusesikweni. Izici zomuntu: Ukubamba iqhaza ezintweni ezithuthukisa izinga lezobungcali kanye nokugcina ilungele izixazululo kanye netrendi zebhizinisi. Ikono lokwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukuhlela, ukubeka izinto ngokubaluleka kwaye kuqashelwe imininingwane. Ukusebenza wedwa ngesikhathi esifanayo usiza emkhakheni weqembu. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokuqeda izixaxhi. Sakaza futhi ulondoloze ubuhlobo obusebenzayo nabaphathi, abasebenzi, abahlanganyeli kanye nomphakathi. Ukuqotho nokwethembeka. Ukuhamba kanye nokusebenza amahora angenisa kalula.
zu.duties: Bamba iqhaza ekukhiqizeni ulwazi lwesimiso sokuhweba kanye nolwazi lokuxilonga oluzoxazulula isidingo samathuba okuthuthukiswa kwemikhiqizo/ebhizinisi entsha kanye nokuqaliswa kwamaphrojekthi. Bamba iqhaza uphathe ukumakethwa nokubonakala kwemikhiqizo kanye nesevisi ye-NSG (izinhlelo zokulwela izinjongo) bese unika usizo ekuqalisweni kwemikhiqizo entsha. Sebenzisana neyuniti yebhizinisi busebenza kumakamu ohlangene ukunquma ukungenelela ko-ETD. Bamba iqhaza uphathe ukuqaliswa nokugqitywa kwe-MoUs/MoAs namaklayenti nabahlanganyeli ababekwe eceleni. Bamba iqhaza uphathe izinhlelo zokuphatha ezihlobene ne-MoUs/MoAs ezisayiniwe, kuhlanganywe neyuniti yebhizinisi langaphakathi. Hlola ukulethwa nokusebenza ko-ETD okuhambisana ne-MoUs/MoAs ezisayiniwe, kanye nesevisi yokunikeza usizo ngemva kokulethwa. Phatha izinkomfa zokuqhathanisa kanye nokuphathwa kwezimemo zamaklayenti kanye nabahlanganyeli. Akha ulondoloze ukuzithiba kwamaklayenti kanye nebhande le-NSG ngokusiza abaklayeni kanye nokuxhumana nabo. Qamba futhi ulondoloze izinhlelo eziyisisekelo ezingokweqiniso, amaphrojekthi kanye nobuhlobo okuyi intokoma yokusekela ukulethwa ko-ETD kanye nokudonsa amaklayenti amasha. Yenza ukuqinisekisa ukuzuzisa bese usungula izikholeji zebhizinisi kwezinhlelo eziyisisekelo namarhadiwe. Hlela izinhlelo zamaphrojekthi nangezinhlelo zokusebenza, okuhlanganisa izinjongo, okufanele ukukhiqizwa, izikhathi eziyisikhombisa kanye nezidingo zesibonezelo. Hlela bese uphatha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo eziyisisekelo kanye namaphrojekthi ngokusebenzisana nabahlanganyeli abangaphakathi kanye nabangaphandle. Sekele ukuthuthukiswa kwezifundo, ukuhlelwa kokuqukethwe ukufunda kanye nokuhlelwa kobuhlobo kwezinhlelo eziyisisekelo. Hlola, qinisekisa bese uthumela imibiko mayelana nokusebenza kohlelo namaphrojekthi, ubungozi, ukuqina ukugcina bengaphelelwe yisikhathi kanye nentuthuko yokuphathwayo. Qamba futhi ukhulise amathuba okusekela ukwandiswa kwesabelo esibangi (izinombolo zokwamukela ukuqeqeshwa kanye nemali etholakalayo). Misela uphathe izinkungo nobuhlobo obuhlangene namabandla amaningi obuncweba ohlangene phansi kwe-NSG. Sekele ezinye izikhungo zabalingiswa bomkhakha kahulumene ngokubandakanya ukwakheka kwamandla. Yiba ngumongameli / qapha izakhiwo zenhlangano ezibalulekile ngaphakathi ekuthuthukisweni kwebhizinisi. Bamba iqhasa emafomini abalulekile angaphandle nangaphakathi okuhlanganisa amafomu a-NSG. Bamba iqhaza ekwenziweni izindaba zokwakha amandla, okuhlanganisa ukulinganiswa kokungenelela ko-ETD, okushicilelwayo kanye nokuphathwa kwamaphepha. Bamba iqhaza, qondisa kanye uphathe izibonezelo (abantu, imali, izinhlelo, izimpahla) ezabelwe kule ndlu yomphathi omkhulu. Yenza ukulawulwa kokusebenza ngaphakathi kweyuniti yebhizinisi, okuhlanganisa ukuqinisekisa amazinga esivisi, inqubo yokusebenza, ukuphathwa kwenqubo yebhizinisi, ukuphathwa kwekhwalithi ephelele kanye noguqulo lwezobuchwepheshe. Phatha ukuhlelwa okusekelwe ezinjongweni kanye nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwendlu yomphathi omkhulu. Phatha izabelo zemili ezinikezwe iyunithi yebhizinisi. Hlola futhi uphathe izinsongo eziyizinjongo kanye nezokuphatha ezingaphakathi kweyuniti yebhizinisi, bese uhlela izinhlela zokunciphisa, okuhlanganisa izinhlelo zokuqhubeka ibhizinisi.

xh.title: Umntu ophethe ikomkhulu: Intshukumo yoshishino nezinto ezizodwa
xh.summary: Indima yoMntu ophethe ikomkhulu: Intshukumo yoshishino nezinto ezizodwa kwi-National School of Government ePretoria, inika R1,554,696 ngonyaka kwinqanaba 14.
xh.requirements: Ifundo ephakamileyo kwi-(NQF level 7) njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA kwi-Business Administration / Management okanye i-Marketing Communication / Management. Ukuqatshwa kwelungu eliqhelekileyo komzimba wabaprofeshinali kuya kuba yoncedo olongezelelweyo. Umntu osebenzela lo msebenzi uya kuxhomwa kwinkqubo yokuvavanya ukhuseleko, elo nqanaba lokugqibela liza kucwangciswa. Ukugqiba ngempumelelo iNkqubo ye-Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela). Amava: iminyaka emihlanu yamava aqinisekisiweyo kwinqanaba lolawulo oluphakamileyo. Amava aqinisekisiweyo ekuthuthuzeni intshukumo yoshishino, kuthethiselwana ngeenkontrakti nakulawulwana nabathathi nxaxheba. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olujulileyo ngokwezinci nemisebenzi malunga nokuphila kwendalo yemfundo, uqeqesho, nentshukumo, ngokukodwa ekuthuthuzeni intshukumo yoshishino. Ukuqonda okujulileyo ngolwimi lwikomkhulu, iinkqubomgama ezifanelekileyo nezikhokelo zemithetho ezisebenzayo (kuquka kodwa ezingagqityeki kwi: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Ulwazi ngabaprofeshinali neemfuno zabalawuli (South African Qualifications Authority, Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, Council for Higher Education) Ukuphuhlisa, ukuhlalutya nokusebenzisa iinkqubomgama. Ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha ngobuchule obuphakamileyo, kuquka ulwazi olululo lokusebenza nge-MS Office suite nesoftwe efanelekileyo yokuhlalutya iingcombolo. Ulwazi ngokulinganisa imiphumo yamaphrojekhi, ukusebenzisa izinto ezitsha ezikhoyo nokuqamba izinto ezitsha. Iimigaqo yeBatho Pele. Amakhono: Amakhono obhalo aqinisekisiweyo aphakamileyo, ukuqwalasela amagama, ukuhlela, kuquza nokubala iingxelo, izithuba eenqwili namaphepha. Amakhono edijithali okusebenza kwindalo yedijithali ngeenkqubo zedijithali, izixhobo zolawulo nokubika. Amakhono amablitye ekulawula iingxwabu. Amakhono obuchule obuphakamileyo bekhompyutha kwi-MS Office Suite. Amakhono okuyila nokuhlalutya. Ikhono lokusebenza: Makakwazi ukubonelela ngembono, ucwangcise isalathiso senkcumama aze akhuthaze abanye ukuba bazalise umthetho wequmrhu. Ukuqamba, ukulawula, ukujonga nokuvavanya imisebenzi ethile ukuya kulinikeza iziphumo ezifunwayo. Ukuqamba nokulawula iimali-mboleko, ukulawla ukuthungatha kwezimali, ukumisela ukulawula ingozi nokulawula iinkqubo zokuthenga ngokuvunywa kwezinto ngokwezimasiko eziqhelekileyo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufezekiswa kwemigiqo yequmrhu. Ukukhuthaza ukwenziwa nokwabiwa kolwazi nokufunda ukuze kwandiswe ulwazi oludityanisiweyo lwequmrhu. Izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha ngokusesikweni nangokomahlulo. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumasebe okuphuhlisa iinkqubo zobuchule kwaye uhlale usazi ngeendlela ezitsha zoshishino nemvela. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi emininzi ngasinye, ukuqamba, ukubeka izinto ezibalulekileyo kuqala nokunaka iinkcukacha. Ukusebenza kodwa ngelixa ungenisa isandla kwikomkhulu elusebenzisanayo. Amakhono okuxazulula iingxaki noxolelwano. Uyila kwaye ulondoloze ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nabaphathi, abasebenzi, abathathi-nxaxheba noluntu. Intobeko nokuzithoba. Ukuhamba nokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelekileyo.
xh.duties: Kuba ngowokuqala ekwenzeni ulwazi ngemmarike nolwazi lokuxilonga oluya kwazisa ukufunwa kwezinto ezitsha/ amathuba okuthuthuza intshukumo yoshishino nokuqalisa amanyathelo. Yiba ngowokuqala ulawule ukuthengisa nokubonakala kwezinto ezenziweyo ze-NSG neenkonzo (iinkqubo zokuxhasa) kwaye unike inkxaso ekuzameni izinto ezitsha. Usebenzisane namacandelo ashishino kwaye usebenze kumaphupha asekwe ngokudityanisiweyo ukuze aqonde iintshukumo ze-ETD. Yiba ngowokuqala ulawule uqalisio nokugqiba kwe-MoUs/MoAs nabaxhasi nabaqeshi abachaziweyo. Yiba ngowokuqala ulawule iinkqubo zokuqaliswa ezinxulumene ne-MoUs/ MoAs esayinwe, ungene elundweni namacandelo angaphakathi. Qwalasela ukunikwa kwe-ETD nentsebenzo ngokuchasene ne-MoUs/ MoAs esayinwe, nakinkxaso emva kokunikwa. Lawula iinkqubo zokuqwalasela okusebenzisanayo nezibingelelo zabo nabo abaxhasi nabaqeshi. Yakha ulondoloze inkxaso yabaxhasi nophawu lwe-NSG ngokunika inkxaso nabaxhasi. Phawula nokukhusela iinkqubo ezizodwa, amaphrojekhi nodibano olusebenzisanayo ngenjongo yokuxhasa ukunikwa kwe-ETD nokutsala abaxhasi abatsha. Yenza iingqwalasela zokwazi ukuba ziyakwazi na nokuyila iingxelo ezizodwa zoshishino ngeenjongo ezizodwa zamaphrojekhi. Qamba iinkqubo zamaphrojekhi, kuquka iinjongo, izinto ezinikwayo, iindawo eziphawulekayo neemfuno zabakhi. Lungelanisa ulawule uqaliswa kweenkqubo namaphrojekhi ezizodwa usebenzisana nabathathi nxaxheba bangaphakathi nabangaphandle. Xhasa ukuphuhliswa kwekharityhulam, uyilo lweziqulatho zokufunda ngenjongo yokubakha iinkqubo ezizodwa. Qwalasela, vavanya ize ubike ngentsebenzo yeenkqubo namaphrojekhi, iingozi, ukuzinza nentuthuko kokuqaliswa. Phawula nokhuthaze amathuba okuxhasa ukwandiswa kwesabelo kwimmarike (amanani okuthathwa kokolunyuso kwamava negalelo lemali). Misela ulawule imithambo nobudlelwane nabalawuli abaninzi obuzele iinkqhasho ze-NSG. Xhasa ezinye iikhomkhulu zoluntu ngokudibana nabo ekwakheni amandla. Yiba nomongameli/ ulawule iinkqubo zolawulo lwendalo yeshishino ezingaphakathi ezifanelekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kumaphupha aqondo ebungaphandle nangaphakathi kuquza namaphuphu ohola i-NSG. Thattha inxaxheba kumathuba okwakha amandla, kuquza nokukhokeza iintshukumo ze-ETD, okushicilelwe nokubhala iiphepha. Yiba ngowokuqala, ukhokeze ulawule izixhobo (abantu, iimali, iinkqubo, izinto) ezabelwe kummandla womongameli ophakamileyo. Zisa inkqubo yolawulo lomsebenzi kwindalo yeshishino, kuquza ukumisela iindinganiso zenkonzo, iinkqubo zokusebenza eziqhelekileyo, ulawulo lwenkqubo yeshishino, ulawulo lwehlabathi jikelele kwaye, uluguqulo olwenziwe ngedijithali. Lawula uqeqesho lwezinyathelo zomgangatho ophezulu nentsebenzo yolawulo. Lawula imali-mboleko enikezelwe kwicala leshishino. Phawula ulawule iingozi ezibetha ithonye nakwindalo yoshishino, nakwindlela yokuzivalela iingozi, kuquza iinkqubo zokuqhubeka koshishino.

jobs.title: Director: Cadet and Youth Development
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum Level 13, (all-inclusive remuneration package)
jobs.summary: Director of Cadet and Youth Development at the National School of Government in Pretoria, requiring a bachelor's degree and five years' relevant experience.
jobs.requirements: A minimum bachelor’s degree or equivalent (NQF level 7) in Management Studies, Human and Social Studies, Education, Training Development or related field. Registration with a relevant professional body will also be an added advantage. The successful applicant will be subjected to security vetting at an appropriate clearance level for senior managers. Experience: Five (5) years of proven relevant experience at a middle/senior managerial level in the areas of ETD interventions and youth capacity development. Knowledge: In- depth theoretical and practical knowledge of the education, training, and development environment, in particular business development. In-depth understanding of the public sector, relevant policies and applicable legislative frameworks (including but not limited to: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Knowledge of professional bodies and regulatory body requirements (South African Qualifications Authority, Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, Council for Higher Education), Policy development, analysis and implementation. Advanced computer literacy, including excellent working knowledge of MS Office suite and relevant software for data analysis. Knowledge on assessing the effects of projects, applying new developments and innovation. Batho Pele principles. Skills: Advanced proficiency in communication, facilitation and presentations. Planning, organising, project management, financial management. Emotional intelligence and interpersonal relations. Research methodologies to analyse data and information (qualitative and quantitative). Computer literacy. Competencies Must be able to provide a vision, set the direction for the organisation and inspire others to deliver on the organisational mandate. Must be able to plan, manage, monitor and evaluate specific activities to deliver the desired outputs. Compile and manage budgets, control cash flow, institute risk management and administer tender procurement processes in accordance with generally recognised financial practices to ensure the achievement of strategic organisational objectives. Initiate and support organisational transformation and change to successfully implement new initiatives and deliver on service delivery commitments. Promote the generation and sharing of knowledge and learning to enhance the collective knowledge of the organisation. Explore and implement new ways of delivering services that contribute to the improvement of organisational processes to achieve organisational goals. People management skills. Ability to put people first in delivery of services (Batho Pele). High standards of integrity and ethics. Personal Attributes: Participate in professional development growth activities to maintain professional knowledge and keep up to date with business solutions trends. Ability to multi-task, organize and prioritize. Work independently while contributing to a team environment. Problem solving and conflict resolution skills. Good interpersonal skills and ability to work cordially with management, employees, stakeholders and the public. Willingness to travel and work extended hours, when required.
jobs.duties: Analyse strategic and policy documents, statutory reports and other mechanisms to identify capacity development and delivery modalities. Undertake research of local and international best practices to identify cutting edge capacity development interventions. Identify appropriate strategies and learning areas to meet capacity development needs. Manage the provision of high-quality capacity development through formal courses, programmes, workshops and seminars, just-in-time interventions, and follow-up institutional support. Lead and oversee the pilot and iteration of organisational learning strategies that contribute to service impact. Inform project plans, budget plans and concept notes to guide learning strategies. Support in curriculum formulation and content, including the identification of platforms and partners as well as critical reading and analysis. Serve on project teams for new curriculum development. Support the development and/or enhancement of facilitator, moderator and assessor competence profiles based on capacity development content and delivery requirements. Determine requirements and capabilities towards the appointment and/or contracting of panel of experts, partners and HEIs. Support the management and the review and update of curriculum content, including customisation of content. Oversee the orientation of capacity development offerings. Provide effective and efficient programme and project monitoring and management. Support the recruitment and/or contracting of panel of experts, partners and HEIs pertinent to the capacity development intervention. Provide collaborative review, regular quality assurance, and feedback sessions with internal and external stakeholders. Support the adherence to accreditation requirements, support assessment and certification, including timely issuing of certificates. Determine and provide post-delivery support to individuals and institutions, as well as case file management and data management. Assess the monitoring and evaluation reports, post-programme delivery, for quality management and improvements. Establish and manage public and private sector networks and multi-sector relationships relevant to the subject matter area located within the bands. Manage cross-functional projects to advance capacity development support initiatives. Participate in capacity development interventions, including facilitation of offerings. Manage the resources (people, finance, systems, assets) allocated within the directorate. Implement operations management within the directorate, including determination of service standards, standard operating procedures, business process management, total quality management and digital transformation. Develop appropriate strategies and plans for achieving performance targets and directorate requirements, including quarterly performance reporting. Identify and manage strategic and operational risks within the directorate and mitigation plans, including business continuity plans. Manage a team of employees expected to accomplish assigned duties efficiently, effectively, and competently and strive for improvement and excellence in all work.
jobs.enquiries: Mpho Mugodo Tel No: (012) 441 6017
jobs.applications: APPLY USING THIS LINK: APPLICATION FOR EMPLOYMENT DIRECTOR: CADET AND YOUTH DEVELOPMENT NSG, 14/2026. – Fill out form OTHER POSTS
jobs.notes: Applications must consist of: A fully completed and signed new Z83 form with a comprehensive CV containing contactable references. Use of the old Z83 Form will result in disqualification. Candidates should not attach certified documents to the application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview. The relevant reference number must be written on the application form. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. All appointments are subject to personnel suitability checks such as security vetting, citizen verification, financial records check, and qualifications verifications. Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements as well as applications that are received late, will not be considered. The selection process of the SMS post will be in line with the Senior Management Service requirements. The successful candidate will be expected to sign a performance agreement within three months from the date of assumption of duties and where applicable to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests within a month. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its employment equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender, and disability) through the filling of this post. The NSG reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) is required for appointment to the SMS posts. Enrolment for the course should be          made          on         the          NSG’s           website       at https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry-programme. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Kadet- en Jeugontwikkeling
af.summary: Direkteur van Kadet- en Jeugontwikkeling by die National School of Government in Pretoria, wat 'n baccalaureusgraad en vyf jaar se relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: 'n Minimum baccalaureusgraad of ekwivalent (NQF vlak 7) in Bestuurstudies, Menslike en Sosiale Studies, Onderwys, Opleidingsontwikkeling of 'n verwante veld. Registrasie by 'n relevante professionele liggaam sal ook 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Die suksesvolle aansoeker sal aan veiligheidsondersoek op 'n toepaslike vrystellingsvlak vir senior bestuurders onderwerp word. Ervaring: Vyf (5) jaar se bewese relevante ervaring op 'n middel-/seniorbestuursvlak in die areas van ETD-intervensies en jeugkapasiteitsontwikkeling. Kennis: In-diepte teoretiese en praktiese kennis van die onderwys-, opleidings- en ontwikkelingsomgewing, in besonder besigheidsontwikkeling. In-diepte begrip van die openbare sektor, relevante beleid en toepaslike wetgewende raamwerke (insluitend maar nie beperk tot: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Kennis van professionele liggame en regulatoriese liggaamvereistes (South African Qualifications Authority, Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, Council for Higher Education), Beleidsontwikkeling, -analise en -implementering. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend uitstekende werkskennis van die MS Office-suite en relevante sagteware vir data-analise. Kennis van die assessering van die effekte van projekte, die toepassing van nuwe ontwikkelings en innovasie. Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardighede: Gevorderde vaardigheid in kommunikasie, fasilitering en aanbiedings. Beplanning, organisering, projeksbestuur, finansiële bestuur. Emosionele intelligensie en interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Navorsingsmetodologieë om data en inligting te analiseer (kwalitatief en kwantitatief). Rekenaarvaardigheid. Bevoegdhede: Moet in staat wees om 'n visie te verskaf, die rigting vir die organisasie vas te stel en ander te inspireer om die organisatoriese mandaat uit te voer. Moet in staat wees om spesifieke aktiwiteite te beplan, bestuur, monitor en evalueer om die gewenste uitsette te lewer. Begrotings opstel en bestuur, kontantvloei beheer, risikobestuur instel en tenderverkrygingsprosesse administreer in ooreenstemming met algemeen erkende finansiële praktyke om die bereiking van strategiese organisatoriese doelwitte te verseker. Organisatoriese transformasie en verandering inisieer en ondersteun om nuwe inisiatiewe suksesvol te implementeer en diensleweringverpligtinge na te kom. Bevorder die generering en deling van kennis en leer om die kollektiewe kennis van die organisasie te verbeter. Ontdek en implementeer nuwe maniere van dienslewering wat bydra tot die verbetering van organisatoriese prosesse om organisatoriese doelwitte te bereik. Mensebestuursvaardighede. Vermoë om mense eerste te plaas in die levering van dienste (Batho Pele). Hoë standaarde van integriteit en etiek. Persoonlike eienskappe: Deelneem aan aktiwiteite vir professionele ontwikkelingsgroei om professionele kennis te handhaaf en op hoogte te bly van neigings in besigheidsoplossings. Vermoë om veelvuldige take uit te voer, te organiseer en te prioriteer. Onafhanklik werk terwyl bygedra word tot 'n spanomgewing. Probleemoplossing- en konflikhanteringsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede en vermoë om hartelik met bestuur, werknemers, belanghebbendes en die publiek saam te werk. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en lang ure te werk wanneer nodig.
af.duties: Analiseer strategiese en beleidsdokumente, statutêre verslae en ander meganismes om kapasiteitsontwikkelings- en leweringsmodaliteite te identifiseer. Ondersoek plaaslike en internasionale beste praktyke om vooruitstrewende kapasiteitsontwikkelingsintervensies te identifiseer. Identifiseer toepaslike strategieë en leergebiede om aan kapasiteitsontwikkelingsbehoeftes te voldoen. Bestuur die verskaffing van hoë gehalte kapasiteitsontwikkeling deur formele kursusse, programme, werkswinkels en seminare, net-tyd-intervensies, en opvolg instellingsteun. Lei en oorsien die proef en iterasie van organisatoriese leerstrategieë wat bydra tot diensimpak. Voorlig projekplanne, begrotingsplanne en konsepnotas om leerstrategieë te rig. Ondersteun kurrikulumformulering en -inhoud, insluitend die identifisering van platforms en vennote sowel as kritiese lees en analise. Dien op projekspanne vir nuwe kurrikulumontwikkeling. Ondersteun die ontwikkeling en/of verbetering van fasiliteerder, moderator en assessor bevoegdheidsprofiele gebaseer op kapasiteitsontwikkelingsinhoud en leweringsvereistes. Bepaal vereistes en vermoëns ten opsigte van die aanstelling en/of kontraktering van paneel van kundiges, vennote en HEIs. Ondersteun die bestuur en die hersiening en opdatering van kurrikuluminhoud, insluitend die aanpassing van inhoud. Oorsien die oriëntasie van kapasiteitsontwikkelingsaanbiedinge. Verskaf doeltreffende en doeltroue program- en projekmonitering en -bestuur. Ondersteun die werwing en/of kontraktering van paneel van kundiges, vennote en HEIs ter sake by die kapasiteitsontwikkelingsintervensie. Verskaf samewerkende hersiening, gereelde gehalteversekering, en terugvoersessies met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes. Ondersteun die nakoming van akkreditasievereistes, ondersteun assessering en sertifisering, insluitend die tydige uitreik van sertifikate. Bepaal en verskaf na-leweringsteun aan individue en instellings, sowel as saaklielêerbestuur en databestuur. Assesseer die moniterings- en evaluasieverslae, na-programlewering, vir gehaltebestuur en verbeterings. Stel openbare en privaatsektornetwerke en multisektordieverhoudings relevant tot die vakgebied wat binne die bande geleë is, in en bestuur dit. Bestuur kruisfunksionele projekte om kapasiteitsontwikkelingsondersteuningsinisiatiewe te bevorder. Neem deel aan kapasiteitsontwikkelingsintervensies, insluitend fasilitering van aanbiedinge. Bestuur die hulpbronne (mense, finansies, stelsels, bates) wat binne die direktoraat toegeken is. Implementeer bedryfsbestuur binne die direktoraat, insluitend die bepaling van diensstandaarde, standaard bedryfsprosedures, besigheidsprosesbestuur, totale gehaltebestuur en digitale transformasie. Ontwikkel toepaslike strategieë en planne vir die bereiking van prestasiedoelwitte en direktoraatsvereistes, insluitend kwartaallikse prestasieverslagdoening. Identifiseer en bestuur strategiese en operasionele risiko's binne die direktoraat en mitigasieplanne, insluitend besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne. Bestuur 'n span werknemers wat verwag word om toegewysde pligte doeltreffend, doeltrou en bevoeg uit te voer en te strewe na verbetering en uitmuntendheid in alle werk.

zu.title: Umngqongqoshe: Inkokhelo Yabasha Nokuqeqeshwa Kwabasha
zu.summary: Umngqongqoshe Wokukhuluza Nokuqeqeshwa Kwabasha e-National School of Government e-Pretoria, ofuna idiploma yesibili degree kanye neminyaka emihlanu yohlu oluhlobene lolwazi.
zu.requirements: Ubuncane bediploma yesibili degree noma okulingana nayo (NQF level 7) kwi-Management Studies, Human and Social Studies, Education, Training Development noma enkundleni ebandakanyelayo. Ukubhalisa emthethweni ohlobene nemisimilo yomuntu siqu kuzobe kunesibonezelo esengeziwe. Umfundi ophumelelayo uzohlolwa ngokuvikela ekuphenyweni kwezokuphepha ezingeni elifanele abaphathi abakhulu. Isipiliyoni: Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yesipiliyoni esiqinisekisiwe esihlobene ezingeni labaphathi abaphakathi noma abakhulu kumikhakha yemizamo ye-ETD nentuthuko yamandla abasha. Ulwazi: Ulwazi olujulile lokuthiyori nolokwenzayo ngendawo yemfundo, ukuqeqeshwa, nentuthuko, ikakhulukazi entuthukweni yamabhizinisi. Ukuqonda okujulile komkhakha kahulumeni, izinqubomgomo ezihlobene kanye nezakhiwo zomthetho ezisebenzayo (okuquketha kodwa okungagxiliswa kuma: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Ulwazi ngemibhalo yemisimilo nemfuno yomthetho wokubhalisa (South African Qualifications Authority, Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, Council for Higher Education), Ukuthuthukiswa, ukuhlaziywa kanye nokuphatha izinqubomgomo. Ukusebenzisana kwamakhompyutha ngobuchophi obuthuthukile, okuhlanganisa ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza i-MS Office suite kanye nosofthiwe efanayo ukuze kuqondwe imininingo. Ulwazi ngokuhlola imithelela yamaphrojekthi, ukusebenzisa izinto ezintsha ezithuthukile nezenzele. Izimiso zika-Batho Pele. Amakhono: Ukusebenzisana okuthuthukile kwabalaleli, ekwelulekeni nasekuboniseni. Ukuhlela, ukuhlela, ukuphatha amaphrojekthi, ukuphatha izimali. Ukuzwa ngokwengqondo nobuhlobo bomuntu nobunye. Izindlela zocwaningo ukuze kuhlaziywe imininingo nolwazi (ngokobungako nangokobunjalo). Ukusebenzisana kwamakhompyutha. Ikhono Lokuthatha Izigaba Kuhluzwe ikhono lokunika isibonakaliso, ukumisa inqondo eqhuba inhlangano kanye nokugqugquzela abanye ukuthi bafeze umthetho wenhlangano. Kuhluzwe ikhono lokuhlela, ukuphatha, ukuqapha kanye nokuhlola imisebenzi ethize ukuze kuqondwe okuhlose ukufeziwa. Ukuqamba kanye nokuphatha amabhajethi, ukulawula ukugeleza kwemali, ukumisa ukuphatha ubungozi nokuphatha inqubo yokuthenga izinkontileka ngokuvumelana nezinqubo zezimali ezaziwa njalo ukuze kuqiniseke ukufeza izinjongo zenhlangano ezibalulekile. Ukuqala kanye nokusekela ukuguqulwa kwenhlangano nokushintsha ukuze kwezwe izinhlobonhlobo ezintsha ngokuphumelelayo kanye nokufeza izithembiso ekuhanisweni. Ukukhuthaza ukukhiqizwa kokwazi nokuwabelana ukuze kwandise ulwazi olwaziwayo kuzo zonke izinhlangano. Ukuhlola futhi ukusebenzisa izindlela ezintsha zokuletha izinsiza ezingezisa ukuthuthukiswa kwezinhlaka zenhlangano ukuze kufeze izinjongo zayo. Amandla okuphatha abantu. Ikhono lokubeka abantu phambili ekunikeni izinsiza (Batho Pele). Azinga eliphakeme lokuziphatha ngokuzenzela. Izici Zomuntu: Ukubambe iqhaza kumasebe okuthuthukiswa komuntu siqu ukuze agcine ulwazi lwakhe ohlelweni lwemisimilo futhi athi kube nguqoqo lwamathrendi ezixazululi zebhizinisi. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi eminingi ngasikhathi sinye, ukuhlela futhi uhle isibalo. Ukusebenza eyedwa ngenkathi esekela indawo yeqembu. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga nokuqeda izinkinga. Amakhono ohlelo nobuhlobo kanye nethemba lokusebenza ngobuhle kumphathi, abasebenzi, iziphoqi ezihlobene kanye nomphakathi. Ukuthanda ukuhamba nokusebenza amahora amaningi uma kudingeka.
zu.duties: Hlola amadokhumenti ezinzuzo nalezomthetho, izibiko esemthethweni kanye nezinye izindlela ukuze kutholwe imizamo yentuthuko yamandla kanye nendlela zokuletha izinsiza. Yenza ucwaningo lwamasu ohlelo kanye namazwe omhlaba ahlukanile ukuze kutholwe izindlela ezingaguqulwa ezintsha zokukhuluza nokuthuthukisa amandla. Khomba izindlela ezifanele nezindawo zokufunda ezingezisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla ohlelo. Phatha ukuletha ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla okuningiliziwe kumakhosi, amaphrografu, amasebhulo kanye nemicimbi yezimboni, imizamo esikhathini, kanye nokuweseka izikhungo okulandelayo. Holisa futhi ulawule ukuqalisa nokushintsha izindlela zokufunda zenhlangano ezingesiza ekubeni nomthelela. Yezela amaphrojekthi ohlelo, amabhajethi ohlelo kanye nokunamathela izinombolo ukuze ohlele izindlela zokufunda. Sekela ukubhalwa kwezifundo kanye nokuqukethwa kwezinye izinto, okuhlanganisa nokubalwa kwamasu abafundi kanye nabalingisi ekufundeni ekuqondile nasekuhlaziyeni. Yiba yilungu lemithimba yamaphrojekthi wokuthuthukiswa kwezifundo ezintsha. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa nokuthuthukisa ikhono labahola, abalawuli kanye nalabo abakhipha iziqu bese bekela imibhalo ekuqondene nokuqukethwa kokuthuthukiswa kwamandla kanye nezidingo zokuhanisa. Hlola izidingo kanye namandla okubeka futhi usayine ngokomthetho iqhulu labanjineli, abalingani kanye ne-HEI. Sekela ukuphatha nokubuyekezwa kokuqukethwa kwezifundo, okuhlanganisa nokwenza okuqukethwe ngendlela ofisayo. Lawula ukuqondiswa kokuthuthukiswa kwamandla. Yezela ukulawula nokuqapha amaphrografu namaphrojekthi ngokusebenza kahle. Sekela ukubhalwa futhi usayine ngokomthetho iqhulu labanjineli, abalingani kanye ne-HEI ekuqondene nokukhuluza ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla. Yezela ukubuyekeza ngokusebenza kwamanye, ukuqinisekisa ukungcola njalo ngamasha, kanye nezigaba zeziniso nabalingani bangaphakathi nangaphandle. Sekela ukuzethemba kwezimiso zokuqinisekiswa, sekela ukuhlola kanye nokukhishwa kweziqu, okuhlanganisa nokukhishwa kwemibhalo yesiqu ngokushelelayo. Hlola futhi unikeze weseko emuva kokuhanisa kubantu nasezinkompanini kanye nokuphatha amafayela kanye nokuphatha imininingo. Hlola izibiko zokuqapha nokuqhathanisa emuva kokuletha amaphrografu ukuze kwenziwe ukuphatha ubuhle kwezinto kanye nokuthuthukiswa. Misa futhi ulawule uxhumo lwamakhulu nomkhakaba yangasese kanye nabalingani bemikhakha eminingi okhombene nendaba ekumakhelo lale minikhakha. Phatha amaphrojekthi asemikhakheni eminingi ukuze kuthuthukiswe imizamo yokweseka ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla. Yiba yilungu kumazamo ukuthuthukiswa kwamandla, okuhlanganisa nokweluleka izinto ezilethwayo. Phatha izinsiza (abantu, imali, amasistimu, izimpahla) ezingeniswe kwisebe. Yenza imizamo yokuphatha izisebenzi kwisebe, okuhlanganisa ukuqondwa kwezinga lezinsiza, izinqubo zokusebenza ngokwezinto ezingagcina ihleli, ukuphatha inqubo yamabhizinisi, ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa ngokuphelele kanye nokuguqulwa kokudluliswa kolwazi. Yenza izindlela ezifanele zohlelo kanye nezinhlelo ezimisa ukufeza amanqamu wemikhiqizo yisebe kanye nezidingo, okuhlanganisa nezibiko zemikhiqizo ngamunyaka. Khomba futhi ulawule ubungozi bokuzela nokusebenza kwisebe kanye nezinhlelo zokuqeda ubungozi, okuhlanganisa nohlelo lohlelo lokuhamba kahle. Lawula iqembu labasebenzi abatelwa ukufeza imisebenzi ebokeziwe ngokusebenza kahle, ngokuphumelelayo, futhi abazime ngokuzenzela futhi bafele isithukuthu nokuqhubeka ekuphumeleleni emsebenzini wonke.

xh.title: Umyili: Izicwangqiso zeentsomi nentsomi
xh.summary: Ngumyili wezinto ezintsha kwindawo yokuzilolonga kwentshaba enkulu yasePretoria, afuna isidanga se-bachelor kunye neminyaka emihlanu yamava.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-bachelor okanye okulinganayo (NQF level 7) kumaziko eNtlalontle, eZemfundo nasekuBhaliseni, eMfundo, kuQeqesho kuNtsalwa okanye kwindalo ekufutshane. Ukubhalisa kwisibhedlele esiyingozi kuya kuba luncedo. Umfundi ophumeleleyo uya kuxelwa ngokupheleleyo kwisikolo esingavunyelwanga. Amava: Iminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava aqinisekisiweyo kwilvela eliphakathi okanye eliphakamileyo kwimisebenzi yokulungiselela iinkqubo ze-ETD nentsalwa. Ulwazi: Ulwazi oluthe ngqo nolusebenzayo lwendawo yemfundo, uqeqesho, kunye nentsalwa, ikakhulu kwishishini lokuphucula amandla okusebenza. Ukuqonda okuthe ngqo kwindalo yabantu abasebenzayo, iindlela ezikwisikolo nolawulo lweempawu ezisebenzayo (kuquka nangaphandle kwezilandelayo: iSikhokelo samaSebe; iSikhokelo soLawulo lweNtengiso; iSikhokelo soLawulo lweSebe). Ulwazi ngemibutho yolwazi yamagunya (iSAQA, iQCTO, iCHE), kuphuhliso, uhlalutyo lweempawu nokuzonkezelwa. Ulwazi oluthe ngqo lweekhompyutha, kuquka ulwazi olusebenzayo olubalulekileyo lwe-MS Office namahlelo okuhlaziya idatha. Ulwazi lokulinganisa iimpembelelo zeprojekthi, ukusebenzisa izinto ezintsha nobuchule obutsha. Iindibaniselwano zeBatho Pele. Amandla: Ukuphumeza kakuhle ukuxhumana, ukwenza imisebenzi nokuyibeka ngendlela. Ukuqamba, ukuqamba, ukuqamba iindlela ezintsha. Isipho sokuziva okanye ukuziva ngokomoya. Uhlalutyo lokuhlaziya idatha nolwazi (ngokobungakanani nobungakanani). Ulwazi lweekhompyutha. Iimpawu zokusebenza: Makakwazi ukunika isimboniso, ukumisa iindlela kumaziko ukubakhuthaza ukuba bagqibe kwimisebenzi yamaziko. Makakwazi ukuqamba, ukulawula, ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela iindaba ezithile ukuyigqiba ngokwemfuno. Qamba ulawulo lwamabajeti, lawula imali eya evela, misela ulawulo lwengozi lawula iindlela zokuthenga ngokwemigaqo ebuziwa ukuze kugqitywe iindlela zentsoro. Qalisa uxhase ukutshintsha kwentsoro nezinto ezintsha ukwenza inkqubo entsha yokuphumeza iindlela ezinomthelela kwishishini. Xhasa ukwenza ulwazi lokuhamba phambili ukuze kubonakale ukukhula kwentsoro. Phanda ukuyisebenzisa iindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto ukuphucula iindlela zentsoro. Amandla okulawula abantu. Amandla okubeka abantu phambili ekwenzeni izinto (iBatho Pele). Imigangatho ephezulu yobuzwe nobugqisa. Izinto zobuqu: Ziba kumathuba amakhulu okuphucula amandla ukugcina ulwazi lwabasebenzi nokulandela iindlela ezintsha zoshishino. Amandla okwenza izinto ezininzi, ukuziqamba ukubeka phambili. Ukusebenza kodwa ngokwenza umsebenzi oqhubekayo. Amandla okusombulula iingxaki. Amandla ezinto ezimnandi zokwenza izinto.
xh.duties: Hlaziya amaxwebhu ezicwangqiso nezenqongozo, iiripoti ezisemthethweni nezinye iindlela ukubacha iindlela zokuthuthuzela amandla okusebenza nokuphumeza. Qhuba uphando malunga namava amabalulekileyo kwasekhaya nakwelamazwe ukubacha iindlela ezitsha zokuthuthuzela amandla okusebenza. Batsha iindlela ezifanelekileyo nendawo yokufunda ukuze zihlangabezane neemfuno zokuthuthuzela amandla okusebenza. Phatha ukubonelela ngenkqubo yamandla okusebenza ephezulu ngokwesiphithiphithi ngezakhiwo ezikwisikolo, iinkqubo, iindaba zomsebenzi ngeenqwelo, iindlela ezithe ngqo, kunye nenkxaso yaso nayimaphi na emva kokuba kwenziwe. Mba qonde ulawulo lokuba yinto yokuvumisa nokuphinda kwenziwe iindlela zokufunda eziguquguqukayo ezinomthelela ekubeni kukho impembelelo ezinkonzeni. Zeza iindlela zeprojekthi, iindlela zamabajeti namaxwebhu okuqonda ukuyisa iindlela zokufunda. Nxiba inkxaso ekwakweni nasekubeni kubekho isiqulatho secirha, kuquka ukubacha iindawo zeenkqubo namaxhoba kunye nokufunda nokuhlaziya okubalulekileyo. Ziba kumaqela eprojekthi kwizicwangqiso ezintsha zecirha. Xhasa ukuphuhliswa okanye ukuphucula amaphawu abo bakho abakhokelayo, abalawuli abaphakathi kwindalo yamandla okusebenza nokuze kubekho iimfuno ezinako ukuphumeza. Misela iimfuno namandla okwenza ngolu hlobo alungiselele ukumiswa okanye ukusayina abantu abagqithisileyo, abaxhasa nemaziko ezeemfundo eziphakamileyo. Xhasa ukulawula, ukuhlola ukuze kubhetele kunye nokuhlaziya isiqulatho secirha, kuquka ukwenza isiqulatho sidibane neemfuno zabathathi nxaxheba. Lawula imboniseliso yamandla okusebenza. Bonelela ngokulawula ukuqwalaselwa kweprojekthi nokuqwalaselwa ngenkqubo eya kusebenza kakuhle. Xhasa ukumiswa okanye ukusayina abantu abagqithisileyo, abaxhasa nemaziko ezeemfundo eziphakamileyo ezithintekayo kwinkqubo yamandla okusebenza. Bonelela ngokuqwalaselwa ngokubambisana, ukuqinisekiswa kwakhona ukwaneliseka rhoqo, neziganeko zokupha uluvo kubantu bangaphakathi nabangaphandle. Xhasa ukuthobela iimfuno zokwamkelwa, xhasa ulinganolwazi lokuvakaliswa kweekhathifikheth, kuquka nokunika iikhathifikheth ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Misela kwaye ubonelele ngenkxaso emva kokuphumeza inkqubo kubantu nakumaziko, kunye nokulawula iifayile zeendaba nolawulo lwedatha. Hlaziya iiripoti zokuqwalaselwa nokuqwalaselwa kwakhona okusetyenziswa emva kokuphumeza inkqubo ukulawula ukwaneliseka nokuyiphucula. Misela ulawule uqhagamshelwano kumacandwo kaqhakamshelwano apha kulawulo lwentengiso kunye namakhon' ethu. Lawula iiprojekthi ezingqubanayo zeentsimi ezahlukileyo ukuyisa phambili iindlela zokuphucula inkxaso yamandla okusebenza. Ziba kumanqanaba okuthuthuzela amandla okusebenza, kuquka nokuqhuba iinkonzo ezibonelelwayo. Lawula imithombo yolwazi (abantu, imali, iinkqubo, izinto) eceliweyo kwikhomkhulu lendlu. Phumeza ulawulo lweenkqubo kwikhomkhulu lendlu, kuquka ukumisela iinqobo zeenkonzo, iinkqubo ezisebenzayo, ulawulo lwenkqubo yeshishini, ulawulo olupheleleyo lolwazi lwekhwalithi nokutshintsha kwezentlalo-ntlalo. Yila iindlela ezifanelekileyo neengcaphephepho zokufikelela kumgangatho wokuphumeza iimfuno zekhomkhulu, kuquka nokubika ngokwenza iindaba ngokwexesha lobuzila. Batsha ulawule iingozi ezikumgangatho ophezulu nezisebenzayo kwikhomkhulu lendlu, kuquka neendawo ezizama ukuthintela iingozi, kuquka iindawo ezingenelelo luluntu. Lawula iqela labasebenzi abalindelwe ukuba baqede umsebenzi onikiweyo ngokukhawuleza, ngokusebenza kakuhle ngokupheleleyo ngokomsebenzi, ukuba bafuna ukuphucula ukugqiba komsebenzi.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Learner Records
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), an inclusive remuneration package
jobs.summary: The National School of Government seeks a Deputy Director to manage learner records quality assurance, verify course data on the MyNSG platform, and enforce assessment controls.
jobs.requirements: A Bachelor’s Degree on NQF level 7 in Public Administration, or related field. Registration with a relevant professional body will also be an added advantage. Experience: A minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience, including at least three (3) years at the Assistant Director or equivalent level in learner records or supporting ETD practices. The job holder will be subjected to a security vetting process, the clearance level of which will be determined. Knowledge of the Skills: Development landscape in South Africa. Thorough understanding of the public sector, relevant policies and applicable legislative frameworks (including but not limited to: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Policy development, analysis and implementation. Advanced computer literacy, including excellent working knowledge of MS Office suite and relevant software for data analysis. Knowledge on assessing the effects of projects, applying new developments and innovation. Skills: Strong interpersonal skills. Problem-solving skills. Research and analysis techniques. Proficiency in communication and presentation skills. Excellent project, time, and people management skills. Proposal and report writing skills. Excellent organising and planning skills, computer literacy in Microsoft Office Suite, and digital skills. Personal Attributes: Participate in professional development growth activities for Participate in professional development growth activities for maintaining professional knowledge and staying current with research practices and trends. Ability to multi-task and organize, prioritize, and follow multiple projects and tasks through to completion with an attention to detail. Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment. Commitment to quality and continuous learning. Professional behaviour and sound judgement. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with management, employees, stakeholders, and the public. Integrity and honesty; detail oriented; creative and innovative; ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Verify the accuracy and correctness of invoices and course offers. Ensure the accuracy of supporting evidence uploaded on MyNSG platform. Verify captured learner results on the MyNSG. Develop, review and enforce quality assurance standards and control measures for learner records, assessments, moderation and certification processes in line with legislative and institutional requirements. Conduct periodic quality reviews and internal audits of learner records and MyNSG data to assess compliance, accuracy and effectiveness, and implement corrective and preventive actions where deficiencies are identified. Monitor the effectiveness of quality management interventions by analysing error trends, audit findings and stakeholder feedback, and recommend continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service delivery and records integrity Manage timeous allocations of invoices for processing. Approve payment advice documentation. Manage timeous submission of payment advice to Finance. Report on status of invoices. Respond to learner and client queries and requests. Ensure that complaints are properly recorded, tracked and channelled properly. Resolve disputes with assessors and moderators, ETQAs, clients and learners. Manage relations with ETQAs on verification and accreditation. Manage the assignment submission dates. Approve extensions on assignment submissions. Manage the capturing of assignment records into the MyNSG. Manage the batching of assignments per training offers. Manage the deployment of assessors and moderators. Manage the implementation of assessment policies with HEIs. Manage the upload of learner assessment and moderation results on ETQAs systems. Manage uploading requests for external moderation and relevant documents (moderation reports, learner lists per course/US, assessors and moderators) in the ETQA system as per the set requirements. Ensure that there are proper filing systems and all portfolios to be moderated are available (either online or physically). Compile and implement a management improvement plan to ensure all findings and issues formally raised by ETQAs are addressed. Manage the resources (people, finance, systems, assets) allocated within the sub-directorate. Implement operations management within the sub-directorate, including determination of service standards, standard operating procedures, business process management, total quality management and digital transformation. Develop appropriate strategies and plans for the achievement of performance targets and sub-directorate requirements, including performance reporting. Identify and manage strategic and operational risks within the sub-directorate, as well as mitigation plans, including business continuity plans. Supervise employees. Strategic planning, performance management monitoring and reporting of unit performance. Risk management as well as mitigation plans, including business continuity plans.
jobs.enquiries: Mpho Mugodo Tel No: (012) 441 6017

jobs.notes: Applications must consist of: A fully completed and signed new Z83 form with a comprehensive CV containing contactable references. Use of the old Z83 Form will result in disqualification. Candidates should not attach certified documents to the application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview. The relevant reference number must be written on the application form. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. All appointments are subject to personnel suitability checks such as security vetting, citizen verification, financial records check, and qualifications verifications. Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements as well as applications that are received late, will not be considered. The selection process of the SMS post will be in line with the Senior Management Service requirements. The successful candidate will be expected to sign a performance agreement within three months from the date of assumption of duties and where applicable to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests within a month. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its employment equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender, and disability) through the filling of this post. The NSG reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) is required for appointment to the SMS posts. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Leerderrekords
af.summary: Die National School of Government soek 'n Adjunkdirekteur om gehalteversekering van leerderrekords te bestuur, kursusdata op die MyNSG-platform te verifieer en assesseringskontroles af te dwing.
af.requirements: 'n Baccalaureusgraad op NQF level 7 in Publieke Administrasie, of 'n verwante veld. Registrasie by 'n tersaaklike professionele liggaam sal ook 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se tersaaklike ervaring, insluitend ten minste drie (3) jaar op die Assistentdirekteur- of gelykwaardige vlak in leerderrekords of ondersteuning van ETD-praktyke. Die posbeklaer sal aan 'n sekuriteitsondersoekproses onderwerp word, waarvan die ondersoekvlak bepaal sal word. Kennis van die volgende: Ontwikkelingslandskap in Suid-Afrika. Deeglike begrip van die openbare sektor, tersaaklike beleide en toepaslike wetgewende raamwerke (insluitend maar nie beperk tot: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Beleidsontwikkeling, ontleding en implementering. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend uitstekende werkkennis van die MS Office-suite en tersaaklike sagteware vir data-ontleding. Kennis van die assessering van die effekte van projekte, die toepassing van nuwe ontwikkelings en innovasie. Vaardighede: Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Navorsings- en ontledingstegnieke. Bedrywigheid in kommunikasie en voorleggingsvaardighede. Uitstekende projek-, tyd- en mensebestuursvaardighede. Voorstel- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Uitstekende organiserings- en beplanningsvaardighede, rekenaarvaardigheid in Microsoft Office Suite en digitale vaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Neem deel aan aktiwiteite vir professionele ontwikkelingsgroei om professionele kennis te handhaaf en tred te hou met navorsingspraktyke en -neigings. Vermoë om veelvuldige take uit te voer en te organiseer, te prioritiseer en veelvuldige projekte en take tot voltooiing deur te voer met oog vir besonderhede. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk terwyl bygedra word tot 'n spanomgewing. Toewyding aan gehalte en deurlopende leer. Professionele gedrag en goeie oordeel. Vermoë om effektiewe werksverhoudings met bestuur, werknemers, belanghebbendes en die publiek tot stand te bring en te handhaaf. Integriteit en eerlikheid; besonderhedgegerig; kreatief en innoverend; vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Verifieer die akkuraatheid en korrektheid van fakture en kursusaanbiedings. Verseker die akkuraatheid van ondersteunende getuienis wat op die MyNSG-platform opgelaai is. Verifieer vasgelegde leerderresultate op die MyNSG. Ontwikkel, hersien en dwing gehalteversekeringsstandaarde en kontrolemaatreëls af vir leerderrekords, assessering, moderering en sertifiseringsprosesse in ooreenstemming met wetgewende en institusionele vereistes. Voer periodieke gehaltehersienings en interne oudits van leerderrekords en MyNSG-data uit om nakoming, akkuraatheid en doeltreffendheid te assesseer, en implementeer regstellende en voorkomende aksies waar tekortkominge geïdentifiseer word. Monitor die doeltreffendheid van gehaltebestuursintervensies deur foutneigings, ouditbevindings en terugvoer van belanghebbendes te ontleed, en beveel deurlopende verbeteringsinisiatiewe aan om dienslewering en rekordintegriteit te verbeter. Bestuur tydige toedeling van fakture vir verwerking. Keur betaaladviesdokumentasie goed. Bestuur tydige indiening van betaaladvies aan Finance. Rapporteer oor die status van fakture. Reageer op navrae en versoeke van leerders en kliënte. Verseker dat klagtes behoorlik aangeteken, nagespoor en behoorlik gekanaliseer word. Los geskille met assessors en moderators, ETQA's, kliënte en leerders op. Bestuur verhoudinge met ETQA's rakende verifikasie en akkreditasie. Bestuur die indieningsdatums vir opdragte. Keur verlengings vir opdragindienings goed. Bestuur die vaslegging van opdragrekords in die MyNSG. Bestuur die groepering van opdragte per opleidingsaanbiedings. Bestuur die ontplooiing van assessors en moderators. Bestuur die implementering van assesseringsbeleide met HEI's. Bestuur die oplaai van leerderassesserings- en modereringsresultate op ETQA-stelsels. Bestuur oplaai-versoeke vir eksterne moderering en tersaaklike dokumente (modereringsverslae, leerderlyste per kursus/US, assessors en moderators) in die ETQA-stelsel soos per die gestelde vereistes. Verseker dat daar behoorlike argiefstelsels is en alle portfolio's wat gemodereer moet word beskikbaar is (òf aanlyn òf fisies). Stel 'n bestuursverbeteringsplan op en implementeer dit om te verseker dat alle bevindings en kwessies wat formeel deur ETQA's geopper word, aangespreek word. Bestuur die hulpbronne (mense, finansies, stelsels, bates) wat binne die subdirektoraat toegewys is. Implementeer operasionele bestuur binne die subdirektoraat, insluitend die bepaling van diensstandaarde, standaard bedryfsprosedures, besigheidsprosesbestuur, algehele gehaltebestuur en digitale transformasie. Ontwikkel toepaslike strategieë en planne vir die bereiking van prestasieteikens en subdirektoraatvereistes, insluitend prestasieverslagdoening. Identifiseer en bestuur strategiese en operasionele risiko's binne die subdirektoraat, asook mitigasieplanne, insluitend besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne. Superviseer werknemers. Strategiese beplanning, prestasiebestuursmonitering en verslagdoening van eenheidsprestasie. Risikobestuur asook mitigasieplanne, insluitend besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne.

zu.title: Onozela Ohamba Phambili: Amarekhodi Abafundi
zu.summary: I-National School of Government ifuna uMqondisi Ohamba Phambili ophatha ukuqinisekiswa kwemigomo yamarekhodi abafundi, aqinisekise idatha yamakilasi ohlelo lwe-MyNSG, futhi aphephuse izilawuli zokuqokwa emsebenzini.
zu.requirements: I-Degree yesiqu kumazinga e-NQF 7 ku-Public Administration, noma inkambiso edingekayo. Ukuqqashelwa komunye umthethosisekelo ohlobene nalesi sikhundla kuzoba yindlela engekho ngaphansi kwenani elifanele. Okufunekayo: ukuba unolwazi oludele uma kwenzeka umsebenzi ochaziweyo ekwabuye uthole ulwazi oluzokwenza ukuba uthathwe njengomntu ofanelwe ukuba kulesi sikhundla, umuntu ofanele ukuba nothando-nani nolwazi lokugcina amarekhodi abafundi ekwenzeni imisebenzi ehlobene nokuthuthukiswa kweziseko nokuqeqeshwa abantu noma njalo abasebenzi abangenele emthethweni wokusebenza komphakathi noma emkhakheni wakho namhlanje waseSouth Africa. Isidingo esibaluleke kakhulu ukuba nomvuzo ophakeme nolwazi lokuqonda imigomo yomphakathi, imigqalasemthetho esebenza kule mikhakha nokwaziswa (njengokubalulele kwelinye kwelinye kodwa kungalikhushi lokuthi: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Ukuthuthukiswa kwemigomo, ukuhlaziwa nokusetshenziswa. Ulwazi lokuqamba nokuqamba izinto, oluhleliswe ukusebenzisa uhlelo oluzinze lwesilulumkisi-mkhondo se-MS Office kanye noshintsho oluhlelwe ukutholakala ngalo idatha. Ulwazi ngendlela ekulinga ngayo imiphumela yamaphrojekthi, ukusebenzisa izinto ezintsha nokuhlakahlwa ekukhiqizweni kwezinto. Amandla: Amandla okuxhumaneka nebandla. Amandla oksolana. Amandla oksolwa ngamandla amakhulu. Ukuba ngumuntu onamandla okuhlela futhi azicabangele kakhulu. Ukuba nomthetho-ndlela nokwazi ukuphathwa kwethimba, kwesikhathi kanye nokuqonda abantu. Ulwazi lokubhala ngokuphathwa kwemigomo kanye namandla okwenza amagama. Amandla amakhulu okuphathwa kwephrojekthi, kwesikhathi nokuqondisa abantu. Ukubhala ngokwemigomo nokwaziswa. Amandla okuhlela, ukucabanga ngokusondeza, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kwi-Microsoft Office Suite, kanye namandla okusebenzisa izinto ezintsha zendalo. Izinto Eziyimfihlo: Ukuba ngumuntu othanda ukuxhumeka kumasebe aphezulu, angase afune ukwaziswa okungahle kwenzeke noma angase afune ulwazi ngokusungula imigomo yomsebenzi nomsebenzi ophathwa ngabanye abantu. Amandla okwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukuzihlola, ukukhetha, nokulandela amaphrojekthi nemisebenzi eminingi kuze kube yilapho iphela, nokugcina inqwaba yemibhalo. Amandla okusebenza kodwa ngesikhathi esisodwa ekwazi ukusebenza kwi-organs ezenza ngamunye. Ukulalela umphakathi nokulandela imigomo. Ukuziphatha kahle nokuqonda izinto. Amandla okuxhumanisa futhi agcine ubudlelwano kahle nomphathi, nabasebenzi, nabalingani, nomphakathi. Ukuzithiba nokuba yindoda; ukunaka imininingwane; ukuba nomqondo oqhamuka kumuntu oqhamuka; amandla okusebenza phansi komthwalo.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba yiqiniso nokulungile kwemali ethunyelwa nokuqokwa kwamakilasi. Qinisekisa ukulungile imibhalo esekela okuthunyelwe kumshini we-MyNSG. Qinisekisa ukulungile imiphumela yabafundi efakwe ku-MyNSG. Hakunye hlaziya futhi uphephuse amazinga oqinisekiso kanye nendlela ezokulawula amarekhodi abafundi, ukuqokwa, ukungalungi kwamanye amagatsha namaphasiwe ngokuhambisana nemithetho nokuqinisekiswa ngokusemthethweni. Yenza ukubuyekezwa kwamanye amagatsha futhi uhlole ungakwazi ukuthola inani eliqinisekisiwe nalelo eliqinisekisiwe ngaphakathi kwesikhathi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukubuyekezwa okwenziwe kuyinto ekhonjwa ngamagatsha angenisa futhi abike imiphumela yalokho okwenziwe ngaphandle kwemithetho. Lawula kwaye ulungise imiba ekhethwa ngokusesikweni kwabanye abantu abajwayelekileyo kwaye ungazami ukuyenza into ezingaqondakaliyo. Hlola ukusebenza komshini wokuqinisekisa idatha yakho kwaye wenze izifundo ezingatshintshe imiphumela. Qonda kwaye uthathe inxaxheba ekwazisweni ngokuqhutshwa kwemali. Gambe imali yemisebenzi. Qhuba imali yemisebenzi esemthethweni. Xela ngokuba yimali yonke ingakanani. Phendula ngemibuzo yakho nabantu abangakuthandi nokucela noma yimuphi umzobo. Qinisekisa ukuba yinto ekiqondwe ngokusesikweni. Khuphela izixuku namathuba amathemba namakhasimende. Lawula ukuxhumana nothile ngokusemthethweni nokulunga kwemali yokwenza imisebenzi. Lawula usuku lokuhanjiswa kolwazi. Qinisekisa olunye ukwandiswa kwesikhathi ngokusuka kwenhlalo yolwazi. Lawula ukugcinwa kolwazi oluphandwa ngokusemthethweni. Lawula ukwahlula-hlulwa kolwazi ngokusemthethweni kwesikhathi sokwenza umsebenzi. Lawula ukuthumela abanye abantu ukuba basebenze. Lawula ukusebenza kolunye uhlelo lokuhamba kwezemali namathuba. Lawula ukufakwa kolwazi lokuqokwa kwamakilasi ngokusemthethweni. Lawula imigomo esemthethweni ekwazi ngokusemthethweni. Lawula ukuphatha izinto ngokwemisebenzi nokuqonda kwezomthetho. Qinisekisa ukuba khona imigomo yokugcina imibhalo nokuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imibhalo iphephile. Hlola nokulungisa imigomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezinto. Lawula imali yokwenza imisebenzi (abantu, imali, izixhobo, izinto). Lawula ukusebenza kwaye ulungelelanise imisebenzi ngokusemthethweni, kubandakanya ukugqiba izindinganiso, ukusebenza kwemithetho, ukuphatha imigiqela, ukulawula imali ephethwe ngabanye kwaye ulungise into ethile. Hlela imigomo kwaye ulungiselele ukufikelela emaphakadini alinganiselwe kwaye ufuna ukuyiqonda. Qonda kwaye ulawule imigiqela yokusingatha kwezimali. Lawula abantu abasebenzayo. Uhlelo lokusebenza kwezimali nokulungiselela iplani yokwenzeka kwemali nokuqinisekiswa ngokusemthethweni. Imali yokwenza imisebenzi nokulawula imali yokwenza imisebenzi.

xh.title: Isebe leNqanaba eliPhakamileyo: Iirekodi zoMfundi
xh.summary: I-National School of Government iFunese uMlawuli ongapheli uKuzilolonga ukuze alawule uQinisekiso lweNgcangcazelo yeeRekodi zoMfundi, aqinisekise iNgcangcazelo yeKlasi kwiplatifom yakwa-MyNSG, aze aphethe ulawulo lokuHlola.
xh.requirements: iNqanaba le-Bachelor's Degree kwinqanaba le-NQF 7 kwi-Public Administration, okanye indlela ephathelene nayo. UkuBhalisa kumsebenzi ophathwa ngamachaphaza angathinteli kuya kuba ngaphezu kolona luncedo. UQeqesho: Isixa esingaphantsi kweminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ahambelana nomsbenzi, kuquka ubuncinane iminyaka emithathu (3) kunqanaba loMLawuli oNcedisayo okanye esilinganayo kwirekodi zabafundi okanye nasekuxhaseni iziqhulo ze-ETD. Umntu oze kulo msebenzi uya kujongwa ngenqanaba lokhuselo, elo nqanaba liya kugqunywa. UkuQonda iZakhono: Ibhalansi yoPhuhliso eMzantsi Afrika. UkuQonda ngokupheleleyo ngaphakathi koluntu lolawulo, iinkqubo ezahambelana nayo nemiGalelo ehambelana nayo (kuquka noko kodwa akukwazi ukuba kuphela koku: i-Public Service Act; i-Public Administration and Management Act; i-Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). UPhuhliso, uQwalaselo noMisela lweNkqubo. Ulwazi oluQeqeshweyo ekusebenziseni iKhompyutha, olubandakanya ulwazi olubalaseleyo lokusebenza ngesixhobo se-MS Office kunye nesoftware ezahambelana nayo ekulawulweni iNgcangcazelo. Ulwazi lokulinganisa imiphumela yamaphulo, ukusebenzisa uphuhliso olutsha nokungqamana kobuchwepheshe obutsha. IZakhono: IZakhono ezomeleleyo zokuManyana nabantu. IZakhono zoKusombulula iNgingqi. Iindlela zoPhando noQwalaselo. Ukuziqhelanisa ekubonakaliseni nasekubonisweni. IZakhono ezomeleleyo zokuLawula amaphulo, isixa senkathi, nabantu. IZakhono zokuBhala iSicelo neNgxelo. IZakhono ezibalaseleyo zokuCwangcisa noKumisela, ulwazi lokusebenzisa iKhompyutha kwisixhobo se-Microsoft Office Suite, nolwazi ekusebenziseni ixesha elincinci kwindlela ezinkcu. IimPawu zobuNgcali: Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumaphulo aPhuhliso lobuGcisa ukuze ugunyaziswe ngolwazi lobugcisa kwaye uhlale uphakathi kolona kulawulo loluntu kwicandelo lobuGcisa nokuhamba koluntu. Ulwazi lokwenza izinto ezininzi ngesixha esinye ngendlela ephawulwe ngokusuka esiqhingini ukuya kwenkcazelo yayo, kwaye ulungelelanise ulwazi. Ulwazi lokwenza isigqibo ekubeni yedwa ngelixa unceda uluntu. Ukuzinikela ngokwaneleyo kwiNqanaba ephezulu nokufunda ngokungengayo. Ulwazi lokwenza izigqibo ezahambelana nemigqaliselo yoluntu. Ulwazi lokuMisela nokugcina ulwazi ngelixa ulawula abantu, abasebenzi, iindlela ezahambelana noluntu, nabezemizi. Ulwazi lokumisela iNkqubo ngelixa ulawula iNqanaba. Ulwazi ekubonakaliseni, ekunikezelweni, kweMigangatho yokuHlola nokulunga.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukulunga nokuzalisekisa kweefaktshi nakwesi sizathu sabafundi. Qinisekisa ukulunga kwezibakeli zeNgcangcazelo ezingeniswe kwithiyori yakwa-MyNSG. Qinisekisa iZiphumo zabafundi ezifakwe kwizikripthi kwi-MyNSG. Cwangcisa, hlola uze uphinge iMigangatho yokuQinisekisa nokuLawula iNkqubo yeeRekodi zabafundi, ukuHlola, iNkqubo yokuQinisekisa nokuQinisekisa ukuya phambili kuhamba nemigalelo yaseZiko nayo. Hlola ngokuhamba kwexesha iNqanaba leNkqubo yokusebenza kwaye ulawule iNkqubo ngaphakathi ngokungangqamani nemiGalelo yaseZiko. Cwangcisa iNqanaba leNkqubo ezahlukeneyo zeNkqubo yokulawula iNkqubo yakwa-MyNSG. Qinisekisa ukuba zikho iNkqubo ezahambelana noko ukuze zithathwe iinyathelo ezahambelana neNkqubo ekwazisekweni kwaye ulawule iNqanaba. Lawula iNkqubo yokumisela iNkqubo yokuLawula nokuyilawula. Zamkela iNgxelo yokuhlawulelwa kwiNkqubo. Lawula ukuthunyelwa ngexesha iNgxelo yokuhlawulelwa kwiFayili. Hlola ngokwakho ukuba zikho iinkqubo ezahambelana nobuGcisa. Phendula iMibuzo nokuCelwa ngumfundi naseKhasikhusele kwaye ulawule iNkqubo ekubonisweni ngokuhamba kwemigangatho yokulunga.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Supply Chain and Asset Management
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum (Level 11), an inclusive remuneration package
jobs.summary: Deputy Director role at the National School of Government overseeing supply chain planning, contract management, risk management and audit processes.
jobs.requirements: A recognised bachelor’s degree or equivalent (NQF level 7) in the field of Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Finance, or a related field. Registration with a relevant SCM professional body will be an advantage. Experience: A minimum of five (5) years’ experience in Supply Chain Management, Asset Management, Logistics, within the education and training or related field, of which three (3) years must be at supervisory Assistant Director or equivalent level. The incumbent must undergo security vetting, and clearance will be determined. Advanced knowledge of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, Supply Chain Management frameworks, and public sector financial management practices. Advanced knowledge and understanding of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and public sector legislation, including the Public Service Act, Public Administration Management Act (PAMA), Public Service Regulations, and related governance frameworks. Extensive knowledge of demand management, acquisition management, logistics management, contract management, supplier management, asset management, disposal management, and inventory management principles and practices. Advanced knowledge of government transversal systems and procurement platforms, such as BAS, LOGIS, Central Supplier Database (CSD), e-Tender Portal, and related SCM information systems. Knowledge of corporate governance, risk management, internal control systems, audit processes, fraud prevention, ethics management, and compliance monitoring. Knowledge of strategic planning, budgeting, performance management, project management, stakeholder management, and service delivery improvement frameworks within government institutions. Treasury Regulations and SCM Frameworks. Batho Pele principles. Experience working on BAS & LOGIS and CSD. Skills: Demand, Acquisition, Logistics, Contract, and Asset Management. Contract Management and Supplier Relationship Management. Bid Administration and Secretariat Support to Bid Committees. Financial and asset management. Computer Literacy and Proficiency in Government Transversal Systems (BAS, LOGIS, CSD, eTender Portal, and Microsoft Office Suite). Project and process management. Leadership and people management. Governance and compliance orientation. Problem-solving and decision-making. Integrity and accountability. Reporting and compliance management. Personal Attributes: Participate in professional development growth activities for maintaining professional knowledge and staying current with curricular trends. Ability to multi-task and organize and prioritise. Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment. Problem solving and conflict resolution skills. Good stakeholder management skills. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Coordinate SCM planning, reporting, risk management, and audit processes, including the implementation of audit action plans and corrective measures. Oversee supplier and contract management processes to ensure effective service delivery, value for money, and compliance with contractual obligations. Monitor SCM performance indicators and prepare management reports on procurement trends, compliance levels, and operational efficiency. Promote ethical procurement practices and implement measures to prevent fraud, corruption, irregular expenditure, and SCM system abuse. Develop, review and implement demand and acquisition management policies, frameworks, processes and procedures. Coordinate the compilation, consolidation and approval of the Annual Procurement Plan in line with budget allocations and operational requirements. Oversee the development of specifications/terms of reference to ensure completeness, compliance and standardisation. Manage acquisition processes, including bid administration and compliance with SCM prescripts. Establish and provide secretariat support and/or advisory services to Bid Specification Committees (BSC), Bid Evaluation Committees (BEC), and Bid Adjudication Committees (BAC). Maintain effective record-keeping systems and procurement documentation in accordance with legislative and audit requirements. Monitor and evaluate demand and acquisition performance and implement corrective measures where required. Manage the prevention of fraud, corruption, irregular expenditure, and SCM system abuse within demand and acquisition management processes. Develop, review and implement logistics, disposal and asset management policies, systems and procedures. Oversee the provisioning, storage, distribution and control of goods and services. Manage inventory and stock control systems to ensure accuracy, safeguarding, and accountability. Coordinate the identification and disposal of redundant, obsolete, or unserviceable assets in line with legislative and regulatory prescripts. Ensure the maintenance, updating, and integrity of asset registers for movable and immovable assets. Monitor asset verification processes, including physical condition assessments, utilisation reviews, and performance reporting. Conduct periodic asset verification and reconciliation processes to ensure asset existence, completeness, and accuracy. Analyse asset performance, utilisation, depreciation trends, and lifecycle management data for strategic decision-making and reporting purposes. Compile and submit asset management reports in compliance with regulatory, audit, and organisational reporting requirements. Provide technical advice and guidance to business units on SCM, logistics, disposal, and asset management practices. Promote awareness, compliance, and adherence to asset management policies, procedures, and internal control measures across the institution. Establish and maintain strategic and operational relations with internal business units and external stakeholders (National Treasury, DPSA) to support effective service delivery. Facilitate integrated planning and collaboration across business units to inform procurement planning, demand management, and asset lifecycle management processes. Undertake benchmarking to identify and implement innovative supply chain and asset management practices. Represent the organisation in internal and external forums/ structures to influence compliance, policy alignment, and best practice implementation. Identify and leverage collaborative opportunities to strengthen supply chain efficiency, asset management capability, and overall institutional performance. Manage the resources (people, finance, systems, assets) allocated within the directorate. Manage the implementation of operations management within the business unit, including determining service standards, standard operating procedures, business process management, total quality management, and digital transformation. Develop appropriate strategies and plans for achieving performance targets and business unit requirements, including quarterly performance reporting. Identify and manage strategic and operational risks within the business unit, as well as mitigation plans, including business continuity plans. Manage a team of employees and service providers who are expected to accomplish assigned duties efficiently, effectively, and competently and to strive for improvement and excellence in all work performed.
