jobs.notes: Applications must consist of: A fully completed and signed new Z83 form with a comprehensive CV containing contactable references. Use of the old Z83 Form will result in disqualification. Candidates should not attach certified documents to the application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview. The relevant reference number must be written on the application form. Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualification Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity All shortlisted candidates, including SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One must be a practical exercise, and the other must be an Integrity (Ethical Conduct) Assessment. All appointments are subject to personnel suitability checks such as security vetting, citizen verification, financial records check, and qualifications verifications. Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements as well as applications that are received late, will not be considered. The selection process of the SMS post will be in line with the Senior Management Service requirements. The successful candidate will be expected to sign a performance agreement within three months from the date of assumption of duties and where applicable to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests within a month. The employment decision shall be informed by the Employment Equity Plan of the Department to achieve its employment equity targets. It is the Department’s intention to promote equity (race, gender, and disability) through the filling of this post. The NSG reserves the right not to make an appointment and to use other recruitment processes. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. Successful completion of the Senior Management Pre-Entry Programme (Nyukela) is required for appointment to the SMS posts. Enrolment for the course should be          made          on         the          NSG’s           website       at https://www.thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry-programme. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

zu.title: Isiphathamthethi: Ukuphathwa Kwenhlule nemali Esetshenziswayo
zu.summary: Indima yesiphathamthethi e-National School of Government ebalulekile ukuphathwa kohlulelo lwenkathi, ukuphathwa kwezivumelwano, ukuphathwa kwezingozi kanye namasu okuhlola.
zu.requirements: Iziqu eziyisiqu ezingaphansi kweziqu noma okulingana (NQF level 7) enkabeni yokuphathwa kwamandla, izimali ezifakwa emaphoyisa, noma okuhlobene. Ukubhalisa emandleni ehlotshaniswa nokuphathwa kwamandla kuzoba yindlela. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni seminyaka emihlanu (5) ekuphathweni kwamandla, ekuphathweni kwemali, kubungqondo nabasebenzi noma enkabeni, kanti iminyaka (3) kufanele ibe khona ngokuqondisa osomlilo ohlongoza imithetho noma ngokulingana. Isikhundla kufanele siphathwe ngokuhlolwa kwabopha, kanti isinqumo sizosetshenziswa. Ulwazi olungeziwe ngomthetho wokuqondisa imali yamaphoyisa, izindikimba zemali, uhlaka lokuphathwa kwamandla, kanye nendlela zokuphathwa kwemali yamaphoyisa. Ulwazi olungeziwe ngemithetho yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nokuqonda imithetho yamaphoyisa, kuhlanganisa nomthetho wamaphoyisa, umthetho wokuqondisa amaphoyisa, izilawulo zamaphoyisa, kanye nohlaka oluhlobene. Ulwazi olubanzi ngokuqondisa amaphoyisa, ukuthola imali, ukuphathwa kwamasu, ukuphathwa kwezivumelwano, ukuphathwa kwabashumi bemali, ukuphathwa kwemali yezimali, ukuphathwa kwemali, kanye nokuqonda imigomo. Ulwazi olungeziwe ngosimiso lwezinsimbi zemfanelo kahulumeni kanye nendlela ezinkundleni ezihlukene, ezinhlobonhlobo ezinjengokuthengisa, ukuthola imali, i-CSD, i-eTender Portal, nezinye izinhlelo. Ulwazi ngemithetho yamaphoyisa, ukuphathwa kwabo, izinhlela zangaphakathi zokuqondisa, amasu okuhlola, ukuvikela inhlazo, kanye nokubuka imithetho. Ulwazi ngokuqondisa izinhlelo, ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa kwakho, ukuphathwa kwabashumi nemithetho, izinhlela zokuthuthukisa amaphoyisa, kanye namaphoyisa. Imithetho yokuqondisa imali nemigomo yamaphoyisa. Imigomo yokuthatha isikhundla. Isipiliyoni sokusebenza kwezinkundla ezihlukene. Amakhono: Ukuphathwa kwabo, ukuthuthwa kwemali, ukuphathwa kwamasu, ukuphathwa kwezivumelwano, nezinsimbi zemfanelo. Ukuphathwa kwezivumelwano nokuphathwa kwezindaba zabashumi. Ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa kwabakho, nesikhundla sokuba ngumlobi. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha kanye nokusebenzisa izinhlela zekhompyutha kahulumeni. Ukuphathwa izinhlela, ukuphathwa kwabantu, ukuphathwa kwemfanelo nokuhambisana nomthetho. Ikhono lokuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokwenza izinqumo. Ukuzethemba nokubhekwa njengomuntu onoxanduva. Izinto zobuqu: Ukubambe iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni ukwaziswa kwemfundo, ukwazi ukwenza izinhlobonhlobo zezinto, kanye nokuba ukwazi ukusebenzela iqembu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkulu, ukuxazulula izinkinga, nokubeka phambili okubalulekile. Ikhono lokuphatha abashumi. Ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi.
zu.duties: Ukuqondisa ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo, okubalulekile, ukuphathwa kwabangu, kanye namasu okuhlola, okuhlanganisa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlela zokuqondisa kanye nezinyathelo zokuxazulula. Ukubuka ukuphathwa kwezinsimbi kanye nokuphathwa kwezivumelwano ukuqinisekisa ukuba ngokufanele, kanye nokuhambisana nezivumelwano. Ukubuka izinkomba zokuqondisa kanye nokulungiselela izindikimba ngemigomo, ukuthengisa, kanye nokuhambisana. Ukuphakamisa ukuphathwa kwemali, ngokuhambisana nomthetho, ukuvikela inhlazo, ukuphathwa kwemali engahambisani, nokusetshenziswa kwamandla. Ukulungiselela, ukubuka nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlela ezihlukene zokuthutha, ukuthola imali, ukuphathwa kwezinsimbi, kanye nohlelo. Ukuqondisa ukubhalisa, ukuqondisa ukuthengisa emnyakeni, kanye nezinhlela zokuqondisa ngenkathi. Ukubuka ukuphathwa kwabashumi kanye nokuxazulula ukuthengisa ngemithetho kahulumeni. Ukubhalisa kwaye uhlinzeke ngokubuka ukuphathwa kwemali. Ukuphathwa kwemali, nokuphathwa kwemfanelo yemali, kanye nokuphathwa kwemali. Ukuqondisa, ukubuka nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlela zokuphathwa kwemali, nokuphathwa kwemali yezimali. Ukuphathwa kokuthengisa, nokuphathwa kwamasu. Ukuphathwa kwezinto zokusebenza zohulumeni. Ukuxazulula ukusetshenziswa kwemali ngokusebenzisa imithetho yohulumeni. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemali, kanye nokuphathwa kwemali yabantu. Ukuhlola amandla, ukubuka imali, kanye nokusebenzisa imali. Ukuphathwa kwemali yokuthengisa, nokuphathwa kwemali yemali. Ukusebenzisa izinhlela zokuqondisa, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinto zomphakathi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemali, ukuphathwa kwemali, kanye nezinye izinkundla. Ukubuka, ukuphatha kanye nokusebenzisa izinhlela zokuqondisa izimali, ukuphathwa kwamandla emali, kanye nezinye izinto. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemali, nokuphathwa kwamandla emali. Ukuphathwa kwemali, nokuphathwa kwabantu. Ukuphathwa kwemali, nokuphathwa kwabantu. Ukuphathwa kokuphathwa kwabantu, nokuphathwa kwemali emnyakeni. Ukuqondisa ukuphathwa kwemali, kanye nokuphathwa kwabantu. Ukubuka, ukuphathwa, nokusetshenziswa kwezinsimbi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, nokuphathwa kwezinkundla ezahlukene. Ukuphatha abantu, abantu, izinhlela, nezimali. Ukuphathwa kwezinsimbi eziguqukayo, kanye nezinye izinsimbi.

xh.title: Isekela Mongam: Ulawulo Lwendlela yokuhambisa iNkcumisa nokulawula iZixhobo
xh.summary: Indima yesekela mongam kwiSikolo seLizwe leRhulumante esibukele ukucwangciswa kwendlela yokuhambisa inkcumisa, ulawulo lweenkonzo, ulawulo lomngcipheko nemisebenzi yokuhlola.
xh.requirements: Idigri yebachelor ekuqatshelwayo okanye engaphezu koko (NQF level 7) kwinkundla yoLawulo loMthwalo weziXhobo, I-Logistics, izeZimali, okanye inkundla enxulumene nayo. Ukuqatshelwa kwesiqwenga somzimba ogunyazisiweyo se-SCM kuya kuba yingozi. Amaphumo: Iminyaka yamava engaphezulu kwemihlanu (5) emva kweenkonzo kulawulo lwendlela yokuhambisa inkcumisa, ulawulo lwezixhobo, i-logistics, ngaphakathi kwemfundo nokuqeqeshwa okanye inkundla enxulumene nayo, apho iminyaka emithathu (3) kufuneka ibe ngowqeqeshi weAssistant Director okanye kwinqanaba elinganayo. Umntu okhethiweyo kufuneka aze wenziwe isikhiti isikhokelo sokhuseleko, kwaye isigqibo sokukhutshwa kuya kumiswa. Ulwazi olunomtheo phezulu loMthetho woLawulo lwezeZimali zeZikorha (PFMA), Imigaqo yeTreasury, iinkqubo zoLawulo loMthwalo weziXhobo, nendlela zokulawula iimali kwindawo karhulumante. Ulwazi olunomtheo phezulu nokuqonda uMgaqo-siseko weRiphablikhi yoMzantsi Afrika nomthetho wedagi yorhulumante, kuquka uMthetho woLwazi lwaRhulumante, uMthetho woLawulo lwaRhulumante (PAMA), Imigaqo yoLwazi lwaRhulumante, nazoqulunqo olunxulumene naloo migaqo. Ulwazi olubanzi ngolawulo lwemfuno, ulawulo lokufumana izixhobo, ulawulo logistics, ulawulo lweenkonzo, ulawulo labanikezeli, ulawulo lwezixhobo, ulawulo lokuchitha, nokuqonda nokuqhuba inkqubo yokulawula izinto ezikhoyo. Ulwazi olunomtheo phezulu lweenkqubo zobukhosi bezorhulumante eziqhuba ngokudibanisiweyo ngeendawo zokuthenga, njenge-BAS, i-LOGIS, i-Central Supplier Database (CSD), e-Tender Portal, nazoqulunqo zolwazi lwe-SCM ezinxulumene nalawa. Ulwazi ngolawulo lwebhodi, ulawulo lomngcipheko, iinkqubo zolawulo lwangaphakathi, imisebenzi yokuhlola, ukuthintela inkohlakalo, ulawulo lokuziphatha, nokuqwalasela ukuthobela imigaqo. Ulwazi ngokuqulunqa iindlela ezinqwenelayo, ulawulo lobungakanani bemali, ulawulo lwemisebenzi, ulawulo labathintekayo, nokuqulunqa iindlela zokuphucula iinkonzo kwiziko lorhulumante. Imigaqo yeTreasury neNkqubo zoLawulo loMthwalo weziXhobo. Imigaqo kaBatho Pele. Aamava okusebenza kwi-BAS & LOGIS nakwi-CSD. Amakhono: Ulawulo lwemfuno, lokufumana, i-logistics, lweenkonzo, nezixhobo. Ulawulo lweenkonzo noQeqesho lokunxibelelwana labanikezeli. Urhwebo lolawulo nesenzo sikuncedisa amaKomiti erhwebo. Ulawulo lwezeZimali nezixhobo. Ukwazima nokuqonda iinkqubo zobukhosi bezorhulumante ezidibanisiweyo (BAS, LOGIS, CSD, eTender Portal, kunye neMicrosoft Office Suite). Ulawulo lwamaphulo nemicimbi. Ulawulo nabantu. Uqhelaniso nokuqonda ngokuthobela imigaqo. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqumba. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza nokubeki kwakho. Iingxelo nolawulo lokuthobela imigaqo. Iimfihlo zobuqu: Thatha inxaxheba kwimisebenzi yophuhliso ngobuchwepheshe ukugcina ulwazi lobuchwepheshe kwaye uhlale ulandela iintshukumo zeqhinga. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi emininzi ngaxa nye nokuqamba nokuqwalasela. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela ngelixa unegalelo kwinkqubo yeqela. Amakhono okuxazulula iingxaki nokulungisa iingxabano. Amakhono amabalwe kakhulu ngokulawula abathintekayo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Qhelanisa ukucwangciswa kwe-SCM, iingxelo, ulawulo lomngcipheko, nemisebenzi yokuhlola, kuquka nokusebenzisa iindlela zenyulo yohlolo kwaye alungele njani. Qhelanisa ulawulo labanikezeli nolawulo lweenkonzo nangendlela yokuthi inkonzo ibuyela njani, ixabiso lemali, nokuba bayathobela yini iinkqubo zeenkonzo. Qwalasela okubonakalisa ukusebenza kwe-SCM kwaye ulungise iingxelo zolawulo ngokudumileyo kokuthenga, ukuthobela imigaqo kwinqanaba elingakanani, nangendlela ekusebenzeni ngayo. Phucula iindlela ezithembekileyo zokuthenga kwaye usebenzise iindlela ezithintela inkohlakalo, ukurhoxiswa kwemali ngokungalunganga, nakusetyenziswa ngendlela engalunganga kwenkqubo ye-SCM. Phuhlisa, phinda uqwalasele kwaye usebenzise iimigaqo, iinkqubo, iindlela nemicimbi yolawulo lwemfuno nolwokufumana izixhobo. Qhelanisa ukuqamba, ukuhlanganisa nokugunyazisa iCwangciso lokuThenga lemihla yonke ngokuthobela iindlela zobungakanani bemali nemfuno yokusebenza. Qhelanisa ukuphuhliswa kwezicatshulwa/iimeko zomsebenzi ngenjongo yokwamkela ukulungelelanisa, ukuthobela nokuqwalasela ngokulinganayo. Lawula iindlela zokufumana izixhobo, kuquka nokulawula urhwebo nokuthobela imigaqo ye-SCM. Misela kwaye nikeza isenzo sokuncedisa nokubuyela nemibuzo noma iinkonzo zokucebisa kumaKomiti eQamba iZicatshulwa (BSC), amaKomiti oQwalaselo (BEC), namaKomiti oQeqesho (BAC). Hlala ugcina iinkqubo zokubhala iingxelo ngokusebenza kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo zokuthenga ngokuthobela imfuno yomthetho nokuqwalasela. Qwalasela kwaye ulinganise ukusebenza komfuno nakwokufumana izixhobo, kwaye usebenzise iindlela zokulungisa apho kufuneka khona. Lawula ukuthintela ukurhoxiswa kwemali, ukurhoxiswa kwemali ngokungalunganga, nokurhoxiswa kwemali ngokungalunganga kumsebenzi wolawulo lwemfuno nolwokufumana izixhobo. Phuhlisa, phinda uqwalasele kwaye usebenzise iimigaqo, iinkqubo nemicimbi ye-logistics, yokuchitha nokulawula izixhobo. Phatha ukunikelwa, ukuhlinzekwa, ukusasazwa nolawulo lwezinto neenkonzo. Lawula inkqubo yokulawula izinto ezisemgodini iqaqambile kwaye zikhuseleke ngokuchanekileyo. Qhelanisa ukumiswa nokuqatshelwa kwezixhobo ezingasafuniwa, ezingasasebenza, okanye ezingasasebenza ngokulandela imigaqo nemitsho yomthetho. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa, ukuhlaziywa, nangokuchanekileyo kokumiswe kophando lwamaxhoba aze athwalwe nangeniso. Qwalasela imisebenzi yokunqatshwa kwezixhobo, kuquka nokuhlolwa ngokulungelelanisa, ukuphinda uqwalasele, nokwenza iingxelo ngokusebenza. Yenza ikuhlolwa nokuqwalaselwa kwexabiso nokuza kokudumileyo iqaqambile, ukwenza iingxelo nangokunika isigqibo. Hlola ukusetyenziswa kweekhompyutha zangaphakathi, ukusetyenziswa, izithuba zokubakwayo kwexabiso, iminikelo yokwenza iingxelo, kwaye ulungelelanise ngokulinganayo. Lungiselela kwaye unike iingxelo ngokulawula izixhobo ngokuthobela imigaqo, nokwenza iingxelo ezibekiweyo phantsi komthetho, nolawulo olusebenzayo. Nika isalathiso ngobuchwepheshe nokuqonda ngokusebenza kwamashishini naku-SCM, logistics, ekuchitheni, nakulawulweni lwezixhobo. Phucula ukuqonda ukuthobela imigaqo yokulawula izixhobo, iindlela, nokuqwalasela ngolawulo lwangaphakathi ngokupheleleyo. Misela kwaye ugcine uqhagamshelwano olusebenzayo nolulinganayo namashishini angaphakathi nangaphandle kubathintekayo (i-National Treasury, i-DPSA) ukukhusela ukulungelelana kobuchule. Khokela ukucwangciswa ngokudibanisa kunye noqhagamshelwano phakathi kwamashishi ukwazisa ukucwangciswa kokuthenga, ukulawula imfuno, nangokusebenza kwezixhobo. Yenza ukuthelekisa ukuzama ukuzisa kwaye usebenzise iindlela ezintsha ngokusebenzisa ezindala nangokulawula izixhobo. Zimele iziko kwinkundla yangaphakathi nangaphandle/iinkqubo ukwazi ukuthintela ukungalungi kwemigaqo, ukuqwalasela ukulungelelanisa, nokusetyenziswa koluntu. Phatha abantu, imali, iinkqubo, izixhobo ezenikelwe kulo. Lawula imisebenzi yolawulo yamashishi, ukubeka iziqulunqi zemigaqo, iziqulunqi zokusebenza, ukulawula inkqubo yamashishini, ukulawula ngokupheleleyo, kwaye ulungelelanise ngokwezezibonelelo. Phuhlisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo nokuqulunqa nangokuphumeza iimfuno ezibeke iindidi ezincinci. Qaphela nangenxa yokubakwayo kwexabiso kwaye ulungelelanise izixhobo ngokomthetho kwaye udibanise nemigaqo ebeka inqanaba lokubakwaya kwamashishini, ukudlula kwexabiso, kwaye ugqibe ukuphanda ngokulungiselela iingxelo. Qwalasela iimfuno nangokuchanekileyo kwezinto ezithintela ukusebenza ngokungalunganga. Lawula iqela labasebenzi neenkonzo ezinikelwe iimfuno ezahlukeneyo. Lawula abantu nokuqhuba umsebenzi oqulunqwe ngokuchanekileyo ngendlela echanekileyo.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: ETD Coordination
jobs.summary: Coordinate education, training and development events including planning, bulk bookings and client interventions at the National School of Government in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A tertiary qualification registered at (NQF Level 6) in Human Resource Development, Business Administration & Management, Public Administration & Management, Operations Management or Project Management. Experience: 3 years' experience in education, training, and development (ETD) coordination or working in an ETD environment, including supervisory experience. The job holder will be subjected to a security vetting process, the clearance level of which will be determined. Knowledge: Good understanding of the education, training, and development (ETD) environment. Practical and proven knowledge of ETD co-ordination or client service coordination. Proficiency with necessary technology such as software applications and computers. Good understanding of the public sector, relevant policies, and applicable legislative frameworks (including but not limited to: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Knowledge of professional bodies and regulatory body requirements (e.g., South African Qualifications Authority, Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, Council for Higher Education). Advanced computer literacy, including excellent working knowledge of MS Office suite and relevant software for data analysis. Batho Pele principles. Skills: Events and project management. Time management. Strong interpersonal skills. Problem solving skills. Research and analysis techniques. Excellent organising and planning skills. Computer literacy in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant solutions. Proven writing skills, including report writing, submissions and articles. Digital skills to work in digital environments with digital systems, management and reporting tools. Good conflict management skills. Creative and analytical skills. Personal Attributes: Participate in professional development growth activities for maintaining professional knowledge and staying current with business solutions trends. Ability to multitask and organise, prioritise, and follow multiple projects and tasks through to completion with an attention to detail. Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment. Ability to analyse problems, identify solutions and take appropriate action, resolve conflicts using independent judgment and decision-making processes. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with management, employees, stakeholders, and the public. Integrity and honesty; detail-oriented; creative and innovative; ability to work under pressure. Travel and work extended hours.
jobs.duties: The incumbent will be responsible for the following Key Results Areas: Co- ordinate the planning process for the delivery of ETD events (e.g., face-to-face, virtual, e-learning and blended training). Manage bulk bookings not to exceed the actual booked number. Co-ordinate ETD interventions with client departments, contracted service providers, and internal business divisions. Manage the processes related to procurement of logistics (e.g. venue and catering). Deployment of the panel of experts and HEl's in accordance with their area of specialization. Prepare case files for handover (final attendance registers, verification of captured records, deviation memos/submissions) and submit to Learner Records after course reports. Management of priority clients (schedule meetings, ensure MOU/MOA project plans implementation). Monitor and assess each ETD event's success, prepare reports and identify areas of improvement. Manage the logistics related to printing and packaging of course material (for face-to-face training) and delivery before the ETD intervention. Monitor and replenish the stock levels of course material timeously and efficiently. Ensure the distribution and completion of learner evaluation questionnaires and feedback forms and submit to the relevant business unit. Ensure the thorough completion of attendance registers and the prompt receipt of reports from the panel of experts and higher education institutions (HEls) subsequent to the educational and training development (ETD) intervention. Quality assure physical and online documentation received from the Contact Centre before co-ordination activities. Manage the quality of course materials distributed in line with the approved specification before printing as well as before dispatching clients. Undertake periodic site visits to ETD venues (internally and externally) to ensure quality standards. Monitor the quality and performance of service providers responsible for catering, venues, and printing in line with the NSG policies and standards. Create awareness of NSG Standards, to Departmental Coordinators. Provide support in the orientation of contracted panel of experts and HEl's and assist in presenting on training logistics matters. Manage and verify the accuracy of data capturing into the system. Ensure quality of the ETD interventions into the system, through continuous monitoring and in liaison with relevant programme managers. Manage data integrity and security of learner personal information into the system. Liaise with Learner Records after each ETD intervention for the issuing of payments and certificates. Manage the resources (people, finance, systems, assets) allocated within the sub-directorate. Implement operations management within the sub-directorate, including determination of service standards, standard operating procedures, business process management, total quality management and digital transformation. Develop appropriate strategies and plans for the achievement of performance targets and sub- directorate requirements, including quarterly performance reporting. Identify and manage strategic and operational risks within the sub-directorate, as well as mitigation plans, including business continuity plans. Manage a team of employees, who are expected to accomplish assigned duties in an efficient, effective, and competent manner and to strive for improvement and excellence in all work performed.

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: ETD-koördinasie
af.summary: Koördineer opvoedkundige, opleidings- en ontwikkelingsgeleenthede insluitend beplanning, groepbesprekings en kliëntintervensies by die National School of Government in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Tersiêre kwalifikasie geregistreer op (NQF Level 6) in Human Resource Development, Business Administration & Management, Public Administration & Management, Operations Management of Project Management. Ervaring: 3 years' experience in education, training, and development (ETD) coordination or working in an ETD environment, including supervisory experience. Die posbekleër sal aan 'n veiligheidskeuringsproses onderwerp word, waarvan die ontruimingsvlak bepaal sal word. Kennis: Goed begrip van die opvoedkundige, opleidings- en ontwikkelings- (ETD) omgewing. Praktiese en bewese kennis van ETD-koördinasie of kliëntdienskoördinasie. Bedryfsaardigheid met nodige tegnologie soos sagtewaretoepassings en rekenaars. Goed begrip van die openbare sektor, relevante beleide en toepaslike wetgewende raamwerke (insluitend maar nie beperk tot: Public Service Act; Public Administration and Management Act; Public Service Regulatory Frameworks). Kennis van professionele liggame en regulatoire liggaamvereistes (bv. South African Qualifications Authority, Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, Council for Higher Education). Gevorderde rekenaargeletterdheid, insluitend uitstekende werkende kennis van MS Office Suite en relevante sagteware vir data-ontleding. Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardighede: Geleentheids- en projekbestuur. Tydbestuur. Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Navorsings- en ontledingstegnieke. Uitstekende organiserings- en beplanningsvaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid in Microsoft Office Suite en ander relevante oplossings. Bewese skryfvaardighede, insluitend verslagskryfwerk, voorleggings en artikels. Digitale vaardighede om in digitale omgewings met digitale stelsels, bestuurs- en verslagdoeninghulpmiddels te werk. Goeie konflikbestuurvaardighede. Kreatiewe en analitiese vaardighede. Persoonlike eienskappe: Neem deel aan professionele ontwikkelingsgroei-aktiwiteite vir die behoud van professionele kennis en om tred te hou met tendense in besigheidsoplossings. Vermoë om veelvuldige take uit te voer en te organiseer, prioriteer, en veelvuldige projekte en take tot voltooiing deur te voer met oog vir besonderhede. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk terwyl bygedra word tot 'n spanomgewing. Vermoë om probleme te ontleed, oplossings te identifiseer en gepaste stappe te neem, konflikte op te los deur onafhanklike oordeel en besluitnemingsprosesse. Vermoë om effektiewe werkverhoudings met bestuur, werknemers, belanghebbendes en die publiek te vestig en te handhaaf. Integriteit en eerlikheid; besonderheidsgeoriënteerd; kreatief en innoverend; vermoë om onder druk te werk. Reis en werk buite gereelde ure.
af.duties: Die ampsequent sal verantwoordelik wees vir die volgende sleutelresultaatgebiede: Koördineer die beplanningsproses vir die aflewering van ETD-geleenthede (bv. van aangesig tot aangesig, virtueel, e-lering en gemengde opleiding). Bestuur groepbesprekings om nie die werklike besprekte getal te oorskry nie. Koördineer ETD-intervensies met kliëntdepartemente, gekontrakteerde diensverskaffers en interne besigheidsafdelings. Bestuur die prosesse verwant aan die verkryging van logistiek (bv. lokaal en etes). Ontplooi die paneel van kundiges en HEl's in ooreenstemming met hul spesialisasiegebied. Berei kaslêers voor vir oorhandiging (finale bywoningregisters, verifiëring van vasgelêde rekords, afwykingsnotas/voorleggings) en dien in by Learner Records na kursusverslae. Bestuur van voorheidskliënte (skeduleer vergaderings, verseker implementering van MOU/MOA-projekplanne). Monitor en assesseer elke ETD-geleentheid se sukses, berei verslae voor en identifiseer areas vir verbetering. Bestuur die logistiek verwant aan die druk en verpakking van kursusmateriaal (vir van-aangesig-tot-aangesig-opleiding) en aflewering voor die ETD-intervensie. Monitor en vul die voorraadvlakke van kursusmateriaal betyds en doeltreffend aan. Verseker die verspreiding en voltooiing van leerder-evalueringsvraelyste en terugvoervorms en dien in by die relevante besigheidseenheid. Verseker die deeglike voltooiing van bywoningregisters en die onmiddellike ontvangs van verslae van die paneel van kundiges en hoër onderwysinstellings (HEls) na die opvoedkundige en opleidingsontwikkelings- (ETD) ingreep. Kwaliteitsverseker fisiese en aanlyndokumentasie ontvang van die Contact Centre voor koördinasie-aktiwiteite. Bestuur die gehalte van kursusmateriaal versprei in ooreenstemming met die goedgekeurde spesifikasie voor drukwerk sowel as voor versending aan kliënte. Onderneem periodieke werfbesoeke aan ETD-plekke (intern en ekstern) om gehaltestandaarde te verseker. Monitor die gehalte en prestasie van diensverskaffers verantwoordelik vir etes, plekke en drukwerk in ooreenstemming met die NSG-beleide en standaarde. Skep bewustheid van NSG-standaarde by departementele koördineerders. Verskaf ondersteuning in die oriëntering van gekontrakteerde paneel van kundiges en HEl's en help met voorleggings oor opleidingslogistiekaangeleenthede. Bestuur en verifieer die akkuraatheid van data wat in die stelsel vasgelê word. Verseker gehalte van die ETD-intervensies in die stelsel, deur deurlopende monitering en in oorleg met relevante programbestuurders. Bestuur data-integriteit en sekuriteit van leerder se persoonlike inligting in die stelsel. Skakel met Learner Records na elke ETD-intervensie vir die uitreiking van betalings en sertifikate. Bestuur die hulpbronne (mense, finansies, stelsels, bates) toegeken binne die sub-direktoraat. Implementeer bedryfsbestuur binne die sub-direktoraat, insluitend die bepaling van diensstandaarde, standaard bedryfsprosedures, besigheidsprosesbestuur, algehele gehaltebestuur en digitale transformasie. Ontwikkel toepaslike strategieë en planne vir die bereiking van prestasieteikens en sub-direktoraatvereistes, insluitend kwartaalprestasieverslagdoening. Identifiseer en bestuur strategiese en operasionele risiko's binne die sub-direktoraat, sowel as mitigeringsplanne, insluitend besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne. Bestuur 'n span werknemers wat verwag word om toegeken pligte op 'n doeltreffende, effektiewe en bekwame wyse te voltooi en te strewe na verbetering en uitnemendheid in alle werk verrig.

zu.title: Umphathi Onkethayo: Ukulungelelanisa kwe-ETD
zu.summary: Ukulungelelanisa izinkundla zemfundo, ukuqeqesha nokuthuthukisa okuhlanganisa ukuhlela, ukubhukha ngemithombo nokungenelela abathundayo e-National School of Government e-Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Isiqinisekiso semfundo ephakeme esibhalisiwe ku-(NQF Level 6) kokuThuthukiswa kweZinsiza Zabantu, ukuLawulwa kwezabhizinisi & nokuphathwayo, ukuLawulwa kwezikhungo zikahulumeni & nokuphathwayo, ukuLawulwa kwezinsiza, noma ukuLawulwa kwezinhlelo. Isiphephelo: 3 years' experience in education, training, and development (ETD) coordination or working in an ETD environment, including supervisory experience. Umgcini wesikhundla uzozibekela esimeni sokuhlolwa kwezokuphepha, ngezinga elizohlolwa. Ulwazi: Ukuqonda okuhle ngendawo yemfundo, ukuqeqesha nokuthuthukiswa (ETD). Ulwazi lwemisebenzi nolulolunye ngokulungelelanisa i-ETD noma ukulungelelanisa inkonzo yomthakathi. Ukukhanya ngobuchule kumathebhinoloji ayadingekayo afana nezinhlelo zesoftware namakhompyutha. Ukuqonda okuhle ngoluntu lukahulumeni, izinqubomgomo ezihlobene nakunamakh/frameworks e-womthetho afanelekayo (okuhlanganisa kodwa okungalimitiwa: umthetho Wesevisi Kahulumeni; umthetho WokuLawula kwezikhungo Kahulumeni nokuphathwayo; ama-framework Wokulawula isevisi kahulumeni). Ulwazi ngamabhodi ezingcali nezidingo zebhodi elilawulayo (isb., South African Qualifications Authority, i-Quality Council for Trades and Occupations, i-Council for Higher Education). Ulwazi olwengeziwe lwekhompyutha, okuhlanganisa ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza lwe-MS Office suite nesoftware ehlelekile ukuhlaziya idatha. Imigubgubu ye-Batho Pele. Amakhono: UkuLawulwa kwezinkundla nezinhlelo. UkuLawulwa kwesikhathi. Amakhono amakhulu okubhekana nabantu. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amasu okuphenya nokuhlaziya. Amakhono amakhulu okuhlela nokuqamba. Ukusebenzisana nekhompyutha kwi-Microsoft Office Suite nezinye izixazululo ezihlobene. Amakhono abhalwayo aqinisekisiwe, ahlanganise ukubhala imibiko, izinkethelo kanye namakhasi. Amakhono wakho digitali ukusebenza kwindawo yedigitali nangamasistimu, ukuphathwa kanye nezinsiza zokubika. Amakhono okuphatha ngobuhlakani konflikthi. Amakhono okuqamba kanye nokucazulula. Izici Zomuntu: Ukuthatha inxaxheba emigqeni yokuthuthukiswa kwezingcali ukugcina ulwazi ngokuchwensa nokuphila ngokuhamba nokuqhuba ngaphandle nezindikimba zezixazululo zebhizinisi. Ikono elingenwela kubhekise nabantu abaningi ukwahlulela, ukuqamba, ukubeka izindaba ezidlule kwezinsiza eziningi kanye nesabelo noma ukuphela ngenxa yokugqamisa ukuphathwa kwezehlule. Ikhono ukusebenza ngokuzimele ngenkathi kwenza isandulela kwindawo yokusebenza ngokubambisene. Ikhono lokuhlaziya izinkinga, lokuqaphela izixazululo nokuthatha inyathelo elifanele, ukuxazulula onflikthi ngokwazibeka ukuthi kwehlule inyathelo elidlulisiwe kuye. Ikhono lokusungula futhi zigcine izinhlelo zokusebenza kabanzi nokuphathwa, abasebenzi, iziphepheli, kanye noluntu. Ukuqina nokuzibeka; kulungele amehlule; lokuqamba kanye nokuvuselela; ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegciwane. Ukuhamba futhi usebenze emahoreni amakhulu.
zu.duties: Umgcini uzobe nolunotho ngemikhakha Eyiphutha Eziyisibopho: Ukulungelelanisa inqubo yokuhlela ukuze kulethwe izinkundla ze-ETD (isb., bukhose ubuso emehlule, e-learning kanye nokuqeqesha okuxutshwe). Ukulawula ukubhukha ngemitho kungavezi inani lesibhaliswe ngokempela. Ukulungelelanisa ukungenelelwa kwe-ETD kwezinsiza zabathakayo, abahlinzeki basevisi abahlelekile, kanye namabhizinisi abangekhayini. Ukulawula inqubomgomo yekhombe izinkundla kwezinsiza (isb. indawo kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwabantu). Ukubeka iqembu lezingcali nama-HEl's ngokuhambisana nekhaya labo lezenzo. Ukulungiselela amafayela amehlule kuqale ukuze adluliswe (izinhlelo zokubhaliswa ekugcineni, ukuqinisekiswa kwerekhodi ezibhaliwe, kanye namafayela okudluliswa okuvela kwesinye isithombe) kwaye adluliselwe kuma-Learner Records emva kwemibiko yokuqeqesha. Ukulawula abathakayo ababuye nabalulekile (ukuhlela izinkomuzimbi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kohlangothi lomshwamatho womquba / uhlelo lokuhlela lwebhizinisi kuhambisana namasu abahunyi). Qhathanisa futhi uhlwaye impumelelo yalolunye ihlelo lokuqeqesha, uhlakule imibiko futhi ubone izindawo zokuthuthukisa. Ulawula inqubo eqhathanisa nokushicilelwa kwaye kugcinwe izinsiza ezenziwa ngokokuqeqesha (nendlela yokuzoqeqeshwa ubuso emehlule, inqubo ezenziwe ngekhaya ekhaya) kwaye zibe khona ngaphambi kokuba kungenelele i-ETD. Qaphela futhi ugcwalise izinsimbi zezinsiza zokuqeqesha ngesikhathi ngempumelelo nangokuhamba kwesikhathi. Qhathanisa ukuba muhle nokwenza imibuzo, iphuzu lesibali lesibali sokulinganiswa nokuhlola kwabathakayo kwaye idluliselwe kolunye uhhovo oluqhathanisayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo ezibhaliswe ezibhaliswe ugqamisa kwaye ngokushesha kutholwe imibiko esuka kwinani labantu ababike ngengcali kwezikhungo zemfundo ephezulu (ama-HEls) emva kokungenelelwa okwenziwe kwe-ETD. Ukuthatha amafayela kwindawo yakha kuye, ahle lafaniswe ngendlela yokuxhumana nabathakayo angaphandle ukuba kungakhethwa uhlelo. Ulawula izinga lokunikelwa kwabahlinzeki, i-inqubo yokuhlela imibhali yokudluliswa kwabantu futhi ibe yindlela ekucacile, ngokuhambisana nesithombe esifanele kwekhombe lekhaya. Thatha ukubheka izinkundla ze-ETD esikhathini (ngaphakathi komnyango nakuyena abangaphandle) ukuqinisekisa izinhlobonhlobo zempilo. Qhathanisa izinga nokusebenza kwabahlinzeki basevisi abaphethe imibhali yabantu, izindawo, nokushicilelwa ngemibhali, ngokuhambisana namaphoyisa nezimo ezihlelekile ze-NSG. Ukwazisa ngamaphuzu aqinisekisiwe we-NSG, kubakhipha, abahleleli beminzimuii. Nikeza isikhuthazo ekusingeni kwenani elingana ngokushintsha izinkondolo ezibhekene nohlelo lwemfundo ngaphandle kokulungisa izinsizakusebenza. Ulawula futhi uqinisekise ulwazi olungenwa ohlelweni. Ukuqinisekisa isibuyekelo se-ETD esingenwa ohlelweni, ngokuqapha okuhlanu okuhamba phambili nokuxhumanisa nososhozabozi bekhaya. Ukuqinisekisa isinifinyezo nokuphathwa kolwazi lwemfuyo ye-Learner ohlelweni. Xhumana nama-Learner Records emva kokuba sekwenziwe inkinga yokusebenza abantu kakhulu kanye nezitifiketi. Ulawula izinsiza (abantu, izimali, izimiso, izimpahla) ezenzelwa esibhedlela esingezansi. Faka amasu okulawula kwemisebenzi kuleminzimuzim, okuhlanganise inkinga yokuxazulula imigqago, izinqubo ezihleliwe ezinhle, ukuqashwa kwamafayela webhizinisi, ukugcina izinga eliphelele lomphila wesevisi kanye nezinguquko zedijithali. Susa isinkethelo iyunifomu kanye nohlelo lokuqeqesha oluchwensa isibuyelo, futhi ohlelo iyunifomu ohlakaniphile lokwaziswa ngokushesha okukhulu. Uhlwaye futhi ulawule izengozi ezingezansi ezinkulu kakhulu, kanye nohlelo lokuqedela, okuhlanganisa nohlelo lwakho ngokuqhubeka ngokuhamba phambili. Ulawule iqembu labasebenzi, ababeke ukuthi baye bakwenze imisebenzi ebekiwe ngokunethezeku, nangokunethezeka, ngokushesha, nangokunethezeka nokufuna ukuthuthukisa nokuphumelela kuyo yonke imisebenzi.

xh.title: Umncedisi woBhalo: Ulungelelaniso lwe-ETD
xh.summary: Lungelelanisa iminyhadlo yemfundo, uqeqesho nophuhliso, kuquka ucwangciso, amabukingi amaninzi kunye nezikholelwa zabakhuseli kwiziko lesiKolo soRhulumente sasePretoria.
xh.requirements: Ifundo ephilileyo egqityiweyo kwindawo (NQF Level 6) kwiNtshukumbo yoPhuhliso lwabasebenzi, ulawulo bhasikidi nokulawulo iShishini, ulawulo lwezaLuthuli zorhulumente nokulawulo iShishini, ulawulo lweNkqubo, okanye ulawulo lweProjekthi. Isipili: 3 yeminyaka yamava kwilungelelaniso lemfundo, uqeqesho, nophuhliso (ETD) okanye ukusebenza kwendawo ye-ETD, kuquka namava okulawula. Umntu ofumana lesi sithuba uya kuhlolwa ngokhuseleko, inqanaba eliya kumiselwa lona. Ulwazi: Ukuqonda kakuhle ngendawo yemfundo, uqeqesho, nophuhliso (ETD). Ulwazi lolwazi lwe-ETD ulungelelaniso okanye ulungelelaniso lenkonzo yabakhuseli. Ukusetyenziswa kobuchule bendalo yamathumba njengamathulusi wesohfwe kunye nekhompyutha. Ukuqonda kakuhle ngowurhulumente, iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo, namagqinintsho esilawulo asekuthintweni (kuquka kodwa ungagqitywa koku: Umthetho wezaLuthuli zorhulumente; Umthetho woLawulo bePhatho kunye noLawulo iShishini; Amagqinintsho oLawulo bezaLuthuli). Ulwazi ngeemithi yobuchule nemfuno yomthi olawulayo (umz. isiGunya samaQinisekiso saseMzantsi Afrika, iBhunga leNgangatho lemaQhinga neSebe, iBhunga lemfundo ePhezulu). Ukuchaseka kwikhompyutha kumgangatho ophakamileyo, kuquka nolwazi olugqwesiweyo lokusebenza nokwazi iqela le-MS Office kwaye nalula ukubala imigca yamaxwebhu. Imigaqo yeBatho Pele. Amaphawu: Ulawulo lweziganeko kunye neeprojekthi. Ulawulo lwexesha. Amaphawu amakhulu okubamba iqabane elingomntu. Amaphawu okusombulula iingxaki. Iindlela zokuphanda nokubala imigca yamaxwebhu. Amaphawu amakhulu okulungelelanisa nokucwangcisa. Ukuchaseka kwikhompyutha kwiMicrosoft Office Suite nakwezinye iindlela ezibalulekileyo. Amaphawu obuchule bokubhala, kuquka nokubhala iingxelo, iingxelo ezibhaliweyo namaphaphu. Amaphawu obuchule obusesikweni sekhompyutha ukusebenza kwimiilingo yesikolo nakwiinkqubo ezikwiikhompyutha, kulawulo kwaye kukubika. Amaphawu amakhulu okulawula iingxabano. Amaphawu obuchule bokudala nokubala. Iimpawu zobuntu: Ngenela imisebenzi yokuphucula ulwazi lobuchule ukugcina ulwazi lobuchule kwaye ugcine ngokuqhuba ngeendlela ezintsha zoshisho. Amandla okwenza imisebenzi emininzi kwaye ulungelelanise, abe phambili, aze alandele imisebenzi emininzi kunye neeprojekthi ukuya kuye igqitywe ngokuchasa iingcango. Amandla okusebenza eyedwa ngelixa unikeza ngenkxaso kwimiilingo yesikolo. Amandla okubala iingxaki, ukuchonga iindlela zokuzisombulula kwaye wenze isigqibo, ukusombulula iingxabano usebenzisa isigqibo esizimeleyo. Amandla okwakha kwaye agcine ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nalawulo, abasebenzi, bathintu, nakubantu. Ukuqina nokuqinisekisa; ukuchasa iingcango; ukudala nokuvelisa izinto ezintsha; amandla okusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo. Kuhambe kwaye usebenze iiyure ezinde.
xh.duties: Umntu oze kuhlala kulesi sithuba uya kuba nesibeki kule ndawo elandelayo ezibalulekileyo: Ulungelelanisa inkqubo yokucwangcisa ukuhanjiswa kweziganeko ze-ETD (umzekelo, uqeqesho olubonwayo, olusesikweni sekhompyutha, noluhlotyeni). Lawula amabukingi amaninzi angengcweli inani elibukiweyo ngokwenene. Ulungelelanisa iinkalo zokuNika isakhono kumasebe abakhuseli, abahanisiweyo abaqulezelela iinkonzo, namaphandle eeshishini. Lawula iinkqubo ezinxulumene nokuthengwa kwezinto ezifuna isikhongozeli (umz. indawo nokutya). Ukusebenzisa iqela leengcali nama-HEI ngokwemimandla yazo ebalulekileyo. Lungiselela iifayile zezimo zokuhanjiswa (izitatu zokubakho ezigqityiweyo, ukuqinisekisa amarekhodi ezinyukiweyo, iimemo ezingaqhelekanga/izibhalo) kwaye zityalelwe kwiRekhodi leZifundi emva kweemveliso zekhosi. Ulawulo lwabakhuseli abaphambili (ucwangcise iindibano, qinisekise ukusebenza kwemigca yemisebenzi ye-MOU/MOA). Qonda kwaye ulinganise impumelelo yalunye ngalunye ulwazi lwe-ETD, ulungise iingxelo aze achonge iindawo ezifuna ukuphuculwa. Lawula izinto ezinxulumene nokushicilela nokupakisha izixhobo zekhosi (kuqeqesho olubonwayo) nokuhanjiswa ngaphambi kokungena kwi-ETD intervention. Qonda kwaye uzalise izinqanaba zegcino lezixhobo zekhosi ngexesha elifanelekileyo nangokusebenziseyo. Qinisekisa ukusasazwa nokugqitywa kweefomu ezibuzwayo zeziqondo zabafundi nokuzezwa eUniti yesishishini. Qinisekisa ukuba izitatu zabakho zigqitywe ngokupheleleyo nokuba iingxelo zifunyenwe ngokukhawuleza kwigqiza leengcali naseziko lemfundo ephakamileyo (ama-HEI) emva kokungena kwi-ETD intervention. Qinisekisa ubungakanani bamaxwebhu abhalwe ngesandla nasekhusi lekhompyutha efunyenwe kwiziko lenkontakhi phambi kwemisebenzi yolungelelaniso. Lawula ubungakanani bezixhobo zekhosi ezisasazwayo ngokwemigaqo egunyazisiweyo phambi kokushicilelwa nangaphambi kokuthumela kubakhuseli. Yenza iindwendwe ezingatyelelwa rhoqo kwindawo ze-ETD (ngaphakathi nangaphandle) ukuqinisekisa iinqanaba zomgangatho. Qonda kwaye ulinganise umgangatho nokuvela kwabaqulezelela iinkonzo abathwele inxaxheba ekunikezweni kokutya, iindawo, nasekushicini ngokwezithembiso namagqinintsho e-NSG. Yenza abakhuseli baziwe ngeMagqinintsho e-NSG, koBaluli besebe. Nikela ngenkxaso ekuqaliseni iqela labaqulezelela iinkonzo abahanisiweyo nama-HEI kwaye uncede ekuboniseni ngemisebenzi efanekiselwa kwiqela labaqulezelela iinkonzo. Lawula kwaye uqinisekise ukuchaneka kwamaxwebhu ezinyukiweyo kwinkqubo. Qinisekisa umgangatho we-ETD interventions kwindalo yesixhobo esisebenzayo, ngokulawula ngokuqhubekayo nangokusebenzisana nabaphathi beenkqubo. Lawula ukuzinza kwamaxwebhu nokhuseleko lolwazi lwabucala lwesifundi kwinkqubo. Sebenzisana neLifayile leZifundi emva kwesikhendlelo sese-ETD ukukhulula iintlawulo nezatifikethi. Lawula izixhobo (abantu, iimali, iinkqubo, izinto) ezabelwe kulo msebenzi. Lawula iinkqubo ezingundoqo kwalo msebenzi oceliweyo, kuquka ukumiselwa kwezinga lenkonzo, iinkqubo ezisesikweni zokusebenza, ulawulo lweenkqubo zeshishini, ulawulo olupheleleyo lomgangatho nenguqu ekusebenziseni iikhompyutha. Phuhlisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo neezicwangciso ngenjongo yokufikelela kuwo amagqabantshishi omsebenzi nezidingo zendawo, kuquka nokubika ngokwenza njalo ngenyanga. Chonga kwaye ulawule iingozi ezibalulekileyo nangemisebenzi yawo, kunye neendwela zokuYeka iingozi, kuquka namacebo okuqhuba ishishini. Lawula iqela labasebenzi, abalindeleke ukuba baqede imisebenzi ebaluliweyo ngokusebenzisa, ngokuchanekileyo, nangobuchule, nakuzama ukuphucula nokupumelela kuwo onke amagqabantshishi abo.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Management Practitioner
jobs.summary: Supply Chain Management Practitioner sought by the National School of Government in Pretoria to support SCM policy development, audit compliance and research activities.
jobs.requirements: A tertiary qualification at (NQF level 6) in Logistics Management, Purchasing Management, Supply Chain Management or Commerce. Experience: one (1) to two (2) years relevant experience in supply management. Knowledge: Public sector legislation, relevant policies and applicable legislative frameworks (including but not limited to: Public Service Act; Public Administration Management Act; Public Finance Management Act. Treasury Regulations, and SCM Practice Notes. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act and Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment. Microsoft Office suite, especially Word, PowerPoint, and Excel. Administration of LOGIS and BAS systems. Virtual meetings (organise, host, record, transcript). Meetings management (scheduling, agenda setting, recording, minute taking, action plans). Document management. Batho Pele principles. Skills: Oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Good writing and presentation skills. Problem solving skills. Operations management skills. Financial management skills. Capabilities: Planning and organising. Programme and project management. Problem solving and analysis. Client orientation and customer focus. Analytics and research. Personal Attributes: Ability to multitask and organise, prioritise, and follow multiple projects and tasks through to completion with attention to detail. Ability to work independently while contributing to a team environment. Commitment to quality and continuous learning. Professional behaviour and sound judgement. Integrity and honesty; detail-oriented; creative and innovative; ability to work under pressure. Travel and work with extended hours, including away from office, may be required.
jobs.duties: Provide administrative support in the development, implementation and monitoring of supply chain management policies, frameworks, and practice notes. Support supply chain management audit and compliance processes. Conduct elementary research as required by the Director to support the implementation and monitoring of supply chain policies, frameworks, and practice notes. Support awareness and communication initiatives to empower NSG officials on SCM matters. Provide general technical and administrative advice to NSG officials, service providers and clients on SCM matters. Provide support in the development and implementation of asset needs assessment, asset acquisitions, operational and asset disposal plans. Ensure the implementation of preferential procurement policy objectives. Ensure that received assets are barcoded, accurate updating of the asset register and monthly reconciliation with supporting documents. Plan and undertake the assets verification, in stock counts, investigate and report on variances, make necessary recommendations to resolve discrepancies. Provide support to obsolescence planning or depreciation rates, management of losses, write offs, redundant and disposal of assets, inventory, and consumables. Provide administrative and secretariat support to the relevant committees related to asset management, as may be required. Provide support in the development and implementation of procurement needs assessment (including future needs), acquisitions, and management. Assess the value of goods and services to be procured, determine optimal acquisition process, commodity and industry analysis, and request response from registered suppliers or activate a bidding response. Compile and source requests for quotations for procurement using the Central Supplier Database (CSD), undertake prescribed evaluation processes, conduct appropriate clearance of the preferred bidder and facilitate contractual bidding processes. Check completeness of documentation and compliance against supply chain management principles and thresholds. Provide support in the development of bidding documents in accordance with relevant policies, including briefing sessions. Provide administrative and secretariat support to the relevant committees related to acquisition and demand management, including the Bid Committees, as may be required. Prepare appointment letters, maintain, and update contract register and liaise with relevant managers for contract management. Assist in the identification and determination of irregular, fruitless and wasteful expenditure. Undertake all aspects of warehouse management, stocktaking, including submission of stocktaking reports per sub-inventory, compilation and updating of stock inventories. Ensure that stock levels are determined, maintained, available upon demand and that proper internal controls are in place. Undertake verification of suppliers in line with applicable prescripts, accurate placement of orders and updating of systems. Manage the performance of vendors, including addressing instances of under- or non-performance against pre- determined standards. Receive invoices from centralised system and forward to relevant line managers. Ensure accurate and verified placement of orders, and payment of suppliers within 30 days. Implement an effective document control and filling systems. Ensure fair and equitable distribution of goods across the NSG. Implement effective and efficient supply chain management systems, including daily capturing, verification, and management on the LOGIS and BAS systems. Ensure the effective monitoring and evaluation of supply chain practices and processes. Maintain close working relationships with other relevant units in the NSG and other key external stakeholders to ensure efficient supply chain management. Administer project accounts (e.g., courier and travel services) as may be determined. Implement effective operations management. including service standards, standard operating procedures, business process management. total quality management and digital transformation. Provide monthly and quarterly inputs on financial and non- financial performance of the Directorate.
