af.title: Supply Chain Management Practitioner
af.summary: Die National School of Government in Pretoria soek 'n Supply Chain Management Practitioner om beleidsontwikkeling vir SCM, oudit-nakoming en navorsingsaktiwiteite te ondersteun.
af.requirements: 'n Tersiêre kwalifikasie op (NQF level 6) in Logistieke Bestuur, Aankopebestuur, Supply Chain Management of Handelswese. Ervaring: een (1) tot twee (2) jaar relevante ervaring in voorsieningsbestuur. Kennis: Openbare sektor wetgewing, relevante beleide en toepaslike wetlike raamwerke (insluitend maar nie beperk tot: Public Service Act; Public Administration Management Act; Public Finance Management Act. Treasury Regulations, en SCM Practice Notes. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act en Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment. Microsoft Office-suite, veral Word, PowerPoint en Excel. Administrasie van LOGIS- en BAS-stelsels. Virtuele vergaderings (reël, huisves, opneem, transkripsie). Vergaderingsbestuur (skedulering, agenda-opstelling, opname, notuleverglywing, aksieplanne). Dokumentbestuur. Batho Pele-beginsels. Vaardighede: Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Sterk interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie skryf- en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Operasionele bestuursvaardighede. Finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Vermoëns: Beplanning en organisering. Program- en projekbestuur. Probleemoplossing en analise. Kliëntoriëntasie en klieënsfokus. Analise en navorsing. Persoonlike eienskappe: Vermoë om veelvuldige take uit te voer en te organiseer, te prioritiseer, en veelvuldige projekte en take tot voltooiing deur te voer met aandag aan detail. Vermoë om onafhanklik te werk terwyl bygedra word tot 'n spanomgewing. Toewyding aan gehalte en deurlopende leer. Professionele gedrag en goeie oordeel. Integriteit en eerlikheid; detail-georiënteerd; kreatief en innoverend; vermoë om onder druk te werk. Reis en werk met verlengde ure, insluitend weg van die kantoor, kan vereis word.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning in die ontwikkeling, implementering en monitering van supply chain management-beleide, raamwerke en oefennotas. Ondersteun supply chain management-oudit- en nakomingsprosesse. Voer elementêre navorsing uit soos deur die Direkteur vereis om die implementering en monitering van supply chain-beleide, raamwerke en oefennotas te ondersteun. Ondersteun bewusmakings- en kommunikasie-inisiatiewe om NSG-amptenare oor SCM-aangeleenthede in te lig. Verskaf algemene tegniese en administratiewe advies aan NSG-amptenare, diensverskaffers en kliënte oor SCM-aangeleenthede. Verskaf ondersteuning in die ontwikkeling en implementering van batesbehoeftesbepaling, batesverkrygings, operasionele en batesbesittingsplanne. Verseker die implementering van voorkeurverkrygingsbeleid-doelwitte. Verseker dat ontvangde bates van strepieskodes voorsien word, akkurate bywerking van die batesregister en maandelikse vereffening met ondersteunende dokumente. Beplan en onderneem batesverifikasie, voorraadtellings, ondersoek en rapporteer oor afwykings, maak noodsaaklike aanbevelings om teenstrydighede op te los. Verskaf ondersteuning aan verouderingsbeplanning of afskrywingstempies, bestuur van verliese, afskryfings, oortollige en beskikking oor bates, voorraad en verbruikbare items. Verskaf administratiewe en sekretariaatsondersteuning aan die relevante komitees verbonde aan batesbestuur, soos vereis. Verskaf ondersteuning in die ontwikkeling en implementering van verkrygingsbehoeftesbepaling (insluitend toekomstige behoeftes), verkrygings en bestuur. Assessering van die waarde van goedere en dienste wat verkry moet word, bepaal optimale verkrygingsproses, kommoditeits- en bedryfsanalise, en versoek reaksie van geregistreerde verskaffers of aktiveer 'n biedreaksie. Stel en verkry versoeke vir kwotasies vir verkryging deur die Central Supplier Database (CSD) te gebruik, onderneem voorgeskrewe evalueringsprosesse, voer toepaslike keuring van die voorkeurbieder uit en fasiliteer kontraktuele biedprosesse. Kontroleer volledigheid van dokumentasie en nakoming teen supply chain management-beginsels en -drempels. Verskaf ondersteuning in die ontwikkeling van bieddokumente in ooreenstemming met relevante beleide, insluitend inligtingsessies. Verskaf administratiewe en sekretariaatsondersteuning aan die relevante komitees verbonde aan verkryging en aanvraagbestuur, insluitend die Bid Committees, soos vereis. Berei aanstellingsbriewe voor, onderhou en werk die kontrakregister by en skakel met relevante bestuurders vir kontrakbestuur. Bystand in die identifisering en bepaling van onreëlmatige, onvrugbare en vermorsende uitgawes. Onderneem alle aspekte van pakhuisbestuur, voorraadopname, insluitend indiening van voorraadopnameverslae per sub-voorraad, samestelling en bywerking van voorraad-inventarisse. Verseker dat voorraadvlakke bepaal, gehandhaaf en op aanvraag beskikbaar is en dat behoorlike interne kontroles in plek is. Onderneem verifikasie van verskaffers in ooreenstemming met toepaslike voorskrifte, akkurate plasing van bestellings en bywerking van stelsels. Bestuur die prestasie van verskaffers, insluitend die hantering van gevalle van onder- of nie-prestasie teen voorafbepaalde standaarde. Ontvang fakture van die gesentraliseerde stelsel en stuur dit deur na relevante lynbestuurders. Verseker akkurate en geverifieerde plasing van bestellings, en betaling van verskaffers binne 30 dae. Implementeer 'n effektiewe dokumkontrole- en lêerstelsel. Verseker billike en regverdige verspreiding van goedere oor die NSG. Implementeer effektiewe en doeltreffende supply chain management-stelsels, insluitend daaglikse vaslegging, verifikasie en bestuur op die LOGIS- en BAS-stelsels. Verseker die effektiewe monitering en evaluering van supply chain-praktyke en -prosesse. Handhaaf noue werksverhoudings met ander relevante eenhede in die NSG en ander sleutel eksterne belanghebbendes om doeltreffende supply chain management te verseker. Administreer projekrekeninge (bv. koerier- en reisdiens) soos bepaal. Implementeer effektiewe operasionele bestuur, insluitend diensstandaarde, standaard bedryfsprosedures, besigheidsprosesbestuur, totale gehaltebestuur en digitale transformasie. Verskaf maandelikse en kwartaallikse insette oor finansiële en nie-finansiële prestasie van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umuntu ophethe izindaba zokuLawula Umhwebo wezimpahla
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumuntu ophethe izindaba zokuLawula Umhwebo wezimpahla sifunwa i-National School of Government e-Pretoria ukuze kunikezwe inkxaso ekuthuthukisweni komthethosisekelo we-SCM, ekuhambisaneni nokuhlola, nakumisebenzi yocwaningo.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zesikole samabanga aphakeme ezingeni le-(NQF level 6) ekuqineni Logistics Management, Purchasing Management, Supply Chain Management noma i-Commerce. Isipiliyoni: unyaka owodwa (1) kuya kowabili (2) isipiliyoni esihambisanayo ekuphathweni kwempahla. Ulwazi: Umthetho weqembu likahulumeni, imithethosisekelo ehambisanayo namaphuzu abalulekile omtsetho (okuhlanganisa kodwa okungagcoshi ku: Public Service Act; Public Administration Management Act; Public Finance Management Act. Treasury Regulations, kanye ne-SCM Practice Notes. Preferential Procurement Policy Framework Act kanye ne-Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment. Isuiti ye-Microsoft Office, ikakhulukazi i-Word, PowerPoint, ne-Excel. Ukuphathwa kwe-LOGIS kanye namasistimu we-BAS. Izinkumpane ezibonakalayo (ukuhlela, ukubamba, ukurekhoda, ukubhala izinkulumo). Ukuphathwa kwemihlangano (ukuhlela isikhathi, ukubeka ihlelo lokuhlangenwa, ukurekhoda, ukuthatha iminuzi, amaphuzu okwenza). Ukuphathwa koxhumano. Imigomo ye-Batho Pele. Amakhono: Amakhono okuxoxa nokubhala. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu. Amakhono amahle okubhala nokuthatha inkulumo. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga. Amakhono okuphatha imisebenzi. Amakhono okuphatha imali. Ikhono lokubakho: Ukuhlela nokuhlelemba. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo kanye nokuqashwa kwemisebenzi. Ukuxazulula nokuhlaziya izinkinga. Ukuqondiswa ikhasimende nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuhlaziya nokucwaninga. Izici zabantu: Ikhono lokwenza izinto eziningi ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukuhlela, ukubeka izinto ezibalulekile, kanye nokulandela imisebenzi eminingi neziyingxenye kuze kuphumelele kunakwazilinganisa imininingwane. Ikhono lokusebenza kwodwa ngenkathi kufaka umnikelo kwindawo yeqembu. Ukuzibophezela ekwenzeni okuhle nokuqhubeka nokufunda. Ukuziphatha ngobungcweti kanye nokuhluleka okuhlakaniphile. Ukuziphatha kokuqotho nokwethembeka; ukugxila emininingwaneni; ukuba nomqondo omdala nokuba yinto entsha; ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegqondo. Kungadingeka ukuhamba kwaye usebenzeamasihla amahle amaningi, okuhlanganisa nokuvela endaweni yokusebenza.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkxaso yokuphatha ekuthuthukiseni, ekusetshenziseni nasekuqaphelelweni kwezinhlelo zomthethosisekelo zokuLawula Umhwebo wezimpahla, imigomo, kanye neminuzo yesenzo. Hlola inkxaso yokuLawula Umhwebo wezimpahla kumapulokisi okuvumelana nemithetho. Qhuba ucwaningo oluyisisekelo njengoba kudingwa ngumqondisi ukuze kunikezwe inkxaso ekusetshenzisweni nasekuqaphelelweni kwezinhlelo zomthethosisekelo zokuLawula Umhwebo wezimpahla, imigomo, kanye neminuzo yesenzo. Nikeza inkxaso ekuletheni izinkumbuzo nasekuxhumaneni ukuze kwamathelwe amaphova abasebenzi be-NSG ngemithetho yokuLawula Umhwebo wezimpahla. Nikeza imibono yobuchwepheshe nayo yegulu elijwayelekile kumaphova abasebenzi be-NSG, abakhi bezinkonzo, nakumakhasimende ngemithetho yokuLawula Umhwebo wezimpahla. Nikeza inkxaso ekuthuthukisweni nokusetshenzisweni kokuqinisekisa izidingo zempahla, ekuthengweni kwempahla, kumaphuzu okulahla impahla. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinhloso zemithetho yokuLawula Umhwebo yesidingo esikhethwa kakhulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi impahla etholwe ibhalwe ikhodi yebakhodi, ukubuyekeza ngokunembile igunya lokuqaphela impahla kanye nokuqondanisa nsuku zonke emibhalweni ehlulekile. Hlela futhi wenze ukuqinisekiswa kwempahla, ekubaleni impahla esitweni, cwaninga futhi uluze mayelana nokungahambisani,enze izincoma ezidingekayo ukuxazulula ukungafani. Nikeza inkxaso ekuletheni ukucatshangelwa kwokungalabolwa kwempahla, izinga lokwehliseka kwentengo yokuphela kobuncweti, ekuphathweni kokulahleka, ukususwa kwemali okungalunganga, imali ebekwe idle kanye nokulahla impahla, impahla egciniwe, kanye nezinto ezibuzwayo ezisetshenziswayo. Nikeza inkxaso yokuphatha nokuba yilungu lesikhulu lekomidi elihlobene nokuqaphela impahla, njengoba kungadingwa. Nikeza inkxaso ekuthuthukisweni nokusetshenzisweni kokuqinisekisa izidingo ezitholwa (okuhlanganana nezidingo zekusasa), ezithengwa, nasekuphathweni. Hlola inani lethovu namasevisi ezidingwa ukuthengwa, qinisekisa inqubo yokuthenga, ukuloleka kwezimpahla kanye nocwaningo olwenziwe, futhi ucele impendulo kwabathengisi ababhaliwe noma uvuse impendulo yokuqashwa. Qamba futhi uce imibuzo yokubiza imibhalo yokuthenga ukubiza ngokusebenzisa u-(CSD) isiphakamido sendlela yokugcina imininingwane yabahlinzeki abakhethwayo, qhuba izinqubo ezithunyelwe zokuqinisekisa, zama ukuxazulula okuhambisana nomthengisi okhethiwe, futhi wenze kubelula izinqubo zokuqashwa ngokuvumelana nemithetho. Bheka ukuphela ngokwanele kokuxhumanayo nokuvumelana nemithetho yokuLawula Umhwebo wezimpahla. Nikeza inkxaso ekuthuthukisweni kwemibhalo yokuqashwa ngokuvumelana imithethosisekelo ehambisana, okuhlanganana nezinkulumo efini. Nikeza inkxaso yokuphatha nokuba yilungu lesikhulu lekomidi elihlobene nokuthenga nokuphatha ngenkani njengoba kungadingwa. Bhala imibhalo yokubekwa esikhundleni, gcina, futhi buyekeza igunya lokuqaphela imithetho, bese uxhumana nabaphathi abahambisanayo ngokuphathwa komthetho. Siza ekubonukeni nokuqinisekisweni kwemali ebilikabhomu, engabi nakuhole kanye nokuphela kwemali engasebenziswa ngokungalungile. Zama zonke izinhlangothi zokuphathwa kwendawo egcinwa kuyo impahla, ukubala impahla, okuhlanganana nokuthumela imibalo yokuthola impahla ngasinye isibuzo, ukwenza kubuyekeze impahla egqamile. Qinisekisa ukuthi amazinga ephahla aquganiswa, agcinwe, abe khona uma esidingwa futhi ukuba izilawulo zangaphakathi ezihle zitholakala. Yenza ukuqinisekiswa kwabahlinzeki ngokuvumelana nemithetho efanayo, ukubeka amadilasi ngokunembile futhi uhleze izistimu. Phatha ukusebenza kwabahlinzeki, okuhlanganana nokubhekana nezimo zokungasebenzi kahle nokungasebenzi ngokuvumelana nemigomo eqinisekisiwe. Thola izibhili kusistimu egcwele futhi uzithumele kubaphathi bokuqeqesha. Qinisekisa ukuthi kubekwa amadilasi ngokunembile, nokukhokhelwa kwabahlinzeki kungakapheli amasonto angama-30. Setha isistimu yokulawula futhi uzalise imibhalu egcinwa kuyo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlotshaniswa futhi kubaliswa imali ehlele ngokufanele kuye kwonke amagatsha e-NSG. Setsha izistimu ezisebenzayo kwaye zikwazi ukwenza okuhle, okuhlanganana nokubala nsuku zonke, ukuqinisekisa, futhi kuphathweni kwesistimu ye-LOGIS noma i-BAS. Qinisekisa ukuphenya kwaye kubuyekezeke izinqubo zokuLawula Umhwebo wezimpahla. Gcina ubuhlobo obuseduze namanye amayunithi ahambisanayo ku-NSG kanye namanye abaphathi abalulekile bangaphandle ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawula okusebenzayo Umhwebo wezimpahla. Phatha amaphova womsebenzi njengoba kungadingwa. Setsha ukuphatha imisebenzi esebenza kakhulu. okuhlanganana nemigomo yesevisi, inqubo emila efanele, ukuphathwa kwenqubo yebhizinisi, ukuphatha inani eliphelele, ukuqamba izinto kwesikhathi esiphila khona. Nikeza imibono yanyanga zonke futhi nenyanga ezinkathu ngokuphumelela imali noma okungeyona imali eqoqwa yiDirectorate.

xh.title: Umsebenzi woLawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso
xh.summary: KuSebe leSizwe looLulingqangi ePretoria kufunwa umsebenzi woLawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso onikela inkxaso ekuthuthukiseni iinkqubo zoLawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso, ekubambeleleni kwesikhalazo nasekwenzeni uphando.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esiphakamileyo kwisigaba se (NQF level 6) kuLawulo loQhingqoqho, kuLawulo loKuthenga, kuLawulo loQoqo-lwemveliso okanye ekuRhwezeni. Isipili: iya kuthi ngaphezulu kobunye (1) ukuya kwawesibini (2) iminyaka isipili ehambelana nolawulo lokuthenga. Ulwazi: uMthetho ngaphakathi kwicandelo likarhulumente, iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo nemithetho esebenzayo (kuquka kodwa ingagqityeli: uMthetho woMthetho woLuntu; uMthetho woLawulo lwoLwalamulo lwoLuntu; uMthetho woLawulo lweMali yoRhulumente. Iingqungquthela zeQhina lweMali, kunye neNcwadana zoQhingqoqho zoQoqo-lwemveliso. uMthetho woSiseko woThengiso oNqamlayo noNyuzamo lweQoqo-rhulumente eBekwa ngokuQhelekileyo nakuBini. Umba weMicrosoft Office, ngokukodwa iNcwadi, iPowerPoint, kunye neExcel. Ulawulo lweNkqubo yeLOGIS neBAS. Iintshumayelo ezibonwa ngamehlo (ukuqamba, ukumkhusela, ukurekhoda, ukuguqula kumninzi). Ulawulo lweentshumayelo (ukucwangcisa, ukumisela ihlelo, ukurekhoda, ukuthabatha imizuzu, iinkqubo zenzo). Ulawulo lwezixhobo ezibhalwayo. iNkqubo iBatho Pele. Amakhono: Amakhono okuthetha nokubhala. Amakhono amakhulu okuhlobana nabantu. Amakhono amakhulu okubhala nokubonisa. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki. Amakhono olawulo lweendlebo zomsebenzi. Amakhono olawulo lweemali. Iikhapabhiliti: Ulungiselelo lweNdlela. Ulawulo lweNkqubo namaphulo. Ukuhlaziya iingxaki nokuziphendulela. Iindlela zokuJongana neeKlayenti nokugxila kubomi babo. Ikhono lokuhlola nokuphanda. Iimpawu zobuNhlobo: Ikhono lokwenza izinto ezininzi ngesixa sinye nokuqamba, ukuqamba ngokweenkqubo, nokuqhubela phambili iziphulo neeminikelo yomsebenzi de igqibe ngokuchanekileyo ngokukhathalela iinkcukacha. Ikhono lokusebenza kodwa ngaxeshanye ukunikela isandla kwindawo yokusebenza njengoluntu. Uzinzo kwingqwalasela nokufunda ngokuqhubekayo. Ukuziphatha okunesithunzi kunye nesigqibo esilungileyo. Intlonipho nenyaniso; kukhathalelwa iinkcukacha; ukuyila nokuqamba izinto ezintsha; ikhono lokusebenza ngixhesha elinzima. Kungenzeka kufunke ihambo nokuqhubeka nemiyalezo yeenyanga, kuquka nokusebenza kude nesihebe.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso ngokulawula ekuthuthukiseni, ekusebenziseni nakujolweni iinkqubo zoLawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zemigaqo. Nika inkxaso kwiinkqubo zesikhalazo nasekubambeleleni kolawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso. Yenza uphando olusuka kumagqabi nokukhankanywa ngumLawuli ukunikela inkxaso ekusebenziseni nasekujolweni iinkqubo zolawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso, iinkqubo, iinkqubo zemigaqo. Nikela inkxaso ekukhuthazeni nasekuxelelana ukuguquguquka abasebenzi beNSG ngemiba yolawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso. Nikela ingcebiso ngamalungiselelo obuchwepheshe kunye nolawulo kwabaqeqeshi beNSG, abaniki bedayimethi nakulowo na lowo usebenzisa iinkonzo ngemiba yolawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso. Yeka inkxaso kwimiba yokujonga iimfuno nemitjhini yokulungelelania izinto zexesho zekhompyutha, ukuthengwa kwezinto zexesho, kunye neenkqubo zokuphela kobomi bezinto zexesho. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwezigqibo zenkqubo yobuthelelo bokuthenga. Qinisekisa ukuba izinto ezithathiwe zigqitywe iikhowudi zebarowuda, ukulungiswa ngokuchanekileyo kweregoda yezinto ezithunyelwa kwaye unyaka wokuqondanisa ngeenyanga kunye namaphepha okuxhasa. Cwangcisa kwaye ulandele ukuqinisekiswa kwazo zonke izinto ezisisiseko, kwizibalo ezithathiweyo ngelixa kusahlolwa, uphando nokubika ngemiba ehlukileyo, wenze izinduliso ezifunekayo ukusombulula ezo meba. Yeka inkxaso ekusingatheni imiba yokugqithela kwixesha noma ukuba akukho qabho kakuhle kwaye uphawule ngemiba, ulawulo oluchithiweyo, iindonga ezingasuswa nasezicwangcisweni zokugqibezela izinto ezisisiseko, izinto ezibekiweyo nabezakuzo. Nikela inkxaso ngokulawula inkqubo nokuba ngumlawuli wekomiti nangemiba yokulawula izinto ezisisiseko, njengoko kungenzeka kufunke. Yeka inkxaso ekuthuthukiseni nokusebenzisa imiba yokulinganiselwa kweemfuno zokuthenga (kuquka neemfuno zexesha elizayo), ezithunyelwa, nakulawulo. Linganisela ixabiso lempahla nekonzo ezithengwayo, qinisekisa inkqubo ehambelana nethamsanqa kakhulu, ukulinganiselwa kwezinto ezithengwayo nezimveliso, kwaye ucele impendulo kubathengisi ababhalisiweyo okanye uvule impendulo yokuqokolelwa. Qamba kwaye ufune iimfuno zamaxabiso kwizinto ezithengwayo kusetyenziswa iData yaseMbindini yabaThengisi (CSD), landela iinkqubo ezichaziweyo zokuqwalasela, yenza ukucoca okuhambelana nomthengisi okhethiweyo kwaye ulawule iinkqubo zoqoqosho zethamsanqa. Qwalasela ukugqitywa kolwazi nokubambelela ngokuchasene neenqobo nengqiqo yolawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso nemitjhini. Nikela inkxaso ekubhalweni kwamaphepha okuthenga ngokuhambelana neenkqubo ezibalulekileyo, kuquka neziqendu zokwazisa. Nikela inkxaso ngokulawula inkqubo nokuba ngumlawuli wekomiti kumakhomithi axhenelekileyo ngokuthenga nokulinganiselwa kokufunwa, kuquka namaKomiti okuThenga, njengoko kufuneka. Lungiselela amagama okuziswa, zigqitywe ngokusetyenziswa, kwaye zilungiswe iregoda yeziqinisekiso, ulawule uluntu ngabaphathi abahambelanayo ngolawulo lweziqinisekiso. Siza ekuboneni nasekumiselweni kolwabiwo olungalunganga, olunganasipho nolubalekayo. Yenza bonke oonobangela wolawulo lwendlu yokugcina impahla, ukubala impahla, kuquka nokunika iingxelo ezithathiweyo kwento nento efakwe kwindlu, ukuqamba nokulungisa izinto ezithathiweyo ezibekwe kwisiko. Qinisekisa ukuba amanqanaba okubeka impahla aqinisekisiwe, agciniwe, afumaneka xa kufunwa kwaye kukho inkqubo elungileyo yolawulo ngaphakathi. Yenza ukubonwa kolwazi kwabaThengisi ngokuhambelana neemigaqo esebenzayo, ukubeka ngokuchanekileyo iiodolo nokulungisa iinkqubo. Lawula ukusebenza kwabaThengisi, kuquka nokubhekana neemeko zokungalawulanga okanye ukungasebenzi ngokuchasene neengqiqo ezichaziweyo ngaphambili. Amukele iintsalo ezisuka kwinkqubo ekuqhekthe kuzo aze athunyelwe kumanabala ahambelana nendlela emiyo. Qinisekisa ukubekwa kolwazi oluchanekileyo noluphathwayo ngokuchanekileyo, kwaye nentlawa yabaThengisi kwiintsuku ezili-30. Sebenzisa inkqubo yomthetho osezantsi nokuqaqumba kolwazi abhalwe ngokuchanekileyo. Qinisekisa ulwahl olungenabuhlungu lolwabiwo lwempahla kuzo zonke iindawo zeNSG. Sebenzisa iinkqubo ezisebenzayo ezilungele iinkqubo zolawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso, kuquka ukuthatha, ukuyibhala kwaye kwaye kuqatshwa iinkqubo ngemini ngosuku, ukuqinisekisa, nolawulo kwiinkqubo zeLOGIS neBAS. Qinisekisa ukulawula ngokuchanekileyo nokuqwalaselwa kweendlebo zolawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso nazo iinkqubo. Zigcine iindlela ezizodwa, kwindawo ezikufutshane nezinye iindawo ezifanayo zeNSG nakuwo nawaphi na amajelo abo bangaphandle abalulekileyo, qinisekisa ulawulo olulungele iinkqubo zolawulo loqoqo-lwemveliso. Lawula iifayile zesiphelo (umzekelo, inkonzo yokuthumela nokuhambe) njengoko kungenzeka kugqitywe. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zolawulo olusebenzayo. Koko kuquka iinkqubo, iinkqubo ngokwenkqubo, iinkqubo zemigaqo, ulawulo lwenkqubo yeshishini. ukulawula iingqiqo ngokupheleleyo nokuqhwesha inkqubo ngokusetyenziswa kwekhompyutha. Nikela imibhalo kwinyanga nakwisihlandlo ngamnye ngemiba yemali eyiyo neengqiqo ezilawulwa ngumLawuli.

jobs.title: Registrar
jobs.centre: Free State Division of The High Court: Bloemfontein
jobs.salary_text: R337 563 - R1 155 777 per annum (MR3-MR5), Salary will be in accordance with Occupation Specific Dispensation (Resolution 1 of 2008). Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit service certificate/s for determination of their experience. The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: Registrar sought for the Free State High Court in Bloemfontein to co-ordinate case flow management, handle taxation of bills of cost, and manage court processes, requiring an LLB degree and minimum two years' legal experience.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of an LLB Degree or a four (4) year legal qualification. A minimum of two (2) years’ legal experience obtained after qualification. MR3: LLB degree or equivalent qualification plus a minimum of 2 years post qualification experience in a legal profession (certificates of service must accompany the application). MR4: LLB degree or equivalent qualification plus a minimum of 8 years post-qualification experience in a legal profession (certificates of service must accompany the application). MR5: LLB degree or equivalent qualification plus a minimum of 14 years post-qualification experience in a legal profession (certificates of service must accompany the application). A valid driver’s license. Superior court/litigation experience and supervisory experience will serve as an added advantage. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Knowledge and skills: Knowledge of Case Flow Management and legislative frameworks governing the Public Service. Skilled in excellent communication (verbal and written), planning, organising, problem solving, numeracy, conflict management, time management along with the following attributes: Attention to detail, professionalism, strong work ethics and ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Co-ordination of Case Flow Management and administrative support to the judiciary, comply with court rules and all relevant prescripts, handling taxation of bills of cost, manage the issuing of all processes and initiating of court proceedings, co-ordinate appeals and reviews, attend to and execute requests from the judiciary in connection with cases and case related matters, issue/sign court orders/letters to attorneys/litigants on behalf of the court, keep/check and analyse the court’s monthly, quarterly and annual statistics and monitor the submission thereof, implement effective and efficient administration of court files and records management, deal with the files in terms of the relevant codes and legislation, prepare and present files for audit purposes, ensure the submission of records for translation, attend/oversee to general public queries/correspondences, attend to office management, planning and organizing and manage staff and related HR processes.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr. S.P Mathibeli Tel No: (051) 492 4523 HR Related Enquiries: Ms D.S.J Peters Tel No: (051) 492 4523
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/92/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will, unfortunately, not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office of the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Registrateur
af.summary: Registrateur gesoek vir die Free State High Court in Bloemfontein om saakvloei-bestuur te koördineer, belasting van kosterekennings te behartig en hofprosesse te bestuur, met 'n LLB-graad en minimum twee jaar se regsonderervaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet 'n LLB-graad of 'n vier (4) jaar regskwalifikasie hê. 'n Minimum van twee (2) jaar se regsondervering wat na kwalifikasie verkry is. MR3: LLB-graad of ekwivalente kwalifikasie plus 'n minimum van 2 jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring in 'n regsberoep (dienssertifikate moet die aansoek vergesel). MR4: LLB-graad of ekwivalente kwalifikasie plus 'n minimum van 8 jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring in 'n regsberoep (dienssertifikate moet die aansoek vergesel). MR5: LLB-graad of ekwivalente kwalifikasie plus 'n minimum van 14 jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring in 'n regsberoep (dienssertifikate moet die aansoek vergesel). 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Hoëhof/litisasie-ervaring en toesighoudende ervaring sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Alle gekose kandidate, insluitend die SMS, moet twee voor-toelatings-assesserings onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteitsassering (etiese gedrag) wees. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van Saakvloei-bestuur en wetgewende raamwerke wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Vaardig in uitstekende kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), beplanning, organisering, probleemoplossing, syfergeletterdheid, konflikbestuur, tydbestuur tesame met die volgende eienskappe: Aandag aan detail, professionaliteit, sterk werksetiek en vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Koordineer van Saakvloei-bestuur en administratiewe ondersteuning aan die regbank, voldoen aan hofreëls en alle tersaaklike voorskripte, behartiging van belasting van kosterekennings, bestuur van die uitreiking van alle prosesse en inisiering van hofverrigtinge, koördineer van appèlle en hersienings, aandag gee aan en uitvoer van versoeke van die regbank in verband met sake en saakverwante aangeleenthede, uitreiking/ondertekening van hofbevele/briewe aan prokureurs/litigante namens die hof, hou/merk en ontleed die hof se maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse statistieke en monitor die indiening daarvan, implementeer van doeltreffende en effektiewe administrasie van hoflêers en rekordbestuur, hantering van lêers ooreenkomstig die tersaaklike kodes en wetgewing, voorbereiding en voorlegging van lêers vir ouditdoeleindes, verseker van die indiening van rekords vir vertaling, bywoon/ontoesig hou oor algemene openbare navrae/korrespondensie, aandag gee aan kantoorbestuur, beplanning en organisering en bestuur van personeel en verwante HR-prosesse.

zu.title: Umenzi wesikhundla sokubhalisa
zu.summary: Kufunwa umenzi wesikhundla sokubhalisa we Free State High Court e Bloemfontein ukuba ahlole ukuphatwa kokuqhubekea kwezinkantolo, aphathe inzuzo yemali yokwezimali, aphathe futhi ezinqubo zenkantolo, kudingwa iziqu ze-LLB kanye nokuhluleka okuncane eminyaka emibili ngaphansi komthetho.
zu.requirements: Abafakwayo kumele babe neziqu ze-LLB noma isiqu sezomthetho seminyaka emine (4). Kudinga okungenani iminyaka emibili (2) yokuhluleka kolwazi olusemqoka. MR3: iziqu ze-LLB noma isiqu esilinganayo kanye nenani elifushaniselwe eminyakeni engu-2 lokuqeqeshwa ngaphansi komthetho (izitifiketi zokusebenza kumele zihambisane nesicelo). MR4: iziqu ze-LLB noma isiqu esilinganayo kanye nenani elifushaniselwe eminyakeni engu-8 lokuqeqeshwa ngaphansi komthetho (izitifiketi zokusebenza kumele zihambisane nesicelo). MR5: iziqu ze-LLB noma isiqu esilinganayo kanye nenani elifushaniselwe eminyakeni engu-14 lokuqeqeshwa ngaphansi komthetho (izitifiketi zokusebenza kumele zihambisane nesicelo). Ilayisense esemthethweni yokushayela. Ulwazi lwenkantolo ephakeme/ezinkingisweni kanye nolwazi lokuphatha kuzoba yinzuzo ephethwe kakhulu. Onke abafakela izinhlelo abafakiwe ohlwini, kuhlanganise ne-SMS, bazokwenza okuhlola kokuqala kwezinkomba ezimbili. Okunye kuzoba kukuzenzakatsela okwenza izinto ukuze kubonakale ukuthi umfaki ufanele yini ngesisekelo sezidingo ezinkimbinkimbi nangokuvamile zaleso sikhundla, okunye kumele kube ukuhlola ukuziphatha ngokungcolile. Ulwazi nokunakwa okusemqoka: Ulwazi lokuqondisa ukugqama kwezinkantolo kanye namashekede womthetho aphatha izinkonzo zomphakathi. Ukunakwa okuhle kokuxhumana (ngomlomo nokubhalwayo), ukulungiselela, ukuhlelela, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukubala, ukuphatha izinkinga, ukulawula isikhathi kanye namagunya okulandelayo: ukunakwa okuncane ekwenzeni izinto, ukuziphatha ngobungcweti, izimiso zokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kanye nokuqineka ukuba ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kokucindezelwa.
zu.duties: Ukuhlonza ukuphatwa kwesimo sezinkantolo kanye nokuqinisekisa inzuzo yegumbi lokugcina imali komunye owayengomahluko, kuhambisana nemithetho yenkantolo kanye namawesiwo womthetho, ukuphatha inzuzo yemali yokwezimali, ukuphatha ukukhishwa kwezinto ezivela enkantolo kanye nokuqeqesha ukungena kokwenza izinto enkantolo, ukuhlonza izicelo zokuphikiswa kanye nezibuyelelo, ukuhamba kwaye ngaphandle kokwenza izinkalo zamagumbi ezinkantolo ezingeyona ngezinkalo ezithinteka nezinye izinto ezihlobene naleso sikhundla, ukukhipha/ukusayina izinqumo zamagumbi/amabhuku abambe lo mphakathi/abangenela isicelo, ukugcina/ukuhlolwa nokuthelekisa izibalo zanyanga zonke, nazonke zezinyanga ezintathu, nangomnyaka wonke zenkantolo kanye nokulawula ukuhambahamba kwalezo zibalo, ukwenza ukuphatwa okuhle kakhulu nangcono kwezibuko zamagumbi kanye nokuqaphela okufanelekile, ukusebenza ngezibuko ngesimo sesimiso somthetho kanye nokuqeqeshwa, ukulungiselela futhi uhlele amabhuku ukuvivinywa izivivinyo, ukwenza isibuki sokuthunyelwa kwebhuku lapho kudingeka khona, ukuhlangana/nokuqapha imibuzo yomphakathi nonke ngokwemibuzo/okubhaliwe, ukwenza ukuphatwa kwegumbi lokusebenza, ukulungiselela kwaye uhlele, kanye nokuphatha abantu kanye nezinkinga ezihlobene nemisebenzi ye-HR.

xh.title: UmGaBAthi
xh.summary: Kufunekiwe umGabathi we Free State High Court eBloemfontein ukuqwalasela ulawulo lokuhamba kwamatyala, ukubhekana nokuvakwa kwamaxabiso amabi namatyala, nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zeenkundla, kufuneka nesiqinisekiso se-LLB degree kunye neminye emithoba yamava emthethweni.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe ne-LLB Degree okanye isiqinisekiso semithetho esixhenxe (4) iminyaka. Asiyonto nje ukuba abantu abangesixhenxe (2) iminyaka yamava emthethweni bayifumana emva kokuba bafumana isiqinisekiso. MR3: LLB degree okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo engeyonto kwaye asiyonto ukuba abantu abangesibini (2) iminyaka bafumana amava emva kokuqinisekiswa kumsebenzi wemithetho (iifikrtheyithi zomsebenzi zimze nayo isicelo). MR4: LLB degree okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo engeyonto kwaye asiyonto ukuba abantu abangesibhozo (8) iminyaka bafumana amava emva kokuqinisekiswa kumsebenzi wemithetho (iifikrtheyithi zomsebenzi zimze nayo isicelo). MR5: LLB degree okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo engeyonto kwaye asiyonto ukuba abantu abangeshumi nane (14) iminyaka bafumana amava emva kokuqinisekiswa kumsebenzi wemithetho (iifikrtheyithi zomsebenzi zimze nayo isicelo). Ileyisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Amava enkundla ephezulu/ezinkciniba kunye namava okulawula abantu kuya kuba lusizo oluqhubekayo. Bonke abantu abakhetiweyo, kuquka i-SMS, kufuneka benze iintsfaniselo ezimbini ezingenangaphambili. Eya kuba lulmsebenzi wemveli wokuqinisekisa ukuzinza komntu ofakiweyo isicelo ngokwemfuno yobugcisa kunye nemfuno emi kwisithuba, neye nga sela nukwa isiga ngokuziphatha ngokulunga. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngeCase Flow Management nangamagqabantshintshi eMthetho aqondisa Isebe loLuntu. Unobuchule bokunxibelelana kakuhle (ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo), ukuceba, ukulungelelanisa, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukubala, ukulawula ingxabano, ukulawula isikhathi, kunye nokuqinisekiswa okulandelayo: Ukutshata ukunodwethu, ubungcali bokusebenza, iindlela ezisemthethweni zokusebenza, nakhono ukusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Ukuqwalasela ulawulo lokuhamba kwamatyala nennikezelo lolawulo kwinkundla, ukuzithoba ngokwemiqathango yenkundla nayo yemithetho yonke edibana nayo, ukubhekana nokuvakwa kwamaxabiso amabi namatyala, ukulawula ukuphumayo kwaye kwaqaliswa iinkqubo nokuqaliswa kweenkundla, ukulawula izikhalazo nokuphonononga, ukubhekana kuwoqobo ekuphakamiswa kwezicelo zothetha-nkamela ngezityalo, ukupapashela/ukusayina iimiyalelo/ iileta zothetha-nkamela/abafaki isicelo enkundleni, okugcina/ukujonga nokuphonononga izibalo zenkundla nyanga ngenyanga, kwihora neshumi nakwindyikitya yonyaka, nakugcinwa kokuzithiswa kwazo, ukuqhuba ukulawulo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo kwaye kakuhle amafayili enkundla nokulawula amarekhodi, ukubhekana ngefayili ngokwemithetho yonke edibana nayo, okulungiselela nokuza ngaphambili amafayili ngenjongo zokuvavwa, ukugqiba ukuthumwa kwamarekhodi na ukutolikwa, ukubhekana/ioyika kwizicelo/ iindulumiso zomntu wonke, ukubhekana nolawulo lwe-ofisi, ukuceba, nokulungelelanisa nakulawula abantu/basebenzi nokuqwalasela iinkqubo ze-HR.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Clerk
jobs.centre: Free State Provincial Service Centre, Bloemfontein
jobs.salary_text: R237 453 – R279 708 per annum (Level 05). The successful candidate will be required to sign a performance agreement.
jobs.summary: A Grade 12 certificate is required for this supply chain clerk position at the Office of the Chief Justice in Bloemfontein, involving invoice capturing and LOGIS administration.
jobs.requirements: Applicants should be in possession of a Grade 12 certificate. No experience required. National Diploma in Supply Chain Management / Economics / Finance / Financial Management / Procurement / Logistics / Public Management / or relevant qualification at NQF level six (06) as recognised by SAQA will serve as an added advantage. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Knowledge and skills: Basic knowledge of financial functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collate financial statistics, basic knowledge and insight of the Public Service financial legislation, procedures and Treasury regulations (PFMA, PSA, DFI), knowledge of basic financial operating systems (BAS), basic knowledge of work procedures in terms of the work environment, knowledge of Batho Pele Principles. Skilled in communication (verbal and written), problem solving, good public relations, monitoring and analytical skills, computer literacy (MS Office), planning and organising, report writing and typing skills.
jobs.duties: Capture invoices and creation of Creditor Payment Advises, verify all invoices received, capture correct information on LOGIS which will be defaulted to the Creditor Payment Advice, attach all the relevant prescribed documentation to the Creditor Payment Advice, maintain a computerised or manual register of all payments processed to track the status of such invoices, provide pertinent information on the state of the department’s creditors to the relevant line managers, maintain and update the Procurement Status Report with details of the relevant transactions, render asset management clerical support, compile and maintain records (asset records/ database), check and issue furniture, equipment and accessories to components and individuals, identify redundant, non-serviceable and obsolete equipment for disposal and verify asset register, render demand and acquisition clerical support, carryout and implement preference points system with appropriate goals per commodity in terms of Preferential Procurement Policy objectives, provide secretariat or logistical support during the bid consideration and contracts conclusion process, , distribute store items to the end-user in the absence of the responsible person, process Purchase Orders (PO), verify if contract existing in a PO should be placed for the item on contract, verify and capture source documents and place the order with the supplier, draft Letters of Awards in cases of the unavailability of LOGIS and other urgent circumstances, send properly signed purchase orders in regard of all goods and service requests to suppliers, render and record all procurement transactions, provide support in monthly reporting for Supply Chain Management department, administer supply chain day-to-day duties for procurement of goods and services, ensure proper filing, recording, safe keeping of documents for audit purposes, administration of stores and compile SCM reports on orders issued.
jobs.enquiries: Technical Related Enquiries: Mr. T.J Diphoko Tel No: (051) 492 4617 HR Related Enquiries: Ms D.S.J Peters Tel No: (051) 492 4523
jobs.applications: Applications can be sent via email to 2026/93/OCJ@judiciary.org.za
jobs.notes: The Organisation will give preference to candidates in line with the Employment Equity goals. All applications must be submitted on a New Z83 form, which can be downloaded           on        internet       at       www.judiciary.org.za       / www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp or obtainable from any Public Service Department and should be accompanied by a recent comprehensive CV only; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated). Please send your documents in a PDF and put them in one folder. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview following communication from Human Resources. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Selection panels shall score both technical exercises as an additional criterion in the interview process. Applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Prior to appointment for SMS, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following link: https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/. Each application form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed on both pages by the applicant. The application must indicate the correct job title, the office where the position is advertised and the reference number as stated in the advert. Failure by the applicant to complete, sign and initial the application form will lead to disqualification of the application during the selection process. Applications on the old Z83 will, unfortunately, not be considered. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation considered. Suitable candidates will be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, financial checks, qualification verification, citizenship checks, social media, reference checks and employment verification). Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months after the closing date of this advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to make any appointment(s) to the advertised post(s). Applicants who do not comply with the above-mentioned requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Failure to submit all the requested documents will result in the application not being considered during the selection process. All successful candidates will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as be required to undergo a security clearance three (3) months after appointment. The Office of the Chief Justice complies with the provisions of the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. We will use your personal information provided to us for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for. In the event that your application was unsuccessful, the Office of the Chief Justice will retain your personal information for internal audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide requested information will render your application null and void. The Office of the Chief Justice will safeguard the security and confidentiality of all information you shared during the recruitment process. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk
af.summary: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat word vereis vir hierdie voorsieningskettingklerkpos by die Kantoor van die Hoofregter in Bloemfontein, wat fakturekaptuur en LOGIS-administrasie behels.
af.requirements: Aansoekers moet oor 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat beskik. Geen ervarding vereis nie. 'n Nasionale Diploma in Voorsieningskettingbestuur / Ekonomie / Finansies / Finansiële Bestuur / Aankope / Logistiek / Openbare Bestuur / of 'n tersaaklike kwalifikasie op NQF-vlak ses (06) soos deur SAQA erken, sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Alle kortlyskandidate, insluitend die SMS, sal twee voortoetse onderneem. Die een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid op grond van die pos se tegniese en algemene vereistes te bepaal en die ander moet 'n integriteitsbeoordeling (etiese gedrag) wees. Kennis en vaardighede: Basiese kennis van finansiële funksies, praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, rekenaar te bedryf en finansiële statistieke bymekaar te maak, basiese kennis en insig van die Openbare Diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en Tesourie-regulasies (PFMA, PSA, DFI), kennis van basiese finansiële bedryfstelsels (BAS), basiese kennis van werksprosedures in terme van die werksomgewing, kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels. Bedrewe in kommunikasie (mondelings en skriftelik), probleemoplossing, goeie openbare betrekkinge, monitering en analitiese vaardighede, rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office), beplanning en organisering, verslagskrywing en tikvaardighede.
af.duties: Vang fakture vas en skep Skuldeiser-betalingsadviese, verifieer alle fakture ontvang, lê korrekte inligting op LOGIS vas wat na die Skuldeiser-betalingsadvies verstuur sal word, heg al die tersaaklike voorgeskrewe dokumentasie aan die Skuldeiser-betalingsadvies, hou 'n gerekenariseerde of handmatige register van alle betalings verwerk om die status van sodanige fakture na te vors, verskaf tersaaklike inligting oor die stand van die departement se skuldeisers aan die tersaaklike lynbestuurders, hou die Aankope-statusverslag op datum met besonderhede van die tersaaklike transaksies, lewer batebestuur administratiewe ondersteuning, stel en hou rekords (baterekords/databasis), kontroleer en reik meubels, toerusting en bybehore aan komponente en individue uit, identifiseer oortollige, onbruikbare en verouderde toerusting vir wegdoening en verifieer bateregister, lewer vraag- en verkrygingsadministratiewe ondersteuning, voer en implementeer voorkeurpuntstelsel met toepaslike doelwitte per kommoditeit in terme van Voorkeur-aankope-beleidsdoelwitte, verskaf sekretariaats- of logistieke ondersteuning gedurende die bodoorweging- en kontraksluitingsproses, versprei winkelartikels aan die eindgebruiker in die afwesigheid van die verantwoordelike persoon, prosesseer Aankope-bestellings (PO), verifieer of 'n kontrak bestaande in 'n PO geplaas moet word vir die item op kontrak, verifieer en lê brondokumente vas en plaas die bestelling by die verskaffer, opstel Toekenningsbriewe in gevalle van die onbeskikbaarheid van LOGIS en ander dringende omstandighede, stuur behoorlik ondertekende aankope-bestellings met betrekking tot alle goedere- en diensversoeke aan verskaffers, lewer en lê alle aankopetransaksies vas, verskaf ondersteuning in maandelikse verslagdoening vir die Voorsieningskettingbestuur-departement, administreer voorsieningsketting daaglikse pligte vir aankope van goedere en dienste, verseker behoorlike lêerwerk, optekening, en veilige bewaring van dokumente vir ouditdoeleindes, administrasie van winkels en stel SCM-verslae oor bestellings uitgereik op.

zu.title: UMmishini Wokusikeka Kwezinsiza
zu.summary: Kudingeka ifayeditheke yesigaba sama-12 kulolu khundla lukaMmishini Wokusikeka Kwezinsiza e-Office of the Chief Justice e-Bloemfontein, okuhilela ukufaka izikhwama kwayo yonke imali yesikweletu kanye nokuphatha i-LOGIS.
zu.requirements: Abafakiswa kufanele babesne ifayeditheke yesigaba sama-12. Akukho mkhombaqedo odingekayo. I-Diploma Yezwe kokuPhatha Inxuba-Mnxeba / I-Economics / Izezimali / ukuPhatha Izezimali / UkuThenga / I-Logistics / ukuPhatha Kawonk wonke / noma noma yisiphi isifakazeso esihambisanayo esisingathini sama-NQF sithandathu (06) njengoba setshunqiwe yi-SAQA kuzoba usizo olongeziwe. Bonke abantu abakhethiwe, kubandakanya i-SMS, bazokwenza izivivinyo ezimbili ngaphambi kokungena. Esinye sizoba isivivinyo sokuzivocavoca ukukhonza ukulingana komuntu ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zobuchwepheshe nezijwayelekile zesikhundla, kanti esinye kumele sibe isivivinyo sokuziphatha okuhle. Ulwazi nobukhosi: Ulwazi oluyisiseko ngezenzo eziyisimali, nokwenza okuhlobene nazo kanye namandla okufaka ulwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo eziyisimali, ulwazi oluyisiseko nokubuka okuhle komthetho wezezimali weNkonzo kaZwelonke, izinqumo nemithetho yeNkantolo yamabhondi (PFMA, PSA, DFI), ulwazi ngohlelo lokusebenza ngezimali (BAS), ulwazi oluyisiseko lwenqubo yokusebenza ngokwesimo sendawo yokusebenza, ulwazi ngezimiso zeBatho Pele. Ukukhona amakhono okuxhumana (ngomlomo nangokubhala), ukuxazulula izinkinga, ubudlelwano obuhle nomphakathi, ukubheka ukuya phambili namakhono okuhlola ukuba yinyani, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Office), ukucubungula futhi uhlele, ukubhala imibiko namakhono okuthayipha.
zu.duties: Faka izikhwama kwaye udale Izaziso zokuHlawulela Abaswebi, qinisekisa zonke izikhwama ezitholiwe, faka ulwazi olufanele kwi-LOGIS okuzoba yisiselo kwiSaziso sokuHlawulela uSwebi, hlanganisa yonke imibhali eqoshiwe edingekayo kuSaziso sokuHlawulela uSwebi, gcina ubhalisiwe bekhompyutha noma ngokwesandla wawo wonke amalahlehlwe ukulandela isimo sezikhwama ezinjalo, nikeza ulwazi olubalulekile ngesimo sabaswebi bomnyango kubaphathi abahlobene, gcina futhi ubuyekeze iNkokhelo yesimo sokuThenga ngemininingwane yezinkokhelo ezihlobene, nikeza ukusekela ngokwebhodi ekuphatweni kwempahla, hlanganisa futhi ugcine amarekhodi (amarekhodi womphahla/ isiqu sehlezi), hlola futhi unikeze izinto zokuhlinzeka, izinsiza kanye nezinto ezincane kumakhompi nakuqobo, bonisa impahla engasetshenziswa, engasebenzi kanye engethathwa isikhathi ukuthathwa kwayo kalula bese uqinisekisa ubhalisiwe bomphahla, nikeza ukusekela ngokwebhodi ekuceleni nasekutholeni impahla, mayelana nokwenza nokusebenzisa isimiso samaphuzu ahambisanayo emigidingweni ehambisanayo yohlelo lwePolisi yokuThengwa Ngokukhethekile, nikeza isekelo lezibali noma lezokuhlela ngesikhathi senqubo yokucatshangelwa kwebhidi kanye nokuqedwa kwezinkontileka, , yahlula izinto zesitorelo kuye kumasebenzisi ekungabeki kwabantu ababhekene nazo, cycisa izinkomba zokuThengisa (PO), qinisekisa ukuthi uma kukhona inkontileka kwi-PO kufanele ibekelwe into enkontilekeni, qinisekisa futhi ufake amabhali omthombo bese ubeka iodolo nomhlinzeki, bhala Amagama esiQashi ezimeni lapho i-LOGIS ingekho noma ezimeni ezibucayi, thumela izinkomba zokuThengisa ezisayiniwe kahle mayelana nazo zonke izicelo zempahla kanye namasevisi kubahlinzeki, nikela futhi uqophe yonke iminkhuba yokuthenga, nikeza ukusekela ekubhaliwe ngekhaya ngenyanga yokubika sikhungwa sokuPhatha Inxuba-Mnxeba, phatha izinsuku zonke imisebenzi yokuhamba komsila wezinsiza ekuthengeni impahla kanye namasevisi, qinisekisa ukugcinwa okufanele, ukuqoshwa, nokugcinwa kwemibhali ngenhloso yokuhlolwa, ukuphatha izitorelo kanye nokuhlanganisa imibiko ye-SCM ngezinkomba ezikhishwe.

xh.title: Umsekeli Wezoqhagamshelwano ZokuHlinza
xh.summary: Kufuneka ibe nekhasimehde le-Grade 12 kulo nyana wesithuba somsekeli wezoqhagamshelwano zokuhlinza ku-Office of the Chief Justice e-Bloemfontein, equka ukubamba i-inivoyisi nolawulo lwe-LOGIS.
xh.requirements: Abafaki isicelo kufuneka babe negradu yesebe le-Gade 12. Akukho mfundo yamava edIaywekitha. I-National Diploma kwi-Supply Chain Management / Economics / Finance / Financial Management / Procurement / Logistics / Public Management / okanye isifundo esifanelekileyo kwinqanaba le-NQF level six (06) njengoko samkelwa yi-SAQA kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelekileyo. Onke amagosa abekiweyo kwidatha, kuquka ne-SMS, kuya kwenza iziphononongo zangaphambi kokuqonda esi sithuba. af.title: Registrateur se Klerk

Alle gekorte lys kandidate, insluitend die SMS, moet twee voor-toegangsassesseringe onderneem. Een sal 'n praktiese oefening wees om 'n kandidaat se geskiktheid te bepaal op grond van die pos se tegniese en generiese vereistes en die ander moet 'n integriteitsassessering (etiese gedrag) wees. Vaardig in rekenaargeletterdheid (Microsoft Office), kommunikasie, syfervaardigheid, interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing, ontleding, tydbestuur en administratiewe vaardighede.
af.duties: Verrig klerklike en administratiewe werk binne die hof; registreer/ken saaknommers toe aan alle pleitstukke en hofdokumente wat ontvang word; verseker dat die lêers op alle betrokke partye betrek is; stel lêers op vir litigante/prokureurs; werk die lêer van diens van kennisgewing/bewys van diens op; hanteer die hof se versoeklêers; haal die versoekte lêer op en maak die lêer beskikbaar aan die aanvrager; hou toesig oor navrae van partye en lede van die publiek; teken dokummente wat ontvang is aan; verseker sistematiese registrasie van hoflêers; hou rekord van versoeke wat van litigante ontvang is; verrig saakbestuurspligte; hou toesig oor saakbestuur en kennisgewing van verhoordatums; implementeer saakbestuurspraktyke (plaas versoekvorms in die plek van 'n lêer wat versoek is, voltooi en lêer die bewegingsblad); verrig saakbestuurspligte; monitor lêers en rekords volgens die saakbestuur; verskaf ondersteuning met administratiewe registrateur; dien verlofvorms by HR in vir nakoming; onderhou en hou alle registers vir lêer en argivering; voldoen aan die telefoonoorskrifte en verlofbeleide; berei en onderteken prestasie-ooreenkoms betyds voor; berg en beskik oor saakrekords.

zu.title: Umhloli weziqu
zu.summary: Ihhovisi likaNobhala-Jaji lifuna umuntu onemfundo yesigaba se-12 ongadinga naluphi na olunye ulwazi wokuba yenze imisebenzi yabahliki nobalulekile kwezinkantolo eDurban.
zu.requirements: Abafaka izicelo kufanele babe nesatifikethi sesigaba se-12. Akukho lulwazi oludingekayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela izoba ngelakho ongakuthola. Bonke abantu abakweyiliwe, kubandakanya ne-SMS, bazothatha ukuhlolwa kabili ngaphambi kokungena emsebenzini. Okukodwa kuzoba kuyisivivinyo sokuqatha ukulingana komuntu okusekelwe ezidingweni ezibekiwe nezijwayelekile zesikhundla, okunye kumele kube kukuqholwa kolwazi (imikhuba etshilo). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi lwezindlela zokusebenza ngokwesimo sokuqashwa emsebenzini, ulwazi lwezinqubo nokuhambisana kwezinto ezigcinwayo, ulwazi lwezinqubo zokugcina nokuphinda kutholwe amafayela ngokwesimo sokuqashwa emsebenzini, ulwazi lokuqonda izisusa ezilawula inkonzo kahulumeni, ulwazi lwendlela yokufaka kumafayela, incwadi yohlelo lweposi, kuthuthukiswa ukungena kolwazi kumthetho we-Act, i-National archives kanye nemigomisi ye-Batho Pele. Kuyakhonywa ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (Microsoft Office), ekukhulumeni, ukubala, kubantu, ekuqondweni izinkinga, ekuqoqeni ukwaziswa, ekuhleleni isikhathi nasezokuphatha imisebenzi.
zu.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yokuhlela nokulawula ngaphakathi kwesikhungo senkantolo, bhalisa/gqiba amanombolo ezicali kuyo yonke imibhalo namafayela ahlangene nenkantolo, qiniseka ukuthi amafayela athunyelwe kubo bonke abahlangenayo, hlela amafayela abantu ababhekene necala/Abaqeqeshi, buka ngokusha amafayela okuthunyelwe imibhalo yefayela/izibonakaliso zokuthunyelwa, lawula amafayela ezicelo zenkantolo, thola afayela aceliwe futhi awenze abatholakale lowo ocele, phendula imibuzo yabantu nabathintekayo, bhalisa imibhalo etholiwe, qinisekwa ukubhalwa ngohlelo lwemibhalo yenkantolo, gcina imibhalo yezicelo ezitholakale kubantu ababhekene necala, yenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo eziphathelene nezinkantolo, ezindabeni zokuphathwa kwensizakalo nemibhalo yokwazisa isikhathi sendlela yokwenza, faka ezindlebeni isicelo sokuphathwa kwenkantolo ezweni, gcwalise ufake imibhalo yokuhamba kwefayela, yenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwamacala, qaphela amafayela namabhuku ngokwendlela yokuphathwa kwamacala, nika inkokhelo ngohlelo lwabaholi, thumela amafomu ogoquko kwi-HR ukwenzela ukuziphendulela, gcina futhi uphephise izibuko ngemibhalo eminingi yokugcina ukufakwa kubhakardi nokusunduka wudlule ngaphezu kwemithetho yokwenza kusebentini namapholisi ogoquko, hlela futhi usayine isivumelwano senkambiso ngokushesha, gcina angabonakali futhi ususe imibhalo yamacala.

xh.title: UMsekeli womNgcweti weBhalisi
xh.summary: IOfisi yoMongameli wamajaji ifuna umntu onegqolo leSigidimi seBakala 12 ongafuni napna naluphi na iqondo lobugcisa bokulinganiselwa kwimisebenzi yekhonto eyi-clekicala nezomphatho eDurban.

Onke amagosa abekiwe, kuquka ne-SMS, kuya kwenza ukuphonononga okubini ngaphambi kokungena esikhundleni. Elinye liza kuba ngumzobo wokuzenzela ukuqinisekisa ukulungelelana komntu ngokwemfuno yobugcisa nangokweziqu ezifunwa kulo sithuba, elinye makube loluphononongo lokuziphatha ngokungahoyi ikhompyutha. Ulwazi neNkqubo: Ulwazi ngendlela yomsebenzi phantsi kwendalo yomsebenzi, ulwazi ngeenkqubo namaziko ebhalisi, ulwazi ngeendlela zokugcina nokuvela kwamaxwebhu, ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zamthetho alawula iNkonzo kaWonke-wonke, ulwazi ngendlela yoGcino lweFayili, iNkqubo yeMeyile yokuqamba amacebo, ukuKhuthazwa kokufikelela kolwazi kumthetho, uBuhlu bweZiko namaziko aBatho Pele. Ukhokelo ekusebenzeni ngekhompyutha (iMicrosoft Office), ekuthetheni, ekubaleni, ekusebenzeni nomntu, ekuxazululeni iingxaki, ekuphononongeni, ekulawuleni ixesha nasekulawuleni imisebenzi.
xh.duties: Yenza imisebenzi yekhonto nengamathambo ayo njalo ekhonto lecalula, bhalisa/abeli amanani amacala kuwo onke amaxwebhu namadokhumenti aze athunyelwe ekhonto, qinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu athunyelwe kubo bonke abathintekayo, yenza iifayili ezibekiweyo abathetha-bini nabameli babo, hlaziya ifayili yonikezelo/ezibonakalisa ngokwakho, zama izicelo zamagosa ekhonto, thola ifayili eceliweyo yenze ibe luncedo kumceli, phendula imibuzo kubathintekayo nakubantu bakhoyo, bhalisa amaxwebhu afikileyo, qinisekisa ukuba amaxwebhu ekhonto ahlelwe ngokulandelelana kweliso, gcina isatifikethi seefayili ezenziwa ngokulandelelana kweliso, zama imisebenzi yokulawula idilesi yecaluli, qinisekisa ukulungelelana kweenkqubo ezilawula ukubhaliswa kwekhalenda lezicelo zemisebenzi, yenza iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo ezimalunga nokulawula iinkqubo zemisebenzi, qinisekisa ukuba kukho imvumelwano ekhoyo kwindlela ekhoyo yokulawula imisebenzi, qinisekisa imisebenzi eqatshwe indlela yokulawula imisebenzi, thumela iifomu zeholide kwabasebenzi bokuqinisekisa ukulungelelana nezigaba, gcina ukusetenziswa kolwazi mayela nendlalo yokugcina nokubhaliweyo, landela iimiso ezahlukeneyo malunga nocingo namacebo okwenza umsebenzi, yenza isivumelwano ngokutsha ixesha elifanelekileyo, gcine ukugqibela kwaye ulahle imisebenzi ehleli.

Verskaf administratiewe en tegniese ondersteuning aan Dienslewering Verbeteringsprosesse: Hersien kwartaal-, jaarlikse SDC- en SDIP-rapporteringsjablone, ontwikkel en redigeer konsep diensleweringverbeteringsverslae (SDC, SDIP, Batho Pele en Frontline Service Delivery Monitoring verslae), verseker gehalte van die indiening van die diensleweringverbeteringsverslae, hou treding met die Dienslewering Verbeteringsprosesse. Stel maandelikse en kwartaalgebonde prestasieverslae van die Strategy and Service Delivery Planning op: Ontwikkel, redigeer en stel konsep maandelikse en kwartaalverslae vir insette op in lyn met die Operational Plan, verseker gehalte van die verkryging van alle vereiste portefeulje van getuienis dokumente, laai tersaaklike portefeulje van getuienis op na die rapporteringstelsel, verseker die indiening van die portefeulje van getuienis aan tersaaklike eenhede. Verskaf klerklike administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Strategy and Service Delivery Planning-eenheid: Skakel met interne en eksterne belanghebbende betrokkenheid, dateer die rekordbestuurstelsel op, hou treding met die SharePoint vir lêer- en argiveringsdoeleindes, verskaf ad hoc administratiewe pligte wanneer nodig binne die SSDP-eenheid, verseker indiening en verspreiding van eenheiddokumente aan besigheidseenhede, verseker suksesvolle logistiese reëlings vir reis, vergaderings en werkswinkels.

zu.title: Clerk Wezokulawula
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Clerk Wezokulawula e-Office of the Chief Justice e-Midrand, inikeza iholo elingu-R237,453 kuya ku-R279,708 ngonyaka ku-izinga 5.
zu.requirements: Abafake izicelo kufanele babe nesatifikhethi se-Grade 12. Akukho ngoliseko oludingekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela izoba yinzuzo eyengeziyo. Abakhethiwe bonke, kuhlanganise ne-SMS, bazokwenza amahlolwa amabili ngaphambi kokungena esikhundleni. Okunye kuzoba kwesisobhotho sezokuzilolonga ukuze kushanyulwe ukufaneleka komuntu ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zobuchwepheshe nezijwayelekile zesikhundla, okunye kumele kube ukuhlolwa kwokuziphatha ngokuzithoba. Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwezinkomba, ulwazi nokuqonda Amaprogramu Ekwensisweni Kwesevisi, ulwazi nokuqonda Imigomo YakoBatho Pele, ulwazi nokuqonda Ukuhlela Okuyisinqamo. Unamakhono ekuxhumeni okuhle (okubhaliwe nokuqhamuzayo), ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (i-MS Office), amakhono ahle abantu, ukuphatha isikhathi, ukuhlela, ukuhlela izinto, amakhono wezokulawula, ukuxazulula izinkinga, nesevisi ebalulekile kumthengi.
zu.duties: Nika inkxaso yezokulawula nezobuchwepheshe kuzo zonke inqubo zokuhlela okuyisinqamo: Hlela izinto zohlelo kuzo zonke izesha zokuqamba izinqumo, kuhlanganise ukuthola indawo, ukondla, amathuluzi asekhompyutheni, njll. Hlela imemo nemihlahla yokuqokobha ngazo zonke inqubo zokuqamba izinqumo, nikez inkxaso ekuthuthukisweni kocwaningo lwe-OCJ Environmental Scan Report, nikez inkxaso ekunqumweni kokubumba ukuthuthukiswa kwe-OCJ Strategic, Annual Performance, kanye no-Operational Plans, qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhanjiswa kwe-OCJ Strategic, Annual Performance kanye no-Operational Plans kuhle kakhulu. Nika inkxaso yezokulawula nezobuchwepheshe ekwenisweni kwesevisi: Cwaninga izikripthi zokubika ze-quarterly, annual SDC kanye ne-SDIP, yakha ukuhlela okusha futhi uhlele imibiko yokuthuthukiswa kwesevisi (SDC, SDIP, i-Batho Pele kanye nemibiko ye-Frontline Service Delivery Monitoring), qinisekisa ukuthi ukuhanjiswa kwemibiko yokuthuthukiswa kwesevisi kuhle, hlala ulandela inqubo yokuthuthukiswa kwesevisi. Hlela imibiko yamanyanga neye-quarterly yokusebenza kwe-Strategy and Service Delivery Planning: Yakha, ukuhlela okusha, hlela imibiko yamanyanga neye-quarterly ngokokungena ngokuhambisana no-Operational Plan, qinisekisa ukuqoqa wofelela wezincwadi ezitholakalayo zokufakazela into, fakela izincwadi zokufakazela into ezihambisana nhlelo lokubika, qinisekisa ukulethwa kwalezincwadi zokufakazela izinto emazweni afanele. Nika inkxaso yezokulawula njengomabhala komunyango we-Strategy and Service Delivery Planning: Xhumana nokubandakanyeka kwabathintekayo bngaphakathi nangaphandle, buyekeza uhlelo lokuphathwa kwezinkomba, aze ahlale eqonda i-SharePoint ngenhloso yokugcina futhi azenzele izinto, nikez izinkxaso zezokulawula ezingahle zidingwe ngesikhathi esithile komunyango we-SSDP, qinisekisa ukulethwa nokusabalalisa izincwadi komunyango kumnyango wezamabhizinisi, qinisekisa ukuhlelwa okupumelelo kohambo,emiqhinganweni namaworkshop.

xh.title: Iklerk yolawulo
xh.summary: Kufunekwa iklerk yolawulo kwi-Office of the Chief Justice e-Midrand, inikezela umvuzo we-R237,453 ukuya ku-R279,708 ngonyaka kwinqanaba le-5.
xh.requirements: Abagcelayo kufunekuba babe nesatifikethi se-Grade 12. Akukho mfundo yamava olindziweyo. Ilayiseni yomqhubi iya kuba ngelinye ilungelo. Onke amagqabantshashi alawulwe ahd, kuquka i-SMS, aya kuthatha uvavanyo olubini olungaphambi kokungena. Olunye luya kuba lusicwangciso lwenziwa ngokwenyani ukumisela ukufaneleka komgcali ngokusekelwe kwimfuno yobuchwepheshhe nobumfundi beli sitoba kwaye elinye kufuneka libe uvavanyo lokuziphatha (ngokwenene). Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi nokuLawulwa Kweekhord, ulwazi nokuqonda Iinkqubo Zokuphucula Iinkonzo, ulwazi nokuqanda Imigaqo ye-Batho Pele, ulwazi nokuqonda uQeqesho lweQhinga. Unobuchwephesha ekunxibelelaneni okulungileyo (okubhaliweyo nokuThethwayo), ukufunda nokuqonda ikhompyutha (i-MS Office), amakhono obudala obuhle, ulawulo lwexesha, uqeqesho, ukuqamba, amakhono olawulo, ukusombulula iingxaki nolonikezelo lweNkonzo yamakhasimande oluhle.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo nobuchwephesha kuwo onke amaqhinga oqeqesho loQhinga: Nika izicwangciso ezingokusetyenziselwa zonke iindlela zeepilan, kuquka ukumisela indawo, ukutya, izixhobo zonyuso, njl. Qamba iimemo neziqondiso kulungiselelo lokuwo onke amaqhinga oqeqesho, nikez inkxaso kwiqela lophuhliso lwe-OCJ Environmental Scan Report, nike inkxaso kwindlela yokulungelelanisa uphuhliso lwe-OCJ Strategic, Annual Performance, ne-Operational Plans, qinisekisa umgangatho kolulwandiso lwe-OCJ Strategic, Annual Performance ne-Operational Plans. Nika inkxaso yolawulo nobuchwephesha kuqhinga loPhuculo lweNkonzo: Phinda uqale iitemplates ezibika nge-SDC ne-SDIP yenyanga nakwindlela, yaza uphuhlise uHlelo lokubika ngokuPhuculwa kweNkonzo (iinkxaso ze-SDC, SDIP, iBatho Pele neNkonzo yoQeqesho ekuQaleni), qinisekisa umgangatho kolulwandiso lwezi nkxaso zokuPhucula iNkonzo, zigcine usehli nab namagqabantshathi endlela yoPhuculo lweNkonzo. Qamba iinkxaso zolwaluko ngeenyanga nakwindlela zoMgangatho weSitrategi neNkonzo yoQeqesho lweQhinga: Phuhlisa, hlela, qamba iinkxaso zolwaluko ngeenyanga nakwindlela kumagqasho ngokuhambelana neQhinga leMisebenzi, qinisekisa umgangatho wokufumana zonke iinkxaso ezifunekayo zoxinzelelo lweportifolio, gqithisa kwinxulunyaniseleko ixinzelelo lweportifolo elifanelekileyo kwinkqubo yokubika, qinisekisa ukuba kwenziwa ulwandiso loxinzelelo lweportifolio kwiiy unit ezingafanelekanga. Nika inkxaso yolawulo lokubhaliweyo kwiiy unit yeSitrategi neNkonzo yoQeqesho lweQhinga: Thetha namashishini angaphakathi nangaphandle, phucula inkqubo yokuLawulwa kweekhord, zigcine usehli nab namasharePoint ngakumbi kwindlela yokugcina ii-archive nangaphezulu, nikez inkxaso yolawulo ngexesha elifunekayo kwi-unit yee-SSDP, qinisekisa ulwandiso nokusaswa koxinzelelo lwe-portifolio kwiiy unit ezenza ishishini qinisekisa ukuba kusinaysense izicwangciso eziphumelele zokulungiselela uhambo lokuHamba, iintlanganiswa naziNkcazelo-magama zobuNgqangi.

jobs.title: Director: Legislation
jobs.department: Department of Public Service and Administration
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum (Level 13), (an all-inclusive remuneration package). Annual progression up to a maximum remuneration package of R1 551 807 per annum is possible, subject to satisfactory performance. The all-inclusive remuneration package consists of a basic salary, the state’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to personal needs within a framework.
jobs.summary: Director of Legislation required to manage drafting of public administration legislation and provide legal advice at the Department of Public Service and Administration.
jobs.requirements: A minimum qualification at NQF Level 7 in Law, a Bachelor of Laws (LLB), or a Bachelor of Procurationis (B. Proc). Minimum 5 years at a middle or senior managerial level. Minimum 8 years’ experience in Legislative drafting. Admitted as an Attorney or Advocate. Knowledge of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, Drafting conventions applicable in South Africa, Public Administration and other relevant/related legislation. Strategic priorities of Government. Must have sound understanding of operations management. Must have an understanding of drafting Public Administration legislation including bills and regulations. Must have managerial skills decision making, problem solving, written and verbal communication, Stakeholder management and coordination, Strategic thinking and leadership, analytical skills, interpersonal relations, teamwork, confidentiality, financial management, human resource management, research, change management and project and program management. Generic skills: Diversity management, communication and information management, interpersonal relations, facilitation, negotiation, presentation, report writing, computer literacy and conflict management. Technical skills: Legislative drafting, legislative processes and legislation scrutiny.
jobs.duties: To manage drafting of Public Administration legislation. Review legislation administered by the Minister for the Public Service and Administration. Provide legal advice on matters concerning public administration legislation. Manage all the operations, systems, and processes of the directorate. Attend departmental management structures and any other meetings as directed. Participate in inter-departmental and intra-departmental committees, tasks, and project teams as nominated.
jobs.enquiries: Adv. Mmasetshaba Matlou Tel No: (012) 336 1638
jobs.applications: E-mail your application to Advert202026@dpsa.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must quote the relevant reference number and consist of: A fully completed and signed NEW Z83 form which can be downloaded at www.dpsa.gov.za/dpsa2g/vacancies.asp.’’From 1 January 2021 should an application be received using the incorrect application for employment (Z83), it will not be considered”, a recent comprehensive CV; contactable referees (telephone numbers and email addresses must be indicated); Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application but must submit the Z83 and a detailed curriculum vitae (Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified documents, all non- SA citizens must attach a copy of proof of permanent residence in South Africa on or before the day of the interviews). Foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. Candidates will also be subjected to personnel suitability checks on criminal records, citizen verification, financial records, qualification verification and applicants could be required to provide consent for access to their social media accounts. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. If you have not been contacted within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The successful candidate will be expected to enter into an employment contract and a performance agreement within 3 months of appointment, as well as completing a financial interests declaration form within one month of appointment and annually thereafter. Note: Prior to appointment, a candidate would be required to complete the Nyukela Programme: Pre-entry Certificate to Senior Management Services as endorsed by DPSA which is an online course, endorsed by the National School of Government (NSG). The course is available at the NSG under the name Certificate for entry into the SMS and the full details can be sourced by the following     link:    https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry- programme/. zu.title: Umongameli: Ulimi-lomthetho
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMongameli Wolimi-lomthetho ukuze aphathe ukubhalwa kolimi-lomthetho lokuphathwa kwezomphakatsi futhi anike izeluleko ezomthetho eMnyangweni Waseburhozini Sikazwelonke Nekuphathweni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezingaphansi kwesilinganiso se-NQF Level 7 eMthethweni, i-Bachelor of Laws (LLB), noma i-Bachelor of Procurationis (B. Proc). Uqhoqobolo oluncane emiswonqa eyi-5 ezingeni eliphakathi noma eliphezulu lokuphatha. Uqhoqobolo oluncane kweminyaka eyi-8 ekubhalweni kolimi-lomthetho. Umkelwe njengommeli noma sidlule esikhungweni sabameli. Ulwazi ngeSulumthetho seRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, izinhlelo zokubhalwa kwezomthetho ezisebenza eNingizimu Afrika, ukuPhathwa Kwezomphakathi kanye nezinye izimothetho ezihambisanayo. Izinhloso eziyinhloko zahulumeni. Kudingeka abe nokuqonda okuhle ngekuphathwa kwezinsiza. Kudingeka abe nokuqonda ekubhalweni kolimi-lomthetho lokuphathwa kwezomphakathi okuhlanganisa namaphrojekthi kanye nemithetho. Kudingeka abe namakhono okuphatha okuhlanganisa ukuthatha izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana ngokubhala nakukhuluma, ukuphathwa nokuhlanganisa abathintekayo, ukucabanga ngesu kanye nokuholwa, amakhono ahlaziywayo, ubuhlobo obuhlangene, ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukugcina imfihlo, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa kwemithombo yabasebenzi, ucwaningo, ukuphathwa kokushintsha kanye nokuphathwa kwamaphrojekthi namahlelo. Amakhono ajwayelekile: Ukuphathwa kwezenhlalo, ukuxhumana nokuphathwa kwolwazi, ubuhlobo obuhlangene, ukweqaqasha, ukuxoxiswana, ukubonisa, ukubhala imibiko, ulwazi lwekhompyutha nokuphathwa kwezinkinga. Amakhono obuchwepheshe: Ukubhalwa kolimi-lomthetho, inqubo yolimi-lomthetho nokuhlola umthetho.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukubhalwa kolimi-lomthetho lokuphathwa kwezomphakathi. Ukuhlola umthetho ophethwe ngumNgqangi wesebe likaqhamula noMnyango Wezamasebe. Ukunikeza izeluleko ezomthetho ezindabeni ezihlobene nolimi-lomthetho lokuphathwa kwezomphakathi. Ukuphatha wonke amansehlwa, izimiso, kanye neznqubo zeqembu. Ukuhlela izinhlobo eziphethwe yilabo abambe iqhaza ekuphathweni kanye nanoma yimiphi imihlangano njengoba kuqondisiwe. Ukubambe iqhaza kwizinhlaka-nzimba ezihlangene kanye namakomidi ohlelo lwangaphakathi, izikhulu namakomidi aphrojekthi njengoba bakhethiwe.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ngokomthetho
xh.summary: Kufuneki gqithwa umphathi ngokomthetho ukulawula ukulunga kolwabiwo-mthetho ngolawulo lwentengiso zomphakatsi nokuzekelela iingcebiso ngomthetho kwisebe lomSebenzi wokuqonda nokuLawula imisebenzi yomphakatsi.
xh.requirements: Isigqibo esincinci seNQF Level 7 kumMthetho, iBachelor of Laws (LLB), okanye iBachelor of Procurationis (B. Proc). Unyaka abaluleleyo abali-5 abe ngumlawuli ophakathi okanye ophakathi nomenzi-mthetho. Unyaka abaluleleyo abali-8 ngemisebenzi ekulungeni ulwabiwo-mthetho. Njengomsinduli weNkundla okanye njengomfundi womthetho ogqithiweyo. Ukuqonda ngomthethosiseko weRephablikha yaseMzantsi Afrika, iindlela zokulunga ulwabiwo-mthetho ezisebenzayo eMzantsi Afrika, uLawulo lwentengiso zomphakatsi kwaye naxa kunjalo nalomnye ulwabiwo-mthetho oqhagamshelana nalo. Iindaba eziphambili ngokoyilo welawyulo. Kufuneka abe nokuqonda okukhulu ngokuLawula imisebenzi yokusebenza. Kufuneka abe nokuqonda ngokulunga ulwabiwo-mthetho ngolawulo lwentengiso zomphakatsi nakubandakanya amathandabuzo nemiqathango. Kufuneka abe nezakhono zokulawula ekuqumbisa isigqibo, ukusombulula iingxaki, ekuhlalayo nakuthethayo, ukulawula nokuqhelanisa abathathi-nxaxheba, ukucinga ngokoyilo nokuhanuwa, izakhono zokusikhusela, uqhagamshelwano nabantu, ukusebenza njengomanyano, ukugcina imfihlo, ukulawula iimali, ukulawula abasebenzi, uphando, ukulawula iinguqu nokuLawula imicimbi yamaphulo. Izakhono ngokubanzi: Ukulawula iindidi ezahlukeneyo, ukuthetha nolawulo lolwazi, uqhagamshelwano nabantu, ukukhuthaza, ukuziphatha okuthengisayo, ukubonisa, ukubhala iingxelo, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuLawula iingxabano. Izakhono ngokobuchwephetshe: Ukulunga ulwabiwo-mthetho, iinkqubo zolwabiwo-mthetho nokuphonononga ulwabiwo-mthetho.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ukulunga kolwabiwo-mthetho ngolawulo lwentengiso zomphakatsi. Ukuphonononga ulwabiwo-mthetho olulawulwa ngumLawuli wezokuSebenza kukaQhawe lwentengiso zomphakatsi. Ukuzekelela iingcebiso ngomthetho kumacala angqinelana nolwabiwo-mthetho ngolawulo lwentengiso zomphakatsi. Ukulawula zonke iinkqubo, iindidi, namanyathelo ophathi. Ukubakhetha kumanxilongo ebalawulo kwisebe nalawo manxilongo amanye njengoko ayalelwa. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumakomiti angaphakathi kwisebe nakumanxilongo aphakathi kwamanye amasebe, kumsebenzi, nakuqeqesho loyilo njengoko bakhethwa.
