Kennis van die Grondwet van die Republiek van Suid-Afrika, die Regering se wetgewende raamwerk met spesifieke verwysing na dienswetgewing, die Openbare Diens se wetgewende en beleidsraamwerk, Regeringsprogramme soos die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan, Kern Strategiese Prioriteite van die Regering en die ontwikkeling van Voorskrifte vir Remunerering en Algemene Voordele vir die Openbare Diens. Algemene en makro-voordele-teorie en -praktyk, kennis van algemene voordele in die Openbare Diens, menslikehulpbronbestuur, navorsing en analise en openbare beleidsontwikkeling en -implementering. Besluitneming, probleemoplossing, skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasie, belanghebbendebestuur en -koördinasie, strategiese denke en leierskap, analitiese vaardighede, interpersoonlike verhoudings, finansiële bestuur, menslikehulpbronbestuur, navorsing, veranderingsbestuur, projek- en programbestuur. Probleemoplossing (konseptuele denke), besluitneming, diversiteitsbestuur, kommunikasie en inligtingsbestuur, interpersoonlike verhoudings, fasilitering, onderhandeling, aanbieding, verslagskrywing, rekenaarvaardigheid en konflikbestuur.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling van Voorskrifte met betrekking tot Algemene Voordele (verlof van afwesigheid, werktyd, PILIR, stand-by-toelaag, gevaarstoelaes, sessionele bystand, Vreemde Diens- Dispensasie, toelaes vir personeel wat uitvoerende owerhede bedien, toelaag vir sekretarisse van 'n hoof van departement, nagskof-toelaag, ens.). Bestuur die verskaffing van implementeringssteun aan departemente. Bestuur die monitering van implementering en nakoming. Bestuur die bedrywighede, stelsels en prosesse van die Direktoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi: Izinzuzo Ezivamile
zu.summary: Isikhundla somPhathi: Izinzuzo Ezivamile ePretoria, sidinga idigri nocani olubanzi kwezimo zokusebenza kanye nolawulo lwemithombo yabantu.
zu.requirements: IDigri efanele kuLawulo Nentuthuko Yemithombo Yabantu noma izifundo ezilinganayo ezinganini le-NQF level 7. Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 ezingeni lokuphathi phakathi noma eliphezulu okungenani eminyaka eyi-10 yohluo olufanele emkhakheni wezimo zokusebenza. Ulwazi ngoMthethosisekelo weRiphabhuliki yaseNingizimu Afrika, umphakathi wolwaziso kahulumeni ongqondo ngomthetho wokusebenza, umphakathi wolwaziso nomthethondaba weSevisi Yomphakathi, izinhlelo kahulumeni ezifana noHlelo Lokuthuthuka Kwezwe, Izinhloso Eziyinhloko Eziyinhlelo Kahulumeni kanye nentuthuko yemiqatho yeMivuzo nezinzuzo Ezivamile zeSevisi Yomphakathi. Imininingwane yezinzuzo ezivamile nakwezinga eliphezulu kanye nokusebenza, ulwazi ngezinzuzo ezivamile eSevisini Yomphakathi, ulawulo lwemithombo yabantu, ucwaningo kanye nokuhalalaza nentuthuko nokusetshenziswa kolwazi mthethondaba womphakathi. Ukwenza izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuxhumana ngokubhala nasenkulumweni, ukulawula nokuhlanganisa abanomzinkelo, ukucabanga ngokuqhubekayo nokuhola, amakhono ekuhlaziya, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, ulawulo lwezimali, ulawulo lwemithombo yabantu, ucwaningo, ulawulo loshintsho, ulawulo lwezinhlelo kanye nezinhlelo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga (ukucabanga ngemininingwane), ukwenza izinqumo, ulawulo lwezinhlobo ezahlukene, ulawulo lolwazi nolwazi, ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu, ukumisa inhlelo, ukuxoxisana, ukuyalela, ukubhala imibiko, ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nolawulo lwezingxabano.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuthuthuka kweMiqatho ehlobene nezinzuzo Ezivamile (ukushiya esikhundleni, isikhathi sokusebenza, i-PILIR, isibonelelo sokuqashwa kwesikhathi, izibonelelo zengozi, usizo lwesikhathi, i-Foreign Service Dispensation, izibonelelo zabenikazi abaphathe izigunundi, isibonelelo sababhalisi behlobo yomnyango, isibonelelo sobusuku, njll.). Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokusebenza kumimnyango. Phatha ukulandelelwa kokusebenza nokuzezelwa. Phatha imisebenzi, izinhlelo kanye nezinhlaka zeDirectorate.

xh.title: Titshala: Iinzuzo Zeqela
xh.summary: Isikhundla sikaTitshala: Iinzuzo Zeqela ePretoria, sifuna idigri nenani elikhulu lemfuno kumhlaba yeenkonzo nolawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu.
xh.requirements: Idegree elungileyo ethi B. Degree kwiHuman Resources Management and Development okwa ngokulinganayo kwinqanaba le-NQF level 7. Ubuncinane iiminyaka eyi-5 kwinqanaba eliphakathi okanye eliphezulu lolawulo kunye nobuncinane beminyaka eyi-10 yemfuno elungileyo kumhlaba weeNkonzo zeemigaqo. Ulwazi ngamaConstitution kaRiphabhlikhi yaseMzantsi Afrika, inkqubo yomthetho kaRhulada kunye nereferensi ethile kumthetho wokuqeshwa, inkqubo yomthetho namagqabantshintshi koLwazi lweNkonzo kaRhulada, iinkqubo zoRhulada ezinjengeNational Development Plan, izinto eziyimoWoyilo eziyintsika kuRhulada nokubhalwa kweePrescripts zeRhavumenti ngeenzuzo Zeqela kwiNkonzo kaRhulada. Ithiyori nomyalelo weenzuzo zeqela nangobubanzi, ulwazi ngeenzuzo zeqela kwiNkonzo kaRhulada, ulawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu, uphandolwano nonkqonkqoziyo kunye nophuhliso nokusebenzisa iNqubomgqo kaRhulada. Ukwenza iigqibo, ukuxazula iingxaki, unxibelelwano ngombhalo nasenomlomo, ulawulo nolungelelaniso lwabathinteli, ukuqonda ngokwenzululwazi kunye nobuququpha, amakhono ekuqwalasela, uqhagamshelwano phakathi kwabantu, ulawulo lweziimali, ulawulo lwemisebenzi yabantu, uphandolwano, ulawulo loshintsho, ulawulo lweeprojekthi neenkqubo. Ukuxazula iingxaki (ukuqonda ngengcinga), ukwenza iigqibo, ulawulo lwentlalontle, unxibelelwano nolawulo lwolwazi, uqhagamshelwano phakathi kwabantu, ukwakha inkqubo, izinga, okubonakalayo, ukubhala iingxelo, ulwazi ngekhompyutha nolawulo lngquzula.
xh.duties: Lawula uphuhliso lwePrescripts maqondo ngeenzuzo Zeqela (ukushiya indawo, ixesha lokusebenza, iPILIR, imal yokuhlala ulindele, iimali zengozi, uncedo lwexesha, iForeign Service Dispensation, iimali zabasebenzi abakhonza iigunya eziphezulu, imali yababhali abakwiinhloko zesebe, imali yobusuku, njalo njalo). Lawula ukunikwa inkxaso yokusebenzisa iinkqubo kumasebe. Lawula ulawulo lokwenza nokuvuya. Lawula iintshukumo, iinkqubo iinkqubo zoLawulo.

jobs.summary: Director role in Performance Management at the Department of Public Service and Administration in Pretoria, developing performance management prescripts, policies, and frameworks.

Manage the provision of implementation support to Departments. Manage the monitoring of implementation and compliance. Manage all the operations, systems and processes of the Directorate.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Employee Relations
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (all-inclusive remuneration package consisting of a basic salary, the State’s contribution to the Government Employees Pension Fund and a flexible portion that may be structured according to the MMS dispensation)
jobs.closing_date_text: 25 August 2026 by 16:30, (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Manage employee relations functions including grievance registration, investigations and conciliation within the Department of Tourism in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate NQF 7 qualification in Labour Relations or equivalent qualification. Five (5) years’ experience in a labour relations environment of which three (3) years must be at a supervisory level. A post graduate qualification in labour relations will be an added advantage. Knowledge and understanding of departmental policies and procedures, all labour laws including LRA, BCEA and EEA. Ability to interpret and apply policies, strategies and legislations. Knowledge of Public Service Regulations, Record Management, the PFMA and Treasury regulations. Communication, analytical and ability to liaise with different stakeholders at different levels. Emotional intelligence and sound interpersonal relations skills. Proactive and innovative as well as technical skills. A valid driver’s licence (Persons with disabilities that prevent them from driving will still be considered).
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the registration of grievances, appointment of investigating officers and facilitation of grievances; managing investigations and conciliation or mediation meetings where appropriate; analysing investigating officers’ reports and quality checking submission for approval; managing the communication on the outcome of grievances and aggrieved employees; ensuring that grievances are routed to the Minister if the employee remained dissatisfied; managing records of receipt of dispute referral forms and notices from Council or Commission; managing the logistics of disputes scheduled for Conciliation and Arbitration; ensuring the technical aspects of the disputes are considered; ensuring registration of misconduct cases; providing short exposition of the process from drafting of charges to conclusion of the case; taking instructions and ambit of instructions in relation to the desired outcome of disciplinary hearings; assisting counsel at arbitration proceedings; managing the appointment of investigators, initiators and presiding officers; managing investigations into allegations misconduct and compiling reports; managing the formulation of charges of misconduct; ensuring the internal approval process is followed following receipt of the presiding officer’s reports; managing the communication on the outcome of the disciplinary hearing; overseeing the capturing of disciplinary outcomes on PERSAL; overseeing the processing of referred harassment cases; overseeing the implementation of the outcome decisions of the Financial Misconduct Committee (FIMICO); quality checking submissions to the Minister or his/her delegate if appeal has been lodged; managing the coordination of DBC’s; managing secretarial services during task team meetings, bi-laterals and multi- laterals; ensuring that the relevant documents are available timeously and complete; ensuring that a mandate is received from the relevant authorities; complying with directives from Council, CCMA or Court to avoid interest costs; identifying technical aspects of the disputes; preparing rescission, variation of awards and reviewing applications to challenge awards and court judgements as and when required; providing objective and unbiased opinion and advising the department and employees on interpretation and application of rights in the collective agreements; identifying areas within the department requiring employee relations training; listening to employees’ complaints and creating an atmosphere conducive to allowing for constructive discussion; monitoring employee relations trends in terms of collective bargaining internally (DBC) and externally (Council); providing written or oral advice to management and officials; monitoring the parties compliance with the LRA, Rules of Council and/or any other law regulating collective agreement engagements; ensuring that parties do not consult on salaries and other conditions of employment in respect of employees at the DBC; advising the employer representing team on options like caucus in order to minimise disruptions to DBC normal work.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A Dreyer Tel No: (012) 444 6543
jobs.applications: E-Mail: Recruitment4326@tourism.gov.za
jobs.notes: Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine the suitability of a person for employment NB: EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a Z83 form and CV only. The electronic application must be in PDF format and made up of a single document file. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each post(s) advert must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial, and sign the Z83 form will lead to the disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Section A, B, C, and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83, it is acceptable for applicants to refer to their CV or see attached. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form are required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following the communication from Human Resources, and such qualifications (s) and other related documents (s) will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will further be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). Some of the interviewed candidates for Senior Management level vacancies may be subjected to a 2-day competency assessment that will test generic competencies. Appointment validity will be conditional to signing of the employment contract, performance agreement, and annual financial disclosure, and must attain a security clearance (vetting) applicable to the post. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Werknemerverhoudings
af.summary: Bestuur werknemerverhoudingsfunksies, insluitend klageregistrasie, ondersoeke en bemiddeling binne die Department of Tourism in Pretoria.
af.requirements: 'n Toepaslike NQF 7-kwalifikasie in Arbeidsverhoudinge of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie. Vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in 'n arbeidsverhoudinge-omgewing waarvan drie (3) jaar op toesigvlak moet wees. 'n Nagraadse kwalifikasie in arbeidsverhoudinge sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis en begrip van departementele beleide en prosedures, alle arbeidswette insluitend LRA, BCEA en EEA. Vermoë om beleide, strategieë en wetgewing te interpreteer en toe te pas. Kennis van Public Service Regulations, Record Management, die PFMA en Treasury-regulasies. Kommunikasie, analitiese vermoë en die vermoë om met verskillende belanghebbendes op verskillende vlakke te skakel. Emosionele intelligensie en goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Proaktief en innoverend asook tegniese vaardighede. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Persone met gestremdhede wat hulle verhoed om te bestuur, sal steeds oorweeg word).
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die bestuur van die registrasie van klagtes, die aanstelling van ondersoekbeamptes en die facilitering van klagtes; die bestuur van ondersoeke en bemiddelings- of mediasievergaderings waar toepaslik; die analise van ondersoekbeamptes se verslae en gehaltekontrolering van voorleggings vir goedkeuring; die bestuur van kommunikasie oor die uitslag van klagtes en ontevrede werknemers; om te verseker dat klagtes na die Minister gestuur word indien die werknemer ontevrede bly; die bestuur van rekords van ontvangs van geskilverwysingsvorms en kennissgewings van die Council of Commission; die bestuur van die logistiek van geskille wat vir Conciliation en Arbitration geskeduleer is; om te verseker dat die tegniese aspekte van die geskille in ag geneem word; om te verseker dat wangedraggevalle geregistreer word; die verskaffing van 'n kort uiteensetting van die proses vanaf die opstel van aanklagte tot die afhandeling van die saak; die neem van opdragte en die omvang van opdragte in verband met die gewenste uitslag van disiplinêre verhore; om advokaat by arbitrasie-verrigtinge by te staan; die bestuur van die aanstelling van ondersoekers, inleiers en voorsittende beamptes; die bestuur van ondersoeke na bewerings van wangedrag en die opstel van verslae; die bestuur van die formulering van aanklagte van wangedrag; om te verseker dat die interne goedkeuringsproses gevolg word na ontvangs van die voorsittende beampte se verslae; die bestuur van kommunikasie oor die uitslag van die disiplinêre verhoor; die toesig oor die vaslegging van disiplinêre uitslae op PERSAL; die toesig oor die verwerking van verwysde teisteringsake; die toesig oor die implementering van die besluite oor die uitslae van die Financial Misconduct Committee (FIMICO); gehaltekontrolering van voorleggings aan die Minister of sy/haar afgevaardigde indien 'n appèl aangeteken is; die bestuur van die koördinering van DBC's; die bestuur van sekretariële dienste tydens taakspanvergaderings, bilaterale en multilaterale byeenkomste; om te verseker dat die tersaaklike dokumente betyds en volledig beskikbaar is; om te verseker dat 'n mandaat van die tersaaklike owerhede ontvang word; om aan direktiewe van die Council, CCMA of Court te voldoen om rentekoste te vermy; die identifisering van tegniese aspekte van die geskille; die voorbereiding van hersiening, variasie van toekenning en hersiening van aansoeke om toekennings en hofuitsprake uit te daag wanneer nodig; die verskaffing van objektiewe en onbevooroordeelde menings en advies aan die departement en werknemers oor interpretasie en toepassing van regte in die kollektiewe ooreenkomste; die identifisering van areas binne die departement wat werknemerverhouding-opleiding vereis; die luister na werknemers se klagtes en die skep van 'n atmosfeer wat konstruktiewe bespreking bevorder; die monitering van werknemerverhoudingstendense ten opsigte van kollektiewe bedinging intern (DBC) en ekstern (Council); die verskaffing van skriftelike of mondelinge advies aan bestuur en amptenare; die monitering van die partye se voldoening aan die LRA, Reëls van die Council en/of enige ander wet wat kollektiewe ooreenkomsbetrokkenheid reguleer; om te verseker dat partye nie by die DBC oor salarisse en ander diensvoorwaardes van werknemers konsulteer nie; die advisering van die werkgewer-verteenwoordigingspan oor opsies soos kouskas om ontwrigtings van die DBC se normale werk tot 'n minimum te beperk.

zu.title: Isikhundla sikaPhini kaMkhulu: Izindinganiso zabasebenzi
zu.summary: Phephathisa imisebenzi yezindinganiso zabasebenzi ehlanganisa ukubhaliswa kwezikhungo, ukuphenya kanye nokuqondanisa ngaphakathi koMnyango wezokuvakasha ePretoria.
zu.requirements: Izemfundo elingana ne-NQF 7 kumabango abasebenzi noma okulingana nalo. Iminyaka eyihlanu (5) yamava kokuphathwa kwamabango abasebenzi, okuyinto eminyaka emithathu (3) kumele ibe ngezinga lokubaphathi. Isiqu sebanga eliphezulu kumabango abasebenzi kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ulwazi nokuqonda izinqubomgomo nezinqubo zomnyango, wonke umthetho wabasebenzi ohlanganisa iLRA, iBCEA neEEA. Ikono lokuhumusha futhi kusebenzise izinqubomgomo, izuqu nemithefana. Ulwazi ngemiQondo yesevisi yomphakathi, okuphathwayo kwamarekhodi, iPFMA nemiQondo yeSikhwama sasezimali. Ukuxhumana, ukuhlaziya ikono lokuxhumana nabahlanganyeli abehlukene emazingeni ahlukene. Ukuqonda izinkanuko nobunjongo obuhle kwezindinganiso zobuntu. Ukuba nobuchule bokubuka phambili kanye nokuqamba izinto, kanye nobuchule obusemthethweni. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni (abantu abasinda isikhathi eside bokungalalelwa okuvimela ukuba bagqoke kusazobhekwa).
zu.duties: Umphakanyiswa ophumelelayo uzobe nesibopho sokuphatha ukubhaliswa kwezinkinga, ukuqasha abaphathi bezinkinga nokwenza kube lula ngemizwa yokuxazulula; ukuphatha ukuphenya namahlangano axazulula noma ahlanganisa lapho kufanele khona; ukuhlaziya imibhalo yabaphathi bezinkinga ukuze kube khona ukuqinisekiswa kwemikhiqizo engathunyelwa; ukuphatha ukuxhumana ngemiphumela yezinkinga kanye noshintsho oluthintekile kubasebenzi abasizwa; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinkinga zithunyelwa kuNgqongqoshe uma umuntu osizwa esengakwazi ukuvuma isinqumo; ukuphatha ukugcinwa kwemibhalo yokwamukela izinkomba zokuqondisa izingxabano nezaziso ezivela kwiKhomishana noma kwiKhomishani; ukuphatha imicimbi yezinhlelo zokuqondisa izingxabano; ukuqinisekisa izingqikithi zezobuchule ezikulezo zinkinga; ukuqinisekisa ukubhaliswa kwezicala zobungozi; ukunika incazelo emfushane ngesinqumo esiqhamukayo kusukela ekubhalweni koshintsho lokwenza izono kuye kube sekupheleni kwecala; ukuthatha imiyalo nemikhawulo yemiyalo ngokuphathelene nesiphetho esifunekayo kuzinkomba zolimi; ukusiza amacebo emvume yangaphakathi ezinsizeni ezintathu zokuqondisa; ukuphatha ukuqashwa kwabaphathi, abasunguli kanye nabaholi bezinkomba; ukuphatha ukuphenya imikhalifulo yobungozi kanye nokubhala imibhalo; ukuphatha ukwakheka kwemikhalifulo yobungozi; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi inqubo yemvume yangaphakathi ilandelwe ngemva kokuthola imibhalo yobuhlakani bokuphatha; ukuphatha ukuxhumana ngemiphumela yenkomba yolimi; ukubuka ukusetshenziswa kwemiphumela yezinkomba zolimi kwiPERSAL; ukubuka inqubo yezinkinga zohlelo ezithunyelwe; ukubuka ukusetshenziswa kwezinqumo zemiphumela yeKhomishani Yezono Eziyimali (iFIMICO); ukuqinisekisa imikhiqizo ethunyelwa kuNgqongqoshe noma kumeluleki wakhe uma kukhona isibopho sesicelo; ukuphatha ukubambisana kwezinkomba ze-DBC; ukuphatha imisebenzi yababhali ngesikhathi sohlangano lweqembu lokusebenza, nezinkomba ezibonwa ngababili kanye nezinkomba ezinkathuni; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphepha afanele atholakale ngokushesha futhi adakile; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umyalezo uyatholakala othunyelwe emaphathini afanele; ukuhambisana nemiyalo evela koMkhandlu, iCCMA noma eNkantolo ukuze kugwemeni izindleko zomshwabadela; ukuqonda izindlela ezithinta izingxabano ngobuchule; ukulungiselela ukususa, ukushintsha izinqumo nokuphinda kabili izicelo ukugxeka izinqumo izinkantolo, lapho kudingeka khona; ukunika umbono oqhamukayo ogqamile ngaphandle kwezinkimbinkimbi ngomumo wezinyathelo zokuhumusha nokusebenzisa amalungu alawula imithetho yokuvumelana kwabasebenzi; ukubona izindawo ngaphakathi komnyango ezingadinga ukuxhaswa ngemfundo yezindinganiso zabantu; ukulalela izinkinga zabantu kanye nokudala isimo esivumela ukukhulunywa ngaphandle kokukhathazeka; ukugada izinga lezindinganiso zabantu ngaphakathi kwezinhlela zokuxhumana (i-DBC) nangaphandle (iKhomishani); ukunika abaphathi namalungu amacebo abhalwe noma abukwe umlomo; ukugada ukuthi amaphathi ahambisana ne-LRA, imitheleka yeKhomishani kanye naseminye imithetho elawula imithetho yokuvumelana kwezinhlelo zokubonisana; ukuqinisekisa ukuthi amaphathi angaxoxi ngamaholo kanye nezinye izimo zokusebenza ngokuphathelene abasebenzi; ukweseka iqembu elimele abaqashi ezinkethweni ezinjengokuba yisibopho esithile, ngesizathu sokunciphisa ukuqhunywa kwesikhathi sokusebenza kwe-DBC.

xh.title: Isebe Lomongameli: Iimbanganiswa Basebenzi
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yamajoni ezimbanganiswa basebenzi kuquka nobhaliswa lwezikhulumo-izinxaxhi, uphando nezithintwelo ngaphakathi kweSabe seTurism ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esifanelekileyo se-NQF 7 kumaba ezamabalwa ngabasebenzi okanye isifundo esilingana neso. Iimvela zeminyaka emihlanu (5) kwindawo yamagaba abasebenzi apho eminyaka mithathu (3) kufuneka ibe kwinqanaba lokulawula. Isifundo seminyaka yedangatya kwamagaba abasebenzi siza kuba nzuzo. ULwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo namacebo esebe, nawo wonke amagaba abasebenzi aquka i-LRA, i-BCEA naku-EEA. Ikhono lokutolika nokusebenzisa iinkqubo, iindawo zolawulo namagaba. Ulwazi ngamagaba alo Mzeko, ulawulo lweefayile, i-PFMA namagaba alo Ndlu yoVimba. Unxibelelwano, ukuhlola nokuhlalutya nokuxhumana nabahlukileyo abalinganiselwayo kwangqondo. Ukuqonda iimvakalelo namakhono amaninzi ekunxibelelaneni nabantu. Ukuba nesipho sokuba ngumntu othe ngqo nentsha, kunye namakhono obugcisa. Ilayisenisi yokushayela esebenzayo (Abantu abakhawuleziso okuthi basinyathele abajongiweyo ekushayeleni bazakusakwa ngenkathalo).
xh.duties: Umthunywa ophumeleyo uza kubizwa ngokuba nawo amaxwebhu okubhaliswa kweziyalezo-iziphithiphithi, ukumisela abaphandi nogqatswa lokudlulisa iingxaki ngokuchanekileyo; ukuphatha uphando nengqungquthela zokubonisana okanye ukumiselwa kwemibungu xa kufanelekile; ukuhlalutya iingxelo zabaphandi nokuqinisekisa ukungabikho kwezibi kuludwe lokuvunywa; ukulawula ukubhalswa kokubhaliswa kokubuyisela ukulunga kweziyalezo-iziphithiphithi kwaye no lawulo. Ukuqinisekiswa kokuthi iinyikinyiki zikawuliswe kuNgqangqumbu xa umntu esagxeka ekuchaseni; ukuphatha amaxwebhu wokwamkelwa kweefomu zokusikwa komyalezo wokudibana noMzobe; ukulawula izinto ezingundozinyana ezokwenziwa kudibano lweNyikinyiki nokuviswa kobulumko; ukuqinisekisa ukungabikho kokujonga izinto ezinkqubo ngesakhono sokubakho obutsha phantsi kolwazi lokusetyenziswa; ukuqinisekisa ukubhaliswa kwemiqulu yeenkwathi; ukubakela ubumpofu iingxelo zomzobo kolwazi ngendlela zingagqibwa ngayo ixatso nelitye leminyaka nemiceli yokubakha ikhaya labantu iindlela ezahlukeneyo; ukumisela iindlela zokubakha ingqondo-ni yendalo yokubakho obukhoyo ukulunga isakhono esikhuselo iindlela ezahlukeneyo; ukubakha igazi lenkqubo yomceli kolwazi lwemisebenzi yoluntu lwe-CCMA okanye ekhofini; ukubakha ithuba lokubakha iindlela ezahlukeneyo ngokwahlukana kwemiqathango nokuqulunqa iingxelo eziphuma kwindlela yokubakha obutsha phantsi kolwazi loMzobo ngokugqithisa iindlela zokuyalela; ukulawula indlela yokubakha inethi yokubakha obutsha ngokubakha iindaba ezinkqubo zonxibelelwano; ukulawula ukubakha kolwazi ngendlela yokubakha obukhoyo kwimveliso ekuyona ndlela yamaphakathi oNyikinyiki; ukuqinisekisa ukuba indlela yokubakha igqibele ukubakha obutsha iindawo ezinkqubo; ukumisela iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokubakha obutsha nokuqulunqa iingxelo ezinkqubo; ukumisela iindlela zokubakha obutsha ngokuqula izinto ezinkqubo zomceli; ukuqinisekisa ukuba indlela yokubakha igqibele ukubakha obutsha kwimveliso yokubakha kwangoku; ukulawula ukubakha kolwazi ngendlela yokubakha obukhoyo kwimveliso yokubakha; ukubakela ubulumko ukubakha obutsha kwimveliso yokubakha e-CCMA noma ekhofini; ukubakha ithuba lokubakha obutsha kwimveliso yokubakha e-CCMA noma ekhofini; ukubakha ithuba lokubakha obutsha kwimveliso yokubakha e-CCMA noma ekhofini; ukubakha ithuba lokubakha obutsha kwimveliso yokubakha e-CCMA noma ekhofini; ukubakha ithuba lokubakha obutsha kwimveliso yokubakha e-CCMA noma ekhofini.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Claims Non-capital Incentives
jobs.closing_date_text: 25 August 2026 by 16:30, (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Assistant Director needed in Pretoria to manage non-capital incentive claims, including screening, evaluation and payment processing for the Department of Tourism.
jobs.requirements: A recognised NQF Level 6 qualification in Finance, Business Administration/ Economics. 3-4 years’ relevant working experience in the appropriate environment in the private or public sector, of which 2 years should be on a senior practitioner level or equivalent. Knowledge of the PFMA. Knowledge of the Tourism Act. Knowledge of Public Sector Regulations. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations. Understanding of the National Tourism Sector Strategy and the Tourism Growth Partnership Plan. Project management skills. Stakeholder management skills. Interpersonal and presentation skills. Numerical skills. Planning and organising skills. Knowledge of incentives will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s licence (persons with disabilities that prevent them from driving will still be considered).
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for acknowledgement of claims; screening claims by applying programme guidelines, rules and policies; evaluating complete claims; preparing payment advices; submitting claims at finance for payment processing; collection of stubs/ proof of payment; compile list of monthly cancellations of claims; compiling and submitting weekly and monthly workload statistics report; managing the database and updating payments on a daily basis, compiling the Travellers list of approved enterprises; communicating to approved enterprises to confirm airport departure; requesting quotations for flight and accommodation through the department’s travel agency; preparing visit authorisation enterprises and submit to the Department’s travel office; verify travel vouchers and send to the approved enterprises; collecting post intervention reports from the beneficiaries after the submission of claims upon their return from the event; collecting the six-months Impact Analysis Report from beneficiaries following the supported event;; following up on the outstanding post intervention and six months Impact Analysis Report; verifying information collected through the post-intervention report and six-month’s Impact Analysis Report; compiling and consolidating the interim financial statement and monthly TIP consolidated financial reports; assisting with reconciliation of travel and accommodation invoices against payments to the Department’s travel agency; providing inputs to the monthly consolidated commitments, accruals and expenditure reports; reconciling approved enterprise claims, travel and accommodation against BAS reports and report discrepancies found to the Supervisor; providing inputs to the quarterly and annual TIP implementation reports; assisting with implementation of the Memorandum of Agreement for the Tourism Grading Support Programme (TGSP); ensuring transfers to the implementer are done timeously upon receiving the request; verifying the information on the TGSP report and annexures and generating a report; drafting the annual meeting schedule; attending and providing secretariat duties during meetings; checking completed MASP files and archive with Records Management; update information and documents on EDMS; ensuring all claims are recorded and filed accordingly after approval; respond to verbal and written client’s queries, enquiries and referrals; liaising with internal and external stakeholders, meet walk in clients; marketing TIP incentives provincially; attending and participating in stakeholder awareness workshops and meetings; conducting site visits on a quarterly basis; identifying areas of improvements on the MASP guidelines and assisting to develop processes and material to ensure that readiness to introduce the revised guidelines.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Kekana Tel No: (012) 444 6333
jobs.applications: Email Application: Recruitment4426@tourism.gov.za
jobs.notes: Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine the suitability of a person for employment. EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a Z83 form and CV only. The electronic application must be in PDF format and made up of a single document file. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each post(s) advert must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial, and sign the Z83 form will lead to the disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Section A, B, C, and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83, it is acceptable for applicants to refer to their CV or see attached. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form are required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following the communication from Human Resources, and such qualifications (s) and other related documents (s) will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will further be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). Some of the interviewed candidates for Senior Management level vacancies may be subjected to a 2-day competency assessment that will test generic competencies. Appointment validity will be conditional to signing of the employment contract, performance agreement, and annual financial disclosure, and must attain a security clearance (vetting) applicable to the post. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment. You are consenting to the Department of Tourism processing your personal information, subject to POPIA, by applying for this post. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Eisings Nie-kapitale Aansporings
af.summary: Assistent-direkteur word in Pretoria benodig om nie-kapitale aansporingseisings te bestuur, insluitend sifting, evaluering en betalingsverwerking vir die Department of Tourism.
af.requirements: A recognized NQF Level 6 qualification in Finance, Business Administration/Economics. 3-4 years' relevant working experience in the appropriate environment in the private or public sector, of which 2 years should be on a senior practitioner level or equivalent. Knowledge of the PFMA. Knowledge of the Tourism Act. Knowledge of Public Sector Regulations. Knowledge of Treasury Regulations. Understanding of the National Tourism Sector Strategy and the Tourism Growth Partnership Plan. Project management skills. Stakeholder management skills. Interpersonal and presentation skills. Numerical skills. Planning and organising skills. Knowledge of incentives will be an added advantage. A valid driver's licence (persons with disabilities that prevent them from driving will still be considered).
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal verantwoordelik wees vir die erkenning van eise; die sifting van eise deur programriglyne, reels en beleide toe te pas; die evaluering van volledige eise; die voorbereiding van betaaladvise; die indiening van eise by finansies vir betalingsverwerking; die insameling van stubs/bewyse van betaling; die opstel van 'n lys van maandelikse kansellasies van eise; die opstel en indiening van weeklikse en maandelikse werkladingstatistiekverslae; die bestuur van die databasis en die daaglikse opdatering van betalings, die opstel van die reisigerslys van goedgekeurde ondernemings; die kommunikasie met goedgekeurde ondernemings om lughawe-vertrek te bevestig; die aanvra van kwotasies vir vlugte en akkommodasie deur die departement se reisagentskap; die voorbereiding van besoekmagtigingsondernemings en indiening by die departement se reiskantoor; die verifiëring van reisbonne en stuur daarvan na die goedgekeurde ondernemings; die insameling van post-intervensieverslae van die begunstigdes na die indiening van eise by hul terugkeer van die byeenkoms; die insameling van die ses-maande Impak-analiseverslag van begunstigdes na die ondersteunde byeenkoms;; die opvolg van die uitstaande post-intervensie- en ses-maande Impak-analiseverslag; die verifiëring van inligting wat deur die post-intervensieverslag en ses-maande Impak-analiseverslag ingesamel is; die opstel en konsolidasie van die tussentydse finansiële staat en maandelikse TIP-gekonsoleerde finansiële verslae; die bystand met die rekonsiliasie van reis- en akkommodasiefakture teen betalings aan die departement se reisagentskap; die voorsiening van insette tot die maandelikse gekonsoleerde verbintenis-, aantekening- en uitgawesverslae; die rekonsiliasie van goedgekeurde onderneming se eise, reis en akkommodasie teen BAS-verslae en die rapportering van afwykings aan die toesighouer; die voorsiening van insette tot die kwartaal- en jaarlikse TIP-implementasieverslae; die bystand met die implementering van die Memorandum of Agreement vir die Tourism Grading Support Programme (TGSP); die versekering dat oordragte aan die implementeerder tydig gedoen word upon receiving the request; die verifiëring van inligting op die TGSP-verslag en bylaes en die genereer van 'n verslag; die opstel van die jaarlikse vergaderingskedule; die bywoning en verskaffing van sekretariaatspligte tydens vergaderings; die nagaan van voltooide MASP-lêers en argivering met Records Management; die opdatering van inligting en dokumente op EDMS; die versekering dat alle eise ooreenkomstig aangeteken en gevul word na goedkeuring; die reageer op mondelinge en skriftelike kliëntnavrae, enquiries and referrals; die skakeling met interne en eksterne belanghebbendes, die ontmoeting van inlopende kliënte; die bemarking van TIP-aansporings op provinsiale vlak; die bywoning en deelname aan belanghebbende-bewustheidswerkswinkels en vergaderings; die voer van werfbesoeke op 'n kwartaallikse basis; die identifiseer van areas vir verbetering op die MASP-richtlyne en die bystand met die ontwikkeling van prosesse en materiaal om gereedheid te verseker vir die bekendstelling van die hersiende richtlyne.

zu.title: Umcebisi ohloniphekile: Izimfanelo ezingenyuziyo zezinkuthazongenxabhas
zu.summary: Kudingeka umcebisi ohloniphekile ePretoria ukuphatha izimfanelo ezingenyuziyo zezinkuthazongenxabhas, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola, ukuhlonza inani kanye nokuphatha ukukhokhelwa kwe-Department of Tourism.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezitholwa ezisingathingeni se-NQF Level 6 kwi-Finance, i-Business Administration/ Economics. Umdlalo weminyaka engu-3-4 wokusebenza ohambisanayo endaweni efanele esimeni yangasese noma yomphakathi, lapho kwengu-2 iminyaka kufanele ibe ezingeni lomsebenzi ophakeme noma okulingana nalo. Ulwazi mayelana ne-PFMA. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Tourism Act. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Public Sector Regulations. Ulwazi mayelana ne-Treasury Regulations. Ukuqonda i-National Tourism Sector Strategy kanye ne-Tourism Growth Partnership Plan. Amakhono ephathwa kwezinhlelo. Amakhono ephathwa bantu abahlobene nenhlelo. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu kanye nokubakhombisa. Amakhono okubala. Amakhono okuhlela futhi uhlele. Ulwazi ngalezozinkuthazo kuzoba yinzuzo. Ilayisensi yokushayela ethi iyasebenza (abantu abanesikhonzi esibavimba ukuthi bashaye bazifudukeli besaba kubakhona besebekhona).
zu.duties: Umuntu oqokwe kuzobe nguye ohlezi ekwindla ukwamukela izinkambiso; ukuseswa kwezinkambiso ngokuphathwa okusemthethweni kohlelo, kanye namaphoyisa; ukuhlola izinkambiso eziphela; ukulungiselelwa izaziso zokukhokha; ukuthumela izinkambiso ezikhokhelwa endlini yemali ukuze zenziwe izinkambiso zokukhokha; ukuqoqa izinkambiso/izibonakaliso zokukhokhelwa; ukuqoqa uhlu lwamathuluzi angena mikhathi yonnyaka wamaphesheya; Amapwo ezibalo. Amapwo eplani nokuhlela. Ulwazi ngezibonelelo kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni (abantu abakhubazekileyo abangenakuqhuba basayiya kubalwa).

ukungenisa iinkcaso kumashishini ukusingatha intlawulo; ukuqokelela iimpompo/ inkqubo yokuhombisa intlawulo; ukwenza uluhlu lwe nkcaso ezicinywa nyanga zonke; ukuqumba kunye nokungenisa iingxelo zeestatistici zomsebenzi ngeveki ngenyanga; ukulawula idathabhesi nokuhlaziya iintlawulo nsuku nasinye, ukwenza uluhlu lweVakashi lamashishini avunyiweyo; ukuxoxa namashishini avunyiweyo ukuqinisekisa ukuhamba kolwandle; ukucela iikota zokundulula nendlalo ngommeli wendawo wesebe; ukuqinisekisa amaxwebhu aphakathi kwendalo, ukubonisa nokuqinisekisa ukuba ayimfuno ekwindlu ebalulekileyo yokwenza iingxelo ezibalulekileyo ngokuchasene nezinye iingxelo; ukubonelela ngolwazi noluhlu ngendlela ebalulekileyo yokusingatha nokusebenza okuhilela umntu ngamnye onxaxhe ekwenzeni okuphantsi kolunye ulwazi ngokusetyenziswa kolunye usetyenziso; ukubonelela ngezinto ezifunekayo ngokusetyenziswa kolunye usetyenziso okufuneka kweNkqubo yeSebe; ukubonelela ngokulinganisa okunokubakho ekwenziweni kolunye ukwaziswa kwesi sizwe, kuxhomekeke kummandla ongokusetyenziswa kwakho; jobs.title: Human Resource Utilisation and Capacity Development
jobs.closing_date_text: 25 August 2026 by 16:30, (Late applications will not be considered)
jobs.summary: Provide administrative support for the bursary scheme, including processing tuition fee and book claims, at the Department of Tourism in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) or equivalent qualification. Knowledge of registry duties, practices, as well as the ability to capture data and operate computer. Working knowledge and understanding of the legislative framework governing the Public Service. Computer literacy. Planning and organising skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Interpersonal skills. Teamwork. Flexibility. HR experience would be an added advantage. A valid driver's license.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will be responsible for providing administrative support for internal and external bursary scheme; receiving and processing tuition fee claims, prescribed book claims and related documentation; verifying student accounts and confirming previous payments where repeat modules are involved; preparing tuition payment requests and submit them to Finance within prescribed timeframes; maintaining accurate records of bursary beneficiaries and related documentation; providing registry, document management and general administrative support; preparing, photocopying, scanning, binding and distributing documents for training, induction, orientation and other HRD programmes; receiving, distributing and tracking official correspondence; maintaining an effective filing and records management system; ensuring confidential disposal of documents through approved shredding processes; providing general administrative support to the Directorate; maintaining Human Resource Development databases and records; capturing and maintaining learner information on the HRD database; updating databases relating to internships, bursaries, Workplace Skills Plan (WSP) training interventions, induction and orientation programmes; producing accurate reports and statistics information when required; maintaining electronic and manual records of all HRD interventions; coordinating training logistics and supporting the implementation of learning interventions; arranging training venues and logistical requirements; coordinating learner registration and attendance confirmations; preparing attendance registers and training material; conducting pre-course administrative activities; monitoring attendance during training interventions; administering training evaluation forms and compile evaluation reports; arranging transport and other logistical requirements where applicable; liaising with training providers and internal stakeholder regarding training arrangements; providing administrative support to the internship programme; assisting with the administration and placement of interns within the Department; coordinating induction and orientation programmes for interns; maintaining intern records and monthly internship reports; supporting the implementation of internship development programmes; monitoring compliance with internship administrative requirements; providing administrative support for Performance Management and Development System; receiving records and filing performance agreements and performance assessment documentation; performing quality assurance on submitted PMDS documents; monitoring compliance with PMDS submission timeframes; compiling reports on outstanding and non-compliant submissions; maintaining accurate filling and record management of all PMDS documentations. ENQUIRIES Ms N Buthelezi Tel No: (012) 444 6149
jobs.applications: Email Application: Recruitment4526@tourism.gov.za
jobs.notes: Short-listed candidates will be subjected to screening and security vetting to determine the suitability of a person for employment. EE Requirements: Coloured Male and White Male candidates as well as Youth and People with Disabilities are encouraged to apply. Application must include a Z83 form and CV only. The electronic application must be in PDF format and made up of a single document file. Indicate the correct job title and the reference number of the post on the subject line of your email. Applications quoting the relevant reference number must be submitted on the new form Z83, obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents. Received applications using the incorrect application for employment (old Z83) will not be considered. Each post(s) advert must be accompanied by its own application form for employment and must be fully completed, initialled, and signed by the applicant as instructed below. Failure to fully complete, initial, and sign the Z83 form will lead to the disqualification of the application during the selection process. All fields of Section A, B, C, and D of the Z83 must be completed in full. Section E, F, G (Due to the limited space on the Z83, it is acceptable for applicants to refer to their CV or see attached. However, the question related to conditions that prevent re-appointment under Part “F” must be answered, and the declaration signed. Only an updated comprehensive CV (with detailed previous experience, if any) and a completed and signed new Z83 application form are required. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following the communication from Human Resources, and such qualifications (s) and other related documents (s) will be in line with the requirements of the advert. Applicants in possession of foreign qualifications must be accompanied by an evaluation report issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Applicants who do not comply with the abovementioned instructions/ requirements, as well as applications received late, will not be considered. Correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will further be subjected to a personnel suitability check (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification, and employment verification). Some of the interviewed candidates for Senior Management level vacancies may be subjected to a 2-day competency assessment that will test generic competencies. Appointment validity will be conditional to signing of the employment contract, performance agreement, and annual financial disclosure, and must attain a security clearance (vetting) applicable to the post. zu.title: Ukusetshenziswa kwezinsizakalo zabantu kanye Nentuthuko Yamandla

Okuhle kakhulu ukuba nohlu lozamosebenzi kwi-HR. Ilayisense yokushayela esevumelekile.

ukuqinisekisa ama-akhawunti abafundi futhi uqinisekise izinkokhelo eziseduze lapho kubandakanyeka ukuphindwa kwemodule; ukulungela izicelo zezinkokhelo zefundi futhi uzihambise eMnyangweni Wezezimali ngaphakathi kwezikhathi ezinqunyiwe; ukwamukela, ukusabalalisa futhi ulandelele ukuxhumana ngokusemthethweni; ukugcina uhlelo olusebenzayo lokuqeqelwa kanye nokuqanjwa kwamarekhodi; ukuqinisekisa ukulahlwa kwamadokhumenti okuyimfihlo ngokusebenzisa izinqubo zokushayelwa ezivunyiwe; ukunika inkxaso ngokujwayelekile yokuphatha kuKhomishani; ukugcina amadathabhentsi kanye namarekhodi e-Human Resource Development; ukungenisa futhi aze ugcube ulwazi lwesifundi kwidathabhentsi ye-HRD; ukubuyekeza amadathabhentsi ahlobene namakhashane, ama-bursary, izinhlelo zokuqeqesha ze-Workplace Skills Plan (WSP), okwazisa nokuhola; ukukhiqiza amarekhodi ajwayelekile kanye nolwazi lwesibalo lapho kudingeka; ukulungiselela ukubhaliswa kwesifundi kanye neziqinisekiso zokubakhona; ukulungela amarekhodi wokubakhona kanye nokuqeqeshwa kwemateriali; ukwenza imisebenzi yokuphatha ngaphambi kokuqeqesha; ukulandelela ukubakhona ngesikhathi sokuqeqeshwa; ukuphatha amafomuokuqinisekisa ukuqeqeshwa futhi uqoqe amarekhodiokuqinisekisa; ukuhlela izwezokuhamba kanye nezinye izidingo lapho kufanele; ukuxhumana nabahlinzeki bokuqeqesha kanye nabashwiniphili bangaphakathi ngokuhlotshaniswa nokuqeqeshwa; ukwamukela amarekhodi kanye nokugcina izivumelwano kokuqina ngokusebenza kanye netohuthi yokuhlola ukusebenza; ukwenza ukuqinisekiswa kwebungu kumadokhumenti e-PMDS okuthunyelwe; ukulandelela ukuthobela izikhathi zokuthumela amadokhumenti e-PMDS; kwokuqinisekisa i-akhawunti zabafundi nokuqinisekisa intlawulo yangaphambili apho kubandakanyeka iimodyuli eziphindoziwayo; kwokulungisa iifomu zentlawulo yemfundo nokuvezazisesigqibeni kwi-Finance ngaphakathi kwexesha elichiwayo; jobs.title: Accounting Clerk: Financial Management
jobs.summary: Capture and reconcile payments, handle BAS and PERSAL queries, and manage monthly IRP5 reconciliations for the Department of Traditional Affairs.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 Certificate with Accounting/Mathematics as a passed subject. A Degree or National Diploma in Accounting/Business Administration or equivalent with accounting as a passed subject will serve as an added advantage. A valid drivers licence. Generic competencies: Finance, problem solving and client orientation and customer focus. Technical competencies: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, general ledger reconciliation and analysis, Knowledge of travel and subsistence, Basic Accounting System (BAS) and PERSAL System.
jobs.duties: The successful candidate will perform the following duties: Capturing, reconciling and ensuring that payments are made within 30 days. Responsible for all queries in respect of BAS and PERSAL payments. Responsible for the reconciliation of monthly IRP5 and ensure timeous payments to the South African Revenue Services and other third parties for statutory deductions. Liaising with clients and resolving queries related to payments. Maintenance and clearing of salary suspense account. Responsible for accounts receivable, accounts, journalise, reconciliations, and prepare payments. Handling of salary claims as well as the clearance of all suspense accounts and payments enquiries and payments from other departments. Assist with month-end closure processes. Assist with provision of source documents/payment batches to Auditor-General and Internal Audit.
jobs.enquiries: Mr L Motlhabedi Tel No: (012) 065 3440

af.title: Rekeningsklerk: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Lê betalings vas en stem dit af, hanteer BAS- en PERSAL-navrae, en bestuur maandelikse IRP5-afstemming vir die Department of Traditional Affairs.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat met Rekeningkunde/Wiskunde as 'n geslaagde vak. 'n Graad of Nasionale Diploma in Rekeningkunde/Besigheidsadministrasie of gelykwaardig met rekeningkunde as 'n geslaagde vak sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Generiese bevoegdhede: Finansies, probleemoplossing en kliëntgerigtheid en klantfokus. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), Treasury Regulations, algemene joernaalafstemming en ontleding, kennis van reis en onderhoud, Basic Accounting System (BAS) en PERSAL-stelsel.
af.duties: Die suksesvolle kandidaat sal die volgende pligte uitvoer: Vastlegging, afstemming en verseker dat betalings binne 30 dae gedoen word. Verantwoordelik vir alle navrae ten opsigte van BAS- en PERSAL-betalings. Verantwoordelik vir die afstemming van maandelikse IRP5 en verseker tydige betalings aan die South African Revenue Services en ander derde partye vir statutêre aftrekkings. Skakel met kliënte en los navrae rakende betalings op. Onderhoud en verrekening van salarisskorskingsrekening. Verantwoordelik vir debiteure, rekeninge, joernale, afstemming, en die voorbereiding van betalings. Hantering van salariseise asook die verrekening van alle skorskingsrekeninge en betalingsnavrae en betalings van ander departemente. Bystand verleen met maandeindsluitingsprosesse. Bystand verleen met die verskaffing van brondokumente/betalingsbondels aan Auditor-General en Internal Audit.

jobs.title: Director: Data Governance
jobs.summary: Director of Data Governance at National Treasury in Pretoria requiring a relevant degree and five years' middle or senior managerial experience in data governance.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 coupled with minimum Bachelor’s Degree (equivalent to NQF Level 7) in Computer Science or Economics or Data Science or Information Management or related qualification. A minimum 5 years’ experience at a middle/senior managerial level obtained in data governance, management and compliance. Experience in the formulation and managing of data governance frameworks, policies and practices. Knowledge of data governance frameworks (e.g., DAMA-DMBOK), data privacy regulations (e.g. POPIA), and data quality standards. Knowledge and experience with data management tools and metadata management platforms. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government available as an online course on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of an appointment.
jobs.duties: Data governance framework and policy development: Develop and implement a comprehensive data governance and management framework, including policies, standards, and procedures. Define data ownership, stewardship roles, and accountability across the organisation. Establish a Data Governance Committee to drive adherence to data policies and facilitate decision-making. Define and track key data governance metrics to measure the effectiveness of data governance initiatives. Lead data governance and data management related to the MzansiXchange. Data and metadata management: Implement and oversee master data management processes to ensure consistency and accuracy of critical data entities. Establish a data catalogue to classify National Treasury data assets. Implement metadata management practices. Ensure that data catalogue and metadata are continuously updated. Data quality management and improvement: Establish data quality metrics, standards, and processes to ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability. Develop appropriate techniques for data verification, profiling, cleaning, and monitoring techniques to maintain high data quality. Collaborate with data stewards and divisions to identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions. Stay updated on emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in data governance and data management. Lead initiatives to adopt new tools and technologies that enhance data governance capabilities. Data compliance, security, and risk management: Ensure compliance with data privacy laws and regulations (e.g., POPIA) and industry standards. Identify potential data risks and develop strategies to mitigate them, including data access controls and encryption Collaborate with the IT and cybersecurity teams to ensure data security protocols are integrated into the data governance framework. Stakeholder engagement: Train and educate stakeholders on data governance best practices, data ownership, and compliance requirements. Engage internal and external stakeholders on new developments pertaining to data governance, compliance, security and risk management and their impact on the management of data in the National Treasury. Represent National Treasury on inter-governmental and other external forums and committees related to data governance. Establish relationships with key government departments, research and international organisations to advance data governance functions.
