zu.summary: Umlawuli Wokuphathwa Kwemininingwane e-National Treasury e-Pretoria ofuna idiploma ehambisana nale ndima namafemu eminyaka yesebe eliphakathi noma eliphezulu lokuphathwa kwemininingwane.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-Bachelor's Degree okungenani (elingana ne-NQF Level 7) kwi-Computer Science noma i-Economics noma i-Data Science noma i-Information Management noma iziqu ezihambisanayo. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yesiphephelo esiphakathi/esiphezulu sokulawula esitholwe ekuphathweni kwemininingwane, ekulawuleni nasekuhambisweni nemithetho. Isiphephelo ekwakheni nokuphathweni kwezimiso zokuphathwa kwemininingwane, izinqubomgomo namasu. Ulwazi ngezimiso zokuphathwa kwemininingwane (isb., DAMA-DMBOK), imithetho yobumfihlo bemininingwane (isb. POPIA), nezindinganiso zekhwalithi yemininingwane. Ulwazi nesiphephelo ngamathuluzi okuphathwa kwemininingwane namasikrini okuphathwa kwemethadatha. Ukuphothula ngemphumelelo i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengoba kunconyiwe i-National School of Government etholakala njengenkathi ye-inthanethi ku-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqiba ukumiswa komuntu.
zu.duties: Ukwakha kwesimiso nezinqubomgomo zokuphathwa kwemininingwane: Ukuthuthukisa nokusebenzisa isimiso esibhekelele ekuphathweni nakulawulweni kwemininingwane, okuhlanganisa izinqubomgomo, izindinganiso, nezinqubo. Ukuchaza ubunikazi bemininingwane, izikhundla zokulondolozwa, kanye nebheki ekuphathweni kwemininingwane kule nhlangano. Ukusungula i-Komidi Yokuphathwa Kwemininingwane ukuqondisa ukulandela izinqubomgomo zemininingwane nokwenza kube lula ukuthathwa kwezinqumo. Ukuchaza kanye nokulandelela izilinganiso ezibalulekile zokuphathwa kwemininingwane ukulinganisa ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwemininingwane. Ukukhokhela ukuphathwa kwemininingwane nokulawula ukuphathwa kwemininingwane okuhlobene ne-MzansiXchange. Ukuphathwa kwemininingwane nemethadatha: Ukusebenzisa kanye nokubheka izinqubo zokuphathwa kwemininingwane eyinhloko ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukungaphazimi nokunembile kwezinhlobo ezibalulekile zemininingwane. Ukusungula ikhataloghi yemininingwane ukuhlelwa kwezimpahla zemininingwane ze-National Treasury. Ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuphathwa kwemethadatha. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ikhataloghi yemininingwane kanye nemethadatha zibuyekezwa njalo. Ukuphathwa nokuthuthukiswa kwekhwalithi yemininingwane: Ukusungula izilinganiso zekhwalithi yemininingwane, izindinganiso, nezinqubo ukuqinisekisa ukunembile, ukuphelele, ukungaphazimi, nokuthembeka kwemininingwane. Ukuthuthukisa izindlela ezifanele zokuqinisekisa, ukuhlola, ukucotha, kanye nokulandelela imininingwane ukugcina ikhwalithi ephezulu yemininingwane. Ukusebenzisana nalabo abagcinayo imininingwane namaphiko ukuze kutholwe izinkinga zekhwalithi yemininingwane kuthuthukiswe izinyathelo zokulungisa. Ukuhlala usezindaweni zezinto ezintsha, izobuchwepheshe, nezilungiselelo ezinhle ekuphathweni nakulawulweni kwemininingwane. Ukukhokhela izinhlelo zokwamukela amathuluzi amasha nobuchwepheshe okuthuthukisa amandla okuphathwa kwemininingwane. Ukwezimiso, ukuvikeleka, nokuphathwa kwezingozi kwemininingwane: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemithetho nezinqubomgomo zobumfihlo bemininingwane (isb. POPIA) nezindinganiso zemboni. Ukuhlola izingozi ezikhona zemininingwane futhi kuthuthukiswe izindlela zokuzehlisa, okuhlanganisa ukulawula ukufinyelela kwemininingwane kanye nesitheke. Ukusebenzisana neqembu le-IT nasekuvikelekeni kwe-intanethi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba izinqubo zokuvikeleka kwemininingwane zihlanganisiwe esimisweni sokuphathwa kwemininingwane. Ukuhlanganyela ngemibhano: Ukufundisa kanye nokwazi abahlanganyele mayelana nezilungiselelo ezinhle zokuphathwa kwemininingwane, ubunikazi bemininingwane, nezidingo zokuhambisana nemithetho. Ukuhlanganisa abahlanganyeli bongaphakathi nabangaphandle mayelana nezinto ezintsha ezihlobene nokuphathwa kwemininingwane, ukuhambisana nemithetho, ukuvikeleka, nokuphathwa kwezingozi nendima yawo ekuphathweni kwemininingwane e-National Treasury. Ukumela i-National Treasury emabhonweni aphakathi kuhulumeni nasezinye izikhungweni zangaphandle nakumakomidi ahlobene nokuphathwa kwemininingwane. Ukwakha ubudlelwano namajende abalulekile kahulumende, ucwaningo kanye nezinhlangano zamazwe ngamazwe ukuthuthukisa imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwemininingwane.

xh.title: Umphathi: Ulawulo Lwemininingwane
xh.summary: Umphathi woLawulo Lwemininingwane kwi-National Treasury e-Pretoria ofuna isidanga esifanelekileyo kunye namashumi amahlanu eminyaka yamava aphakathi okanye ephezulu ekulawulweni kwemininingwane.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 12 ekunye nesidanga esincinci se-Bachelor's Degree (elingana ne-NQF Level 7) kwi-Computer Science okanye i-Economics okanye i-Data Science okanye i-Information Management okanye ngesiqinisekiso esinxulumeneyo. Amava angesona ngaphantsi kweminyaka engama-5 kwinqanaba le-management eliphakathi/ephezulu afunyenwe kwilawulo, ulawulo nokuzithoba kwemininingwane. Amava ekumisweni nakulawulweni kweendlela zokusebenza, iinkqubo nemigaqo yolawulo lwemininingwane. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokusebenza zolawulo lwemininingwane (umz., DAMA-DMBOK), iimigaqo yobumfihlo bemininingwane (umz. POPIA), nakumazinga omgangatho wemininingwane. Ulwazi namava ngamathuluzi olawulo lwemininingwane kunye nesiqendu solawulo lwemethadatha. Ukuphumelela ukugqiba i-Nyukela Public Service Senior Management Leadership Programme njengokuqinisekiswe yi-National School of Government ekhona njengenkqubo kwi-https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, ngaphambi kokugqibeka kwesithuba.
xh.duties: Inkqubo yolawulo lwemininingwane nentlhaselo yemigaqo: Phuhlisa futhi usebenzise inkqubo eqondileyo yolawulo nokulawula imininingwane, kuquka iimigaqo, amazinga, kunye neendlela zokusebenza. Chaza ubunini bemininingwane, iindima zokulonda, kunye nexabiso kulo lonke iqela. Misi iKomiti yoLawulo Lwemininingwane ukuyisa phambili ukuthobela iimigaqo yemininingwane nokunceda ekwenzeni isigqibo. Chaza ulandele iimilinganiselo ebalulekileyo yolawulo lwemininingwane ukulinganisa ukusebenza kweziganu zulawulo lwemininingwane. Yisa phambili ulawulo lwemininingwane nakulawulo kwemininingwane enxulumene ne-MzansiXchange. Ulawulo lwemininingwane nalemethadatha: Sebenzisa ulawule iinkqubo zolawulo lwemininingwane ephambili ukuqinisekisa ulwazi-luvakalelwe nokuchaneka kwezinto ezibalulekileyo zemininingwane. Misi uvimbo weemininingwane wokuqwalasela iimpahla zemininingwane ze-National Treasury. Sebenzisa iindlela zolawulo lwemethadatha. Qinisekisa ukuba uvimbo weemininingwane nalemethadatha zihlaziyelwa ngokunoqoba. Ulawulo nokuphucula umgangatho wemininingwane: Misiiimilinganiselo yomgangatho wemininingwane, amazinga, kunye neendlela zokusebenza ukuqinisekisa ukuchaneka, ukugqibelela, ukulunga, kunye nokuthembeka kwemininingwane. Phuhlisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo zokuqinisekisa, ukuqwalasela, ukucotha, kunye nokuqaphela imininingwane ukugcina umgangatho ophezulu wemininingwane. Sebenzisana nabalondolozo bemininingwane kunye namacandelo ukuzisa iingxaki zomgangatho wemininingwane futhi uqhubele phambili izinyathelo zokulungisa. Hlala uvuselelwa ngeentengiso ezisanda kuko, iiteknoloji, kunye neendlela ezilungileyo kulawulo nakulawulo lwemininingwane. Yisa phambili iziganu zokuamkela amathuluzi amasha namateknoloji aphucula amand olawulo lwemininingwane. Ulawulo lokuzithoba, ukhuseleko, nolawulo lengozi: Qinisekisa ukuzithoba ngokwemigaqo nemithetho yobumfihlo bemininingwane (umz. POPIA) kunye namazinga eshishino. Qaphela iingozi ezinokubakho zemininingwane futhi uphuhlise iindlela zokuzithoba, kuquka ulawulo lofikelelo nemininingwane kufuziso. Sebenzisana neqela le-IT nolokhuseleko kwinethiwekhi ukuzinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zokhuseleko lwemininingwane zongezwa kwindlela yolawulo lwemininingwane. Ukuqhelana nabaninimathathala: Qeqesha futhi ufundise abaninimathathala ngeendlela ezilungileyo zolawulo lwemininingwane, ubunini, kunye nemfuneko yokuzithoba. Qhelisana abaninimathathala bangaphakathi nangaphandle ngezinto ezintsha ezinxulumene nolawulo lwemininingwane, ukuzithoba, ukhuseleko nolawulo lweengozi nomthelela wawo ekulawulweni kwemininingwane kwi-National Treasury. Mela i-National Treasury kumajelo ohlukileyo kolawulo kaphakathi kunye namanye amajelo angaphandle kwaye neekomiti ezinxulumene nolawulo lwemininingwane. Sakha iindibaniselwano namasebe abalulekileyo kurhulumente, uphononongo ngengezo-mazwe ukuyisa phambili izigaba zolawulo lwemininingwane.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: BAS & Logis Operations
jobs.summary: Manage BAS and Logis system operations and modernisation initiatives for National Treasury, supporting national and provincial government departments.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 is required, coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF Level 6) or Bachelor’s. Degree (equivalent to NQF level 7) in Information Technology, Information Systems, or Business Analysis; A certification in Project Management will serve as an added advantage. A minimum of 3 years’ experience obtained in an application, system support, or operations environment. Experience in transversal financial management systems operations and support processes (incident, problem solving, change and release management). Experience in Project Management (IT Systems Implementation). Knowledge and experience of the public-sector financial framework and end-user support in a multi-stakeholder environment.
jobs.duties: Systems Operations & Modernisation: Assist in the evaluation of policy requirements and user specifications for National and Provincial Government Departments. Assist with planning and implementation of proposed and new initiatives, e.g. modernisation, configuration, patching and upgrade for the enhancement of financial system capabilities (e.g., General Ledger, Reporting and Analytics). Validate that the implemented functionality meets business requirements prior to deployment. Coordinate change and release activities for new system enhancements and support user access (user provisioning, role/profile maintenance and access reviews) in accordance with security and segregation-of-duties requirements. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, user guides, knowledge articles and support documentation to promote consistent, high-quality service delivery. Evaluate Financial Systems Competencies: Assist in conducting policy research in conjunction with stakeholders, e.g. Office of the Accountant General, CPO and DPSA, etc. Assist in collaborating policy initiatives with other technical experts and evaluate inputs in alignment with system requirements. Log, coordinate and monitor incidents, service requests and problems; support root-cause analysis and implement approved corrective and preventive actions. Provide functional and operational support for transversal financial management systems in accordance with agreed service levels and governance processes. Financial Management Systems Accessibility: Assist in providing percentage availability of the system during peak processing times. Assist in integrating measure to enable system to recover data lost during operations downtimes. Assist in conducting policy research in conjunction with stakeholders, e.g. Office of the Accountant General, CPO and DPSA, etc. Stakeholder Engagement: Assist in developing communication circulars regarding new system functionalities, updates and implications to users. Assist in coordinating Annual User Forums and attend other Stakeholder Forums when necessary. Support business readiness, stakeholder engagement, defect resolution and post- implementation validation. Ensure stakeholder communication, implementation readiness and successful deployment within approved timeframes. Assist in developing intervention strategies and assist users.
jobs.enquiries: enquiries only (No applications): Recruitment.Enquries@treasury.gov.za
jobs.applications: To apply visit: https://erecruitment.treasury.gov.za/eRecruitment
jobs.notes: Effective from 7 April 2021, the National Treasury now utilises an e-Recruitment System which means all applicants must login/register to apply for positions, we only accept hand delivered/posted applications should an applicant prove that he/she tried to apply via e-Recruitment with no success and the National Treasury ICT unit was unable to assist. The applicant’s profile on the e- Recruitment is equivalent to the newly approved Z83, and it is the responsibility of applicants to ensure their profiles are fully completed or their applications will not be considered, as per the DPSA Practice Note. Certain documentation will still be required to be uploaded on the system such as copies of all qualifications including National Senior Certificate/Matric certificate, ID, etc., however these documents need not be certified at point of application, however certification will be required prior to attending the interview. Please note: All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. It should be noted that the National Treasury does not support the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in any of its recruitment and selection processes and will disqualify an application if it picks up the use of AI when completing assessments without acknowledging the source of information. Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government,            available       as      an       online       course      on https://www.thensg.gov.za/training-course/sms-pre-entry-programme/, prior to finalisation of appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. All qualifications, criminal and SA citizenship checks will be conducted on all short-listed candidates and, where applicable, additional checks will be conducted in line with the new DPSA Directive effective 01 April 2024. Please note that by responding to our advertisement/s, you consent to the collection, processing, and storing of your Personal Information for internal HR processes in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), Act No. 4 of 2013. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies, only for a specific period, of which the submitted documents will then be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. It is the applicant’s responsibility to have all their foreign qualifications (this includes O and A level certificates) evaluated by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at your own expense. Upon appointment, successful candidates will be required to disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and to sign a Performance Agreement within 3 months from date of appointment and for candidates whose appointment exceeds 12 calendar months will be appointed on probation for the period of twelve (12) calendar months excluding leave taken as prescribed by Public Service Regulation 68. The status of your application will be visible on the e-Recruitment system. However, if you have not received feedback from the National Treasury within 3 months of the closing date, please regard your application as unsuccessful. Note: The National Treasury reserves the right not to fill the below-mentioned posts, withdraw or put on hold a position and/or to re-advertise a post. All queries must be submitted via email addressed to the Human Resources Recruitment Support Team on Recruitment.Enquiries@treasury.gov.za. Kindly note that all National Treasury adverts published/LIVE on the eRecruitment System have a closing date listed and closing time of 12h00 (Midday) on that closing date. The system is designed to automatically remove the advert from public view at exactly 12h00 (Midday) of the said closing date for that post. There are no other means to submit applications post the closing date and time, if you have missed or delayed in submitting on time. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Assistentdirekteur: BAS & Logis-bedrywighede
af.summary: Bestuur BAS- en Logis-stelselbedrywighede en moderniseringsinisiatiewe vir National Treasury, met ondersteuning van nasionale en provinsiale regeringsdepartemente.
af.requirements: 'n Graad 12 word vereis, tesame met 'n minimum Nasionale Diploma (gelykstaande aan NQF Vlak 6) of Baccalaureusgraad (gelykstaande aan NQF Vlak 7) in Inligtingstegnologie, Inligtingstelsels, of Besigheidsanalise; 'n Sertifikaat in Projekbestuur sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. 'n Minimum van 3 jaar se ervaring wat in 'n toepassing-, stelselsondersteunings- of bedryfsondersteuningsomgewing opgedoen is. Ervaring in transversale finansiële bestuurstelselbedrywighede en ondersteuningsprosesse (voorval-, probleemoplossing-, veranderings- en vrystellingsbestuur). Ervaring in Projekbestuur (IT-stelselimplementering). Kennis en ervaring van die openbare sektor se finansiële raamwerk en eindegebruikersondersteuning in 'n multi-belanghebbende omgewing.
af.duties: Stelselbedryf en modernisering: Help met die evaluering van beleidsvereistes en gebruikerspesifikasies vir Nasionale en Provinsiale Regeringsdepartemente. Help met beplanning en implementering van voorgestelde en nuwe inisiatiewe, bv. modernisering, konfigurasie, pleistering en opgradering vir die verbetering van finansiële stelselvermoëns (bv., Algemene Grootboek, Verslagdoening en Analise). Bevestig dat die geïmplementeerde funksionaliteit aan besigheidsvereistes voldoen voor ontplooiing. Koördineer verandering- en vrystellingsaktiwiteite vir nuwe stelselverbeterings en ondersteun gebruikerstoegang (gebruikerprovisionering, rol/profielonderhoud en toegangshersienings) in ooreenstemming met sekuriteits- en skeiding-van-pligvereistes. Ontwikkel en onderhou standaardbedryfsprosedures, gebruikersgidse, kennisartikels en ondersteuningsdokumentasie om konsekwente, hoëgehalte-dienslewering te bevorder. Evalueer Finansiële Stelselbevoegdhede: Help met die uitvoer van beleidsnavorsing in samewerking met belanghebbendes, bv. Kantoor van die Rekenmeester-Generaal, CPO en DPSA, ens. Help met die samewerking van beleidsinisiatiewe met ander tegniese kundiges en evalueer insette in ooreenstemming met stelselvereistes. Log, koördineer en monitor voorvalle, diensversoeke en probleme; ondersteun oorsaakontleding en implementeer goedgekeurde korrektiewe en voorkomende maatreëls. Verskaf funksionele en operasionele ondersteuning vir transversale finansiële bestuurstelsels in ooreenstemming met ooreengekome diensvlakke en bestuursprosesse. Toeganklikheid van Finansiële Bestuurstelsels: Help om persentasie-beskikbaarheid van die stelsel tydens spitssverwerkingstye te verskaf. Help met die integrasie van maatreëls om die stelsel in staat te stel om data te herstel wat tydens bedryfsstilstand verlore is. Help met die uitvoer van beleidsnavorsing in samewerking met belanghebbendes, bv. Kantoor van die Rekenmeester-Generaal, CPO en DPSA, ens. Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid: Help met die ontwikkeling van kommunikasie-sirkulaires rakende nuwe stelselfunksionaliteite, opdaterings en implikasies vir gebruikers. Help met die koördinering van jaarlikse gebruikersforums en woon ander belanghebbendeforums by wanneer nodig. Ondersteun besigheidsgereedheid, belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, defekresolusie en post-implementeringsbevestiging. Verseker belanghebbende-kommunikasie, implementeringsgereedheid en suksesvolle ontplooiing binne goedgekeurde tydlyne. Help met die ontwikkeling van ingrypingsstrategieë en help gebruikers.

zu.title: Umndeni weziqu ongusihlalo: Izinkambiso ze-BAS & Logis
zu.summary: Phatha izinkambiso zesistimu ye-BAS ne-Logis kanye namaphrojekthi okuvuselela eNational Treasury, ukusekela emanyangweni kahulumeni kazwelonke nasezifundazweni.
zu.requirements: Kudingeka ibe ne-Grade 12, kanye ne-National Diploma (elingana ne-NQF Level 6) noma i-Bachelor's Degree (elingana ne-NQF level 7) kwi-Information Technology, Information Systems, noma i-Business Analysis; Isitifikedi se-Project Management sizoba ngusizo olwengeziwe. A minimum of 3 years’ experience obtained in an application, system support, or operations environment. Experience in transversal financial management systems operations and support processes (incident, problem solving, change and release management). Experience in Project Management (IT Systems Implementation). Knowledge and experience of the public-sector financial framework and end-user support in a multi-stakeholder environment.
zu.duties: Izinkambiso zesistimu nokuvuselelwa: Siza ekuhloleni izidingo zenkambiso kanye nezinqubo zomsebenzisi ezimaphakathi nezifundazwe kahulumeni. Siza ekwelweni nasekuqedeni amaphrojekthi anconyiwe nasha amasha, njengokuvuselela, ukulungiselela, ukulungisa izifaki kanye nokwenza amabhiginjini ukuze kuqiniswe amandla esistimu yezimali (njenge-General Ledger, Reporting and Analytics). Qinisekisa ukuthi isistimu eqediwe ihambisana nezidingo zebhizinisi ngaphambi kokusetshenziswa. Hlela izinguquko kanye nemisebenzi yokukhulula izinto ezisha kusistimu bese usekela ukungena kwabasebenzisi (ukulethwa kwabasebenzisi, ukugcinwa kwamaphrofayela kanye nokuhlola ukungena) ngokwesimo sokuphepha kanye nezidingo zokuhlukaniswa kwemisebenzi. Bese uphucula futhi ulondoloze izinqubo zokusebenza ezijwayelekile, iziqondiso zabasebenzisi, izihloko ezingezantsi kolwazi kanye nomaxhft olusekelo ukuze kuqinisekiswe isevisi efewayo nokuhamba kahle. Hlolisisa amandla esistimu yezimali: Siza ekwenzeni ucwaningo lwenkambiso kanye nabake ukuxhumana nabo, njenge-Office of the Accountant General, CPO and DPSA, etc. Siza ekuhlanganiseni amaphrojekthi enkambiso nabanye ochwepheshe bokuqinisekisa futhi uhlolisise izindinganiso ngokuqondana nezidingo zesistimu. Bhalisa, hlela futhi ulandele izinkinga, izicelo kanye nezinkinga ezenzeke; sekela ukuhlaziywa kwezimbangela futhi ufeke imilungu egunyaziwe yokulungisa kanye nokuqamba. Nikeza usekelo olusebenzayo nolwenzelayo kumasistimu aphathekayo ezimali ngokwezinga lesevisi ekuvunyelanwe ngayo kanye nenkambiso. Ukungena kumasistimu ezimali: Siza ukunikeza amaphesenti okutholakala kwesistimu ngesikhathi sokusebenza kakhulu. Siza ekufakeni izindlela zokuloleka amasistimu ukuthi asindise idatha ilahlekile ngesikhathi kungasebenzi. Siza ekwenzeni ucwaningo lwenkambiso kanye nabake ukuxhumana nabo, njenge-Office of the Accountant General, CPO and DPSA, etc. Ukuxhumana nabasunguli: Siza ekwakheni izaziso zokuxhumana mayelana nezinto ezisha kumasistimu, izibuyekezo kanye nezimpindamandla kubasebenzisi. Siza ekuhleleni i-Annual User Forums futhi uzibandakanye kwezinye i-Stakeholder Forums uma kunesidingo. Sekela ukulungelelwa kobuntu bokuhweba, ukuxhumana nabasunguli, ukulungiswa kwezimpazamo kanye nokuqinisekisa okwenziwe ngemuva kokuqashwa. Qinisekisa ukuxhumana nabasunguli, ukulungelelwa ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuqashwa ngempumelelo ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esivunyiwe. Siza ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokungenelela futhi useke abasebenzisi.

xh.title: Umncedisi weenkqavino: iBAS & i-Logis Operations
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yenkqavino ye-BAS kunye ne-Logis namanqamiselo ashukumisayo abakhiwa ngoko kwesebe le-National Treasury, exhasa iisebe zorhwebo zabarhwebi karhulumente kunye namaphondo.
xh.requirements: Kufuneka ibekho iNqanaba le-12, kunye neDiploma yesizwe ubuncinane (elingqangana noNqanaba luka-6 lwe-NQF) okanye iDegree yeBachelor's (elingqangana noNqanaba luka-7 lwe-NQF) kwinkqubo ye-Information Technology, i-Information Systems, okanye i-Business Analysis; Isatifikedi kwi-Project Management iya kubakho nzuzo ehlayo. Ubuncinane i-3 yeminyaka yamava efumene kwimeko yosetyenziso, inkxaso yenkqavino, okanye i-environment yokusebenza. Amava kwinkqubo yabahlinzeki beenkqavino yorhwebo lweemali kunye nemizekelo yenkxaso (isiganeko, isisombululo seengxaki, ulutshintsho nokulawula inkululeko). Amava kwi-Project Management (Isicwangciso seenkqavino ze-IT). Ulwazi namava kumagatya orhwebo lwemali lwentsapho yoluntu kunye nenkxaso yomsebenzisi ekujoliswe kubo kwindawo enabahlali abaninzi.
xh.duties: Iinkqubo Zokusebenza Nokubakho ixesha elide: Nceda ekuhlolweni kweemfuno zengqineliso nokucaciswa komsebenzisi kwiisebe zikaRhulumente weSizwe kunye namaphondo. Nceda ngeenjongo zokulungiselela nokusetyenziswa kwenqamiselo ezisungulwayo kunye neentsha, umz. ukuvuselela, ukuseka, ukuchaza nokunyusa amandla enkqubo yemali (umz. i-General Ledger, i-Reporting kunye ne-Analysis). Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okuvela kumntu kuhlangabezana neemfuno zorhwebo phambi kokubekwa esetyenzisweni. Lungisa ulutshintsho nemihaso yenkululeko kwintsonkotheni entsha yenkqavino nceda unike umsebenzisi, inkxaso yokwenza isakhiwo (ukubonelela ngomsebenzisi, ukugcina indima/iprofayile kunye neehlolo zokungena) ngokwemfuneko yokhuseleko nokuhlukeni kwemisebenzi. Yila ulondolazo iinkqubo zokusebenza eziqheliswayo, iinkqubo eziluncedo kwabasebenzisi, ipepha-magazini yolwazi nemiqulu yeenkxaso ukukhuthaza iinkonzo ezingafaniyo, ezibonelela ngenkonzo yomgangatho ophezulu. Hlola Ukuzinza kweenkqubo zokulingana kweMali: Nceda ekwenzeni uphononongo lweengqineliso ngokuvumelana namahlali, umz. i-Office of the Accountant General, i-CPO kunye ne-DPSA, nokunye. Nceda ekubumbeni iingqineliso zeprojekthi ngabalamkelwa beetechnical experts balé njalo. Kwaye hloola izimvo ngokwemfuneko yenkqavino. Bhala ngokutsha, lungisa uluntu phantsi kwemizekelo, nceda ngeziganeko, iinkonzo eziceliweyo kunye neengxaki; nceda ngokutshintsha impendulo yesisombululo nokwenza izigqibo ezivunyiweyo zokulungisa nokuthintela. Bonezela inkxaso yemisebenzi nokusebenza kweenkqubo zokurhweba ngemali ngeendlela ezivunyelweni ngokwamazinga enkonzo nokuqaliswa kolawulo. Iinkqubo Zokulawula imali ezifikelele kubo bonke: Nceda ekunikela ngesiphithiphithi sezesibalo senkqavino ngenkxaso ngokwemfuneko yakho. Nceda ekungeniseni iindlela ezisezinyeni ukuze inkqavino ikwazi ukubuyisela i-data elahlekileyo ngexesha apho kukho iingxaki. Nceda ekwenzeni uphononongo lweengqineliso ngokuvumelana namahlali, umz. i-Office of the Accountant General, i-CPO kunye ne-DPSA, nokunye. Umanyano namahlali: Nceda ekwakheni ipepha-magazini ngenkqavino ezizezayo, ezintsha neempembelelo kumsebenzisi. Nceda ekulawuleni iinkqubo zoNyaka zomntu wonke kwaye uzivakalelise kwezinye iNkqubo zabahlali xa kuyimfuneko. Nceda ngokulungelelana korhwebo, ukuhlangana namahlali, ulungiso leeempazamo nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza emva kokubekwa esetyenzisweni. Qinisekisa isaziso sabahlali, ulungelelano lokusebenza nokuqinisekisa ukubekwa esetyenzisweni ngokuphumelelayo kumaxesha ahleliweyo. Nceda ekwakheni iindlela zokungena nceda abasebenzisi.

jobs.title: Performance Auditor
jobs.summary: Performance Auditor role at National Treasury in Pretoria requiring a diploma or degree in Internal Audit or Accounting plus two years of relevant audit experience.
jobs.requirements: A Grade 12 coupled with a minimum National Diploma (equivalent to NQF Level 6) or Bachelor’s Degree (equivalent to NQF Level 7) in Internal Audit/ Accounting. A minimum of 2 years’ experience in an Internal Audit environment, of which a part of the experience must be in the Performance audit and Performance information field. Experience in performance audit and Performance information audit processes and procedures is required. Sound knowledge of Performance Audit and Performance Information Audit processes, procedures and methodology are required.
jobs.duties: Audit Planning: Provide inputs to the development of performance audit notification letters. Perform preliminary surveys on planned performance audit and audit of performance information engagements. Gather background information on identified performance audit and audit of performance information. Initiate interview sessions in preparation of performance audit and audit of performance information engagements and analyse disseminated information. Identify symptoms and assist with the development of audit objectives and criteria for engagement. Audit Execution: Assist with the development of an audit program for implementation. Test procedures as per the prescribed performance audit and audit of performance information programme. Determine root causes to address management measures that are lacking or inadequate. Complete work papers and draw conclusions from test results. Audit Reporting: Draft informal audit queries as per the prescribed performance audit methodology. Confirm the findings and the impact of risk ratings of performance audit and audit of performance information findings with clients and draft recommendations on root causes. Assist with compiling draft audit report. Follow up audit of Performance Audits. Follow up on previous performance audit findings. Perform performance audit reviews through tests and observations. Evaluate and capture action plans instituted by management to rectify identified inadequate management measures. Assist with completion of findings register to be reported to Audit Committee.

af.title: Prestasie-ouditor
af.summary: Prestasie-ouditorpos by National Treasury in Pretoria wat 'n diploma of graad in Interne Oudit of Rekenkunde plus twee jaar se tersaaklike ouditeurervaring vereis.

'n Minimum van 2 jaar se ervaring in 'n Interne Oudit-omgewing, waarvan 'n deel van die ervaring in die prestasie-oudit en prestasie-inligtingveld moet wees. Voer voorlopige opnames uit oor beplande prestasie-oudit en oudit van prestasie-inligting-opdragte. Versamel agtergrondinligting oor geïdentifiseerde prestasie-oudit en oudit van prestasie-inligting. Inisieer onderhoudsessies ter voorbereiding van prestasie-oudit en oudit van prestasie-inligting-opdragte en ontleed verspreide inligting. Identifiseer simptome en help met die ontwikkeling van ouditdoelwitte en kriteria vir die opdrag. Oudituitvoering: Help met die ontwikkeling van 'n ouditprogram vir implementering. Toets prosedures volgens die voorgeskrewe prestasie-oudit en oudit van prestasie-inligtingprogram. Bepaal oorsake om bestuursmaatreëls wat ontbreek of onvoldoende is, aan te spreek. Voltooi werksvelle en trek gevolgtrekkings uit toetsresultate. Ouditrapportering: Opstel van informele ouditnavrae volgens die voorgeskrewe prestasie-ouditmetodologie. Bevestig die bevindings en die impak van risikoklasserings van prestasie-oudit en oudit van prestasie-inligtingbevindings met kliënte en opstel aanbevelings oor oorsake. Help met die samestelling van konsepouditverslag. Opvolg van oudit van Prestasie-ouditte. Opvolg van vorige prestasie-ouditbevindings. Voer prestasie-oudittoetse en waarnemings uit. zu.title: Umolahleki Wokusebenza
zu.summary: Isikhundla somMolahleki Wokusebenza eNational Treasury ePretoria esifuna idiploma noma idigri ku-Internal Audit noma i-Accounting kanye neminyaka emibili yohlaka oluhlobene nokuqasha.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye ne-National Diploma evisayo (elingalingana ne-NQF Level 6) noma i-Bachelor's Degree (elingalingana ne-NQF Level 7) ku-Internal Audit/ i-Accounting. Uhlaka oluncane lweminyaka engu-2 kwindawo ye-Internal Audit, lapho inxenye yohlaka kufanele ibe kwinkundla yokuqasha kokusebenza kolwazi lokusebenza. Uhlaka kwinkambiso nezinqubomgomo zokuqasha kokusebenza nokuqashwa kolwazi lokusebenza kudingeka. Ulwazi oluzinikele ngokwenkambiso, izinqubomgomo kanye nendlela yokusebenza yokwazi kokusebenza nokuhlola ulwazi lokusebenza kudingeka.
zu.duties: Ukuhlela Ukuqasha: Nikeza okungenayo ekubunjweni kwamagazethi asazisa ngokuqashwa kokusebenza. Yenza izivivinyo ezingeyomuva ekubhukudeni ukuqashwa kokusebenza nokuhlolwa kolwazi lokusebenza okuhleliwe. Qoqa ulwazi osusweni ngesikhathi sokubhukuda ukuze uthole ukubikezelwa kokusebenza kolwazi lokuqashwa. Qalisa izingxoxo eziphathelene nokulungiselela ukuze uqashe ukubhukuda nokuhlolwa kolwazi lokusebenza uze uhlehlulule olwazi olusatshaliswayo. Hlola izinkomba zezifo usize ekubunjweni kwezinhloso zokuqashwa kanye nezimiso zokubhukuda. Ukwenziwa Kokuqasha: Size ekubunjweni kohlelo lokuqasha ukuba lulandelwe. Hlola izinqubo njengoba kunqunyiwe ohlelweni lokubhukuda ukuze uqhashe ulwazi lwokuqashwa. Qinisekisa izimbangela ezinkulu zokulungisa izinyathelo ezihoxile noma ezinganele zolawulo. Qedela amaphepha okusebenza uze ukhiphe izimiso eziphumayo kwiziphethamandla zokuqashwa. Ukubika Ngekuqashwa: Qamba imibuzo yokuqasha emnandi njengoba kulindeke ohlelweni lokuqashwa kokusebenza. Qinisekisa izifundo kanye nomthelela wokuhlola engozini yezifundo zokubhukuda nokuhlolwa kolwazi lokusebenza nevakashi bese ulungisa izindululo ezingabangela izimpawu. Size ekubhaleni ukubika okusanda kuqashwa. Landela imibhalo ye-Performance Audits. Landela izifundo ezedlule zokubhukuda kokuqashwa. Yenza ukubuyekezwa kokubhukuda ngezivivinyo kanye nokuqashwa okubonakalayo. Hlela bese ubamba izinkundla zenkambiso eziqoqwe abaphathi ukuthi zilungise izimo zolawulo ezinganele evezwe. Size ekugcineni irekhodi lezifundo ezizobe zibikwa kuKomidi Lokuhlela IsiNqamu.

Amava kumavalonke nokukhankanywa ngokusebenza iinkqubo ngeenkqubo ezifunekayo. Ulwazi olululo lweenkqubo, iinkqubo nendlela yokusebenza zoKuvavankokubakho nokuKhankanywa ngokusebenza kwiimvavankokubakho lufuneka.
xh.duties: Uqalelo lokuVava: Nikezela ngemibhalo ekuthathwa ngayo inxaxheba ekwenziweni lamagama esoNxulumana nokuvavankokubakho. Zenza iziphononongo ezoqalayo ezicekwene ngokuvavankokubakho okucetyiweyo nokukhankanywa ngokusebenza. Qokelela ulwazi ngokuyelela ngokuvavankokubakho nokukhankanywa ngokusebenza okutoliweyo. Qalisa iindibano zemibuzo ekulungiselelweni kokuvavankokubakho nokukhankanywa ngokusebenza uze ulole ulwazi olusasaziweyo. Phawu iimpawu kwaye uncede ekwakheni iinjongo nemiqathango yobukhosi. Urhumo lokuVava: Nceda ekwakheni inkqubo yokuvavankokubakho eza kusetyenziswa. Vavanya iinkqubo ngokwekqbo yokuvavankokubakho nokukhankanywa ngokusebenza esuswayo. Misela izizathu eziyintsalteli kwaye uncedise ngezinyanzezo zolawulo ezingekhayi okungekho ngokwaneleyo. Qedela amaphepha omsebenzi kwaye ukhuphe iziphetho kwimizamo yamava. Imbaliso yokuVava: Bhala imibuzo yokuvavankokubakho engalunganga ngokwendlela yokuvavankokubakho esuswayo. Qinisekisa iziphumo nengongoma yobungozi ezingowokuvavankokubakho nokukhankanywa ngokusebenza nakumthengi kwaye uphawule iingcebiso ngokwazibanga ezingu n. Nceda ekubhaleni umbaliso obandakanya amanye amagagasi emibali. Landela imibuzo yokuvavankokubakho. Landela iziphumo zegcisa lokuvavankokubakho. Zenza ukukhathazwa kokuvavankokubakho ngokuvavanya ukuqwalasela. Linganisa kwaye ulandele iinkqubo ezithile ngeendlela ezazibekiweyo ngurhulumente ukulungisa izinyanzezo ezingekho ngokwaneleyo. Nceda ekupheleni isibukelo seziphumo eza kusikwa kuQumba lokuVavankokubakho.

jobs.title: Control Engineering Technologist Grade a (CIVIL)
jobs.salary_text: R958 776 per annum, (all-inclusive OSD salary package)
jobs.summary: Control Engineering Technologist needed in Gqeberha to manage technical services, ensure safety compliance and evaluate technical manuals for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A Bachelor of Technology (BTech) in Civil Engineering as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of six (6) years’ post-qualification experience as an Engineering Technologist/Technician. Compulsory registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as a Professional Engineering Technologist. The disclosure of a valid Code B unexpired driver’s licence (except for persons with disabilities). Demonstrated experience in infrastructure condition assessment, project management, design and analysis of water-related infrastructure, preparation of procurement documentation and site supervision of construction works. Proven practical experience in mentoring graduate interns and facilitating training and development. An understanding of ECSA professional mentorship requirements will be an added advantage. Sound knowledge of contract administration and project management, with proven ability to interpret and review technical drawings and designs. Understanding of public sector procurement processes and financial planning and management principles. Knowledge of applicable legislation, including the National Water Act, Water Services Act, environmental legislation, and the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Familiarity with standard forms of contract used in infrastructure projects. Strong communication, conflict management, dispute resolution, and negotiation skills. Proven ability in computer aided design software with special emphasis on ability to work with Autodesk Revit. Problem solving and decision- making skills are essential as well as the ability to work in multi-disciplinary teams. Willingness to work outside normal working hours and to travel extensively throughout the Eastern and Western Cape Provinces.
jobs.duties: Manage technical services in conjunction with engineers, technologists, technicians and maintenance personnel. Ensure safety in terms of statutory and regulatory requirements. Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Ensure the quality of technical designs with specifications and authorise/make recommendations for approval by the relevant authority. Manage projects in terms of best practice and policy requirements. Undertake condition assessments of infrastructure and update the relevant databases and produce detailed reports on assessment results. Prioritise infrastructure rehabilitation projects based on condition assessments. Undertake analyses and designs of rehabilitation solutions. Produce the necessary design reports, drawings and specifications. Supervise rehabilitation work on site. Manage, supervise and control technical and related personnel and assets. Research studies on technical engineering technology to improve expertise, liaise with relevant bodies/councils on engineering related matters. Mentor candidate technicians. Lend support to strategic and business planning, financial management, human resource management and general office management of the section.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. G Daniell Tel No: (041) 508 9706)
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity documents, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. af.title: Beheer Ingenieurstechnoloog Graad a (SIVIEL)
af.summary: Beheer Ingenieurstechnoloog benodig in Gqeberha om tegniese dienste te bestuur, te verseker dat daar aan veiligheidsvereistes voldoen word, en tegniese handleidings vir die Department of Water and Sanitation te evalueer.
af.requirements: 'n Baccalaureus in Tegnologie (BTech) in Siviele Ingenieurswese soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van ses (6) jaar se post-kwalifikasie-ervaring as 'n Ingenieurstechnoloog/tegnikus. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Professionele Ingenieurstechnoloog. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, onverstreke Code B-bestuurslisensie (behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede). Agetoonde ervaring in die assessering van infrastruktuurtoestand, projekbestuur, ontwerp en ontleding van waterverwante infrastruktuur, voorbereiding van verkrygingsdokumentasie en werksite-toesig van konstruksiewerk. Bewese praktiese ervaring in die mentorskap van gegradueerde interns en die fasilitering van opleiding en ontwikkeling. 'n Begrip van ECSA se professionele mentorskapsvereistes sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Deeglike kennis van kontrakadministrasie en projekbestuur, met bewese vermoë om tegniese tekeninge en ontwerpe te interpreteer en te hersien. Begrip van openbare sektor verkrygingsprosesse en finansiële beplanning en bestuursbeginsels. Kennis van toepaslike wetgewing, insluitend die National Water Act, Water Services Act, omgewingswetgewing, en die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA). Bekendheid met standaardvorms van kontrakte wat in infrastruktuurprojekte gebruik word. Sterk kommunikasie-, konflikbestuurs-, geskille-oplossings- en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Bewese vermoë in rekenaargesteunde ontwerpsagteware met spesiale klem op die vermoë om met Autodesk Revit te werk. Probleemoplossing- en besluitnemingsvaardighede is noodsaaklik asook die vermoë om in multidissiplinêre spanne te werk. Bereidwilligheid om buite normale werksure te werk en om wyd deur die Eastern en Western Cape Provinces te reis.
af.duties: Bestuur tegniese dienste in samewerking met ingenieurs, technoloë, tegnici en onderhoudspersoneel. Verseker veiligheid in terme van statutêre en regulerende vereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie in te lyf. Verseker die kwaliteit van tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en magtig/maak aanbevelings vir goedkeuring deur die relevante outoriteit. Bestuur projekte in terme van beste praktyk en beleidsvereistes. Onderneem toestandassesserings van infrastruktuur en werk die relevante databasisse by en produseer gedetailleerde verslae oor assesseringsresultate. Prioritiseer infrastruktuurherstelprojekte op grond van toestandassesserings. Onderneem ontledings en ontwerpe van hersteloplossings. Produseer die nodige ontwerpverslae, tekeninge en spesifikasies. Hou toesig oor herstelwerk op die werksite. Bestuur, hou toesig oor en beheer tegniese en verwante personeel en bates. Navorsingstudies oor tegniese ingenieurstechnologie om kundigheid te verbeter, skakel met relevante liggame/rade oor ingenieurswese-verwante aangeleenthede. Mentor kandidaat-tegnici. Verskaf ondersteuning aan strategiese en besigheidsbeplanning, finansiële bestuur, menslike hulpbronbestuur en algemene kantoorbestuur van die afdeling.

zu.title: Isiphathi Senjiniyela Yobuchwepheshe Esinga a (CIVIL)
zu.summary: Kudingeka Isiphathi Senjiniyela Yobuchwepheshe eGqeberha ukuphatha izinkonzo zobuchwepheshe, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela imithetho yokuphepha kanye nokuhlola izincwadi zokwesekwa zobuchwepheshe ezingowokwoMnyango WeziManzi Nokuhlanzeka.
zu.requirements: I-Bachelor of Technology (BTech) ku-Civil Engineering njengokuqashelwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yeminyaka yokuhlola emumva kokuthola iziqu njengenjiniyela yobuchwepheshe/umthubi. Ukubhaliswa ngokuphothulewe ku-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengenjiniyela yobuchwepheshe ogwityiwe. Ukwazisa ilayisensi evumelekile yokuqasha ehlobo B ezingekashiyi isikhathi (ngaphandle kwabantu abasishiyamandla). Okubonakaliswe ukuhlola ukulinganisa isimo sezakhiwo zomgwaqo, ukuphatha imiklamo, ukwakheka kanye nokuhlaziya izakhiwo ezihlobene namanzi, ukulungisa imibhalo yokuthenga kanye nokugadwa kwendawo yomsebenzi wokwakha. Okuqinisekisiwe ukuhlola ngokuphila ekuhlomula abafundi abasheshwayo kanye nokuqondisa ukwelulekwa kanye nentuthuko.ukuqonda izidingo zokuhlomuleka okungowobuchwepheshe ze-ECSA kuzoba yinzuzo engeziwe. Ukuqonda okuqinile ngokuphathwa kwezivumelwano kanye nokuphatha imiklamo, nokuba nakhono okuqinisekisiwe lokuhumusha kanye nokuhlola imidwayizo yobuchwepheshe kanye namaklamo.Ukuqonda inqubo yokuthenga kwabalawuli bomphakathi kanye nezinhloso zokuhlela kanye nokuphatha izimali.Ukwazi imithetho efanelekayo, okuhlanganisa i-National Water Act, i-Water Services Act, umthetho wezomvelo, kanye ne-Public Finance Management Act (PFMA).Ukujazi izindlela eziqavile zemivumelwano esetshenziswa emiklamweni yezakhiwo. Amandla okuxoxa, okuphatha ingxabano, ukuxazulula izingxabano, kanye nokuncamela. Amandla akuqinisekisiwe kusoftware yokwakheka ngesicikizi ngokugqamisa khona amandla okusebenza nge-Autodesk Revit.Amandla okuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo abadingekile kanye nokuqashelwa amandla okusebenza othungeni olunamagatsha amaningi. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngemahora angeyona njalo kanye nokuhamba kakhulu kulo lonke i-Eastern and Western Cape Provinces.
zu.duties: Phatha izinkonzo zobuchwepheshe ngokuhlanganyela nabanjiniyela, abanjininiyela bobuchwepheshe, abathubi kanye nabagadi. Qinisekisa ukuphepha ngokohlelo lwemithetho nemithesho yokulawula. Hlola izincwadi zokwesekwa zobuchwepheshe ezikhona, imidwayizo eqavile kanye nokuqhuba ukuze kufakweobuchwepheshe obusha. Qinisekisa izinga lemiklamo yobuchwepheshe ngokohlelo lokwakha futhi wemukeze/wenze izincomo ukuze zimukelwe umbuso ofanele. Phatha imiklamo ngokohlelo lokusebenza okuhle kanye nezidingo zomthethosisekelo. Yenza ukulinganisa kwezimo zezenzakalo bese ubuyekeza izinhlelo ze-data ezifanele futhi ukhiqze imibhalo eqavile ngamaphumimu okulinganisa. Beka phambili imiklamo yokuvuselela izakhiwo ngokususelwa ekulinganisweni kwezimo. Yenza ukuhlaziya nokwakheka kwezixazululo zokuvuselela. Ukhiqze imibhalo yomklamo, imidwayizo kanye nezinhlobo eziyidingekayo. Qaphula umsebenzi wokuvuselela esizeni. Phatha, qaphula futhi ulawule abantu bobuchwepheshe kanye nalabo abahlobene nabo nezimpahla. Funda izifundo zobuchwepheshe bezenzakulo ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubuchwepheshe, uxoxe nabalawuli / amakhonsatha ngemikhakha ehlobene nobunjiniyela. Hlomula abathubi abangamakhandela. Nikela inkululeko ekuhleleni ngokusobala nangohwezamabhizinisi, ekuphathweni kwezimali, ekuphathweni kwezinsizakusebenza kanye nokuphathwa kvulawulo olujwayelekile komkhakha.

xh.title: Isahluleli seNgcayo yoBunjiniyela eNqanaba le-a (CIVIL)
xh.summary: Kufuneka isiSahluleli seNgcayo yoBunjiniyela eGqeberha ukulawula iinkonzo ezingcali, kuqinisekiswe ukuzalathisa kwentlalontle kwaye kuqatshwe iincwadi ezibalulekileyo ezingcali kwisebe leZoMlabo nokuQothula.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-Bachelor of Technology (BTech) ku-Bunjiniyela eNgcwalileyo njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Amava angaphantsi kwamashumi amathandathu (6) eminyaka emva kokugqiba izidanga njengesigqibi sqhelo saseBunjiniyela/Umngenisi. Ukubhalwa ngokunyanzelekileyo kwiNkululeko yoBunjiniyela eMzantsi Afrika (ECSA) njengesigqibi sqhelo seNgcwele soBunjiniyela. Ukutyhila ilayisenisi yokuhamba evakalayo etshintshiweyo yeKhodi B (ngaphandle kwezidalwa ezinokuphela ukusetyenziswa kwamandla). Umboniso wamava ekqinisekiseni isimo sempilo yonke imisebenzi ephakathi kwelinye nelinye, ekulawulweni iiprojekthi, ekwakhiweni nokuqonda ngokuphindaphindwayo kwemisebenzi ephakathi kwelinye nelinye ekusingeni amanzi, ekulungiseleleni amaxwebhu okumiswa emisebenzini nasekuqwalaselweni kwindawo yokwakhiwa. Amava aqinisekisiweyo ngokusebenzisa izandla ekukhuliseni abangenela izidanga nokwazisa ukuzilolongela ukuba ngamandla. Iqonda iimfuno ze-ECSA zokukhulisa iingcali kuya kuba ngumda othile oza kongeza isixabo. Ukuqonda okumangalisayo kwentengiselwano nokuqwalasela iiprojekthi, ngenketho yokuba nakho ukuqonda nokuqwalasela iimidlalo yokubakho iiprojekthi neqondo. Iqondakaliso ngokusebenza imisebenzi yemirhumo yomphakathi nokuqonda ngokulungiselela iimali nokuqonda iindlela ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngemithetho esebenzayo, kuquka iMithetho yeZoMlamo eNgcwele, iMithetho yeNkonzo zoMlomo, iMithetho ephilileyo ngemilingo, nokuMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente (PFMA). Iqonda ngakumbi ngokuqonda iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezisetyenziswa ekwakheni iinkqubo ezisemthethweni zeempilo ezingaphantsi komthetho. Iakhono ezinzileyo lokuthetha-thetha, ukulawula iingxabano, ukuzama ukugcina uxolo, nokuba negalelo ekunwebeni isaziso nenyani. Isakhono esizinze ngokwakha nokuqonda iinkqubo ezisezantsi zesixhobo sophuhliso ngqamaniswa nesakhono sobunjiniyela esinamandla sokusebenzisa i-Autodesk Revit. Isakhono sobugcisa bokuzonwabisa ngokuzaliseka kwemfuneko ngokusetyenziswa kweekhompyutha iimfuno ezibalulekileyo nangokuba nakho ukusebenza kumagqabi asezantsi we-Authokho. Ukuzimisela ukusebenza ngaphandle kwemigqa yemisebenzi eqhelekileyo nokuhamba kakhulu kuwo onke amaphondo eMpuma naseNtshona Koloni.
xh.duties: Lawula iinkonzo ezingcali ngokuhlanganisa iingcali zobunjiniyela, abaqhelanisi nabasebenzi bolungiselelo. Qinisekisa ukhuseleko ngokwemithetho yelizwe nangokwemigaqo yokuqwalaselwa eboniswayo. Qwalasela iincwadi ezingaboneleli ngezinto ezibalulekileyo eziphaya kwesakhono, iintsapho ezizodwa zemifanekiso yokwakha nendlela ezahlukeneyo zokwenza izinto ukuzisa izinto ezintsha zenkululeko. Qinisekisa ukuba yintoni na iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo zokwakhiwa ngokwemigaqo ephantsi nokunikela iingcebiso ezingagqibeki nangokwemigaqo engamkelekanga ngurhulume ophathwayo. Lawula iiprojekthi ngokwemigaqo ebekiweyo nangokwemigaqo eqhelekileyo. Yenzela ukukhangela iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuxinwa kwemisebenzi ebonakalayo uvuselele iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zeenkcazelo kwaye wenze iingxelo ezibalulekileyo ngokuqonda okufunyenweyo. Phatha ngokubaluleka iiprojekthi zokulungiswa kwemisebenzi ebonakalayo ngokusekelwe kwimigaqo yokukhangela ukuqonda okusetyenzisiweyo. Yenzela ukuhlalutya nokuphanda iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokulungiswa okusetyenzisiweyo. Yenza iingxelo ezibalulekileyo zokuphanda, imifanekiso yemisebenzi nokuqwalasela imigaqo. Qwalasela umsebenzi wokulungiswa kwemisebenzi ebonakalayo kwindawo yokusebenza. Lawula, qwalasela kulawule abasebenzi abangcali nokuqwalasela ezinye izinto ezahlukeneyo nengqalaselo. Zonke izifundo ngokwemigaqo yokuphanda ubuchwepheshe ngobunjiniyela ezingcali ukuphucula ulwazi, qhagamshelana nemithetho ngokwemisebenzi ebalulekileyo ngobunjiniyela. Phatha abangenela izidanga ngokusebenza. Nikela inkxaso ekusebenzeni ngamathuba eenguqu nangokusebenza kwezimali, ukulawula abantu nokuqwalasela iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezisebenza kule ndlela ekwabiweyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Financial Management
jobs.summary: Deputy Director overseeing financial revenue, expenditure, supply chain and accounting at the Hartbeespoort Cluster Office for the Department of Water and Sanitation.
jobs.requirements: A bachelor’s degree or relevant qualification at NQF Level 7 in Financial Management. Five (5) years relevant experience in Financial Accounting at supervisory/management (ASD) level. Knowledge and understanding on human resource management legislation, policies, practices and procedures. Knowle and understanding of Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), treasury regulations and guidelines. Knowledge of public service anti- corruption strategy and anti-corruption and fraud prevention measures. Knowledge of equal opportunities and affirmative action guidelines and laws. Knowledge of administrative clerical procedures and systems. Understanding of departmental policies and procedures, government financial systems, principles and practice of financial accounting. Understanding of framework for managing performance information. Knowledge of business strategy transaction and alignment. Problem solving and analysis. People diversity management. Client orientation and customer focus. Excellent communication skill (both verbal and written). Accountability and ethical conduct.
jobs.duties: Manage the financial revenue, expenditure management, supply chain management and accounting sub-directorate. Monitor the policy and legislative framework to ensure that cognisance is taken of new developments. Develop and maintain policies and processes. Monitor revenue collected, expenditure incurred, submits reports and plans as required. Monitor compliance with financial prescripts. Provide advice and guidance to role players on revenue and expenditure procedure. Undertake revenue, expenditure management and accounting work as required. Revenue management-Ensure that cashier, banking, debt management, monitoring and reporting services are rendered. Expenditure management-Ensure that payment for compensation of employees, goods and services, transfers, subsidies and reporting are efficiently and effectively performed. Accounting-To provides financial administration and accounting services (legal/journals, accounting and reporting, interim and annual financial statements). Manage the sub- directorate revenue, expenditure management and accounting. Maintenance of discipline. Management of performance and development. Undertake Human Resource and other related administrative functions. Establish, implement and maintain efficient and effective communication arrangements. Develop and manage the operational plan of the sub-directorate and report on progress as required. Develop, implement and maintain processes to ensure proper control of work. Compile and submit all required administrative reports, serve on transverse task teams as required. Procurement and asset management for the Directorate. Planning and allocate work, Quality control of work delivered by employees. Conduct strategic tariff determination assessments, utilising macroeconomic variables to design sustainable, legally compliant pricing structures for cluster services. Functional technical advice and guidance.
jobs.enquiries: Mr TG Monaisa Tel No: (012) 200 9000
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity documents, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Finansiële Bestuur
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur wat toesig hou oor finansiële inkomste, besteding, verskaffingsketting en rekeningkunde by die Hartbeespoort Cluster Office vir die Department of Water and Sanitation.
af.requirements: 'n Bachelor se graad of relevante kwalifikasie op NQF Level 7 in Financial Management. Vyf (5) jaar relevante ervaring in Financial Accounting op toesighoudende/bestuursvlak (ASD). Kennis en begrip van menslike-hulpbronbestuurswetgewing, beleide, praktyke en prosedures. Kennis en begrip van die Public Finance Management Act (PFMA), tesouriereëls en riglyne. Kennis van die openbare diens se anti-korrupsiestrategie en anti-korrupsie- en bedrogvoorkomingsmaatreëls. Kennis van gelykegeleenthede- en affirmatiewe-aksiereglyne en -wette. Kennis van administratiewe klerklike prosedures en stelsels. Begrip van departementale beleide en prosedures, regeringsfinansiële stelsels, beginsels en praktyk van finansiële rekeningkunde. Begrip van die raamwerk vir die bestuur van prestasie-inligting. Kennis van besigheidsstrategie-transaksie en -belyning. Probleemoplossing en analise. Bestuur van mense-diversiteit. Kliëntgerigtheid en klantfokus. Uitstekende kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik). Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag.
af.duties: Bestuur die sub-direktoraat vir finansiële inkomste, besteding, bestuur van die verskaffingsketting en rekeningkunde. Monitor die beleids- en wetgewingsraamwerk om te verseker dat daar kennis geneem word van nuwe ontwikkelinge. Ontwikkel en handhaaf beleide en prosesse. Monitor inkomste wat ingesamel is, besteding wat aangegaan is, dien verslae en planne in soos vereis. Monitor nakoming van finansiële voorskrifte. Verskaf advies en leiding aan rolspelers oor inkomste- en bestedingsprosedures. Onderneem inkomste-, bestedingsbestuurs- en rekeningkundewerk soos vereis. Inkomste bestuur - verseker dat kassier-, bank-, skuldbestuurs-, moniterings- en verslagdoeningsdienste gelewer word. Besteding bestuur - verseker dat betaling vir vergoeding van werknemers, goedere en dienste, oordagte, subsidieë en verslagdoening doeltreffend en effektief uitgevoer word. Rekeningkunde - verskaf finansiële administratiewe en rekeningkundige dienste (regstransaksies/joernale, rekeningkunde en verslagdoening, tussentydse en jaarlikse finansiële state). Bestuur die sub-direktoraat se inkomste, bestedingsbestuur en rekeningkunde. Handhaaf dissipline. Bestuur van prestasie en ontwikkeling. Onderneem Menslike Hulpbronne en ander verwante administratiewe funksies. Stel, implementeer en handhaaf doeltreffende en effektiewe kommunikasiereëlings. Ontwikkel en bestuur die operasionele plan van die sub-direktoraat en doen verslag oor vordering soos vereis. Ontwikkel, implementeer en handhaaf prosesse om behoorlike beheer van werk te verseker. Stel alle vereiste administratiewe verslae op en dien dit in, dien op dwarstaakspanne soos vereis. Procurement en batesbestuur vir die Direktoraat. Beplanning en toewysing van werk, gehaltebeheer van werk wat deur werknemers gelewer word. Voer strategiese tariefbepaling-assesserings uit deur makro-ekonomiese veranderlikes te gebruik om volhoubare, wetlik vereenselwigde prysstrukture vir clusterdienste te ontwerp. Funksionele tegniese advies en leiding.

zu.title: Isikhundla: Financial Management
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokubeka ilinga esimbidlana noma ngaphezu kwalo esimenza izibalo kwezezimali ezingenayo, eziqhushqiswayo kwandlule kanye nezimali eziqhutshwa ukuze zitholakale kwezempahla eziqhutshwa njalo ezeziqoqo kwezimali zakwaHartbeespoort Cluster Office ezingeni elingangenwa ekuphatweni kwamanzi nomyalelo wokuhlanza emnyakeni weWater and Sanitation.
zu.requirements: Isidingo sobudokotela noma iziqu eziyisiseko ezinhlobonhlobo ezingeni le-NQF Level 7 kumnyango weFinancial Management. Amakhulu amahlanu (5) iminyaka evela kumnyango wezimali ezingangenwa emkhakheni weFinancial Accounting ngesikhathi esithize emkhakheni wezomphakathi noma ngaphezu kwalo. Ukulwazi futhi ukuqonda kumnyango wezomthetho kwezokusiza izisebenzi, izinqubomgomo, indlela zokwenza umsebenzi kanye nemithetho yokuphatha. Ukulwazi futhi ukuqonda umthetho wePublic Finance Management Act (PFMA), imithetho yabelo mali kanye nemiyalelo. Ukulwazi ngemigomo yokulwa nokhwabaniso emkhakheni wezomphakathi kanye nendlela zokulwa nokhwabaniso nokwenza amacebo okuvikela. Ukulwazi ngemiyalelo kanye nemithetho yezenhlalo nokutholakala kwamathuba abantu bonke kanye nokutholakala kwamathuba. Ukulwazi ngemisebenzi yokuqoqa ulwazi kanye nezinhlelo zokwenza umsebenzi. Ukuqonda izinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho yomnyango, izinhlelo zikahulumeni wemali, izimiso kanye nokwenza umsebenzi wezimali ezingenwayo. Ukuqonda isikhungo esibekwe ukuphatha imininingwane yokwenza umsebenzi. Ukulwazi ngenqubomgomo yebhizinisi, ukuhweba kanye nokuhambisana. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuphatha ukubahluka kwabantu. Ukuqonda izidingo zabalulekile kakhulu kubathengi kanye nokunaka kakhulu izidingo zabathengi. Ukukhuluma kahle ngomlomo kanye nokubhala kahle. Ukuziphendulela kanye nokuziphatha kahle.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha imali engenayo, ukuphathwa kwemali evela, ukuphathwa kohlangothi lwezempahla ezikagesi kanye nokuqoqa imali. Ukulandela isikhungo sezinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho ukuze kuqiniseke ukuthi kuthathwa inqondo ngokuthuthuka okusha. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukugcina izinqubomgomo kanye nokuqhuba imikhakha. Ukulandela imali ebandakanywa ekutholakaleni kwemali, emali evela, futhi uhambise imibiko kanye namaphulani njengoba kudingeka. Ukulandela ukulandela imithetho ephathelene nemali. Ukunika izeluleko kanye nokuqondisa abadlali abakhulu ngomkhakha wemali engenayo nesevelayo. Ukwenza umsebenzi wemali engenayo, yokuphathwa kwemali futhi ukwenze njengoba kudingeka. Ukuphathwa kwemali - qiniseka ukuthi kusebenzwa imisebenzi yokubala imali yokutholakala kwemali, imali ebhange, ukuphathwa kwesikweletu, ukubuka nokubika. Ukuphathwa kwemali - qiniseka ukuthi ukukhokha imali yokuhlinzeka abasebenzi, izimpahla kanye namasevisi, ukudluliselwa, izibonelelo nokubika kwenziwa ngendlela efanele futhi ngokusebenza kahle. Ukubala imali - ukunika imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwemali nokusebenza ngokutholakala kwemali (ngezomthetho / amaphepha okubhala, ukubala imali nokubika, ukubika ngemali yesikhathi kanye nonyaka). Ukuphatha imali evela, ukuphathwa kwemali nokubala imali. Ukugcina inqubo yokuziphatha. Ukuphatha ukwenza umsebenzi kanye nokuthuthuka. Ukwenza imisebenzi ephathelene nabantu kanye nomunye umsebenzi ongafani. Ukusungula, ukusebenzisa futhi ukugcina izinhlelo zokuxhumana ezisebenza kahle. Ukuthuthukisa futhi ukuphatha iplani yokusebenza kwegatsha lokuphathwa kwemali evela nemitsho yokubika. Ukuthuthukisa, ukusebenzisa futhi ukugcina inqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulawulwa kwezimali. Ukuqamba futhi uhambise zonke imibiko edingekayo, ukusebenza kumakomidi njengoba kudingeka. Ukuthenga futhi ukuphatha impahla egatsheni. Ukucubungula futhi ukwabela umsebenzi, ukulawula ikhwalithi yomsebenzi ovela kubasebenzi. Ukwenza ukubuyezwa kokuqinisekiswa kwentela yokusingatha inqubo, ukusebenzisa okuguqukayo kwamazwe omhlaba ukwakha izakhiwo zentela eziphilayo, ezingaphansi komthetho ukwazi ukuletha izinsizakalo emaqhugqwane. Izeluleko nezinqondiso zobuchwepheshe.

xh.title: Isikhundla seSoftware Developer
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMzimba, iNtlalo noPhuhliso luHluLulomimo: usetyenziso lwezakhiwo ezizodwa
xh.requirements: Izelamani elifanelekileyo kwinqanaba lesithandathu kwi-National Qualifications Framework (NQF) kwilizwe lam nokulingana. Isiqinisekiso kwinqanaba lesi-6 kwi-National Certificate Vocational (NCV). I-Police Clearance Certificate eza kwangoko kwaye engaphezu kweenyanga ezintathu. Ukuba nalwazi ngokuphathelele i-National Water Act (Act 36 of 1998) noLawulo lwabasebenzi ekusingathweni kolwelo. Amakhono obuntu ngokubanzi, amakhono okuzilawula, ukuzinika umsebenzi, ukuzimisela nokuba nomfanekiso omhle. Ulwazi lokusebenza kwikompyutha. Isiqinisekiso seDiploma kwisigaba sama-3.
xh.duties: Phatha elinguwo leentyalo-mali, ulawulo lokuchithwa kwemali, ulawulo lweyonke iinkonzo ezidityanisiweyo kunye nokuqqhwaba kweentyalo-mali. Qaphela iinkqubo zemigaqo-nkqubo kunye nemithetho ukuze kuqatshelwe izinto ezitsha ezivelayo. Yenza kwaye ulondoloze imigaqo-nkqubo kunye neenkqubo. Qaphela imali eqokelelwayo, imali echithiweyo, rhwese iingxelo kunye neezicwangciso njengoko kufunekayo. Qaphela ukuthobela imigaqo ebalawulo leentyalo-mali. Nika izalathiso kunye nenkqubo kwabathe ngqo kumalungiselelo okuqokelelwa kwemali nokuyichitha. Yenza umsebenzi wokuqokelela imali, ulawulo lokuchithwa kwemali kunye neentyalo-mali njengoko kufunekayo. Ulawulo lwemali eqokelelwayo-Qinisekisa ukuba kwenziwa iinkonzo zokubamba imali, iibhanki, ulawulo lwezikredito, ukuqaphela nokwenza iingxelo. Ulawulo lokuchithwa kwemali-Qinisekisa ukuba nkrhaxo yabasebenzi, izinto kunye neenkonzo, iindleko ezidluliswayo, izibonelelo nokwenza iingxelo zifunyenwe ngokusebenza kakuhle nangendlela efaneleyo. Iintsalo-mali-Ukuze kubonezelelwe ulawulo lwemali kunye neenkonzo zeentyalo-mali (izikwahlelo/amarhwcwfwezo, iintsalo-mali kunye neengxelo, iingxelo zeentsalo-mali zexesha eliphakathi kunye neminyaka). Phatha elinguwo lemali eqokelelwayo, ulawulo lokuchithwa kwemali kunye neentyalo-mali. Ukuhlala ulawule isithintelo. Ulawulo lwenkonzo yokwenza umsebenzi kakuhle kunye nephuhliso. Yenza ulawulo abantu olusebenza kulo kunye nezinye iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Misela, phumeza kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo zokunxibelelwana ezisebenza kakuhle. Yenza kwaye ulawule iplani yokusebenza kolinguwo kwaye wenze ingxelo ngaphambili njengoko kufunekayo. Yenza, phumeza kwaye ulondoloze iinkqubo ukuze kuqinisekiswa ulawulo olufanelekileyo lomsebenzi. Hlela kwaye uzithumele iingxelo onke ezifunekayo zolawulo, kwaye ukhonze kumagqabhaza abaqokeleli njengoko kufunekayo. Iinkonzo zokuthenga nokulawulo lwempahla kwiDirekhe. Uplana kwaye wabelane umsebenzi, Ulawulo lokhwalithi komsebenzi owenziwa ngabasebenzi. Qhagamshela iinkqubo ezifunekayo zokulinganisa amaxabiso, usebenzisa iinguqu ezimalini-mveliso ukuze ulungise iinkqubo ezihlala zimi kwexabiso ezivunyelwe yimithetho kwiinkonzo zeqoqo.

jobs.title: Engineering Technician Production Grade A-C
jobs.salary_text: R407 337 – R435 066 per annum, (OSD), (Offer will be based on proven years of experience)
jobs.summary: Engineering Technician Production Grade A-C position at the Department of Water and Sanitation in Mbombela, requiring a National Diploma in Engineering and ECSA registration.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma in Engineering or relevant qualification. Three (3) years post qualification technical engineering experience. Compulsory registration with the Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as an Engineering Technician. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Knowledge and experience in project management, technical design and analysis. Understanding of research and development. Computer aided engineering applications. Problem solving, decision making, teamwork, creativity, customer focus and responsiveness. Good communication skills (both verbal and written).
jobs.duties: Render technical services to the directorate. Assist engineers, technologist and associates in the appraisal of business plans and technical reports. Monitor the implementation of Infrastructure projects such as Regional Bulk Infrastructure Programme (RBIG) and Water Services Infrastructure Grant (WSIG) through conducting site inspections; site meetings; compilation and submission of progress reports. Promote safety in line with statutory and regulatory requirements. Evaluate existing technical manuals, standard drawings and procedures to incorporate new technology. Evaluate technical designs with specifications and submit approval by the relevant authority. Perform administrative and related functions. Provide inputs into the budgeting process as required. Compile and submit expenditure reports as required. Verify and certify invoices for payment of contractors and public service providers. Maintain proper records and documentation for all projects to enable a clean audit. Provide and consolidate inputs to the infrastructure development operational plan. Develop, implement and maintain databases. Research and development. Continuous professional development to keep up with new technologies and procedures.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Matiso, Tel No: (013) 759 7330 / Ms FM Mkhwanazi, Tel No: (013) 759 7515 / Ms PC Ngwamba, Tel No: (013) 759 7446 / Mr E Pinga Tel No: (013) 759 7575
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity documents, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Engineering Technician Production Grade A-C
af.summary: Engineering Technician Production Grade A-C pos by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Mbombela, waarvoor 'n National Diploma in Engineering en ECSA-registrasie vereis word.
af.requirements: 'n National Diploma in Engineering of 'n relevante kwalifikasie. Drie (3) jaar post-kwalifikasie tegniese ingenieurservaring. Verpligte registrasie by die Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) as 'n Engineering Technician. Bekendmaking van 'n geldige, nie-verstreke bestuurderslisensie. Kennis en ervaring in projekbestuur, tegniese ontwerp en ontleding. Begrip van navorsing en ontwikkeling. Rekenaargesteunde ingenieurstoepassings. Probleemoplossing, besluitneming, spanwerk, kreatiwiteit, klienfokus en reaksievermoë. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondeling as skriftelik).
af.duties: Verskaf tegniese dienste aan die direktoraat. Bystand aan ingenieurs, teknoloë en medewerkers by die evaluering van besigheidsplanne en tegniese verslae. Monitor die implementering van infrastruktuurprojekte soos die Regional Bulk Infrastructure Programme (RBIG) en Water Services Infrastructure Grant (WSIG) deur terreininspeksies uit te voer; terreinvergaderings by te woon; vorderingverslae op te stel en in te dien. Bevewig veiligheid in ooreenstemming met statutêre en regulasievereistes. Evalueer bestaande tegniese handleidings, standaardtekeninge en prosedures om nuwe tegnologie in te sluit. Evalueer tegniese ontwerpe met spesifikasies en dien goedkeuring deur die betrokke gesag in. Voer administratiewe en verwante funksies uit. Verskaf insette tot die begrotingsproses soos vereis. Stel uitgaweverslae op en dien dit soos vereis in. Verifieer en sertifiseer fakture vir betaling van kontrakteurs en openbare diensverskaffers. Hou behoorlike rekords en dokumentasie vir alle projekte om 'n skoon oudit moontlik te maak. Verskaf en konsolideer insette tot die operasionele plan vir infrastruktuurontwikkeling. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou databasisse. Navorsing en ontwikkeling. Deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling om tred te hou met nuwe tegnologieë en prosedures.

zu.title: Umlobi Wezobunjiniyela Kwezokukhiqiza Izinga A-C
zu.summary: Isikhundla somlobi wezobunjiniyela kwezokukhiqiza izinga A-C e Department of Water and Sanitation e Mbombela, esidinga i-National Diploma kwezobunjiniyela nokubhaliswa kwi-ECSA.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma kwezobunjiniyela noma izifundo ezihambisanayo. Eminyakeni emithathu (3) wemisebenzi yezobunjiniyela yobuchwepheshe emva kokuthola izifundo. Ukubhaliswa ngokuphoqelele ku-Engineering Council of South Africa (ECSA) njengomlobi wezobunjiniyela. Ukwenza okuzwakalayo kwelayisense yokushayela evumelekile engakapheli. Ulwazi nomkhakha wemisebenzi yokuphathwa kwephrojekthi, ukwakheka kobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya. Ukuqonda ucwaningo nentuthuko. Izinhlelo zokusebenza zobunjiniyela ezisekelwe kumakhompyutha. Ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukuthatha izinqumo, ukusebenza ngokuhlanganyela, ukubumba, ukugxila kumthengi kanye nokuphendula. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana (okukhulunywayo nokuqoshiwe).
zu.duties: Nikela ngezinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe kwidirektorathi. Siza abanjiniyela, abachwepheshe kanye nabahlobene ekuhloleni amaphula nokuqashwa kwezindaba zezimali kanye nemibhalo yezobuchwepheshe. Landa ukusetshenziswa kwamaphrojekthi ezokwakheka njenge-Regional Bulk Infrastructure Programme (RBIG) kanye ne-Water Services Infrastructure Grant (WSIG) ngokwenza ukuhlolwa kwesiza; izinkomfo zesiza; ukuhlanganisa nokuthumela imibhalo yentuthuko. Khuthaza ukuphepha ngokuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho kanye nezomthethonqondo. Hlola imibhalo yezobuchwepheshe ekhona, izithombe eziqondile kanye nokuqondiswa ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obusha. Hlola ukwakheka kobuchwepheshe ngokuspecification okuhambisanayo bese uthumela ukugunyazwa ngabagunyazi abahambisanayo. Zenza imisebenzi yolawulo kanye nezihlobene kuyo. Nikeza okungenwayo kwenqubo yokwenza kabuhleni amalebheri njengoba kudingeka. Hlanganisa bese uthumela imibhalo yokuchithwa kwemali njengoba kudingeka. Qinisekisa futhi uqinisekise izikhiqino zokukhokhelwa kwabathengi nabahlinzeki besebenza kahle bogogode benhlangano. Gcina irekhodi efanele nemibhalo yawo wonke amaphrojekthi ukuvumela ukugxotshwa okuhlanzekile. Nikeza futhi uhlanganise okungenwayo kwendlela yokusebenza ekuthuthukisweni okwamanje kophahla okuwumqondo. Bumba, ukusetshenziswa nokugcina amadatha abulwazi. Cwaningo kanye nentuthuko. Ukuthuthuka ngokungapheleleko ekubunjiniyeleni ukugcina isikhathi nobuchwepheshe obusha kanye nokuqondiswa.

af.title: Gemeenskapsontwikkelingsbeampte
af.summary: Fasiliteer geïntegreerde gemeenskapsontwikkelingsintervensies in water- en sanitasie-belanghebbende bestuur by King Williams Town, wat 'n Nasionale Diploma in Menswetenskappe vereis.
af.requirements: A National Diploma in Human Sciences. One (1) to two (2) years’ experience in water and sanitation stakeholder management, education and awareness, hygiene, community development and project management. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license (candidates should be able to drive). Knowledge of community development work, skills, attitudes and values of communities. Knowledge and understanding of human behaviour and social systems and legislation to assist with interventions at the points where people interact with their environments in order to promote self-empowerment. Knowledge and understanding of basic financial management. The ability and competence to co-ordinate community development structures and ability to manage projects. Skakel en koördineer met alle tersaaklike rolspelers, belanghebbendes, intern en ekstern om samewerking te fasiliteer en vennootskappe te vestig om volhoubaarheid van ontwikkelingsaksies binne die gemeenskap te verseker.
