zu.title: Inkantshwa Phambili Yentuthuko Yomphakathi
zu.summary: Gqugquzela ukungenelela okuhlangene kwentuthuko yomphakathi ekuphatweni kwabahlotshaniswe kumanzi nokuhlolwa kwemvelo eKing Williams Town, kudinga iNational Diploma kwezocwaka bezabantu.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma kwezocwaka bezabantu. Ukuze kube yiminyaka eyi-One (1) kuya kubeyimbali eyi-two (2) yokuhlolwa kwamanzi nokususwa kwamafinyila okuphathwa kwabantu, imfundo nolwazi ngokuqaphela, izimiso zokusiza abantu, imfundo yabantu kanye nokuphatwa kwemisebenzi. Ukubonisa ilayisense evumelekileyo engaphelelwa lixesha lokushushisa (abagqatswa kufuneka bakwazi ukuqhuba). Ulwazi ngomsebenzi wokukhula komphakathi, amakhono, izimilo namaxabiso abemi. Ulwazi nokuyiqondaindalo ezenzwa ngabantu. Ulwazi nokuyiqondakwa kwendlela abantu abaziphatha ngayo kwaye nobuntu jikelele. Ulwazi ngokuphathwa kwezemali. Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwemisebenzi. Ikhono elihambelana nomthwalo wokusebenza ngokwanelelo. Ikhono lokuqonda kwaye lonke iingqondo nokuziphatha kwabantu abahlala kunye emzimbeni wabo. Ikhono nokwazi ukuba nabantu ngabanye nangamagqirha ukuzithuthupha kwabakwigumbi. Ikhono lokubonakalisa izinto ngeendlela ezahlukeneyo kuze kube ngcono ukwenzela ukuba abantu banokuzinceda ngokwabo. Isakhono sokuqhubea, imfundo, uxwebhu olubhaliweyo.
zu.duties: Yakha kwaye wenze imisebenzi yokukhula komphakathi kunye namanye amaqela. Qhagamshelana nayo yonke imida yomsebenzi ngexesha elifanelekileyo kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo ekhaya, kwiindawo ezingaphakathi nangaphandle. Xhasa iintshukumo ezahlukeneyo ezikwizinga lokuqala zokukhula kwezinye iindawo. Qinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi iqhutywa ngendlela echanekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho imisebenzi ekwanelisela ukuba inokwenza umsebenzi. Gcina ulwazi olutsha malunga nomsebenzi wokukhula komphakathi. Yenza imisebenzi yamabango avela kumaziko apho abantu bahlala kwaye awancedise ekubeni baziinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Yenza iinkqubo zokucenga amakhosikazi ukuba ayilandelwe iinkqubo ezintsha ngokulunga okusemthethweni. Yenza uxwebhu lokuqinisekisa ukuba yonke imisebenzi yenziwe ngokwemigaqo. Phefumlela kubemi bakho ngendlela abafuna ukuba bagqithwe ngayo. Yenza uxwebhu lwamagama abo. Vakalisa ngokukhethwa kwamagama okukhulisa umphakathi kubemi bakho. Yenza inkqubo ekhuthaza imisebenzi yokulinganisa imali. Sebenzela ukuba abantu baziinkqubo ezisebenzayo ekukhuliseni umphakathi.

xh.title: Iofisa loPhuhliso lweLali
xh.summary: Ukuqhuba izithinteli ezigqithisiweyo zophuhliso lwelali ekulawulweni kubambiswano nabanini nzala kwimizobo kunye nokuchithwa kwangcoliseko e King Williams Town, kufuneka kubekho iDiploma yelizwe kwiZindlu zobuntu.
xh.requirements: IDiploma yelizwe kwiZindlu zobuntu. Eyoku-1 (1) ukuya kowonye (2) unyaka wamava ekulawulweni kubambiswano nabanini nzala kwimizobo kunye nokuchithwa kwangcoliseko, imfundo nolwazi, ukucoceka, uphuhliso lwelali kunye nokulawula iiprojekthi. Ukuvula ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni engazange iphelelwe lixesha (abagqatswa kufuneka bakwazi ukushayela). Ulwazi ngomsebenzi wophuhliso lwelali, amakhono, imimoya kunye namaxabiso eelali. Ulwazi kunye nokuqonda ukuziphatha kobuntu kunye namajelo entsapho nemithetho ukunceda ngaphandle kolwazi nakumanqanaba apho abantu bedibana namazinga abo ukuze baqinise ukuzikhululela. Ulwazi kunye nokuqonda ulawulwa olusisiseko lwezemali. Ikhono lokulawula iindawo zophuhliso lwelali nokuqondayo. Ikhono lokulawula iiprojekthi. Ikhono nokuzinikela ekwenza. Ikhono lokuphathwa ngokomgangatho. Ilisebe lesiXhosa. Isalathiso ngenqanaba lesi-10. Isikhundla. Iofisi. IiNkonzo. Izinga.
xh.duties: Ukuqonda nokwenza ulwazi oluqhuba amathuba okuba lusebenza ekulawulweni kolwazi nokuqonda okupheleleyo. Ukusebenzisana nabasebenzisi bamanye amanye amasebe ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi, imfundo, amakhono, amaxabiso, imfundiso, imilinganiselo, amagama, iinkalo, imithetho yolwazi yoluntu. Ukusebenzisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo zolwazi kunye noqoqosho. Ukusebenzisa amanani, izitathu, iinkcukacha, amaxabiso ezemali, imali, isikhundla, iofisi, iinkonzo, isikhundla, imisebenzi, ilisebe, isalathiso, iNqanaba. Ukwenza ulwazi lweNkonzo yoLuntu ngokusemthethweni ngokwemithetho. Ukusebenzisa ulwazi ngokweemfuno ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Administration Officer
jobs.summary: Provide administrative support to the Integrated Environmental Engineering Component in Gqeberha, including environmental compliance coordination and records management.
jobs.requirements: A National Diploma or Degree in Public Management or Administration. One (1) to Three (3) years’ experience in administrative matters. The disclosure of a valid unexpired driver’s license. Experience in the environmental management sector will be an added advantage. Knowledge of administrative procedures. Basic financial management and knowledge of PFMA. Basic knowledge of the National Water Act, National Environmental Management Act and other environmental legislations and policies. Computer literacy. Client orientation and customer focus. Good communication skills (both verbal and written), report writing, and organisational skills. People and diversity management. Accountability and ethical conduct. Problem solving and analysis.
jobs.duties: Provide administrative support to all personnel in the Integrated Environmental Engineering Component. Assist with administration and coordination of environmental compliance, access and use of government waterworks, related environmental programs and land administration. Maintain records and support information management relating to land rights Administration. Implement and maintain administrative procedures. Administer procurement processes for the component in accordance with departmental and SCM prescripts. Maintain records on goods and services procured for the component. Provide accurate statistics. Maintain a register of the component. Coordinate travel, logistics and administrative support for meetings, site visits and stakeholder engagements. Compile submissions and administrative reports as delegated by the supervisor.
jobs.enquiries: Ms S Mapapu Tel No: (041) 508 9718
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity documents, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. af.title: Administrasiebeampte
af.summary: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan die Integrated Environmental Engineering Component in Gqeberha, insluitend die koördinering van omgewingsnakoming en rekordbestuur.
af.requirements: 'n Nasionale Diploma of Graad in Openbare Bestuur of Administrasie. Een (1) tot Drie (3) jaar se ervaring in administratiewe aangeleenthede. Die bekendmaking van 'n geldige, ongeërfde bestuurderslisensie. Ervaring in die omgewingsbestuursektor sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis van administratiewe prosedures. Basiese finansiële bestuur en kennis van die PFMA. Basiese kennis van die National Water Act, National Environmental Management Act en ander omgewingswetgewing en -beleid. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Kliëntgerigtheid en kundefokus. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (sowel mondelings as skriftelik), verslagskrywing en organisatoriese vaardighede. Mense- en diversiteitsbestuur. Verantwoordelikheid en etiese gedrag. Probleemoplossing en ontleding.
af.duties: Verskaf administratiewe ondersteuning aan alle personeel in die Integrated Environmental Engineering Component. Help met administrasie en koördinering van omgewingsnakoming, toegang tot en gebruik van staatswaterwerke, verwante omgewingsprogramme en grondbestuur. Hou rekords aan en ondersteun inligtingbestuur rakende die administrasie van landregte. Implementeer en onderhou administratiewe prosedures. Administreer verkrygingsprosesse vir die komponent in ooreenstemming met departementele en SCM-voorskrifte. Hou rekords aan van goedere en dienste wat vir die komponent verkry is. Verskaf akkurate statistieke. Onderhou 'n register van die komponent. Koördineer reis, logistiek en administratiewe ondersteuning vir vergaderings, werfbesoeke en belanghebbende-betrokkenheid. Stel voorleggings en administratiewe verslae op soos deur die toesighouer gedelegeer.

zu.title: Inkulu Yesisekelo
zu.summary: Nikela ngesekelo lesisekelo ku-Integrated Environmental Engineering Component eGqeberha, okuhlanganisa nhlephesheleleko yokuhambisana nemikhawulo yemvelo kanye nokuphathwa kwezirekhodi.
zu.requirements: I-National Diploma noma i-Degree ku-Public Management noma ku-Administration. Isiphephelo esingunyaka owodwa (1) kuya kwamathathu (3) kwezomphathwa. Ukwasula ilayisensi yokuqasha evumelekile ebuye ingakapheli. Isiphephelo kuleyona ndawo yokuqashwa kwemvelo kuzoba yinzululwazi olungele wona. Ulwazi mayelana nezindlela zokuqashwa kwemisebenzi. Ukuphathwa kwezimali okuyisisekelo nolwazi nge-PFMA. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo nge-National Water Act, i-National Environmental Management Act namanye omthetho kanye nemigomo yemvelo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukugxila kumthengi nokunakekelwa komthengi. Amakhono okuxhumana amahle (okukhulunywa nokubhalwa), ukubhala imibiko, namakhono okuhlela izinto. Ukuphatha abantu nokwahlukahluka. Ukuba nesibopho nokuziphatha ngokuyisimilo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuhlaziya.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesekelo lesisekelo bonke abantu abakule-Integrated Environmental Engineering Component. Siza ngokuqashwa kwemisebenzi kanye nenhlephesheleko yokuhambisana nemikhawulo yemvelo, ukungena kanye nokusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi yamanzi kahulumeni, izinhlelo zemvelo eziqhathaniswa nalokho kanye nokuqashwa komhlaba. Gcina izirekhodi uze uxhase ukuphathwa kolwazi mayelana noqashwa lwamalungelo omhlaba. Setha uze ugcinange izindlela zokuqashwa kwemisebenzi. Qashwa izinqubo zokuthenga ngekhaya, izinhlelo zokuthenga ngaphakathi, nasezindaweni eziseduze neyomnyango. Gcina izirekhodi ngempahla namasevisi okuthengelwe isiqoqo. Nikela ngezibalo ezinembile. Gcina irekhodi lesiphakamiso. Hlela izinhlela zokuhamba, ukuthutha, kanye nokuqashwa kwezinto eziseduze njengesekelo ngokuhlangana, ukuvakashela izindawo kanye nokubandakanya izihlobo. Hlanganisa izinkulumo ezithunyelwe kanye namabiko okuqashwa njengoba kuphoqwe umqashi omkhulu.

xh.title: Iofisa Lolawulo
xh.summary: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kumcimbi woMfundi wolwaklulo lwemvelo oludityanisiweyo eGqeberha, kuquka nokuqhubelela kumthetho wolandelelwano lwezidingo zemvelo nokulawula amarekhodi.
xh.requirements: I-National Diploma okanye i-Degree kwi-Public Management okanye i-Administration. Ukuba namava emyaka elisi-1 (1) kuya kwelithathu (3) kwezomphatho. Ukuveza ilayisenisi yomqhubi esemthethweni engaze iphela. Ukuba namava kwicandelo lolawulo lwemvelo kuya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yolawulo. Ulawulo olusiseko lweemali nolwazi nge-PFMA. Ulwazi olusiseko nge-National Water Act, i-National Environmental Management Act namanye amagunya nemigaqo yemvelo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukuzinikezela kumthengi kunye nokugxila kumthengi. Amakhono amabalisezincoko (ngomlomo nangokubhalwe), ukubhala iingxelo, namakhono olungiselelanisa. Ulawulo labantu nobunyulu. Ixanduva nenkqubo yamahlawule. Ukuxazula iingxaki nokuhlalutya.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso yolawulo kuwo onke abantu abasebenza kumcimbi woMfundi wolwaklulo lwemvelo oludityanisiweyo. Nceda nolawulo nokuqhubelela kumthetho wolandelelwano lwezidingo zemvelo, ukufikelela nokusetyenziswa kwemisebenzi yamanika yoluntu, iinkqubo zemvelo ezinxulumene nayo nolawulo lwamhlaba. Gcina amarekhodi uze unike inkxaso yolawulo lwolwazi malunga nolawulo lwamalungelo omhlaba. Zalisa uze ugcine imigaqo yolawulo. Lawula iinkqubo zokuthengwa kwempahla kwicandelo ngokwemigaqo yesebe nesiyo-SCM. Gcina amarekhodi ngeempahla nezinto ezithengiweyo kwicandelo. Nikezela ngesibalo esichanekileyo. Gcina irekhodi lecandelo. Qhubelela iindwendwe, amasebe e logistics noloncedo lolawulo kwiindibano, iindwendwo kwindawo kunye nokuqhathaniswa nabathathi nxaxheba. Hlola izicelo nengxelo yolawulo njengoko umphathi esinike ibango.

af.title: Voorsieningskettingklerk Produksie
af.summary: Voorsieningskettingklerk benodig by die Department of Water and Sanitation in Pretoria om bateregisters te bestuur, fisiese verifikasies uit te voer, en barkodering van bates te hanteer.
af.requirements: A Senior/Grade 12 certificate. National Diploma (NQF 6), in Accounting/ Financial Management/ Logistics Management/ Supply Chain Management will serve as an added advantage. Current Enrolment in Internship in Finance/Supply Chain Management will serve as an added advantage. Special requirements (Skills needed) Knowledge of the PFMA, Asset Management Framework and Treasury Regulations. Vaardigheid in Microsoft, Office-pakket, Excel. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondeling en skriftelik). Koördinasie-, beplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Buigsaamheid, spanwerk en interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede, probleemoplossing en handhawing van dissipline.
af.duties: Voer kwartaallikse batetelling uit. Voer halfjaarlikse fisiese verifikasie van roerende bates uit. Verseker dat alle bewegings van bates opgedateer word. Verseker dat die Bate Register gereeld opgedateer word. Dateer voorraadlyste op. Ontvangs van nuwe bates en barkodering. Opdatering van ge huurde bates register. Bystand met beskikking en verliese van bates. Bereidwilligheid om saam met ander as 'n span saam te werk en goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Voer ander aktiwiteite soos benodig uit om die doelwitte van Department of Water and Sanitation te bereik.

zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-Senior/Grade 12. I-National Diploma (NQF 6), ku-Accounting/ Financial Management/ Logistics Management/ Supply Chain Management izokuba yin hlazo. Ukubhalisa okwamanje kwi-Internship ku-Finance/Supply Chain Management izokuba yin hlazo. Izidingo ezikhethelekile (Izikhomba ezidingekayo) Ulwazi nge-PFMA, i-Asset Management Framework kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ukukhombisa ukwazi ukusebenzisa i-Microsoft, ama-Office suits, i-Excel. Amakhono okuxhumana kahle (Okukhulunywayo nokubhaliwayo). Amakhono okuhlanganisa, ukucubungula kanye nokuhlela. Ukuguquguquka, ukusebenza njengaqoqo kanye namakhono obudlelwane obuhle nabantu, Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokugcina inzila.
zu.duties: Ukwenza ukubala kwezimpahla njalo ngenkathi yenyanga ezintathu, Ukwenza ukubhekisisa okubalulekile kwezimpahla ezihamba njalo eminyakeni yonke. Qinisekisa ukuthi zonke izinhemba zemimpahla zibuyekezwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi i-Asset Register ibuyekezwa njalo. Ukubuyekeza izinhlu zezimpahla. Ukuthola imipahla entsha kanye nokukhodiyezimpahla. Ukubuyekeza izibalo zemimpahla eqashiwe. Ukusiza ekulahlekeni nokulahlweni kwemipahla. Ukuzithoba ukusebenza ngokubambisano nabanye njengaqoqo kanye namakhono okuxhumana kahle. Ukwenza omunye umsebenzi njengoba kudingeka ukuze kufinyelelwe emigqeni e-Department of Water and Sanitation.

Nceda kukudityaniswa nokulahleka kwamaxhathu. Ulungelelwaniso lokusebenza ngokusebenzisana nabanye njengesithiyo nalamakhono abalulekileyo echaba. Yenza omnye umsebenzi njengoko kufunekayo ukuze kufezwe iinjongo ze-Department of Water and Sanitation.

jobs.requirements: A Senior/ Grade 12 certificate with accounting as a passed subject. Basic knowledge of financial functions, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate a computer and collate financial statistics by use of spreadsheets. Basic knowledge and insight into the Public Service Financial legislation, procedures and treasury regulations (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PISR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Knowledge of financial operating systems such as PERSAL and SAP. Good communication skills. Accountability, integrity, honesty and ethical conduct. Must be able to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Responsible for compiling, checking and capturing payroll allowances on PERSAL e.g. Subsistence and Travel claims, overtime, standby and payroll deduction transactions. Liaise with third party with regards to court maintenance orders to submit and implement. Distribute pay slips plus supplementary pay slips to officials and submit signed pay point certificates to head office. Attend payroll enquiries. Receive vendor invoices and keep accurate register. Liaise with different sections regarding source documents. Compile source documents and capture invoices to pay vendors on SAP. Ensure that creditors are paid within 30 days. Perform Creditors Reconciliation. Compile Payables and Accruals reports. Be responsible for Cashier’s functions. Safekeeping of cash and checking of Petty Cash issued. Replenish Petty Cash when required. Attend to vendor enquiries. Scan paid invoices onto SAP. Perform cashier duties, receiving and issuing receipts and banking of cash. Perform petty cash transactions. Order and distribute stationery. File all face value documents systematically and complete. Attend to audit samples and ensure compliance.

af.title: Finansieklerk Produksie
af.summary: Vang loontoelaes en aftrekkings op PERSAL vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Port Elizabeth.
af.requirements: 'n Senior/ Grade 12-sertifikaat met rekeningkunde as 'n geslaagde vak. Basiese kennis van finansiële funksies en praktyke asook die vermoë om data vas te lê, 'n rekenaar te bedien en finansiële statistiek deur middel van sigblaaie saam te stel. Basiese kennis en insig in die Openbare Diens se finansiële wetgewing, prosedures en tesourie-regulasies (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PISR, PPPFA, Financial Manual). Kennis van finansiële bedryfstelsels soos PERSAL en SAP. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Verantwoordelikheid, integriteit, eerlikheid en etiese gedrag. Moet onder druk kan werk.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die opstel, kontrole en vaslê van loontoelaes op PERSAL bv. Subsistence and Travel-eise, oortyd, wagdiens en loonaftrekkingstransaksies. Skakel met derde partye met betrekking tot hofonderhoudsbevele om in te dien en te implementeer. Versprei loonstawe asook aanvullende loonstawe aan amptenare en dien getekende betaalpunksertifikate by hoofkantoor in. Hanteer loonnavrae. Ontvang verskaffersfakture en hou 'n akkurate register aan. Skakel met verskillende afdelings rakende brondokumente. Stel brondokumente op en lê fakture vas om verskaffers op SAP te betaal. Verseker dat krediteurs binne 30 dae betaal word. Voer Krediteurrekordvergelyking uit. Stel Betaalbare en Tydverwante uitgawesverslae op. Neem verantwoordelikheid vir Kassierfunksies. Veilige bewaring van kontant en kontrole van uitgereikte Kleingeld. Vul Kleingeld aan wanneer vereis. Hanteer verskaffernavrae. Skandeer betaalde fakture na SAP. Voer kassierpligte uit, ontvang en reik kwitansies uit en bank kontant. Voer kleingeldtransaksies uit. Bestel en versprei skryfbehoeftes. Lê alle dokumente stelselmatig en volledig weg. Hanteer oudits-steekproewe en verseer nakoming.

zu.title: Isikhundla Sokuqasha Ezezimali - Ukukhiqizwa
zu.summary: Qopha izimali ezongeziwe nokuthathwa kwezimali kumholo kokusebenza kwi-PERSAL kwi-Department of Water and Sanitation ePort Elizabeth.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Senior/Grade 12 senyuka nesibalo njengenkundla edlule. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemisebenziyezimali, izindlela kanye nokuhlola ukwazile ukuthi uma uqopha imininingwane kakhompyutha, ulusebenzise kanti noqoqe izibalo ezezimali ngokusebenzisa amaspredishithi. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo nokuqonda umthethosisekelo wezezimali wesebe likahulumeni, izinqumo nemithetho yokuqondisa ngesikhwama saseNdlu yogwembe (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PISR, PPPFA, Isigqibo Esibaliwe). Ulwazi ngezinhlelo ezisisekelo zamafos ezezimali njengePERSAL neSAP. Izinhlelo zokusebenzisana ezinhle. Ukwethembeka, ukuba neculo lokuziphatha, ukuqotho kwendlalo nemikhuba yomotho. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwenkinkomba.
zu.duties: Umbeki wokubala, ukuhlola ukuqopha izimali ezongezwa kumholo kokusebenza kwi-PERSAL isb. izimali ze-Subsistence and Travel, ukugcwalisa isikhathi, ukulindela kanye nokwenza okuhlolwe ngokuthathwa kwemali emholweni kokusebenza. Xhumanisa ngesithili sesibili mayelana nezinkulungwane ezinikwa inkantolo ukuba zenziwe futhi zisetshenziswe. Sula izimpahla zomholo kanti nezimpahla ezongeziwe zomholo ezinikwa izikhulu bese uthumela izitifikedi ezisayiniwe zezindawo zokukhokha ofisini eziyinhloko. Zibandakanya ekupheni ukulalele imibuzo ephathelene nemholo. Yamukela izikweletu zemali bese ugcina okubhaliwe okunemvela. Xhumanisa nobuciko obunekudlule mayelana nokuhlela imibhalo. Hlela okutshaliwe bese kuqopha izikweletu ezikhokhelwa abakhokhi eSAP. Qinisekisa ukuba ngokuthengiwe bakhokhelwa kuleminyaka angama-30. Wenza ngokuvumelanisa izikweletu. Wenza izindaba ezibalulekile nezinye ezibhalwe phansi. Hlengwa ngokuthungatha imisebenzi yethangi. Ukugcina izimali ezifakwe ngesikhathi esithile kanye nokuhlolwa kwaleyo mali encane ethunyelwe. Gxiba kakhulu imali encane uma isengxushunxushu. Funda imibuzo yezikweletu. Qopha izikweletu ezikhokhiwe kuSAP. Wenza imisebenzi yethangi lokuqasha, ngokwamukela bese ukhomba izinkomba zokuqashwa kanye nemali yokuhola. Yenza imisebenzi yemali encane. Faka izimpahla kanye nozikhukhula kwamaphoyi. Hlela ngamafomu aqoshwe ngokuphelellwe ngokobunjalo. Zibandakanya ekupheni imibuzo yokuhlolwa kanye nokuqinisekisa ngokulandelwa.

xh.title: Umsebenzisi wezezimali wokuvelisa
xh.summary: Shicilela izibonelelo kunye nokuthotywa komvuzo kwi-PERSAL kwi-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Port Elizabeth.
xh.requirements: Isetifikedi esemvelakuni se-Senior/Grade 12 kunye nokuwugqiba isifundo sokulinganisa imali. Ulwazi olusiseko lweekhoyo zemali, iinkqubo nokwazi ukushicilela iingcombolo, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuhlanganisa izibalo zemali ngokusebenzisa amaspredshiti. Ulwazi olusiseko nokuqonda ngokujulile koMthetho wezeMali weQeke eRhubululo, iinkqubo nomthetho weqhina lemba (PFMA, DORA, PSA, PISR, PPPFA, iSihlahla sezeMali). Ulwazi ngamajelo okusebenza ezezimali afana ne-PERSAL kunye ne-SAP. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelwana. Ukubanexanduva, ukuzithembisa, inyaniso nokuziphatha ngokungcolileyo. Kufuneka ukwazi ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo.
xh.duties: Uxanduva lokuhlanganisa, ukuqinisekisa nokushicilela izibonelelo zomvuzo kwi-PERSAL ngokomzekelo izimanga zokuzihlala nokuhamba nokutya, isixa esengaphezu kwesixa esisoloko kwiSazindwa sokuba ngaphezulu kwevamisa, nokuvela igama nakwindlu yomntu okulindeleyo kwaye uzibambe ngoko konke. Thetha nomthengi wengxwile ngokubakho kwalo malunganiso wenkundla yonke apho kubhekwa khona iindleko zokuhanjiswa nazo zonke izibonelelo ezisekelwe kwii-akhawuntu. Khupha iintlobo ezahlukeneyo zemali ebalwa kwiiakhawuntu ezahlukeneyo ngokwemigaqo yendalo yaloo mmandla. Yenza isibini sazo zonke iifom ezingangenisi okanye ziphume ngaphandle kwendalo ekude neyaseBhayi ngokunjalo kube sesixekweni ngokutsha kwesithethi-dvut.

jobs.title: Maintenance Vehicle Operator
jobs.summary: Operate and maintain specialised plant and heavy vehicles, conduct daily roadworthy inspections, and oversee driver quality assurance at Somerset East.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 4. The disclosure of a valid Code EC /EC1 (or equivalent) unexpired driver’s license with valid PDP. Certified competency /operating certificate or relevant heavy plant/ machinery. At least five (5) years’ experience in driving heavy motor vehicles and operating heavy equipment. Traffic and road safety regulations. Mechanical knowledge of heavy vehicles and machinery. Occupational Health Safety (OHS). Basic knowledge of departmental transport policies and procedures. Basic record keeping and reporting procedures. Good Communication skills both (verbal and written). Attention to details and alertness. Problem solving in operational environments. Ability to work under pressure and in adverse weather/site conditions. Integrity and discretion.
jobs.duties: Responsible for conducting quality assurance of driver/operator systems. Operate specialised plant/ equipment. Implement best practice of driver/operator systems. Responsible for daily roadworthy inspections. Responsible for ensuring that vehicles are serviced on time. Analyse logistics operations. Transportation of work teams and materials/ equipment. Collection of goods at suppliers and department stores. Maintenance of registering department and pickups. Function in accordance with applicable legislative requirements. Detect and repair minor mechanical problems on the vehicles/ equipment and take steps to have it repaired. Routine maintenance of equipment. Routine inspection of visible defects around the exterior of the equipment and vehicles. Attend to special requests. Recording of daily trips, fuel and fluids levels. Periodic checks on vehicles maintenance standards. Ensure that the place is clean, where equipment is kept avoiding fire hazards. Adherence to Safety and procedures: ensure the safekeeping of equipment and vehicles. Assist with maintenance work at gauging stations. Assist with refurbishment and construction work at gauging stations. Assist the technical personnel with special tasks.
jobs.applications: All applications to be submitted online on the following link: https://erecruitment.dws.gov.za/
jobs.notes: Other related documentation such as copies of qualifications, identity documents, driver’s license etc need not to accompany the application when applying for a post as such documentation must only be produced by shortlisted candidates during the interview date in line with DPSA circular 19 of 2022. With reference to applicants bearing professional or occupational registration, fields provided in Part B on the online Z83 must be completed as these fields are regarded as compulsory. Failure to complete or disclose all required information will automatically disqualify the applicant. No late applications will be accepted. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to suitability checks (SAQA verification, reference checks criminal and credit checks). SAQA evaluation certificate must accompany foreign qualifications (only when shortlisted). Applications that do not comply with the above- mentioned requirements will not be considered. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. A pre-entry certificate obtained from the National School of government is required prior to the appointment. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Candidates will be required to complete a financial disclosure form and undergo security clearance. Foreigners or dual citizenship holders must provide a police clearance certificate from country of origin (only when shortlisted). The Department of Water Sanitation is an equal opportunity employer. In the filling of vacant posts, the objectives of section 195 (1) (i) of the Constitution of South Africa, 1996 (Act No: 108 of 1996) the Employment Equity imperatives as defined by the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act No: 55 of 1998) and relevant Human Resources policies of the Department will be taken into consideration. Correspondence will be limited to short-listed candidates only. If you do not hear from us within three (3) months of this advertisement, please accept that your application has been unsuccessful. Faxed applications will not be considered. The department reserves the right not to fill these positions. Women and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and preference will be given to the EE Targets. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Onderhoudsvoertuigoperateur
af.summary: Bedien en onderhou spesialiseerde aanleg en swaar voertuie, voer daaglikse padwaardigheidsinspeksies uit, en hou toesig oor bestuurderkwaliteitsversekerings by Somerset East.
af.requirements: 'n NQF vlak 4. Openbaarmaking van 'n geldige Code EC /EC1 (of ekwivalent) onvervalle bestuurslisensie met geldige PDP. Gesertifiseerde bevoegdheid /bedryfsertifikaat of tersaaklike swaar aanleg/ masjinerie. Ten minste vyf (5) jaar se ervaring in die bestuur van swaar motorvoertuie en die bedryf van swaar toerusting. Verkeer- en padveiligheidsregulasies. Meganiese kennis van swaar voertuie en masjinerie. Beroepsveiligheid (OHS). Basiese kennis van departementele vervoerbeleide en prosedures. Basiese rekordhouding en verslagdoeningsprosedures. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede beide (mondelings en skriftelik). Aandag aan besonderhede en waaksaamheid. Probleemoplossing in bedryfsonderhoude. Vermoë om onder druk en in ongunstige weer/terreinomstandighede te werk. Integriteit en diskresie.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik vir die uitvoer van kwaliteitsversekering van bestuurder/operateurstelsels. Bedien spesialiseerde aanleg/ toerusting. Implementeer beste praktyk van bestuurder/operateurstelsels. Verantwoordelik vir daaglikse padwaardigheidsinspeksies. Verantwoordelik om te verseker dat voertuie betyds onderhou word. Analiseer logistieke bedrywighede. Vervoer van werkspanne en materiaal/ toerusting. Versameling van goedere by verskaffers en departementwinkels. Onderhoud van die registrasie van departement en bakkies. Funksioneer in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewende vereistes. Bespeur en herstel klein meganiese probleme op die voertuie/ toerusting en tree stappe om dit te laat herstel. Roetineonderhoud van toerusting. Roetine-inspeksie van sigbare gebreke rondom die buitekant van die toerusting en voertuie. Behandel spesiale versoeke. Optekening van daaglikse ritte, brandstof en vloeistofvlakke. Periodieke kontrole op voertuie se onderhoudstandaarde. Verseker dat die plek skoon is waar toerusting gehou word om brandgevaar te vermy. Nakoming van Veiligheid en prosedures: verseker die veilige bewaring van toerusting en voertuie. Bystand met onderhoudswerk by meetstasies. Bystand met opknapping en konstruksiewerk by meetstasies. Bystand aan die tegniese personeel met spesiale take.

zu.title: Umlawuli Wezimoto Zokulungisa
zu.summary: Ukuphatha futhi ulungise izitshalo ezikhethekile nezimoto ezinkulu, wenze ukuhlola ukuthi ziyifanele yini ukuzula endaweni nsuku zonke, futhi ulawule ukuqinisekiswa kwemikhiqizo yabashayeli e Somerset East.
zu.requirements: NQF level 4. Ukubonisa ilayisenisi yeshayeli evumelekile ye Code EC /EC1 (noma efanayo) eke pheli. Isitifikathi sobuqhawe /sitifikathi sokusebenza noma izitshalo ezinkulu /amashini ahlobene. Okungenani iminyaka eyihlanu (5) yohluvu lokushayela izimoto ezinkulu zomzimba futhi usebenze ngezinsimbi ezinkulu. Imithetho yokuphephisa kwezokuthutha nokuphepha ezindleleni. Ulwazi lokwenziwa kwezimoto nezinsimbi ezinkulu. Izempilo Nokuphepha Komsebenzi (OHS). Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngemithetho nemigomo yezokuthutha komnyango. Izindlela eziyisisekelo zokugcina amarekhodi nokubika. Amakhono amahle okuxhum a kokubili (okuthunyelwe nokubhalwe). Ukunaka iminikelo nokuba sekujwayelekileni. Ukuxazulula izinkinga ezindaweni zokusebenza. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokucindezelayo futhi ezimeni zezulu ezingemihle /endaweni. Ukuqotho nesibindi.
zu.duties: Uxhome ekubeni nobhizinide kokuqinisekiswa kwemikhiqizo yabashayeli /abasebenzisi. Ukuphatha izitshalo ezikhethekile /amashini. Ukuphatha ngendlela engcono kakhulu imikhiqizo yabashayeli /abasebenzisi. Uxhome ekubeni nobhizinide nsuku zonke ukuhlola ukuthi ziyifanele yini ukuzula endaweni. Uxhome ekubeni nobhizinide ukuthi izimoto zihlengwa ngosuku olufanele. Ukuhlazanya imisebenzi yezokuthutha. Ukuthuthwa kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi kanye nezinsimbi /amashini. Ukuthola izimpahla kubanikazi bazo nasezitolo somnyango. Ukulungisa ukubhaliswa komnyango nokuqoqa. Ukusebenza ngokuvumelana nemithetho elandelayo. Ukuthola futhi ulungise izinkinga ezincane zensimbi ezimoto /amashini uthathe izinyathelo zokulungiswa. Ukulungisa nsuku zonke amashini. Ukuhlola nsuku zonke izono eziwubonakalayo ngaphandle kweqophelo lamashini nezimoto. Ukunakela izicelo ezikhethekile. Ukubhala ukuhamba nsuku zonke, amafutha nemazinga amashaye. Ukuhlola njalo emva kwesikhathi emazinga wokulungisa izimoto. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi indawo ihlanzwe lapho amashini agcinwa khona ukuze kugwemulwe ingozi zomlilo. Ukuhambisana nokuphepha nemigomo: ukuphephisa amashini nezimoto. Ukusiza ukulungiseza umsebenzi eziteshini zokulinganisa. Ukusiza ukushintsha futhi ukwakhe umsebenzi eziteshini zokulinganisa. Ukusiza abasebenzi bamakhono emisebenzini ekhethekile.

xh.title: Umsebenzi wokuLawula iMoto yeZolimo
xh.summary: Ukuqhuba nokugcina izityalo ezizodwa nezimoto ezinzima, ukuqamba iingqinisiso zangemihla zokuba zikulwandle, nokulawula inqanaba lokhwalipho lomqhubi Somerset East.
xh.requirements: I-NQF level 4. Ukutyhila ilayisenisi yokushukumisa evakalayo ye-Code EC/EC1 (okanye efanayo) engaphelelwa isikhathi nge-PDP evakalayo. Isatifikethi sokuziphatha / isatifikethi sokusebenza okanye izityalo ezinzima / i-machinery. Ubuncinane leminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava ekuqhubeni izimoto ezinzima kwaye ezingasebenzisa izixhobo ezinzima. Iimigaqo zokhuseleko kwiindlela nentlalo. Ulwazi lwezimoto ngezinto ezinzima. Urhoqo loLwazi lweMisebenzi (OHS). Ulwazi olusetyenziswa kwiindlela nemigaqo yokuhamba kwesebe. Iindlela ezisisiseko zokugcina iirekhodi nokubika. Amandla okubiza ngamathe nakubhalwayo. Ukunaka iinkcukacha nokuvakalelwa. Isisombululo sezinkinga kumaxwebhu okusebenza. Amandla okusebenza ngaphantsi komlinge kwaye kumaxesha amabi / iindawo. Ukuzithoba nokuzigqatsa.
xh.duties: Uxanduva lokwenza iphelo lenqanaba lokhwalipho kwisixhobo somqhubi / somsebenzi. Ukuqhuba izityalo ezizodwa / izixhobo. Ukusebenzisa iindlela ezilungileyo zokusebenza kumasistim womqhubi. Uxanduva lwangemihla ngeempelo zokuhamba kolwandle. Uxanduva lokuqinisekisa ukuba izimoto ziyakhangelwa ngexesha. Ukuhlalutya iindlela ze-logistics. Ukuthutha iqela lomsebenzi ngezinto / izixhobo. Ukuqokelela izinto kwabathengisi nakwiivenkile zeesebe. Ukugcina irejista yesebe. Ukusebenza ngokwemigaqo esetyenziswa. Ukufumanisa kulungiswe izinto ezincinane kwizimoto / izixhobo kwaye uzenze izinyathelo zokuzilungisa. Ukugcina ngemihla izixhobo. Ukujonga iimpapši ezibonakalayo ngaphandle kwezityalo nezimoto. Ukuphendela izicelo ezizodwa. Ukurekhoda iintambo zomhlha, ipelele neeleveli zamafutha. Ukuqinisekisa iyaqinisekiswa isixa esicocekileyo, apho izixhobo zihlelwa khona ukunyanzeliswa iingozi zemililo. Ukuqwalasela Iindaba zokuKhuseleka kwaye nemigaqo: ukwazi ukugcina izixhobo nezimoto. Ukuncedisa ngomsebenzi wokulungisa iziko lezinga. Ukuncedisa ngokuseta kabusha nomsebenzi owakhiwa kwiziko lezinga. Ukuncedisa abantu abanobuchule ngemisebenzi ezodwa.

Basic knowledge of chemical use (dilution/mix) chemical product knowledge. Basic knowledge daily maintenance procedures for efficient machine/equipment performance. Basic in knowledge supporting water utilization and water resource strategy. Basic knowledge of health and safety procedures. Basic knowledge of garden maintenance. Basic understanding of Government legislation. Communication skills and ability to work in a team. Must be punctual, productive, and loyal. Must be able to work in or near rivers, dams, and canals.
jobs.duties: Clean and maintain grounds, canals etc. Assist in repairing tools and structures such as building, fences, canals areas and benches using hand and power tools. Mix spray or spread fertilizers using hand or automatic sprayers or spreaders. Provide proper upkeep of sidewalks, driveways, parking lots, planters, and other ground features. Maintain existing grounds / gardens by caring for sod, plants, and trees. Rake and mulch leaves irrigate plants and lawns. Sweep walkways, grounds, and clean buildings by sweeping and washing floors.

af.title: Algemene Werkker
af.summary: Algemene werkerposisie vir die onderhoud van gronde, kanale en infrastruktuur vir die Department of Water and Sanitation in Mthatha, wat 'n ABET-kwalifikasie en ervaring in handearbeid vereis.
af.requirements: ABET-kwalifikasie. Ervaring in die uitvoer van handearbeid sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Kennis van algemene werk ten opsigte van die hantering van toerusting en apparaat. Basiese kennis van chemikaliëgebruik (verdunning/meng) en chemiese produkkennis. Basiese kennis van daaglikse onderhoudsprosedures vir doeltreffende masjien/toerustingsprestasie. Basiese kennis ter ondersteuning van waterbenutting en waterhulpbronstrategie. Basiese kennis van gesondheids- en veiligheidsprosedures. Basiese kennis van tuinonderhoud. Basiese begrip van Regeringswetgewing. Kommunikasievaardighede en vermoë om in 'n span te werk. Moet stip, produktief en lojaal wees. Moet in staat wees om in of naby riviere, damme en kanale te werk.
af.duties: Skoonmaak en onderhou gronde, kanale ens. Bystand met die herstel van gereedskap en strukture soos geboue, heinings, kanaalareas en banke met behulp van hand- en kraggereedskap. Meng, spuit of versprei bemesting met behulp van hand- of outomatiese spuiters of verspreiders. Verskaf behoorlike onderhoud van voetpaaie, opritte, parkeerterreine, plantbakke en ander grondeienskappe. Onderhou bestaande gronde/tuine deur vir gras, plante en bome te sorg. Hark en bedek blare met mulch en besproei plante en gazon. Veeg voetpaaie en gronde en skoon geboue deur vloere te vee en te was.

zu.title: Umsebenzi Jikelele
zu.summary: Isikhundla somsebenzi jikelele sokugcina izinkalo, amafamu wamanzi kanye ne-infrastructure e-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Mthatha, sifuna ifundo ye-ABET kanye nolwazi ngomsebenzi ongenzandla.
zu.requirements: Ifundo ye-ABET. Ulwazi ngokwenza umsebenzi ongenzandla luyoba yinzuselwano. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi jikelele ekuphathweni kwemishini nezimpahla. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwezikhemikhali (ukuhlanza / ukuxuba) ulwazi ngemikhiqizo yamakhemikhali. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngomgomo wokuphila nsuku zonke wokugcina imishini / isisetshenziswa sisebenze kahle. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ekusekeleni ukusetshenziswa kwamanzi kanye nohlelo lwamandla wamanzi. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngomgomo wempilo nephepho. Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngokugcinwa kwesitshalo. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo ngomthetho kahulumeni. Amakhono okuxhumana kanye nenhlokomeno yokusebenza esiqhingini. Kumele ukhawule futhi usebenze kahle ngokuguqula, kanti uthembekile. Kumele ukwazi ukusebenza eduze noma esibhelu, nasemafamu wamanzi.
zu.duties: Hlola futhi gcina izinkalo, amafamu wamanzi njll. Siza ekulungiseni amathuluzi izakhiwo njengokuba ngamabhilidi, izibali, amafamu wamanzi kanye nemiqolo, usebenzisa amathuluzi angenzandla nalawo aseshadini. Hlanganisa futhi sike noma usakaze izithombo ezidla, usebenzisa izisetshenziswa zokushaya ngesandla noma ezizenzakalayo noma ezisasazayo. Hlaziya izindlela zokuqhuba zohambo olunyathelwayo, izindawo zokubuka imoto ezinqamile, iziqhingi zokubeka izitshalo, kanye nezinye izici zezinkalo. Gcina izinkalo ezikhona / izinto ezihlala zimo njengokunakekelwa kwenhlabathi eshiyiwe, izitshalo, namakhaphetshe. Buyisela (Qoqa) amaqabunga wasike nagqwabu, wageze izitshalo namakhaphetshe. Cowezela izindlela zokuhamba kwenyawo, izinkalo futhi uhloze izakhiwo ngokuqoqa kanye nokugeza phansi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Jikelele
xh.summary: Isithuba somsebenzi jikelele ekugcineni iindawo, amajelo nemiPla entoluko yesebe le-Department of Water and Sanitation e-Mthatha, sifuna isikrweqe se-ABET nolwa ngemisebenzi yezandla.
xh.requirements: Ispane le-ABET. Isipilo sokwenza umsebenzi ngesandla siya kuba luncedo olongezelelekileyo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi jikelele ekusebenziseni izixhobo nezixhobo zasekhaya. Ulwazi olusisiseko malunga nokusetyenziswa kwezakhiwo zezitokfeyili (ukuzithandabuzela/ukutya) ukwazi ngeemveliso zezakhiwo zezitokfeyili. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngemigaqo yokonkcwalasa okuqeqeswa iinkqubo zemihla ngemihla ukuze kuqatywe ukusebenza koluhle olufanele. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngokuxhasa ukusetyenziswa kwamanzi nokuqonda isicwangciso samathafa. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngeenzaqo zamathafa. Ulwazi olusisiseko ngokugcina igadi. Ukuqonda okusisiseko ngomthetho kahulumende. Ikhono lokunxibelelana nokusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba. Kufuneka ube ngumntu ozelezela, ongumsebenzi, ongathembekanga.
xh.duties: Kucocwa kugcinwe iindawo, amajelo njl. Kuncedwa ekulungiseni izixhobo neemilo ezinjengezakhiwo, izikrabhu, iindawo zamajelo namaqabla kusetyenziswa izixhobo zesandla namandla. Kutyibilikwa kutyazwa okanye kusasazwa izongamiso kusetyenziswa abasasizi basesandla okanye ezikuzenziseleyo okanye abasasazi. Kunikwa ukhathalo olufaneleyo kwiindlela zokuhamba, eindlela zokupaka iimoto, kwindawo zokubeka iityantyi, nasezinye iimvelo zendawo. Kugcinwa iindawo ezikho / iigadi ngokuqonda inqanaba lothindo okhoyo, iityalo namakhwaphu. Kutyhuthwa kubekwa izigqoki ezithintelweyo kuncediswa amanzi iityalo namahlathi. Kucocwa iindlela zokuhamba, iindawo, kwaye kucocwa izakhiwo ngokucoca nokuhamba namanzi phantse.

jobs.title: Chief Director: Research, and Knowledge Management
jobs.department: Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum (Level 14), fully inclusive remuneration package
jobs.summary: Chief Director position leading research and knowledge management strategy for the Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities in Pretoria.
jobs.requirements: A Bachelor’s Degree (NQF level 7) qualifications in Social Sciences, Policy, Research, Knowledge Management, Economics, Development Studies, or a related field. A postgraduate degree (NQF 8 and above) in Policy, Research, Knowledge Management, Economics, Development Studies, or a related field shall be an added advantage. Certificate of successful completion of National School of the Government’s SMS Pre-Entry programme prior appointment. A minimum of 5 years’ experience in research, policy development and analysis or knowledge management experience at a senior management level; Skills: Research and analytical skills, Report writing skills, Communication skills (written and verbal), Computer skills, Programme and Project Management Skills, Strategic Planning, Financial Management, Change Management; knowledge; Research coordination, Policy development, analysis and evidence synthesis, Stakeholder engagement and negotiation, Knowledge management systems. Personal Attributes. Ethical behaviour; honesty and Integrity; Emotional Intelligence; Passion and Achievement driven; Ability to work under pressure; Ability to maintain confidentiality of information; Respect for copyrights/ aversion to plagiarism.
jobs.duties: Provide strategic leadership and manage the development and implementation of policy, research and knowledge management strategies, plans and product; Lead the strategic positioning of policy, research and knowledge management in support of the Department’s mandate on women, youth and persons with disabilities, Develop and manage the Chief Directorate’s strategic and operational plans, annual targets, performance indicators and reporting obligations, Ensure alignment of the Chief Directorate’s work with the Constitution, MTDP, NDP, GRPBMEAF, NSP on GBVF, departmental APP and relevant departmental and sector priorities, Provide evidence-informed strategic advice to the Minister, Director-General, Deputy Director-General and departmental governance structures, Ensure that outputs of the Chief Directorate strengthen mainstreaming, institutionalisation and accountability for women, youth and persons with disabilities priorities across government. Lead the development of a research agenda and manage research undertakings on the transformation and rights of women, youth and persons with disabilities; Lead the development and periodic review of a national and departmental research agenda on women, youth and persons with disabilities, manage the design, commissioning, implementation and quality assurance of research studies, evaluations, evidence reviews and analytical reports, ensure that research methodologies are rights-based, ethical, credible, scientifically sound and appropriate for public policy use, promote the use of disaggregated data, including sex, age, disability, geography and other relevant variables where available, manage local, regional and international benchmarking on empowerment, inclusion, equality and transformation. Ensure that research findings are translated into practical recommendations for policy, planning, budgeting, monitoring and evaluation. Lead policy analysis, evidence synthesis and the development of policy knowledge products to support departmental and intergovernmental decision-making; Lead policy analysis on matters affecting women, youth and persons with disabilities, manage the development of policy briefs, discussion documents, analytical notes, status reports, Cabinet inputs, parliamentary inputs and technical advisory products, ensure that departmental policy positions are evidence-based, constitutionally grounded and aligned with applicable national, regional and international obligations, analyse the implications of government policies, plans, budgets and programmes for women, youth and persons with disabilities, provide technical input into policy formulation, policy review, impact assessment and implementation monitoring processes, ensure that evidence from research, monitoring and evaluation is used to inform policy advice and executive decision-making. Manage knowledge management systems, repositories, evidence-use products and dissemination mechanisms; Lead the development and implementation of a knowledge management strategy for the Department, manage systems for collecting, organising, storing, protecting and disseminating institutional knowledge, research outputs and evidence products., establish and maintain knowledge repositories, databases, dashboards, learning platforms and evidence-use mechanisms, ensure that departmental knowledge products are accessible, credible, current and useful for decision-making, promote a culture of knowledge-sharing, learning and evidence use across the Department and relevant stakeholders, manage the translation of research and policy analysis into user-friendly products such as briefs, summaries, presentations, learning notes and executive reports. Coordinate strategic partnerships with government departments, Chapter 9 institutions, academia, research institutions, civil society and international partners; Build and manage strategic partnerships to strengthen policy, research, evidence generation and knowledge management, coordinate engagements with national departments, provinces, municipalities, public entities, Chapter 9 institutions, academia, research councils, civil society and development partners, represent the Department in technical committees, research forums, policy platforms, intergovernmental structures and knowledge-sharing forums, facilitate collaboration on studies, policy analysis, data sharing, capacity-building and evidence-use initiatives, ensure that partnerships advance the Department’s mandate and protect the credibility, independence and integrity of departmental evidence products. Manage stakeholder inputs into research, policy and knowledge products, ensuring that contributions are properly considered and documented. Manage human, financial and other resources in line with the PFMA, Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations and departmental delegations, Manage the Chief Directorate’s human resources, budget, assets, procurement inputs, operational risks and performance obligations.
jobs.enquiries: Mr Dire Segatlhle Tel No: (012) 359 0394
jobs.applications: Applicants are urged to submit the applications using this URL https://recruitment.dwypd.gov.za/ General enquiries may be brought to the attention of Mr Zuko Bebula Tel No: (012) 359 0417/ Mr Joseph Mahlangu Tel No: (012) 359 0238
jobs.notes: Preference will be given to women, youth and persons with disabilities from African males, Coloured (female and male) All fields in the Z83 application form on https://recruitment.dwypd.gov.za/ must be completed in full, in a manner that allows a selection committee to assess the quality of a candidate based on the information provided in the form. It is therefore prudent that fields be completed by applicants and signed, noting the importance of the declaration. South African applicants need not to provide passport numbers. Candidate must respond “Yes “or “No “to the question whether you are conducting business with the state. If “Yes”, details thereof, only shortlisted candidates will submit the Declaration form for conducting business with the state when shortlisted for the application. It is acceptable for applicant to indicate “not applicable” or leave a blank to the question “In the event that you are employed in the Public Service, will you immediately relinquish such business interest?” Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents, but must submit the completed and signed Z83 and detailed Curriculum Vitae. The communication from HR of the Department regarding the requirement for certified document will be limited to shortlisted candidates. Therefore, only the shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from HR. Applications received after the closing date will NOT be considered or accepted. Correspondence is limited to short-listed candidates only; should you not hear from us within six weeks of the closing date, please consider your application unsuccessful. Non-RSA citizens/permanent resident permit holders must submit a copy only when shortlisted. Should you be in possession of a foreign qualification, it must be accompanied by an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Should you not hear from the Department within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please consider your application to be unsuccessful. The Department reserves the right not to fill and/or make an appointment to any of the advertised posts. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical skills that are generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Further, personnel suitability checks, including security vetting, competency assessment will be conducted, as such transfer/promotion/appointment will made subject to positive outcomes of personnel suitability checks. Successful candidates shall be required to enter into performance agreement within three (3) months of assuming their duties in the Department, and within one (1) month of the date of their appointment conclude the prescribed contract of employment. Designated employees shall be required to disclose their financial interest within 30 days after assumption of duty. Appointments will only be made on the first notch of the advertised salary level. Note that in terms of the Protection of Personal Information Act, 2021, the Department will ensure the protection of applicants ‘personal information and only collect, use and retain applicants’ personal information for the purposes of recruitment and selection processes. The Department shall safeguard such personal information against access by unauthorised persons, unlawful disclosure, or breaches. The Department is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. In the filling of these posts, It is the intention of the Department to promote representivity in the Public Service through the filling of this position and the candidature of persons whose transfer/promotion/appointment will promote representivity will receive preference as the objectives of section 195 of the Constitution of the Republic of South Africa and the Employment Equity Act, 1998 (Act 55 of 1998) will be taken into consideration MANAGEMENT ECHELON
