zu.title: Umqondisi Ohola: Ucwaningo, Nobuqondo Bezulzulwazi
zu.summary: Isikhundla somqondisi ohola esihola inqubomgomo yocwaningo nobuqondo bezulzulwazi bacabange ngomnyango we Department of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities e Pretoria.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-Bachelor's Degree (NQF level 7) kwezemfundo ezenzakalayo, inqubomgomo, ucwaningo, ulawulo lolwazi, ezomnotho, izifundo zentuthuko, noma indawo ehlobene nalesi. I-degree yesikhundla esiphezulu esafunda kanti (NQF 8 nangaphezulu) kwinqubomgomo, ucwaningo, ulawulo lolwazi, ezomnotho, izifundo zentuthuko, noma indawo ehlobene nalesi kuyobe kuyinzuzo. Isitifiketi sobe uphezu umfundvo ohloliwe National School of Government SMS Pre-Entry programme ngaphambi kokuba uthunyelwe. Okungenani okuhamba isikhathi seminyaka engu-5 ohlezi uyazi ngemisebenzi yocwaningo, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo kanye nokuhlola noma ulawulo lolwazi oluhlezi phezulu; Amakhono: amakhono ocwaningo nokucazulula, amakhono okubhala imibiko, amakhono okuxhumana (okubhaliwe nakokukhulumayo), amakhono ekhompuyutha, amakhono olawulo luhlelo noluwohmiso, ukuhlela okubhekisa kude, ulawulo lwezimali, ulawulo loshintsho; ulwazi; ukuhlelwa kokubambisana kwemisebenzi yocwaningo, ukuthuthukiswa kwenqubomgomo, ukuhlola kanye nokuhlanganisa okushiwo ngokomtholampilo, ukuxhumana nabantu abahlukene kanye nokuxoxisana, izinhlelo zolawulo lolwazi. Izici zomuntu. Ukuziphatha okuhle; ukuqinisile nokuba nesibindi; ukuqonda izinkanhliziyo zabantu; ukuzifisela kakhulu futhi ukuba yilowo ophumelelisa; ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi; ukukwazi ukugcina imfihlo yolwazi; ukuhlonipha amalungelo okubhala/ukuzipatha ngokungalungi ukubeka izinto zokunye ekudeni.
zu.duties: Nika inqubomgomo eholela futhi ulawule ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo, ucwaningo nezindlela zolawulo lolwazi, izinketho neziphoqo-msebenzi; Hola indawo ehleli kahle inqubomgomo, ucwaningo kanye nolawulo lolwazi ukweseka nenzima yomnyango ngabesifazane, intsha nabantu abakhubazekile e Pretoria, Thuthukisa ulawule izinhlelo zesikhundla esihlule kakhulu nezokuhlela okuphilayo, imigomo yonyaka, izinkomba zokusebenza kanye nezigaba zokubika, Qinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wesikhundla sokuqondisa uhambisana nomthethosisekelo, MTDP, NDP, GRPBMEAF, NSP on GBVF, i-APP yomnyango kanye nezinhloso ezibalulekile zomnyango nezinye izinhloso, Nikeza izeluleko ezinolwazi oluwugqinsi ohleli abakhulu eNgqongqosheni, uMqondisi Jikelele, uMqondisi Jikelele ongumomopheli kanye nezakhiwo zokulawula zomnyango, Qinisekisa ukuthi imigqabo yalesi sikhundla sokuqondisa isiza ekubeni yinto evamile, ukwamukelwa ezikhungweni kanye nenkululeko ngabesifazane, intsha nabantu abakhubazekile ezigabeni zikahulumeni. Hola ukuthuthukiswa kohlelo lokucwaninga ulawule imisebenzi yokucwaninga ngokushintsha kanye namalungelo abesifazane, intsha nabantu abakhubazekile; Hola ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuhlola njalo ohlelwini lwezwe nezomnyango lokucwaninga ngabesifazane, intsha nabantu abakhubazekile, lawule ukwakhiwa, ukuthumela kubantu ababungela imisebenzi, ukuqashwa nokwenza izindinganiso ngemvelo kwezifundo zocwaningo, ukuhlola, ukuphinda kubuke imininingwane kanye nemibiko yokuhlola, qinisekisa ukuthi izindlela zokucwaninga zihlonipha amalungelo, zihle, zithembekile, zinemvelo ekuzwisisweni kwesayensi futhi zifanele ukusetshenziswa enqubomgomo yomphakathi, khuthaza ukusetshenziswa kolwazi oluhlukaniswe ngamagumbi, okuhlanganisa isini, iminyaka, ukukhubazeka, indawo kanye nezinye izinto ezibalulekile lapho kutholakala khona, lawule ukuqhathanisa emkhankulweni wasekhaya, owasingasingeni nangomhlaba ngamandla, ukuhlanganiswa, ukulingana kanye noshintsho. Qinisekisa ukuthi imiphumela yocwaningo ihunyushelwa kwizeluleko ezisebenzayo ezinqubomgomo, ekuhleleni, ekwenzeni umabhajethi, ekulawuleni nasekuhloeni. Hola ukuhlola inqubomgomo, ukuhlanganisa imibhalo evela ucwaningo kanye nokuqoqa ulwazi ngenqubomgomo ukuze kwesekwe izinqumo zomnyango zalapho kuhlangana khona amahulumenti; Hola ukuhlola inqubomgomo kumaphuzu athinta abesifazane, intsha nabantu abakhubazekile, lawule ukuthuthukiswa kwezinqulo zenqubomgomo, amadokhumenti wokuxoxisana, amanothi okuhlaziya, imibiko yokuqhubeka, izindinganiso zekhabhinethi, izindinganiso zesishayamthetho kanye nemikhiqizo yezelulezo yobuchwepheshe, qinisekisa ukuthi izimo zenqubomgomo zomnyango zisekelwe eminininingwaneni, zisuselwa emthethosisekelweni futhi zihambisana nezenziso ezifanele zamazwe angakweli nangaphesheya kwamanzi, hlola imiphumela yezinqubomgomo zahulumeni, amahlela, imibhalo yemali futhi uhlele imikhiqizo ngomnotho wabesifazane, intsha nabantu abakhubazekile, nikeza okufakwayo kobuchwepheshe ekwakheni inqubomgomo, ekuhlolweni kwayo, ekuhloeni ukuthinta kwayo nakumiklamo yokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwayo, qinisekisa ukuthi imibhalo evela ocwaningweni, ekulawuleni kwayo nasekuhloeni iyasetshenziselwa ukunika izeluleko ngenqubomgomo nezinqumo ezingabusi. Lawula izinhlelo zolawulo lolwazi, izikhungo zokugcina imininingwane, imikhiqizo yokuqasha ulwazi kanye nezindlela zokusabalalisa ulwazi; Hola ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwenqubomgomo yolawulo lolwazi komnyango, lawula izinhlelo zokuqoqela ndawonye, zokuhlela, zokulondoloza, zokuvikela kanye nokusabalalisa ulwazi lomnyango nemitapo yolwazi yocwaningo nemitapo yolwazi yemvelo., sungula ulondoloze imitholampilo yolwazi, izinhlelo zemibhalo, amabhodi abonisa imininingwane, izinkundla zokufunda kanye nezinto zokusebenzisa ulwazi, qinisekisa ukuthi imikhiqizo yolwazi yomnyango ifinyeleleka kalula, ithembekile, igqamile futhi ihleli itholakala lula ukusetshenziswa ekwenzeni izinqumo, khuthaza isiko lokwabelana ngolwazi, lokufunda nokusebenzisa imininingwane kulo lonke umnyango nakubantu abahlobene, lawula ukuhunyushwa kolwazi olungenayo kocwaningo nokuhlola inqubomgomo kwimikhiqizo elula kubasebenzisi njengezinqulo, okufingqiwe, okuthunyelwe, okulandela izinto ezintsha ezibhalwe ngokuluma nokuqonda kanye nemibiko yezinqumo ezinkulu. Hlela ubuhlobo benqubomgomo kanye namahulumeni awo wonke amanye amanyango, izikhungo i-Chapter 9, izikole zemfundo eziphakeme, izikhungo zocwaningo, abantu basemphakathini kanye nabahlobo bemazwe ngaphesheya; Akha ulawule ubuhlobo benqubomgomo ngeqhaza ukuze kuqiniswe inqubomgomo, ucwaningo, ukuvela kolwazi kanye nolawulo lolwazi, hlela ukuxhumana namanyango kazwelonke, izifundazwe, amakhaya obuse, izikhungo zabantu bomphakathi, izikhungo i-Chapter 9, izikole zemfundo eziphakeme, amabhodi ocwaningo, abantu basemphakathini kanye nabahlobo bentuthuko, mela umnyango kumakomidi obuchwepheshe, emaphoramithi ocwaningo, kumaphulatifomu wenqubomgomo, ezakhiweni zokuhlela kumahulumeni kanye nakumaphoramithi okwabelana ngolwazi, yenza ukusebenza ndawonye ezifundweni, ekuhloleni inqubomgomo, ekwabelananeni ulwazi, ekuheni amandla nakumiklamo yokusebenzisa ulwazi, qinisekisa ukuthi ubuhlobo buyaphembili inkinguni yomnyango futhi bugweme ukungazethemba, ukuzimela nokuziphatha okuhle kwezinto evela ocwaningweni zomnyango. Lawula okufakwayo kwabantu ocwaningweni, ngenqubomgomo nakumikhiqizo yolwazi, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi okulethwa kuyacatshangelwa futhi kubhalwe kahle. Lawula abantu, imali kanye nezinye izinsiza ngokuvumelana ne-PFMA, Izimiso ze Treasury Regulations, Public Service Act, Public Service Regulations kanye nemigomo yomnyango yokwabelana amandla, Lawula abantu bemali, umtholampilo, okungenayo ekuthengeni izinto, ukuphithizela kokuqhuba kanye nezenziso zokusebenza kwesikhundla sokuqondisa.

xh.title: INjingalawuli: Uphando, nolawulo Lolwazi
xh.summary: Isithuba sikaNjingalawuli esikhokela iindlela zophando nolawulo lolwazi kwisebe leDepartment of Women, Youth and Persons with Disabilities ePretoria.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seBachelors (inqanaba le-NQF 7) kwezacfundo zezenzululwazi ezenzulu ngeentsapho, iinkqubo zorhwebo, uphando, ulawulo lolwazi, izorhwebo, iifundo zophuhliso, okanye isigaba esinxulumene nalo. Isidanga esiphezulu kwezacfundo (NQF 8 nangaphezulu) kwezinkqubo zorhwebo, uphando, ulawulo lolwazi, izorhwebo, iifundo zophuhliso, okanye isigaba esinxulumene nalo, siza kuba yingconelo. Isatifikethi esibonisa ukupheliswa kweNkqubo yokungena ngaphambili kwe-SMS yeSikolo sikaRhulumente ngaphambi kokunikwa isithuba. Amava afunekayo okusebenza iminyaka engu-5 kumphando, uphuhliso lweenkqubo zorhwebo nokuqwalaselwa, okanye amava olawulo lolwazi kwinqanaba eliphezulu lolawulo; Amaphawu: Amaphawu okuphunda nokuhlalutya ulwazi, amaphawu okubhala iingxelo, amaphawu okunxibelelana nabantu (okubhaliweyo nokuthethwayo), amaphawu ekhompyutha, amaphawu olawulo lweenkqubo namaphrojekthi, iindlela zokuqwalaselwa ezizeenjongo, ulawulo lwezimali, ulawulo lotshintsho; ulwazi; ulawulo lophando, uphuhliso lweenkqubo zorhwebo, uhlalutyo nokuqokelelwa kolwazi, ukunxibelelana nabantu abanomdla nokuqhelanisa nabo, iinkqubo zolawulo lolwazi. Iimpawu zobuntu. Ukuziphatha ngokwenene; inyaniso nokuwohloka; ukuqonda iimvakalelo; umdla nokuzimisela ukufikelela kumgqabo; ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo; ukuba nakho ukugcina Iiyimfihlo ngolwazi; ukuhlonipza amalungelo okusesikweni/ukuzithinta ngokuchasene nokutsalwa kolwazi olungenamtshato.
xh.duties: Nika intwaso yolawulo ngokuzinika ngokupheleleyo lulawule uphuhliso nokusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zorhwebo, uphando lolwazi nolawulo lwolwazi, iindaba neenjongo; Lingisa ngeenjongo zokubeka ngokuchanekileyo iinkqubo zorhwebo, uphando nolawulo lolwazi xa ixhasa umthetho wesebe ngabafazi, intlalutsha nabantu abakhubazekileyo. Phuhlisa ulawule iindlela ezizeenjongo nentelezi ezisezantsi zeNjingalawulo, iinjongo zobnyaka, izalathiso zokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nezibhalo ezidwelisa izibhalo ezifunekayo, Qinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi weNjingalawulo uyahambelana noMgaqo-siseko, MTDP, NDP, GRPBMEAF, NSP on GBVF, i-APP yesebe nangaphezulu kwezo ndawo ezibalulekileyo zolawulo, Cosa izalathiso ezixhaswa ngolwazi ezinomdla weNkqubo ezeenjongo kwiNkosana, uMlawuli-Jikelele, uMlawuli-Jikelele oNgcangcazelayo nemiqathango yolawulo yesebe, Qinisekisa ukuba iziphumo zeNjingalawulu zomeza zibe namandla ngakumbi ukuzinza, ukwamkelwa kwesebe nokwabelana ngemfumba ngabafazi, intlalutsha nabantu abakhubazekileyo kwiindawo ezingoomanyano norhulumente. Lingisa uphuhliso lwendlela yophando ulawule uphando ngokutshintsha amalungelo abafazi, intlalutsha nabantu abakhubazekileyo; Qondisa uphuhliso nokuqwalaselwa kwexesha ngexesha lendlela yophando karhulumente kwangokwesethe nakwisebe ngabafazi, intlalutsha nabantu abakhubazekileyo, lawula uphuhliso, ukugqibezela, ukusebenza nokuchanekileyo kokwenziwa kolwazi lwophando, ukuguqulelwa kolwazi, iindaba ezinolwazi kunye neendaba ezilungeleleneyo ezinolwazi, qinisekisa ukuba iindlela zophando zixhasa amalungelo, zilungele ukwenza izinto ngokugqibeleleyo, zinolwazi olunyeni, zisezinzileyo zilungele ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo zorhwebo, khuthaza ukusetyenziswa kolwazi olwahlulwahlulweyo, kuquka ulimi, iminyaka, ukukhubazeka, indawo nolunye ulwazi olufumaneka, lawula ukuthelekiswa kolwazi ngokwentsapho, ngokobuzwe nangokwehlabathi ekujameni amandla, ukubandakanyeka, ulingano notshintsho. Qinisekisa ukuba iziphuma zophando ziguqulelwa ziibe ngokwamacebo okwenza izinto ezinomdla kwezorhwebo, iindaba, imali, ulawulo nokuqwalaselwa. Lingisa uhlalutyo lweenkqubo zorhwebo, uqoqosho lolwazi nokuphuhliswa kweenkqubo zolwazi zeenjongo zeenjongo ukuxhasa ukuzinza kolwazi kwesethe nakwisebe ngakwamanyano; Qondisa uhlalutyo lweenkqubo ngemiba echaphazela abafazi, intlalutsha nabantu abakhubazekileyo, lawula uphuhliso lweenkqubo zorhwebo, amaphepha ecandelo, iindaba ezingelulozi kwaphandle, izalathiso ezilungeleleneyo, iindaba ezibhaliweyo ezibekiweyo, izalathiso zoManyano lwaseKhabhinethi, izalathiso zePalamente nemveliso ebonelela ngolwazi olubalulekileyo noloncedo, qinisekisa ukuba izalathiso zesethe ngamaphepha ezorhwebo zixhaswa ngamagqabantshi, zisekelwe kuMgaqo-siseko zahlulahlule ngokuchanekileyo nakwezinye iindaba zamanyano norhulumente, coca iimpsuku zokwenza izinto ezinomdla kumalungiselelo wee nkqubo, iindaba, amafutshane, urhwebo namacebo karhulumente ngokubakho kwabafazi, intlalutsha nabantu abakhubazekileyo, bonelela ngolwazi oluluncedo olubalulekileyo ekwenziweni kweenkqubo zesorhwebo, ukubuyiselwa kweenkqubo, ukulinganiselwa kokubakho impembelelo noluvo lolwazi lweenkqubo ezisebenzayo, qinisekisa ukuba ulwazi olusuka kuphando, kulawulo nasekuqwalaselweni lusetyenziselwa ukunikela izalathiso ezinomdla kweenkqubo ezizeenjongo nokuqwalaselwa kwezigqibo eziphezulu. Lawula iinkqubo zolawulo lolwazi, iindawo zokugcina ulwazi, iinkqubo ezisebenzisa ulwazi kunye nendlela yokusasaza ulwazi; Lingisa uphuhliso nokuqwalaselwa kweenkqubo zolawulo lolwazi lwesebe, lawula iinkqubo zokuqokelela, ukuhlela, ukugcina, ukukhusela nokuqukuqela ulwazi ngokutsha, iziphumo zophando neenjongo ezikhiqiza ulwazi, setha ulawule iindawo zokugcina ulwazi, iindawo ezikhuselekileyo, iindlela ezibonisa ulwazi, iziphelo ezifundisa kwaye zithembisa ukusetyenziswa kolwazi; Qinisekisa ukuba iinkqubo zolwazi zisebe zifikeleleka kalula, zithembisa ukuthembeka, zisemthethweni ziluncedo ekuzeni izigqibo, khuthaza isiko lokwabelana ngolwazi, ukufunda nokusetyenziswa kolwazi kwesebe nasekwabanye abo banomdla, lawula uguqulelo lwophando nokuqwalaselwa kweenkqubo zezorhwebo zibe ngokwemveliso ezilula ukuba zisetyenziswe njengamaphepha aqabisileyo, iinkcukacha ezimfutshane, iingxelo ezibonakalayo, iindaba ezimfutshane nongxelo ezikwiziphilinge eziphezulu. Lingisa amaqhinga obudlelwane obunomdla norhulumente, iindawo zorhulumente ezingoomanyano, iindawo zeNkqubo yesi-9, izikolo eziphakamileyo, iindawo zophando, intlangano yorhulumente nabalingani belizwe lonke; Phuhlisa ulawule amaqhinga obudlelwane obunomdla ukomeza ngokuzinza iinkqubo zorhwebo, uphando, uqoqosho lolwazi nolawulo lolwazi, lingisa amaqhinga obudlelwane norhulumente wezikhundla, amaphondo, amazulu, iindawo zorhulumente, iindawo zoburhulumente zoburhulumente, iindawo zeNkqubo yesi-9, izikolo eziphakamileyo, iindawo zophando zorhulumente, intlangano yoluntu nabalingani bokuphuhlisa, Mela isethe kwabaqathi abanomdla, kwiindawo zophando, kwiiplathform zoorhwebo, nakwindlela yamanyano norhulumente yokwabelana ngolwazi, Qedisa ukusebenzisana kwizifundo, uhlalutyo lweenkqubo, ulwazi ngokwexesha nangaphezulu kokuguqula amandla okusetyenziswa kolwazi, qinisekisa ukuba amaqhinga obudlelwane ancedisa ngokuzinza umthetho wesebe axhase nokomeza ngenene, nokuba azimeleyo nangokuzinza kolwazi kwesethe. Lawula imibhalo yeemfumba ngokubakho kwentsapho ngabafazi, intlalutsha nakubantu abakhubazekileyo kwizifundo zorhwebo nangolwazi lwamaphepha eesethe, ukuthembisa ukuba iingcali zilungele ukuzinza ulwazi kwizinto ezingomdla nasekuphuhliseni amaphepha amaninzi, Qinisekisa ukuba imibhalo ipelwa ngokuchanekileyo ixhaswa yamaphepha aqondwa ngokuchanekileyo. Lawula ulwazi ngoluntu, iimali nolunye ulwazi ngokuhambelana noMthetho we-PFMA, iMigaqo yeNdlu yoLwazi, uMthetho woNkonzo woRhulumente, iMigaqo yoNkonzo woRhulumente nendlela yolawulo yesebe, Lawula uluntu olubandakanyekayo olubandakanyekayo kwesebe, iimali, izinto ezingezizo iimali, izicelo zoburhulumente, iingozi ezinokubakho zibe khona nakumthetho wokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager Nursing
jobs.centre: Nelson Mandela Metro, Dora Nginza Regional Hospital
jobs.salary_text: R1 069 215 - R1 219 323 per annum, (OSD), (an all-inclusive package), basic salary consists of 70% or 75% of total package, salary package will be structured according to Middle Management Service guidelines.
jobs.summary: Deputy Manager Nursing sought to provide strategic nursing leadership at Dora Nginza Regional Hospital in Gqeberha, requiring an R425 qualification and nine years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification Diploma/Degree in Nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse General. Minimum of 9 years after registration as a Professional Nurse, at least 4 years’ appropriate recognizable experience must be at Management Level. Demonstrate advanced understanding and application of Nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices. Knowledge of PFMA, HR Management. Knowledge of Public Sector Legislation and relevant Prescript/Regulation, Batho Pele Principles and patient Right Charter. Strong leadership, good interpersonal relations, effective problem-solving, management and decision-making skills. Good verbal and written communication skills are essential requirements. A valid driver’s license.
jobs.duties: To manage and provide strategic Nursing leadership and direction to the Nursing Services. Plan and monitor the objectives of the specialised unit in line with the strategic plan of the institution and the department. Coordinate and maintain conducive/constructive working relationships with Nursing and other stakeholders. Ensure compliance with professional and ethical practice. Monitor and ensure nursing care is practised in accordance with the statutory law, policies and procedures governing the Nursing Profession, Labour and Health Care. Effective management and utilisation of Human and Material Resources. Ensure effective implementation of PMDS. Monitor compliance to Quality Assurance and Infection Control and Occupational Health and Safety standards and National Core Standards Compliance. Ensure efficient and effective execution of administration functions of the Nursing unit.
jobs.enquiries: Ms B Bomela Tel No: (041) 406 4421
jobs.applications: must be submitted electronically via email to: Busisiwe.Bomela@echealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be posted on the new Z83 Form, a comprehensive CV, indicating three reference persons: Name and Contact Numbers, and a relationship with reference. Applicants are only required to submit a Z83 form and a comprehensive CV. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents (copies of Qualification(s) inclusive of Matric certificate, Identity document, Proof of registration, proof of citizenship if not RSA citizen) on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Applicants must note that further Personnel Suitability checks will be conducted on short- listed candidates and that their appointment is subject to the outcome of these checks which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal record checks. Reference checks will be done on nominated candidate(s). If you have not been contacted by the Department of Health within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging
af.summary: Adjunkbestuurder Verpleging gesoek om strategiese verpleegkundleierskap by Dora Nginza Regional Hospital in Gqeberha te verskaf, wat 'n R425-kwalifikasie en nege jaar se ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie Diploma/Degree in Verpleegkunde of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige Algemeen toelaat. Minimum van 9 jaar na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige, waarvan ten minste 4 jaar se toepaslike, herkenbare ervaring op Bestuursvlak moet wees. Toon 'n gevorderde begrip en toepassing van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke. Kennis van PFMA, HR-bestuur. Kennis van Openbare Sektor-wetgewing en tersaaklike Voorskrif/Regulasie, Batho Pele-beginsels en Pasienteregtehandves. Sterk leierskap, goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, effektiewe probleemoplossing, bestuurs- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goeie mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede is noodsaaklike vereistes. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf strategiese verpleegkundleierskap en rigting aan die verpleegdienste. Beplan en monitor die doelwitte van die gespesialiseerde eenheid in ooreenstemming met die strategiese plan van die instelling en die departement. Koördineer en handhaaf gunstige/konstruktiewe werksverhoudinge met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Verseker nakoming van professionele en etiese praktyk. Monitor en verseker dat verpleegsorg beoefen word in ooreenstemming met die statutêre wette, beleide en prosedures wat die verpleegprofesie, arbeid en gesondheidsorg regeer. Effektiewe bestuur en benutting van menslike en materiaalhulpbronne. Verseker effektiewe implementering van PMDS. Monitor nakoming van Kwaliteitsversekering en Infeksiebeheer en Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidsstandaarde asook Nasionale Kernstandaarde-nakoming. Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe uitvoering van administratiewe funksies van die verpleegeenheid.

zu.title: Umlindi weNkosikazi ohlela iNzululwazi, osesikhundleni
zu.summary: Kufunwa osesikhundleni ohlela izindlela zokulawula oyingcwele, ohlinzeka ngezindlela eziya phambili ukuphatha iNzululwazi eDora Nginza Regional Hospital eGqeberha, kudingeka unalo ubuncgishi be-R425 ube namava eminyaka engu-9.
zu.requirements: Ubuncgishi obuyisisekelo be-R425 Diploma/Degree kweNzululwazi noma obulinganayo obuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-SANC njengochwepheshe we-Nursing General. Ukuze kube khona iminyaka engu-9 ngemuva kokubhalisa njengochwepheshe we-Nursing, okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 yamava ahambisanayo abalulekile kumele ibe kwi-Management Level. Kubonise ukuqonda okuphakeme nokusebenzisa umthetho we-Nursing kanye namasu abalulekile nezomthetho ezihambisana nezobuciko bokuhlinzeka. Ukwazi i-PFMA, ukuLawula Abantu. Ukwazi umthetho we-Public Sector namagunya ohlelo abalulekile, izimiso zeBatho Pele kanye noMthethosisekelo wezamalungelo omphakathi. Ukuzwela okuphakeme, ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga ngokusebenza, ukuphatha kanye nokuthatha izinqumo ezisebenzayo. Ukuxhumana ngomlomo kanye nokubhala kahle kubalulekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha futhi uhlinzeke ngobuholi be-Nursing obubheke phambili kanye nesiqondiso kumasevisi e-Nursing. Cwangcisa futhi ulandele imigomo yenyunyana ezime ngokukhethekile ngokuhambisana nomcabango ohlelekile wesikhungo nomyango. Hlela futhi ulondoloze ubuhlobo obuhle obuletha ukusebenza kahle kwe-Nursing nabanye abalingisi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kwemisebenzi ehloniphekile nobuciko. Landela futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ukunakekelwa kwenziwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho, izinqobo nokuqondiswa okubusa i-Nursing, i-Labour kanye ne-Health Care. Ukuphatha okusebenzayo nokusebenzisa abantu neminonhlobo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza kahle kwe-PMDS. Qapha ukuthobela imigomo ye-Quality Assurance, i-Infection Control kanye ne-Occupational Health and Safety kanye nokuziphendulela kwemigomo yezizwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle nokusebenza okuhamba kahle kwezomphatha ze-Nursing.

xh.title: iNgcinee yomphathi wezesiNingatha
xh.summary: Kufuneki iNgcinee yomphathi wezesiNingatha ukunika inkokheli eqondo kwezesiNingatha eDora Nginza Regional Hospital eGqeberha, kufuneka ibe nelayisensi yekwalifikheyshen R425 namava eminyaka elishoba.
xh.requirements: Ilayisensi yekwalifikheyshen R425 eNursing okanye ikwalifikheyshen elinganayo evumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengenesiProfessional Nurse General. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba unamava angazange abe ngaphantsi kweminyaka elithoba (9) emva kokubhalisa njengenesi Professional, kubekho ubuncinane beminyaka emine (4) yamava afanelekileyo aqondekayo kwindqanaba loNdlu. Kubonise ukuqonda okuphakamileyo nokusebenzisa umthetho wezesiNingatha nendlela ezalo nendlela ngokomthetho nangokwesistensi yokwenza iNursing. Ulwazi ngePFMA, ulawulo lweHR. Ulwazi ngomthetho woLawulo lwesiLungu somnqweno ohambelana nendlela ezalo, iimpawu zeBatho Pele kunye neMigqo yamalungelo omPhathi. Inkokheli eqinileyo, ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu, isakhono esisebenzayo sokuzalathisa izixhobo, ulawulo nokuThatha isigqibo. Isakhono esihle sokuthetha nangokubhala kubalulekile. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni.
xh.duties: Ukulawula nokunika inkokheli eqondo nendlela kwamacebo azesiNingatha ezolawula iinkonzo zesiNingatha. Ukuqamba nokulawula iinjongo zeNdawo ngokweNkqubo yeSaziso oluNqamlezayo lwesazi nesebe. Ukuqhubeza nokugcina ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwezesiNingatha nabo bonke abanxaxhe njengoko kuyimfuneko. Ukuqinisekisa ukuzinikela ngokobuchwepheshile nokusetyenziswa kwemithetho yokuziphatha yamabom. Ukulawula nokuzimisela ukwenza isondlo ngenkqubo ngokumthetho osemthethweni, amagqabantshi athile nolawulo lomthetho ochwepheshile bokwenziwa kobuchwepheshile bokunyanga, ulawulo lomSebenzi nesiBe loNxande. Ulawulo olusebenzayo nasekubonakaliseni amacebo amathongo asebenzayo nezinto ezizifuna. Ukulawula ukubhaqabhqa ngokuchanekileyo kwendlela yokwenza iinkonzo ezibalulekileyo nongqina lweNdalo yoBomi. Ukulawula ukuhanjiswa kolawulo ngokwemigaqo yamathemba nokuqhubelela ekwenzeni iNkcithakalo lokukhuhla nokuBeka umThetho woKhuseleko lweMisebenzi ngakumbi ngokomthetho oqhelanayo osemthethweni oqinisekileyo. Ukuzimisela ukuba ngowasebenza ngokuchanekileyo iinkqubo zolawulo eziNingatha.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing Specialty (INTENSIVE Care Unit)
jobs.centre: OR Tambo District, Nelson Mandela Academic Hospital
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing Specialty for the Intensive Care Unit at Nelson Mandela Academic Hospital, requiring SANC registration and 10 years nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma/degree in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification, with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in Intensive Nursing Science. Registration with SANC as Professional Nurse. A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience in the specific specialty after obtaining the 1-year post-basic qualification in the relevant specialty. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognisable experience at management level. Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team. Knowledge of PFMA, Batho Pele Principles, Patient Rights Charter and other relevant legal framework, Labour Relations and Public Service Acts. Managerial and communication (both written and verbal), report writing and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of six key priority areas, ability to work under pressure. A valid driver’s license. Computer Literacy.
jobs.duties: Demonstrate in in-depth knowledge of relevant prescripts as well as understanding of the legislative’s framework governing Public Service. Ensure that the clinical nursing practice by the team is rendered in accordance with the scope of practice and nursing standards as determined by the relevant health facility. Promote quality of nursing care as directed by professional scope of practice and standards determined by the health facility. Demonstrate a basic understanding of HR and Financial policies and practices. Demonstrate in depth understanding of nursing legislation and related legal and ethical nursing practices and how it expects a service delivery. Demonstrate knowledge of National Care Standards and in reporting and monitoring of indicators. Ensure that the environment complies with Health and Safety Act and Infection Prevention and Control Policies.

jobs.applications: must be submitted electronically via email to: Nozidumo.Calaza@echealth.gov.za

All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. Applicants must note that further Personnel Suitability checks will be conducted on short- listed candidates and that their appointment is subject to the outcome of these checks which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal record checks.
