af.title: Assistent-bestuurder Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit (INTENSIVE Care Unit)
af.summary: Assistent-bestuurder Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit vir die Intensive Care Unit by Nelson Mandela Academic Hospital, wat SANC-registrasie en 10 jaar verpleegkundige ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma/graad in Verpleegkunde) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC in Intensive Nursing Science. Registrasie by SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 6 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1-jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Ten minste 3 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk. Kennis van PFMA, Batho Pele-beginsels, Pasienteregtehandves en ander tersaaklike regskader, Arbeidsverhoudinge en Openbare Dienswette. Bestuurs- en kommunikasie- (sowel geskrewe as mondelinge), verslagskryf- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis van ses kernprioriteitsgebiede, vermoë om onder druk te werk. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Toon diepgaande kennis van tersaaklike verordeninge sowel as begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die Openbare Diens regeer. Verseker dat kliniese verpleegpraktyk deur die span ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk en verpleegkundige standaarde soos bepaal deur die tersaaklike gesondheidsfasiliteit gelewer word. Bevorder die gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde bepaal deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Toon 'n basiese begrip van HR- en Finansiële beleide en praktyke. Toon diepgaande begrip van verpleegwetgewing en verwante regs- en etiese verpleegpraktyke en hoe dit dienslewering verwag. Toon kennis van National Care Standards en in die verslagdoening en monitering van aanwysers. Verseker dat die omgeving aan die Health and Safety Act en Infeksievoorkoming en Beheerbeleide voldoen.

zu.title: Msizi Womphathi Wezokwelapha Ngokwesikhulu (Isigaba Sokunakekelwa Esibucayi)
zu.summary: Msizi Womphathi Wezokwelapha Ngokwesikhulu wesigaba sokunakekelwa esibucayi eNelson Mandela Academic Hospital, ofuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC namava eminyaka engu-10 ekuqashweni kokunakekela abagula.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezisisiseko ze-R425 (okungukuthi idiploma/izinga kwezokunakekela abagula) noma iziqu ezilinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqaji wezempilo. Iziqu zezenzo ezingasemva kwesiseko ezokunakekela abagula, ezithatha isikhathi esingaphansi konyaka ungamunye, ezibhalisiwe kwi-SANC ezifundweni zesayensi yokunakekelwa esibucayi. Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengogqaji wezempilo. Amava okungenani eminyaka engu-10 ahambisana/nawo oqashwayo ekuqashweni kokunakekela abagula emva kokubhalisa njengogqaji wezempilo kwi-SANC ekuqashweni kwamasiko obunjiniyela. Okungenani iminyaka engu-6 yemesikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele ibe amava ahambisana/awoqashwayo kwesigaba esithize sokwelapha emva kokuthola iziqu zenyaka ungamunye ezingasemva kwesiseko kwesigaba esihlobene. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yemesikhathi okushiwo ngenhla kumele ibe amava ahambisana/awoqashwayo ezingeni lomphathi. Ikono lokusebenza eqenjini elinababezelisi abaningi. Ulwazi nge-PFMA, Izimiso ze-Batho Pele, isibambiso samalungelo abagula nokunye okuhlobene nomthetho, ukuhlobana nabasebenzi kanye nemithetho yesevisi yomphakathi. Izikhathi zokuphatha nokuxhumana ( kokubhaliwe nokukhulunywe), ukubhala umbiko kanye namakhono ekuqondeni izinkinga. Ulwazi ngezindawo eziyisihluthulelo eziyisithupha, ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Bonisa ulwazi olujuqu oluhlobene nemithetho kanye nokuqonda ukwesekwa komthetho okuphethe isevisi yomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izenzo zokunakekela abagula ezinqumweni zikhishwa ngokwezesekelo senza nemigomo yokunakekela njengokuqunyiwe isikhungo sezempilo esihlobene. Khuthaza izinga lokunakekelwa kwabagula njengokuqondiswa isiesekelo senza sobuchwepheshe nemigomo equnyiwe isikhungo sezempilo. Bonisa ukuqonda okuyisiseko kwezomgomo nezokwenza kwe-HR kanye nezomnotho. Bonisa ukuqonda okujuqu ngomthetho wezokunakekela abagula kanye nokusetshenziswa kwomthetho nokuziphatha ngokwesibindi ekunakekelweni kwabagula nokuthi kulindeleke ukuthi kuhlinzwe kanjani isevisi. Bonisa ulwazi lwezinga lokunakekelwa kazwelonke nokubika nokuqaphela izinkomba. Qinisekisa ukuthi indawo ihambisana noMthetho wezoMpilo Nokuphepha kanye Nomgomo Wokuvimbela Ukuhamba Kwesifo.

xh.title: Umphathi oNcedo weNtsinbi yeMisebenzi eNginzulwini (Icandelo leNtlaselo eliQinileyo lokunyanga)
xh.summary: Umphathi oNcedo weNtsinbi yeMisebenzi eNginzulwini kwiCandelo leNtlaselo eliQinileyo lokunyanga eNelson Mandela Academic Hospital, kufuneka abhalwe kwiSANC abe nokuba nemyaka eyi-10 yamava ohambelana nokuqeqeshwa kokuGqithisa.
xh.requirements: Izifundo zesisiseko zeR425 (oko kukuthi iDiploma/izifundo eziphakamileyo kwiNtsinbi yokuGqithisa) okanye izifundo ezalinganayo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengoGqithisi weeNtsinbi. Izifundo zeNtsinbi ezingasemva kwesiseko, ngexesha lesixa esingaphantsi kwemo, kwakunye nonyaka owedluleyo, esemthethweni kwiSANC kwiSayensi yokuNyangwa ngeNdlela eNzulu. UkuBhaliswa kwiSANC njengoGqithisi weeNtsinbi. Isiphelo seemva ezifanelekileyo/eziqaphelwayo ezili-10 kwintsinbi emva kokubhaliswa kwiSANC njengoGqithisi weeNtsinbi kwiNtlinde yoBuchule. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-6 kule migaqo elandelayo kufuneka ibe yiyo le mava efanelekileyo/eqaphelwayo kwintsinbi ethile eNzulu emva kokuphuma kwesifundo seNtsinbi ezingasemva kwesiseko esithatha unyaka owedluleyo kule ntlinde ixabisekileyo. Ubuncinane beminyaka eyi-3 kule migaqo ilandelayo kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/ aqaphelwayo kwinqanaba lolawulo. Ulwazi lokusebenza kwiqembu elinezisebe ezininzi. Ulwazi ngePFMA, iimPelo ngezimPelo zeBatho Pele, iNqunyunyulu lamaLungelo oMpatient kunye nezinye iinkqubo zomthetho ezibalulekileyo, iMibandela yeRomlelana kuSebenza kunye neMithetho yeNkonzo zeZizwe. Amava okulawula nokuxoxwa (kokubili okubhaliweyo nokuThethwayo), ukubhala iingxelo nokuSombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi ngeendawo eziphambili ezintandathu, ukuba namandla okusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. iLesenti elisebenzayo. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ngeKhompyutha.
xh.duties: Bonakalisa ulwazi oluzinzileyo malunga nemigaqo ekwamkelwayo kunye nokuqonda ngenkqubo yomthetho elawula iNkonzo yoLuntu. Qinisekisa ukuba ukuqeqeshwa kokuNyangwa kokuchaphazeleka yiqembu kwenziwa ngokobangacala bokuqeshwa nobugqila obuQqhayiweyo njengoko miselwa sisikhululo senkcubeko esifanelekileyo. Phakamisa isimo seNkonzo yokuNyangwa njengoko kwamiswa zizibangacala zobugqila obuQqhayiweyo nemiQathango esisikhululweni senkcubeko esifanelekileyo. Bonakalisa uqondo lokuqonda ngeMigaqo yokuSebenza ngokwendalo nezemali. Bonakalisa uqondo oluzinzileyo ngomthetho kokuNyangwa nokwenziwa ngokomthetho namasiko okuNyangwa indlela alindele ukuba kuhanjiswe iNkonzo. Bonakalisa ulwazi ngeMilinganisela yezeLizwe yokuhlolwa nokubika nokwazi ukuqonda iNdlela yokulawula imiqondo. Qinisekisa ukuba imeko yendawo ihambelana noMthetho weMojula kunye neMigaqo yokuthintela ukwalatya nokulawula iSifo.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing Specialty (PEADIATRICS)
jobs.centre: OR Tambo District, Nelson Mandela Academic Hospital
jobs.summary: Assistant Manager Nursing Specialty in Paediatrics at Nelson Mandela Academic Hospital, requiring a Professional Nurse qualification with advanced paediatric training and 10 years experience.
jobs.requirements: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. Diploma/Degree in Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse plus post-basic nursing qualification, with duration of at least 1 year, accredited with SANC in terms of Government Notice No R212 in Advanced Paediatrics Nursing Science. A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the one-year post-basic course/qualification in the relevant speciality. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience at management level. Knowledge of nursing care procedures, Good communication skills.
jobs.duties: To ensure a holistic approach in the delivery of nursing care to customers/clients in cost effective, efficient & equitable manner. Overall supervision/management of the nursing services & maintain constructive working relations with nurses & other stake – holders. Participate in the analysis, formulation & implementation of nursing guidelines, standards & procedures. Monitor & ensure proper utilization of financial & physical resources. Utilize information technology and other management information systems to manage nursing information for the enhancement of service delivery: Advocate and ensure the promotion of nursing ethos and professionalism.
jobs.enquiries: Ms Calaza Tel No: (047) 502 4469
jobs.applications: must be submitted electronically via email to: Nozidumo.Calaza@echealth.gov.za
jobs.notes: Applications must be posted on the new Z83 Form, a comprehensive CV, indicating three reference persons: Name and Contact Numbers, and a relationship with reference. Applicants are only required to submit a Z83 form and a comprehensive CV. Therefore, only shortlisted candidates for a post will be required to submit certified documents (copies of Qualification(s) inclusive of Matric certificate, Identity document, Proof of registration, proof of citizenship if not RSA citizen) on or before the day of the interview following communication from HR. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Applicants must note that further Personnel Suitability checks will be conducted on short- listed candidates and that their appointment is subject to the outcome of these checks which include security clearance, security vetting, qualification verification and criminal record checks. Reference checks will be done on nominated candidate(s). If you have not been contacted by the Department of Health within three (3) months of the closing date of the advertisement, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. We thank all applicants for their interest. People with disabilities are encouraged to apply for these posts. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde Spesialiteit (PEADIATRICS)
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde Spesialiteit in Pediatrik by Nelson Mandela Academic Hospital, wat 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige-kwalifikasie met gevorderde pediatriese opleiding en 10 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. Diploma/Graad in Verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat, plus na-basiese verpleegkundige kwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by SANC ingevolge Regeringskennisgewing No R212 in Gevorderde Pediatriese Verpleegkunde. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 6 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die eenjaar na-basiese kursus/kwalifikasie in die tersaaklike spesialiteit. Ten minste 3 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak wees. Kennis van verpleegsorgprosedures; goeie kommunikasievaardighede.
af.duties: Om 'n holistiese benadering in die lewering van verpleegsorg aan klante/kliënte op 'n kostedoeltreffende, doeltreffende & billike wyse te verseker. Algehele toesig/bestuur van die verpleegdienste & handhaaf konstruktiewe werksverhoudinge met verpleegkundiges & ander belanghebbendes. Deelneem aan die analise, formulering & implementering van verpleegriglyne, standaarde & prosedures. Monitor & verseker behoorlike benutting van finansiële & fisiese hulpbronne. Benut inligtingstegnologie en ander bestuursinligtingstelsels om verpleeginligting te bestuur vir die verbetering van dienslewering: pleitbesorg en verseker die bevordering van verpleeg-etos en professionaliteit.

zu.title: Msizi Womphathi Wezokunakekela Ekhokhelwe (I-PAEDIATRICS)
zu.summary: Msizi Womphathi Wezokunakekela Ekhokhelwe kwi-Paediatrics e-Nelson Mandela Academic Hospital, ofuna izifundo zokuba Ngunesi Ochwepheshe ezinolwazi oluthuthukisiwe lokunakekela izingane kanye namava eminyaka engu-10.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esiyisiseko se-R425 (okuyi-Diploma/Degree e-Nursing) noma isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoGqoka Unesi ohlathiwe kanye nesifundo sokunakekela abagulayo ngemva kweyisiseko, esithatha isikhathi esingasenani unyaka we-1, esamukelekile e-SANC ngokwe-Saziso Lolawu Luhulumeni eliyingu-R212 kwi-Advanced Paediatrics Nursing Science. Okungenani unyaka we-10 wamabizelwe/awaziwayo ekukeni ngemva kokubhalisa njengoGqoka Unesi e-SANC kwi-General Nursing. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-6 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube ngamabizelwe/awaziwayo ngemva kokuthola isifundo seminyaka eyodwa ngemva kweyisiseko kuleyo ndawo ekhokhelwe. Okungenani eminyakeni engu-3 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube ngamabizelwe/awaziwayo ezingeni lobuqhophi. Ulwazi ngemigangatho yokunakekela abagulayo, Amakhono okuxhumana ahle.
zu.duties: Ukuqinisekisa indlela ebandakayo konke ekuhaniseni inakekelo kwabathintekayo ngendlela ehlahle imali,esebenza kahle futhi elinganayo. Ukuphatha ngokuphelele izinsizakalo zokunakekela kanye nogcinisekisa ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabanesi nabanye abathintekayo. Ukubambe iqhaza ekuhlaziyeni, ukwenza kanye nokuphetha imigangatho nemiqathango yokunakekela abagulayo. Ukulawula futhi ukuqinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okulungele imali nezinsiza ezingokwakho. Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bolwazi kanye namanye amasistimu e-technology ukuphatha ulwazi ngokunakekela ngenhlayo yokwenza isevisi: Ukusekela futhi ukuqinisekisa ukuthuthukisaamasiko nokuziphatha okukahle ezokunakekela.

xh.title: Umphathi owuncedisayo weNkululeko eNqanaba eliphezulu loGqithiso (PEADIATRICS)
xh.summary: Umphathi owuncedisayo weNkululeko eNqanaba eliphezulu loGqithiso kwiNgcina yamagunya eNelson Mandela, efuna ifomali yamaGqirha oNongqondile eneQeqesho eliphezulu lokugqithisa kwabantwana kunye neminyaka eli-10 yamava.
xh.requirements: Ifomali esisiseko seR425 (okunokuthi yiDiploma/Isidanga kwiNkonzo yoGqirha) okanye ifomali elingathatha njengento elifanayo evumela ubhaliso kwiSANC njengesiGqirha soNongqondile ehambisa ngeQeqesho elingemva kwesiseko seNkonzo yoGqirha, ngexesha elingalinganisi ngetyanga eli-1, elivunyelwe yiSANC ngokwesaziso seRhulwantamke kuphawu ngo-rhuqo lwe-R212 kwiSayensi eNqanaba eliphezulu leNkonzo yoGqirha kubantwana; Ubuncinci beminyaka eli-10 yamava ahambelanayo/abonakalayo kwiNkonzo yoGqirha emva kobhaliso njengesiGqirha soNongqondile kwiSANC ekuQeqeshweni lwaqo. Ubuncinci beminyaka esi-6 kule minyaka etshiwo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava ahambelanayo/abonakalayo emva kokufumana iqeqesho/ifomali lemnyaka wesinye ngemva kwesiseko kwindawo ogqithise kuyo; Ubuncinci beminyaka esi-3 kule minyaka etshiwo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava ahambelanayo/abonakalayo kwinqanaba lolawulo; Ulwazi ngemigaqo yenkonzo yokunyangwa, amakhono obukhululeko lulungileyo.
xh.duties: Ukuqinisekisa indlela ezingathathi cala yonke ekuboneleleni ngenkonzo yokunyangwa kumakhaya/kubathengi ngenkqubo engabizi kakhulu, esebenzayo futhi ngokulinganayo; Ulawulo jikelele/ulawulo lweenkonzo zenkonzo yokunyangwa kwaye ugcine iindibanisela ezakhiweyo zobudlelwane abakho phakathi kabaNongqondile naye nabanye abantu abanentshukumo; Ukuthatha inxaxheba kumanalis, ekwakheni nasenkqubo yamagunya, amalinga nobuquqabelo bokunyangwa; Ukuqaphela futhi ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwemali nezibonelelo ezothe ngqo; Ukusebenzisa iNkqubo yamakhompyutha yoxhaxha lweThulagqondo kunye nezinye iinkqubo zelwazi lolawulo ukulawula ulwazi ngokunyangwa ngokusetyenziswa kwentsatsho yentsatsho elunguzo; Ukukhusela futhi ukuqinisekisa ukukhuthazwa kwamaxa kunye noyilo lokusebenza.

jobs.title: Deputy Director General: Environment
jobs.salary_text: R1 885 710 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs).
jobs.closing_date_text: 24 August 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Lead environmental compliance and enforcement services as Deputy Director General in Johannesburg, requiring a postgraduate qualification and eight years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus post graduate qualification (NQF level 8) in Environmental Science/Management/Natural Science/Business Management/Administration recognized by SAQA. 8 years relevant experience at a senior managerial level. Valid driver’s licence. Competencies: Knowledge of Departmental policies and procedures and Government priorities. Understanding of government standard administrative procedures, Knowledge and understanding of PFMA, Treasury Regulation, PSA, PSR, Labour relations etc. Reporting procedures, Information system, SA Constitution and Employment Equity Act,1998. Interpreting and Evaluating Information, Organizing/maintaining information, communicating information, Computer Literacy, Listening and negotiation, Tact and diplomacy, Discipline, Financial Management. Attributes: Committed, Initiative, Objective, Logical, Proactive and resourceful, Flexible/change orientated, Credible, Loyal and friendly, open-minded, Responsible and accountable. Good interpersonal relations. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Ability to work in a team and independently. Strong Management skills. Problem Solving and conflict management, People Orientated, Verbal and written communication.
jobs.duties: Manage the rendering of reactive compliance and enforcement services. Manage compliance monitoring and enforcement services. Manage and administer the provision of compliance, monitoring and enforcement regarding national environmental management biodiversity act. Manage the implementation of environmental impact mitigation to promote sustainable development and a safe healthy environment. Manage the promotion of sustainable development of quality of life by promoting acceptable ambient air quality and manage hazardous substances and other related anthropogenic activities. Manage the implementation of waste management strategies and waste information systems, issue waste authorizations, support local government to render appropriate waste management. services and promote waste minimization in Gauteng. Render administrative support to environmental management services. Empower communities to manage natural resources through job creation, skills development and awareness opportunities. Ensure and manage the integration of environmental policy, planning and coordination services. Promote the conservation and sustainable utilization of the province's biological diversity to the benefit and upliftment of the quality of life. Manage and provide biodiversity scientific services. Render administrative support to biodiversity management services. Oversee and ensure discipline. Assess the performance of management. Consolidate and manage of budget for executive support directorate. Authorise, control and monitor the budget and expenditure.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za or send an email @ GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za quoting the relevant reference number applications must be submitted on the New Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents FOR ATTENTION : Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364– Recruitment
jobs.notes: Applications with the Old Z83 form will not be considered. A New Z83 form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed by the applicant. A recent, comprehensive CV, specifying all qualifications and experience, with respective dates must accompany the application form. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. After the pre-entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry- programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal: Omgewing
af.summary: Lewer omgewingsnakomings- en handhawingsdienste as Adjunk-Direkteur-Generaal in Johannesburg, met 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie en agt jaar se senior bestuurservaring as vereiste.
af.requirements: Matric plus nagraadse kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 8) in Omgewingwetenskap/Bestuur/Natuurwetenskap/Sakebestuur/Administrasie erken deur SAQA. 8 jaar relevante ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van departementele beleide en prosedures en Regeringsprioriteite. Begrip van die regering se standaard administratiewe prosedures, Kennis en begrip van PFMA, Tesourie-regulasie, PSA, PSR, Arbeidsverhoudinge ens. Verslagdoeningsprosedures, Inligtingstelsel, SA Grondwet en Wet op Indiensnemebillikheid, 1998. Inligting interpreteer en evalueer, Inligting organiseer/onderhou, inligting kommunikeer, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Luister en onderhandeling, Tak en diplomasie, Dissipline, Finansiële Bestuur. Eienskappe: Toegewyd, Inisiatief, Objektief, Logies, Proaktief en vindingryk, Buigsaam/veranderingsgerig, Geloofwaardig, Loyaal en vriendelik, oopkop, Verantwoordelik en aanspreeklik. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums te haal. Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Sterk bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en konflikbestuur, Mensegerig, Verbale en geskrewe kommunikasie.
af.duties: Bestuur die lewering van reaktiewe nakoming- en handhawingsdienste. Bestuur nakomingsmonitering- en handhawingsdienste. Bestuur en administreer die voorsiening van nakoming, monitering en handhawing met betrekking tot die Nasionale Omgewingsbestuur: Biodiversiteitswet. Bestuur die implementering van omgewingsimpakvermindering om volhoubare ontwikkeling en 'n veilige gesonde omgewing te bevorder. Bestuur die bevordering van volhoubare ontwikkeling van lewensgehalte deur aanvaarbare omgewende luggehalte te bevorder en gevaarlike stowwe en ander verwante antropogene aktiwiteite te bestuur. Bestuur die implementering van afvalbestuurstrategieë en afvalinligtingstelsels, gee afvalmagtigings uit, ondersteun plaaslike regering om toepaslike afvalbestuur te lewer. dienste en bevorder afvalminimering in Gauteng. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuning aan omgewingsbestuursdienste. Bemagtig gemeenskappe om natuurlike hulpbronne te bestuur deur werk skepping, vaardigheidsontwikkeling en bewustheidsgeleenthede. Verseker en bestuur die integrasie van omgewingsbeleid, beplanning en koördineringsdienste. Bevorder die bewaring en volhoubare benutting van die provinsie se biologiese diversiteit tot die voordeel en verhoging van die lewensgehalte. Bestuur en verskaf biodiversiteitswetenskaplike dienste. Lewer administratiewe ondersteuning aan biodiversiteitsbestuursdienste. Hou toesig oor en verseker dissipline. Assesseer die prestasie van bestuur. Konsolideer en bestuur die begroting vir die uitvoerende ondersteuningsdirektoraat. Magtig, beheer en monitor die begroting en besteding.

zu.title: Isiphathi Sengqalasithandathu: Izindaba Zemvelo
zu.summary: Hola izinsiza zokuhambisana nemithetho nokuphoqa ngokuhambisana nemithetho njengesiphathi sengqalasithandathu eJohannesburg, okudinga iziqu ze-postgraduate neminyaka yisishiyagalombulu yemfundo yokuphatha ezingeni eliphezulu.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye niziqu ze-postgraduate (izinga le-NQF 8) ku-Environmental Science/Management/Natural Science/Business Management/Administration ezibonwa ngumnyango i-SAQA. 8 years relevant experience at a senior managerial level. Valid driver's licence. Ikhono: Ulwazi mayelana nemithetho yomnyango kanye namaphojekothi kanye nezinhloso zikahulumeni. Ukuqonda izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokuphatha zikahulumeni, Ulwazi kanye nokuqonda i-PFMA, i-Treasury Regulation, i-PSA, i-PSR, ubudlelwano basebenzi njll. Izinqubo zokubika, ulwazi lwesistimu, uMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika kanye ne-Employment Equity Act,1998. Ukuhumusha kanye nokuhlola ulwazi, ukuhlanganisa/kugcina ulwazi, ukwazisa ulwazi, ukusebenzisana nekhumputa, ukulalela kanye nokuxoxisana, ubuchule kanye nobudlelwano, isiyalo, ukuphatha izimali. Izimpawu: Uzinikele, ukuthatha isinyathelo, ungakhethi izinkalo, unengqondo eqondile, uyangabazeli futhi unamandla, uyakwazi ukushintsha, uyathembeka, unobungani futhi unengqondo evulekile, unomthwalo futhi uphendula. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcindezi kanye nokuhlangabezana nemikhawulo yosuku. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini kanye nodwa. Amakhono aphathelelwe ukuphatha. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuphatha izinxaxhi, ukugxila kubantu, ukuxhumana ngomlomo kanye nokubhala.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuhambisana nokuphoqa. Phatha ukugcinwa kokuhambisana kanye nezinsiza zokuphoqa. Phatha futhi ulawule ukunikezwa kokuhambisana, ukugcina kanye nokuphoqa mayelana nesigaba samazwe ngaphezulu sokuphatha ubuhlahlambe bemvelo. Phatha ukuqashelwa kokunciphisa imiphumela emvelo ukukhuthaza intuthuko ezinzile kanye nendawo ephephile enempilo. Phatha ukukhuthaza intuthuko ezinzile yisizinga samaphuphi ngokukhuthaza umoya ohamba kahle kanye nokuphatha izinto ezinengculaza kanye nezinye izenzo ezihlobene. Phatha ukuqashelwa kwezindlela zokuphatha iziqhabo kanye namasistimu ezolwazi ngesiqhabo, nikela izimvume zesiqhabo, usekela uhulumeni wendawo ukunikeza izinsiza zokuphatha isiqhabo. kanye nokukhuthaza ukunciphiswa koesiqhabo eGauteng. Nikeza ukusekelwa ngokuphatha izinsiza zokuphatha imvelo. Gunyaza imiphakathi ukuphatha imithombo yemvelo ngokudalwa kwemisebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa amakhono kanye namathuba okwazisa. Qinisekisa futhi uphathe ukuhlanganiswa kwezinhloso-mthetho zemvelo, ukucwangciswa kanye nezinsiza zokuhlanganisa. Khuthaza ukugcinwa kanye nokusetshenziswa ngokuzinza kwezinhlobo-hlobo zebhayoloji yesifunda sithole inzuzo kanye nukwenza ngcono isizinga samaphuphi. Phatha futhi nikeze izinsiza zesayensi yebhayoloji. Nikeza ukusekelwa ngokuphatha izinsiza zokuphatha ibhayoloji. Qapha futhi uqinisekise isiyalo. Hlola ukusebenza kokuphatha. Hlanganisa futhi uphathe izabelomali kwisikhungo sokusekela abaphathi. Gunya, lawula futhi qapha izabelomali kanye nokuchithwa kwemali.

xh.title: iPhini leNkulumbuso: iNgqungquthela
xh.summary: Qhubeza iinkonzo zokuzithoba kumthetho nokuphumeza umthetho njengePhini leNkulumbuso eJohannesburg, kufuneka nemyalela yemfundo ephezulu kunye neminyaka yamawaka asibhozo yamava abaphathi abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: iMatric kunye nemyalelo yemfundo ephezulu (NQF level 8) kwisiXhosa sayensi/ iNqanaba lemfundo ye-NQF 8 kwi-Environmental Science/Management/Natural Science/Business Management/Administration evunyiwe yi-SAQA. 8 years relevant experience at a senior managerial level. Valid driver's licence. Ikhono: Ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela zolwenzeleko luesebe nangamagqabaza karhulumente. Ukuqonda iindlela ezizelelweyo zolawulo lolwenzeleko karhulumente, Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA, iTreasury Regulation, i-PSA, i-PSR, uquanano lwabasebenzi njl. Iindlela zokuxela, inkqubo yolwazi, uMgaqo-siseko waseNingizimu Afrika noMthetho woLinganiso lweNkqubo, 1998. Ukucohla nokulinganisa ulwazi, ukuqamba/ukugcina ulwazi, ukuthumela ulwazi, ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukulalela nokuqamba isisombululo, inqubo yokuzithatha, umanyano, ulawulo lweemali. Iimpawu: Uyalelwe, ungumntu oqalayo, unobulumko, unengqondo eqinileyo, uyazikhwebula usoloko unesikhokelo, uyakwazi ukutshintsha, unesigqibo, ungowoqinisekileyo, ungowamthothotho, uyandwendwela, ungowamkelekileyo, ungowamkele kwezimvo, ungowoqinisekileyo ngexabiso. Ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokuqeda umsebenzi ngexesha. Ikhono lokusebenza qhawe nangalondolozo. Ikhono elinzulu lokulawula. Ukusombulula iingxaki nokulawula iziphithiphithi, ukuzijahanela abantu, Unxibelelwano ngomlomo nangokubhalwa.
xh.duties: Lawula ukubonelela ngenkxaso yokuzithoba kumthetho nokuphumeza umthetho. Lawula ukuqapha ukuzithoba kumthetho nokuphumeza iinkonzo. Lawula nokuqhuba ukubonelela ngokuzithoba, ukuqapha nokuphumeza umthetho ngokumayela nomba wokulawula iindalo ye nkqubo. Lawula ukusebenzisa iindlela zokucutha ngcolmngcoliso ukuze nkquthaza iNqanaba eluhlaza nokusingqongileyo esezantsi. Lawula ukukhuthaza inkqubo ethengisa phantsi kolawulo lokusingqongileyo ngokuphucula ukusingqongileyo ngokwemeko yomoya nokulawula izinto ezazingcolisayo nenzalo ezingezeli. Lawula ukuphumeza iindlela zokulawula inkqubo yokwenza inkqubo ngenkxaso yolwazi, kukhuphe iindidi ezahlukeneyo zeemvume, ukuxhasa urhulumente wengingqi ukubonelela iinkonzo ezikwelinye. ukuyamekela ukunciphisa inkqubo kwindawo yokudlula kuxinzelelo. Yila inkxaso yolwenzelelo ngenkxaso yolwazi wolwenzeleko. Nikela abantu abayiinkxaso ngamakhono abo abathileyo ukuyamekela abantu abayiinkxaso. Qinisekisa nolawula ukudibanisa umgaqo-nxulumene nokuhlohlela nokudityaniselwa kweenkonzo. Khuthaza ukugcina ukuthengiswa kolwazi loluntu jikelele ukuxhasa ukuphucula okukhulu nangaphezulu kobomi. Lawula noku bonelela inkxaso yolwazi nge ndlela yemfundo. Nikela iinkxaso ezizelelweyo kwindlela yokulawula inkxabo yolwazi. Buka ukuze uqinisekise ukumanyana kwabasebenzi. Linganisa inkqubo yokulawula. Dibanisa ulawulo lweemali zendlu yolwazi yokwenza inkxaso yolwazi ezizelelweyo. Nikela, lawula ukwenza kwaye ulawule iimali zendlalelo namashishini.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer: Finance
jobs.salary_text: R1 554 696 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs)
jobs.closing_date_text: 24 August 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Chief Financial Officer position in the Department of Environment, Johannesburg, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification in Financial Management and five years of senior managerial experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) as recognised by SAQA in the field of Financial Management. A minimum of five (5) years relevant experience at a senior managerial level. CA qualification will be an added advantage. A valid driver’s licence. Competencies: Strategic Capacity and Leadership skills, People Management, Empowerment and Integrity, Financial Management, Change Management, Programme and project Management. Technical Competencies: Advanced financial and analytical skills and innovativeness. Adequate financial management and extensive knowledge of Supply Chain Management in the Public Service. Strong managerial and communication skills (written and verbal). Thorough knowledge of the Financial Prescripts of the Public Service and Supply Chain Management. Attributes: Good interpersonal relations. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Ability to work in a team and independently. Strong Management skills. Problem Solving and Analysis, Client Orientation and Customer Focus, Communication.
jobs.duties: Ensure effective compilation of accurate financial statements. Manage revenue efficiently and effectively by developing and implementing appropriate processes. Ensure that internal procedures and control measures are in place. Compile and accurate departmental annual budget, MTEF budget, and maintaining effective standard chart of accounts for the department. Provide value adding report to management and external stakeholders timeously. Monitor the operation of accounting systems, controls and procedures to ensure the integrity of financial information and administration. Monitor the provision of financial reporting processes and provide recommendations and advice to address significant variances. Ensure proper financial reporting requirements as required in terms of financial management legislation such as PFMA, Treasury Regulations, DORA etc. Provide and oversee the overall management and monitoring regarding supply chain compliance. Manage the provisioning of asset management services. Manage the provisioning of logistical and transport services. Manage and facilitate the demand, acquisition and contract management. Manage and conduct compliance Audit. Coordinate and facilitate forensic investigation. Facilitate the conducting of performance Audits. Provide support service to the internal Audit committee. Follow up on the Audits queries. Research and keep abreast of breast practice initiatives and developments within the directorate. Develop business/ strategic plan for the directorate and align it with the Chief Directorate and ensure implementation thereof. Oversee the development and implementation of operational plans for the chief directorate. Manage the development and coordination of service delivery improvement plan. Oversee and ensure provision of coaching, disciplining and mentoring of staff to improve performance. Manage the performance of staff and ensure assessment of their performance. Consolidate and manage of budget in the chief directorate. Authorise, control and monitor the budget and expenditure. Manage the compilation of various reports and statistics. Manage leave in the chief directorate.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za or send an email @ GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za quoting the relevant reference number applications must be submitted on the New Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents FOR ATTENTION : Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364– Recruitment
jobs.notes: Applications with the Old Z83 form will not be considered. A New Z83 form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed by the applicant. A recent, comprehensive CV, specifying all qualifications and experience, with respective dates must accompany the application form. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. After the pre-entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry- programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Hoof Finansiële Beampte: Finansies
af.summary: Hoof Finansiële Beampte-pos in die Department of Environment, Johannesburg, wat 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie in Finansiële Bestuur en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 12 plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) wat deur SAQA erken word op die gebied van Finansiële Bestuur. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se relevante ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak. 'n CA-kwalifikasie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Strategiese kapasiteit en leierskapsvaardighede, mensebestuur, bemagtiging en integriteit, finansiële bestuur, veranderingbestuur, program- en projekbestuur. Tegniese bevoegdhede: Gevorderde finansiële en analitiese vaardighede en vernuf. Toereikende finansiële bestuur en uitgebreide kennis van Supply Chain Management in die Public Service. Sterk bestuurs- en kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Deeglike kennis van die Financial Prescripts van die Public Service en Supply Chain Management. Eienskappe: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom. Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Sterk bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en ontleding, kliëntgerigtheid en klienfokus, kommunikasie.
af.duties: Verse doeltreffende opstel van akkurate finansiële state. Bestuur inkomste doeltreffend en effektief deur toepaslike prosesse te ontwikkel en te implementeer. Verseker dat interne prosedures en beheermaatreëls in plek is. Stel 'n akkurate departementele jaarlikse begroting, MTEF-begroting op en handhaaf 'n doeltreffende standaard rekeningkundige grafiek vir die departement. Verskaf waarde-toevoegende verslae betyds aan bestuur en eksterne belanghebbendes. Monitor die werking van rekeningkundige stelsels, kontroles en prosedures om die integriteit van finansiële inligting en administrasie te verseker. Monitor die voorsiening van finansiële verslagdoeningsprosesse en verskaf aanbevelings en advies om beduidende afwykings aan te spreek. Verseker behoorlike finansiële verslagdoeningsvereistes soos vereis ingevolge finansiële bestuurswetgewing soos PFMA, Treasury Regulations, DORA ens. Verskaf en hou toesig oor die algehele bestuur en monitering ten opsigte van voorsieningskettingnakoming. Bestuur die verskaffing van batesbestuursdienste. Bestuur die verskaffing van logistieke en vervoerdienste. Bestuur en fasiliteer die vraag, verkryging en kontrakbestuur. Bestuur en voer nakomingsoudit uit. Koördineer en fasiliteer forensiese ondersoeke. Fasiliteer die uitvoer van prestasie-ouditte. Verskaf ondersteuningsdienste aan die interne ouditkomitee. Volg ouditnavrae na. Doen navorsing en hou tred met beste praktyk-inisiatiewe en -ontwikkelings binne die direktoraat. Ontwikkel 'n besigheids-/strategiese plan vir die direktoraat en bely dit met die Hoofdirektoraat en verseker implementering daarvan. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling en implementering van operasionele planne vir die hoofdirektoraat. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en koördinering van die diensleweringsverbeteringsplan. Hou toesig oor en verseker die verskaffing van afrigting, dissiplinêre maatreëls en mentorskap van personeel om prestasie te verbeter. Bestuur die prestasie van personeel en verseker assessering van hul prestasie. Konsolideer en bestuur die begroting in die hoofdirektoraat. Magtig, beheer en monitor die begroting en besteding. Bestuur die opstel van verskeie verslae en statistieke. Bestuur verlof in die hoofdirektoraat.

zu.title: Umphathi Omkhulu Wezimali: Izimali
zu.summary: Isikhundla somphathi omkhulu wezimali kuMnyango Wezemingcelelayo, eJohannesburg, esifuna izifundo zegaqatshi le-NQF level 7 ekuqondeni kokuPhathwa Kwezimali futhi namaphunga amahlanu okuhlelelele emsebenzini ophakeme.
zu.requirements: I-Grade 12 kanye nesisindo sezigaba ngaphansi kwe-NQF level 7 esivunywa yi-SAQA emkhakheni Wokuqondisa Izimali. Umkhathi omncane weminyaka eyisihlanu (5) uhlelo lwemisebenzi ephakeme emkhakheni walapha. Izifundo ze-CA zibengezela isikhathi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono elikhulu: Ikhono lokubusa kanye nobuholo, ukulawula abantu, ukukhululeka kanye nokuzinza, ukulawula imali, ukulawula izinguquko, ukulawula amaprogramu kanye namaphrojekhi. Ikhono lobuchwepheshe: Ikhono elibucayi ekuqondiseni nasekuhlaziweni kanye nokuqamba okusha. Ukulawula imali kokuqondisa kanye nolwazi olwandisiwe lokulawula uhlelo lokuhlinzeka emasevisini abantu. Ikhono elikhulu lokubusa kanye nokuxhumana (elibhaliwe nokuqhuba). Ulwazi olubanzi lwemithetho yezimali yomnyango wezasebusisini kanye nohlelo lokuhlinzeka. Izici: Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwesigxobo kanye nokuqedela ngasikhathi sinye. Ikhono lokusebenza iqembu nangabanye. Ikhono elikhulu lokubusa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda, ukuzungezisa umthengi kanye nokuqwalasela umthengi, ukuxhumana.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukwakheka okusebenzayo kwezinkulumo zezimali ezinembile. Lawula imali engenayo ngokusebenzayo futhi ngokusebenzayo ngokwakha futhi usebenzise izinqubo ezifanele. Qinisekisa ukuthi kunezinqubo zangaphakathi kanye nezilinganiso zokulawula ezikhona. Hlela futhi uhlele imali yesikhathi esinganconyiwa ukuthi wasebenzisa imali kaMnyango ngonyaka, imali kaMTEF, kanye nokugcina uhlelo olusebenzayo lwezimali zeMnyango. Nikeza umbiko onesikhundla kuholo nakubantu abangaphandle ngokushesha. Hlola ukusebenza kwezinhlelo zokubala, izilawulo kanye nezinqubo ukuze kuqiniseke ukuqinisekwa kolwazi kanye nokuqondiswa kwemali. Hlola ukunikezwa kwezinqubo zokubika imali kanye nokunikela izincomo kanye nencekelo ngokuphathelene nezinguquko ezinkulu. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nezidingo zokubika imali njengoba kudingwa ngokuya ngemithetho yokulawula imali njengenge-PFMA, izimiso zeTreasury, i-DORA njll. Nikeza futhi ulawule ngokuphelele ukulawula kanye nokuqonda mayelana nokuhambisana kohlelo lokuhlinzeka. Lawula ukunikezwa kwezinsiza zokuphathaimpahla. Lawula ukunikezwa kwezinkonzo zokuhamba kanye zokuthutha. Lawula futhi wenze kakhulu ukufuna, ukuthola kanye nokuqondisa izinkulumo. Lawula futhi wenze isibheqaodunye sokuhambisana. Hlanganisa futhi wenze kakhonye ukuphenya ngaphandle kophando. Yenza kakhulu ukwenziwa kwesibheqaodunye samandla. Nikeza inkonzo yesekelo ekomidiyesibheqaodunye sangaphakathi. Landela izibuzo zesibheqaodunye. Phenya futhi ugcine ulwazi ngezinhlelo kanye nentuthuko eqondene nendawo yokusebenza. Hlela uhlelo lwebhizinimu/amasu endaweni yokusebenza futhi ulinganise nenhloko yendawo yokusebenza futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwayo. Lawula ukwakheka kanye nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zendawo enkulu yokusebenza. Lawula ukwakheka kanye nokuqondisisa kohlelo lokuthuthukisa inkonzo. Hlola futhi uqinisekise ukunikezwa kokuqeqesha, ukulawula kanye nokweseka abasebenzi ukuze kuthuthukise ukusebenza. Lawula ukusebenza abantu futhi uqinisekise ukuhlolwa kwemisebenzi yawo. Hlanganisa futhi ulawule imali endaweni enkulu yokusebenza. Vuma, lawula futhi uhlole imali kanye nezindleko. Lawula ukwakheka kwezinkulumozahlukene kanye nezibalo. Lawula ukukhishiwa kwabasebenzi endaweni enkulu yokusebenza.

xh.title: Noxhiba Mphezomthetho weziMali: eeMali
xh.summary: Isithuba sokuba nguNxhiba Mphezomthetho weziMali kwiSebe lezeNdalo, eJohannesburg, esifuna izifundo ezingangabo NQF level 7 kwiNqanaba lokuLawula imali kwaye sidziimfuno zeminye emihlanu (5) yamava obunkokeli abaphezulu.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seGrade 12 kunye neso sidangatya sobugcisa obungazelelwayo (NQF level 7) esamkelwa yi-SAQA kwinkundla yoLawulo lweziMali. Ubuncinane beminye emihlanu (5) yamava ahambelanayo kwinqanaba lobunkokeli obuphezulu. Isidanga se-CA kuya kuba ngomdla othileyo. Ilayisenisi yokushayela eyamkelekileyo. Iikhompetensi: Amandla okusebenza ngobuchule kunye namandla obunkokeli, uLawulo lwabantu, ukuzabusela nokuzinikela, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo olutsha, uLawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Iikhompetensi zobugcisa: Amandla aphezulu okuhlalutya imali nobuchule bokudala okutsha. Ukuqonda okwaneleyo ngokuLawula imali nolwazi olubanzi malunga nokuLawula uNjinela wokuNikezela kwiNkonzo kaZwelonke. Amandla amakhulu obunkokeli nokuThetha (okubhalisiweyo nokuthethwayo). Ukuqonda ngokupheleleyo ngokuLawulwa kweziMali eNkonzo kaZwelonke nokuLawulwa kukaNjinela wokuNikezela. Iimpawu: ubuhlobo obuhle nabantu. Amandla okusebenza ngocinezelo nokugqiba umsebenzi ngexesha. Amandla okusebenza kunye nothimba nokuzimela. Amandla amakhulu obunkokeli. Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuHlalutya, ukuQondiswa kumthengi nokuQwalasela umthengi,okuThetha.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuqulunqwa okusebenzayo kwezitatimende ezichanekileyo zeMali. Lawula imali engenayo ngokusebenziseko nangokuchanekileyo ngokusungula nokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Qinisekisa ukuba kuneendlela zangaphakathi nezilinganiso zolawulo. Qulunqa iNgqikithi yonyaka yesebe, iNgqikithi yeMali ye-MTEF, nokuqhuba uLawulo olusebenzayo lwekhadi elifanelekileyo le-akhawunti kwisebe. Yola ingxelo exabiso kubalulekileyo kunye nabanegalelo ngaphandle ngexesha. Qaphela ukusebenza kweenkqubo ze-akhawunti, izilawulo nendlela zokuqinisekisa ukuzinza kolwazi lweMali nolawulo. Qaphela ukunikelwa kweenkqubo zengxelo yemali kwaye unike iingcebiso kunye nengcebiso malunga nokuqhwesha okubalulekileyo. Qinisekisa izimfuno ezifanelekileyo ezimali zengxelo njengoko kufuneka ngokwemigaqo yokulawula imali efana ne-PFMA, iMigaqo yeQocha, i-DORA njl. Nikeze uqondise nolawulo olubanzi nokuqaphela ngokuhambelana kolawulo lokuLawulwa kwamaja. Lawula ukunikela ngezinkonzo zolawulo lwempahla. Lawula ukunikela ngezinkonzo zolawulo ngemali nokuhamba. Lawula kwaye uncede ekulawulweni kokufuna, nokuthengisa nokulawula iinkontrakthi. Lawula kwaye wenze uqondo lokuhambelana nokuLandelwa kweemigaqo. Hlela kwaye uncede kolwando lwezenzo ezifihlakeleyo. Yila iSicwangciso/ sokuQamba ulwandle qondise iNqanaba elawulayo kwaye ulungelelanise neNqanaba ePhakamileyo eLawulayo ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kwayo. Qaphela iNqanaba elawulayo ephezulu ekuyileni nokusebenziseni iinkqubo ezingamanqanaba asezantsi kule Nqanaba ephezulu eLawulayo. Lawula ukuyila nokulungelelanisa iSicwangciso sokuphucula iinkonzo eziselula. Qonda kwaye uqinisekise ukunikelwa kokulungelelisa, ukulawula ukuziphatha nokukhokela abasebenzi ukuze kuqhubeke kakuhle ukusebenza kwabo. Lawula ukusebenzela kwabasebenzi ukuze kqinisekiswe ukulinganisa ukusebenza kwabo. Qulunqa kwaye ulawule iNgqikithi yemali kwinQanaba eLawulayo ephezulu. Vumela, lawula kwaye uqaphele iNgqikithi yemali nokutshixa. Lawula ukuqulunqwa kweengxelo ezahlukeneyo nokuqulunqa inani. Lawula iNqanaba ephezulu eLawulayo elitsha.

af.title: Hoofdirekteur: Nakoming en Handhawing
af.summary: Hoofdirekteur word benodig om nakoming en handhawing by die Department of Environment in Johannesburg te lei, met 'n vereiste van vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring en 'n NQF vlak 7-kwalifikasie.
af.requirements: Matric plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie in Regte, Omgewingsreg, Natuurwetenskap of 'n relevante kwalifikasie (NQF vlak 7) binne die verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar relevante ervaring op 'n senior bestuursvlak binne die nakomings- en moniteringsektor. Ervaring in die veld van Omgewing. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van Omgewingsbestuur, Omgewing, Bestuursmagtigingsondersteuning, Regulasies vir die evaluering van omgewingsimpak, Omgewingsbestuurstelsels, Begrip van Omgewingsbestuursake in verhouding tot magtigings sowel as toepaslike wetlike vereistes en prosesse. Begrip van standaard administratiewe prosedures van die regering, Bewese Leierskap en Bestuur, Koördinasievaardighede, Organisatoriese en beplanning, Verhoudingsbestuur, Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, Program- en Projekbestuur, Finansiële Bestuur, Veranderingsbestuur. Kennisbestuur, Diensleweringinnoviasie (SDI Probleemoplossing en Analise, Mensebestuur en Bemagtiging, Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus, Innovatief en proaktief. Eienskappe: Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Vermoë om onder druk te werk en sperdatums na te kom. Vermoë om in 'n span en onafhanklik te werk. Sterk bestuursvaardighede. Probleemoplossing en Analise, Kliëntoriëntasie en Kliëntfokus, Kommunikasie.
af.duties: Bestuur en verskaf strategiese leierskap aan die Hoofdirektoraat en dra by tot die relevante programme en verantwoordelikhede binne die Hoofdirektoraat. Hou toesig oor die bestuur en verskaffing van reaktiewe nakomings- en handhawingsdienste. Hou toesig oor die verskaffing van nakomingsmoniterings- en handhawingsdienste. Bestuur en administreer die verskaffing van nakoming, monitering en handhawing met betrekking tot die Wet op nasionale omgewingsbestuur biodiversiteit. Verseker effektiewe bestuur van spanne en programme binne die departement wat nakoming met omgewingswetgewer oor die verskillende omgewingsektore moniteer en bevorder, insluitend afval en besoedeling, lugkwaliteit en biodiversiteitsbestuur. Moniteer en bevorder nakoming met die National Environmental Management Biodiversity Act (NEMBA) 2004 en ander verwante regulasies. Hou toesig oor hulpbronne (Menslik, Finansieel, Toerusting/Bates)

zu.title: Umholi Omkhulu: Ukuhambisana Nomthetho Nokuphoqelela
zu.summary: Kudingeka umholi omkhulu oholele ukuhambisana nomthetho nokuphoqelela kumnyango we Environment e Johannesburg, ofuna iminyaka emihlanu yokuhlolwa okuphezulu kokubhalisa kanye nesitifiketi se NQF level 7.
zu.requirements: Ukugqiba ibangamabhalo kanye nesitifiketi sabaphakathi endaweni yomthetho, umthetho wezemvelo, isayensi yemvelo noma isitifiketi esihambisana naleso (NQF level 7) endaweni ephathelene naleso njengoba singasemthethweni ngokomthetho we SAQA. Okungenani amaphuzu amahlanu (5) eminyaka yokuhlolwa okuhlobene nalokho ngokulinganisela okuphezulu kwindaweni yokubuka nokuhambisana nomthetho. Ukuhlola endaweni yemvelo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Izindinganiso: Ulwazi ngokulawula imvelo, imvelo, usekelo lokugunyaza ukulawula, imithethonqondo yokuhlolwa kokuqhathanisa kwemvelo, izindlela zokuphatha imvelo, ukuqonda izinkinga zokulawula imvelo eziphathelene nokugunyaza kanye nemithethonqondo kanye nezinqubo ezifanele. Ukuqonda izinqubo ezijwayelekile zokuphatha zahulumende, ukubusa kokuqinisekiswa nokulawula, amakhono ohlelweni, ukuhlela nokuhlanganisa, ukuphatha ubudlelwano, ukuthintana nabahlanganyeli, ukuphatha ohlelweni lwemisebenzi noluwo, ukulawula izimali, ukuphatha inguquko. Ukulawula ulwazi, intuthuko kokuletha izinsizakalo (SDI) ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuqonda kokuqhathanisa, ukuphatha abantu nokubakhulisa, ukugxila kumthengi, ukubakholelwa ngokuzenzakalela. Izimpawu: Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngocingo nokuhlangabezana namapheshana. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwethimba nangabanye. Amakhono aphezulu okubusa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza incazelo, ukuzinikela kumthengi, ukukhuluma.
zu.duties: Nika amandla ngokobuchwepheshe i Chief Directorate bese uthatha inxaxhele ezinhlelweni ezihlobene nemisebenzi ngaphakathi kwe Chief Directorate. Hlola ukulawula nokuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuqondisa okuhambisana nomthetho nokuphoqelela. Hlola ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo zokuqaphela ukuhambisana komthetho nokuphoqelela. Lawula futhi uhlele ukwaziswa ngokuhambisana, ukuqaphela nokuphoqelela ukuvikelwa kwe biodiversity act yezemvelo yesizwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngempumelelo kwamathimba amakhulu kanye nezinhlelo ngaphakathi komnyango oqapha futhi oqinisekisa ukuhambisana nomthetho kulo lonke ihhoveli elididene lezemvelo, okufaka phakathi ukulahlekelwa kwamasampula nentuthuko emikhulu yomoya kanye nezinhlela eziningi zokulawula imvelo Yenza isibonakaliso ngesigaba sokuthi izinhlelo ezinconyiwe zinhlelelwe ukwenziwa ngokushesha ekutheni kuba khona okunciphisa imithwalo emkhakheni wobugculisa ikhaya, i-airbnb kanye ne-sharing economy, futhi kufanele kube neshedi esilawulwa ikakhulukazi lapho kunemikhiqizo kanye namasevisi abathengi. Lawula futhi ukusebenziswa kwemithombo yokukhuluma. Hlola imithombo (abantu, izimali, amathuluzi/impahla).

xh.title: Chief Director: Compliance and Enforcement
xh.summary: Kufuneka iChief Director ukulawula ukuzalathiswa nokuphunza kwemigaqo kwiDepartment of Environment eJohannesburg, kufuneka kube neminyaka emihlanu yamavaqngamva kwinqanaba lesikhokela esiphakamileyo negunya lesidanga se-NQF level 7.
xh.requirements: I-Matric negunya lezidanga ezingaphantsi kwezidanga ezine degree kwiZaziso, iZaziso zeNdalo, iNzululwazi yeNdalo okanye isidanga esinxulumene nayo (NQF level 7) kwinkalo enxulumene nako njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamavaqngamva kwinqanaba lesikhokela esiphakamileyo kwinkalo yokuzalathiswa nokuqonda. Iqondo kwindalo. Ilicence yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono: Isaziso ngolawulo lweNdalo, iNdalo, inkxaso yegalwa lolawulo, iinqwelomgaqo zokuqonda ingcali yendalo, inkqubo yolawulo lwendalo, ukuqonda iingxaki zolawulo lwendalo kwinkcazelo yemigaqo nakuwo onke amagqabantshishi omthetho anokusetyenziswa neenkqubo. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zomgaqo wokurhangqa kahle karhulumente, uBukhokheli obuqinisekisiweyo noLawulo, amakhono eQhinga, uLuntu kunye noCwangciso, uLawulo loQuhinga, ukuZibandakanya koBuzisa, uLawulo lweNkqubo neeProjekthi, uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lokuTshintsha. Isaziso ngokuLawula inkonzo, iNnovasyon yokubonelela ngeNkonzo (i-SDI), ukuSombulula iingxaki nokwahlulahlula, uLawulo labaBantu nokuBakhuthaza, uQhagamshelwano namaxhoba nomxhasi, ukuQamba izinto ngendlela entsha nokuba mhlobokhule. Iimpawu: Ubudlelwane obuhle kumanabakhwelwa. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngantsimi kokuxinezeleka nokuzuza iinxelo zexesha. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza eqabini nokodwa. Amakhono oluLawulo olomephezulu. ukuSombulula iingxaki nokwahlulahlula, uQhagamshelwano namaxhoba nomxhasi, ukuThetha.
xh.duties: Nika izikhokelo eziyingqondo kwaye ulawule iChief Directorate, uze ungatele kwinkqubo nemisebenzi egqithiselwe kule Chief Directorate. Lawula ukulawulwa nokubonelela ngeenkonzo zokuzalathiswa nokuphunza kwemigaqo. Lawula ukubonelela ngeenkonzo zokuqonda ukuzalathiswa nokuphunza kwemigaqo. Lawula nokuqondisa ukubonelela ngokuzalathiswa, ukuqonda nokuphunza kwemigaqo ngokubhekisele kwakwa national environmental management biodiversity act. Qinisekisa ukulawulwa ngokusebenzayo kweqela lenkqubo kwisebe eliqondisa nokukhuthaza ukuzalathiswa kwemigaqo yendalo kwizinto ezahlukeneyo ezindalweni, kuquka iinkunkuma nengcoliso, umgangatho womoya, nolawulo lwezinto eziphilayo. Qonda ukuzalathiswa nokukhuthaza ukuzalathiswa kwakwa National Environmental Management Biodiversity Act (NEMBA) 2004 nakwezinye iinqwelomgaqo ezinxulumene nayo. Lawula izixhobo (Abantu, Eemali, Izixhobo/Iimpahla).

Ukuhumusha nokuhlaziya ulwazi, ukuhlela/ukugcina ulwazi, ukudlulisa ulwazi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukulalela nokuxoxisana, ububele nobungihambeli, isiyalwenzi, Ukuphatha Izimali.
