Izinhlobonhlobo ezinhle zobudlelwane nabantu. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphezulu kwesigqoto nokuhamba isikhathi esimisiwe. Ikono lokusebenza eqenjini futhi kunodwa. Amakhono amahle okubusa. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuphatha izimpixano, Oqondiswe kubantu, Ukuxhumana ngomlomo nokubhaliwe.
zu.duties: Qapha ukunikezwa kwamasevisi omthetho koMnyango. Phatha futhi uqaphele ukunikezwa kwesimanjemanje yokuxhumana nobuchwepheshe. Phatha futhi ulawule ukunikezwa kwamasevisi okuvikela nezempahla. Qinisekisa ukunikezwa kwamasevisi okuxhumana okusebenza kahle nangempumelelo, ukumaketha, ubudlelwano nabahlanganyeli kanye nokuphatha imicimbi yamasevisi. Nikeza inkombandlela ebujuqayo futhi uqapha ukuphatha kokuphathwa kokubusa abantu nokuqeqeshwa okubusa abantu. Lawula izinsiza zoMnyaka Kaqondile Omkhulu (abantu, izimali, izinto/izimpahla).

xh.title: Um lawuli wezaphulo: Iinkonzo zoLawulo lweShishini
xh.summary: Qonda iinkonzo zolawulo lweshishini eziquka izommthetho, i-ICT, ukhuseleko, iziseko zeemfunzo nolonwabo kwisebe lezeNdalo eJohannesburg.
xh.requirements: iMatric kunye nenqanaba lezifundo ezingaphantsi kwamabanga aphakamileyo (inqanaba le-NQF 7) kuLawulo lokuZenza kuRhulumente / uLawulo / uLawulo loBuntu / iNkqubo yeNgqondo yeMfundo okanye izifundo ezifanelekileyo njengoko zivunyiwe yi-SAQA. Amava amabalwa amathathu (5) eminyaka ubudala ngoweMisebenzi ohlwini oluphakamileyo oluphatha abantu kwindawo yolonwabo lwemisebenzi. Ilayisenisi yokushayela eseYinyani. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi ngeNkqubo nezithetho zeSebe nezinto ezibalulekileyo kuRhulumente, Ulwazi nokuqonda i-PFMA, iNkqubo yeNqgela yoManyano, i-PSA, i-PSR, iingxoxo zabasebenzi nabalawuli, iNkqubo yokubika, iNkqubo yolwazi, uMgaqo-siseko weSouth Africa noMthetho woLawulo ngokulingana koShishelwa,1998. Ingcathiswa nokuqondwa kolwazi ekuhlelweni, ulwazi ekukhululweni, ukululeka ulwazi kubantu, Ulwazi ngokusebenzisa ikhompyutha, nokuzamele ukupapa ulwazi, amandla okuziphatha, ukulawula inzondo, namandla okumela abantu, eNkqubo yokulawula imali. iimpawu: Umthetheleli ohlala enika ngolwazi, ogqamayo, enomsindo ophakathi, anolwazi olupheleleyo, ogqamayo ohambisa abantu, anganamthetho ophilileyo ongathanda ukushukuma, ongenanto nento angazenzayo, ongazenzisi, ongakwazi ukunika abantu into ebalulekileyo, onokuthembeka nokuhamba ixesha, ongazange aze angamntu othanda ukwenza into ngokutsha okungakabikho, ongazange aze abe nguMntu ongakwazi ukubala ngezinto ezenziwayo.
xh.duties: Qonda iinkonzo zamagqabantshintshi kwisebe. Lawula kuqonda iinkonzo zolwazi nge computer nge technology. Lawula uqonde iinkonzo zokhuseleko nendawo yokuhlala. Qinisekisa amandla okunikwa iinkonzo ezisebenzayo ngonqanaba eliphezulu, ukuthengiswa nokwenziwa kwezinto, kubantu abasebenza nomsebenzi wokuqonda isikhundla somsebenzi. Nikeza iNdlela yokumela abantu abambe iqhaza kubulela iinkonzo zokwakha iinkqubo, iindlela zokulawula iinkonzo, ukulawula iinkonzo ezibonelela ngamandla okwakha iinkqubo eziphakamileyo ekuqonden iinkqubo zokuphuhliswa komntu. Lawula amandla kwindawo iNkqubo ebalulekileyo ngomsebenzi, iMali, iNdawo nakwinkqubo.

jobs.title: Director: Risk Anti-corruption & Integrity Management
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs).
jobs.closing_date_text: 24 August 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Director of Risk, Anti-corruption and Integrity Management at the Department of Environment in Johannesburg, requiring an NQF level 7 qualification and five years of senior risk management experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus an undergraduate qualification (NQF level 7) in Risk Management or related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years relevant experience at middle or senior management level in Risk management environments. a valid driver’s licence. Competencies: Leadership, Management, Planning, Organizing, People management, Service Delivery, Communication, Decision Making, Problem solving, Report writing, Teamwork, Risk management, Customer management, Innovation/continuous improvement, Analytical, Negotiations, Computer literacy, Project management, Flexible. Knowledge of Departmental policies and procedures, Government Priorities, Risk management policies and frameworks, Reporting procedures, Information system, SA Constitution, Employment Equity Act,1998. Ability to Interpret & Evaluate Information, Verbal and written communication, Organizing/maintaining information, communicating information, Computer Literacy, Problem solving and conflict management, Listening and negotiation, Tact and diplomacy, Teamwork, Discipline, Financial Management. Business acumen, Team Leader, Strategist, Flexible/Change oriented, Problem-solving ability, Responsive, Interpersonal relations, Customer focus, Loyal and friendly, Open-minded, Responsible and accountable.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of enterprise risk management services. Conduct strategic risk assessment. Conduct operational risk assessment. Develop and review the risk management strategy. Coordinate monthly progress reporting against the risk register. Develop and monitor the organisational risk management plan. Ensure training of risk officials and risk committee members. Prepare monthly and quarterly reports for risk management committee. Develop and review organisational risk management policy. Manage the implementation, development and monitoring of business continuity plans. Establish BCP governance structures. Develop policies and standards related to disaster recovery. Ensure that business continuity plans are in place. Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements. Promote the implementation of code of conduct and ensure ethical environment. Develop, implement and maintain policies, procedures and systems. Identify risk and threats related to ethical environment. Conduct ethics and integrity awareness for the department. Promote financial disclosure system. Develop and maintain internal anti-corruption systems. Investigate all allegations of fraud and corruption received from internal and external persons. Conduct research on latest fraud and corruption legislation and develop educational programmes. Develop and implement fraud prevention ad anti-corruption strategies. Conduct fraud risk assessment. Develop and monitor the fraud prevention plan. Provide strategic direction for the directorate. Research and keep abreast of breast practice initiatives and developments within the directorate. Develop business/ strategic plan for the directorate and align it with Chief Directorate and ensure implementation thereof. Oversee the development and implementation of operational plans for the directorate. Develop and coordinate a service delivery improvement plan. Manage resources (Human/ Finance/Equipment/ Assets). Ensure proper implementation of budget by monitoring, projecting and reporting expenditure. Ensure proper spending in line with strategic objectives. Monitor the optimal utilization and functionality of equipment. Evaluate and monitor performance of employees to ensure achievement strategic goal. Manage the human resource development of employees in the directorate. Enhance and maintain employee motivation.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za or send an email @ GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za quoting the relevant reference number applications must be submitted on the New Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents FOR ATTENTION : Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364– Recruitment
jobs.notes: Applications with the Old Z83 form will not be considered. A New Z83 form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed by the applicant. A recent, comprehensive CV, specifying all qualifications and experience, with respective dates must accompany the application form. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. After the pre-entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry- programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Risiko-, Korrupsiebestryding- en Integriteitsbestuur
af.summary: Direkteur van Risiko-, Korrupsiebestryding- en Integriteitsbestuur by die Department of Environment in Johannesburg, wat 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se seniors risikobestuurervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Matric plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) in Risk Management of 'n verwante veld soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar relevante ervaring op middel- of seniorbestuursvlak in Risk management-omgewings. 'n geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Leierskap, Bestuur, Beplanning, Organisering, Personeelbestuur, Dienslewering, Kommunikasie, Besluitneming, Probleemoplossing, Verslagskrywing, Spanwerk, Risikobestuur, Kliëntebestuur, Innovasie/deurlopende verbetering, Analities, Onderhandelings, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Projektebestuur, Buigsaam. Kennis van departementele beleide en prosedures, Regeringsprioriteite, Risikobestuursbeleid en -raamwerke, Verslagdoeningsprosedures, Inligtingstelsel, SA Constitution, Employment Equity Act, 1998. Vermoë om inligting te interpreteer en te evalueer, Verbale en skriftelike kommunikasie, Organisering/onderhoud van inligting, kommunikasie van inligting, Rekenaarvaardigheid, Probleemoplossing en konflikbestuur, Luister en onderhandeling, Takt en diplomasie, Spanwerk, Dissipline, Finansiële bestuur. Besigheidsinsig, Spanleier, Strateeg, Buigsaam/Veranderingsgeoriënteerd, Probleemoplossingsvermoë, Responsief, Interpersoonlike verhoudings, Kliëntefokus, Loyaal en vriendelik, Oopkop, Verantwoordelik en aanspreeklik.
af.duties: Bestuur die verskaffing van ondernemingsrisikobestuursdienste. Voer strategiese risikobevalk uit. Voer operationele risikobevalk uit. Ontwikkel en hersien die risikobestuurstrategie. Koördineer maandelikse vorderingsverslae teen die risikoregister. Ontwikkel en monitor die organisatoriese risikobestuursplan. Verseker opleiding van risikoamptenare en risikokomiteelede. Berei maandelikse en kwartaalverslae vir die risikobestuurskomitee voor. Ontwikkel en hersien organisatoriese risikobestuursbeleid. Bestuur die implementering, ontwikkeling en monitering van besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne. Stel BCP-bestuursstrukture in. Ontwikkel beleide en standaarde rakende rampherstel. Verseker dat besigheidskontinuïteitsplanne in plek is. Verseker belyning met regulatoriese vereistes. Bevorder die implementering van die gedragskode en verseker 'n etiese omgewing. Ontwikkel, implementeer en onderhou beleide, prosedures en stelsels. Identifiseer risiko's en bedreigings rakende die etiese omgewing. Voer etiek- en integriteitsbewustheid vir die departement uit. Bevorder die finansiële openbaarmakingstelsel. Ontwikkel en onderhou interne korrupsiebestrydingstelsels. Ondersoek alle bewerings van bedrog en korrupsie wat van interne en externe persone ontvang word. Doen navorsing oor die jongste bedrog- en korrupsiewetgewing en ontwikkel opvoedkundige programme. Ontwikkel en implementeer bedrogvoorkoming- en korrupsiebestrydingstrategieë. Voer bedrogrisikobevalk uit. Ontwikkel en monitor die bedrogvoorkomingsplan. Verskaf strategiese rigting vir die direktoraat. Doen navorsing en bly op hoogte van bestepraktyk-inisiatiewe en -ontwikkelings binne die direktoraat. Ontwikkel 'n besigheids-/strategiese plan vir die direktoraat en bely dit met die Hoofdirektoraat en verseker implementering daarvan. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling en implementering van operationele planne vir die direktoraat. Ontwikkel en koördineer 'n diensleweringverbeteringsplan. Bestuur hulpbronne (Menslik/Finansies/Toerusting/Bates). Verseker behoorlike implementering van begroting deur uitgawes te monitor, te projekteer en daaroor te rapporteer. Verseker behoorlike besteding in ooreenstemming met strategiese doelwitte. Monitor die optimale benutting en funksionaliteit van toerusting. Evalueer en monitor prestasie van werknemers om bereiking van strategiese doelwitte te verseker. Bestuur die menslike hulpbronontwikkeling van werknemers in die direktoraat. Verbeter en onderhou werknemersmotivering.

zu.title: Umlawuli: Ukuphathwa kwe-Risk, ukulwa nokhothama kanye nokuphathwa kokuQinisekisa
zu.summary: Umlawuli we-Risk, ukulwa nokhothama kanye nokuphathwa kokuQinisekisa e-Department of Environment e-Johannesburg, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yempihlamvu yokuphathwa kwe-Risk ephakeme.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye neziqu ezingezansi ze-undergraduate (NQF level 7) ku-Risk Management noma endaweni ehlobene njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. Okungeyona okuncane eminyakeni engu-5 yempihlamvu ehlobene ezingeni lokuphathwa laphakathi noma eliphezulu kumimepezulu yokuphathwa kwe-Risk. ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono: Ukubusa, ukuphatha, ukuletha iso, ukuhlela, ukuphatha abantu, ukuhanjiswa kwenkonzo, ukuxhumana, ukwenza izinqumo, ukuxazulula izinkinga, ukubhala imibiko, ukusebenza njengeqembu, ukuphathwa kwe-Risk, ukuphathwa abathengi, intuthuko/ukuthuthuka ngokungengamuki, ukuhlaziya, izinkulumo eziyisixaxa, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuphatha imiklamo, ukuguquguquka. Ulwazi lwemigomo kanye namayilisa womnyango, izinhloso kahulumeni, imigomo nezinhlelo zokuphathwa kwe-Risk, amayilisa okubika, uhlelo lwolwazi, uMthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika, uMthetho we-Employment Equity,1998. Ikono lokuhumusha nokuhlaziya ulwazi, ukuxhumana ngokulalelana nokubhaliwe, ukuhlela/ukugcina ulwazi, ukwazisa ulwazi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye nokuphatha izinkinga, ukulalela kanye nokuququmba, ubuhlakani nokuziphatha kahle, ukusebenza njengeqembu, isithunzi, ukuphatha imali. Ukuzwisisa ibhizinisi, ukuba ngumholi weqembu, umhleli wezinhlelo, ukuguquguquka/ukujwayela inguquko, ikono lokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphendula, izinkampani zomuntu ngamunye, ukugxila kubathengi, ukuzithoba nobungani, ukuba nosuku oluvulekile, ukubekezela kanye nokuba nesibopho.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuhanjiswa kwamasevisi we-enterprise risk management. Yenza ukuhlola okujulile kwe-Risk. Yenza ukuhlola kokusebenza kwe-Risk. Hlaba futhi uhlaziye inqubo yokuphathwa kwe-Risk. Hlelela ukubika inkaso yenyanga ngokumelene nesibalo se-Risk. Hlaba futhi ulawule iplani yokuphathwa kwe-Risk yenhlangano. Qinisekisa ukuthunjwa kwabaphathi be-Risk kanye namalungu ekomidi le-Risk. Lukela imibiko yenyanga nanye futhi yeminyaka emithathu ekomidini yokuphathwa kwe-Risk. Hlaba futhi uhlaziye imigomo yokuphathwa kwe-Risk yenhlangano. Phatha ukuphunywa, ukuthuthukiswa kanye nokuqaphelwa kwezinhlelo zoqhubo kabuhlungu. Sela izakhiwo zokuqondisa i-BCP. Hlaba imigomo kanye namazinga ahlobene nokubuyisa ngemuva kwezinsizi. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zoqhubo kabuhlungu zikulungele. Qinisekisa ukuhambisana nezidingo zomthetho. Khuthaza ukuphunywa kwemigomo yokuqhuba futhi qinisekisa imvezelo yomothetho. Hlaba, phuma futhi gcina imigomo, amayilisa kanye nezinhlelo. Hlukanisa i-Risk kanye nosoyingo ohlobene nemvezelo yomothetho. Yenga ulwazi ngokuziphatha okuhle kanye nokuqinisekisa kumnyango. Khuthaza uhlelo lokwaziswa ngezimali. Hlaba futhi ugcize izinhlelo zangaphakathi zokulwa nokhothama. Phenya wonke amaphupho ezidakamizwa kanye nokhothama atholwe kubantu banganaphandle nangaphakathi. Yenza ucwaningo ngemithetho yakamuva yesidakamizwa kanye nokhothama futhi uhlele izinhlelo zemfundo. Hlaba futhi uphume izinhlelo zokuthintelwa kwesidakamizwa kanye nezinhlela zokulwa nokhothama. Yenza ukuhlola kwe-Risk yesidakamizwa. Hlaba futhi ulawule iplani yokuthintelwa kwesidakamizwa. Nikeza isiqondiso esijulile kwe-directorate. Cwaninga futhi uhlale ulandela izinhlelo kanye nentuthuko ezinhlelweni ezinhle ngaphakathi kwe-directorate. Hlaba iplani ye-bhizinisi/yezinhlelo ze-directorate futhi uyihambisane ne-Chief Directorate futhi uqinisekise ukuphunywa kwayo. Qapha ukuthuthukiswa nokuphunywa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza kwe-directorate. Hlaba futhi uhlelele iplani yokuphucula ukuhanjiswa kwenkonzo. Phatha imithombo (Abantu/Imali/Izinto/Impahla). Qinisekisa ukuphunywa okululekile kwesabelomali ngokuqapha, ukubhala ngaphambili kanye nokubika ukusetshenziswa kwemali. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okululekile ngokuhambisana nezinhloso eziphakeme. Qapha ukusetshenziswa okuhle kanye nokusebenza kwezinto. Hlola futhi uqaphe ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukufeza izinhloso eziphakeme. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwemithombo yabantu abasebenzini kwe-directorate. Phezulu phezulu futhi gcina ukugqugquzela kwabasebenzi.

xh.title: Umongameli: Ulawulo lwengozi, Okuchasene nokurhweba ngokungaziphathi kakuhle & Ulawulo lokuziphathisa
xh.summary: Umongameli woLawulo lwengozi, Okuchasene nokurhweba ngokungaziphathi kakuhle nokuLawula ukuziphathisa kwisebe lezeNdalo eJohannesburg, kufuneka abe nelayisensi yemfundiso enqanaba le-NQF level 7 aneminyaka emihlanu yamava ohlelo lolawulo lwengozi esigqithini.
xh.requirements: I-Matric ngakumbi nelayisensi yemfundiso ezingangeni (NQF level 7) kuLawulo lwengozi okunabala oqhagamshelwayo njengokuvunyiwe yi-SAQA. Ukuqala kweminyaka esi-5 yamava ahambelanayo kwinqanaba lolawulo lwaphakathi okanye labaphezulu kwindawo zoLawulo lwengozi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Ikhono: uQondiswe, uLawulo, uCwangciso, ukuQumba, uLawulo lwabantu, ukuNikela inkonzo, uThethathethwano, ukuThatha izigqibo, ukuSombulula iingxaki, ukuBala iingxelo, ukuSebenza njengeqela, uLawulo lwengozi, uLawulo labathengi, uQhakamshelwano/ukuphucula ngokuqhubekayo, uQwalaselo, ukuNxibelelwana, ukuGqabhuka ekusebenzeni ikhompyutha, uLawulo lomsebenzi, ukuTshintsha. ulwazi ngemigaqo nendlela zokusebenza zesebe, iinjongo zaRhulumente, imigaqo namakhuwo oLawulo lwengozi, iinkqubo zokubala iingxelo, inkqubo yolwazi, uMgaqo-siseko waseMzantsi Afrika, uMthetho woLinganiso lweQabane lomSebenzi, 1998. Ikhono lokutolika nokuqwalasela ulwazi, ukunxibelelana ngokuthetha nokubhala, ukuqumba/ugcine ulwazi, ukusasaza ulwazi, uGqabhuka ekusebenziseni ikhompyutha, ukuSombulula iingxaki nokuLawula iingxabano, ukumamela nokunxibelelwana, inzondo nokuNgathana, ukuSebenza njengeqela, iNqindi, uLawulo lweMali. Isazimagama sayiNzuzo, uQhagamsheli weqela, uMchaqi, ukuTshintsha/ukujolise kutshintsho, ikhono losombululo lweengxaki, ukuPhendula, uNxibelelwano phakathi kwabantu, ukujolisa kubathengi, ukuThemba nokuhlonela, ukuMzimba opheleleyo, ukuThembeka nokuNxiba kakuhle.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunikwa iinkonzo zoLawulo lwengozi lshishini. Yenza iQwalaselo loLawulo lwengozi ngokomgama. Yenza iQwalaselo loLawulo lwengozi ngokwemisebenzi. Yaphula uze ucocise umgama woLawulo lwengozi. Lungelanisa iingxelo zentcheko znyanga zonke ezichasene nosalathiso lweengozi. Yaphula uze ulawule icebo loLawulo lwengozi lshishini. Qinisekisa ukugqibelelwa kweekhosi zabaphathi beengozi namalungu ekomiti yeengozi. Lungelelanisa iingxelo znyanga nentsimbi znyanga ezintathu zekomiti yeLawulo lwengozi. Yaphula uze ucocise umgaqo weLawulo lwengozi lshishini. Lawula ukusebenziswa, ukuphuhlisa nokuqwalasela amacebo obomi obuqhamile obhizinisi. Siseka iinkqubo zolawulo ze-BCP. Yaphula imigaqo namazinga ahambelana nokuBuyiswa koluhlu. Qinisekisa ukuba amacebo obomi obuqhamile obhizinisi akho. Qinisekisa uqwalaselo nemfuneko zomthetho. Khuthaza ukusebenziswa komgaqo wokuziphatha uze uqinisekise indawo ethe rhoqo. Yaphula, usebenzise zigqibe iimigaqo, iinkqubo nentsnqo. Jonga iingozi nemiqubo ehambelana nendawo ethe rhoqo. Yenza iQhalaselo lokuziphathisa nokuhlonelwa kwisebe. Khuthaza inkqubo yokutyhila ngeemali. Yaphula uze ulawule iinkqubo zangaphakathi zokuchasana nokurhweba ngokungaziphathi kakuhle. Phenya zonke iingxabano zokurhweba ngokungaziphathi kakuhle ezivela kubantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle. Yenza uphando ngomthetho omtsha wokurhweba ngokungaziphathi kakuhle uze uphuhlise iinkqubo zemfundo. Yaphula uze usebenzise amagama wokuthintela okurhweba ngokungaziphathi kakuhle nokuQwalaselo loLawulo lwengozi. Yenza iQwalaselo loLawulo lwengozi. Yaphula uze ulawule icebo lokuthintela okurhweba ngokungaziphathi kakuhle. Nikela ngesiqendu ngomgama wolawulo. Yenza uphando uze ugcine ulwazi ngokuqaliswa kolwazi nokuphuhliswa kwexesha. Yaphula icebo lobhizinisi/ ngokomgama wolawulo uze ulinganise neQela loQondiso uze uqinisekise ukusetyenziswa kwalo. Qwalasela ukuphuhlisa nokusebenzisa amacebo ngokwemisebenzi yolawulo. Yaphula uze ulungelelanise icebo lokuphucula ukunikelwa kweenkonzo. Lawula izixhobo (Abantu/ iMali/ Izixhobo/ Iimpahla). Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwebhajeti ngokuqwalasela, ukuchaza nokubala iingxelo zentlawulo. Qinisekisa ukuchithwa kwemali ngokomgama onjengamagama obunaka. Qwalasela ukusebenziswa ngokufanelekileyo nokusebenza kwezixhobo. Qwalasela uze ulawule ukusebenza kwebasebenzi ukuze uqinisekise ukufikelela kumgama onjengamagama. Lawula ukuphuhlisa abantu abasebenzelayo kulawulo. Phucula uze ulawule inkuthazo yabasebenzi.

jobs.title: Director: Information Communication Technology
jobs.salary_text: R1 317 384 per annum, (all-inclusive salary package which can be structured according to the individual’s needs).
jobs.closing_date_text: 24 August 2026. Applications received after the closing date will not be considered.
jobs.summary: Director of ICT at the Department of Environment in Johannesburg, requiring an NQF Level 7 ICT qualification and five years of senior management experience.
jobs.requirements: Matric plus undergraduate (NQF Level 7) in ICT / Information Communication Technology / Computer Science / or a relevant ICT-related field as recognised by SAQA. A minimum of 5 years relevant experience at middle or senior management level in ICT management environment. Valid driver’s license. Competencies: Knowledge, understanding and implementation of the Department of Public Services DPSA) State Information Technology Agency (SITA) Act, Information Technology Governance Framework, Internal and External Audits, ICT Risk Management, ICT strategy development, Operational plans Implementation and general administration duties, practices as well as the ability to capture data, operate computer and collecting statistics. Managerial Competencies: Visionary leadership, change management, planning and organising, financial management, people management and development, project management, service delivery innovation. Generic Competencies: Business acumen, customer management, results/quality management, analytical thinking, decision making, innovation and creativity. Technical Competencies: Knowledge of System Development Life Cycle, ICT security management, project management, risk management, database design and administration (SQL, MySQL), data center operations, software development tools, networking principles, IT governance frameworks (COBIT, ITIL, ISO), business analysis, disaster recovery, data analytics and integration solutions. Skills: ICT Regulations and standards (COBIT, ITIL, ISO etc. Business Analysis, Innovative development technologies, DBMS technologies, Project management skills, Information and data Security. Risk assessment and mitigation, Disaster recovery technologies.
jobs.duties: Manage the provision of infrastructure and operational support services. Manage the provision of desktop support services to the Department. Manage the provision of support and maintenance of the servers. Manage the provision of support and maintenance of all the networks. Manage the provision of support and coordination of departmental telecommunication services (telephony, video conferencing etc.). Manage innovative business solutions, development and implementation. Manage the automation and digitization of information and business processes. Manage ICT projects. Manage the provision of reliable, secured, quality information and data analytics through integration of business solutions. Develop and ensure implementation, maintenance, training and provide support business applications. Manage and implement ICT governance and policy frameworks. Provide ICT service management and manage ICT projects. Develop and ensure implementation of ICT policy and ICT security. Develop and facilitate the implementation of IT policies. Ensure ICT continuity and ICT change management. Manage acquisition and management of ICT solutions (Software, Hardware and Goods & Services). Manage ICT service desk 4. Provide strategic direction for the Directorate. Research and keep abreast of the best practice initiatives and developments within the directorate. Develop business/ strategic plan for the directorate and align it with Chief Directorate and ensure implementation thereof. Oversee the development and implementation of operational plans for the directorate. Develop and coordinate a service delivery improvement plan. Manage resources (Human, Financial, Assets). Manage and ensure proper implementation of budget by monitoring, projection and reporting of expenditure. Consolidate budget and ensure proper spending in line with strategic objectives. Ensure optimal utilization and functionality of equipment/ assets. Evaluate and monitor performance of employees to ensure achievement of Directorate strategic goal. Manage the development of employees in the directorate. Enhance and maintain employee motivation.
jobs.enquiries: Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364
jobs.applications: To apply for the below positions, please submit your application online at http://professionaljobcentre.gpg.gov.za or send an email @ GDENVrecruitment@gauteng.gov.za quoting the relevant reference number applications must be submitted on the New Z83 form obtainable from any Public Service Department or on the internet at www.gov.za/documents FOR ATTENTION : Ms. Iris Thanjekwayo at 072 788 2364– Recruitment
jobs.notes: Applications with the Old Z83 form will not be considered. A New Z83 form must be fully completed, duly signed and initialed by the applicant. A recent, comprehensive CV, specifying all qualifications and experience, with respective dates must accompany the application form. Applicants are not required to submit copies of qualifications and other relevant documents on application. Only shortlisted candidates will be required to submit certified copies of qualifications obtained and other related documents on or before the day of the interview, following communication from Human Resources and will be subjected to verification by the South African Qualifications Authority. Candidates in possession of a foreign qualification must also provide an evaluation certificate issued by the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA), at own expense. Failure to submit the requested documents will result in the application not being considered further. Due to the anticipated large volume of responses, correspondence will be limited to shortlisted candidates only. All shortlisted candidates shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other will be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. After the pre-entry assessments, an oral interview will be conducted. Suitable candidates will be subjected to personnel suitability checks (criminal record, citizenship, credit record checks, qualification verification and employment verification). By responding to the advertisement, applicants consent to the collection, processing and storing of their Personal Information in accordance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA) Act No. 4 of 2013. Candidates will therefore be required to give consent in terms of the POPI Act in order for the Department to conduct the verifications. Information will be used for the purpose of recruitment only and more specifically for the purpose of the position/vacancy you have applied for and will not be shared with third parties without prior consent, unless required by law. All applicants must declare any conflict or perceived conflict of interest and must disclose membership on Boards and directorships associated with. If you have not been contacted within six (6) months of the closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. The submitted CVs will be destroyed as legislated in the National Archives Act. In the event that your application is unsuccessful, the Department will retain your personal information only for audit purposes as required by policies. All the information requested now or during the process is required for recruitment purposes. Failure to provide the requested information will result in your application not being considered further. The Department reserves the right not to make an appointment to the advertised post(s). The successful candidate must disclose particulars of all registrable financial interests and sign an employment contract within one month from the date of assumption of duty. A Performance Agreement must be concluded and signed within three months from the date of assumption of duty. Notes for applicants of SMS posts: Successful completion of the Nyukela Public Service SMS Pre-entry Programme as endorsed by the National School of Government, available as an online course on https://thensg.gov.za/trainingcourse/sms-pre-entry- programme/, prior to the finalisation of the appointment, is a requirement for all SMS positions. All shortlisted candidates for SMS posts will be subjected to a technical exercise and interview. Following the technical exercise and interview, a maximum of three (3) SMS candidates will undergo psychometric assessments to assess cognitive capabilities, behavioural preferences, emotional intelligence, and integrity. MANAGEMENT ECHELON

af.title: Direkteur: Inligtingkommunikasietegnologie

af.requirements: Matriek plus voorgraadse (NQF Level 7) in IK / Information Communication Technology / Rekenaarwetenskap / of 'n tersaaklike IK-verwante veld soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van 5 jaar tersaaklike ervaring op middle- of seniorbestuursvlak in 'n IK-bestuursomgewing. Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Generiese bevoegdhede: Besigheidsinisiatief, kliëntebestuur, resultate/kwaliteitsbestuur, analitiese denke, besluitneming, innovasie en kreatiwiteit. Vaardighede: IK-regulasies en -standaarde (COBIT, ITIL, ISO ens. Besigheidsontleding, innoverende ontwikkelingstegnologieë, DBMS-tegnologieë, projekbestuursvaardighede, inligting- en datasekuriteit. Risiko-assessering en -versagting, ramphersteltegnologieë.
af.duties: Bestuur die voorsiening van infrastruktuur en operasionele ondersteuningsdienste. Bestuur die voorsiening van lessenaarondersteuningsdienste aan die departement. Bestuur die voorsiening van ondersteuning en instandhouding van die bedieners. Bestuur die voorsiening van ondersteuning en instandhouding van al die netwerke. Bestuur die voorsiening van ondersteuning en koördinering van departementele telekommunikasiedienste (telefonie, videokonferensie ens.). Bestuur innoverende besigheidsoplossings, ontwikkeling en implementering. Bestuur die outomatisering en digitalisering van inligting en besigheidsprosesse. Bestuur IK-projekte. Bestuur die voorsiening van betroubare, beveiligde, gehalte-inligting en data-analise deur integrasie van besigheidsoplossings. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering, instandhouding, opleiding en verskaf ondersteuning van besigheidstoepassings. Bestuur en implementeer IK-bestuurs- en beleidsraamwerke. Verskaf IK-diensbestuur en bestuur IK-projekte. Ontwikkel en verseker implementering van IK-beleid en IK-sekuriteit. Ontwikkel en fasiliteer die implementering van IT-beleid. Verseker IK-kontinuïteit en IK-veranderingsbestuur. Bestuur verkryging en bestuur van IK-oplossings (Sagteware, Hardeware en Goedere & Dienste). Bestuur IK-diensskakel 4. Verskaf strategiese rigting vir die Direktoraat. Doen navorsing en hou tredy met die beste praktyk-inisiatiewe en ontwikkelinge binne die direktoraat. Ontwikkel 'n besigheids-/strategiese plan vir die direktoraat en belyn dit met die Hoofdirektoraat en verseker implementering daarvan. Hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling en implementering van operasionele planne vir die direktoraat. Ontwikkel en koördineer 'n diensleweringverbeteringsplan. Bestuur hulpbronne (Menslike, Finansiële, Bate). Bestuur en verseker behoorlike implementering van begroting deur monitering, projeksie en verslagdoening van uitgawes. Konsolideer begroting en verseker behoorlike besteding in ooreenstemming met strategiese doelwitte. Verseker optimale benutting en funksionaliteit van toerusting/bates. Evalueer en monitor prestasie van werknemers om bereiking van die Direktoraat se strategiese doelwit te verseker. Bestuur die ontwikkeling van werknemers in die direktoraat. Versterk en handhaaf werknemersmotivering.

zu.title: Umphathi: I-Information Communication Technology
zu.summary: Umphathi we-ICT e-Department of Environment e-Johannesburg, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF Level 7 kwi-ICT kanye neminyaka emihlanu yeziphiwo eziphezulu ezinhlotsheni zabaphathi.
zu.requirements: I-Matric kanye neziqu ezingaphansi kwesiqu (NQF Level 7) ku-ICT / Information Communication Technology / Computer Science / noma ngephandle elihlobene ne-ICTh njengoba kuhlotshanisiwe yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyaka emi-5 yamava ohlelele njengabaphathi abaphakathi noma abaphezulu kumazinga okuphatha imisebenzi ye-ICT. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Izindlela: Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa umthetho we-Department of Public Services (DPSA) State Information Technology Agency (SITA), Inqubo yokuphathwa kwe-Information Technology, I-Internal and External Audits, ukuphathwa kwezingozi ze-ICT, ukuthuthukiswa kwakho njongo ye-ICT, ukuqashelwa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi kanye nemisebenzi yonke, kanye namandla okubhala ulwazi, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqoqa izibalo. Izindlela zokuphatha: Ukuba nobuso bokuhola, ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuhlela nokuqamba, ukuphathwa kwezimali, ukuphathwa nentuthuko yabantu, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi, kanye nenovelshi yohlinzeko lwezinsizakalo. Izindlela eziyisisekelo: I-Business acumen, ukuphathwa kwakho onikelayo, ukuphathwa kweziphumo/ikhalithi, ukucabanga okuhlukaniswe, ukwenza izinqumo, inoveshi nokudala. Izindlela zobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi lwe-System Development Life Cycle, ukuphathwa kokuqinisekiswa kwe-ICT, ukuphathwa kwephrojekthi, ukuphathwa kwezingozi, ukwakhiwa nokuphathwa kwe-database (SQL, MySQL), imisebenzi ye-data center, amathuluzi okuthuthukiswa kwe-software, izimiso zoxhumano, inqubo yokuphathwa kwe-IT (COBIT, ITIL, ISO), ukuhlaziywa kwebhizinisi, ukubuyiselwa esimweni kwezenzakalo, ukuhlaziya ulwazi kanye nezixazululi zokuhlanganisa. Amakhono: I-ICT Regulations and standards (COBIT, ITIL, ISO etc. Business Analysis, Innovative development technologies, DBMS technologies, Project management skills, Information and data Security. Risk assessment and mitigation, Disaster recovery technologies.
zu.duties: Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsiza ezingaphakathi nezinsizakalo zokusebenza. Phatha ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zokwesekwa kwedeskithophu e-Department. Phatha ukunikezwa kwesekelo nolondolozo lwezixazululi. Phatha ukunikezwa kwesekelo nolondolozo lwazo zonke izinxulumo. Phatha ukunikezwa kokesekelo nokuqoqiswa kwezinsizakalo zobuchwepheshe bokuxhumana bomnyango (ukukhuluma eceleni, inqwaba yomfanekiso njll.). Phatha izixazululi eziyinoveshi zebhizinisi, ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa. Phatha ukuzenzakalela kanye nokwenziwa yimali ulwazi nezinqubo zebhizinisi. Phatha amaphrojekthi e-ICT. Phatha ukunikezwa kolwazi oluthembekile, oluvikelekile, kanye nekhwalithi kanye nokuhlaziya idetha ngokuhlanganisa izixazululi zebhizinisi. Thuthukisa futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa, ukulondolozwa, ukufundiswa nokweseka izinhlelo zokusebenza zebhizinisi. Phatha futhi usebenzise inqubo yokuphathwa nemiyaqo ye-ICT. Nikeza ukuphathwa kwezinsizakalo ze-ICT futhi upheethe amaphrojekthi e-ICT. Thuthukisa futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwemiyaqo ye-ICT nokuqinisekiswa kwe-ICT. Thuthukisa futhi usize ekusetshenzisweni kwemiyaqo ye-IT. Qinisekisa ukuba khona nokuphathwa koshintsho kwe-ICT. Phatha ukutholwa nokuphathwa kwezixazululi ze-ICT (i-Software, i-Hardware kanye ne-Goods & Services). Phatha i-ICT service desk 4. Nikeza isiqondiso esibonakalayo i-Directorate. Cwaninga futhi uhlale ulandela izinhlelo ezinhle zemikhuba kanye nentuthuko ngaphakathi kwedirectorate. Thuthukisa i-business/ strategic plan yedirectorate futhi uyihambisanishe ne-Chief Directorate uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa kwayo. Qapha ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zomsebenzi zedirectorate. Thuthukisa futhi uhlanganise isinqubo sokuthuthukisa ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo. Phatha izinsiza (abantu, izimali, impahla). Phatha futhi uqinisekise ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwebhajethi ngokuqapha, ukubona ngaphambili nokubika ukuchithwa kwezimali. Hlanganisa ibhajethi futhi uqinisekise ukuchithwa okuhle ngokuhambisana nezinhloso ezibukhayo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle nokusebenza kwempahla. Hlola futhi uqaphe ukusebenza kwabasebenzi ukuze uqinisekise ukufeza kohlobo olubukhayo lwedirectorate. Phatha ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi kudirectorate. Khulisa futhi zigcine inkuthazo yabasebenzi.

xh.requirements: Imatriki kunye nesidanga esingaphantsi (NQF Level 7) kwi-ICT / Information Communication Technology / Computer Science / okanye indawo ephathelene ne-ICT njengokuqatyaniswa yi-SAQA. Iminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu yamava ahambelanayo kwinqanaba labaphathi abaphakathi okanye abaphezulu kwindawo yolawulo le-ICT. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni. Iikhompetensi: Ulwazi, ukuqonda nokusebenzisa iAkthi yesebe leZicwangciso zoLuntu (DPSA) yeState Information Technology Agency (SITA), isiSakhezo soLawulo lwesikhokelo seTheknoloji yolwazi, uKwangqinisiso lokwangaphakathi nangaphandle, uLawulo loBungozi be-ICT, uPhuhliso lwezicwangciso ze-ICT, ukuSetyenziswa kwezicwangciso ezenzwayo kunye nemisebenzi yemiba yolawulo jikelele, iindlela zokwenza njengokunokulungiselela ukuthatha idatha, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nokuqokelela izibalo. Iikhompetensi zoLawulo: uBukhosi bembono, uLawulo lwenguquko, ukuCwangcisa nokuhlela, uLawulo lwemali, uLawulo nophuhliso babantu, uLawulo lweephrojekthi, intshukumo yokuNika iinkonzo. Iikhompetensi eZiqhelekileyo: ukuQonda kwishishini, uLawulo babathengi, uLawulo lemiphumela/ikhwalithi, ukucinga ngokuhlalutya, ukuThatha iigqibo, intshukumo nokudalwa okutsha. Iikhompetensi zeThekniki: Ulwazi ngokuPhuhliswa kweSistim yeBomi, uLawulo lokhuseleko le-ICT, uLawulo lweephrojekthi, uLawulo lobungozi, ukuyila nokuLawula isiseko sedatha (SQL, MySQL), imisebenzi yenkqubo yedatha, izixhobo zokuphuhlisa isoftwe, iinkqubo zokudibanisa amanethiwekhi, iisakhezo_solawulo se-IT (COBIT, ITIL, ISO), ukuHlalutya ishishini, ukubuyela emva kokubakho isohlwayo, ukuHlalutya idatha nezisombululo zokudibanisa. Amandla: iNgqiqavu nezingaMgangatho ze-ICT (COBIT, ITIL, ISO njl. ukuHlalutya iShishini, iTheknoloji yophuhliso olutsha, iTheknoloji ye-DBMS, amandla oLawulo lweephrojekthi, uKhuseleko lwolwazi nedatha. uNikingo nobuncin bobungozi, iTheknoloji yokubuyela emva kokubakho isohlwayo.
xh.duties: Lawula ukunika iinfrastructure kunye neenkonzo zokuxhasa ezenzwayo. Lawula ukunika iinkonzo zokuxhasa idesktop kwisebe. Lawula ukunika inkxaso nolondolozo lweseva. Lawula ukunika inkxaso nolondolozo lwamanethiwekhi onke. Lawula ukunika inkxaso nolungelelwaniso lweenkonzo zokunxibelelwana zesebe (ucingo, inxibelelwana ngevidiyo njl.). Lawula izisombululo ezitsha zeshishini, uphuhliso nokusebenzisa. Lawula ukuzenzakalisela nokuYenzwa ngokutsha kolwazi neenkqubo zoshishino. Lawula iiphrojekthi ze-ICT. Lawula ukunika ulwazi oluthembekileyo, olukhuselekileyo, olulinganisiweyo nokuHlalutya idatha ngokudibanisa izisombululo zoshishino. Phuhlisa ukuqinisekisa ukusebenzisa, ulondolozo, uqeqesho nokunikela inkxaso kwiinkqubo zoshishino. Lawula ukuze ukuqinisekisa ukusebenzisa iisakhezo neengqinqibo zoLawulo lwe-ICT. Nikeza uLawulo lweenkonzo ze-ICT uze ulawule iiphrojekthi ze-ICT. Phuhlisa ukuqinisekisa ukusebenzisa iNgqinqibo ye-ICT nolKhuseleko lwe-ICT. Phuhlisa uze ulungelelanise ukusebenziswa kweeNgqinqibo ze-IT. Qinisekisa ukusuka kabuhle nokuqhubeka kwe-ICT ukuqheleko lwe-ICT. Lawula ukuthengwa nokuLawulwa kwezisombululo ze-ICT (isoftwe, iHardiwe kunye neZinto & neeNkonzo). Lawula i-desk yeenkonzo ze-ICT 4. Nikeza isalathiso esibalulekileyo kwiDirektorethi. Cosa uphando uze uhlale ulwazi ngentshukumo ezilungele iindlela ezilungileyo nophuhliso ngaphakathi kwidirektorethi. Phuhlisa isicwangciso soshishino/ esibalulekileyo sedirektorethi ulisebenze nesiDirektorethi Enikulu ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa kwaso. Qhatha ubomi bokuPhuhlisa nokusebenzisa iCwangciso ezenzwayo zedirektorethi. Phuhlisa uze ulungelelanise isicwangciso sokuNgcwaliseka kweNkonzo. Lawula izixhobo (Abantu, imali, iziXhobo). Lawula ukuqinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okulungileyo kwebhajeti ngokuqaphela, ukubeka ngaphambili nokuvelisa inkcazelo yokuchithwa. Dibanisa ibhajeti ukuqinisekisa ukuchithwa okulungileyo ngokwemigangatho ebalulekileyo. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okulungileyo nokusebenza kwezixhobo/izixhobo. Hlalanisa ukuqaphela ukuze uqinisekise ukufezwa kwemigangatho ebalulekileyo yeDirektorethi. Lawula uphuhliso labasebenzi kwidirektorethi. Phucula uze ulondoloze ukuzimisela kwabasebenzi.

af.title: Direkteur: Kommunikasie
af.summary: Direkteur van Kommunikasie by die Department of Environment in Johannesburg, wat 'n NQF level 7-kwalifikasie en vyf jaar se senior bestuurservaring in kommunikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Matric plus 'n voorgraadse kwalifikasie (NQF level 7) in Kommunikasie/ Publieke Betrekkinge/ Mediakakivering/Joernalistiek soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se relevante ervaring op middel- of seniorbestuursvlak in 'n kommunikasie-omgewing. Geldige bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede: Kennis van GPG-beleide en prosedures, relevante wetgewing en Public Service Regulations, begrip van kliënte se verwagtinge, kennis van kontrakte, bestuursinligting, projekbestuursmetodes, beleidsontwikkeling en veranderingbestuur. Kennis en begrip van finansiële bestuur, projekbestuur. Beplanning en organiseringsvaardighede, proaktief en vindingryk. Kenmerke: Innoverend, spanspeler en buigsaam, kliëntegerig, gehaltegerig, kostubewus, invloedryk, strategies, voorleggingsvaardighede, kommunikasievaardighede, analitiese vaardighede, leierskapsvaardighede en verslagskryfvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur die ontwikkeling, implementering en uitvoering van die departement se geïntegreerde kommunikasiestrategie, wat interne en eksterne kommunikasie, media- en sosiale media-betrokkenheid, belanghebbende betrekkinge, geleenthede en digitale platforms behels, insluitend die departement se internet en intranet. Bestuur interdepartementele en interregeringsplatforms om belynde, samehangende en impakvolle kommunikasie te verseker. Bestuur die departement se mediakakikeringsfunksie en wyer media-ekosisteem. Lei inhoudstrategie, skepping en redaksionele toesig oor alle kommunikasieplatforms. Bestuur die ontwikkeling en implementering van belanghebbende-betrokkenheidstrategieë, beleide en prosedures en hou toesig oor die beplanning en lewering van departementele veldtogte, geleenthede, uitstallings en aktiverings. Bestuur die departement se redaksionele, publikasie- en inhoudprogramme, insluitend die koördinering en produksie van statutêre en korporatiewe publikasies. Bestuur mediakakikering en moniteringsdienste. Hou toesig oor inhoudverspreiding oor tradisionele, digitale en sosiale media-platforms, asook goewerneurskap. zu.title: Umcondzisi: Izexwayiso
zu.summary: Umcondzisi wezexwayiso eMnyangweni weZenhlalakahle eGoli, ofuna iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kanye neminyaka emihlanu yemisiphi emkhulu yokuphatheka kwezexwayiso.
zu.requirements: Imatikulethe kanye nesiqu esingezansi semfundo (NQF level 7) kwezexwayiso ubudlelwano nabantu abaphakathi kanye nabezindaba njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani eminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yemisiphi ehambisana naleso sikhundla esibekiwe kwezexwayiso. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ikhono: Ulwazi lwezenqubomgomo nendlela zokwenza ze-GPG, umthetho ohambisana nalokhu kanye Nemithetho Yomsebenzi Kahulumeni, ukuqonda okulindelwe abathengi, ulwazi lwezinkontileka, ulwazi lolawulo, izindlela zokuphatha imiklamo, ukuthuthukiswa kwezenqubomgomo nokuphatha inguquko. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukuphatha Izimali, ukuphatha imiklamo. Ukubeka izinhloso, ukuba nobuhlakani bokuziqondisa izinsiza. Iziphawu: Ukuba nomqondo omutsha, ukuzwana neminye imiphakathi nokuguquguquka, ukuqondwa ngabathengi, ukubeka izinga eliphakeme, ukuqaphela izindleko, ukuba negalelo, ukubeka izinhloso ezinombono, amakhono abuveza imibono, amakhono axwayiso, amakhono okuhlaziya, amakhono okuhola amakhono okubhala imibiko.
zu.duties: Ukuphatha ukuthuthukiswa, ukusetshenziswa nokwenziwa kwenqubomgomo exhushunywe yomnyango yesexwayiso, ehlanganisa izexwayiso zangaphakathi nangaphandle, ukuqhathaniswa nabezindaba nabezindaba kudijithali, ubudlelwano nabathintekayo, imikhosi, kanye namaphulatifomu wamadijithali, kuhlanganise nainthanethi nainthanethi yangaphakathi komnyango. Uphathe amaphulatifomu avela kumnyango naphakathi kwahulumene ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izexwayiso zihambisana, zicoke kanye nokuqinisekisa ukuba nomthelela. Uphathe imisebenzi yokuqhathaniswa nabezindaba kanye nokuqamba imikhuba yabezindaba emikhulu. Ukuthi isinqamuli samakhono ekubhalweni nokuqamba okuwumqondisi kuzo zonke izinkundla zokukhulumisana. Uphathe ukuthuthukiswa nokusetshenziswa kwezenqubomgomo zokuqhathaniswa nabathintekayo, izinqubomgomo nendlela zokwenza nokubuka ukubekwa kwezinhloso nokulethwa kwemikhankaso yomnyango, imikhosi, imibukiso kanye nemikhosi yokususa izinto. Uphathe amakholomu, okushicilelwayo kanye nemiklamo okubhalwayo, kuhlanganise nokuhlelwa nokukhiqizwa kwayo eyimithetho nasezinkompanini okushicilelwayo. Uphathe ukuqhathaniswa nabezindaba kanye nokuhlola imisebenzi. Ubuke ukusatshaliswa kwesiqu kumaphulatifomu abalezindaba asendlelini yamagama, kanye nalawo omdijitha nabezindaba basendlelini yamakhuni ngokudijithali kanye nokuphathwa kwayo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa kahle kwesabelo ngokuqapha, ukubuka kwezimali kanye nokushicilela izimali ezichithiwe. Uphathe izinsiza (Abantu/Izimali/Amathuluzi/Izimpahla).

xh.title: Umlawuli: Iziqhoboshi
xh.summary: Umlawuli weziqhoboshi kwisebe lezeNgingqi eJohannesburg, lifuna ifom yeNQF level 7 namava eminyaka emihlanu yolawulo oluphezulu kummandla weziqhoboshi.
xh.requirements: iMatric ngakunye nesidanga se-undergraduate (NQF level 7) kwiZiqhoboshi/Ubudlelwane nodwendwe lwemaxabiso/Unxibelelwano namakhusi abaPhathwa/iJournalism njengoko kusiqondwa nguSAQA. A minimum of five (5) years' relevant experience in middle or senior management level in communications environment. Isilawuli esisebenzayo sekendera. Ikhono nolwazi: Ulwazi ngeenkqubo neengqungquthela zeGPG, umthetho ofaneleyo neZicwangciso zoLawulo lwaMasebenzi kaRhulumente, ukuqonda okulindwe ngamaxhasi, ulwazi ngeziSivumelwano, iNkcazelo yolawulo lweenkcukacha, iindlela zolawulo lweiprojekthi, ukuqamba iinkqubo nolawulo lotshintsho. Ulwazi nokuqonda uLawulo lweMali, uLawulo lweeprojekthi. Uqwalaselo nokuqulunqa, usetyenziso lokuziqhelanisa nendalo. Iimpawu: Uyiroqo, Umdlali wetim kwaye uyakwazi ukuzidudlisa, Uqwalaselwa ngamaxhasi, Uqwalaselwa ngokwemigaqo, unobuqhetseba kwixabiso, uncamhleli, ngokomchaso, amakhono aboniso, amakhono oluncedo, amakhono oqondo, amakhono obuqukuqulu kunye namakhono okubhala iingxelo.
xh.duties: Lawula ukuqamba, ukusebenzisa nokuqhutywa kwenkqubo ebandakanyekelayo yeziziqhoboshi kwisebe, equka unxibelelwano lwangaphakathi nangaphandle, unxibelelwano namakhusi nolunxibelelwano kumakhompyutha abantu ngabanye, ubudlelwane namaphu, kwaye nemiba ezinxulumene nayo nakumaplatifomu e-dijithali, kuquka nainthanethi nainthanethi yangaphakathi kwesebe. Lawula amaplatifomu phakathi kweendawo ngokwahlukileyo nasemaphu kwindawo yolawulo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuzinza, ukuvumelana nokunika isiphum esinamandla kwingxoxo yeziziqhoboshi. Lawula inkqubo yoluxabano namakhusi kwesebe, kwanabakho kwe-ekosisimam ekunxulumene namakhusi. Qhobosa iqondo lokuyila imixholo, ukuqamba ulawulo lwamaxwebhu kunye nokuqwalasela uluhlu phakathi kwazo zonke iinkqubo zolwazi/ezentlalo. Lawula ukuqulunqa nokusebenzisa amanqaku okunxibelelwano namaphu, iinkqubo kunye neengqungquthela, kwaye ulawule uqwalaselo lokuqulunqa nokuphuhliswa kweenkqubo nolwazi loLuntu, amava, nemiso yamasiko. Lawula uqeqesho kunye nokuqulunqa nolwazi olutsha noludala ngokwethutyana, neemveliso ezithile; ulawule ulungelelwaniso lomsebenzi wokuzimela nokuvelisa iinkqubo ezichanekileyo kwicandelo ngalinye. Lawula uxhaxha lweemeko ekunxibelelwaneni namakhusi, nolawulo lweemeko zenkqubo ukuze zisebenze kakuhle ngakumbi kwandothi yemibuzo ekulindwa iphendule. Qhobosa ukuphuhliswa kolwazi nolunxibelelwano, oluqukwe phantsi kolwazi olubhalwe phantsi kolwazi olubhalwe phantsi kolwazi neendawo ezikhoyo. Lawula inkqubo yokulawula nemfihlo yokubeka iinkqubo kumda wokuqina kolawulo ngokulawula, ukusuka kumaxesha amnyama kunye noqeqesho. Lawula izixhobo eziwuwo (Abantu/Imali/Izixhobo/izinto ezikhuselweyo/izidengekile).

A minimum of 3 years’ junior management experience in Enterprise Development in the manufacturing space or Industrial Development project. A valid driver’s License. Attributes such as Competence, Vision, Integrity, Transparency, Respect, Honesty & trustworthy, Team-player, as well as Commitment.

Ilayisensi yokuqhuba esemthethweni. Amakhono, uqeqesho Namandla okusebenza: Umphathi ofanelekileyo kufuneka abe nolwazi oluqinisekileyo ngamachain exabiso eManufacturing, iinkqubo zolawulo ezintsha zezeNkonzo kaRhulumente, i-National Industrial Policy Framework, i-National Development Plan, i-Integrated Action Plan, ii-Economic Development Plans, i-Provincial Growth & Development Strategy, i-National R&D and Innovation Strategy, i-Industrial Policy Action Plan, i-National & Provincial Economic Transformation Policies and Strategies nakanjalo i-Black Industrial Policy ne-Enterprise Development nokutolika nokuhlalutywa kolwazi ngezoqoqosho. Ulwazi oluhle neluqonde ngokwesoNkonzo soLawulo, umzekelo, i-Public Service Act, i-PFMA, iMgaqo-siseko weRephabliki yaseMzantsi Afrika, i-Public Service Act, i-Public Service Regulations, i-Public Finance Management Act, i-Labour Relations Act, i-Basic Conditions of Employment Act, iinkqubo zoKunikezela ngeNkonzo (iBatho Pele Principles), i-Employee Performance Management System, i-Skills Development Act, i-Promotion of Access to Information Act, i-National Development Plan, i-Promotion of Administrative Justice Act, i-Project Management Principle. Amakhono anjengophando, uqeqesho lwezinto, unxibelelwano ngemilevale nangokubhalwa (ubugqi kwi-isiZulu & English), ukuqamba amacebiso nokubakamshanqw'abathunyelwano, amandla okuncokola nabantu kuzo zonke iinqanaba, ulawulo lwexesha, ubudlelwane obunamahluko, ulawulo lwezixhobo, ukudweba ibhizinisi, ukubhala iingxelo namakhono okubonisa, ulawulo lweyure nezimali, ulawulo labathunyelwano, ingqondo ehlalutyayo nokuqamba izinto, ukusombulula iingxaki, ukukhokela nolawulo labantu nakanjalo ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha. Iimpawu ezinjengokuba mandla, ukubona, integriti, ukuchaza, inhlonipho, inyanisekileyo nokuthembekileyo, ukuzibamba njengomdlali kwindawo ethile, nakanjalo ukuqina kwengqondo.
xh.duties: Kwenze kube lula ukusebenzisa i-KZN Black Industrial Framework; kwenze kube lula amaphakathi anegalelo e-KZN Black Industrialist; Kwenze kube lula ukufikelela kwiimarike nakuqoqosho kubo bonke aba-KZN Black Industrialists; Phepha uze usebenzise iinkqubo zomthetho, iindlela, iinkqubo, neenkqubo ezinxulumene neNkqubo yeBlack Industrialist; Lawula abantu nemicimbi yemali yenkundla e-Sub- directorate.

jobs.title: Pharmacist Grade 1, 2&3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R882 816 – R936 987 per annum, Plus Rural Allowance appropriate qualification and registration with Pharmacist. Grade 2: R954 339 – R1 011 516 per annum, Plus Rural Allowance = 12% Appropriate qualification and registration with SAPC as Pharmacist plus 5 years’ experience as a pharmacist Grade 3: R1 041 402 - R1 104 669 per annum, Plus Rural Allowance Appropriate qualification and registration with SAPC as Pharmacist plus 13 years’ experience as a pharmacist All-inclusive salary package: 70% and 30% flexible portion can be restructure
jobs.summary: Pharmacist positions at Niemeyer Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal requiring SAPC registration to manage medicine distribution and pharmaceutical services.
jobs.requirements: STD 10 or grade12 Certificate Appropriate qualification and registration with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as a Pharmacist. Persons in possession of a foreign qualification must furnish the Department with an evaluation certificate from the South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (only when shortlisted). Current registration as a Pharmacist with the SAPC. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Require: Knowledge of pharmacy information, relevant Government legislative and Department of Health Policies and procedures. Computer literate, management skills. Sound knowledge of District health system. Leadership skills. Interpersonal skills.
jobs.duties: Manage and control distribution of medicine for inpatients, outpatients and clinics. Monitor and evaluate the provision of quality pharmaceutical services including CCMDD. Manage financial resources by maintaining accurate and appropriate records, statistics and information as required by management complying with applicable legislation and regulatory policies. Manage human resource through supervision and support of staff by delegating, empowering, planning and execution. Provide appropriate and adequate counselling to patients ensuring optimal pharmaco-therapeutic outcomes. Have a sound control of stack management with high accuracy/ responsibility and accountability to PFMA and the allocated budget. Have a sound knowledge of the six domains; public health, safe and rational use of medicines and devices and their supply, organisation and management skills, professional and personal practice, critical analysis and research.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. VB Dlamini Tel No: (034) 331 3011
jobs.applications: Please forward applications quoting reference number to: Human Resource Management, Niemeyer Memorial Hospital, Private Bag X1004, Utrecht, 2980 or email: Niemeyer.Intern@kznhealth.gov.za

af.title: Apotheker Graad 1, 2&3
af.summary: Apothekerposte by Niemeyer Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal wat SAPC-registrasie vereis om medisyneverspreiding en farmaseutiese dienste te bestuur.
af.requirements: STD 10 of grade12 Sertifikaat Toepaslike kwalifikasie en registrasie by die South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as 'n Apoteker. Persone wat oor 'n buitelandse kwalifikasie beskik, moet die Department voorsien van 'n evaluasiesertifikaat van die South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (slegs wanneer vir 'n onderhoud gekies is). Huidige registrasie as 'n Apoteker by die SAPC. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van apteekinligting, relevante Regeringswetgewing en Department of Health Beleide en prosedures. Rekenaargeletterd, bestuursvaardighede. Deeglike kennis van die distriksgesondheidstelsel. Leierskapsvaardighede. Tussense verhoudingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en beheer die verspreiding van medisyne vir pasiënte in die hospitaal, buitepasiënte en klinieke. Monitor en evalueer die voorsiening van gehalte farmaseutiese dienste, insluitend CCMDD. Bestuur finansiële bronne deur die byhou van akkurate en toepaslike rekords, statistieke en inligting soos deur bestuur vereis, in ooreenstemming met toepaslike wetgewing en regulatiewe beleide. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne deur toezig en ondersteuning van personeel deur delegering, bemagtiging, beplanning en uitvoering. Verskaf toepaslike en voldoende voorligting aan pasiënte om optimale farmako-terapeutiese uitkomste te verseker. Handhaaf deeglike beheer van voorraadbestuur met hoë akkuraatheid/verantwoordelikheid en aanspreeklikheid teenoor PFMA en die toegewysde begroting. Oor 'n deeglike kennis beskik van die ses domeine: openbare gesondheid, veilige en rasionele gebruik van medisyne en toestelle en die verskaffing daarvan, organisasie en bestuursvaardighede, professionele en persoonlike praktyk, kritiese ontleding en navorsing.

zu.title: Ithibhishi Lokuthenga Amakhemikhali Ezinga 1, 2&3
zu.summary: Izikhundla zamathibhishi okuthenga amakhemikhali esibhedlela iNiemeyer Memorial KwaZulu-Natal esidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SAPC ukuphatha ukusatshaliswa kwemithi nezinsizakalo zamakhemikhali.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-STD 10 noma ibanga 12. Ithuba elifanele kanye nokubhaliswa kwi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengenthibhishi lokuthenga amakhemikhali. Abantu abanamathuba okufundela abavela emazwe angaphandle kumele bahunikeze umnyango isitifikedi sokuhlola esivela ku-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (kuphela uma kubekwe ohlwini abancintisana). Ukubhaliswa njengamanje njengenthibhishi lokuthenga amakhemikhali kwi-SAPC. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Adingekayo: Ulwazi ngesikhululo selwazi lokuthengisa, umthetho kahulumeni ofanelekayo kanye nomthetho-sisekelo weZinqubomgomo kanye nezinqubo zeNyuvesi yeSempilo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, amakhono okuphatha. Ulwazi olunjengolwazi oluhle mayelana nesistimu yezempilo yomasipala. Amakhono okuqonda. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu.
zu.duties: Phatha kanye nokulawula ukusatshaliswa kwemithi yabagula abangenwe esibhedlela, abaphuma esibhedlela namakhliniki. Qaphela futhi uhlole ukunikezwa kwezinsizakalo zamakhemikhali ezingeni eliphezulu kuhlanganise i-CCMDD. Phatha izinsizakalo zemali ngokugcina ukushicilelwa okuhlakaniphile kwayo ngokuzenzele, izibalo nolwazi njengoba kudingwa ukuphathwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho osebenzayo kanye namapholisi okulawula. Phatha abantu abakhulumu ngokuqondisa kwaye useke abasebenzi ukwenzela ukuba bangeniswe ngesikhathi bakhuthazwe, behlelwe besebenze. Nikela ngeluleko elifanele nelanele kubagula kuqinisekisa imiphumela evela ekuthengiselwa imithi nokuqoqwa kwamakhono. Melwe ube nokulawula okuhle kwesibophiwo sokulondoloba ngekhondo eliphezulu/ enesibopho kwaye uthathe inxaxheba ngokwemithetho we-PFMA kanye nomthethosibili onikeziwe. Mela ulwazi oluhle ngezinkomba eziyisithupha; izimpilo zomphakathi, ukusetshenziswa okuphephile kwayo ngokuzwakalayo kwemithi namadayivayisi kanye nokusatshalaliswa kwazo, amakhono okuhlela kwaye aphathe, izinkambiso zobungcweti nobuntu bukaumuntu, ukuhlaziya ngokubalulekile kwaye uphenye.

xh.title: Umchiza-warhwele Inqanaba 1, 2&3
xh.summary: Izithuba zabachizi-warhwele eNiemeyer Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal ezifuna ukubhaliswa kwiSAPC ukulawula ukusasazwa kwezithi neenkonzo zamachiza.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSTD 10 okanye umgangatho wesi-12. Ifanelekileyo nangobunikelo bokubhalisa kwikomitye yamachiza yaseMzantsi Afrika (SAPC) njengomchiza-warhwele. Abantu abanamava afanelekileyo abavela kwamanye amazwe kufuneka babonelele iSebe nesatifikethi esiboniswa ngamava abo esivela kuSouth African Qualifications Authority (SAQA) (kuphela xa kubakho abagqatswa). Ubhaliso lwangoku njengomchiza-warhwele kwiSAPC. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namAmandla aFunekayo: Ulwazi ngolwazi lwamachiza, umthetho kaRhuluto olufanelekileyo kunye namacebo kunye neendlela zesebe lezeempilo. Ukuba nedyweso yekhompyutha, amakhono olawulo. Ulwazi oluxabisekileyo lwesixokelelwano sezempilo sommandla. Amakhono okuba ngumkhokeli. Amakhono okusebenza nabantu.
xh.duties: Qondisa nilawule ukusasazwa kwezithi kwabaguli abaselwayo, ababuyela ekhaya nakwiikliniki. Lilandle nilinganisela ukubonelelwa kweenkonzo zamachiza zobuchwepheshe ezikumgangatho ophezulu eziquka iCCMDD. Lawula izixhobo zemali ngokugcina amagama, izibalo nenkcazelo ezichanekileyo nezifanelekileyo njengoko kufunwa ngabaphathi ngokuthobela umthetho osebenzayo namagunya abalawulo. Lawula izixhobo zabantu ngokulawula kunye nokuxhasa abasebenzi ngokwabelana, ukunika amandla, ukuqamba iindlela nokuphumeza. Bonelela ngengcebiso efanelekileyo nayanele kubaguli kuqinisekisa iziphumo ezihle zamachiza nokwelapha.iba nokulawula okusemzantsi kokugcina izinto ngenkathalo echanekileyo/ ngenxibelelwano nobuxanduva kuPFMA nakwembali elinganisiweyo. Uba nolwazi oluxabisekileyo kwii-domeyini ezintandathu; impilo yoluntu, ukusebenzisa ngokhuselekileyo nangokuchanekileyo amachiza namacebo okunyanga nokubonelelwa kwawo, amakhono e-organaysasi nolawulo, ulwazi lomsebenzi wabantu nolwazi lwakho, ukuhlalutya ngokujingayo nophando.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing (PHC)
jobs.salary_text: R785 568 – R898 215 per annum. Other benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), 8% Rural Allowance and Housing allowance: Prescribed requirements to be met.
jobs.summary: Manage clinical operations and coordinate nursing care at Dannhauser CHC, overseeing casualty, Mother and Child, and mobile health services.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1 Experience: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years’ experience in PHC after obtaining a 1-year qualification in Primary Health Care. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognizable experience at managerial level under PHC. Grade 12 (Senior Certificate). Degree/Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery. Registration with SANC as a General Nurse. PHC Certificate endorsed by SANC. A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years’ experience in PHC after obtaining a 1-year qualification in Primary Health Care. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognizable experience at managerial level under PHC. Driver’s license. Diploma in Nursing Administration. ICRM programme will be added as an advantage. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required for the post: Knowledge of Nursing care processes and procedures, Nursing Acts, Health Act, Nurses Pledge, Patient’s-Right charter, Batho Pele principles etc. Nursing statutes and relevant legal framework. Knowledge and understanding of legislative framework governing the public services. Knowledge of HR, Finance, Skills development, Labour Relations, Public Service. PHC Guidelines and other prescripts. Conflict, change and people management and decision-making skills. Writing reports and time management, leadership and supervisory skills.
jobs.duties: Manage minor and acute, casualty, HAST, Mother and Child, Mobile services and satellite clinics. Delegate, supervise and coordinate the provisioning of effective and efficient patient care through adequate nursing care. Participate in the implementation of the nursing plan, clinical audits, QIP’s and its implementation for quality care. Participate in the formulation of nursing standards, protocols, sops, policies and ensure implementation through monitoring and evaluation. Ensure that practice in nursing is in accordance with laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Manage and monitor HR and Finance in all relevant clinical areas. Facilitate implementation of ICRM and OHSC monitor process and maintain status and compliance. Facilitate and oversee the development of Nursing Operational plan in the relevant clinical areas and satellite clinics. Monitor and ensure data collection and adherence to Data Management Principles. Coordinate and engage Sukuma Sakhe promoting activities/ events within the community. Facilitate and monitor implementation of PHC re-engineering. Monitor implementation of clinical governance in the units and satellite clinics. Provide guidance and leadership towards the realization of strategic goals and objectives. Delegate, supervise and coordinate the provision of effective, efficient quality of care. Establish, maintain and participate in inter-professional and multi-disciplinary teamwork that promotes Health Care. Provide strategic leadership in delivery of integration DHS based on relevant policy imperatives. Reduce burden of diseases by implementing the integrated multi stakeholder HEALTH promotion well-being strategy (IMHPWS) fully in your subdistrict and implementation of health program and service package within the subdistrict. Ensure effective, efficient and economical management of allocated resources- HRM, HRD, Budget, Transport, Equipment etc. within the subdistrict. Monitor and evaluate the PHC activities. Management of Records, Data performance information within the subdistrict.

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde (PHC)
af.summary: Bestuur kliniese bedrywighede en koördineer verpleegsorg by Dannhauser CHC, met toesig oor ongevalle-, Moeder-en-Kind- en mobiele gesondheidsdienste.
af.requirements: Graad 1 Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 6 jaar ervaring in PHC na die behaal van 'n 1-jarige kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Ten minste 3 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet gepaste/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak binne PHC wees. Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat). Graad/Diploma in Algemene Verpleging en Vroedkunde. Registrasie by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige. PHC-sertifikaat deur SANC geëndosseer. 'n Minimum van 10 jaar gepaste/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging.
