Ten minste 3 jaar van bogenoemde tydperk moet gepaste/erkenbare ervaring op bestuursvlak binne PHC wees. Bestuurderslisensie. Diploma in Verplegingsadministrasie. ICRM-program sal as 'n voordeel bygevoeg word. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis vir die pos: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, Verpleegwetwese, Gesondheidswet, Verpleegkundigesbelofte, Pasienteregte-handves, Batho Pele-beginsels ens. Verpleegstatute en die relevante regsraamwerk. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat openbare dienste regeer. Kennis van HR, Finansies, Vaardigheidsontwikkeling, Arbeidsverhoudinge, Openbare Diens. PHC-riglyne en ander voorskrifte. Konflik-, veranderings- en mensebestuurs- en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Skryf van verslae en tydbestuur, leierskaps- en toesighoudende vaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur minderjarige en akute, ongevalle, HAST, Moeder-en-Kind, Mobiele dienste en satellietklinieke. Delegeer, hou toesig en koördineer die verskaffing van effektiewe en doeltreffende pasiëntsorg deur middel van voldoende verpleegsorg. Neem deel aan die implementering van die verplegingsplan, kliniese oudits, QIP's en die implementering daarvan vir gehalte sorg. Neem deel aan die formulering van verplegingsstandaarde, protokolle, sop's, beleide en verseker implementering deur monitering en evaluering. Verseker dat die praktyk in verpleging ooreenstem met wette en regulasies relevant tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Bestuur en monitor HR en Finansies in alle relevante kliniese areas. Fasiliteer implementering van ICRM en OHSC-monitorproses en handhaaf status en nakoming. Fasiliteer en hou toesig oor die ontwikkeling van die Verplegingsoperasionele plan in die relevante kliniese areas en satellietklinieke. Monitor en verseker dataversameling en nakoming van databestuursbeginsels. Koördineer en betrek Sukuma Sakhe-bevorderingsaktiwiteite/-geleenthede binne die gemeenskap. Fasiliteer en monitor implementering van PHC-herontwerp. Monitor implementering van kliniese bestuurstelsels in die eenhede en satellietklinieke. Verskaf leiding en leierskap toward die verwesenliking van strategiese doelwitte en oogmerke. Delegeer, hou toesig en koördineer die verskaffing van effektiewe, doeltreffende gehalte sorg. Vestig, handhaaf en neem deel aan interprofessionele en multidissiplinêre spanwerk wat Gesondheidsorg bevorder. Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die lewering van integrasie DHS gebaseer op relevante beleidsimperatiewe. Verminder siektelas deur die geïntegreerde multi-belanghebbende HEALTH-bevordering welweensheidsstrategie (IMHPWS) ten volle in jou subdistrik te implementeer en implementering van gesondheidsprogram en dienspakket binne die subdistrik. Verseker effektiewe, doeltreffende en ekonomiese bestuur van toegekennde bronne - HRM, HRD, Begroting, Vervoer, Toerusting ens. binne die subdistrik. Monitor en evalueer die PHC-aktiwiteite. Bestuur van Rekords, Dataprestasie-inligting binne die subdistrik.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohlangothi Wezokunakekelwa (PHC)
zu.summary: Phatha imisebenzi yokwelapha uhlele futhi ulawule ukunakekelwa kwezokunakekelwa e-Dannhauser CHC, ubukele inqubo yezesimo esiphuthumayo, uKanisayo Nomntwana, kanye nesevisi yezempilo eziyahambayo.
zu.requirements: Grade 1 Isipiliyoni: Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele/esiqondakalayo ekunakekelweni kashizi ngemuva kokuqoshwa njengoGqiza Wezokunakekelwa e-SANC ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile. Okungenani unyaka ngu-6 wesipiliyoni ku-PHC ngemuva kokuthola iziqu zangonyaka engu-1 ekunakekelweni kwe-PHC. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/esiqondakalayo ezingeni lomphathi ngaphansi kwe-PHC. Grade 12 (Isitifikedi Samabanga Aphakeme). I-Degree/I-Diploma ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile kanye nokubeleka. Ukuqoshwa e-SANC njengoGqiza Wezokunakekelwa Okujwayelekile. Isitifikedi se-PHC esiqinisekiswe yi-SANC. Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele/esiqondakalayo ekunakekelweni kashizi ngemuva kokuqoshwa njengoGqiza Wezokunakekelwa e-SANC ekunakekelweni okujwayelekile. Okungenani unyaka ngu-6 wesipiliyoni ku-PHC ngemuva kokuthola iziqu zangonyaka engu-1 ekunakekelweni kwe-PHC. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/esiqondakalayo ezingeni lomphathi ngaphansi kwe-PHC. Ilayisensi yokushayela. I-Diploma ekuphathweni kwezokunakekelwa. I-ICRM izobe yinzuzo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho namakhono afunekayo kulesi sikhwama: Ulwazi ngemikhuba nangezinqubo zokunakekelwa, uMthetho Wezokunakekelwa, uMthetho Wezempilo, Isifungo Sezogqiza, Ikhadi lamalungelo omphathi, izimiso ze-Batho Pele njll. Omthetho nezokunakekelwa nosimo oluthintekayo ngomthetho. Ulwazi nokuqonda osimo lomthetho oluphatha izinsizakalo zomphakathi. Ulwazi nge-HR, Izimali, Tuthuko kwamakhono, Izikhala Zomsebenzi, Imphakathi. Izindlela ze-PHC kanye namanye omagazini. Amakhono okuphatha ingxabano, inguquko kanye nabantu nokuthatha izinqumo. Ukubhala imibiko kanye nokuphatha isikhathi, amakhono okuqonda nokuhlola.
zu.duties: Phatha isimo esincane nesiphuthumayo, i-casualty, i-HAST, uKanisayo Nomntwana, Isevisi eziyahambayo kanye namakiliniki amagesitshe. Kabizela, ohlole futhi uhlele ukunikezwa kokunakekelwa kwengane okusebenza kahle nangempumelelo ngokunakekelwa okwanele. Hlanganyela ekusetshenzisweni kohlelo lokunakekelwa, ukucinga okwelapha, ama-QIP kanye nokusetshenziswa kwayo ukunakekelwa kwekhwalithi. Hlanganyela ekudalweni kwezindinganiso zokunakekelwa, izinqubo, ama-sop, izinqubomgomo futhi wuqinisekise ukusetshenziswa ngokuqapha nokuhlolwa. Qinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi wokunakekelwa uyahambisana namathuluzi nemithetho ehlobene nokunakekelwa nabezempilo. Phatha futhi uqaphele i-HR nezimali kuzo zonke izindawo ezithintekayo ezokwelapha. Siza ekusetshenzisweni kwe-ICRM kanye nenqubo yokuhlola i-OHSC futhi ulondoloze isimo nokuhambisana. Siza futhi ubukele tuthuko kohlelo lomsebenzi wezokunakekelwa ezindaweni ezithintekayo ezokwelapha nakumakiliniki amagesitshe. Qaphela futhi uqinisekise ukuqoqwa kwemininingwane nokulandela izimiso zoKuphatha Imininingwane. Hlela futhi ubambe i-Sukuma Sakhe ukukhuthaza imikhuba/izincomo ngaphakathi komphakathi. Siza futhi uqapha ukusetshenziswa kokubuyiselwa kabusha i-PHC. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kogogo lokwelapha emayunithini nakumakiliniki amagesitshe. Nikeza isiqondiso nobuqondo ekufinyeleleni imigomo nezinhloso ezibalulekile. Kabizela, ohlole futhi uhlele ukunikezwa kwekhwalithi yokunakekelwa okusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Misal, ulondoloze futhi uhlanganyele kumsebenzi wamandla amaningi oqondene namakhono ekukhuthaza Izempilo. Nikeza ubuqondo obuphatha ekulethweni kokuhlanganiswa i-DHS ngokusekelwa emagazini. Nciphisa isibhamu sezifo ngokusetshenziswa ibhajethi ehlangene yokukhuthaza impilo kahle enazingini zakho nangokusethenziswa kohlelo lwezempilo kanye nomthwalo wezinsizakalo enzingini. Qinisekisa ukuphatha ngokusebenza kahle, nangempumelelo kanye nangokugcina ngemitholwana okwabelwwe ngayo i-HRM, i-HRD, i-Bhajethi, Ukuhamba, Izibhambo njll. endaweni. Qaphela futhi uhlolisе i-PHC imikhuba. Uphatha kwerekhodi, imininingwane yokusebenza kwemininingwane endaweni yenu.

xh.title: UMlawuli ongesiNceda weMisebenzi yoKusingatha abaGulayo (PHC)
xh.summary: Lawula imisebenzi yezempilo ulungelelanise kukhathalelo lwamaxesha ezempilo eDannhauser CHC, ngokulawula i-casualty, iMother and Child, nziinkonzo ezihamba nomyalezo wezempilo.
xh.requirements: IGrade 1 Experience: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years’ experience in PHC after obtaining a 1-year qualification in Primary Health Care. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognizable experience at managerial level under PHC. IGrade 12 (Senior Certificate). Degree/Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery. Registration with SANC as a General Nurse. Isatifikethi sePHC esigunyaziswe yiSANC. A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 6 years’ experience in PHC after obtaining a 1-year qualification in Primary Health Care. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/ recognizable experience at managerial level under PHC. Ilayisensi yokushayela. IDiploma in Nursing Administration. Iinkqubo ze-ICRM ziya kubakho njengenzuzo. Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho naBantu abafanelekileyo abafunekayo kulesi sithuba: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezempilo nakwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, iNkqubo yabaPhelekisi, uMthetho weZempilo, isifungo samaNesi, isatifikethi samalungelo omgulayo, imigaqo yeBatho Pele, nokunye. Imithetho yolawulo ngokusebenza kolawulo ngabasempilweni. Ulwazi ngokuqonda kwemithetho elawula inkonzo zikarhulumente. Ulwazi ngabaBantu, iziMali, uQeqesho lwezakhono, uLwaziso ngezabasebenzi, iNkonzo kaRhulumente. Iinkqubo ezisisiseko ze-PHC nezinye iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo. Ikhono lokulawula iingxaki, iinguqu nerhulumente kwabantu nakwezigqibo. Ukuqamba iingxelo nokulawula ixesha, amandla okulawula nokugcina iziko lakho ngasemva.
xh.duties: Lawula iindawo ezincinane nezibuhlwangu, i-casualty, i-HAST, iMother and Child, iinkonzo ezihamba nomyalezo we-satellite clinics. Misa abantu abangakwaziyo, ulawule ngasentla uze ulungelelanise ukunikwa kukhathalelo lweempiliso olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo ngokuthunyelwa kwexesha elifanelekileyo. Zibandakanye ekusebenzeni kwendlela yokusingatha abagulayo, kuluguqulo lokuseswa kwemizekelo yezigulana, kwiQIP's nakusebenziseni kwazo ngokuphucula ukhathalelo olungcono. Zibandakanye ekwakheni iindlela ezisesikweni zokusingatha abagulayo, iinkqubo, i-sops, iinkqubo zolawulo uze uqinisekise ukuzisebenzisa ngokulawula nokuqonda. Qinisekisa ukuba umsebenzi wokusingatha abagulayo uyenzwa ngokwemithetho nemigaqo elawula ukusingatha abagulayo nempilo. Lawula uze ulawule abaBantu (HR) nezeMali kwazo naziphi na iindawo ezizezolona. Yenza kube lula ukusebenza kwe-ICRM nenkqubo yolawulo ye-OHSC uze ugcine isimo nokuzelelana nemigaqo. Yenza kube lula uze ulawule uphuhliso lwendlela yokusingatha abagulayo kumacandelo abalulekileyo nakwi-satellite clinics. Lawule uze uqinisekise ukuqokelelwa kolwazi nokuzinikela kwiMigaqo yoLawulo loLwazi. Lungiselelanisa uze uzibandakanye namanqanqamlo/ iziganeko ezikhuthazayo iSukuma Sakhe apho kwindlu. Yenza kube lulu uze ulawule ukusebenza kokuqokelelwa kolwazi ngokutsha kwe-PHC. Lawula ukusebenza kolawulo ngokutsha kwezempilo kwiiyunithi nakwi-satellite clinics. Nika isalathiso nokuqonda ngokufezekiswa iinjongo ezibalulekileyo. Misa abantu abangakwaziyo, ulawule ngasentla uze ulungelelanise ukunikwa kokhathalelo olusebenzayo, oluchanekileyo nolungomgangatho ophezulu. Misela, ulondoloze uze uzibandakanye kumsebenzi weqela elibandakanya iingcali ezininzi nobuchule obubanzi obukhuthaza iZempilo. Nika inkululeko ngokumgangatho ophezulu ngokunikwa kwexesha elifanelekileyo lolawulo ngokwe-DHS nangokwemigaqo echanekileyo. Nciphisa isithi sangokugula ngokusebenzisa i-integrated multi stakeholder HEALTH promotion well-being strategy (IMHPWS) ngokupheleleyo kwesifunda sakho nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zezempilo kunye nepakeji yenkonzo kwesifunda. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo, oluchanekileyo nolugcina imali ezabelwe zona- HRM, HRD, iNkqubo yeMali, uRhwebo, izixhobo nokunye kwesifunda. Lawula uze uqonde ukusebenza kwe-PHC. ULawulo lweziFayile, iNkqubo yoLwazi ngokusebenza kwendawo kwesifunda.

jobs.title: Operational Manager (PRIMARY Health Care)
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 per annum. Other Benefits 13th Cheque, Home owners allowance (employee must meet prescribed Requirements), Medical Aid (Optional) and 12% Rural Allowance
jobs.summary: Operational manager needed at Murchison Hospital's Thembalesizwe Clinic to monitor and evaluate primary health care services in KwaZulu-Natal.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate Degree / Diploma in General nursing plus 1 year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care or 1 year post basic qualification in Community Nursing Science with specialization in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care as per R212 SANC Regulation. Current registration with SANC as a General Nurse and Primary Health Care Nurse A minimum of 9 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in general nursing of which 5 years must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care or one year post basic qualification in Community Nursing Science with specialization in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care as per R212 SANC Regulation. Certificate of service from previous and current employer endorsed and stamped by HR Preference will be given to candidates who possess a valid Code 08 Drivers license and have proof of Computer Literacy Knowledge, Skills and Competencies Knowledge of nursing care and processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks Knowledge of Public service regulations Disciplinary code, human resource policies, hospital generic and specific policies Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework and good communication skills Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care Computer skills in basic programmes.
jobs.duties: Monitor and evaluate the performance of primary health care services and systems within the designated services area in line with, public health indicators, set norms, standards and targets with a view to report thereon and to initiate corrective action timeously. Analyse health policy and programme imperatives with a view to developing customised implementation strategies to guide the primary health care service providers in the service area towards complying with the stated norms, standards and targets. Identify “transversal “primary” health care and systems barriers (including emerging health trends in the service area) with a view to ensure corrective action at an appropriate level. Ensure and monitor that primary health care services within the designated services area are provided with adequate support by multi- disciplinary teams attached to the CHC / district hospital as well as from shared corporate service providers attached to the mothering institution. Ensure an integrated approach with the implementation of various primary health care programmes to provide a seamless service delivery platform, including the prioritising of needs within the service area and the allocation of resources accordingly. Ensure the effective and efficient utilisation of allocated resources, including the development of staff budgetary, procurement planning inputs and maintenance of prescribed information management systems. zu.title: Umphathi Wokusebenza (EZOKUNAKEKELA IMPILONOMTHANGA)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umphathi wokusebenza ethuluzi lesiko lokwelapha i-Thembalesizwe Clinic esibhedlela i-Murchison Hospital ukugcina amaphuzu nokuhlola izinsiza zokunakekela impilonomthanga KwaZulu-Natal.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate Degree / Diploma in General nursing plus 1 year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care or 1 year post basic qualification in Community Nursing Science with specialization in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care as per R212 SANC Regulation. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ne-SANC njengoba yimunesi evamile nema-Nurse Wokunakekela Impilonomthanga. Kuncane okuyiminyaka engu-9 yohluvo olufanelekile/oluhloniphekile olwaziwayo kumsebenzi wonakekela ngemuva kokubhalisa njengoNurse Ohloniphekile ne-SANC kumsebenzi wokunakekela jikelele, lapho kufanele kube yiminyaka engu-5 yohluvo olufanelekile/oluhloniphekile olwaziwayo ngemuva kokuthola ifayunedeshi yamunya yokusesikhundleni esiphezulu kokuNakekela Impilonomthanga noma ifayunedeshi yamunya yokusesikhundleni esiphezulu kusayensi yomphakathi wonakekela ngokukhethwa kusayensi yokunakekela yezokwelapha, ukuhlola impilo, ukwelapha nokunakekela njengoba kushiwo isimiso se-R212 SANC. Isitifiketi sesikhathi esibhalwe futhi sifakwe isitembu nguHr kubasebenzi basekhaya nabanimanje. Okuhunyushwayo okuzothunyelwa kubasebenzi abanelayisensi ebhalisiwe ye-Code 08 yokushayela kanye nesibonisi sokwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Ukwazi, amakhono namandla okwenza izinto. Ulwazi ngomsebenzi wokunakekela kanye nama-prosesi namapholisi, izimiso zokunakekela, kanye nezinye izimiso ezahlukeni ezifanele. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesevisi yomphakathi. Ikhodi yesigwebu, amapholisi ezinsiza zabantu, amapholisi wesibhedlela avamile nakhonkile. Amandla okuhola, ekuhleleni, ekwenzeni izinqumo nokuqamba izixazululo ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yesevisi yomphakathi nesakhiwo sezimiso zalezi nyuzi kanye namakhono ohlakaniphi okukhuluma. Amakhano abantu kuhlanganise ubudlelwano bomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukubhekana nezingxabano nokweluleka. Ulwazi lwezimali namabhajethi ngemithombo efanele engaphansi kwalolu hluvo. Ukuqonda izinkomba namapholisi ezinkomba ezithintela ukunakekela. Amakhono ekhompyutha okwenza izinkomba ezisisekelo.
zu.duties: Londoloza futhi uhlolo ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lokunakekela impilonomthanga nendlela ezokusebenza ngaphakathi kwesifunda esinikelwe njengoba kuhambisana namaphoyinti okuqinisekiswa impilo, amanani, izindinganiso namaphoyinti abekiwe ngenhleso yokwenza umbiko ngawo nokuqala ukulungisa izinkinga ngesikhathi esifanele. Hlafula ukuqonda izimiso noma amaphoyinti ohlelo nokubaluleka kwawo ukuze kuthuthukiswe izindlela ezizimele zokuqalisa ukuqondisela abanakekeli bezenziza ekubeni bayizinkokeli ohlelweni olwenziwayo noma ukungena ngakwesobunye. Buka imikhiqizo efinyelelekayo ngokungangabazeki ukuze kuhlolwe ibonakala ngokulingana kokusebenza kwabantu ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza. Qinisekisa futhi uhlolle ukuthi izinkonzo zokunakekela impilonomthanga ezinkabeni eziphephiya etholakala ezindaweni ezinikelwe zithola isekelo esanele emphakathini ohlangene nakwamanye amaqembu ohlelo lokusebenza emphakathini nakulezi zinto ezenza izimpilo ezikhethiwe. Hlela ukusetshenziswa ngendlela ehlangene nokwazi imithombo yokunakekela impilonomthanga ekudedeleni izinkinga ezithinta impilo emphakathini ngokusebenzisa amaphoyinti abekiwe namanani abekiwe. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kahle kanye nokuqasha ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo ehlinzekiwe, kuhlanganise nenhlelo yezimali, ukuhlela ukuthenga futhi ulondoloze ulwazi ngemithombo yokunakekelwa emphakathini. jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (NAASFARM Clinic)
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 – R821 454 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Inhospitable Allowance: 8% and Housing allowance: Prescribed requirements to be met. Basic qualification in Primary Health Care.
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing position at Naasfarm Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal requiring a Professional Nurse with at least 9 years experience to manage PHC services and clinic operations.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: A minimum of 9 years appropriate/ recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the one-year post Grade 12(Senior Certificate), Standard 10/ or National Certificate plus basic R425 qualification i.e. Degree/Diploma in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Post Basic qualification with the duration of at least 1 year in Curative Skills in Primary Health Care accredited with the SANC. Current registration with SANC (2026) as Professional Nurse and Primary Health Care and a minimum of 9 years appropriate /recognisable experience after registration as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required for the post: Knowledge of Nursing care processes and procedures, Nursing Acts, Health Act, Nurses Pledge, Patient’s-Right charter, Batho Pele principles etc. Nursing statutes and relevant legal framework. Knowledge and understanding of legislative framework governing the public services. Knowledge of HR, Finance, Skills development, Labour Relations, Public Service. PHC Guidelines and other prescripts. Conflict, change and people management. Disciplinary code and procedure, Grievance Procedure, Human Resource Policies, Hospital generic and specific policies. Leadership, organisational, decision making and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework, supervisory and communication skills. Good report writing and facilitation skills, good verbal and communication skills. Team building and cross-cultural awareness. Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Sound knowledge of the National Core standards (OHSC) and Data Management. Sound knowledge of health programme run at the PHC level. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management. Computer skills in basic programmes.
jobs.duties: Facilitate provision of comprehensive package of service at PHC level including priority programme and Quality Improvement Programmes. Develop Clinic Operational Plan, monitor the implementation and submit progress reports. Participate in the implementation of the nursing plan (Clinical practice/quality patient care). Participate in clinical audits in the facility and ensure implementation of the quality improvement plans supported by strong work ethics. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (Quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all nursing staff/housing keeping staff and give guidance. Ensure continuity of patient care on all levels e.g. workbook, handover and rounds. Ensure effective utilisation of human resources, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Render health services in the community by implementing Community Oriented Primary Care. Supervise and ensure the provision of an efficient patient care through adequate nursing care at the clinic. Ensure Batho Pele principles, National Core standards and ideal Clinic priorities are implemented. Provide safe therapeutic environment that allows for the practice of safe nursing care as laid down by nursing act and Occupational Health and Safety Act. Compile monthly, quarterly statistics and other reports. Provide strategic leadership in delivery of integration DHS based on relevant policy imperatives. Reduce burden of diseases by implementing the integrated multi stakeholder Health promotion well-being strategy (IMHPWS) fully in your subdistrict and implementation of health programmes and service package within the subdistrict. Ensure effective, efficient and economical management of allocated resources- HRM, HRD, Budget, Transport, Equipment etc. within the subdistrict. Monitor and evaluate the PHC activities. Management of Records, Data performance information within the subdistrict.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging (NAASFARM Clinic)
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging pos by Naasfarm Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal wat 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige met ten minste 9 jaar ervare vereis om PHC-dienste en kliniekbedrywighede te bestuur.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige met SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 5 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkende ervaring wees na verkryging van die eenjaar post Graad 12 (Senior Certificate), Standaard 10/ of National Certificate plus basiese R425-kwalifikasie d.w.s. Graad/Diploma in verpleging of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie met SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Post-basiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in Kuratiewe Vaardighede in Primêre Gesondheidsorg geakkrediteer by die SANC. Huidige registrasie met SANC (2026) as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Primêre Gesondheidsorg en 'n minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike/erkende ervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis vir die pos: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, Verpleegwette, Gesondheidswet, Verpleegstersbelofte, Pasienteregte-handves, Batho Pele-beginsels ens. Verpleegstatute en relevante regsraamwerk. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat openbare dienste regeer. Kennis van HR, Finansies, Vaardigheidsontwikkeling, Arbeidsverhoudinge, Openbare Diens. PHC-riglyne en ander voorskrifte. Konflik, verandering en mensebestuur. Dissiplinêre kode en prosedure, Grievance Procedure, Menslike Hulpbronbeleide, hospitaal-generiese en spesifieke beleide. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en instellingsbeleidsraamwerk, toesighoudende en kommunikasievaardighede. Goed verslagskryf- en fasiliteringsvaardighede, goeie verbale en kommunikasievaardighede. Spanbou en kruiskulturele bewustheid. Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandeling, konflikhantering en beradingvaardighede. Deeglike kennis van die Nasionale Kerntandarte (OHSC) en Databestuur. Deeglike kennis van gesondheidsprogramme wat op PHC-vlak uitgevoer word. Insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Finansiële en begrotingskennis rakende die relevante hulpbronne onder bestuur. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die verskaffing van 'n omvattende dienspakket op PHC-vlak insluitend prioriteitsprogramme en Kwaliteitsverbeteringsprogramme. Ontwikkel Kliniek Operasionele Plan, monitor die implementering en dien vorderingsverslae in. Neem deel aan die implementering van die verpleegplan (Kliniese praktyk/kwaliteitspasiesorg). Neem deel aan klinieke oudits in die fasiliteit en verseker implementering van die kwaliteitsverbeteringsplanne ondersteun deur sterk werketiek. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging (Kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met wette en regulasies relevant tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig van alle verpleegpersoneel/huishoudelike personeel en gee leiding. Verseker kontinuïteit van pasiesorg op alle vlakke bv. werkboek, oorhandiging en rondes. Verseker effektiewe benutting van menslike hulpbronne, materiële en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Lewer gesondheidsdienste in die gemeenskap deur die implementering van Gemeenskapsgeoriënteerde Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Hou toesig en verseker die verskaffing van doeltreffende pasiesorg deur voldoende verpleegsorg by die kliniek. Verseker dat Batho Pele-beginsels, Nasionale Kerntandarte en ideale kliniekprioriteite geïmplementeer word. Verskaf 'n veilige terapeutiese omgewing wat die beoefening van veilige verpleegsorg soos uiteengesit deur die verpleegwet en die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid toelaat. Stel maandelikse, kwartaalstatistieke en ander verslae op. Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die lewering van integrasie DHS gebaseer op relevante beleidsimperatiewe. Verminder die siektelas deur die implementering van die geïntegreerde multi-belanghebbende Gesondheidsbevordering-welstandsstrategie (IMHPWS) ten volle in u subdistrik en implementering van gesondheidsprogramme en dienspakket binne die subdistrik. Verseker effektiewe, doeltreffende en ekonomiese bestuur van toegekende hulpbronne- HRM, HRD, Begroting, Vervoer, Toerusting ens. binne die subdistrik. Monitor en evalueer die PHC-bedrywighede. Bestuur van Rekords, Dataprestasie-inligting binne die subdistrik.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokusebenza Wabezoluluso (Naasfarm Clinic)

Izindlela ze-PHC kanye namanye emiyalo. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga, izinguquko kanye nabantu. Ikhodi nomthetho wokuvalelwa, Inqubo yokusikwa isahlulelo, Izinhlelo zomtholampilo wabantu, Amapholisi esibhedlela ajwayelekile nawakhona. Amandla okuhola, abahloli, okuthatha izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwezindinganiso zendawo yomphakathi namapholisi esikhungo, amakhono okuhola nokuxhumana. Amakhono amahle okubhala imibiko nokukhokha, amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokuxhumana. Ukwakha iqembu nokwaziswa kwamasiko ahlukene. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu kufaka phakathi ubudlelwano nomphakathi, ukuxoxisana, ukuphathwa kwezinkinga kanye namakhono okweluleka. Ulwazi oluwumoya wezilinganiso ze-National Core (OHSC) kanye nokuqondisa imininingwane. Ulwazi oluwumoya wezinhlelo zezempilo ezenzelwa ezingeni le-PHC. Ukuqonda okujulile ngomthetho namapholisi okunakekelwa kwabezoluluso. Ulwazi ngemali nangemali ngemithombo ethintekile ebusweni. Amakhono okusebenzisa iakhompyutha kumaphrogramu msinya.
zu.duties: Qondisa ukunikezwa kwephakheji ephelele yezinsiza ezazingeni le-PHC kufaka phakathi ohlelo olubalulekile namaprogramu Okuthuthukisa Ikhwalithi. Hlela iNqubo Yokusebenza Yeziklinikhi, luphathe ukuphathwa kwayo futhi ungenise imibiko yentuthuko. Yiba nescsha ekuphathweni kwesu lokusebenza labezoluluso (Ukusetshenziswa okwesobala kwesibhedlela/ikhwalithi yokunakekelwa kwesiguli). Thatha inxaxheba ekuhloleni izobuqu efasilitini futhi uqinisekise ukuphathwa kwezinhlela zokuthuthukisa ikhwalithi ezixhaswa yizimiso zokuqasha ezisemqoka. Phatha izilinganiso, amasu, amagugu namaphuzu aphawule ukukhethwa kwabezoluluso (Ikhwalithi yokusebenza). Yenza ukunakekelwa koluluso nezempilo ngokuvumelana nomthetho nemiyalo ephathelene noluluso nezempilo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabasebenzi bezokunakekelwa nabanye abahlanganyeli. Nikeza okuholela futhi ungamathe wonke amalunga abasebenzi bezokunakekelwa/abasebenzi basendlini futhi unikeze imiyalo. Qinisekisa ukuqhubeleka phambili kokunakekelwa kwesiguli kuzo zonke izinga ngokwesibonelo kusisindo, ekushintshaniseni ulwazi nasohambo. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwemithombo yabantu, izinto nemithombo yezindlu ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle.Nikeza izinsiza zezempilo emphakathini ngokusebenzisa Izinsiza Eziqondene Nemiphakathi Eyangaseseni Eyangaseseni Eyangaseseni. Qondisa futhi uqinisekise ukunikezwa kokunakekelwa kwesiguli okusebenza kahle ngokunakekelwa kwabezoluluso okwanele esiklinikhi. Qinisekisa ukuba sekho izimiso ze-Batho Pele, izilinganiso eziyisisekelo ze-National Core namaphuzu aphawulekwe wesiklinika esihle. Nikeza indawo yokwelapha ephephile evumela ukwenziwa kokunakekelwa kwabezoluluso okuphepha njengoba kuhleliwe umthetho wabezoluluso noMthetho Wezempilo Nokuphepha Kwabasebenzi. Hlela imibiko yezibalo yanyanga zonke, yesikhashana neminye imibiko. Nikeza umbuso oholelayo ekulethweni kwe-DHS edidiyelwe ngokusekelwe kumagugu ohlelo olubalulekile. Nciphisa isithwathwa sezifo ngokusebenzisa iMHPWS edidiyelwe yeqiniso ngeqiniso esifundeni sakho esingaphansi futhi ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo zezempilo nephakheji yezinsiza esifundeni esingaphansi. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenza kahle, okuphumelelayo nangokuthi kwezimali kwemithongo enikeziwe - i-HRM, i-HRD, iNani, IsiNodi, Ithuluzi nnj. ngaphakathi kwesifundo esingaphansi. Londa futhi uhlolis amashishini e-PHC. Ukuphathwa kwezifundo, imininingwane yokusebenza kwemininingwane ngaphakathi kwesifundo esingaphansi.

xh.title: Umphathi Wemisebenzi Wokhathalelo Lweziguli (I-Klinik yase-NAASFARM)
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wemisebenzi wokhathalelo lweziguli kwikliniki yase-Naasfarm e-KwaZulu-Natal efunayo umongikazi othwebileyo onamava angalinganiselwa kumnyaka oyi-9 ukuze alawule iinkonzo ze-PHC nokuqhutywa kwekliniki.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Amava: Amava abohlobo afanelekileyo/abaziywa amava abongikazi angalinganiselwa kumnyaka oyi-9 emva kokuqesha njengomongikazi othwebileyo kwi-SANC ekuKhathalelweni lweziguli ngokubanzi. Ubuncinane kwiminyaka eyi-5 yexesha elishiwo ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/abaziywa emva kokuqokelelwa kwelungelo leminyaka elilinye emva kwama-Grade 12(Isatifikethi esiPhakamileyo), i-Standard 10/ okanye iQondo leSizwe kwelunga le-R425 esiseko oko kukuthi iGree/Diploma ekukhathaleleni iziguli okanye isigqibo esilinganayo esivumela ukuqeshwa kwi-SANC njengomongikazi othwebileyo. IRightekhulo yangemva kwesiseko ebude bonyaka obungenalungelo elilinye ekunyakeni ekunika ulwazi lokwakha iimfuno ekukhathaleleni i-PHC eqinisekiswe kwi-SANC. Ukuqeshwa okwangoku kwi-SANC (2026) njengomongikazi othwebileyo nakuThathwa ngamava ngokubanzi kwaye kubandakanye amava angalinganiselwa kumnyaka oyi-9 abohlobo abaziwayo/afanelekileyo emva kokuqeshwa njengomongikazi othwebileyo ekukhathaleleni iziguli ngokubanzi. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nokuZinikela efunekayo kulesi sithuba: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yokuqhuba neenkqubo zokhathalelo lweziguli, iMithetho yabaNongikazi, iMithetho yeMpilo, iSatifikethi sabaNongikazi, iSaziso samalungelo esiguli, iimpembelelo zeBatho Pele, njl. Imithetho yabaNongikazi nezikhokelo ezalayo. Ulwazi nakuqonda kwezikhokelo zeMithetho ezilawula iinkonzo zikarhulumende. Ulwazi lwe-HR, izeMali, uPhuhliso lwamakhono, iZincwadi ezingcaleni zokusebenza, iNkonzo kaRhulumende. Iikhonkco ze-PHC nezinye izikhokelo. Ulawulo lweempixano, okutshintshayo nabantu. Ikhodi nendlela yokuqhuba ukuguquka, iNkqubo yokuziphendulela, iinkqubo zezeMfundo yabaNtu, iinkqubo zePolisi ezingasentla nezexhobo lezeMfundo yabaNtu iSibhedlela. Ubunkokeli, uLuhlu lweMisebenzi, ukwenza iiggibo nokuSombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida yeenqanaba zikorhulumende neenkqubo zesikhungo, amakhono okulawula nokunxibelelwana. Ubuchule obuhle ekubhaleni iiNkcazelo nasekuqhubeni, amakhono amnandi okunxibelelwana nokuqondisa nokuqhula nokuthetha. Ukwakha iqela nokuziqonda ngokweenkculturu. Amakhono onxibelelwano namanye abantu aquka iinkonzo zikawonke-wonke, ukuxoxisana, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuxelela ngokuyinika amava. Ulwazi oluzinze lwezidingo zeNqanaba lesiZwe i-OHSC noLawulo lweData. Ulwazi oluzinze lweenkqubo zempilo ezenziwa kwinqanaba le-PHC. Ukuqonda kweenkqubo neendlela ezimayela nokuqhathela kweziguli. Ulwazi lwezeMali nokuqamba iNkqubo yeMali ezimayela namacebo afunekayo ngaphantsi kolawulo. Amakhono eKhompyutha kwiinkqubo ezisisiseko.
xh.duties: Qhoboshela ukubonelela ngesixhobo esidibaniswe ndawonye seenkonzo kwinqanaba le-PHC kuquka iinkqubo ezibalulewe kakhulu neZicwangciso zoPhuhliso lweNgcangcazelo. Bala iSicwangciso soQhutywa lweKliniki, qhoba inkcubeko yaso uze ugcwalise iinkcazelo ngangaphezulu kwemisebenzi ethunyelweyo. Thabatha inxaxheba kunkqubo yokuqhutywa kweesicwangciso zabongikazi (ukuSebenza komthetho/ukhathalelo oluhle lweguli). Thabatha inxaxheba kwizibalo zeempilo kwisixhobo ukuze uqinisekise ukusebenza kweenkqubo zophuhliso lwengcangcazelo eluzuzwa zinkqubo ezomeleleyo zomsebenzi. Sebenzisa imigaqo, iinkqubo, iinkalo nemiphumo yokukhathalela iguli. Khathalela igula kwakunye nokukhathalela kwempilo ngokwemithetho neemeko ezalatha ukhathalelo lwabongikazi nempilo. Gcina ubudlelwane obuzayo bokusebenza nabongikazi nakunye namagosa amanye. Bonelela ngolawulo oluqhelekileyo noluqondileyo kuwo onke amaphakathi abongikazi/abagcini bendlu uze unike isikhokelo. Qinisekisa ukusuka kwisebe elinye kuye kwelinye ukungahoywa kweziguli nakuzo onke amanqanaba. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa koluntu, amacebo nezixhobo ngokusebenza kakuhle nangempumelelo. Yiza iinkonzo zempilo nakwikomki ngokusebenzisa iinkonzo ze-Community Oriented Primary Care. Lawula ukuqinisekisa ukubonelela ngokhathalelo lweziguli olusebenzayo ngokukhathalela okwaneleyo kwikliniki. Qinisekisa ukuba zisebenza iimpembelelo zeBatho Pele, iinkqubo zeNqanaba lesiZwe nokuqwalaselwa kwezinto eziphambili zeKlinik. Bonelela ngendawo ekhuselekileyo eyakunika isazimo esikuvumela ukukhathalela ngokhathalelo lwesiguli ngokumila ngumthetho kaRhulumende kwaye kumthetho woKhathalelo lwakho. Bala iitilathi, kwexesha kwaye ezinye iinkcazelo ngokwalo nyaka. Bonelela ngobunkokeli bobunyeni bokuhamba koluntu nakwinkqubo esekelwe kuzo naziphi na iimpawu ezimalini ngokulungelelanisa iinkonzo ze-DHS. Kunciphisa izithiyo ngokuphuhliswa kwembalo ngokuphuhlisa iNkqubo efanelekileyo enceda abantu bonke (i-IMHPWS) ngokupheleleyo kwisithili sakho nakwinkqubo yokwenza iinkonzo nakwisixhobo seenkonzo ngaphakathi kwesithili. Qinisekisa ukuba kukho ulawulo olusebenzayo, olusebenzayo nolugcinwa ngcono ngaphezulu kwamacebo abekiweyo - i-HRM, i-HRD, iNkqubo yeMali, iThutha, iZixhobo, njl. Kwisithili. Qhobosha nokuqinisekisa ukusebenza kokukhathalela iinkonzo ze-PHC. Ulawulo lokuQhelwa kwamagama, iNkcukacha nokuqhutywa ngokwemiba yesixhobo kwisithili.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing (VIEDRIET Clinic)
jobs.salary_text: R720 819 – R821 454 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Inhospitable Allowance: 8% and Housing allowance: Prescribed requirements to be met.
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing sought for Viedriet Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal to facilitate comprehensive PHC services and develop clinic operational plans.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: A minimum of 9 years appropriate/ recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the one-year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care. Grade 12 (Senior Certificate), Standard 10/ or National Certificate plus basic R425 qualification i.e. Degree/Diploma in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Post Basic qualification with the duration of at least 1 year in Curative Skills in Primary Health Care accredited with the SANC. Current registration with SANC (2026) as Professional Nurse and Primary Health Care and a minimum of 9 years appropriate /recognisable experience after registration as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies required for the post: Knowledge of Nursing care processes and procedures, Nursing Acts, Health Act, Nurses Pledge, Patient’s- Right charter, Batho Pele principles etc. Nursing statutes and relevant legal framework. Knowledge and understanding of legislative framework governing the public services. Knowledge of HR, Finance, Skills development, Labour Relations, Public Service. PHC Guidelines and other prescripts. Conflict, change and people management. Disciplinary code and procedure, Grievance Procedure, Human Resource Policies, Hospital generic and specific policies. Leadership, organisational, decision-making and problem-solving abilities within the limit of the public sector and institutional policy framework, supervisory and communication skills. Good report writing and facilitation skills, good verbal and communication skills. Team building and cross-cultural awareness. Interpersonal skills including public relations, negotiating, conflict handling and counselling skills. Sound knowledge of the National Core standards (OHSC) and Data Management. Sound knowledge of health programme run at the PHC level. Insight into procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Financial and budgetary knowledge pertaining to the relevant resources under management. Computer skills in basic programmes.
jobs.duties: Facilitate provision of comprehensive package of service at PHC level including priority programme and Quality Improvement Programmes. Develop Clinic Operational Plan, monitor the implementation and submit progress reports. Participate in the implementation of the nursing plan (Clinical practice/quality patient care). Participate in clinical audits in the facility and ensure implementation of the quality improvement plans supported by strong work ethics. Implement standards, practices, criteria and indicators for quality nursing (Quality of practice). Practice nursing and health care in accordance with laws and regulations relevant to nursing and health care. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all nursing staff/housing keeping staff and give guidance. Ensure continuity of patient care on all levels e.g. workbook, handover and rounds. Ensure effective utilisation of human resources, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Render health services in the community by implementing Community-Oriented Primary Care. Supervise and ensure the provision of an efficient patient care through adequate nursing care at the clinic. Ensure Batho Pele principles, National Core standards and ideal Clinic priorities are implemented. Provide safe therapeutic environment that allows for the practice of safe nursing care as laid down by nursing act and Occupational Health and Safety Act. Compile monthly, quarterly statistics and other reports. Provide strategic leadership in delivery of integration DHS based on relevant policy imperatives. Reduce burden of diseases by implementing the integrated multi stakeholder health promotion wellbeing strategy (IMHPWS) fully in your subdistrict and implementation of health programmes and service package within the subdistrict. Ensure effective, efficient and economical management of allocated resources- HRM, HRD, Budget, Transport, Equipment etc. within the subdistrict. Monitor and evaluate the PHC activities. Management of Records, Data performance information within the subdistrict.

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging (VIEDRIET Kliniek)
af.summary: Operasionele Bestuurder Verpleging gesoek vir Viedriet Kliniek in KwaZulu-Natal om omvattende PHC-dienste te fasiliteer en kliniekebedryfsplanne te ontwikkel.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste 5 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na die verwerwing van die eenjaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), Standaard 10/ of Nasionale Sertifikaat plus basiese R425-kwalifikasie d.w.s. Graad/Diploma in verpleging of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Postbasiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in Kuratiewe Vaardighede in Primêre Gesondheidsorg geakkrediteer by die SANC. Huidige registrasie by SANC (2026) as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Primêre Gesondheidsorg en 'n minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede vereis vir die pos: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en -prosedures, Verpleegwette, Gesondheidswet, Verpleegstersbelofte, Pasienteregte-handves, Batho Pele-beginsels ens. Verpleegstatute en relevante regsraamwerk. Kennis en begrip van die wetgewende raamwerk wat die openbare dienste regeer. Kennis van HR, Finansies, Vaardigheidsontwikkeling, Arbeidsverhoudinge, Openbare Diens. PHC-riglyne en ander voorskrifte. Konflik-, veranderings- en mensebestuur. Dissiplinêre kode en prosedure, Grieweprosedure, Menselike Hulpbronbeleide, hospitaalgeneriese en spesifieke beleide. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming- en probleemoplossingvermoëns binne die perke van die openbare sektor en institutionele beleidsraamwerk, toesig- en kommunikasievaardighede. Goede verslagskryf- en fasiliteringsvaardighede, goedge verbale en kommunikasievaardighede. Spanbou en kruiskulturele bewustheid. Interpersoonlike vaardighede insluitend openbare betrekkinge, onderhandelinge, konflikhantering en beradingsvaardighede. Degelike kennis van die Nasionale Kerstandaarde (OHSC) en Databestuur. Degelike kennis van gesondheidsprogramme op PHC-vlak uitgevoer. Insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Finansiële en begrotingskennis rakende die toepaslike hulpbronne onder bestuur. Rekenaarvaardighede in basiese programme.
af.duties: Fasiliteer die voorsiening van 'n omvattende dienspakket op PHC-vlak insluitend voorheidsprogramme en Kwaliteitsverbeteringsprogramme. Ontwikkel Kliniekbedryfsplan, monitor die implementering en dien vorderingsverslae in. Neem deel aan die implementering van die verpleegplan (Kliniese praktyk/kwaliteitspasiesorg). Neem deel aan kliniese oudite in die fasiliteit en verseker implementering van die kwaliteitsverbeteringsplanne ondersteun deur sterk werketiek. Implementeer standaarde, praktyke, kriteria en aanwysers vir gehalteverpleging (Kwaliteit van praktyk). Beoefen verpleging en gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met wette en regulasies relevant tot verpleging en gesondheidsorg. Handhaaf 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig van alle verpleegpersoneel/huishoudelike personeel en gee leiding. Verseker kontinuïteit van pasiesorg op alle vlakke bv. werksboek, oorhandiging en rondes. Verseker doeltreffende benutting van menslike hulpbronne, materiaal en fisiese hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektiief. Lewer gesondheidsdienste in die gemeenskap deur Gemeenskap-georiënteerde Primêre Gesondheidsorg te implementeer. Toesig hou en verseker die voorsiening van doeltreffende pasiesorg deur toereikende verpleegsorg by die kliniek. Verseker dat Batho Pele-beginsels, Nasionale Kerstandaarde en ideale kliniek-prioriteite geïmplementeer word. Verskaf 'n veilige terapeutiese omgewing wat die beoefening van veilige verpleegsorg soos neergelê deur verpleegwet en Beroepsgesondheids- en Veiligheidswet toelaat. Stel maandelikse, kwartaalse statistieke en ander verslae op. Verskaf strategiese leierskap in die levering van integrasie DHS gebaseer op relevante beleidsimperatiewe. Verminder siekdelas deur die geïntegreerde multibetrekkinge gesondheidsbevordering-welsynsstrategie (IMHPWS) volledig in u subdistrik te implementeer en implementering van gesondheidsprogramme en dienspakket binne die subdistrik. Verseker effektiewe, doeltreffende en ekonomiese bestuur van toegewysde hulpbronne- HRM, HRD, Begroting, Vervoer, Toerusting ens. binne die subdistrik. Monitor en evalueer die PHC-aktiwiteite. Bestuur van Rekords, Dataprestasie-inligting binne die subdistrik.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokusebenza Wokunakekela (Ikiliniki le-VIEDRIET)
zu.summary: Kufunwa umphathi wezokusebenza wokunakekela wekiliniki le-Viedriet e-KwaZulu-Natal ukuze kwesondelene nezenzo ezibanzi zamasevisi e-PHC kanye nokuthuthukisa amaphulani okusebenza ekelinini.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Isiphephelo: Isiphephelo esingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-9 esifanele/ esaziwayo sokunakekela emva kokuqoshwa njengongunesi weBungcweti ne-SANC ekunakekeleni Jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 kwesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube isiphephelo esifanele/ esaziwayo emva kokuthola izifundo zangemva kwesisekelo ezithatha unyaka owodwa ekunakekeleni Isempilo Eyisisekelo. Izinga 12 (Ithifikethi Ephakeme), I-Standard 10/ noma Ithifikethi Lesizwe kanye nesifundo esiyisisekelo se-R425 okunguthi I-Degree/I-Diploma ekunakekeleni noma isifundo esilingana esivumela ukuqoshwa ne-SANC njengongunesi weBungcweti. Isifundo sangemva kwesisekelo esithatha okungenanzi unyaka owodwa kumakhono Okuphilisa ekunakekeleni Isempilo Esiyisisekelo esamukelekwe i-SANC. Ukuqoshwa kwamanje ne-SANC (2026) njengongunesi weBungcweti nasekunakekeleni Isempilo Esiyisisekelo kanye nesesiphephelo esingaphansi kweminyaka eyi-9 esifanele/ esaziwayo emva kokuqoshwa njengongunesi weBungcweti ekunakekeleni Jikelele. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa kanye namakhono afunekayo kwalesisikhundla: Ulwazi ngemikhuba kanye nokuqhuba ukunakekela, Umthetho Wokunakekela, Umthetho Wezempilo, Isifungo Sabanesi, Ikhadi Lamalungelo Omutu, Imigomo kaBatho Pele nokunye. Imithetho yokunakekela kanye nesakhiwo sezomthetho esihambisana nayo. Ulwazi nokuqonda isakhiwo sezomthetho esibusa amasevisi kahulumeni. Ulwazi ngabantu, Izimali, Ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono, Izindaba Zabasebenzi, nezeNhlangano Yomphakathi. Imihlahlandlela ye-PHC kanye nezinye izimiso. Ukuphatha abantu, izinguquko kanye namakhwebhulu. Ikhodi yezinhlelo zomthetho kanye namaphulosedi, iphulosedi yezinhlelo zokudlulisela izinkinga, izinhlela zabantu abakuleziqondiso zokuphatha, imithetho yamakiliniki amakhulu. Amakhono okuhola, ukuqamba izinqumo, nokuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwezinkinga ezimbozwe imithetho. Amakhono okuhola abantu. Ubuhlakani ekubhaleni izibali. Amakhono okubukela kude. Amakhono okukhulumisana. Amakhono oqhagamshelwano, wokubakha iqhagamshelwano. Amakhono abantu kuhlanganiswe nobudlelwano. Amakhono omlando wezepolitiki kanye namakhono ehlabathi. Ulwazi nge-WHO National Core Standards.
zu.duties: Yenza kwesondelene nezenzo ezibanzi zamasevisi ekelinini kanye namaphulani anemiqondo yezinhlelo eziphakeme. Hlela iphulani ekusebenzeni kwekiliniki. Buka izinto ezibangelwa ukusetshenziswa kwezimali kanye nemithi. Hlanganyela ekusebenzeni kolwazi. Hlola isifundo kwezokunakekela nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono. Zinike ukunakekelwa okuhle nabantu. Qinisekisa amakhono okuqonda, ukwenza isinqumo nokuthuthukisa. Hlola imigomo. Hlola izindaba. Hlola imithetho. Yenza ngendlela evela emthethweni. Hlola imigomo yokusebenza neyokuthuthukisa. Hlola imigomo yezinhlelo zokugcina izindleko. Hlola imigomo yokuqinisekisa izinkalo. Thuthukisa imigomo. Yenza ngemigomo. Yenza izinkinga zibe lula.

xh.title: Umphathi Wezokusebenza Khozahlobo lwezohlolwayo (I-Kliniki yase-VIEDRIET)
xh.summary: Kufunwa gqa Umphathi Wezokusebenza Khozahlobo lwezohlolwayo we-Kliniki yase-Viedriet e-KwaZulu-Natal ukuze alawule iinkonzo ezizele ze-PHC aze ahlome iinkqubo zokusebenza zekliniki.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Ulwazi loqeqesho: Okungenani iminyaka eli-9 olungelelonani/lwazi olusengqondweni khozahlobo lwezohlolwayo emva kokubhalisa njengoGqirha Wezohlolwayo ohlathiweyo ku-SANC kwi-Nzalo yoqobo lwezohlolwayo. Okungenani iminyaka eli-5 kwexesha elitshiwo ngasentla kufuneka ibe lulwazi olungelelonani/lusengqondweni emva kokufumana isidanga seminyaka elilodwa yeesifundo esisiseko kwi-Nqanaba lokuqala lemfundo kwi-Somlomo wezeempilo koqobo. Inqanaba 12 (Isatifikethi Samabanga aphezulu), Isitendard 10/ okanye Isatifikethi Ssezwe kwakunye nesi fully R425 esithi yi-Degree/Diploma khozahlobo lwezohlolwayo okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengoGqirha Wezohlolwayo ohlathiweyo. Isidanga seziqendu ezingaphezu kwesisiseko ngexesha lokufunda elingangenanga unyaka owodwa kwi-Nzalo Yempilo kuqeqesho lwezakhono zokwelapha kwi-PHC etyunjiweyo ku-SANC. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku ku-SANC (2026) njengoGqirha Wezohlolwayo kunye ne-PHC nokuba okungenani iminyaka eli-9 olungelelonani/lwazi olusengqondweni emva kokubhaliswa njengoGqirha Wezohlolwayo kwi-Nzalo yoqobo lwezohlolwayo. Ulwazi, izakhono, uqeqesho namandla ofunekayo kule sithuba: Ulwazi ngokuqhuba iinkqubo zohlolwayo nezendlela zokwenza umsebenzi, iMithetho yamagosa eZohlolwayo, uMthetho wezeMpilo, isifungo samaGosa eZohlolwayo, i-Nqululeko yamaLungelo oMvuzanyana, iimpawu zeBatho Pele, njl. iMithetho yamagosa eZohlolwayo nolawu olusemthethweni oluhambelana nalo. Ulwazi nokuqonda kolawu olusemthethweni olulawula iinkonzo zikawonke-wonke. Ulwazi ngabasebenzi, eziMali, uPhuhliso lwezakhono, uBudlelwane boBusebenzi, nokuSebenza kuWonke-wonke. Iindlela zeliso le-PHC nezinye iingxilitho. Ukuphathwa kwezindabazoxabana, okutshintshayo nabantu. Ikhodi nendlela yohlwayo, iNqubo yokubakhupha iingxila, iMigaqo ngokuSebenza koBantu, namagama esikhululo i-General nespecific. Amandla okuba ngumgca oqhuba phambili wokulungelelanisa izinto, ukuthathela iigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemida yamagazethi kazwelonke namagazethi wesikhululo, amandla okulawula abasebenzi nokuThetha kakuhle. Amandla amabalwa okubhala iingxelo nokulawula, amandla amabalwa okuthetha nakucoca inkulumo namandla okuchaza. Ukwakha iqela lomsebenzi nokuziqonda izithO zosapho olahle ilimi. Amandla okuhamba nabantu abaqukuze imixokise, imiba yoluntu ukuze bathethe nakho, abhejwele nabantu abayinxaxhe, abalawuli imigibe lenkxaso-mali yemisebenzi ebandakanya imigaqo yosapho olahle ilimi. Amandla anokusetyenziswa kolunye ulwazi oluBuhle kwesiLuluhlobo ngokubanzi kwi-programme yezempilo eqhutywa kwesiNqanaba se-PHC. Ukuqonda iingxelo zemithetho namagunya ezohlolwayo nezohlolwayo. Ulwazi olubanzi ngokwenza iinkqubo zolawulo nolungelelwe ukusebenza kwendalo nolungelelwe izinto eziqulunqwa.
xh.duties: Qhubele phambili ukunikela ngeqela elizelelo lezinkonzo kwesiNqanaba se-PHC kuquka iinkqubo ezibalulekileyo namagatya aKakhulu. Hloma iNqubo yokusebenza yaseKliniki, ulawule ukusetyenziswa kwayo uze unike iingxelo zentshukubo. Thabatha inxaxheba ekusetyenzisweni kwenqubo yohlolwayo (Ukuqeqesha komGqirha nonakekelo olusemthethweni lomVuzanyana olupheleleyo). Thabatha inxaxheba kumaxela amacwaka olawulo ekliniki uze uqinisekise ukusebenza kwenqubo elungiselelwa ukunyuselelwa kwekhwalithi ixhaswe lugqozi lomsebenzi olusiniw'olungeni. Bekisa izinto ezisebenzayo, iindlela nempawu ezifuna iKliniki ekhuthaza izigqibo ezilungele ukusebenza ngokulinganeyo kwamagosa oGqirha ezohlolwayo. Qamba iindlela entsha ezokusombulula iingxaki ezisezantsi kwamaza eNtlanga kwiSaziswa soLuntu esiya ngokumgangatho osisiseko. Sebenzisa ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho yoluntu ebanceda ekusebenzeni nolungelelwa abasebenzi nolungelelwa nzalo. Qinisekisa iNkqubo ekhazimla iNkonzo ezahlukene kumazwe amaninzi anelulwazi lweNkonzo enikwa iziqendu kwisaziswa sokuThengisa iMisebenzi.

jobs.title: Operational Manager (MAMBEDWINI Clinic)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R720 821 – R821 554 per annum. Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional) and Housing Allowance (Employee must meet the prescribed requirements). Rural allowance 8%
jobs.summary: Operational Manager position at Mambedwini Clinic under Appelsbosch Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, requiring a nursing qualification and at least 9 years of experience.
jobs.requirements: Degree/National Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery. Only shortlisted candidate will submit proof of current registration with SANC (2026) as a Professional Nurse and Midwifery. A Post Basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year in Curative skills in Primary Health Care accredited with SANC Experience: A minimum of 9 years appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. At least 5 years of the period referred above must be appropriate /recognisable after obtaining the 1 year post basic qualification in the relevant specialty. Certificate of Service endorsed by Human Resource as proof of experience. (Only if shortlisted). Additional information Diploma in Nursing Management, Computer literacy. Valid Driver’s license Code B (08) will serve as a recommendation. Knowledge, Skills, Training, And Competencies Required: Knowledge of SANC Rules and Regulations, Knowledge of Legislative Framework and Departmental prescripts. Leadership, organisational, Decision making, problem solving and interpersonal skills. Basic financial management skills. Knowledge of Human Resource Management. Personal Attitude, Responsive, Professionalism, Supportive, Assertive and Team player role. Communication skills and decision making skills. Leadership and supervisory skills.
jobs.duties: Assist in planning, organising and monitoring of objectives of the specialised unit/department. Manage all resources within the unit effectively and efficiently to ensure optimum service delivery. Ability to plan and organise own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Display a concern for patients, promoting and advocating proper treatment and care. Monitor Provision of quality comprehensive service delivery at PHC clinic. Participate actively in Operation Sukuma Sakhe programme. Work as part of the multidisciplinary team to ensure good nursing care. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, community and multidisciplinary team. Monitor safe patient service and improve client satisfaction. Participate in the attainment of Norms and Standards (OHSC). Contribute to the realization of Ideal Clinic (ICRM) status. Participate in the analysis and formulation of nursing policies and procedures. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all staff within the unit and give guidance. Demonstrate an understanding of Human Resource and Financial Management Policies and procedures. Monitor and evaluate the care and management of all patients through clinical audits. Ability to supervise PHC emergencies and refer appropriately. Monitor implementation of PHC Re-Engineering Monitor implementation and performance on indicators on daily, weekly and monthly basis; provide feedback to management, analyse data and draw up quality improvement plan and implementation plan. Exercise control of discipline and any other Labour Related issues in terms of laid down procedures. Ensure complaint management is functional in the Clinic Ensure functionality of the Clinic committee programme so that community involvement and participation is achieved.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. M Zele: Assistant Manager Nursing-PHC Tel No: (032) 294 8000
jobs.applications: should be forwarded to: The Chief Executive Officer, P/Bag X215, Ozwathini, 3242. email: Zakhele.nxumalo@kznhealth.gov.za FOR ATTENTION : Human Resource Manager

af.title: Operasionele Bestuurder (MAMBEDWINI Kliniek)
af.summary: Operasionele bestuurderpos by Mambedwini Kliniek onder Appelsbosch Hospital, KwaZulu-Natal, wat 'n verpleegkwalifikasie en ten minste 9 jaar ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Degree/National Diploma in General Nursing and Midwifery. Slegs gekorte kandidate sal bewys van huidige registrasie met SANC (2026) as 'n Professional Nurse and Midwifery voorlê. A Post Basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year in Curative skills in Primary Health Care accredited with SANC Experience: 'n Minimum van 9 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as Professional Nurse met SANC in General Nursing. Ten minste 5 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslik/herkenbaar wees na verkryging van die 1 jaar post basic qualification in die toepaslike spesialiteit. Certificate of Service wat deur Human Resource goedgekeur is as bewys van ervaring. (Slegs indien gekort). Additional information Diploma in Nursing Management, Computer literacy. Valid Driver's license Code B (08) sal as 'n aanbeveling dien. Knowledge, Skills, Training, And Competencies Required: Kennis van SANC Rules and Regulations, kennis van Legislative Framework en departementele voorskrifte. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitnemings-, probleemoplossings- en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Basiese finansiële bestuursvaardighede. Kennis van Human Resource Management. Persoonlike houding, meegaand, professioneel, ondersteunend, assertief en spanspeler rol. Kommunikasievaardighede en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Leierskaps- en toesighoudende vaardighede.
af.duties: Bystand met die beplanning, organisering en monitering van die doelwitte van die gespesialiseerde eenheid/departement. Bestuur alle hulpbronne binne die eenheid doeltreffend en effektief om optimale dienslewering te verseker. Vermoë om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en beywer vir behoorlike behandeling en sorg. Monitor die verskaffing van gehalte omvattende dienslewering by die PHC kliniek. Neem aktief deel aan Operation Sukuma Sakhe programme. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om goeie verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, gemeenskap en multidissiplinêre span. Monitor veilige pasiëntdiens en verbeter kliëntetevredenheid. Neem deel aan die bereiking van Norms and Standards (OHSC). Dra by tot die verwesenliking van Ideal Clinic (ICRM) status. Neem deel aan die analise en formulering van verpleegbeleide en prosedures. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor alle personeel binne die eenheid en gee leiding. Toon begrip van Human Resource en Financial Management Policies and procedures. Monitor en evalueer die sorg en bestuur van alle pasiënte deur kliniese oudite. Vermoë om PHC-noodgevalle te toesien en toepaslik te verwys. Monitor implementering van PHC Re-Engineering Monitor implementering en prestasie op aanwysers op daaglikse, weeklikse en maandelikse basis; verskaf terugvoer aan bestuur, analiseer data en stel gehalteverbeteringsplan en implementeringsplan op. Oefen beheer uit oor dissipline en enige ander Labour Related kwessies volgens vasgestelde prosedures. Verseker dat klagbestuur funksioneel is in die kliniek. Verseker die funksionering van die kliniekkomiteeprogram sodat gemeenskapsbetrokkenheid en -deelname bereik word.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezokusebenza (IKLINIKA yaseMambedwini)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba ngumPhathi wezokuSebenza eKlinika yaseMambedwini ngaphansi kweSibhedlela i-Apelsbosch, eKwaZulu-Natali, sidinga isifundo sezokwelapha kanti futhi kube nokuhlangenwe nakho okungaphezulu kwezingu-9 eminyakeni.
zu.requirements: IDigri/INazhonalodiploma kwiJikelele kwezokuHlengwa kanti abantu abatholwe bengalashwa bakhethiwe banikwa isikhathi esithile, abayobe befake amaphepha abo ezokwamukelwa kwindawo ethize. Isikhathi esincane isikhathi esilandela ngemva kokuba kukhethiwe izinsuku ezingu-7 ezidlulile kubalingisi abayobe bethunyelwe ngemvume yohlelo lokuqinisekisa ukuthi bangena ngemvume yohlelo lwe-SANC njengoba kudingeka kule ndlela yokutholakala kwemvume yokungenisa izinkambu eziyingxenye yemisebenzi yezokwelapha. Isibonakaliso esivezwa njengesidingo okubalulekile kumsebenzi wokuba ngumuntu osethuliwe okuthiwa ngumNurse Professional ogcwele ukwazi ukuthi nakanjani ukuthi ukwazi ukuqhathanisa kwezokwelapha abasebenza abayibe bethole iminikelo yezemfundo ephakeme kakhulu njengesidingo sokuba ngumuntu okhethiweyo onemvume yokungenisa izinkambu. Isidingo esithile sokuthi kube khona okuthile okukhomba ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba khona kwezokwelapha ngaphakathi kwendawo ethize. Amagama amiswe ngokwemiso efana namagama abakwa-mfethu angaphakathi endaweni yokuqinisekiswa kokuba khona kolwazi. Okuqukethwe kuwo wonke amagama amakhulu avela kubantu abaningi abayobe befuna ukusebenza endaweni ethize, ahlezi athathwe njengesidingo esibalulekile sokuba ngumuntu ohamba phambili ekubeni ngumuntu oyise. Izinsuku ezingaphezu kwalolu hlelo ezitholwa zibuye ziphawule nge-goli eliphephulwa ngamandla emphakathi ohlwini. Ulwazi oluningi ngokubaluleka kolimi okulodwa nokuba lusebenziseka kahle lokhu kubuye kuholele ekutheni umuntu azi ukuba namakhono amaningi okuba yisakhiwo ezindaweni ezahlukene ezihlukene. Isidingo esiphelele sokuba umuntu azithobe futhi azihloniphe ekubeni ngumuntu oqinisekiswe ukuthi uhlangabezana nemikhawulo ephathelene nokuba ngumuntu okwazi ukuba ngumuntu ongenalutho ekutheni angaqondi ukuba kumele kwenzeke ngakho konke okutholakala kule minikelo yokukhethwa. Abantu abayobe bethole iziqu eziyi-post-graduate ezenza ukuba umuntu abe namakhono okuqonda kahle indlela yokuba kumele kubekhona isidingo sokuba ngumuntu okhethiwe onemvume yokungena ekubeni ngumuntu onemikhawulo ethile. Imininingwane ekuqinisekiswa ngayo imvume yokuba khona kwezokuhamba nabantu abaningi bokuqinisekisa ukuba kubalulekile ukuba khona kokuthi abantu bakwazi ukuziphatha kabuhlungu, kanti futhi lokho kubuye kubaluleke kakhulu ekubeni komuntu okwazi ukuba nesibindi nokuzethemba. Isibopho sikaHulumeni kule minikelo sisebenza kuphela kubantu abayobe behamba nokuqonda ukuthi banakho ukwenza imisebenzi yawo wonke umuntu onegunya lokuthi azijwayeze ngokusebenzisa amandla akhe. Abantu abaningi abayobe bethole imfundo ephakeme noma baye bafunde emikhakheni ehlukene bayobe behlezi bethathwa njengabakhiqizi. Isidingo sokuqinisekiswa kwezokuba khona kwemisebenzi kubantu abayobe bethole iziqu zabantu abaningi ngemvume yokuba khona kwezokwaziswa. Ulwazi oluphelele ngendlela yokwenza imisebenzi ngokwemithetho nokuba khona kwemvume yokungenisa izinkambu ezinkulu. Abantu abayobe besebenza emikhakheni ehlukene sebehlezi bethathwa njengabantu abakwazi ukusebenza ngezincazelo ezithile zokuba ngemvume yokwenza imisebenzi yawo wonke umuntu okhethwe. Isidingo sokuqinisekiswa kokuba khona kwesifundo sokuba ngumuntu okwazi ukubeka phambili izidingo zabantu. Lokhu kubuye kubaluleke ekubeni khona kwemvume yokuba khona kokuthi abantu abaningi bangathola iziqu. Abantu abaningi abayobe bethole iziqu eziphelele zokubeka phambili izinhloso zabo baye bahlala besekela abanye abantu.

xh.title: Umphathi Wokuqhuba (iKlinhiki yaseMambedwini)
xh.summary: Isithuba somphathi wokuqhuba eKlinhiki yaseMambedwini ngaphansi kwePitalsi yaseAppelsbosch, KwaZulu-Natal, esifuna izifundo zokuhlonza kwaye ungamava okungenani emva kweminyaka eyi-9.
xh.requirements: I Degree/National Diploma kwiNursing yeJikelele neMidwifery. Kuphela omanye kuluhlu lokuqinqwa abaza kugcinwa iimvobo zobhalo lwangoku ku-SANC (2026) njengomhloli weNursing weJikelele neMidwifery. Isifundo sePost Basic sokuhlonza ngaphakathi kwexesha elingangenani kweminyaka eyi-1 kwi-Curative skills kwiPrimary Health Care esemthethweni ku-SANC. Amava: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-9 yamava obuchuli bokuhlola/bokuqaphela emva kobhalo njengomhloli weNursing ku-SANC kwiNursing yeJikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-5 yexesha elichaziwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava alungileyo/okuqaphela emva kokufumana isifundo semyaka engu-1 se-post basic kwikhondo elibalulekileyo. Isatifikethi seNkonzo esiqinisekiswe yi-Human Resource njengengqinisekiso yamava. (Kuphela ukuba ukuluhlu lokubuzwa). Ulwongelelo olongezelelayo iDiploma kwiLawulo lobuhle, Ukusebenzisa iKompyutha. Ilayisenesi yokuqhayisa eSebenzayo i-Code B (08) iya kubakho njengesiphakamiso. Ulwazi, amakhono, uQeqesho, namaQaqamba afunekayo: Ulwazi ngeMigaqo neMithetho ye-SANC, ulwazi ngeFramework yomthetho nezequmrhu zesebe. Aakhono oKhokelo, olulwamkelo, oKuzalisekisa, ukusombulula iingxaki namakhono onxibelelwano phakathi kwabantu. Aakhono abakhakaqheyo oLawulo lemali. Ulwazi ngokuLawula i-Human Resource. Ebo inclining, Ethintelwayo, uBuntu bomgcakwana, Ekwalekisa, eZimange-engezizilulekeli kwaye udlala indima esigqibeleni. Aakhono oNxibelelwano noKuzalisekisa oqukuqwayo. Aakhono oKhokelo noLawulo.
xh.duties: Nceda ukuqulunqa, ulungise kwaye ulawule iinjongo ze-thisha ethile/esebe. Lawula onke amakhaya kwisigqi ngokusebenza nangekuqonda ukuba ngokomthetho nangokwemali ukwaneliseka kokuhlinzekwa kwamasebe. Aba namandla okuyila kwaye alungise nomsebenzi wakhe nyalwakho abo abakunceda oko ukwanelisa isigqi sokuhlinzela ibhedi yokuhlonza. Phawula inkathalo ngemikhuhla, kukhuthaza nokulwela ukusombulula ukwenza nokunyanzeliswa kolunye kwaye naloluqhuba iinkonzo ezilula. Lawula ukunikelwa kwamasebe ukunika ngakumbi ngokuphila ngokwemfuno kwesigqi PHC. Thatha inxaxheba ngokubakho kwenzakalo kwiqumrhu elidala elondolwayo kwinkqubo yeOperation Sukuma Sakhe. Sebenza njengesigqi ngokulawula ezinye iinkonzo ukunyanzeliswa kolunye kolunye ekuhamba komsebenzi. Qamba inkqubo ekhankamsha kwabakhuhla, koluntu nakuluntu olunxibelelanayo koluntu olusoluluntu olusoluluntu lwezonyo kwesiya ezinye iinkqubo ezinye iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo. Lawula ikhadi lokwenza iinkonzo eziphephileyo kwaye ulusebenzise ukuphucula ulwazi kwabakhuselekileyo abambe iqhaza kwiinkqubo iNorms and Standards (OHSC). Nceda ngokusombulula isigqibo sokufikelela kwisigqi se-Ideal Clinic (ICRM). Yiba nendima ekujolisweni kwemigaqo yendalo nezento ezihlangabezana neNkonzo ezahlukeneyo zeNursing. Lawula ngokuqondileyo nangokungalawulekiyo abo basebenza ngaphakathi kwesigqi kwaye abanike isikhokelo. Qamba isilumkiso ngokukhululekileyo kwe-Human Resource kwaye ulawule inkqubo ngokwemiqathango nemali yolawulo. Hlola kwaye ulinganise ukukhululekileyo nangokulawula onke abakhuhla emva kokuqonda okanye abo basebenzayo kwesigqi ngokulawula iinkonzo ezindala. Yiba namandla okugalela abakhusela ngokuqondisa okukhabo ngokwekhompyutha ngokungqalisekileyo ngokubhala abakhusela abakhethiweyo abagcina igunya elilodwa ngakumbi lomntu onokucinga ngokubakho kwexesha i-PHC kwaye emva kwexesha kwiindawo ezikude nabakhethiweyo. Lawula iinkqubo zomthetho PHC nezinye iinkonzo ezilawulwa yinkqubo yoMthetho wezezimali ne-Human Resource; linganisa inkqubo yemizila yemigangatho yemini ngemihla, yamanga aphila ngokuphila, inyanga kwaye uqinisekise ngokuchonga ngokwemvisiswano kwaye uhlola idata yakho neNkonzo ekufuneka kuqondane nemithetho ekulawula uluntu lweNkonzo ezoqondwa ngumphathi. Lawula iinkqubo eziphathwayo nangokukhululekileyo nokungqalisa ukubakho kwamathandabuzo eNkonzo kunye nokuba ngokomthetho ngokomthetho weBhodi ngokutsha nokunyuka kwezinye izigqibo ngezinye iinkonzo ezinikezelwa kwindalo.

jobs.title: Clinical Programme Coordinator (TRAINING and
jobs.salary_text: R571 161 per annum. Plus 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional) and Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Clinical Programme Coordinator for training at Uthukela District Office, requiring a nursing diploma, SANC registration and seven years' experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12/ Matric Certificate. An appropriate B Degree / National Diploma or equivalent qualification in Nursing, PLUS. Minimum of 7 years appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Registration as a Midwife /Accoucheur with SANC. Computer Certificate- Ms Office (Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint) and post graduate qualification in Nursing Education will be an added advantage. Current Registration with SANC. Valid Driver’s License – Code 8 plus. Only Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of experience/ service certificate endorsed by HR Department Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Report writing. Knowledge on District Health Systems. Knowledge of relevant regulation and policies. An understanding of challenges facing the Public Health sector. Ability to translate and transform objectives into practical plan. Leadership, organisational, decision making and problem-solving abilities within the DHS framework
jobs.duties: Ensure alignment of all training plans to the National Development Plan. Coordinate the District training plan compilation. Prioritize training for priority programs. Work closely with other program managers to coordinate trainings. Coordinate, facilitate and attend training. Monitor the training health budget and ensure timeous procurement of all required resources. Procure all approved items in line with the business plan. Ensure that all funded RTC training is conducted and attendees contribute to improving health outcomes. Coordinate candidates to attend RTC Funded Provincial and District trainings. Monitor utilization of allocated resources. Monitor that all facilities are well covered in terms of training for comprehensive and quality service delivery. Facilitate execution of skills audit in all facilities. Develop a training plan target all facilities across the district to improve coverage of training items. Map all facilities not covered after every training. Develop catch-up plans for all facilities not covered. Participate in quality improvement programs and clinical audits. Conduct facility support visit using appropriate tools for relevant programs. Facilitate the signing of mentorship agreements for priority training and the linkage of training attendees to mentors. Conduct mentorship after all priority trainings. Attend performance review meetings quietly. Compile and manage data health care training providers, which can assist in extending the health care training function, including post training quality assessments. Facilitate the compilation of standardised attendance registers in all trainings. Coordinate reporting of all trainings to RTC and HRD through forwarding standardised completed attendance registers. Coordinate the district database for all trainings conducted and attended. Share attendance registers with relevant program managers and Sub-District after each training.
