af.title: Kliniese Programkoördineerder (OPLEIDING en
af.summary: Kliniese Programkoördineerder vir opleiding by Uthukela Distrikkantoor, vereis 'n verpleegkundediploma, SANC-registrasie en sewe jaar se ervaring.
af.requirements: Graad 12/ Matrik-sertifikaat. 'n Toepaslike B-graad / Nasionale Diploma of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde, PLUS. Minimum van 7 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegkunde-ervaring na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Registrasie as 'n Vroedvrou /Accoucheur by SANC. Rekenaarsertifikaat- Ms Office (Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint) en 'n nagraadse kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde-onderrig sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Huidige registrasie by SANC. Geldige bestuurslisensie – Kode 8 of hoër. Slegs gekorte lys kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van ervaring/ dienssertifikaat deur HR-departement onderskryf voor te lê. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Sterk interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagskrywing. Kennis van Distrikgesondheidstelsels. Kennis van toepaslike regulasies en beleide. 'n Begrip van uitdagings wat die Publieke Gesondheidssektor in die gesig staar. Vermoë om doelwitte te vertaal en te transformeer in 'n praktiese plan. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die DHS-raamwerk.
af.duties: Verseker belyning van alle opleidingsplanne met die Nasionale Ontwikkelingsplan. Koördineer samestelling van die distrikopleidingsplan. Prioritiseer opleiding vir prioriteitsprogramme. Werk nou saam met ander programbestuurders om opleidings te koördineer. Koördineer, fasiliteer en woon opleiding by. Monitor die opleidingsgesondheidsbegroting en verseer tydige verkryging van alle benodigde hulpbronne. Verkry alle goedgekeurde items in ooreenstemming met die besigheidsplan. Verseker dat alle gefinansierde RTC-opleiding uitgevoer word en dat bywoners bydrae tot die verbetering van gesondheidsuitkomste. Koördineer kandidate om RTC-gefianseerde provinsiale en distrikopleidings by te woon. Monitor benutting van toegewysde hulpbronne. Monitor dat alle fasiliteite behoorlik gedek word ten opsigte van opleiding vir omvattende en gehalte-dienslewering. Fasiliteer uitvoering van 'n vaardigheidsoudit in alle fasiliteite. Ontwikkel 'n opleidingsplan wat alle fasiliteite oor die distrik teiken om dekking van opleidingsitems te verbeter. Kartere alle fasiliteite wat na elke opleiding nie gedek is nie. Ontwikkel opvangsplanne vir alle fasiliteite wat nie gedek is nie. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme en kliniese oudits. Voer fasiliteitsondersteuningsbesoeke uit met toepaslike instrumente vir toepaslike programme. Fasiliteer ondertekening van mentorskapsreeksooreenkomste vir prioriteitsopleiding en die koppeling van opleidingsbywoners aan mentors. Voer mentorskap uit na alle prioriteitsopleidings. Woon prestasie-evalueringsvergaderings stilweg by. Stel saam en bestuur data van gesondheidsorg-opleidingsverskaffers, wat kan help om die gesondheidsorg-opleidingsfunksie uit te brei, insluitend na-opleiding gehalte-assesserings. Fasiliteer die samestelling van gestandaardiseerde bywoningsregisters in alle opleidings. Koördineer verslagdoening van alle opleidings aan RTC en HRD deur gestandaardiseerde voltooide bywoningsregisters te stuur. Koördineer die distrikdatabasis vir alle opleidings wat uitgevoer en bygewoon is. Deel bywoningsregisters met toepaslike programbestuurders en Sub-Distrik na elke opleiding.

zu.title: Umhlanganisi weNkuhlolwane kwezohwebo (UKUQOQWA kanye
zu.summary: Umhlanganisi weNkuhlolwane kwezohwebo eKantolo loMkhandlu wase-Uthukela, ofuna idiploma yokuhlinzeka, ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC kanye nenyimbo eminyakeni eyisikhombisa yokuhlola.
zu.requirements: Isitifikedi se-Grade 12/ Matric. I-Degree / National Diploma efanele noma iziqu ezilinganayo eNursing, PLUS. Okungenani unyaka abayisi-7 bokuhlola okufanele/okuhlonishwayo eNursing emva kokubhaliswa njengoNesiwePhezulu (Professional Nurse) e-SANC kwiNursing jikelele. Ukubhaliswa njengoMidwife /Accoucheur e-SANC. Isitifikedi seKhompyutha- Ms Office (Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint) kanye nokuqhuba iziqu eziphezulu (post graduate) eNursing Education kuyoba yinzuzo. Ukubhaliswa okwamanje e-SANC. Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni – Code 8 kanye nokweqa. Kuphela abagqwayezi abakhethwe okwamanje abazofuneka ukuthumela umboniso weminye yemisebenzi/ isitifikedi sezinsiza esiqinisekiswe umnyango we-HR Izazi, Amaxhono, Ukuqoqwa kanye namakhono afunekayo: Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu nokuthintana. Ukubhala imibiko. Ulwazi ngezinhlelo ze-District Health. Ulwazi nemiyalo nezinqumama ezihlukene. Ukuqonda izinselele ezibhekene nokuwohloka kwezomphakathi. Isikhathi sokuhumusha futhi wenze ukugqamisa izinhloso sibe yinhlelo yokuqoqisa. Amakhono obuholo, ukuhlelela, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokuxazula izinkinga ngaphakathi kohlaka le-DHS
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuhambisana kwezinhlelo zonke zokuqeqesha neNational Development Plan. Hlela ukuqeqelwa kokubhaliswa kwezinhlelo zeDistrict. Nika mkhathi omtlha wezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa. Sebenza kanyeabanini bezinhlelo abangewo ukwenza ukulungiselela izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa. Hlela, wenze futhi uhfole ekukhethwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Hlola umgodi wamaholo ekuqeqeshweni kwezempilo futhi uqinisekise ukuthengiswa ngesikhathi esifanele kwezinsiza zonke ezidingekayo. Thenga zonke izinto ezamukelwe kuye kwisitondedwa senhlangano nenhlelo yokuhweba. Qinisekisa ukuthi yonke imali ekelwe i-RTC yokugunundwa iyenziwa kanti nalabo abaholayo bengonye ekuthuthukisweni kwezempilo. Hlela abagqwayezi ukuba babambe iqhaza ekugunundweni kwe-RTC emaProvincial namaDistrict. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza ezingeni elifanele. Qapha ukuthi wonke amakhasi ezezempilo aqinisekiswe kakhulu ngokwezinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa ekuqoqeni kohlelo oluphelele nobuhle bokwenza umsebenzi. Wenze isilingo samakhono kumakhasi wonke amakhulu ezezempilo. Bumba isu lokugununda kumakhasi amakhulu wonke ezesifunda ukuba kuthuthuke isikhathi sokugununda izinto. Hlola wonke amakhulu angenasizo ngemuva kokugunundwa. Bumba izinhlela zokubamba kumakhasi wonke amakhulu angenasizo. Thatha inxaxheba ezinhlebeni zokuthuthukiswa kwekhono nokuhlolelwa kwezohwebo. Yenza ukuvakashela amakhulu ezezempilo ngokusebenzisa izinsiza eziwuwohhloka kumabalana akeba. Qinisekisa ukusayina izivumelwano zobulemi wezinhlelo eziphambene yokugununda kanti nalabo abagqwaye ngokugununda bahle abekwe kubantwana. Beka isibonelo sokuhlenga emva kokuqeqeshwa kwezinhlela eziphambili. Hamba emihlanganweni yokuqoqwa kokuhlolelwa ngokuzola. Qoqa futhi ulawule idatha yamahlinzeki wezempilo ezigunundweni, okungaluleka ekwandeni kweqoqi lezohwebo sigununda, kuhlanganise nokuqeqeshwa kohlelo lokuhlolelwa ngemva kokugununda. Wenze ukubumba imanqamula ejwayelekile yokuhlohlo kwesikhathi nakuzo zonke izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa. Hlela imibiko yezinhlelo zonke zokuqeqeshwa kwi-RTC ne-HRD ngokusika izinkomba ezijwayelekile ekubhaliseni okuphelele kwindawo yokubhaliswa. Lawula idathabhasi yesibili yonke imisebenzi egqunjiwe nasekuhlotsheni. Yabelane ngesiqalekiso sokugununda kubaphathi bahlebo kanye nomaSebukele ikhambi kwakho konke ukugununda.

xh.summary: iClinical Programme Coordinator yolwazi kwiUthukela District Office, ifuna idiploma yokuba ligqirha, ukubhaliswa kwiSANC kunye namava eminyaka elishumi elinesixhenxe.
xh.requirements: Izatifikethi yeGrade 12/Matric. IDiploma elungileyo yeB Degree/noma iNational Diploma okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo kwisiXhobo soGqirha, PLUS. Iminyaka elungeneyo ye-7 yamava agqithiweyo kwindawo yolwazi emva kokubhalisa njengoNongcali weProfessional Nurse kwiSANC kwisiXhobo soGqirha jikelele. Ukubhaliswa njengoMidwife/Accoucheur kwiSANC. IComputer Certificate - Ms Office (Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint) kwaye nesiXhobo seB Degree kwisiXhobo soGqirha siza kuba luncedo. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwiSANC. IIsaziso sokuba yiSokoli wee-8 elikhoyo. kuphela abagqibele iya kufuneka bafake iziqinisekiso zamava/inkonzo ezinamagama athethwa ngusebe leHR ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqesha namakhono aFunekayo: amakhono anamandla okubonisana nokunxibelelana. ukubhala iirepothi. ulwazi kwiinkqabo zezeempilo ezingundoqo. ulwazi ngemigaqo nemigaqo-ngqubo ezibalulekileyo. ukuqonda iingozi ezibhekiswa kwisebe lezempilo zikawonke-wonke. ukuba nokuba ukuguqula iinjongo zibe ziinkqubo ezisebenzayo. ukuba namakhono obuqu, ulawulo, ukwenza izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwesangqa seDHS.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba zonzi iindawo zolungiselelo zolwazi zihambelana neNational Development Plan. Lungiselela indlela yokwenziwa kwesicwangciso solwazi sesebe. Phawula olufanelekileyo ulwazi lweenkqubo ezibalulekileyo. Sebenza ndawonye nabaphathi balweenkqabo ukulungiselela ulwazi. Lungiselela, kwaphula izithintelo, ukuze kukho ulwazi olwenziwa kwaye ulungiselela nendlela abaya kuyo. Qwalasela imali echotiweyo yolwazi empilweni kwaye uqinisekise ukuthengwa kwexesha elifanelekileyo lemisebenzi efunekayo. Thenga zonke izinto ezamkelweyo ngokuhambelana nesicwangciso senyanga. Qinisekisa ukuba wonke ulwazi oluxhaswa yiRTC lwenziwa kwaye abathathi nxaxheba bagale ekuphuculeni iimpembelelo ezifana nezemfundo. Lungiselela abagqatswa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kulwazi lweProvincial neleDistrikthi exhaswa yiRTC. Qwalasela ukusetyenziswa kwemisebenzi ebaluliweyo. Qwalasela ukuba kukho ulwazi ngaphaya kweendawo ezininzi zeemfundo ezinokudlula ukuba inkqubo yasekhaya ihamba kakuhle kwaye inkonzo ibenechane. Lungiselela ukuphathwa kwesimo sobuchule kwiindawo ezahlukeneyo. Yila isicwangciso solwazi esijolisa kumacandelo onke eemfundo kunye nesebe ukuphucula ukubakho kokubakwa kolwazi kweendawo ezahlukeneyo. Hlela imisebenzi yonke engazange igqitywe emva kwalo lonke ulwazi. Yila izicwangciso zokubamba inxaxheba kumacandelo onke angazange agqitywe. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokuphucula izinga elithileyo kunye namaza obugcisa obuchele. Qwalasela ukwenziwa kweekhaya ezahlukeneyo ngokusebenzisa izixhobo ezifanelekileyo kwiinkqubo ezibalulekileyo. Lungiselela ukusayinwa kwezivumelwano zobulumko-msebenzi zolwazi olubalulekileyo kunye nokuqhubanisa abathathi-nxaxheba bolwazi nabagqatswa bobulumko-msebenzi. Yenza ubulumko-msebenzi emva kwanjani lolwazi olubalulekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kuwo onke amaza obugcisa obuchaziweyo. Qamba kwaye ulawule iinkcukacha zobungcali bolwazi bezempilo, ezinokunceda ekwandiseni inkqubo yolwazi bezempilo, kuquka iindlela zokuqwalasela izinga elithileyo emva kolwazi. Lungiselela indlela yokwenziwa kwabafundi abakhoyo kuwo onke amaza obugcisa obuchele. Qamba kwaye ulawule uluhlu lwabafundi abayinika inkqubo iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo kwaye ulungiselela indlela yokudlulisa iinkcukacha kwindlu yolwazi. Qamba kwaye ulawule iindlu yolwazi kumacandelo onke ukuba agcine iinkcukacha ezahlukeneyo. Yenza iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zobugcisa obuchele ngaphakathi kweendawo ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Ultra-sonographer
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R510 906 – R581 892 per annum Grade 2: R598 260 – R683 808 per annum Grade 3: R703 785 – R756 444 per annum Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Rural Allowance and Housing allowance: Prescribed requirements to be met.
jobs.summary: Ultra-sonographer position at Dannhauser CHC in KwaZulu-Natal, offering salaries across three grade levels with rural allowance and medical aid benefits.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: No experience after registration with the Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an ultra-sonographer in respect of RSA qualified employee who performed Community Service as required in South Africa. 1-year relevant experience after registration with HPCSA in respect of foreign qualified employees. Grade 2: Experience: A minimum of 10 years appropriate /recognisable experience after registration with HPCSA as an ultra-sonographer in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed community Service. 11 years’ experience after registration with HPCSA in respect of foreign qualified employees. Grade 3: Experience: A minimum of 20 years appropriate /recognisable experience after registration with HPCSA as an ultra-sonographer in respect of RSA qualified employees who performed Community Service. 21 years’ experience after registration with HPCSA in respect of foreign qualified employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service as required in South Africa. Grade 12/ Senior Certificate. Degree/ National Diploma in Ultrasound. Current registration with HPCSA as Sonographer. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies required for the post: Sound knowledge of Obstetrics and Gynaecology ultrasound. Sound knowledge of general ultrasound scans. Sound knowledge of Ultrasound procedures. Knowledge of relevant Health and Safety policies, regulations and acts. Sound report writing and administrative skills. Knowledge of Quality Assurance procedure and methods. Sound communication, interpersonal, problem solving, teaching and training skills. Good interpersonal relations and ability to perform with a team. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Provide high quality ultrasound services consistent with scope of practice and clinical standards. Provide high quality ultrasound services according to the patient’s needs. To promote good health practices and ensure optimal patient care. Execute all ultrasound procedure completely to prevent complications. Provide general administrative duties as required. Provide guidance and supervision to junior staff. Participate in multidisciplinary team as part of medical and allied team. Participate in institutional radiographic policy making and planning for service delivery. Promote Batho Pele Principles in the execution of all duties for effective service delivery. Give factual information to patients and clients on ultrasound examinations. Participate in departmental Quality Assurance, Quality Improvement Programmes and National Core Standards. Inspect and utilise equipment professionally to ensure that they comply with safety standards. Develop protocols to ensure that sonographic services comply with the required prescripts. Participate in ultrasound quality assurance programmes. Participate in Continued Professional Development (CPD) programmes. Compile report and memos as required in the working environment. Assist with ultrasound patient booking. Perform other duties as per delegation by radiography management.
jobs.enquiries: Dr FP Mtshali Tel No: (034) 621 6100

af.title: Ultra-sonograaf
af.summary: Ultra-sonograafpos by Dannhauser CHC in KwaZulu-Natal, wat salarisse oor drie graadvlakke bied met landelike toelaag en mediese hulpvoordele.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Ervaring: Geen ervaring na registrasie by die Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n ultra-sonograaf ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis, verrig het. 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Graad 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n ultra-sonograaf ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens verrig het. 11 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Graad 3: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA as 'n ultra-sonograaf ten opsigte van RSA-gekwalifiseerde werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens verrig het. 21 jaar se ervaring na registrasie by HPCSA ten opsigte van buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers van wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens soos in Suid-Afrika vereis, te verrig nie. Graad 12/Seniorsertifikaat. Graad/Nasionale Diploma in Ultrasound. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA as Sonograaf. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis vir die pos: Deeglike kennis van Verloskunde en Ginekologie-ultraklank. Deeglike kennis van algemene ultraklankskanderings. Deeglike kennis van ultraklankprosedures. Kennis van tersaaklike Gesondheids- en Veiligheidsbeleid, regulasies en wette. Deeglike verslagskryf- en administratiewe vaardighede. Kennis van Kwaliteitsversekeringsprosedures en -metodes. Deeglike kommunikasie-, interpersoonlike, probleemoplossings-, onderrig- en opleidingsvaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en vermoë om in 'n span te funksioneer. Rekenaarvaardigheid.
af.duties: Verskaf hoë gehalte ultraklankdienste in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en kliniese standaarde. Verskaf hoë gehalte ultraklankdienste volgens die pasiënt se behoeftes. Om goeie gesondheidspraktyke te bevorder en optimale pasiëntsorg te verseker. Voer alle ultraklankprosedures volledig uit om komplikasies te voorkom. Verskaf algemene administratiewe pligte soos vereis. Verskaf leiding en toesig aan junior personeel. Neem deel aan multidissiplinêre span as deel van mediese en verwante span. Neem deel aan institusionele radiografiese beleidbepaling en beplanning vir dienslewering. Bevorder Batho Pele-beginsels by die uitvoering van alle pligte vir effektiewe dienslewering. Verskaf feitelike inligting aan pasiënte en kliënte oor ultraklankondersoeke. Neem deel aan departementele Kwaliteitsversekering, Kwaliteitsverbeteringsprogramme en Nasionale Kernstandaarde. Inspekteer en gebruik toerusting professioneel om te verseker dat dit aan veiligheidsstandaarde voldoen. Ontwikkel protokolle om te verseker dat sonografiese dienste aan die vereiste voorskrifte voldoen. Neem deel aan ultraklankkwaliteitsversekeringsprogramme. Neem deel aan Volgehoue Professionele Ontwikkeling (CPD)-programme. Stel verslae en memo's soos in die werksomgewing vereis op. Bied hulp met ultraklankpasiëntbespreking. Voer ander pligte uit soos gedelegeer deur radiografiebestuur.

zu.title: Umma-sonographer
zu.summary: Isikhundla somma-sonographer eDannhauser CHC eKwaZulu-Natal, esinikeza amaholo kuzo zonke izinga ezintathu zesigaba ngesibonezelo sasemaphandleni nezinzuzo zosizo lwezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Igrade 1: Isiphephelo: Alikho iphephu emva kokuqoshwa kwi-Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomma-sonographer mayelana nomsebenzi oqeqeshiwe kwa-RSA oenze imisebenzi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Unyaka oyi-1 wokuphepha okuhambisana nalokhu emva kokuqoshwa kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe koMbuso wangeNkathi. Igrade 2: Isiphephelo: Okungenani iminyaka engu-10 yokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana/okwaziwayo emva kokuqoshwa kwi-HPCSA njengomma-sonographer mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwa-RSA abenza imisebenzi yomphakathi. Iminyaka engu-11 yokuqeqeshwa emva kokuqoshwa kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe koMbuso wangeNkathi. Igrade 3: Isiphephelo: Okungenani iminyaka engu-20 yokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana/okwaziwayo emva kokuqoshwa kwi-HPCSA njengomma-sonographer mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwa-RSA abenza imisebenzi yomphakathi. Iminyaka engu-21 yokuqeqeshwa emva kokuqoshwa kwi-HPCSA mayelana nabasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe koMbuso wangeNkathi okuyiwona okungadingeki ukwenze imisebenzi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Igrade 12/ Isitifikedi Esiphezulu. Idegree/ iDiploma Yezwe kwi-Ultrasound. Ukuqoshwa kwesikhathi esithi manje kwi-HPCSA njengomlinganisi womsindo. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa kanye namandla okusebenza adingekayo kulesi sikhundla: Ulwazi olujulile lokubona ngokomsindo kwe-Obstetrics ne-Gynaecology. Ulwazi olujulile kokubona ngokomsindo jikelele. Ulwazi olujulile lwenqubo yokubona ngokomsindo. Ulwazi lwezinqumela-magama namasu wobuSempilo nokuvikeleka. Amakhono ajulile okubhala imibiko kanye nokulawula. Ulwazi lwenqubo nokuqinisekisa izinga kanye namasu. Amakhono ajulile okuxhumana, kokuhlobana, kokuxazulula izinkinga, kokufundisa kanye nokuqeqesha. Ubuhlobo obuhle phakathi kwabantu kanye namandla okusebenza phakathi kwethimba. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha.
zu.duties: Nikela ngezinsiza zobungcweti bokubona ngokomsindo ezihambisana nendawo yokwenza umsebenzi nezinqubo zokwelapha ezijwayelekile. Nikela ngezinsiza zobungcweti bokubona ngokomsindo ngokwesidingo somphumela. Ukuthuthukisa izindlela ezinhle zempilo kanye nokuqinisekisa ukunakekelwa okuphelele komphumela. Qeda yonke inqubo yokubona ngokomsindo ngokugcwele ukuze kuqathanwe izinkinga ezingase zibe khona. Yenza wonke umsebenzi wezokulawula njengoba kudingiwe. Nikeza isiqondiso kanye nokuqondisa abasebenzi abasezingeni eliphansi. Ukubambe iqhaza kthimba elihlangene njengengxenye yethimba lokwelapha nangcolile. Ukubambe iqhaza ekwakheni nqumela-magama esikhungweni sokubona ngokusithombe nokuhlela ukulethwa kwenkonzo. Ukukhuthaza Izimiso ze-Batho Pele ekwenzeni imisebenzi yonke ukuze kube khona ukuhlelwa kwenkonzo. Nikeza ulwazi oluqinisekile abaphilayo nakabathengi ngokuhlolwa ngokomsindo. Ukubambe iqhaza ekuqinisekisweni kwebangani leQiniso, izinhlelo zokuphucula izinga kanye nezimo ezibalulekile zezwe. Hlola futhi usebenzise izinsiza ngobungcweti ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi zihambisana nezimo zokuvikeleka. Bheka izinqubo ezizokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zobungcweti zobuso zihambisana nezinqumela ezidingwayo. Ukubambe iqhaza kwezinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ubukhali bokubona ngokomsindo. Ukubambe iqhaza kwezinhlelo zokuQeqesha ngobungcweti futhi aze athuthuke (CPD). Lenga imibiko namamuva njengoba kudingiwe esikhundleni sokusebenza. Siza ngokubhukuda abafundi bokubona ngomsindo. Yenza omunye umsebenzi njengoba kumiselwe ngabaphathi bokubona ngokusithombe.

xh.title: I-Ultra-sonographer
xh.summary: Isithuba se-Ultra-sonographer e-Dannhauser CHC KwaZulu-Natal, esinika umvuzo kwiinqanaba ezintathu zamagrade ngomrhobo wasezihlalweni zasemazweni nezinzuzo zosizo lwezempilo.
xh.requirements: I-Grade 1: Ulwazi lolwangqesho: Akukho lwazi lolwangqesho emva kokubhalisa kwi-Health Profession Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njenge-ultra-sonographer ngokumayelana nomsebenzi waseR wamagqabi owenze i-Community Service njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. Unyaka we-1 wolwazi olufanelekileyo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA ngokumayelana nabasebenzi bakwangamanye amazwe. I-Grade 2: Ulwazi lolwangqesho: Ubuncinci beminyaka elishumi yolwazi olufanelekileyo/olunokubonakalayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njenge-ultra-sonographer ngokumayelna nomsebenzi waseR wamagqabi owenze i-Community Service. Iminyaka elishumi nethunga yolwazi emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA ngokumayelna nabasebenzi bakwangamanye amazwe. I-Grade 3: Ulwazi lolwangqesho: Ubuncinci beminyaka elingamashumi amabini yolwazi olufanelekileyo/olunokubonakalayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njenge-ultra-sonographer ngokumayelna nomsebenzi waseR wamagqabi owenze i-Community Service. Iminyaka elingamashumi amabini nethunga yolwazi emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA ngokumayelna nabasebenzi bakwangamanye amazwe abangekufuneki baze benze i-Community Service njengoko kufuneka eMzantsi Afrika. I-Grade 12/ I-Senior Certificate. Isidanga/ I-National Diploma kwi-Ultrasound. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengo-Sonographer. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho kunye namakhono afunekayo kwesi sithuba: Ulwazi olunyangayo nge-Obstetrics and Gynaecology ultrasound. Ulwazi olunyangayo ngezikulinganiso jikelele ze-ultrasound. Ulwazi olunyangayo ngeendlela zokwenza i-Ultrasound. Ulwazi ngeemp policies, imigaqo kunye namagazathwana ezezoZempilo nokuKhuseleko ezifanelekileyo. Amakhono olubhala iireport kunye nezabaphathiwo ezinyangayo. Ulwazi ngeendlela ngezindlela zokuQinisekisa umgangatho. Amakhono oluthetha lunye, obantu abangenabanye bokuziphatha nokuzonceda, ekuqondisa iingxaki, nokufundisa nokutraina. Ubudlelwane obulungileyo nobantu kwaye ukwazi ukusebenza ngethimu. Ulwazi lokusebenzela ikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Kuvakalelwe ukubonelela ngeenkonzo ze-Ultrasound zamagagela alo mthetho wokuziphatha ngokwemigaqo yamagqabi. Kubonelelwe ngeenkonzo ze-Ultrasound zamagagela ngokwemfuno yesigulane. Baluleke amalungelo obomi obulungileyo baze baqinisekise ukhathalelo olugqunywe kakhulu. Kubonelelwe ngokwenza iindwendwe zonke iindlela ze-Ultrasound ngokuphela ukuzinza iingxaki. Kuvakalelwe ukubonelela ngemisebenzi yolawulo jikelele njengoko kufuneka. Kubonelelwa ngokuqonda nokuyala abasebenzi abasezantsi. Kuvakalelwe ukuba nabambe iqhaza kwithimu ebanzi kwaye njengesigxoba sabaphathiwo basemzimbeni nabanamanye. Kuvakalelwe ukuba nabambe iqhaza ekusekweni kwemigaqo yefilimu yorhwebo nakulwangqesho lweenkonzo. Baluleke iindwendwe ezithi 'Batho Pele' ekuphumezeni yonke imisebenzi ukuze kube khona iinkonzo ezingagqitywanga ngokuchanekileyo. Kuvakalelwe ukunikela iinkcukacha eziyinyaniso kubagulane nabaxhasi ngeendwendwe ze-Ultrasound. Kuvakalelwe ukuba nabambe iqhaza kwindlela zokuQinisekisa umGangatho, iinkqubo zokuPhucula umGangatho kwiNtlangano nakumGangatho oBuncinci weSizwe. Kuvakalelwe ukutshintshela nokusebenzisa izixhobo ngokuchanekileyo ukuze bagqithise ukuba zigqithise kwimigaqo yokhuseleko. Baluleke iimphumelelo ezakuzo ukuze baqinisekise ukuba iinkonzo ze-sonographic zithobela imigaqo edelaya. Kuvakalelwe ukuba nabambe iqhaza kwiinkqubo zokuQinisekisa umGangatho we-Ultrasound. Kuvakalelwe ukuba nabambe iqhaza kwiinkqubo ze-Continued Professional Development (CPD). Kuvakalelwe ukulungiselela iireport kunye namagqabaxa njengoko kufuneka kwimeko yokusebenza. Kuvakalelwe ukunceda ngebhukiingi labagulane kwi-Ultrasound. Kuvakalelwe ukwenza omnye umsebenzi njengoko umiswe ngurhulumente wokulawula i-radiography.

jobs.title: Chief Artisan
jobs.salary_text: R499 470 per annum. Plus 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional) and Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed requirements)
jobs.summary: Chief Artisan needed at the KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health to oversee infrastructure, conduct site inspections, and rectify building complaints at clinic sites.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate (Grade 12) or equivalent; Appropriate Trade Test Certificate in terms of section 13(2)(h) of the Manpower Act of 1981 as amended Valid driver’s license, ten years post qualification experience required as an Artisan/Artisan Foreman. Only Shortlisted candidates will be required to submit proof of experience/ service certificate endorsed by HR Department Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Project management technical design and analysis knowledge Computer-aided technical applications Knowledge of legal compliance technical report writing technical consulting Production, process knowledge and skills Problem solving and analysis Decision making Change management financial management Customer focus and responsiveness Communication Computer skills Planning and organizing.
jobs.duties: Investigate and rectify complaints from staff and community members on infrastructural matters. To perform frequent site inspections during building and construction operations to ensure that specifications and plans are adhered to. Inspect possible new clinic sites and provide technical guidance in the planning and the maintenance of existing clinics to prevent and alleviate construction and maintenance difficulties. Attend planning and process meetings and PHC clinics meetings to identify deficiencies and possible areas for improvement. Ensure the effective, efficient and economical management of allocated resources and provide emergency responses to incidents of disaster and damage to infrastructure by mobilizing contractors and service providers to assist with repairs.

af.title: Hoof-ambagsman
af.summary: Hoof-ambagsman benodig by die KwaZulu-Natal Department of Health om infrastruktuur te oorsien, werkskoplewerkondersoeke uit te voer en bouklakte by klinieke te herstel.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate (Grade 12) of gelykwaardig; Toepaslike Trade Test Sertifikaat volgens artikel 13(2)(h) van die Manpower Act van 1981 soos gewysig; Geldige bestuurslisensie, tien jaar se ervaring na kwalifikasie vereis as 'n Artisan/Artisan Foreman. Slegs kortelys-kandidate sal vereis word om bewys van ervaring/dienssertifikaat deur HR-departement onderskryf voor te lê; Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Projekbestuur, tegniese ontwerp en analise-kennis; Rekenaargesteunde tegniese toepassings; Kennis van regsgelykstelling, tegniese verslagskrywing, tegniese konsultasie; Produksie- en proseskennis en -vaardighede; Probleemoplossing en analise; Besluitneming; Veranderingsbestuur; Finansiële bestuur; Kliëntfokus en reaksievermoë; Kommunikasie; Rekenaarvaardighede; Beplanning en organisering.
af.duties: Ondersoek en herstel klagtes van personeel en gemeenskapslede oor infrastruktuur-aangeleenthede. Voer gereelde werkskoplewerkondersoeke tydens bou- en konstruksiebedrywighede uit om te verseker dat spesifikasies en planne nagekom word. Inspekteer moontlike nuwe kliniekterreine en verskaf tegniese leiding by die beplanning en die instandhouding van bestaande klinieke om konstruksie- en instandhoudingsprobleme te voorkom en te verlig. Woon beplannings- en prosesvergaderings en PHC-kliniekvergaderings by om tekortkominge en moontlike areas vir verbetering te identifiseer. Verseker die effektiewe, doeltreffende en ekonomiese bestuur van toegewysde hulpbronne en verskaf noodreaksies op voorvalle van rampe en skade aan infrastruktuur deur kontrakteurs en diensverskaffers te mobiliseer om met herstelwerk te help.

zu.title: I-Artisan Ephethe
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Artisan ephethe emnyangweni weKwaZulu-Natal Department of Health ukuze igadle imikhakha yangaphakathi, ibheke amaphoyinti, futhi ilungise izikhalo mayelana nezakhiwo emaphoyini amakiliniki.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate (Grade 12) noma okulinganayo; Isitifiketi esifanele sokuhlolwa kwesebenzi ngokusho kwesigaba 13(2)(h) somthetho weManpower Act of 1981 njengoba ulungisiwe Ilayisensi yokuqasha esemthethweni, kudingeka iminyaka eyishumi yamava emva kokuthola isifundo njengesebenzi somuntu ohlinzela ngamakhono/Artisan Foreman. Abantu abakhiwe ohlwini abafushane kupheli bobe badingeka ukuthi balethe ubufakazi bamava/isitifiketi sezenzo esigxekiwe ngumnyango we-HR Knowledge, Skills, Training And Competencies Required: Ulwazi lokuphathwa kwephrojekthi, ukwakhiwa ngobuchwepheshe kanye nokuhlaziya. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ngekhompyutha ezisekelwe ngobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi lokuhambisana nomthetho, ukubhala imibiko yezobuchwepheshe, nokweluleka ngobuchwepheshe. Ulwazi namakhono ekukhiqizeni nasekuhlelweni inqubo. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukwenza izinqumo. Ukuphathwa koshintsho, ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukuqonda ikhasimende futhi uphendule. Ukuxhumana. Amakhono ekhompyutha. Ukuhlela nokuhlelela.
zu.duties: Phenya futhi ulungise izikhalo zabasebenzi nakwabahlali bephakethe mayelana nezindaba zokwakha. Ukwenza ukubhekisiswa okuvamile kwamaphoyinti lapho kwenziwa khona izakhiwo nokwakhiwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi kulandelwa imiyalelo namaphulani. Bheka amaphoyinti amasha okungenzeka abe amakiliniki futhi uhlinzeke ngokuhlakanipha okusemgangenikho ekuhlelweni nasekugcineni amakiliniki akhona ukuze kugwambe futhi kuncishelwe izinkinga zokwakha nokulungisa. Hlanganyela emihlanganweni yokuhlela nokwenza umsebenzi kanye namahlelo amakiliniki we-PHC ukuze kutholwe okungahambi kahle kanye namaphoyinti okungenzeka ngawo ukuthuthukiswa. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa ngokusebenza kahle, ngokusebenza ngempumelelo nangokonga kwemithombo ebnikiwe futhi uhlinzeke ngempendulo yesimo esiphuthumayo ezimeni zezinguquko nokonakala kwemikhakha yangaphakathi ngokubumba abakhi futhi abahlinzeki besebenza ukulekelela ekulungenisweni.

xh.title: IChief Artisan
xh.summary: Kufuneka iChief Artisan eKwaZulu-Natal Department of Health ukulawula isiseko sezakhiwo, ukwenza iingqwalasela zesiza, nokulungisa iingxaki ezimalunga nezakhiwo ezikwindawo zeekliniki.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate (Grade 12) okanye esilinganayo; Isatifikethi esifanelekileyo soVavanyo lweMisebenzi ngokweqela 13(2)(h) loMthetho weManpower ka-1981 njengoko ulungisiwe Ilayisenisi yomqhubi esebenzayo, iiminyaka elishumi ngemva kwesatifikethi efuna amava njengoMsebenzisi/Onogada abasebenzisi. Kuphela abantu ababekwe kuluhlu abaya kufuneka bangeze ubungqina bamava/isatifikethi senkonzo esiqinisekiswe liSebe le-HR Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho kunye neNkqubo efunekayo: Ulwazi lokuLawula iiprojekthi, ukuyila ngokobuchwepheshe nokusikida Ulwazi lwesicelo sobuchwepheshe esisebenzisa ikhompyutha Ulwazi lokuzeleleko ngokomthetho, ubhalo lweengxelo zobuchwepheshe, ingcebiso zobuchwepheshe Ukuvelisa, ulwazi lwenkqubo namandla Ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqwalasela Ukwenza izigqibo Ulawulo lwezoshintsho, ulawulo lweemali Ukuqwalasela abathengi nokuphendula Unxibelelwano Amandla ekhompyutha Ukuqwalasela nokuqwalasela.
xh.duties: Phononononga ulungise iingxaki eziveliswa ngabasebenzi nakuluntu malunga nemicimbi yesiseko sezakhiwo. Ukwenza iingqwalasela ezivamile zesiza ngexesha lokwakhiwa nokuqulunqwa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kugcinwa iinkcazelo neendlela ezicwangciswayo. Qwalasela iindawo ezitsha ezinokubakwa iikliniki kunye nokunikela isikhokelo esingcali ekuqwalaselweni nasekugcineni iikliniki ezikhoyo ukuze kuthintelwe kunye nokunciphisa iingxaki zokwakha nasekugcineni. Ukubakhona kwabasebenzi kwintlanganiso yokucwangcisa nenkqubo kunye namagumbi e-PHC clinics ukuze kuqatshwe iingxaki kunye namawonga anokuphuculwa. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo, olusetyenziswa kakuhle nolugcina imali lwemithxeba ebaluliweyo, yonike imibongo emva kwexesha kumngeni weeziqhingamfazwe kolonakalo lwesiseko sezakhiwo ngokubumba abathengi nabakho nzinzisi ukuba bancede ngokulungisa.

jobs.centre: Ilembe Health District Office (KwaDukuza Primary Health Care)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 - R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 - R752 913 per annum Plus 8% rural allowance Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical aid (optional), and Housing Allowance (Employee must meet prescribed requirements).
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner providing comprehensive primary health care services in the Ilembe Health District, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic PHC qualification.
jobs.requirements: Minimum Requirements for the post: Grade 1: Matric Certificate or Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) Diploma or Degree in General Nursing Science and Midwifery that allows registration with SANC as a General Nurse, plus (1) year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) plus, Registration Certificate with SANC as a General Nurse with Midwifery and Primary Health Care, plus, Current Registration with SANC (2024) A minimum of 4 years appropriate/ recognizable nursing experience as s General Nurse. Minimum Requirements for the post: Grade 2: Matric Certificate or Grade 12 (Senior Certificate) Diploma or Degree in General Nursing Science and Midwifery that allows registration with SANC as a General Nurse, plus (1) year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC Registration Certificate with SANC as a General Nurse with Midwifery and Primary Health Care, plus, Current Registration with SANC (2024). A minimum of 14 years appropriate/ recognizable nursing experience after registration as s General Nurse with SANC of which 10 years of the period must be appropriate/ recognizable PHC experience after obtaining a one year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care. NB: Please note that most of the Clinics in KwaDukuza Sub District operates from 07h00 to 18h00. KwaDukuza Clinic operates over 24 hours, Mpumelelo and Groutville Clinic operates on call after 18h00. Staff may be requested to relieve/ allocated in any of the nine (09) facilities within the Sub District if and when the need arises. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competence Required: Knowledge of all applicable legislations such as Nursing Acts, Mental Acts, OH & S Act, Batho Pele Principles and Patient’s Rights Charter, Labour Relations Act, Grievance procedure, etc. Leadership, organizational, decision making and problem solving, conflict handling and counselling. Good listening and communication skills. Co- ordination and planning skills. Team building and supervisory skills. Good interpersonal relationship skills. Good insight of procedures and policies pertaining to nursing care. Ability to assist in information of patient care related policies.
jobs.duties: Provide quality comprehensive Primary Health Care by providing promotive, preventive, curative and rehabilitative services for the clients and community. Ensuring proper utilization and safekeeping of basic medical equipment, surgical and pharmaceutical stock. Assist in orientation, induction and monitoring of all nursing staff. Provide direct and indirect supervision of all nursing staff and to give guidance. To provide nursing care that leads to improved health service delivery by upholding principles of Batho Pele. Execute duties and functions with proficiency and perform duties according to scope of practice. Implement infection control standards and practices to improve quality nursing care. Assist with conducting clinical audits and developing quality improvement plans. Improve the knowledge of staff and patients through health education and in service training. Implement Nursing care standards, and practices for quality nursing care according to guidelines and prescripts. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders, implementation of the Integrated Multi Stakeholder Health Promotion Strategy. Management of patients records, both written and electronic. Ensuring proper utilization of Human, material and financial resources and keeping up to date records of resources. Ability to plan and organise own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care in the clinic. Motivate junior staff regarding development in order to increase level of expertise and assist patients to develop a sense of self-care. Strengthen data systems and treatment outcomes by assisting and capturing on Tier.net. Ensure the collection, collation and timeous submission of accurate verified data. Support the realisation and maintenance of an ideal Clinic and OHSC Programme in the facility.

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (PHC)
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (PHC) wat omvattende primêre gesondheidsorgdienste in die Ilembe Health District verskaf, met SANC-registrasie en 'n post-basiese PHC-kwalifikasie as vereiste.
af.requirements: Minimum Vereistes vir die pos: Graad 1: Matrieksertifikaat of Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat) Diploma of Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vroukunde wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige toelaat, plus (1) jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde, Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en Sorg (PHC) plus, Registrasiesertifikaat by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige met Vroukunde en Primêre Gesondheidsorg, plus, Huidige Registrasie by SANC (2024). 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare verpleegervaring as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige. Minimum Vereistes vir die pos: Graad 2: Matrieksertifikaat of Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat) Diploma of Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde en Vroukunde wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige toelaat, plus (1) jaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkunde, Gesondheidsassessering, Behandeling en Sorg (PHC) Registrasiesertifikaat by SANC as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige met Vroukunde en Primêre Gesondheidsorg, plus, Huidige Registrasie by SANC (2024). 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/herkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie as 'n Algemene Verpleegkundige by SANC waarvan 10 jaar van die periode toepaslike/herkenbare PHC-ervaring moet wees na verkryging van 'n eenjaar post-basiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. NB: Neem asseblief kennis dat die meeste van die klinieke in KwaDukuza Sub-distrik van 07h00 tot 18h00 funksioneer. KwaDukuza Kliniek funksioneer oor 24 uur, Mpumelelo en Groutville Kliniek funksioneer op roep na 18h00. Personeel kan versoek word om aflos/toegekent te word in enigeen van die nege (09) fasiliteite binne die Sub-distrik as en wanneer die behoefte ontstaan. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdheid Vereis: Kennis van alle toepaslike wetgewing soos Nursing Acts, Mental Acts, OH & S Act, Batho Pele-beginsels en Pasiënt se Regtehandves, Labour Relations Act, Grievance procedure, ens. Leierskap, organisatoriese, besluitneming en probleemoplossing, konflikhantering en berading. Goeie luister- en kommunikasievaardighede. Koördinasie- en beplanningsvaardighede. Spanbou- en toesighoudende vaardighede. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudingsvaardighede. Goeie insig in prosedures en beleide rakende verpleegsorg. Vermöë om te help met inligting van pasiëntsorgverwante beleide.
af.duties: Verskaf gehalte omvattende Primêre Gesondheidsorg deur die verskaffing van bevorderende, voorkomende, kuratiewe en rehabilitasiedienste vir kliënte en die gemeenskap. Verseker behoorlike benutting en veilige bewaring van basiese mediese toerusting, chirurgiese en farmaseutiese voorraad. Help met oriëntasie, inductie en monitering van alle verpleegpersoneel. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor alle verpleegpersoneel en gee leiding. Verskaf verpleegsorg wat lei tot verbeterde gesondheidsdienslewering deur die handhawing van Batho Pele-beginsels. Voer pligte en funksies met vaardigheid uit en verrig pligte volgens die omvang van praktyk. Implementeer infeksiebeheerstandaarde en -praktyke om gehalte verpleegsorg te verbeter. Help met die uitvoer van kliniese oudite en die ontwikkeling van gehalteverbeteringsplanne. Verbeter die kennis van personeel en pasiënte deur gesondheidsopvoeding en in-diens opleiding. Implementeer verpleegsorgstandaarde en -praktyke vir gehalte verpleegsorg volgens riglyne en voorskifte. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleeg- en ander belanghebbendes, implementering van die Geïntegreerde Multi-Belanghebbende Gesondheidsbevorderingsstrategie. Bestuur van pasiëntrekords, beide geskrewe en elektronies. Verseker behoorlike benutting van menslike, materiële en finansiële hulpbronne en die byhou van op-datum rekords van hulpbronne. Vermöë om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg in die kliniek te verseker. motiveer junior personeel aangaande ontwikkeling om die vlak van kundigheid te verhoog en help pasiënte om 'n gevoel van selfversorging te ontwikkel. Versterk datastelsels en behandelingsuitkomste deur te help en op Tier.net vas te lê. Verseker die versameling, kollasie en tydige indiening van akkurate geverifieerde data. Ondersteun die verwesenliking en instandhouding van 'n ideale Kliniek en OHSC-program in die fasiliteit.

zu.title: Umqondisi wezokwelapha ohlinzayo (PHC)
zu.summary: Umqondisi wezokwelapha ohlinzayo ohlinzeka ngamasevisi abanzi ezenkolo yezempilo ekuqaleni esifundazweni sezempilo sa Ilembe, ofuna ukubhaliswa ku-SANC nokuqeqeshwa ngemva kwesikhundla esiyisisekelo se-PHC.
zu.requirements: Izidingo eyingquza yaleso sikhundla: Izinga 1: Isitifiketi se-Matric noma i-Grade 12 (Isitifiketi Esiphezulu) I-Diploma noma i-Degree kwi-Nursing Science jikelele kanye ne-Midwifery evumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengogwayi jikelele, kanye nokqeqeshwa kwemva kwesikhundla kweminyaka elingu-(1) ku-Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) kanye nesitifiketi sokubhaliswa ku-SANC njengogwayi jikelele obe ne-Midwifery kanye ne-Primary Health Care, kanye nokubhaliswa kwamanje ku-SANC (2024) Okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yohlulo olufanele/oluvelelekile bokube umongi njengogwayi jikelele. Izidingo eyingquza yaleso sikhundla: Izinga 2: Isitifiketi se-Matric noma i-Grade 12 (Isitifiketi Esiphezulu) I-Diploma noma i-Degree kwi-Nursing Science jikelele kanye ne-Midwifery evumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengogwayi jikelele, kanye nokqeqeshwa kwemva kwesikhundla kweminyaka elingu-(1) ku-Clinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) Isitifiketi sokubhaliswa ku-SANC njengogwayi jikelele obe ne-Midwifery kanye ne-Primary Health Care, kanye nokubhaliswa kwamanje ku-SANC (2024). Okungenani iminyaka engu-14 yohlulo olufanele/oluvelelekile bokube umongi emva kokuqashelwa njengogwayi jikelele ku-SANC okuyilapho iminyaka engu-10 kuleyo minyaka kufanele kube nguhlulo olufanele/oluvelelekile lwe-PHC emva kokuthola ukqeqeshwa kwemva kwesikhundla kweminyaka engu-1 ku-Primary Health Care. NB: Qaphela ukuthi iningi lezikhungma zokwelapha e-KwaDukuza Sub District zisebenza kusukela ku-07h00 kuya ku-18h00. Isikhungma zokwelapha sase-KwaDukuza sisebenza amahora angu-24, i-Mpumelelo ne-Groutville Clinic ziba sisebenza esiye esibizeni emva kuka-18h00. Abasebenzisi bangacelwa ukuba bazosiza/babelwe kunoma iyiphi kwezikhungma ezingiyisishiyagalolunye (09) ngaphakathi kwe-Sub District uma sibe sikhona isidingo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa nokuZwana okudingekayo: Ulwazi ngawo onke umthetho oshile ngokufana nokuthi Nursing Acts, Mental Acts, OH & S Act, Izimiso zika-Batho Pele kanye ne-Patient's Rights Charter, Labour Relations Act, inqubo yezikhalazo, njengenjalo. Ubuqhawe, ukuhleleka, ukwenza izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga, ukuphathwa kwezinxaxhi kanye nenxaxhi. Amakhono okulalela nokuxhumana ahle. Amakhono oku-hlela nokuqamba izinhlelo. Amakhono okwakha iqembu nokuqondisa. Amakhono amahle wokwakha ubuhlobo. Ukuqonda okuhle kwezinqubo nezinqema ezithinta ukunakekelwa kokugula. Isikhondo sosizo ekwakheni izinqema ezithinta ukunakekelwa kwesiguli.
zu.duties: Hlinzeka ngamasevisi aqinisekisiwe abanzi ezenkolo yezempilo ekuqaleni ngokuphakamisa, thintela, welapha futhi ubuyisisele abantu kanye nomphakathi. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa nokuqanjelwa ukuphepha kwegumbi lokungcwela izinto zokwelapha, zokuhlinza kanye nezinkwemfihlo zokwelapha. Siza ekuletheni, ekufungeni nasekuqaphelelweni konke oqashiyo bokunakekela. Hlinzeka ngokuqondisa ngokuqondile nangokungaqondile konke oqashiyo bokunakekela uphinde unikeze isiqondiso. Hlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kokugula okuholela ekuthi ukulethwa kwezinsizakalo zezempilo kuthuthukise ngokugcina izimiso zika-Batho Pele. Phatha imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi ngekhono futhi wenze imisebenzi ngokwesibalo sokusebenza. Phatha izindinganiso kanye nezinqubo zokuqamba amashele ukuthuthukisa inqondo yokunakekelwa kokugula. Siza ukwenza ukuhlola ezokwelapha futhi wakhe izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa inqondo. Thuthukisa ulwazi loqashiyo kanye neziguli ngokufundisa ngempilo nangokuqeqeshwa ngaphakathi. Phatha izindinganiso zokunakekelwa, futhi zenze izinqubo zekhono zokunakekelwa ngokwemiyalo nokuqondiswayo. Gcina ubudlelwano obuziyo bokusebenza nabongi kanye nabanye abahlubuki, ekusebenzeni kwe-Integrated Multi Stakeholder Health Promotion Strategy. Ukuphathwa kwezinkomba zeziguli, kokubili okubhaliwe kanye nkokubhalisiwe ngokugqamisa. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okuhle kwezimfihlo ezingemvelo, izinto ezibonakalayo kanye nezimali futhi ugcine izinkomba ezibuyekeziwe ezinsizakalweni. Isikhondo sokuhlela nokuqamba umsebenzi wakho noka basekelayo ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa okuhle kwesiguli esikhungmeni. Khuthaza oqashiyo abangaphansi ngokuthuthukiswa ukuze kwenyuswe izinga lekhono futhi usize iziguli ukuba zenze ngokuzinakekela. Qinisekisa izinto ezibhalwayo kanye nemiphumela yokwelapha ngokwesiza kanye nokubhala ku-Tier.net. Qinisekisa ukuqoqa, ukuhlela kanye nokuhanjiswa ngasezikhathini kwemininingwane eqinisekisiwe eqondile. Sekela ukuzuzwa nokuqanjelwa kwezinto eziyisikhungma esihle kanye ne-OHSC Programme esikhungmeni.

xh.title: Umongikazi woMsebenzi weKlinikhala (PHC)
xh.summary: Umongikazi woMsebenzi weKlinikhala onika iinkonzo ezizinzileyo nequlathe konke zezempilo ezingunaphakathi kwisiG_ba sezeMpilo sase Ilembe, efunwa ukubhalisa kwiSANC nokuqatshelwa kweSANC, negqiba lemfundo yesiqu sephela kwiPHC.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezisezantsi kwesithuba: Inqanaba 1: Isethifikethi seMatric okanye iGrade 12 (Isethifikethi seGrade 12) iiDiploma okanye iDegree kwiGeneral Nursing Science naseMidwifery evumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGqatso weGeneral Nurse, plus (1) yeminyaka ingabhaliswa kwaye ngokwesazisi seClinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC) plus, Isethifikethi sobhaliso ngeSANC njengoGqatso weGeneral Nurse kunye neMidwifery nakuqonda ngakumbi iinkonzo zePrimary Health Care, plus, Ugqatsho lweSANC lweNyanga (2024). Kubanzi okuqatshelwayo ukuba angabi naphantsi kweminyaka eli-4 ngenye yeminyaka yokuqatshelwa ngumntu ongumongikazi ngokusemthethweni njengoGqatso weGeneral Nurse. Iimfuno ezisezantsi kwesithuba: Inqanaba 2: Isethifikethi seMatric okanye iGrade 12 (Isethifikethi seGrade 12) iiDiploma okanye iDegree kwiGeneral Nursing Science naseMidwifery evumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengoGqatso weGeneral Nurse, plus (1) yeminyaka ingabhaliswa kwaye ngokwesazisi seClinical Nursing Science, Health Assessment, Treatment and Care (PHC Isethifikethi sobhaliso ngeSANC njengoGqatso weGeneral Nurse kunye neMidwifery nakuqonda ngakumbi iinkonzo zePrimary Health Care, plus, Ugqatsho lweSANC lweNyanga (2024). Kubanzi okuqatshelwayo ukuba angabi naphantsi kweminyaka eli-14 ngokusemthethweni njengoGqatsho weGeneral Nurse kwiSANC, apho kwiminyaka eli-10 kule minyaka ibangelwa ngokuhambelana nokuqatshelwa kokusebenza ngokuhambelana nokuqatshelwa kwePrimary Health Care ngemva kokufumana isazisi sengonyaka yeminyaka yamnyaka enye kwesiqu sePrimary Health Care. NB: Nceda qaphela ukuba uninzi lweKlinikhala kwiKwaDukuza Sub District lusebenza ukusuka ngama-07h00 ukuya kwama-18h00. IKlinikhala yase KwaDukuza iyasebenza iiyure ezili-24, iKlinikhala yase Mpumelelo nase Groutville iyasebenza ngenxa yokubizelwa emva kwama-18h00. Basebenzi bangafunwa ukuba baxhase/babelwe nakweyiphi na kweziko (09) malunga nayo ngaphakathi kweSub District xa kwaye ngamathambo kwenzeka isidingo. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nokuQatshelwa okufunwayo: Ulwazi ngazo zonke iimithetho ephatha imisebenzi njengoko kubunjwa ngumthetho weNursing Acts, Mental Acts, OH & S Act, Iindwelo zoBomi kaBatho kunye neNqununu yeMalungelo eGqithiweyo, Labour Relations Act, Ivela ngokwenza iNgcendelelwano, njalo njalo. Ukuqhuba, ukuqamba, ukwenza izigqibo kunye nokusombulula iingxaki, ukupatha iingxabano kunye neNgcetyiswa. Amakhono alula okuzwa nokuThetha. Amakhono okuQhelanisa nokuCwangcisa. Ukwakhiwa kweQela kunye nokuQeqeshwa abalawuli. Amakhono amahle okuqhathaniswa kweziqu. Ukuqonda okuqinileyo ngenkqubo nemigaqo ngokubhekisele kunkonzo zokhathalelo lwamangqamuzana. Ulwazi lokuncedisa ekuqeqeshweni kwemigaqo eqhagamshelana nendlela yokukhathalela igula.
xh.duties: Nikeza iinkonzo ezizinzileyo nezingunaphakathi ezizinzileyo zezempilo ngokunikela ngeenkonzo ezikhuthazayo, ezithintayo, ezilaphayo neziphilisayo abathengini nakwibantwana. Qinisekisa ukusetenziswa okufanelekileyo nokugciniwa ngokhuseleko kwezixhobo zokuhambisa izigulo, ukudlala iindhawa ezinkulu kunye nezenkqubo zokwenza usetyenziso olubini. Uncede ekubhekiseni, ekungeniseni nasekuphawulweni kubo bonke abasebenzi bengongikazi. Nikeza ukulawula okuthe ngqo nangokungatshongo bonke abasebenzi bengongikazi kunye nokunika izikhokelo. Ukunikela ngenkonzo yokhathalelo lwamagula eholela ekuphuculweni kwenkonzo yezempilo ngokugcina iindwelo zoBatho Pele. Zenza imisebenzi nemiqathango ngokuchanekileyo nokwenza imisebenzi ngokwezantsi kolwazi lomsebenzi. Fakela iinkqubo zezenkqubo yokuzikhusela ekuhambeni nakwenzakalayo ukuphucula inkonzo yokhathalelo olungcono. Unceda ngokwenza izihloko-zinto ezijongene nezempilo kwaye udale iinkqubo zokuphucula. Phucula ulwazi lwabasebenzi kunye nabalwa ngenkathazo ngokuzisa imfundo yemfundo nasekuqeqeshweni kwabasebenzi ngesikhathi. Fakela iinkqubo zokhathalelo lwamagula, nokuQeqesha ngokwemigaqo nakuqeqesho okubhaliweyo. Gcina ukwaneliseka komsebenzi oqinisekileyo kubasebenzi bengongikazi nasezinye izahlulelo, kubandakanya inkqubo yeNgcangcazelo ePhakathi eNkxenye kubakho oluHambayo Iindwelo kunye neNkxaso kwiSaziso somZantsi. Lawulwa imibhalo yamagula, kokubili ebiyileyo kunye nakwilawulo lekhompyutha. Qinisekisa ukusetenziswa ngokufanelekileyo koluntu ngokubanzi, izinto nezimali nokugcina izinto ezisemthethweni. Ilawulo lokucwangcisa ukuzilungiselela nokulawula umsebenzi wakho nokwenzeka kule nkxaso kukhathalelo lwamagula ngokuchanekileyo kwiClinic. Khuthaza abasebenzi abangomzuzwana ukuba bakhuphisane ekuphuculeni ukwazi ukuze bakwazi ukuphucula inqanaba lolwazi bancede abantu ukuba bakhuphisane ekuzikhathaleleni. Phucula inkqubo yokubhala ngokunceda nasekuhambiseni iinkcukacha nge-System.net. Qinisekisa ukuya, ukubhaliswa nasekuhambeni kwexesha okufanelekileyo lokuthumela idata eqinisekisiweyo. Nxibelelanisa nokuqhagamshela nokugcina inkqubo eqinisekileyo yeClinic kunye neNkxaso kwiOHSC Programme kwisikhululo.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1 OR Grade 2
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423.per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum Other Benefits: 13th cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Home owner’s allowance (employee must meet prescribed Requirements) and 12% Rural Allowance
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner (Grade 1 or 2) sought for Othobothini Community Health Centre in KwaZulu-Natal, offering rural allowance and medical aid benefits.
jobs.requirements: Senior certificate/STD 10/Grade 12. Basic R425 qualification (diploma/degree in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse and Midwife.1 year post basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Assessment, Diagnosis, Treatment and Care accredited with SANC. Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 1: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Clinical Nurse Practitioner Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. 10 years of experience of the experience referred to above must be appropriate / recognisable experience after obtaining a 1–year Post Basic qualification in Clinical Nursing Science, Assessment, Diagnosis, Treatment and Care accredited with SANC. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required: Knowledge of nursing care and procedures, Knowledge of SANC Rules and Regulations and other relevant Legal framework. Knowledge of Quality Assurance Programmes, Batho-Pele principles and Patient Rights charter, Human Resource Management and Basic Financial Management skills. Leadership, supervisory and report writing skills. Good communication, counselling, interpersonal relations, conflict management, decision making and problem solving skills.
jobs.duties: Ensure the efficient and effective control of surgical sundries, pharmaceuticals, equipment and miscellaneous stores. Promote preventive and promote health for clients in the facility. Maintain accurate and complete patients’ records according to legal requirements. Assist in compiling and updating of procedural guidelines. Identify problems and areas of improvement and communicate with the Operational Manager. Deal with grievances and labour relations issues in terms of laid down procedures/policies. Provide direct and indirect supervision of junior staff and give guidance for quality patient care. Implement infection control standards and practices to improve quality health care. Initiate treatment and ensure evaluation of patients’ clinical conditions. Participate in health promotion activities in the clinic and in community. Assess in-service training needs, plan and implement training. Participate in data management processes. Participate in the attainment of National Core Standards, realisation of ideal clinic (ICRM), PSI and Surveys on PEC and waiting time.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. S.R Dlamini Tel No: (035) 572 9002
jobs.applications: to be hand deliver to Othobothini CHC HR Department next to Msiyane High School, Jozini, 3969. Or email to Sabelo.Mchunu@kznhealth.gov.za

People with disabilities should feel free to apply. Reference numbers must be indicated on the space provided. The following documents must be submitted: Applicants must ensure that they fully complete the most recent Application for Employment Form (Form Z83) as issued by the Minister for DPSA (gazetted on 06 November 2020 - 81/971431 effective 01 January 2021) in line with regulation of 10 of the Public Service Regulations, 2016 and the information template which is provided to ensure the fair consideration of suitably qualified applicants and which is obtainable from the website - www.kznhealth.gov.za. Applicants are respectfully informed that, if you have not been contacted within 3 months after closing date, please accept that your application was unsuccessful. af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 1 OF Graad 2
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (Graad 1 of 2) gesoek vir Othobothini Community Health Centre in KwaZulu-Natal, met landlike toelaag en mediese hulpvoordele.
af.requirements: Senior certificate/STD 10/Grade 12. Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (diploma/graad in verpleegkunde of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige en Vrouensiekteverpleegkundige toelaat. 1 jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkundige Wetenskap, Assessering, Diagnose, Behandeling en Sorg geakkrediteer by SANC. Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. 10 jaar van die ervaring waarna hierbo verwys is, moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van 'n 1-jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Kliniese Verpleegkundige Wetenskap, Assessering, Diagnose, Behandeling en Sorg geakkrediteer by SANC. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorg en prosedures, Kennis van SANC-reëls en -regulasies en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerk. Kennis van Gehalteversekeringsprogramme, Batho-Pele-beginsels en Handves vir Pasienteregte, Menslike Hulpbronbestuur en Basiese Finansiële Bestuursvaardighede. Leierskap-, toesig- en verslagskryfvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie-, berading-, interpersoonlike verhoudings-, konflikbestuur-, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Verseker doeltreffende en effektiewe beheer van chirurgiese verbruiksgoedere, farmaseutiese produkte, toerusting en diverse voorraad. Bevorder voorkoming en bevordering van gesondheid vir kliënte in die fasiliteit. Onderhou akkurate en volledige pasienterekords volgens regsvereistes. Bystand verleen met die opstel en opdatering van prosedurale riglyne. Identifiseer probleme en areas vir verbetering en kommunikeer met die Operasionele Bestuurder. Hanteer griewe en arbeidsverhoudingskwessies ooreenkomstig vasgestelde prosedures/beleide. Verskaf direkte en indirekte toesig oor junior personeel en gee leiding vir gehalte pasientesorg. Implementeer infeksiebeheerstandaarde en -praktyke om gehalte gesondheidsorg te verbeter. Inisieer behandeling en verseker evaluering van pasiente se kliniese toestande. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevorderingsaktiwiteite in die kliniek en in die gemeenskap. Assesseer in-diens opleidingsbehoeftes, beplan en implementeer opleiding. Neem deel aan databestuurprosesse. Neem deel aan die bereiking van Nasionale Kernstandaarde, verwesenliking van ideale kliniek (ICRM), PSI en Opnames oor PEC en wagtyd.

zu.title: Umongamosi Wezokwelapha Ohlinzayo Izinga 1 Noma Izinga 2
zu.summary: Kufunwa Umongamosi Wezokwelapha Ohlinzayo (Izinga 1 noma 2) ozoze esikhungweni sezempilo emphakathini i-Othobothini Community Health Centre e-KwaZulu-Natal, sinikwa inkokhelo yasezindaweni ezisemakhaya kanye nezinzuzo zomshuwalense wezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Itholakala isitifikedi samatikhetela/STD 10/Grade 12. Isigaba sokugcina se-Basic R425 (idiploma/idigri ekuqeqeshweni bokuhlaza noma isigaba esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa ku-SANC njengogogqoka lezempihla kanye nomonanyisi wezazalume. Unyaka oyedwa ngemva kwalokho kutholwe isigaba ekuqeqeshweni kobunyanzusi bokuhlinza, ekuhlolweni, ekuqondisweni, ekwelapheni nakunakekelweni esevunyiwe ku-SANC. Umongamosi Wezokwelapha Ohlinzayo Izinga 1: okungenani eminyakeni engu-4 yokuhlola/okuvunyelwe kokuqeqeshwa kwabahlali ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoGogqoka leZempihla ku-SANC ekuqeqeshweni okuvamile. Umongamosi Wezokwelapha Ohlinzayo Izinga 2: okungenani eminyakeni engu-14 yamava okuhlola/okuvunyelwe kokuqeqeshwa kwabahlali ngemuva kokubhaliswa njengoGogqoka leZempihla ku-SANC ekuqeqeshweni okuvamile. Kumele kube kungu-10 kweminyaka yamava okushiwo ngentla uhlobo lokuqeqeshwa/okuvunyelwe ngemva kokuthola unyaka oyedwa wesigaba ekuqeqeshweni kobunyanzusi bokuhlinza, ekuhlolweni, ekuqondisweni, ekwelapheni nakunakekelweni esevunyiwe ku-SANC. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namandla Afunekayo: Ulwazi ngokuqashwa nokuhlolwa kwezempilo kanye nezinqubo, Ulwazi ngemithetho nemigomo ka-SANC kanye nezinye izakhiwo ezomthetho ezihambisana nalezo. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokuqinisekiswa ikhwalithi, ngemigoka ye-Batho-Pele nangamalungu asetshenziswa abagulayo, ukuphathwa kwabasebenzi kanye namakhono abalulekile okuphatha imali. Amakhono okukhokhela, okuqondisa nokubhala imibiko. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, okweluleka, okusebenza nabantu, okuphatha izinkinga, okwenza izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuqashwa nokulawulwa okusebenzayo kokuqashwa kwemishanguzo yezokuhlinza, imithi, izisetshenzwa namasitore wezinto ezihlukahlukene. Khuthaza ukuvikwa nokukhuthaza impilo kwabatholwe esikhungweni. Gcina amaphedi ashukumisayo nokuqinisekiswa ukuthi aphelele ngokusho komthetho. Siza ukwakheka kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwezincwadi zokuqondisa izinqubo. Hlola izinkinga nezindawo okungashiswa khona ukuthuthukiswa bese uxhumana noMphathi Wezokusebenza. Phatha izikhalazo nezindaba zezinkinga zabasebenzi ngokusho kwezinqubo/imigumo ehleziwe. Nikeza ukugqamisa ngokuqondile nangangakho abasebenzi abancane futhi unikeze imiqondo yokunakekelwa kwemigulihle yokuphumelela. Tumela amagugu nokwenza okuqinisekisa ukulawulwa kokutheleleka ukuze kuthuthukiswe ikhwalithi yezokwelapha. Qala ukwelapha futhi uqinisekise ukuhlolwa kwezimo zokwelapha zabagulayo. Thatha inhlalo ezinkundleni zokukhuthaza impilo emtholampilo nakumphakathini. Hlola izidingo zokuqeqesheka esikhundleni, hlela futhi uqeqeshe. Thatha inhlalo ezinkundleni zokuphatha idatha. Thatha inhlalo ekutholeni amagugu abalulekile e-National Core Standards, ekwaziseni isikhungo esihle (ICRM), i-PSI nokuhlola i-PEC kanye nesisikhathi sokulinda.

xh.title: Umongikazi wezoKliniki ongangathanga 1 OKanye ongangathanga 2
xh.summary: Kufuneka kusetyenziswe umongikazi wezoKliniki (ongangathanga 1 okanye 2) kwiZiko leMfuyo ekuLalini iOthobothini Community Health Centre kwiKwaZulu-Natal, elinikelwa ngekyhalazo zasemaphandleni nezinzuzo zosizo lwezempilo.
xh.requirements: Isetifiketi samabanga aphezulu/STD 10/Grade 12. Isigaba seR425 esisisiseko (idiploma/inqanaba kwimisebenzi yokhathalelo lwezempilo okanye isigaba esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiSANC njengomongikazi oGqithiswayo nesiNongakazi. Isigaba sengama-1 emva kwesiseko kwiZenzululwazi zoKhathalelo lweMisebenzi yoKliniki, ukuQwalasela, ukuChaza isiGula, ukuNyanga noKukhathalela esagunyaziswe yiSANC. Umongikazi wezoKliniki ongangathanga 1: Uqobo lwe-4 lweminyaka yamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo kwimisebenzi yokhathalelo lwezempilo emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oGqithiswayo kwiSANC kwisoNga jikelele. Umongikazi wezoKliniki ongangathanga 2: Uqobo lwe-14 lweminyaka yamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo kwimisebenzi yokhathalelo lwezempilo emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oGqithiswayo kwiSANC kwisoNga jikelele. Iminyaka eli-10 yamava ekuthethwe ngayo ingasentla kufuneka ibe yamava afanelekileyo/avakalwayo emva kokufumana isigaba se-1 emva kwesiseko kwiZenzululwazi zoKhathalelo lweMisebenzi yoKliniki, ukuQwalasela, ukuChaza isiGula, ukuNyanga noKukhathalela esagunyaziswe yiSANC. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nokuLungelelanisa okuFunekayo: Ulwazi ngokukhathalelwa komguli nangendlela zokwenziwa kwezinto, ulwazi ngeMigaqo yeSANC nokuQulunqwa kwayo nangolunye ulwluMkhandla oChaziweyo. Ulwazi ngeeNkqubo zoQinisekiso lweNgcango, iinkamxeliso iBatho-Pele noMgomo wamaLungelo omGuli, uLawulo lweNgcadamba yabaNtu namakhono oBuntu oMzantsi eMali. Amakhono okukhokela, okulawula nokuBhala iingxelo. Ulwazi oluhle lokunxibelelana, lokweluleka, iindibano phakathi kwabantu, ulawulo lweenguqu, ukuthatha iigqibo namakhono okusombulula iingxaki.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo noluchanekileyo lwezinto ezisetyenziswa ezenza iinqwelo, iziyiyo, izixhobo nolunye olugcinwa kwindlu yokugcina. Khuthaza ukuthintela kwaye ukhuthaze impilo kubakhasi kwisikhululo. Gcina ukuchanekileyo nangaphezu kwemibhalo yabaguli ngokwemfuno yomthetho. Nceda ekubhaliweni nakuqwalaselweni kweekhadi zoqwalaselo. Chonga iingxaki nendawo ezithi zibe ngcono unxibelelane neNkukhetha kuLawulo. Phatha iingxabano neendaba zokuhambelana koluntu ngokwemigaqo/iinkqubo ebiyelweyo. Nikezela ulawulo oluthe ngqo nangat indirect kumalungu asezingeni elingaphantsi unike isikhokelo ukuze kubekho ukhathalelo oluchanekileyo lomguli. Zise inkqubo yokulawula iitshehu ezithi zingenise isifo ukwenzela ukuphucula ubunyulu bekhathalelo lempilo. Qalisa unyango uze uqinisekise uqwalaselo lwemimo yomguli ngokwezempilo. Thatha inxaxheba kumasebe makhathalelo empilo kwindawo yocingo kwaye nasentshona. Qwalasela iimfuno zoqeqesho, cwangcisa uze usebenzise uqeqesho. Thatha inxaxheba kwindlela yolawulo lwemininzi. Thatha inxaxheba ekufikeleleni kwiNqanaba leSizwe esiBhalisiweyo, ukufezekiswa kovimba wezempilo weSondela (ICRM), iPSI nakuPononongo kwiPEC nakunxulumaniso ixesha.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse (SPECIALTY Ophthalmic)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum, Plus Rural Allowance 8% Benefits: 13th Cheque/ Service Bonus Medical Aid (Optional Homeowners Allowance: Employee must meet prescribed requirements. Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum, Plus Rural Allowance 8% Benefits: 13th Cheque/ Service Bonus Medical Aid (Optional Homeowners Allowance: Employee must meet prescribed requirements
jobs.summary: Professional nurse specialised in ophthalmic nursing required at Niemeyer Memorial Hospital Eye Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal, with a minimum of four years post-registration experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General nursing. Grade 2: Experience: A minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience after obtaining the one post Basic qualification in Ophthalmic Nursing. STD 10 or grade12 Certificate. Degree / Diploma in General Nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. One year Post Basic Registration Degree/Diploma in Ophthalmic nursing plus 4 years appropriate/recognisable registration experience as a general nurse. Current registration with South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse Specialty (2026 SANC receipt). Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Require: Knowledge of nursing care processes and procedures, nursing statutes, and other relevant legal frameworks such as: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele principles. Public Service Regulations, Labour Act, Disciplinary Code and Procedure, Grievance Procedure, etc. Good communication skills; report writing skills; facilitation skills; coordination skills; liaison skills; networking skills; problem solving skills; Information management; knowledge management; planning & organising; computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Maintain a therapeutic relationship and environment in which health care can be provided optimally and safety. Create and maintain a complete and accurate nursing record for individual health care users. Participate in health promotion and illness prevention initiatives and contribute to their evaluation. Maintain a plan to improve the quality of nursing and health care. Implement quality improvement plan. Maintain a professional and ethical as well as an enabling environment for ethical practice. Protect and advocate right of patients regarding health care. Diagnose and manage conditions related to eyes. Implement patient care standards, policies and procedures. Compliance and adherence to the relevant acts/prescript applicable within the nursing environment. Apply the principles of nursing care in service rendering for the maintenance of professional excellence. Implement nursing care management activities according to the Standard of Practice and Scope of Practice and act upon breaching of laws relating to nursing practice and professional code of conduct and practice standard. Implement quality improvement plan, the Nursing Act and Regulations, the Code of Ethics and Professional Practice of the South African Nursing Council. Implement procedure that maintain effective infection control and occupational and safety measures in accordance with Occupational Health and safety legislation. Maintain accountability and responsibility for nursing care activities.
jobs.enquiries: Mrs. G.N Nkosi Tel No: (034) 331 3011
