af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige (SPESIALITEIT Oftalmiese)
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige wat in oftalmiese verpleging gespesialiseer het, word benodig by Niemeyer Memorial Hospital Eye Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal, met 'n minimum van vier jaar se ervaring na registrasie.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene verpleging. Graad 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene verpleging. Ten minste 10 jaar van die bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na die verkryging van die een post-Basiese kwalifikasie in Oftalmiese Verpleging. STD 10 of graad12-sertifikaat. Graad / Diploma in Algemene Verpleging of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. Een jaar post-Basiese Registrasie Graad/Diploma in oftalmiese verpleging plus 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare registrasie-ervaring as 'n algemene verpleegkundige. Huidige registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige Spesialiteit (2026 SANC-kwitansie). Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Kennis van verpleegsorgprosesse en prosedures, verpleegstatute en ander tersaaklike regsraamwerke soos: Nursing Act, Health Act, Occupational Health & Safety Act, Patient Rights Charter, Batho-Pele-beginsels. Public Service Regulations, Labour Act, Dissiplinêre Kode en Prosedure, Grievance Procedure, ens. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede; verslagskryfvaardighede; fasiliteringsvaardighede; koördinasievaardighede; skakelvaardighede; netwerkvaardighede; probleemoplossingsvaardighede; inligtingsbestuur; kennisbestuur; beplanning en organisering; rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Onderhou 'n terapeutiese verhouding en omgewing waarin gesondheidsorg optimaal en veilig verskaf kan word. Skep en onderhou 'n volledige en akkurate verpleegrekord vir individuele gesondheidsorgebruikers. Neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering en siektevoorkoming-inisiatiewe en dra by tot hul evaluering. Onderhou 'n plan om die gehalte van verpleging en gesondheidsorg te verbeter. Implementeer gehalteverbeteringsplan. Onderhou 'n professionele en etiese sowel as 'n bemagtigende omgewing vir etiese praktyk. Beskerm en beywer vir die regte van pasiënte met betrekking tot gesondheidsorg. Diagnoseer en bestuur toestande wat met oë verband hou. Implementeer pasiëntsorgstandaarde, beleide en prosedures. Nakoming en aandag aan die tersaaklike wette/voorskriwe wat binne die verpleegomgewing van toepassing is. Pas die beginsels van verpleegsorg toe in dienslewering vir die handhawing van professionele uitnemendheid. Implementeer verpleegsorgbestuursaktiwiteite volgens die Standaard van Praktyk en Omgang van Praktyk en tree op teen oortredings van wette wat op verpleegpraktyk van toepassing is en professionele gedragskode en praktykstandaard. Implementeer gehalteverbeteringsplan, die Nursing Act and Regulations, die Code of Ethics and Professional Practice van die South African Nursing Council. Implementeer prosedures wat effektiewe infeksiebeheer en beroeps- en veiligheidsmaatreëls in ooreenstemming met Occupational Health and safety-wetgewing handhaaf. Onderhou aanspreeklikheid en verantwoordelikheid vir verpleegsorgaktiwiteite.

zu.title: Unesi Ohlotshaneni (EZIKHITHINI Ophthalmic)
zu.summary: Kudingeka unesi ohlotshaneni oqeqeshelwe ezikithini e-Niemeyer Memorial Hospital Eye Clinic e-KwaZulu-Natal, onehlaya lokuhlolwa kweminyaka emine ngemva kokuqeqeshwa.
zu.requirements: Izinga 1: Isipiliyoni: Kudingeka okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yesipiliyoni esifanele/okuqukethwe ezokunakekelwa kuyise ngemva kokuqashwa njengoNesi Ohlotshaneni ne-SANC ezokunakekelwa jikelele. Izinga 2: Isipiliyoni: Kudingeka okungenani iminyaka engu-4 yesipiliyoni esifanele/okuqukethwe ezokunakekelwa kuyise ngemva kokuqashwa njengoNesi Ohlotshaneni ne-SANC ezokunakekelwa jikelele. Kumele kube okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 kuleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla yesipiliyoni esifanele/okuqukethwe ngemva kokuthola le ndima yamva kokufunda e-Ophthalmic Nursing. Isitifikedi se-STD 10 noma i-grade12. I-Degree / Diploma kwi-General Nursing noma iziqu ezingangenwa ezenza ukuthi umuntu abhalise e-SANC njengoNesi Ohlotshaneni. Isiqu seminyaka eyisikhombisa sokufunda esiphelele i-Post Basic Registration Degree/Diploma kwi-Ophthalmic nursing kahulumende nabesipiliyoni 4 sokuqashwa okufanele/okuqukethwe njengonesi ohlotshanenemiphakathi. I-SANC registration ngesimo ngasinye njengoNesi Ohlotshaneni Wezindinganiso (2026 SANC receipt). Ulwazi, Amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa Nezidingo: Ukufuna ulwazi ngemijaho yokunakekela kanye nemiqulu yokunakekela okulawulwayo neminye imithetho edingekayo efana: u-Mthetho Wezempilo, u-Mthetho Wezokugcinwa Kwesikhundla, no-Carta Yamalungelo Wegula wonhlangano namaphuzu abaphetha labo. Imithetho Yesiphakamiso Somphakathi, u-Mthetho Wabasebenzi, isibopho Somthetho olandelayo nesiga, nezinga elisemthethweni sokuziphendulela, njengenjalo. Amandla okukhuluma kahle, nokuqamba nokuqhathanisa imibiko ekhatshwa kakhulu; ukuthumela abakini ukuba ngoolwazi ababambe, nokuqhathanisa; isikhundla nokuhlela nemisebenzi yenkonzo; amandla okusebenzela isici sekhombeha.
zu.duties: Gcina ubudlelwano obunyakaza nokuhlinzwa abalolunge ngokugcizelela okuhle ekulolongeni. Dala ugcine i-red lethadi leNesi eliqinisekile le-Nesi ngamunye othile wokunakekela izempilo. Thinta nzalo ekusizeni ukukhulisa izincomo zokunakekela amalungiselelo ezigula nokubandakanya okungalolunge. Gcina icebo elithuthukisa izinga lenkonzo yokwelula kanye nezokunakekelwa kwe-Ichthud e-Izinsiza ezenza isimo esiphelele sokuphila ezempilweni. Yehlisa ngemigomo eyisibopho semisebenzi nokulawula inkomba ngokuphelele. Hlala ngesibopho ohlotshaneni nasemphilweni wenkonzo ukugcina ikhwalithi nokuphephelwa kwamalungelo amalunga eziphika zokunakekela impilo. Sibuza kubonisa izinhlelo eziningi kakhulu, imithetho imithetho yokuphepha ngokuhamba kwesibhedlela nokusetshenziswa okusesimweni njengalo lohlakaniphile kokugunda okungenisiwa ezokunakekela Izikhali ezisesiphilweni. Gcina izinto okufunakalayo ezibhekene namalungiselelo okukunakekela inani elihle kwezempilo zomphakathi.

xh.title: Umongikazi oGunyaziwe (OBUKHOBUKHU I-Ophthalmic)
xh.summary: Kufuneka kugunyazwe umongikazi ogranjwe kwindawo yamasondo eNiemeyer Memorial Hospital Eye Clinic eKwaZulu-Natal, anamava eminye emininzi yeminyaka emine emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Amaxesha: Kufuneka abe nobuncinane beminyaka engama-4 amava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo kunyanga emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGunyaziwe kwiSANC kwiNzondo jikelele. Inqanaba 2: Amaxesha: Kufuneka abe nobuncinane beminyaka engama-4 amava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo kunyanga emva kokubhalisa njengoMongikazi oGunyaziwe kwiSANC kwiNzondo jikelele. Kufuneka kube nobuncinane beminyaka elishumi kweli xesha elifunekayo apha ngasentla amava afanelekileyo/avakalisekayo emva kokufumana iziqu ezinye zeSiseko zezaBhalo kwiNzondo yokuQwalasela ameSo. ISTD 10 okanye isatifikethi segreyidi 12. Isiqu/Isidiploma kwiNzondo jikelele okanye iziqu ezingoko ezingenisa isazinda kunye neSANC njengoMongikazi oGunyaziwe. Isidiploma/Isiqu sobuNina bokuBhalisa buNyaka omnye kwinkqubo yamaSo ngaphezu kwamava eminyaka emine abhaliswayo avakalisekayo njengomongikazi jikelele. Ukubhalisa kwangoku kwikonklusi yokunyanga yaseMzantsi Afrika njengoMongikazi oGunyaziwe kwiQhalabbu (2026 isipathi seSANC). Ulwazi, Amandla, uQeqesho neMfuneko eFunekayo: Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemiNculo yenkqubo yokunyanga nenzwayo, kwaye nemithetho yemigaqo yemisebenzi yamanye amagatya ewela kumthetho afana nala: uMthetho woBukiNqunyi, uMthetho weMpepho, uMthetho woKhuseleko lwaBasebenzi noMthetho wezeMfundo, iKhartha yeGunya leNgenxo, imigaqo yeBatho-Pele. Imigaqo yokuSebenza koluntu, uMthetho weMisebenzi, neKhowudi yoLwahlulelo noMthetho wokuSebenza, iNqumbo zeziKeledo, ncn. Amandla agqithisileyo okuNxibelelana; amandla okubhala iingxelo; amandla okuQhuba; amandla oluHluulo; amandla oluQhuba ngokuhamba kokuhamba; amandla oluQhuba imisebenzi yakuQhuba; amandla okuSombulula iingxaki; uLawulo lweNkcazalo; ulwazi lolawulo noludidi lolwazi; nokuCwangcisa&kuHlela; ulwazi lokusebenza ngokuSebenzisa iKhompyutha.
xh.duties: Gcina undyebo-dyakon Ludya-dyakon neluSapho lokuqinisekisa ukuba inkonzo yamеpepho inikwa ngendlela ekuyo yamandla iphela nangokhuseleko. Yala ngokucacileyo uGcino kwaye ulugcine ludli ngokupela ngenqwena yemida yeNgenxo yeNzulu ngokukaLuntu ngamnye. Thabatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuSoka iNtsebenziso nokuThintelwa kweZifo, kwaye uluze ngokwakho ukulinganisa imiba. Gcina izicwangciso zokuPuhlisa ubukho buBukhali bokunyanga neNkonzo yampepho. Faka isicwangciso sokuphucula ngobukhali. Gcina iNkqubo yeNkonzo yamapepho eNtengiso nezodidi nendawo ethetha ukuzinza koluntu. Khusela kwamkhwela ade abambe iqhosa lam amalungelo abaguli. Yiva nokuLawula izifo ezingxamileyo ngokuswela ngokwamehlo. Faka iMigaqo, iNqamulelo neNkqubo yokuQatshelwa kokuQhathiswa kwamakhaladi kweNkonzo. Kuthintelwa ukuphula umthetho nemiSebenzi egqithisweyo ngokukhuseleka koluntu ngokwecandelo lenkqubo yokunyanga. Faka amacandelo eNkqubo yoBukho bokulungelelanisa namandla okulunga ngoluHlobo lokuQhathiswa ngokwemigaqo yokugcina ukupela koluntu. Faka isicwangciso seNkqubo yokuQhathiswa ngokwemigaqo yoluntu nobukho bobukho bokunyanga nendlela yokuQhathiswa nokuziphendula ngokokupheliswa komthetho ongqangqamileyo ngokwemigaqo yamakhaladi kunye nokuQwalasela iNkqubo yeNkonzo yeKhodi nemiSebenzi. Faka isicwangciso sokuphucula inkonzo, uMthetho woBukhali boluntu nokuLawula, neKhodi yoluntu nokuLawula iNkonzo yeKhowili yoluntu yonyango eMzantsi Afrika. Yala imiNculo elungelelanisa ulawulo lokuNgena kolwazi iNkqubo yoluntu nokuQhathiswa ngokwemigaqo nokuQhathiswa ngendlela yomthetho weKhowudi nokuQhathiswa ngokwemigaqo yoluntu iKhowudi yokulunga nokuQhathiswa ngokwemigaqo yoluntu neKhowudi yokuQhathiswa kweNkqubo iNkqubo yeNkonzo yoluntu. Gcina uLawulo nokuBambeka ngokukhuseleka koluntu kweKhowidi.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner (NAASFARM Clinic)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Inhospitable Allowance: 8% and Housing allowance: Prescribed requirements to be met.
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner needed at Naas Farm Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal to provide patient care, supervise clients and implement community health programmes.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience A minimum of 4 years appropriate /recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: Experience A minimum of 14 years appropriate /recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General nursing, of which at least 10 years must be appropriate /recognisable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care Grade 12(Senior Certificate), Standard 10/ or National Certificate plus basic R 425 qualification i.e. Degree/Diploma in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Post Basic qualification with the duration of at least 1 year in Curative Skills in Primary Health Care accredited with the SANC. Current registration with SANC as Professional Nurse and Primary Health Care and a minimum of 4 years appropriate /recognisable experience after registration as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required for the post: Relevant legal framework such as Nursing Acts, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Batho Pele and Patient’s Rights Charter, Labour Relations etc. Disciplinary code, human resources policies, hospital generic and specific policies. Sound knowledge of the National Core Standards (OHSC) and Data Management. Sound knowledge of the health programmes run at the PHC level. Ability to relieve in the service areas. Co-ordination and planning skills. Team building and supervisory skills. Good communication and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of all applicable legislation guidelines and policies related to nursing principles. Good interpersonal relationship and listening skills.
jobs.duties: Implement and advocate for programmes initiative for clients and the community served by the clinic. Supervision of patients and provision of basic needs e.g. oxygen availability, nutrition, elimination, fluids and electrolyte balance, safe and therapeutic environment in the clinic. Ensure proper usage and understanding of relevant guidelines, policies and protocols e.g. IMCI, EDL booklet etc. Ensure clinical intervention to clients including proper administration of prescribed medication and ongoing observation of patients in the clinic. Implement health programmes within the PHC package, monitor performance and outcomes against the set targets by the Department and act on deviations. Ensure accurate data generation/ collection, verification and submission to FIO timeously. Motivate staff regarding development in order to increase level of expertise and assist patients to develop sense of care. Ensure effective implementation of National Core Standards (OHSC) and Ideal Clinic Realisation. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, Including report writing. Assist Operational Manager with overall management and necessary support for effective functioning in the clinic. Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team to ensure good Nursing Care in the clinic. Be able to plan and organise own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper Nursing Caren in the clinic. Ensure proper utilisation and safe keeping of basic Medical, Surgical, Pharmaceutical and other stock.
jobs.enquiries: Mr VP Nene Tel No: (034) 621 6100

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (NAASFARM Clinic)
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn benodig by Naas Farm Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal om pasiëntsorg te verskaf, toesig oor kliënte te hou en gemeenskapsgesondheidsprogramme te implementeer.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Ervaring 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: Ervaring 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging, waarvan ten minste 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring moet wees na verkryging van die een jaar post-grundleggende kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg Grade 12(Senior Certificate), Standard 10/ of National Certificate plus basiese R 425 kwalifikasie d.w.s. Graad/Diploma in verpleging of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie met SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Post-grundleggende kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in Curatiewe Vaardighede in Primêre Gesondheidsorg geakkrediteer met die SANC. Huidige registrasie met SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Primêre Gesondheidsorg en 'n minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Kompetensies Vereis vir die pos: Relevante regsraamwerk soos Nursing Acts, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Batho Pele en Patient's Rights Charter, Labour Relations ens. Dissiplinêre kode, menslike hulpbronbeleide, hospitaal-generiese en spesifieke beleide. Deeglike kennis van die National Core Standards (OHSC) en Data Management. Deeglike kennis van die gesondheidsprogramme wat op PHC-vlak uitgevoer word. Vermoë om in die diensareas waar te neem. Koördinasie- en beplanningsvaardighede. Spanbou- en toesighoudingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis van alle toepaslike wetgewingsriglyne en beleide rakende verpleegbeginsels. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en luistervaardighede.
af.duties: Implementeer en bevorder programinisiatiewe vir kliënte en die gemeenskap wat deur die kliniek bedien word. Toesig oor pasiënte en voorsiening van basiese behoeftes bv. beskikbaarheid van suurstof, voeding, eliminasie, vloeistof- en elektrolietbalans, veilige en terapeutiese omgewing in die kliniek. Verseker behoorlike gebruik en begrip van relevante riglyne, beleide en protokolle bv. IMCI, EDL-boekie ens. Verseker kliniese ingryping by kliënte insluitend behoorlike toediening van voorgeskryfde medikasie en deurlopende observasie van pasiënte in die kliniek. Implementeer gesondheidsprogramme binne die PHC-pakket, monitor prestasie en uitkomste teen die gestelde teikens deur die Department en tree op op afwykings. Verseker akkurate datagenerering/versameling, verifikasie en tydige voorlegging aan FIO. motiveer personeel rakende ontwikkeling ten einde vlak van kundigheid te verhoog en help pasiënte om 'n sin vir sorg te ontwikkel. Verseker effektiewe implementering van National Core Standards (OHSC) en Ideal Clinic Realisation. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing. Bystand Operasionele Bestuurder met algehele bestuur en nodige ondersteuning vir effektiewe funksionering in die kliniek. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie Verpleegsorg in die kliniek te verseker. Wees in staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike Verpleegsorg in die kliniek te verseker. Verseker behoorlike benutting en veilige bewaring van basiese Mediese, Chirurgiese, Farmaseutiese en ander voorraad.

zu.title: Umvlomandi Wezokwelapha Oqeqeshiwe (IKliniki ye-NAASFARM)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umvlomandi wezokwelapha oqeqeshiwe e-Kliniki ye-Naas Farm e-KwaZulu-Natal ukuze kunikezwe ukunakekelwa kwabagulayo, kugqamwe abathengi futhi kuqalwe amaphrogramu empilo yomphakathi.
zu.requirements: Ibanga 1: IsipiliSibili Okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile/okubonakalayo kwezokunakekela ngemuva kokubhalisa njengesiGuli Sezinzuzo Ngokulawula Ngokujwayelekile (SANC) kwezokunakekela. Ibanga 2: IsipiliSibili Okungenani iminyaka engu-14 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile/okubonakalayo kwezokunakekela ngemuva kokubhalisa njengesiGuli Sezinzuzo (SANC) kwezokunakekela, okuphezu kwalokho okungenani iminyaka engu-10 kufanele kube ukuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile/okubonakalayo ngemuva kokuthola le minyaka yedwa yesidanga esiphakeme se-PHC. Ibanga 12(Isitifikedi Sezilinganiso), Isitifikedi 10 noma Isitifikedi seSizwe sangaqedwa isibalo se-R 425 i.i. IDigri/IDiploma noma isidingo esingalinganayo osivumela ukuba ubhalise ku-SANC njengesiGuli. Isidanga esiphakeme esingeziwe esibekwa isikhathi okungenani unyaka oyedwa kwezobuchophisi e-PHC esimakwe yi-SANC. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-SANC njengesiGuli kanye nokuthola okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 yokuhlangenwe nakho okufanelekile/okubonakalayo ngemuva kokubhalisa njengesiGuli. Ulwazi, Amandla, Ukuqeqesha Nemikhuba Edingekayo: Uluhlelo oluthintayo lomthetho njengakumthetho wezokunakekela, kanye nokuqonda kwemithetho ehlotshaniswe nalawo aqondene nendlela yokunakekela. IsipiliSibili esihle sezinhlelo zezezempilo ezenzwa kumazinga e-PHC. Amandla okubalekela kumakhono okuba khona. Amandla okuhlela futhi uhlele. Amandla okwakha iqembu kanye namakhono okuqondisa. IsipiliSibili esihle sokuxhumana kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi ngawo onke amathulusi omthetho kanye namapholisi ahlobene nemigomo yokunakekela. Ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu kanye namakhono okulalela.
zu.duties: Qala futhi usekele izinhlelo ezingenwa abathengi nomphakathi onakekelwa yikliniki. Okuqondisa abagulayo kunokwethula okudingekayo njengesipiliSibili sezimpilo ezahlukeneko, ukulunga, ukudla, amanzi, izinto ezingangenwa, ukuphephisa indawo ekliniki. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okulungele kanye nokuqonda imigumo, amapholisi kanye nemibandela eqondene nalokho okushiwo njengakwi-IMCI, EDL. Qinisekisa ukungenelela abathengi kuhlanganise nokuphathwa okulungile kwemithi elotshiwe nokubukwa ngokuqhubeka kwabagulayo ekliniki. Qala izinhlelo zezempilo ngaphakathi kwephakethe le-PHC, ukubheka ukusebenza kanye nokuthola okuhlobene namaphuzu abekiwe umbuso futhi wenze ngokungafani. Qinisekisa ukwakhiwa/okuqoqiwe kudatha okunembile, ukuqinisekiswa nokuthunyelwa ku-FIO ngokushesha. Dlulisela ngokuthuthukiswa ngokwamandla abasebenzi ukuze ukhuliswe izinga lolwazi futhi usize abagulayo bakhulise indlela yokukhathalela. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwemigomo ye-Sizwe (OHSC) kanye Nokuqondiswa Kwekliniki. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo kubagulayo, abaqondisi kanye nabanye abasebenza eklethini, okuhlanganisa nokubhala imibiko. Sisa umphathi wezemisebenzi ngokuphatha konke futhi unikeze inkxaso edingekayo yokusebenza kwekliniki. Sebenza njengengxenye yeqembu elihlangenwe ngendlela eziningi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekela okuhle ekliniki. Yakha futhi uhlele umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabanye abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekela ngokulawuleka ekliniki. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okulungile kanye nokugcinwa kweziyakhiwa zokwelapha.

xh.title: Uqeqeshi Lomongikazi Wezilumbo (I-Clinic ye-NAASFARM)
xh.summary: Kufunekwa uqeqeshi lomongikazi wezilumbo kwi-Clinic ye-Naas Farm e-KwaZulu-Natal ukunika ukhathalo kumagula, ukuqamba abaxhasi nokusebenzisa iinkqubo zeempilo zoluntu.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Iimava Iminyaka engu 4 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo/eqaqiswayo ekunyusekeni emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oGunyaziweyo ne-SANC ekunyusekeni iJikelele. Inqabana 2: Iimava Iminyaka engu 14 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo/eqaqiswayo ekunyusekeni emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oGunyaziweyo ne-SANC ekunyusekeni iJikelele, apho iminyaka engu 10 ubuncinane kufuneka ibe yimava afanelekileyo/eqaqiswayo emva kokufumana isifikelelo se nyanga ethatha inqanaba elingasentla kwi Primary Health Care. I-Grade 12(iQobho eliPhezulu), i-Standard 10/ okanye i-National Certificate ngesiseko se R 425 isifikelelo oko kukuthi i-Degree/i-Diploma ekunyusekeni okanye isifikelelo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa ne-SANC njengomongikazi oGunyaziweyo. Isifikelelo esingasentla ngenqanaba elithatha inyanga enye ubuncinane kwakhona kwi Curative Skills kwi Primary Health Care esemthethweni ne-SANC. Ukubhalisa kwangoku ne-SANC njengomongikazi oGunyaziweyo ne Primary Health Care kunye neminyaka engu 4 ubuncinane yamava afanelekileyo/eqaqiswayo emva kokubhalisa njengomongikazi oGunyaziweyo ekunyusekeni iJikelele. Ulwazi, Amandla, Uqeqesho nokuNyaniseka okuFunekayo kule nxeba: Uphawu lomthetho oluhambelanayo njengakumaNxeba oNongikazi, uMthetho weMpilo yaseMsebenzini noKhuseleko, iBatho Pele neSaziso sezamaLungelo oMagula, uQuqumbo lwaBasebenzi njl. Ikhodi yenguqu, iinkqazo zemithombo yabasebenzi, iinkqazo ezijwayelekileyo nezithileyo zesibhedlele. Ulwazi olunamandya lweNqanaba eliPhambili leSizwe (OHSC) nokulawula iDatha. Ulwazi olunamandya lweenkqubo zeempilo eziqhutywa kwinqanaba lePHC. Amandla okubeka endaweni kummandla wesebenza. Amandla okuhlanganisa nokuqamba. Amandla okwakha iqela nokuqamba. Amandla abalulekileyo bokunxibelelana nokuqonda iinkinga. Ulwazi ngawo onke amacebo omtetho, iinkqazo neenkqazo ezahambelana nemigaqo yonongikazi. Ubudlelwane obuhle phakathi kwabantu namandla okuphulaphula.
xh.duties: Sebenzisa kwaye uxhase iinkqubo ezisiqaliswayo zabaxhasi noluntu oqhutywa sisikhululo. Ukuqamba kumagula kunye nokunika iimfuno eziqhelekileyo ngenkqubo yokufumana umoya-mpilo, ukutya, ukukhutsha, ulungelelwaniso lamanzi namathunzi, indawo ekhuselekileyo nephilayo kule kliniki. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo nokuqonda kumacebo ahambelanayo, iinkqazo neenkqazo njengakwi-IMCI, incwadadi ye-EDL njl. Qinisekisa ukungenelela kwezilumbo kwabaxhasi kuquka nokunikwa ngokuchanekileyo kwamachiza anyuliweyo nokuqhuba uqeqesho-meso kubagula bale kliniki. Sebenzisa iinkqubo zeempilo ngaphakathi kwesiphakathu sePHC, qapha ukusebenza nendlela ephilayo ngokumagunya abekwe ngumnyanya we-ofisi kwaye wenze ngemiba engaqambekiyo. Qinisekisa ukwenziwa kwedatha ngokuchanekileyo/ukuqokelelwa, ukuqinisekisa kwaye ithunyelwe kwi-FIO ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Khuthaza abasebenzi ngokuphuhliswa ukuze kwandise inqanaba lolwazi kwaye uncede abagula ukuba bakhe inxaxheba yokhathalo. Qinisekisa ukusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kweNqanaba eliPhambili leSizwe (OHSC) nokufezekiswa kweKliniki eNgcwele. Bonisa ukunxibelelana ngokuchanekileyo nabagula, abaqambi nabanye oongikazi, kuquka nokubhaliweyo. Ncedisa umLawuli oSebenzayo nangokulawula jikelele noloncedo olufunekayo ukuze kusebenze ngokuchanekileyo kule kliniki. Sebenza njengenxalenye yeqela elinamabanga amaninji ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalo lweNongikazi oluhle kule kliniki. Yiba nakho ukuqumba kuqamba umsebenzi wakho nakawabo abasebenzi abaxhasi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalo lweNongikazi oluchanekileyo kule kliniki. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo nolondolozo lwezixhobo zoGqitha, zoQhaqazo, zeMachiza nezinye izinto.

jobs.title: Clinical Nurse Practitioner (GREENOCK Clinic)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 – R581 931 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 – R752 913 per annum Other Benefits: 13th Cheque, Medical Aid (Optional), Inhospitable Allowance: 8% and Housing allowance: Prescribed requirements to be met.
jobs.summary: Clinical Nurse Practitioner position at Greenock Clinic in KwaZulu-Natal, requiring SANC registration with at least 4 years of nursing experience.
jobs.requirements: Grade 1: Experience: A minimum of 4 years appropriate /recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. Grade 2: Experience: A minimum of 14 years appropriate /recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General nursing, of which at least 10 years must be appropriate /recognisable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care Grade 12(Senior Certificate), Standard 10/ or National Certificate plus basic R 425 qualification i.e. Degree/Diploma in nursing or equivalent qualification that allows registration with SANC as a Professional Nurse. Post Basic qualification with the duration of at least 1 year in Curative Skills in Primary Health Care accredited with the SANC. Current registration with SANC as Professional Nurse and Primary Health Care and a minimum of 4 years appropriate /recognisable experience after registration as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Knowledge, Skills, Training and Competencies Required for the post: Relevant legal framework such as Nursing Acts, Occupational Health and Safety Act, Batho Pele and Patient’s Rights Charter, Labour Relations etc. Disciplinary code, human resources policies, hospital generic and specific policies. Sound knowledge of the National Core Standards (OHSC) and Data Management. Sound knowledge of the health programmes run at the PHC level. Ability to relieve in the service areas. Co-ordination and planning skills. Team building and supervisory skills. Good communication and problem-solving skills. Knowledge of all applicable legislation guidelines and policies related to nursing principles. Good interpersonal relationship and listening skills.
jobs.duties: Implement and advocate for programmes initiative for clients and the community served by the clinic. Supervision of patients and provision of basic needs e.g. oxygen availability, nutrition, elimination, fluids and electrolyte balance, safe and therapeutic environment in the clinic. Ensure proper usage and understanding of relevant guidelines, policies and protocols e.g. IMCI, EDL booklet etc. Ensure clinical intervention to clients including proper administration of prescribed medication and ongoing observation of patients in the clinic. Implement health programmes within the PHC package, monitor performance and outcomes against the set targets by the Department and act on deviations. Ensure accurate data generation/ collection, verification and submission to FIO timeously. Motivate staff regarding development in order to increase level of expertise and assist patients to develop sense of care. Ensure effective implementation of National Core Standards (OHSC) and Ideal Clinic Realisation. Demonstrate effective communication with patients, supervisors and other clinicians, including report writing. Assist Operational Manager with overall management and necessary support for effective functioning in the clinic. Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team to ensure good Nursing Care in the clinic. Be able to plan and organise own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper Nursing Caren in the clinic. Ensure proper utilisation and safe keeping of basic Medical, Surgical, Pharmaceutical and other stock.

af.title: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn (GREENOCK Kliniek)
af.summary: Kliniese Verpleegpraktisyn-pos by Greenock Kliniek in KwaZulu-Natal, wat SANC-registrasie met ten minste 4 jaar verpleegervaring vereis.
af.requirements: Graad 1: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Graad 2: Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by SANC in Algemene verpleging, waarvan ten minste 10 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring moet wees na die verkryging van die een jaar na-basiese kwalifikasie in Primêre Gesondheidsorg. Graad 12 (Senior Sertifikaat), Standaard 10/ of Nasionale Sertifikaat plus basiese R 425-kwalifikasie d.w.s. Graad/Diploma in verpleging of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie met SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Na-basiese kwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar in Curatiewe Vaardighede in Primêre Gesondheidsorg geakkrediteer by die SANC. Huidige registrasie met SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Primêre Gesondheidsorg en 'n minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis vir die pos: Toepaslike regsraamwerk soos die Verpleegwette, Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, Batho Pele en die Handves vir Pasiente se Regte, Arbeidsverhoudinge ens. Dissplinêre kode, menslikehulpbronnebeleid, hospitaal se algemene en spesifieke beleid. Deeglike kennis van die Nasionale Kernstandaarde (OHSC) en databestuur. Deeglike kennis van die gesondheidsprogramme wat op die PHC-vlak bestuur word. Vermoë om in die diensareas waar te neem. Koördinasie- en beplanningsvaardighede. Spanbou- en toesighoudende vaardighede. Goeie kommunikasie- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis van alle toepaslike wetgewingsriglyne en beleide wat met verpleegbeginsels verband hou. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings en luistervaardighede.
af.duties: Implementeer en beywer vir programinisiatiewe vir kliënte en die gemeenskap wat deur die kliniek bedien word. Toesig oor pasiënte en voorsiening van basiese behoeftes bv. suurstofbeskikbaarheid, voeding, eliminering, vloeistof- en elektrolietbalans, veilige en terapeutiese omgewing in die kliniek. Verseker behoorlike gebruik en begrip van toepaslike riglyne, beleide en protokolle bv. IMCI, EDL-boekie ens. Verseker kliniese ingryping by kliënte insluitend behoorlike toediening van voorgeskrewe medikasie en deurlopende waarneming van pasiënte in die kliniek. Implementeer gesondheidsprogramme binne die PHC-paket, monitor prestasie en uitkomste teen die gestelde teikens deur die Departement en tree op op afwykings. Verseker akkurate datagenerering/insameling, verifiëring en tydige indiening by FIO. Motiveer personeel rakende ontwikkeling om vlak van kundigheid te verhoog en help pasiënte om 'n sin van sorg te ontwikkel. Verseker effektiewe implementering van Nasionale Kernstandaarde (OHSC) en Ideal Clinic Realisation. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing. Bysstaan Operasionele Bestuurder met algehele bestuur en nodige ondersteuning vir effektiewe funksionering in die kliniek. Werk as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span om goeie Verplegsorg in die kliniek te verseker. Wees in staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike Verplegsorg in die kliniek te verseker. Verseker behoorlike benutting en veilige bewaring van basiese Mediese, Chirurgiese, Farmaseutiese en ander voorraad.

zu.title: Umpraktisi wezogula (Isikhungo i-GREENOCK)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sompraktisi wezogula esikhungweni i-Greenock Clinic e-KwaZulu-Natal, esidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC okunamafomu amancane angu-4 asebenzayo ohambweni lokukhelwa isikhathi sezogula.
zu.requirements: I-GRADE 1: Experience: A minimum of 4 years appropriate /recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General Nursing. I-GRADE 2: Experience: A minimum of 14 years appropriate /recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with SANC in General nursing, of which at least 10 years must be appropriate /recognisable experience after obtaining the one year post basic qualification in Primary Health Care. I-GRADE 12 (Senior Certificate), i-Standard 10/ noma i-National Certificate kanye nesidingo sesikhundla se-R 425 i.e. i-Degree/Diploma kwezogula noma isitifikedi esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengo-Nesi osezingeni eliphezulu. Isitifikedi se-Post Basic esithatha isikhathi esingaphezu konyaka owodwa kumakhono okwelapha kwi-Primary Health Care, esihambisana namagunya e-SANC. Ukubhaliswa kwamanje kwi-SANC njengo-Nesi osezingeni eliphezulu kanye ne-Primary Health Care kanti futhi kudingeka ubuncane beminyaka emi-4 yohlu lobuchwepheshe obuhlobene /obungaziwa emva kokubhaliswa njengo-Nesi osezingeni eliphezulu kwezogula jikelele. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nobuNcwadi obudingekayo kulesi sikhundla: uHlelo lomthetho oluhlobene nalolu olungenelayo njengama-Nursing Acts, i-Occupational Health and Safety Act, i-Batho Pele kanye noMthethosisekelo wezamalungelo abaguliyo, imiHlangano yabasebenzi njll. Ikhodi yezijeziso, imisimulo yabantu abakhonzwa, kanye nemisimulo ehihliqwayo nengachazeki kakhulu esibhedlela. ULwazi olujulile lwezima zezigaba eziyisiseko esiZwe (OHSC) kanye nokuLawulwa imininingwane. ULwazi olujulile ngemisebenzi yezogula ephathwa kumazinga e-PHC. Isidingo sokuba ukwazi ukusebenza ngokusekela emawunegcini. Amakhono okuHlanganisa nokuhlela. Amakhono okuMakha iqembu kanye nokuphatha. Amakhono ohlelo lokukhulumisana nokuxazulula izinkinga. ULwazi ngemiThetho yonke emisiwe, imihlahlahlela neyobuNcwadi ohlobene nemiNa yezogula. UBudlelwano obuhle ngomuntu ngamehlo abantu nokuLalela ngokucophelela.
zu.duties: Sekela futhi usize ukuba abantu baziphatsele imisebenzi ebanjwa isibhedlela abantu nomphakathi ongaphandle. UkuHlinzekwa kwemfuneko yemisebenzi yabaguli kanye nokuHlinzeka ngemfuneko ebalulekile njengokutholakala komsinga, ukudla, ukukhipha, uketshezi kanye ne-electrolyte ukulingana, indawo ekhululekile neMtholampilo esibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okulungile ukuqonda izinkombandlela, imisimulo nemicimbi yomsebenzi e.g. i-IMCI, incwadi i-EDL njll. Qinisekisa ukungena kwezinyanga ezilingene kubantu kuhlanganisa nokuphatha okuhle kakhulu imishanguzo ebolewe kanye nokubuka okuhamba phambili kubaguli esibhedlela. Hlela imisebenzi yezogula ngaphakathi kusici se-PHC, kwazi ukusebenza kanye imiphumela ngokumelana nokuHlolwa okumiswe ngumbuso kwaye basebenzise ngezinto ezingavunyelwe. Qinisekisa ukubakho okukahle imininingwane /uQoqo imininingwane, ukubuza futhi kuthunyelwe e-FIO ngesikhathi. Khuthaza abasebenzi ukuthi bakhule ukuze bakhulise izinga lemfundo yabo kubantu ukuba bakhulise inzwa yokukhathalelana. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okunempilo kokuba nokuHlolwa kwezwe okusezingeni eliphezulu kanye nokuzuza kokuSebenza okuhle kwezolimo. Khombisa ukuKhuluma okukahle nabaguli, abaphathi nabanye ochwepheshe bezoGula, kuhlanganise nokubhala imibiko. Siza umphathi weMinyanya yonke ngokuLawula iNqobo yonke kanye nokwesekwa okudingekayo ukuba kusebenze kahle esibhedlela. Sebenza njengesahlukanisi sayo yonke imiNcintisano ukuze kube nokukhululeka okukahle kwezoGula esibhedlela. Kufanele ukuba ukwazi ukuHlela futhi uhlole umsebenzi wakho kanye nalabo abakusekela ukuba kuHlolwe okukahle koGulayo esibhedlela. Qinisekisa ukusetshenziswa okukahle nokugcinwa okuphephile kwezinto zokuSebenza ezisekelwa iMedicine, iSurgery, namaPharmaceutical kanye nanoma yisiphi esinye isitoko.

xh.title: Umngcali weNkonzo yeNesi (iKliniki ye-GREENOCK)
xh.summary: Isithuba somNgcali weNkonzo yeNesi kwiKliniki yase-Greenock eKwaZulu-Natal, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC ngenani leminye engu-4 ubudala obungaphezulu kwesiphepho sokuba yinnesi.
xh.requirements: Inqanaba 1: Amafomula: Ubuncinane beminye engu-4 ubudala obufanelekileyo /obqatshelwayo kwinconikezi yokuba yinnesi emva kokubhaliswa njengoNesi yamakhono aQatshuliweyo e-SANC kwiNkonzo yeNesi jikelele. Inqanaba 2: Amafomula: Ubuncinane beminye engu-14 ubudala obufanelekileyo /obqatshelwayo kwinconikezi yokuba yinnesi emva kokubhaliswa njengoNesi yamakhono aQatshuliweyo e-SANC kwinconikezi yeNesi jikelele, apho ubuncinane beminye engu-10 kufuneka kube yobudala obufanelekileyo /obqatshelwayo emva kokuqokelelwa kwesigqeba seminye engu-1 sokubhaliswa kwamakhono aPhezulu eQolo eNkonzo yeMpilo yeNqanaba lokuQala. IGrade 12(iSatyifiketi seMatriki), iStandard 10/ okanye iNational Certificate kunye nefomula esisiseko ye-R 425 elo ngxelo iDiploma/iDiploma ekwinconikezi yamakhono aqatshuliweyo okanye amakhono ahambelana nayo, afunyanwa kubhalisa njengoNesi yamakhono aQatshuliweyo e-SANC. Ifomula yamakhono aPhezulu eQolo, ixesha lexesha elingelinye ngowonyaka, kwiMisebenzi yeNkonzo yeNqanaba lokuQala, igunyaziswe yi-SANC. Ukubhaliswa kwangoku njengoNesi yamakhono aQatshuliweyo e-SANC kwaye usesikweni kwimfuneko yobuncinane beminye engu-4 ubudala obufanelekileyo /obqatshelwayo emva kokubhaliswa njengoNesi yamakhono aQatshuliweyo e-SANC eNqanaba leNesi jikelele. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namakhono aMfuno kwisithuba: Ingqikithi yomthetho ofanelekileyo njengakwiMithetho yamaNesi, uMthetho woKhuseleko nokuZinza kolusebenzo, iBatho Pele neYecawa laaMthetho yabaLuntu, iFama iMbaxa, naxa umntu ekhankabiweyo ngumthetho. Inqununu imithetho, iNkqubo iMiso yamakhono aLuntu, iNkqubo iNkqubo siseko iNkqubo kwizibhedlele kunye neNkqubo ezizeyo. Ulwazi olunamanzi noluchanekileyo ngamagqabantshintshi eQolo eSizwe (OHSC) nokuLawula iData. Ulwazi olunamanzi noluchanekileyo ngeenkqubo zempiIlo eziquka eNqanaba leNkonzo yeMpilo yeNqanaba lokuQala. Ulwazi lokubeka abantu ababamba indawo yabanye. Aakhoni oqhagamshelo nokuqhelanisa. Aakhoni oqhagamshelwa nabakhenkethi nokuqhagamshelwa. Ulwazi oluhle lokunxibelelanakunye namakhono oQeqesho lweengxaki. Ulwazi ngazo zonke iNgqikithi zemithetho nokuqwalasela iinkqubo ezisesikweni ezinxulumene nemicimbi yamakhono eNesi. Ulwazi oluhle lokunxibelelana nabantu nokuva.
xh.duties: Zonke izixhobo zenziwe ukuba zize zithuthelwe kuluntu neNqanaba leNkonzo eNqanaba lokuQala. uQeqesho kwiNkonzo kaBantu abalimele nokuBoela izinto ezisisiseko ezinjengokubonelela nge-oksijini, ukutya, ukubuyisela iindidi, amafutha nokuNqamla kwamachiza amanzi, izikhululo ekhaya nakwiNqanaba leNkonzo eKliniki. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokufanelekileyo ukuqonde okanye ukuqonde ngokuchanekileyo nokuqonde ngokuchanekileyo kweenkqubo, iNkqubo kunye nemithetho efana ne-IMCI, incwadi ye-EDL, nokunye. Qinisekisa ukuba ngumsebenzi wokuNqamla kwiNkonzo kaBantu abalimele ngokubandakanya ukwamkelwa ngokuchanekileyo kokubonelela ngamachiza kunye nokuQwalasela ngokuphaya iNqanaba leNqanaba lokuQala. Zonke izinto ezikhoyo kwiNkqubo yeMpilo yeNqanaba lokuQala kwiiKliniki ziza kwaliwa, zize zibhalwe, kwaye zize zithunyelwe kumasebe afanelekileyo. Kwaye ukuba kukho imiba engaqukiyo, into iya kwenziwa ukuba isalungele ukuqwalaselwa. Qinisekisa ukuQeqesha abaSebenzi ngokubakhusela nokuQeqesha ngokubakhusela ngokuphela kwexesha. Bonke abantu abangenamsebenzi baya kubonelelwa ngamathuba okuQeqesha abakwazi ukuqeqesha abantu abalimele ukuba baziqonde nokuQwalasela abantu abangenamsebenzi. Zonke izinto ezininzi ezifana neNkqubo yokuQwalasela iNqanaba leNqanaba lokuQala (OHSC) kwaye zize zifakwe kwiNkqubo yeNqanaba lokuQala. Kwindawo ekhoyo, umntu ozele waye ekwazi ukunxibelelana nabantu abalimele nakuNese eNqanaba, kukho imisebenzi eNqanaba leNkonzo. uKhethe ngokusemthethweni nezinye iNkqubo zokuQwalasela iNkqubo iNkqubo iNkqubo siseko iNkqubo iNkqubo. Kwindawo ekhoyo, umntu ozele waye ekwazi ukuQeqesha iNkqubo iNkqubo siseko iNkqubo iNkqubo siseko iNkqubo. Qinisekisa ukusetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo nokugcina ngokuchanekileyo izinto ezifana neSiseko sezeMisebenzi yoMzimba, izeMisebenzi yoMzimba, iNkqubo iNkqubo, nokuSebenzisa izinto ezininzi.

af.title: Finansiesbestuursbeampte (Inkomste)
af.summary: Finansiesbestuursbeampte wat inkomstesameling en rekeninglêering by Niemeyer Memorial Hospital in KwaZulu-Natal hanteer, met 'n diploma en finansieservaring as vereistes.
af.requirements: STD 10 of Graad 12-sertifikaat. Toepaslike graad/nasionale diploma. 1-3 jaar se ervaring in finansies. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis: Kennis van finansies. Kennis van lêerstelsel. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Finansiesbestuur. Kennis van kontantkwitansies.
af.duties: Onderhou 'n gebruikersvriendelike lêerstelsel vir rekeninge. Verantwoordelik vir alle finale inkomstekorrespondensie, afskrywing en rekeningbetalingskategorieë. Monitor die invordering van inkomste van alle pasiënte. Handhaaf prosedures rakende die gebruik van die kluis en kontroleer kwitansieboek. Onderhou doeltreffende en effektiewe benutting van personeel. Doen opvolgwerk oor pasiënte se rekeninge en mediese hulpskemas. Rekord van skuldenaars en krediteure. Stel rekonsiliasie op van alle finansiële verslae en dien dit by Hoofkantoor in. Verseker veilige bewaring van staatsgelde wat ingevorder is. Bestuur pasiënte se rekeninge en verseker nakoming. Voer inkomste-inspeksies uit en identifiseer finansiële risiko's. Superveer inkomstebewerings en verseker doeltreffende fakture ring en invorderings.

zu.title: Isikhulu Sokuphathwa Kwezimali (INGENISO)
zu.summary: Isikhulu Sokuphathwa Kwezimali esiphatha ukuqoqwa kwingeniso nokugcinwa kwamafayili emali eNiemeyer Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, esidinga idiploma namava kuphathwa kwezimali.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi se-STD 10 noma i-Grade12. I-Degree/National Diploma efanelekile. Amava angu- 1- 3 eminyakeniyezimali Ulwazi, Amandla, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Adingekayo: Ulwazi ngezimali. Ulwazi ngendlela yokugcina amafayili. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okuxoxa nokubhala. Uphathwa kwezimali. Ulwazi ngemali ethile efana nezinsizakusebenza ezincane.
zu.duties: Gcina indlela yokugcina amafayili emali elula ukuyisebenzisa. Uphonywe ngemisebenzi yonke ehlotshaniswe nengeniso yokugqibelela, ukususa, kanye namakholwa ekukhokhelwa. Qaphela ukuqoqwa kwingeniso kubo bonke abagulayo. Gcina izinqumo mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwesitshalo bese uhlola incwadi yokumukela. Gcina ukusetshenziswa kwabasebenzi okusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Landela izikweletu zabagulayo nemikhakaba yokusiza kwezokwelaphwa. Bogada abachwepheshile nabadayisi. Hlanganisa futhi uhambisanise wonke amabiko ezimali uwethule eNdiya enkulu. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemali yombuso eqoqiwe. Phatha amakholwa abagulayo bese uqinisekisa ukulandelwa kwemithetho. Yenza ukuhlolwa kwingeniso bese uchaza izingozi ezimali. Qapha izindlela zengeniso bese uqinisekisa ukubhala nokukhokha okusebenza kahle.

xh.title: Ofisi yoLawulo lwezeMali (IREVENUE)
xh.summary: Ofisi yoLawulo lwezeMali elawula ukuqokelelwa kwemali nokulungelelanisa i-akhawunti eNiemeyer Memorial Hospital eKwaZulu-Natal, efunayo idiploma kunye namava kwimali.
xh.requirements: Isatifiketi seSTD 10 okanye Grade 12. IDegree/INational Diploma efanelekileyo. I-1-3 years’ Experience kwimali ULwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho neNtshukumo efunekayo: Ulwazi ngezeMali. Ulwazi ngendlela yokulungelelanisa amafayela. Ukuba nalwazi lwekhompyutha. Amakhono enkululeko yesityhila nolwandiso. Ulawulo lwemali. Ulwazi ngemali encinci esebenziswa kwintsuku.
xh.duties: Phatha indlela yokulungelelanisa amafayela e-akhawunti esebenziseka lula. Nilise ibango kuyo yonke imiceli yengxelo eya phambili ngemali, ukutshaja ikrwada, neendlela zokuhlawula i-akhawunti. Qwalasela ukuqokelelwa kwemali kubo bonke abagulayo. Gcina iinkqubo ezimalunga nokuwasebenzisa isikhwama esinobucwrwada kunye nokukhangela incwadi yokwamkela imali. Qinisekisa ukusebenziswa abasebenzi ngokusebenzayo nangokuchanekileyo. Landelela i-akhawunti zabagulayo namacebo okuncedisa ngonyango. Gcina irekhodi labatywala kunye nabantu abanikwa imali. Lungiselela ukuqwalaselwa kwawo onke amanqaku ezimali kwaye wathumele kwindlu enkulu. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemali karhuwo ekuqokelelweyo. Phatha i-akhawunti zabagulayo uze uqinisekise ukuthobela imigaqo. Yenza ukuqwalasela kwemali ekuqokelelwayo uze uchonge iingozi zamali. Lawula imisebenzi yemali ekuqokelelwayo uze uqinisekise ukubhala i-akhawunti kunye nokuqokelelwa imali ngokusebenzayo.

af.requirements: Grade 12 met wetenskapvakke. Intermediate Life Support Certificate (AEA). Huidige registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Ambulance Emergency Assistant. Huidige registrasie by HPCSA (Geldige kaart sal aanvaar word, depositiestrokie sal nie aanvaar word nie). Ongeëndorseerde bestuurderslisensie, kode C1 met 'n professionele bestuurderspermit (kwitansie van hernuwing sal nie aanvaar word nie) Rekenaarsertifikaat – Ms Office (Word, Excel, Outlook & PowerPoint) sal 'n voordeel wees. Huidige registrasie by SANC. Geldige bestuurderslisensie – kode 8 of hoër. Slegs gekandidateerde kandidate sal verlang word om bewys van ervaring/dienssertifikaat wat deur die HR-departement geëndosseer is voor te lê. Vereiste kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede: Sterke interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Verslagskrywing. Kennis van die District Health Systems. Kennis van tersaaklike regulasies en beleide. Begrip van uitdagings wat die openbare gesondheidssektor in die gesig staar. Vermoë om doelwitte te vertaal en te transformeer in 'n praktiese plan. Leierskap-, organisatoriese-, besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvermoëns binne die DHS-raamwerk.
af.duties: Die ampseraars van hierdie poste sal aan die EMS-skiftleier: Emergency Medical Services rapporteer en verantwoordelik wees om pre-hospitale behandeling binne die omvang van Basic Life Support te verskaf en pasiënte na 'n geskikte gesondheidsfasiliteit te vervoer om die verlies van lewens te minimaliseer. Die ideale kandidaat moet: Oor kennis van die Intermediate Life Support-protokol beskik en EMS en sy bedryfstak verstaan. Oor kennis van Basic Medical Rescue beskik. Oor kennis van die Reëls en Regulasies van die Road Traffic Ordinance beskik. Oor goeie kommunikasievaardighede beskik. Oor praktiese pasiëntbestuursvaardighede beskik. Emergency Ambulances Obstetrics ambulance, inter-facility ambulances, communication Centres, Rescue of Patient, Transport services soos toegewys of ontplooi deur die bestuur van EMS. Buigsaam wees om na enige skif ontplooi te word soos dienslewering vereis. Beskikbaar wees vir Disaster Relief Emergency-ontplooiings nasionaal en/of internasionaal. ENQURIES : Mnr. Abashayeli abangenazigqibo, ilayisenensi yekhodi C1 nelayisensi yokushayela ngobuchwepheshe (isiqinisekiso sokuqinisekisa asisayi kubamkelwa). Kuphela abo kuya kubakho kuluhlu olumfutshane abaya kufuneka benze isiqinisekiso sobugcisa bosetyenziso/ isatifikethi senkonzo esiqinisekiswe liSebe leHR. Ulwazi, amakhono, uqeqesho namandla afunekayo: Amandla amakhulu okunxibelelana nokuThetha. Ukwabhala iingxelo. Ulwazi malunga neNkqubo yeMpilo yoMmandla. Ulwazi ngemigaqo kunye namapoli ahambelana nayo. Ukuqonda iingxaki ezibhekiswa kwisebe leMpilo kaLuntu. Amandla okuguqula okhuselekileyo abe ngumgama ozenzeleyo. Amandla okukhokela, ezoqoqosho, okwenza izigqibo nokusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwesakhelo seDHS.

Umntu ofanelekileyo kufuneka: Aluze nolwazi lowo nxibelelwano lokuXhasa uBomi kwinqanaba eliphakathi kwaye aqonde i-EMS nendlela yayo yokusebenza. Aluze nolwazi lokuXhotyiswa kwesisongwa esiBucala. Aluze nolwazi lweMigaqo nemiQondiso yoMthetho woGqogqo weeNdlela. Abene khono elinzulu lokunxibelelana nokuThetha. Abene khono elibonelelayo lokuLawulwa komntu onomonde. Akwazi ukuzelela iinkqubo zeemngelo. Akwazi ukusebenza ngaphezu komthwalo wakhe. Allokeer. beheer en monitor bestedings volgens begroting om effektiewe kontantvloei bestuur te verseker. Investigate electrical engineering Installations and oversee commissioning of electrical engineering installations.

Support SIAS support structures, school-based support teams SBST. District-based support teams (DBST). Provincial & National programs. zu.title: Onobumba: Nhlophu: Ukwelapha ngokukhuluma
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaNhlophu Othi Ngesikhundla sokwelapha ngokukhuluma izinga le-1 e-Setotolwane LSEN School e-Limpopo, sidinga iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kanye nobhalo lwe-HPCSA onemva iminyaka engu-3 yamava.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF 7 kwelapha ngokukhuluma kanye nokuzwa ngamazwi njengoba kuhambisana ne-SAQA. Ukwetholakala ngaphansi kwe-HPCSA okuvunyiwe njengomuntu olapha ngokukhuluma nangokuzwa ngamazwi. Okuncane iminyaka engu-3 yamava okuhambisana nendima emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA enkabeni yokwelapha ngokukhuluma kanye nokuzwa ngamazwi. Ukukwazi. Ukuphathwa kwesikhathi. ukuphathwa kweqembu. ukusebenza ngaphansi kwegi. ukuphathwa kwezinhlobonhlobo. ukushintsha kanye nolwazi. ukuthanda ukusebenza nangemva kwesikhathi. ulwazi lwezinqubomgomo kanye nemithetho yokufundisa ngendlela ehlanganisa bonke. ukusebenzisa ulwazi ngempilo ukuze uhlele. Ulwazi lwemithetho yokufundisa ehlanganisa bonke kanye namaphatho kahulumeni. imithetho kanye nezinqubomgomo. Ulwazi lokuqaphela kanye nenqubo yokwelapha izigameko ezithize. ukuxhumana kahle. ukubhala imibiko. ukukhuthaza. ukuxhumanisa. ukuhlanganisa. ukuxhumana kanye nokuqamba izinqumo. zu.duties: Nika izinkonzo zokwelapha ngokukhuluma kanye nokuzwa ngamazwi bonke abafundi abadingayo. Sekela abafundisi nabanomsebenzi ohlangothini lokuqondisa kwenziwa izinqubomgomo ze-SIAS. Ukuba nesandla ekubambisweni ngenjongo yokukhuthaza. isb. amafolamu okukhulumisana ngobudoda nobukhwezela. Yiba nomfundo wokutholwa kanye nokuphathwa kwemisho yosizo yokwelapha ngokukhuluma kanye nokuzwa ngamazwi kubo bonke izikole. Sekela izakhiwo zokusekela i-SIAS, amaqembu okusekela esikoleni i-SBST. jobs.summary: Chief Occupational Therapist Grade 1 positions at special schools in Limpopo providing therapy support, supervising therapists, and collaborating with transversal teams.
jobs.requirements: An NQF level 7 qualification in Occupational Therapy as recognised by SAQA. Valid and active registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Occupational Therapist. Minimum of 3 years’ appropriate experience after Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in the Occupational Therapy field. Competencies. Knowledge and Skills: Have knowledge and understanding of education legislation and policies especially Inclusive education and principles (White paper 6, SIAS etc. In-depth knowledge and understanding of Occupational therapy and treatment of learners at designated schools and Care Centre’s. Must be able to promote inclusive education which includes promoting access to quality public funded education for learners with disability. Should have experience in working as part of a team and collaborating with stakeholders. Should be able to take initiative. work under pressure and problem-solve if and when necessary. Experience in coordinating education and other support for learners with disabilities will be an added advantage. The incumbent will function as part of the District-based Support Team with the specific responsibility of providing transversal outreach services to special schools that include learners with severe to profound intellectual disability (LSPID). Preferably be able to communicate effectively. The job involves travelling, and therefore a valid driver’s licence is a requirement. Functional computer literacy (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint & MS Outlook).
jobs.duties: As a member of the transversal team. the incumbent will collaborate with team. members in the provision of support to designated schools. Supervisory work to all the therapists or professionals at a school. Support to be provided will include Assessment of LSPID enrolled in the schools; provision of relevant therapeutic intervention to learners and families; monitoring and reporting on these learners’ progress. training on learning programme for LSPID. Monitoring and reporting implementation of the learning programme for LSPID. Training and supporting teachers for proper assessment and therapeutic session. Monitoring and reporting on the implementation of the intervention for therapeutic purposes in designated schools; advocating for access to quality public funded education for LSPID and carrying out administrative functions related to the support provided. Provide support to other learners in the community as and when needed. Support the District in the development, review, implementation of Inclusive Education for the benefit of designated schools and care center’s in the district.

af.title: Hoof Arbeidsterapeut Graad 1
af.summary: Hoof Arbeidsterapeut Graad 1 poste by spesiale skole in Limpopo wat terapie-ondersteuning verskaf, terapeute toesig hou en met transversale spanne saamwerk.
af.requirements: An NQF level 7 kwalifikasie in Arbeidsterapie soos deur SAQA erken. Geldige en aktiewe registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Arbeidsterapeut. Minimum van 3 jaar se gepaste ervaring na Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in die Arbeidsterapie-veld. Bevoegdhede. Kennis en Vaardighede: Oor beskikking oor kennis en begrip van onderwyswetgewing en beleide veral Inklusiewe onderwys en beginsels (Wit papier 6, SIAS, ens. Diepgaande kennis en begrip van Arbeidsterapie en behandeling van leerders by aangewysde skole en sorgsentra. Moet in staat wees om inklusiewe onderwys te bevorder wat die bevordering van toegang tot gehalte openbaar befondsde onderwys vir leerders met gestremdhede insluit. Behoort ervaring te hê in spanwerk en samewerking met belanghebbendes. Behoort in staat te wees om inisiatief te neem. onder druk te werk en probleme op te los indien en wanneer nodig. Ervaring in die koördinering van onderwys en ander ondersteuning vir leerders met gestremdhede sal 'n voordeel wees. Die ampshouer sal funksioneer as deel van die Distrik-gebaseerde Ondersteuningspan met die spesifieke verantwoordelikheid om transversale uitreikdienste aan spesiale skole te verskaf wat leerders met ernstige tot diep intellektuele gestremdheid (LSPID) insluit. By voorkeur in staat wees om doeltreffend te kommunikeer. Die pos behels reis, en daarom is 'n geldige bestuurderlisensie 'n vereiste. Funksionele rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint & MS Outlook).
af.duties: As 'n lid van die transversale span. sal die ampshouer met spanlede saamwerk in die voorsiening van ondersteuning aan aangewysde skole. Toesighoudende werk aan al die terapeute of professionele persone by 'n skool. Ondersteuning wat verskaf sal word, sal insluit assessering van LSPID wat by die skole ingeskryf is; voorsiening van relevante terapeutiese ingryping aan leerders en gesinne; monitering en verslagdoening oor die vordering van hierdie leerders. opleiding oor leerprogram vir LSPID. Monitering en verslagdoening oor implementering van die leerprogram vir LSPID. Opleiding en ondersteuning van onderwysers vir behoorlike assessering en terapeutiese sessies. Monitering en verslagdoening oor die implementering van die ingryping vir terapeutiese doeleindes in aangewysde skole; beywering vir toegang tot gehalte openbaar befondsde onderwys vir LSPID en die uitvoer van administratiewe funksies wat verband hou met die ondersteuning wat verskaf is. Verskaf ondersteuning aan ander leerders in die gemeenskap soos en wanneer nodig. Ondersteun die Distrik in die ontwikkeling, hersiening, implementering van Inklusiewe Onderwys tot voordeel van aangewysde skole en sorgsentra in die distrik.

zu.title: Oqhubelekayo Phambili weTherapy Grade 1
zu.summary: Iindawo ezintathu ezikwikhondo lokuvakalisa kwikhondo elisezantsi eLimpopo ezibonelela ngenkxaso ekuvakaliseni, ukulawula abasebenzi basekhaya, kunye nokusebenza ngokubambisana namakomiti ohamba phambili eLimpopo.
zu.requirements: Ileveli 7 yamava afanelekileyo kumsebenzi wokuvakalisa i-Diploma kwikhondo eliseltya elikwisikolo sikanonnelo ecelweni esemthethweni. Ukuba ngumsebenzi ohamba phambili ngokugqithisa amava afanelekileyo kwikhondo lokuvakalisa, ukuba nolwazi olubanzi malunga nokubhaliswa kwamalungiselelo emisileyo eluntwini. Ulwazi olubanzi ngokomthetho ka-2001 nakwisikhokelo esigqithiselwa kolunye uguquko, ngokukodwa kwabafundi abanemiphumo engathathi hlangothi kwiindawo ezikwisikolo esingowalo. Ulwazi ngokukhusela amalungiselelo ibhalwe kuLuntu olusetyenziswa ngabafundi abangenamandla okuqhuba umsebenzi wokulawula. Ulwazi ngokuqhuba amaxesha amaninzi ukuba ngumsebenzi wokuvakalisa kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi ngokubonelela ngokukhusela amaxwebhu alawulwa kukabafundi nokukhusela ukuba akwazi ukusetyenziswa kwabafundi abangenamandla okusebenza. Ulwazi ngokubonelela ngokukhusela ukubhaliswa kwabafundi kwiinkqubo zomsebenzi wokuvakalisa. Ulwazi ngokubonelela ngokukhusela amalungiselelo amaninzi kwaye abe nokukwazi ukusebenza ngokutsha.
zu.duties: Njengelungu leqhikimba elihamba phambili. lowo ohlolwayo uzosebenzisana nemalungu eqhikimba. ekunikeni inkxaso ezikoleni eziqokiweyo. Umsebenzi wonqulo ongcali abo bonke abanye abasebenzi ngokomthombo osekulo. Inkxaso ekunikezelwayo iya kuquka ukuhlolwa kwabafundi abakhwelayo ukufumana inkxaso ebanzi (LSPID) ababhalisiweyo ezikweni, kunye nokubonelela ngenkxaso ehambelana nemfuno yekhathi elide ngokweemfuno zabafundi. Nokupela ukuxhaswa nokubhaliswa kwaba bafundi, ukulandelelwa kwaye kubike ixesha elithile.

xh.title: Chief Occupational Therapist Grade 1
xh.summary: Izithuba ze Chief Occupational Therapist Grade 1 kwiiskulu ezikhethekileyo eLimpopo ezinika inkxaso yemisebenzi yamachasi, kulawule abachasi, kwaye basebenzisane namanqamba abalawuli.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF level 7 kw Occupational Therapy njengoko sivunywe yiSAQA. Ubulungu obusebenzayo obungavuselelwanga ngo-HPCSA njengomchazi we Occupational Therapy. Ukuba ngumntu onamava obunganganga kw iminyaka elishumi elinesithandathu (1994) ukusukela koko aguqulwa ngokusesixhenxe kwi Occupational Therapy ekwindla. Iinkqubo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuba nolwazi nokuqonda iNkqubo yeemfundo nemiqathango ngokukhethekileyo iNkqubo yeemfundo ebandakanyayo (iNkqubo ebandakanyayo 6, SIAS, nokunye. Ulwazi olujonge nzondelelo nokuqonda i Occupational Therapy kunye nokusetyenziswa kwezilumkiso kubafundi kwiikholeji ezakhethwayo nakuqokelela iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Kufuneka ukuba ukwazi ukukhuthaza inkqubo yeemfundo ebandakanyayo, equka ukukhuthaza ukufikelela kwabafundi abakhubazekileyo kwinkqubo yezemfundo eboniswayo enikela inkxaso. Kufuneka ukuba unamava kokusebenza njengelungu lenqamba nasekuqokeleleni inkxabo ngokusetyenziswa koluntu. Kufuneka ukwazi ukwenza izinto ngokutsha. ukusebenza ngamandla kwaye ukwazi ukusombulula iingxaki xa kunjalo. Amava ekulawulen iinkqubo zezemfundo nongenelelo kubafundi abakhubazekileyo ziza kuba luncedo. Lo mntu uza kusebenza njengelungu lenqamba ekuqokeleleni amaziko, exhasa iikholeji ezakhethwayo ngokusetyenziswa koluntu. Kuyacetyiswa ukuba ukwazi ukuthetha kakuhle. Lo msebenzi uqokelela ukuhamba, ngoko ke ifayile yokuyaleza iluncedo elingangangenwa. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint & MS Outlook).
xh.duties: Njengelungu lenqamba ezalathelayo. umntu othe ngaphaya kweyure ezisisigxina, oza kusebenzisana namalungu enqamba ekuqokelelweni inkxaso kwiikholeji ezakhethwayo. Umsebenzi wolawulo kubo bonke abachasi ngomgangatho obuzayo nangamakhulu amakhulu aqokelelwe koolungu bethu. Inkxaso ezakunikezwa iquka ukuqokelela iinkcukacha zamakhulu abantu abanengqondo ezingamakhulu athathu kakhulu, kubandakanya ukuqokelela iinkxaso ezahlukeneyo, ukulinganisa nokuqinisekisa ukuba banako ukwenza umsebenzi oqinileyo wokuzilolonga. Ukulathela kwabafundi abanengqondo ezingamakhulu, ukuyalela iinkqubo zokufunda, ukulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo, ukwenza iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokwenza umsebenzi, kunye nokulawula iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokwenza umsebenzi. Ukufundisa nokuxhasa ootitshala ukuba bakwazi ukuqokelela iinkcukacha nakuqinisekisa ukwenza kwezilumkiso. Ukulawula nokuchaza indlela esetyenziswe kuyo inkqubo yokuqokelela iinkcukacha ngemigangatho yabafundi abanengqondo ezingamakhulu, nokuguqula iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezinokuthi zisetyenziswe kwiikholeji ezakhethwayo; nokukhuthaza ukufikelela kwabafundi abanengqondo ezingamakhulu kwinkqubo yezemfundo eboniswayo, nokwenza imisebenzi yokuqokelela iinkcukacha ngexesha lokunikela inkxaso. Ukunikela inkxaso kwezinye iindidi zabafundi kuluntu xa kusetyenziswa. Ukuxhasa iDistrhikhi ekuyileni, ekucocweni, nakuqokeleleni iinkqubo zokuqokelela iinkcukacha ngexesha lokunika amandla iikholeji ezakhethwayo kunye namaziko eNkathazo kwidistrhikhi.

af.title: Maatskaplikewerk-toesighouer
af.summary: Die Department of Education in Limpopo soek Maatskaplikewerk-toesighouers oor tien distrikte om ECD-beleidsimplementering te bestuur en tegniese ondersteuning aan ECD-programme te verskaf.
af.requirements: NQF-vlak 7-kwalifikasie in Maatskaplike Werk soos deur SAQA erken. Minimum van sewe (07) jaar se ervaring as 'n Maatskaplike Werker. Ervaring in die veld van ECD en Gedeeltelike Sorg sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien. Geldige registrasie by die South African Council for Social Service Professions (SACSSP). Geldige bestuurderslisensie met die uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede. Bevoegdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Kennis van ECD-voorwaardelike toelaes, Onderwys- en Maatskaplike Ontwikkeling-strategieë en programme wat op ECD betrekking het. Regeringsbeleide en benadering tot ECD en die Children's Act. Program- en projeksbestuursvaardighede. Inligtings- en kennisbestuursvaardighede. Mensebestuurs- en bemagtigingsvaardighede. Kommunikasie- en koördinasievaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede. Beleidsimplementeringvaardighede. Besondersetiekvaardighede. Goeie verbale en skriftelike kommunikasie. Goeie verslagskryfvaardighede. Vermoë om in te gryp en konflik van 'n komplekse aard op te los. Probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Beplannings- en organisasievaardighede en die vermoë om onafhanklik te werk. Deernis. Analitiese vaardighede.
af.duties: Bestuur en fasiliteer die implementering van ECD-beleide. strategieë. minimum tegniese norme en standaarde. insluitend praktykriglyne ten opsigte van die voorwaardelike toelaag vir vroeë kinderontwikkeling. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan die ECD-program en verseker dat alle lewerbare uitkomste van die voorwaardelike ECD-toelaag nagekom word. Konsolideer provinsiale verslae in ooreenstemming met die ECD-voorwaardelike raamwerk. Bestuur en fasiliteer kapasiteitsbou oor die voorwaardelike ECD-toelaag. Bestuur en monitor befondsde ECD-sentrums. hou toesig oor maatskaplike werkers. maatskaplike hulpwerkers en datavasvatters.

zu.title: Umphathi Wabasebenzi Bezenhlalo
zu.summary: Umnyango we-Education e-Limpopo ufuna abaphathi babasebenzi bezenhlalo kuzinkomponi ezishumi ukuze balawule ukuqashelwa kwenqubomgomo ye-ECD bathole ukwesekwa ngobuchwepheshe kuhlelo lwe-ECD.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kwi-Social Work njengoba kunconywa yi-SAQA. Isipho esingaphansi kwesikhathi eside (07) sokuqashelwa njengenye yezinto ezingabalulekile kulo msebenzi. Ulwazi lweminyaka elikhulu (07) emsebenzini wezenhlalo. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ehlobene ne-ECD Partial Energy nokusebenza kwabantu abakhubazekile kuzothola ulwazi olwengeziwe. Hlela imiklamo yezibonelelo ezifundwa, isikhundla sokusebenza, ukufunda nokuzijwayeza emsebenzini. Qapha ukusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amakhono kwezabasebenzi kanye nezingajwayelekile. Qamba amaphuzu abalulekile emphakathini, izibalo kanye namaphuzu wokuphumelela. Hlela ukubuswa kwezinhlelo zokubonisana ngamakhono aphakeme. Phatha imali yokuthuthukisa amakhono futhi ulandele ukusetshenziswa kwayo. Nikeza izeluleko ngemikhuba yokuthuthukisa amakhono abasebenzi. Lawula futhi uthuthukise abasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesigaba. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nawo wonke umthetho kanye nemibandela yaphakathi. Hlela imiklamo yamaphulo wokuthuthukisa amakhono esifundazweni nakomasipala.

Yiba nokuqonda okungenamkhawulo kweminyaka emihlanu (5) ekwakhawuleza iimfuno phakathi kwaye ezi zintathu (3) zibekwe kwinqanaba loLawulo olusezantsi okanye oluphambili okulingana ne-7/8 kwimimandla yoPhuhliso lwamakhono, ukuphuhlisa imithombo yabasebenzi, ukuqengqelela uqeqesho, nakwindawo yokusebenzela. Layisensi yasekhaya yokushishiya ibhedi yokuhamba, ngaphandle kwabantu abaswela amandla okuzisebenzela. Iimpawu zokuba namandla okwenza into. Ulwazi & amakhono: Yiba nolwazi ngomthetho woPhuhliso lwamakhono, umthetho weMali engeniswa yiNkqubo yoPhuhliso lwamakhono, iNkqubo yoPhuhliso iNkqubo lwamakhona, iMigaqo yoLuntu, umthetho wokuqaliswa kolulinganisayo lwaBantu, umthetho wokuqaliswa kobudlelwano bokusebenza, iimfuno ze-ETDP SETA namagunya ayo, kwaye nakwisixhobo esilawulayo esithengiselwa i-DPSA. Inkqubo yomthetho waseburhulumente, nemithetho yakwaXhosane njengoko nokusemthethweni, kwaye iinkqubo zophuhliso lwemithombo yabasebenzi. Iinkqubo zokusebenzela iNdlela zokuHlaziya amakhono (WSPs) kwaye neNgxelo yokuQeqesha ngonyaka (ATRs). Ulwazi ngokulinganisa amakhono kwaye ibeke iindilinga ezisetyenziswayo. Ukuqhankqalaza iinkqubo zemisebenzi, abafundi basekuhlaleni kwaye iinkqubo zokusebenza ezikumakhono. Iimfuno ze-ETDP SETA kwaye i-Skills Fund yasezantsi eMzantsi Afrika. Iinkqubo zoPhuhliso lwaBantu kwiNkqubo (PMDS). Ukuqengqelela okuqinisekileyo. Ulwazi ngokulinganisa, ukuqinisekisa okukhulu kunye nokuqinisekiswa kokubakho kwezimali, imigaqo yokuqinisekiswa. Ukuzithomba, ukucutshungula nokucinga ngokubanzi. Amakhono wokuqhankqalaza nokulawula iinkqubo ezomelezayo. Amakhono abalaseleyo eNkqubo yolawulo nokulawula abantu abangaphezulu. Ulawulo lweSiphakamile nezinye iindlela zokuLawulwa. Amakhono wokuqaqumba iingxelo kwaye axoxe ngazo. Ukuba namandla okuthetha nabantu kwaye axoxe ngokomntu. Ulwazi lokuhlalutya idata yemilinganiselo yezibalo kwaye axoxe ngazo. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki kwaye athathe iigqibo ezibalaseleyo. Ukuba namandla okusebenza phantsi kwexesha elinzima kwaye awugcwalise iinkqubo ngexesha elifunekayo. Amakhono okuqonda ngokusetyenziswa, ukuqinisekiswa nokulawula konke okusemthethweni. Amakhono okusebenzisa ikhompyutha: MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, kwaye iinkqubo HRD.
xh.duties: Lawula inkqubo yesebe leNkqubo yeakhawuntu ngamakhono abasebenzi neNgxelo yokuQeqesha ngonyaka. Qondisa uluvo ngeziphulumoiso zamakhono kwaye kuchaze iindlela ezijulileyo ezikhoyo ngamakhono ebuhlalu. Lawula inkqubo yokuziqhelanisa, ukuphuhlisa nokwakha ikhondo labasebenzi. Yiba nolonwabo lobudlelwane ETDP SETA, iintshisho zobugcisa obuphezulu babafundi kunye nokuqeqesha ababoneleli. Lawula inkqubo yemibonelelo yemali yefundi, iinkqubo zokuziqhelanisa, abafundi basekuhlaleni, nokufunda ngokwazimo. Qengqelela ukusetyenziswa kweenkqubo HRD kunye neendlela ezicutshungulwayo. Qengqelela iingxelo zolawulo, izibalo, neengxelo zokuthobela. Lawula iinkqubo zeBhunga leNkululeko noLwazi kwiNgxoxo ngoPhuhliso lwamakhono. Lawula imigca yemali yokufundisa ukuze ubone imitharo yokuqhekezwa. Nikela nengcebiso ngendlela yokwenza inkqubo yokuphuhlisa imithombo yabasebenzi. Lawula abasebenzi abangaphakathi kwale ntshisho ukwakhela bonke ubuchule. Qinisekisa ukuthobela lonke izinto ezilawulwa ngumthetho, iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo. Lawula iiprojekthi zophuhliso ngamakhono ephondo nakummandla.

zu.title: Umsekeli Weqonga: Ukusungulwa kwezikhundla namaSistimu e-HR
zu.summary: Phatha ukulawulwa kokusungulwa kwezikhundla namaSistimu e-HR e-PERSAL ehhovisi elikhulu le-Limpopo Department of Education, kudingeka iziqu ze-NQF level 6 namava eminyaka emihlanu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 6 kwi-Human Resource Management/ Human Resource Development / Public Administration/ Public Management njengoba kubonwa yi-SAQA. Isitifikedi se-PERSAL. Amava eminyaka emihlanu (5) lapho kufuneka iminyaka emithathu (3) kube kulesikhundla sokuphatha esingezansi / ezingeni lokuhlola 7/8 ngaphakathi kwesigaba esihlobene. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile (ngaphandle komuntu onesisu). Amakhono. Ulwazi nakhono: Ulwazi nekuqonda kwe-Public Service Act (PSA), Public Service Regulations (PSR), Izinqumo ze-PSCBC, Labour Relations Act Inqubo namapholisi e-HR. Employment of Educators Act (EEA). Personnel Administrative Measures (PAM), PFMA ne-sistimu ye-PERSAL. Ukuhlelwa okunamandla nebebuqhawe. Isikhono sokusebenza ngaphansi kwenkaza futhi ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esibekiwe. Ukuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuhlaziya. Ukuphathwa kwezinhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ukuphathwa koshintsho. Ukuphathwa kwezimali. Ukumiswa kwabathile nokugxila kumthengi. Ukuthumela imiyalezo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwekhompuyutha: MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point & MS Outlook.
zu.duties: Ukulawulwa kokusungulwa kwezikhundla: Ukuphathwa kwemathirikisi. Hlaqamba umbiko nyanga zonke. Yenza ukuhlola izindaba zokusungulwa kwezikhundla. Nikeza ulwazi lwe-PERSAL. Ukulawulwa kwesistimu: Yiba ngumlawuli we-HR PERSAL. Bhalisa i-SCC ku-National Treasury. Yenza ukuvakashela amasifundza ezindabeni ze-sistimu. Dala futhi ususe abasebenzisi be-PERSAL. Faka amakholi abasebenzisi nge-Help Desk. Setha kabusha abasebenzisi abayekiwe. Qapha ukwephula ukufinyelela kwe-PERSAL. Phendula imibuzo ye-AG ezindabeni ze-sistimu.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezempilo Yokusebenza
zu.summary: Kudingeka abaphathi abane Bezempilo Yokusebenza kumakhulu emfundo ase-Limpopo ukuze kusetshenziswe izinqubo zokuphepha, kwenziwe ukubheka ukuphepha komsebenzi (OHS) kuphathwe futhi kuphenywe izenzakalo.
zu.requirements: Izindingo ezinga le-NQF Level 6 ekuphathweni kokuphepha / ekuphathweni kwezempilo zomhlaba njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Iziqu ekuphathweni kokuphepha / ekuphathweni kwezempilo zomhlaba noma iziqu ezihlobene kuzoba yinuzuzo. Ukufundela ikhosi ekuphathweni kokuphepha i-SAMTRAC kanye nokwazi ngempilo yomhlaba kuzoba yinuzuzo. Ukubhalisa emthethweni ochwepheshe, i-South African Institute of Occupational Safety and Health (SAIOSH). Ubufakazi obuncane beminyaka engu-3 bokusebenza kwezempilo nokuphepha komsebenzi kanye nendawo ehlobene nalesi. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni ngaphandle kwalabo abakhubazekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngohlaka lokuqondisa i-Employee Health and Wellness Strategic Framework. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Compensation for Occupational Injuries and Diseases Act (COIDA), i-Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHSA) kanye nemithetho yayo. Ukuqonda nokusebenzisa i-Hazard Identification and Risk Assessment (HIRA). Ulwazi ngendlela i-Incident Cause Analysis Method (ICAM). I-Root Cause Analysis Technique (RCAT) ekuphenyweni kwezehlakalo. Ukufundela i-First Aid. Ulwazi ngale-International Organization for Standardizations (ISO) 45001 & 14001. Amakhono okukhuluma nokubhala ahloniphekile. Ukusebenzisa i-Health & Safety Management System. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point kanye ne-MS Outlook).
zu.duties: Sebenzisa futhi uqaphele wonke izinqubo zokuphepha. Thatha inxaxheba eqweni lokuhlola ubungozi. Yenza ukubheka ukuphepha komsebenzi (OHS). Phenya izehlakalo kanye nezinto ezenzekile. Yenza ukuhlola ngaphakathi ngokushayinga izinqubo zenhlangano nomthetho. Gcina uhlelo lwe-SHE RISK system. Ukulungiselela nokuphendula ezimweni ezingozipho. Ukuphatha ngempumelelo ukuphepha kwezonto. Hlanganiswa futhi ukuthatha inxaxheba emihlanganweni ehlobene ne-SHE kanye nemikhankaso yokuqinisekisa ukuphepha. Qoqa ulwazi/mininingwane yemibiko ye-SHE kanye nezibalo.

af.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Facilities Management (X2
af.summary: Twee senior administratiewe beamptes benodig vir fasiliteitebestuur in Limpopo se Department of Education, wat 'n NQF Level 6-kwalifikasie en drie jaar relevante ervaring vereis.
af.requirements: NQF level 6-kwalifikasie soos erken deur SAQA. 'n Kwalifikasie(s) in Finansiële / Risikobestuur / Sekuriteitsbestuur sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Grade-B PSIRA-sertifikaat sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Minimum van 3 jaar relevante ervaring in Sekuriteit & Fasiliteitebestuur of verwante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie, behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede. Kennis en vaardighede: Deglike kennis van die Criminal Procedure Act, Minimum Information Security Standard, Control of Access to Public Premises and Vehicles Act, rekenaarvaardigheid en Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHS). Die aansoeker moet bereid wees om die proses van sekuriteitsondersoek te ondergaan.
af.duties: Toesig hou oor die sekuriteitsfunksies wat deur sekuriteitsbeamptes/diensverskaffers uitgevoer word, en verseker nakoming van die departement se sekuriteitsbeleid. Ken pligte toe aan sekuriteitsbeamptes/diensverskaffers, monitor uitkomste en instelleer die nodige korrektiewe maatreëls om afwykings van norme en standaarde aan te spreek. Monitor toegangsbeheer om ongemagtigde toegang tot geboue en ander persele te voorkom. Magtiging van toerusting, dokumente en voorrade na of uit die gebou of persele. Monitor en bied ondersteuning in geval van noodgevalle. Lewer administratiewe en verwante funksies. Administreer die sleutelbeheerstelsel. Identifiseer risiko's en bedreigings vir die sekuriteit van die departement. Verskaf inligting rakende voorvalle aan ondersoekbeamptes. Rapporteer foutiewe toerusting/stelsels. Administreer alle beheerkamer-bewerkings om die departement se bates te beskerm. Hersiening van opnames op versoek deur die korrekte prosedure. Werk alle register vir die waargenome voorvalle by.

zu.title: Ofisa Ophethe Iminyakathi Yokuphathwa Kwemisebenzi Yokuphepha (X2
zu.summary: Kudingwa abaphathi abaphezulu bengxenye yobalulekile ababili ukuphathwa kwezinsiza e-Umbuso wezeMfundo we-Limpopo, kudinga iziqu ze-NQF Level 6 kanye neminyaka emithathu yokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambelana nalokho.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 6 njengoba zivunywa yi-SAQA. Iziqu kwi-Financial / Risk Management / Security Management zizoba yinzuzo. Isitifiketi se-Grade-B PSIRA sizoba yinzuzo. Okungenani unyaka we-3 wokuhlangenwe nakho okuhambelana ne-Security & Facilities Management noma indawo ephathelene nayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekile Ulwazi nobuchwepheshe: Ulwazi oluhle nge-Criminal Procedure Act, i-Minimum Information Security Standard, i-Control of Access to Public Premises and Vehicles Act, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kanye ne-Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHS). Umfaki isicelo kufanele ezimisele ukugqamuka inqubo yokuhlola ukuphepha.
zu.duties: Qapha imisebenzi yokuphepha eyenziwa ngabaphathi bokuphepha / abahlinzeki bezinsiza, ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kulandelwa izinqubomgomo zokuphepha zomnyango. Abanike imisebenzi kubaphathi bokuphepha / abahlinzeki bezinsiza, ulinganise imiphumela usize ngamalungiselelo afanele okuxazulula ukweqa kwemithesho nemigomo. LINGANISE UKULAWULA UKUNGENA ukuvikela ukungena okungagunyaziwe ezakhiwo nasezindaweni ezinye. Vuma izinto, amadokhumenti nemitshingo engena noma ephuma esakhiweni nasezindaweni. LINGANISE futhi unike usizo ezimeni eziphuthumayo. Yenza imisebenzi yobalulekile nephathelene nayo. Lawula isistimu yokulawula okhiye. Khomba izingozi nezinkululeko ezibeka ingcuphezo yokuphepha komnyango. Nikela ulwazi ngomlando wesenzo kubaphathi bophenyo. Mbiko izinto / izistimu ezingasebenzi kahle. Lawula yonke imisebenzi yegumbi lokulawula ukuvikela izimpahla zomnyango. Buyekeza amavesi ngesicelo ngendlela elandelwayo. Buyekeza yonke imibhalo yezenzo ezibonakalayo.

xh.title: Senior Administrative Officer: Facilities Management (X2
xh.summary: Kufuneka ababe abapili balawulo ababini bakwi-Facilities Management kwisebe lezeMfundo kwi-Limpopo, kufuneka babe nesidanga se-NQF Level 6 kunye neminyaka elishumi yamava ahambelanayo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno NQF level 6 njengokuqatshwa yi-SAQA. Isidanga kwi-Financial / Risk Management / Security Management siza kuba lusizo olungezelelweyo. Isatifikethi se-Grade-B PSIRA siza kuba lusizo olungezelelweyo. Ubuncinane iinyanga eziyi-3 zemfuno ekusebenzeni kwi-Security & Facilities Management okanye kwinkalo ebandakanyekayo. Ilayisensi yomqhubi egqithisiweyo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olubalulekileyo lwe-Criminal Procedure Act, i-Minimum Information Security Standard, i-Control of Access to Public Premises and Vehicles Act, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kunye ne-Occupational Health and Safety Act (OHS). Umfundi kufuneka abe sikweni wokuwohloka inkqubo yokhuseleko yokuba igunya.
xh.duties: Phatha imisebenzi yokhuseleko eyedwa ngamagosa okhuseleko/baboneleli benkonzo, ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zokhuseleko zesebe. Nika imisebenzi amagosa okhuseleko/baboneleli benkonzo, qonda iziphumo uze usebenzise iindlela ezilungileyo zokulungisa ukungqubana neendlela ezimiselayo nemigaqo. Qonda ulawulo lokungena ukuyiphatha ukungena abangenayo igunya kwakho kunye nakwamanye amawindi ezakhiwo. Inika igunya eqosisiweni, amaxwebhu kunye nezinto zendlu ezingena okanye eziphuma kwakho okanye nakwamanye amawindi ezakhiwo. Qonda unike inkxaso xa kukho iimeko eziphuthumayo. Zenza imisebenzi yolawulo nendlela ezidityanisiweyo nayo. Lawula inkqubo yolawulo lwesitshixo. Chonga iingozi kunye nokusinyeka kukhuseleko lwesebe. Nikezela nolwazi malunga nenkokhela Kumagosa aphando. Xela izixhobo/inkqubo ezisimbi. Lawula zonke iinkqubo zeqela lolawulo ukuyikhusela izinto zesebe. Phinda ubuke iifoto xa kucelwa ngokwenza inkqubo elungileyo. Hlaziya yonke irejista ngenxa yoko kutyiwayo.
