zu.requirements: Ithuluzi le-NQF level 6 njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Isitifiketi/nobufakazi kwi-Introductory PERSAL. Ubufakazi noma ngeliphi elingaphansi kwalesi ngezinga le-NQF level 6 lapho kuqashwa khona yi-SAQA nobuntwana balemini yokwazi ukuthi kungenziwa ngaphakathi. Obuncwane bekhono elihle lokuxhumana. Ubufakazi bekhono elihle lokubhala. Ubufakazi bekhono elihle lokukhuluma. Ubuchwepheshe bokusebenza ngamakhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint kanye ne-MS Outlook).
zu.duties: Qapha izimo zokusebenza zokuqasha abafundisi kanye nabasebenzi basezikhundleni zomphakathi. Qapha ukufakwa nokucutshungulwa kwezinzuzo zomsebenzi (izindleko zokuhlala, iholo lokuphumula, izinkokhelo zokuhlala, isikhathi esengeziwe, imiklomelo yamakhulu eminyaka, njll.) Qapha ukuphela kwesikhathi sabasebenzi. Buyekeza ukuphela kwezinkokhelo kusiko sakho-elekthronikhi ukuze kulandelwe nakuwo umaka wabasebenzi. Vumisa/ungalivumi izinto ezenziwa ezimeni zokusebenza kwi-PERSAL. Hlela imibiko yezibalo yanyanga zonke kanye nemibiko yabaphathi.

xh.title: Umsebenzi ophezulu wabaqeqeshi bantu: Iimeko zomsebenzi (X2
xh.summary: Abo buphayona ababini abaphezulu babantu abaqhuba iimeko zomsebenzi kwindlu enkulu yeLimpopo Department of Education nakwi-Capricorn North District.
xh.requirements: Ithuba le-NQF level 6 njengokumkelwa yi-SAQA. Isidanga okanye oonotshiwo kwi-Management yoBuntu/i-Public Management/i-Public Administration kuya kuba yoncedo. Isatifikethi okanye ubungqina be-Introductory PERSAL. Iminyaka engu-3 ubudala yamava ahambelanayo kwindawo ye-HRM/Public Management okanye kwimimandla elunganiselweyo. Ilayisense yokushayela esebenzayo, ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukusombulula iingxaki nenkqubo yokuthetha ngokucatshulwa kwento ethile. Ulawulo lweenkqubo namaphulo. Ulwazi ukuqonda ngakumbi kwisasimo solawulo seNkonzo kaRhulumente. Amakhono obuqhawe bokunxibelelana (ngomlomo nakubhalwe). Amakhono okucinga nokuhlela. Ukusebenzisa iikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint ne-MS Outlook).
xh.duties: Qikelela iimeko zomsebenzi wokuqesha ootitshala baseMfunweni nabasebenzi baseNkonzo kaRhulumente. Qikelela ukungeniswa nokucutshungulwa kwezinzuzo zomsebenzi (iimalana zendlu, iikhuse ezahlukeneyo, iipenshini, ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwexesha eliqhelekileyo, iindondo zokukhonza ixesha elide, njl.). Qikelela ukupheliswa kwabasebenzi. Ukuhlaziya iindaba zokuqeshwa kwindawo egcinwayo yeenkcukacha ze-elekthronikhi ukuze kusetyenziswe njengomkhondo nakwifayili yomsebenzi. Vuma/ungavumi iindaba ezithintela iimeko zomsebenzi kwi-PERSAL. Ukwakha iingxelo zobuni brenyo ngeenyanga ezithintelwe ubungakanano beendaba.

af.requirements: NQF vlak 6-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. Kwalifikasie(s) in Inligtingstegnologie, Rekenaarwetenskappe, Telekommunikasie-ingenieurswese / Elektroniese ingenieurswese sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Minimum van 3 jaar relevante ervaring in Inligtingstegnologie / Rekenaarwetenskappe of verwante veld. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie behalwe vir persone met gestremdhede: Kennis van netwerkontwerp, netwerksekuriteit en probleemoplossing. zu.title: Chief Network Controller
zu.summary: Izikhundla zika-Chief Network Controller emaphaselini e-Limpopo Department of Education abheke imisebenzi yenethiwekhi, ukuphepha kanye nokuqhwebwana, idinga iziqu ezingeni le-NQF Level 6 nokuhlangenwe nakho kweminyaka emithathu kwe-IT.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezinga le-NQF 6 njengoba zidunyiswe yi-SAQA. Iziqu/iziqu ku-Information Technology, Computer Sciences, Telecommunication Engineering / Electronic Engineering kuzoba ngumusa ongaphezu kwawo. Umkhulu weminyaka engu-3 ohambisana nokuhlangenwe nakho ku-Information Technology / Computer Sciences noma enkombweni edingekayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esemthethweni ngaphandle kwalabo abaphila nokuphila okukhubazekile: Ulwazi ngokwakha inethiwekhi, ukuphepha kwenethiwekhi kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi ngamaphrothokholi namateknoloji e-nethiwekhi (TCP/IP, DNS and OSPF and BGP). Ulwazi ngamateknoloji e-LAN/WAN.
zu.duties: Qapha futhi uhlole imisebenzi yonke yamasistimu ethulekweni nokuqhwebwana. Bheka ukusebenza kwenethiwekhi nokuphepha kwayo usebenzisa izinsiza ezithuthukisiwe. Qinisekisa ukuhlangana okuthembekile kuzo zonke iziteshi zomnyango (LAN/WAN/WIFI). Qapha ukugcina okwesikhathi, ukubuyiswa kwemininingwane kanye nazo zonke izinqubo zokubuyisa. Gcina imibhalo ye-ICT. Qinisekisa ukuthobela izindinganiso zokuphepha kwe-IT kanye namapholisi aqobo nokuvikelwa kwemininingwane.

xh.title: UMlawuli weNethiwekhi oyiNkokheli
xh.summary: Iindima zoMlawuli weNethiwekhi oyiNkokheli kwizithili zesebe lezemfundo i-Limpopo Department of Education, ephethe iinkqubo zenethiwekhi, ukhuseleko nokuqhagamshelana, kufuneka nesiqinisekiso esingana nalesi sinqanaba i-NQF Level 6 kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava kwe-IT.
xh.requirements: NQF level 6 qualification as recognized by SAQA. Iziqinisekiso kwISayensi yolwazi lwekhompyutha, nokwInjinieri yamajombo / Injinieri yamajombo kuya kuba lumngeno. Ubuncinane iimyaka ze-3 yamava ahambelanayo kwiNdlela yolwazi lwekhompyutha / ISayensi yekhompyutha okanye indawo ehambelanayo. Ilayisensi yomqeshi egqithisiweyo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo: Ulwazi ngokuyila iNethiwekhi, ukhuseleko nokuqondisa iNethiwekhi. Ulwazi ngeendlela zokusebenza zeNethiwekhi (TCP/IP, DNS kunye ne-OSPF ne-BGP). Ulwazi ngolu phando lwe-LAN/WAN Technologies.
xh.duties: Qondisa kwaye ulungelelanise yonke imisebenzi yenethiwekhi kunye neesistim zokunxibelelanisa. Lilindele inkqubo yasebenzayo kunye nokhuseleko lenethiwekhi kusetyenziswa izixhobo ezithe ngqo. Qinisekisa ukudityaniswa okusebenzayo kuzo zonke iindawo zesebe (LAN/WAN/WIFI). Lawula ukulondoloza iinkcukacha, ukubuyiswa kweenkcukacha nayo yonke iindlela zokubuyisa. Gcina amaxwebhu e-ICT. Qinisekisa ukuzilandela emigangathweni yokhuseleko lwe-ITC nepamFnqaku zokukhusela iinkcukacha.

zu.summary: Phatha izinto zokuqondana nabafundi ezihlanganisa ukushicilela ngokuvikelekile, ukusatshalaliswa nokugcina amaphepha emibuzo emahhovisi amaningi we-Limpopo Education district offices.
zu.requirements: Isifundo esinganqamuki esingasemqoka esingowomthamo ongaba nguNQF level 6 njengoba kunconywa ngumphakathi we-South African Qualifications Authority (SAQA). Isifundo noma izifundo ekubuchwepheshe bolwazi nokuxhumana komchazamkhando nezinye izifundo ezihambisanayo kuzoba yinzuzo ekwengezeni. Ubuchwepheshe bengaphansi kweminyaka engu-3 kokusebenza endaweni yokuhlolwa kwabafundi noma enkundleni ehambisanayo. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile ngaphandle kokuba kulabo abaphila nokuphila nokukhubazekile Ulwazi Namakhono: Ulwazi nokuqonda umthamo wokufundisa, amapholisi okuqondana nokuhlolwa kwamandla, ukusetshenziswa kwawo, ukuphathwa kwemfundo, ukubusa nokuzezelwa kwenkonzo, isimo somthetho, imitheshwana, izakhiwo nezinkomba. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu angaphezulu kakhulu kanye namakhono obudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Amakhono okuhlaziya, ukucinga ngokujulile nokuqamba izindlela. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lokusebenza ngakomshini nokuxhumana ngalo (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-MS Outlook).
zu.duties: Nika inkuxa ekushicilelweni okuvikelekile, ekuhlanganiseni, ekusatshalalisweni nokugcinweni kwamaphepha emibuzo, izinto zokuhlola amandla nokulawula izinto zokuhlola. Lawula izinkomba zokuqondana nokuhlolwa kwamandla, izisebenzelo ezongezelelwe kanye nokuzezelwa kwezinkonzo zolawulo lokuhlola. Lawula ukwenziwa kokuqondana nokuhlolwa kwamandla. Nikeza inkuxa ekulawulweni kokulungiselela ukwahlulelwa.

zu.title: Umphathi Ohamba Phambili Wokulondoloza Amarekhodi
zu.summary: Izikhundla zomphathi ohamba phambili wokulondoloza amarekhodi ehofisi enkulu yomnyango we-Limpopo Department of Education nakamahhovisi esifunda, edinga izifundo ze-NQF level 6 kanye nokuhlomula unyaka owodwa kuya kubabili ngokuhlomula ngokulawula amarekhodi.
zu.requirements: Isifundo se-NQF level 6 esamukelekwa yi-SAQA. Isifundo sokulawula / ukuthuthukisa amabalulekile / ukulawula komphakathi / izindaba zokulawulwa komphakathi sizoba yinonuso. Okungenani unyaka 01 - 02 wohlelo lolwazi ngokulawula amarekhodi noma indawo ehlobene nawo. Ilayisense yokushayela esemthethweni ngaphandle kwalabo abakhubazekile. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuxazulula nokuhlaziya izinkinga. Ukulawula uhlelo namaphrojekthi. Ukulawula inguqulo. Ulwazi nokuqonda izakhiwo zomthetho namapholisi ahlobene nawo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha olusebenzayo (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Ikono lokubhalwa kwezibika. Amakhono okuxhumane athuthukile (abhalwe naxhumwe), amakhono athuthukile okuxhumana nomunye umuntu, ukuhlela, nokuqamba amakhono. Amakhono athuthukile okugcina amarekhodi.
zu.duties: Qaphela ukudalwa, ukugcinwa, ukusetshenziswa, ukuskena, ukuzaliswa kabusha nokulahwa kwamarekhodi. Qaphela futhi ulondoloze amafayela abasebenzi. Nikeza futhi ulondoloze izinsiza zokulawula amarekhodi ngaphakathi. Qaphela futhi uphendule abakhulumayo bese ubhalisa iposi/ amafayela ahambiswa ngesandla.

xh.title: ISikhululu Sezicwangciso Eziqulunqwayo

xh.requirements: Isifundo sesinqanaba se-6 seNQF njengoko samkelwe yiSAQA. Isifundo kwiLawulo / Phuhliso lweZabantu / iLawulo loLuntu / iNqubo yoLawulo lukaZwelonke kuya kuba lusixhobo esongezelelweyo. Inani elingaphantsi kweminyaka 01 - 02 yemisebenzi ehambelana nalo kuqondwayo kwimeko yoLawulo lweRekhodi okanye kwinkqubo ebandakanyekayo. Ilayisense yokuqhuba esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabo banokuphila kwezokwaphila. Ulwazi namakhono: Ukuxazulula iingxaki nokuqonda iziphene. Ukulawula iinkqubo namaphulo. Ukulawula iinguqu. Ulwazi nokuqonda iinkqubo zomthetho neemvisiswano ezihambelana nokuqondwayo. Ukubakho ngokusebenzisa iikhompyutha (i-MS Word, i-Excel, i-PowerPoint, ne-Outlook). Ukwazi ukuqulunqa iingxelo. Amakhono amakhulu okunxibelelane (okubhalwayo nokuthethwayo), amakhono amanundu obudlelwane nabantu, ukuqamba iplani, namakhono okuhlela. Amakhono amanundu okugcina iirekhodi.
xh.duties: Qaphela ukudalwa, ukugcinwa, ukusetyenziswa, ukuscanning, ukuzeleda nokulahla iirekhodi. Qaphela ugcindele kwaye ulondoloze iifayile zabantu nikela ngokugcina iinkonzo zangaphakathi zolawulo lweerekhodi. Qaphela kwaye uphendule abaxhasi uze ubhalele i-imeyile/ iifayile ezilethwe ngesandla.

zu.summary: Izikhundla zabantu abasebenzayo wezempilo nenzuzo kuzifundvo ezingayishumi nakubili zemfundo yakwa Limpopo, kufuna iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kumsebenzi wezentengalwazi noma Isengqondeni.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF level 7 kumsebenzi wentengalwazi / Isengqondi njengoba kuthathwa ngumzimba i-SAQA. Iziqu / ikhosi kuma-EAP noma i-HIV kuzoba yinzuzo. Ukhonza ungeminyaka yonke ubuncane 01 - 02 emsebenzini othinta Wezempilo Nenzuzo Yabasebenzi noma enkundleni ezohambisana nalo. Ukwazi kumzimba ongaphansi komkhakha, iSouth African Council for Social Service Profession (SACSSP) noma iHealth Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Ilayiseni yemishini esemthethweni ngaphandle kwabantu abasindala. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-EHW Strategic Framework. Ulwazi nge-National Strategic Plan on HIV, STIs & TB. Amakhono okulawula imithetho. Amakhono okwethula. Okubika, okuhlangabezana. Isikhathi sokugcina imfihlo. Ukwazi uku-sebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint kanye ne-MS Outlook).
zu.duties: Nikeza insizakalo yokuweluleka nge-HIV kanye nokwesekwa ngomunye umuntu. Qalisa imithetho ye-HIV, STIs & TB. Hlola futhi uhlole abantu abangaphakathi nangaphandle. Qalisa imithetho yokuphatha Isengqondi. Nikeza inkxaso yezenhlalo (umuntu oyedwa kanye nqembu) kubasebenzi kanye nemindeni yabo eseduze. Nikeza incazelo ngokuswaya kwengqondo ukuze uxolise futhi uhlele ukuphathwa kobuhlungu noma isimo esibucayi ngemva kokuba kwenzeke iziphothelwe. Hlele futhi wenze izinhlela zokwazisa, izingqungquthela, izenzakalo kanye nemikhankaso yezempilo (ngokuqiniswa, i-HIV/AIDS, isimo sengqondo njll) ukufundisa abasebenzi. Khuthaza izempilo zemizimba kanye namaphrojekthi ezemidlalo futhi akhuthaze ukudla okuhle. Hlela imibiko yenyanga zonke, yenyanga kanye neminyaka yonke yesifunda.

xh.summary: Izithuba zoMsebenzi weMpilo noNtlezwano kwindawo ezintandathu zemfundo i-Limpopo education districts, zifuna ifundo ye-NQF level 7 kuSocial Work okanye i-Psychology.
xh.requirements: Ifundo ye-NQF level 7 kuSocial Work / Psychology njengokukwolulwa yi-SAQA. Ifundo / Isifundo kwi-EAP okanye i-HIV kuya kuba yoncedo. Ukuba namava afanelekileyo amabini afunekayo aka-01 - 02 emisebenzi ephilileyo kwi-Employee Health and Wellness okanye kwindawo ethunditheleyo. Ukubhaliswa kwethiliyam, i-South African Council for Social Service Profession (SACSSP) okanye i-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA). Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubekileyo. Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi nge-EHW Strategic Framework. Ulwazi nge-National Strategic Plan on HIV, STIs & TB. Amakhono oLawulo lweProjekthi. Amakhono okubonisa. Iingxelo, intetho. Ukuphila emthethweni wokugcina iyimfihlo. Ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint ne-MS Outlook).
xh.duties: Kwazisa iindlela zengqondo ngenkxaso yabalingani. Ukuphumeza iinkqubo ze-HIV, STIs & TB. Ukuphonononga & ukuhlola abajolise ngaphakathi nangaphandle. Ukuphumeza iinkqubo zoLawulo loNtlezwano. Ukunika inkxazo yengqondo (komntu ngamnye & ngenqanaba leqela) kwabasebenzi & abomalungelo abo abasondeleneyo. Ukuyala iingxwabo zoyiva ngengqondo kwaye ulungelelanise ulawulo lwexhoba okwingxaki emva kweziganeko ezingalindelekanga. Ukulungelelanisa nokukhokeza iindlela zokwazisa, iindaba zemisebenzi, iiganeko nemikhankaso yempilo (ngengcinezelo, i-HIV/AIDS, impilo yengqondo, njl) ukufundisa abasebenzi. Ukukhuthaza impilo yomzimba & iinkqubo zemidlalo kwaye uxhasa ukutya okulungileyo. Ukuqulunqa iingxelo zenyanga, zesikomba & zorhoqo ezingangingeki kwii-district.

af.title: Staatrekenmeester: ECD-uitgawebestuur
af.summary: Staatrekenmeester benodig in Limpopo om ECD-uitgawes te bestuur, finansiële transaksies te verwerk en begrotingsnakoming binne die Department of Education te monitor.
af.requirements: NQF Level 6-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Kwalifikasie in Finansies/Rekenkunde sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Minimum van 01 - 02 jaar se tersaaklike ervaring in Vroeë Kinderontwikkeling of verwante veld. Geldige bestuurderslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede lisensie Kennis en vaardighede: Deeglike kennis van die Public Finance Management Act en Treasury Regulations. Vermoë om finansiële beleide en voorskrifte te verstaan, te interpreteer en korrek toe te pas. Begrip van die finansiële en rekenkundige prosesse. Goed ontwikkelde redenerings-, wiskundige, analitiese, innoverende denk- en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Vermoë om doeltreffend verslae op te stel en voor te lê. Goed ontwikkelde mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede met goeie interpersoonlike verhoudings. Vermoë om doeltreffend met kliënte te kommunikeer en saam te werk. Spanspeler, ontvanklik vir voorstelle en ingestel op zero defect. Positief, lojaal, kreatief en betroubaar. Funksionele rekenaarvaardigheid (Microsoft Word, Excel en PowerPoint).
af.duties: Verwerk finansiële transaksies in ooreenstemming met toepaslike ECD-wetgewing en -beleide. Verseker behoorlike toekenning en registrasie van uitgawes en inkomste. Monitor finansiële aktiwiteite om te verseker dat daar aan goedgekeurde begrotings voldoen word. Bied hulp met die voorbereiding van jaarlikse en mediumtermynbegrotings. Monitor uitgawes teen begrotingstoekennings. Analiseer afwykings en doen aanbevelings aan bestuur. Uitgawebestuur: Begrotingsverslagdoening, uitgaweproeksies en verslae. Verifieer en verwerk betalings aan ECD-sentrums. Verseker dat uitgawes gemagtig en deur tersaaklike dokumentasie gestaaf word. Monitor verbintenisse en voorkom ongemagtigde, onreëlmatige, vrugtelose en vermorsende uitgawes. Berei maandelikse, kwartaallikse en jaarlikse finansiële verslae voor. Stel bestuursverslae op vir besluitnemingsdoeleindes. Bied hulp met die voorbereiding van Jaarlikse Finansiële State (AFS). Verskaf finansiële inligting wat deur ouditeure vereis word. Herstemming van betalings wat aan ECD-sentrums gedoen is. Verseker dat betalings aan alle gefinansierde ECD-sentrums betyds gedoen word. Hanteer alle navrae van verskaffers onverwyld en stel 'n onverwyldde antwoord op tot alle ouditnavrae rakende skuld wat betaalbaar is. Rapporteer en regstel enige afwyking wat gevind word i.v.m. kontrak/instruksie en delegasies voor goedkeuring van betalings. Volg alle betalingsdokumente wat laat vir betalings ontvang is, na en verseker dat toepaslike voorkomende maatreëls ten opsigte daarvan geneem word. Voorbereiding van joernale en herstemming van alle ECD-sentrums wat kwartaalliks betaal is. Kennis ten opsigte van buitelandse betalings. Rapporteer alle finansiële wangedrag soos deur die voorskrifte vereis. Hou die tersaaklike statistieke vir bestuursdoeleindes. Verseker die veilige bewaring van alle transaksie-ondersteunende dokumentasie, lêers en data vir ouditdoeleindes in ooreenstemming met voorskrifte. sentrums. Konsolideer weeklikse, maandelikse en kwartaallikse verslae. Woon Nasionale, Provinciale en Distriksvergaderings by.

zu.title: Umuntu obhala izimali kahulumeni: ECD Expenditure Management
zu.summary: Kudingwa umhola ongumuntu oqashwe ngokwesikhundla sokubhala izimali ze-ECD, ukubhala izimali ezihamba, futhi abhale izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ukuthi zihambisana nebhajethi kule Minyango ye-Education.
zu.requirements: Isiqu esingabalwa njengesesikhundla se-NQF Level 6 njengoba kuhlonishwa yi-SAQA. Isiqu esimhlabeni wezezimali noma ekuqashweni kuzoba yinzuzo ekwenzeni le ndima. Kudingeka okungenani u-01 kuya ku-02 unyaka ulwazi ekuphathweni kolimi lwezezimali. Ilayisense yokushayela ethengiwe. Ulwazi nokuthunjana: Ulwazi oluhle ngomthetho we-Public Finance Management Act kanye ne-Treasury Regulations. Ukuzwela, ukuhumusha futhi usebenzise ngendlela efanele imithetho nendlela yokusebenza yezimali. Ukuqonda izinhlaka zezezimali kanye nezimali. Ikhono elithuthukiswe lokucabanga, lezibalo, lokucutshungula, ukucabanga ngokubamba iqhaza nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokubhala futhi kwethule imibiko ngendlela efanele. Ukuxhumana ngomlomo kubhalwe ngokuhle futhi kuhloniphe abanye. Ikhono lokusebenzisana nabantu abangamakhasimende. Ukusebenza njengomuntu oqotho, othanda ukubekezela, ongathathi hlangothi, ohlonipha abanye. Ukusebenzela ukuba into engenaphutha nokuhlonishwa. Ukuthanda abantu, ukuba nomoya wokubaqondisa nokuxhumanisa nabo.
zu.duties: Bheka izinhlelo zezezimali ngokuvumelana nemithetho kanye namapholisi efanele e-ECD. Qinisekisa ukwabiwa okufanele kanye nokubhalwa kokukhitra kanye nenzuzo. Landa izinkalo zezezimali ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana namabhajethi avunyiwe. Siza ekulungiseleleni amabhajethi abambe ngaso sonke isikhathi naphakathi kwesikhathi. Landa ukukhitha uma kunikezwe ngokwamabhajethi abekelwe umbhalo. Hlaziya okuhlukile futhi unikeze izeluleko eziphethi. Ukuphathwa kokukhitha: Umbiko webhajethi, ukubuka kokuthi kukhithwa njani, kanye nemibiko. Qinisekisa futhi ubhale izinkokhelo ezibekelwe izikhungo ze-ECD. Qinisekisa ukuba izinkokhelo zivunyiwe futhi zisekelwe ngemibhalo edingekayo. Lada izethembiso futhi uvimbelize ukukhitha okungalunyawo, okungalungile, okungalusemkhayweni nangokuzitshalaza. Bhalile imibiko yezezimali yamanyanga, izinguqulo, kanye namabhajethi abambe ngaso sonke isikhathi. Yenza imibiko ekwenza abaphathi bathath'isinqumo. Siza kwakha imibiko yezimali yamakhulu eminyaka (AFS). Nikeza abahloli ngolwazi oludingekayo mayelana nezimali. Hlanganisa izinkokhelo ezenziwe abantu bakhokhela izikhungo ze-ECD. Qinisekisa ukuba zonke izikhungo e-ECD ezinikwa imali zikhokhelwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Sithatha yonke imibuzo evela kubanikezeli ngokushesha futhi uhlanganise impendulo ngokushesha kuyo yonke imibuzo yezibalo ehlobene nabakhokhelwa. Bika futhi ulungise noma yikuphi ukwehluka okutholakale mayelana nezinkontileka/umyalo kanye namagunya ngaphambi kokuvuma izinkokhelo. Phonsa imibuzo yonke imibhalo ngezinkokhelo etholakale iseduze futhi uqinisekise ukuthi kuthathwa isinyathelo esifanele ngokuvimbela. Lungiselela amajornali futhi uhlanganise zonke izikhungo ze-ECD ezikhokhelwa njalo ngenkathi yamakhulu amathathu. Ulwazi mayelana nezinkokhelo zamanye amazwe. Buka konke ukungalunga kwezezimali njengoba kudingwa yizimiso. Gcina izibalo ezidingekayo ngenhloso yokuphathwa. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwemibhalo yonke yokusekela izimali, amafayela, kanye nesidingo sokuba abahole bathole ulwazi ngezinkontileka nemiyalo ngaphambi kwesimemezelo sezinkokhelo. Ukuhlanganisa imibiko yamasonto, abambe ngaso sonke isikhathi, namakhaveyithi. Hlanzwa onke amaphesheya, iphafundetha nezinkunzi zemibuzo efanele mayelana nezinkokhelo kubantu be-ECD. Zibandakanya emihlanganweni yezwe, iphrovhinsi, kanye newesifunda.

xh.title: IsiGqeba sezimali sikaRhulumente: Ulawulo Lwetyxazo le-ECD
xh.summary: Kufuneka isiGqeba sezimali sikaRhulumente kwi-Limpopo ukulawula ityxazo le-ECD, ukucubungula iintengiselwano ezimalini, nokuqaphela ukuthobela kwebhajeti ngaphakathi kwiSebe leMfundo.
xh.requirements: Isifundo se-NQF Level 6 esivunywe yi-SAQA. Isifundo kwezeMali/okuBala iimali kuya kuba yindlela engeyona nto. Ubuncinane beminyaka engama-01 - 02 yamava ahambelana nokuPhuhlisa abaNtwana basemsebenzini wokuqala okanye indawo ehlobene nayo. Ilayisenisi yokuQhuba esebenzayo (ngaphandle kwabantu abakhubazekileyo). Ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi olululo ngoMthetho woLawulo lweMali kaRhulumente nemiQathango yeTreasury. Ulawulo lokuziphendulela, ukuqonda, ukuhicigca nokusebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo iinkqubo nemigaqo yezimali. Ukuqonda iinkqubo zezimali nokuBala iimali. Ikhono lokucinga ngokubanzi, lezibalo, lokuhlalutywa, lokucinga iindlela ezitsha nokusombulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokubhala nokubonisa iingxelo ngokusebenza. Amakhono amabalulekileyo okuthetha nokubhala anobudlelwane obuhle nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokusebenzisana nabathengi. Umdlali weliqembu, ovulekile kwiingcebiso kwaye ugqamisa ukungenabo iimposiso. Onothando, onokuzimisela, onamava amaninzi wokucinga iindlela ezitsha othembekileyo. Ulwazi olusebenzayo lwekhompyutha (iMicrosoft Word, iExcel nePowerPoint).
xh.duties: Cubungula iintengiselwano ezimali ngokwemigaqo nemiqathango ye-ECD. Qinisekisa ukwaba okuchanekileyo nokubhala ityxazo nenyiso. Qaphela imisebenzi yezimali ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela kwiibhajeti ezivunyiweyo. Nceda kolungiselelwa kweebhajeti zonyaka nakuleyo mva kumacala amafutshane. Qaphela ityxazo ngokwemigabelo yebhajeti. Hlalutya iinguqu ezahlukeneyo unike iingcebiso kulawulo. Ulawulo lwetyxazo: Iingxelo zebhajeti, iingcamango zetyxazo nokuvela iingxelo. Qinisekisa kwaye ucubungule imali ezahlawulwa kwiiziko ze-ECD. Qinisekisa ukuba ityxazo ivunyiwe kwaye ixhaswe ngamaxwebhu ahambelanayo. Qaphela izithembiso kwaye uthintele ityxazo engavunyiweyo, engaqhelekanga, engenamva nento ebalulekileyo. Lungiselela iingxelo zezimali nyanga zonke, kwikota nakuyonyaka. Hlanganisa iingxelo zolawulo ngenjongo yokwenza iigqibo. Nceda kolungiselelwa kweNgxelo yemali yonyaka (i-AFS). Yimali efuna ulwazi kubagxeki abahlalutyiyo. Ukuhambelanisa imali ehlawulwe kwiiziko ze-ECD. Qinisekisa ukuba imali ihlawulwa kuwo onke amaziko arixhasiweyo a-ECD ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Phatha ngokukhawuleza yonke imibuzo evela kubahanjisi bempahla kwaye uphendule ngokukhawuleza yonke imibuzo yokuhlalutya ehambelana namafa ahlawulwayo. Iingxelo nokulungisa nayiphi na indlela ephosakeleyo malunga nekontraka/imiyalelo noku nikela ngamandla phambi kokuvunywa kwezimahlawulelo. Landela yonke imixwebhu yemahlawulelo efilwe ilate ngenjongo yokuhlawula ukuze uqinisekise ukuba kuthathwa isigqibo esifanelekileyo sokuqhuba ngaphambili. Ulungiselelo lweejrnali nokuhambelanisa yonke imali ehlawulwe kumaziko a-ECD kwikota. Ulwazi ngemahlawulelo yamanye amazwe. Iingxelo ngalo naliphi na igwenxa lecala lezimali njengoko kufuneka ngemigaqo. Ukugcina izibalo ezahambelanayo ngenjongo yolawulo. Qinisekisa ukugcina ngokukhuselekileyo konke uxwebhu oluxhasa iintengiselwano, iifayile nedatha ngenjongo yokugxola ngokwemigaqo. amaziko. Hlanganisa iingxelo ngeveki, nyanga nakuqo. Thatha iindibano zeSizwe, eSiphondo nasekuWombeni.

af.title: Data-administrasie: Ondersteuningsbeampte
af.summary: Verskaf IT- en dataondersteuning aan distrikbeamptes in die Vhembe East-distrik en help met datakaptuur, probleemoplossing en stelseltransaksies.
af.requirements: NQF Vlak 6-kwalifikasie soos deur SAQA erken. 'n Kwalifikasie in Inligtingstegnologie sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Minimum van 01 - 02 jaar se relevante ervaring in IT of verwante veld. Geldige bestuurderslisensie (met uitsondering van persone met gestremdhede se lisensie). Kennis en vaardighede: Sterk funksionele rekenaarvaardigheid (MS Office, aanlynstelsels, Excel, data-inskrywing/platforms). Praktiese ervaring in die gebruik van inligtingstelsels of databasisse. intermediêre data-analise en verslagdoeningsvaardighede. Opleidingsfasilitering en gebruikerondersteuningsvaardighede. Dokumentbestuur en -verifikasie. Goed ontwikkelde redenering, innoverende denke en probleemoplossingsvermoë. Vermoë om verslae doeltreffend op te stel en voor te lê. Sterk rekenaar- en digitale geletterdheidsvaardighede, met die vermoë om met selfvertroue veelvuldige stelsels en toepassings te gebruik. Data-analise en verslagdoeningsvaardighede op 'n intermediêre vlak, insluitend die identifisering van tendense, gapings en teenstrydighede. Opleidingsfasilitering en gebruikerondersteuningsvaardighede, insluitend die vermoë om tegniese konsepte op 'n duidelike en praktiese wyse te verduidelik. Probleemoplossing en analitiese denkvaardighede, met die vermoë om praktiese oplossings vir operasionele en stelselverwante uitdagings te ontwikkel. Doeltreffende mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede wat geskik is vir betrokkenheid by distrikbeamptes en ECD-diensverskaffers.
af.duties: Verskaf eerstelynse ondersteuning aan distrikbeamptes en ECD-sentrums rakende die gebruik van cares, datakaptuur en probleemoplossing. Verskaf tegniese ondersteuning aan gebruikers met dataversameling, dokumentoplaai, inskrywingsopdaterings en stelseltransaksies. Eskaleer onopgeloste tegniese probleme na provinsiale of nasionale ondersteuningsstrukture waar nodig. Ondersteun deurlopende verbetering van opleidingsbenaderings gebaseer op gebruikersterugvoer en behoeftes van distrikgebruikers. Bevorder 'n kultuur van datagebruik, leer en aanspreeklikheid binne distrik-ECD-strukture. Verskaf ondersteuning vir databestuur en -onderhoud aan distrikgebruikers. Bestuur die Provinsiale ECD-databasis vir toegang tot en befondsde ECD-sentrums. Verantwoordelik vir die skoonmaak van geregistreerde ECD-kinders. Middele van verifikasie. Ervaring in die ondersteuning van stelselrollouts, opleiding of gebruikerondersteuning (by voorkeur in onderwys of ECD). Agetoonde rekenaarvaardigheid en selfvertroue om met digitale stelsels te werk. Bereidwilligheid om binne die distrik te reis en direk met gebruikers op perseel te werk.

zu.summary: Nika abasebenzisi besifunda ukusekelwa kwe-IT ngedatha Vhembe East District, usize ekungeniseni idatha, ekuxazululeni izinkinga nasekuqhubeni imisebenzi yamasistimu.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-NQF Level 6 njengoba ziyajatshulwa yi-SAQA. Iziqu ezimalunga ne-Information Technology zizoba yinzuzo ekwedlulele. Isipiliwoni esingaphansi kweminyaka engu-01 - 02 esibalulekile kwi-IT noma olimini oluhlobene nalo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo (ngaphandle kwelayisensi yabantu abakhubazekile. Ulwazi nezikhokelo: Amakhono amakhulu okusebenza ngomshini wamakhompyutha (MS Office, amasistimu ku-inthanethi, Excel, ukungenisa idatha/amasayithi). Isipiliwono esibonakalayo ekusebenziseni amasistimu wolwazi noma amadathabhesi. Amakhono aphakathi nendlela yokuhlaziya idatha nokubika. Amakhono okuhola eqeqeshweni nokusekelwa abasebenzisi. Ukuphathwa kanye nokuqinisekiswa kwamadokhumenti. Ikhono elikhuleke kahle lokubuka izinto ngokomqondo, ucabango olusha kanye nethalenta lokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono lokuhlela futhi kwethule amabhiko ngendlela esebenzayo. Amakhono amakhulu ekhompyutha nangobuchwepheshe be-digital, elikhono lokusebenzisa amasistimu namahlelohlelo amaningi ngekhonhco. Amakhono aphakathi nendlela yokuhlaziya idatha nokubika, okuhlanganisa ukubona izinto eziphahlelayo, izikhala, nokungahambelani. Amakhono okuhola eqeqeshweni nokusekelwa abasebenzisi, okuhlanganisa ikhono lokuchaza izinjongo zobuchwepheshe ngendleya ecacile nebonakalayo. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokucabanga ngokuhlaziya, elikhono lokuthuthukisa izixazululo eziyisibonelo ezinkingeni ezingokuphathwa kwemisebenzi namasistimu. Amakhono asebenzayo okukhuluma futhi kubhale afanele ukuxhumana nabasebenzisi besifunda nabahlinzeki besevisi be-ECD.
zu.duties: Nika abasebenzi besifunda namakhemikhali e-ECD ukusekelwa okokuqala mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwamacares, ukungenisa idatha, nokuxazulula izinkinga. Nika abasebenzisi ukusekelwa ngobuchwepheshe ekuthathweni kwedatha, ukulayisha amadokhumenti, ukubuyekeza ukubhaliswa, nasemisebenzini yamasistimu. Phakamisa izinkinga zobuchwepheshe ezingaxazululeki ezakhiweni zokusekelwa ezifundeni noma ezweni lapho kudingeka khona. Sekela ukuthuthukiswa okuqhubekayo kwezindlela zokuqeqesha okusekelwe empendulweni yabasebenzisi nasezidingweni zabasebenzisi besifunda. Khuthaza isiko lokusetshenziswa kwedatha, ukufunda, nokubhekele emakhiweni we-ECD wesifunda. Nikezela ngokusekelwa ekuphathweni nakulondolozweni kwedatha kubasebenzisi besifunda. Phatha idathabhesi ye-Provincial ECD ngenhloso yokufinyelela nakuma-ECD Centre atholwa imali. Iphathwe ukucisha idatha yabantwana ababhalisiwe. Izindlela zokuqinisekisa. Isipiliwoni ekusekeleni ukusetshenziswa kwamasistimu, ekokuqeqesheni, noma ekusekelweni kwabasebenzisi (ikakhulukazi emfundweni noma kwi-ECD). Ubuchwepheshe obubonakalayo bokusebenza ngamakhompyutha nenkoliso yokusebenza namasistimu e-digital. Ukuzimisela ukuhamba ngaphakathi kwesifunda futhi usebenze ngqo nabasebenzisi endaweni.

xh.title: Ulawulo Lweenkcukacha: Ofisi Yonkxaso
xh.summary: Nika abasebenzi basebe kwindawo yaseVhembe East District inkxaso ye-IT ngeenkcukacha, ibe ndixhasa ekungeniseni iinkcukacha, ekusombululeni iingxaki nakwiintshuxo zesixhobo.
xh.requirements: Ifanele ibe nogunyaziso lweNqanaba le-6 le-NQF njengokuqwalaselwa yi-SAQA. Ugunyaziso kwInkqubo yeTeknoloji yolwazi luya kuba ngowongezelelo. Ubuncinane bamava afanelekileyo eminye eyi-01 - 02 kwinkqubo ye-IT okanye kwendawo edibana nayo. Ilayisense yokushayela eseleyo (ngaphandle kwelayisense yabantu abakhubazekileyo Ulwazi nakhono: Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha ngokusebenzayo (i-MS Office, iinkqubo ezikwi-intanethi, i-Excel, ukungenisa iinkcukacha/iindawo zokuzenza). Amava okusebenzisa iinkqabo zolwazi okanye iindawo zokugcina iinkcukacha. Amakhono aphakathi kokuhlola nokuvelisa iingxelo ngeenkcukacha. Amakhono okuguqula ulwazi nokuba ngumxhasi wabasebenzisi. Ulawulo kwaye uqiniseke amaxwebhu. Ikhono eliphuhlileyo lokucinga ngokuzingca, ukucinga ngendlela entsha nokusombulula iingxaki. Ikhono lokuyila iingxelo ngokusebenzayo nokuzibonisa. Amakhono amakhulu ekhompyutheni nangokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezikwiliza elikhawulezayo, elinokuthembeka lokusebenzisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo nezicelo. Amakhono okuhlola iinkcukacha nokubika kwinqanaba eliphakathi, kuquka ukuqaphela iintshukumo, iingozi, nokungahambelani. Amakhono okuguqula ulwazi nokuxhasa abasebenzisi, kuquka ikhono lokucacisa izinto zobuchwephesha ngendlela ecacileyo nesebenzayo. Amakhono okusombulula iingxaki nokucinga ngokuhlalutya, elinokuthi laphuhlise izisombululo ezisebenzayo kwiingxaki ezidibana nosebenzo n nakuzo iinkqabo. Amakhono asebenzayo ethetha nokuvelisa iingxelo aqwalaselwe ukusebenzisana abasebenzi basebe kwindawo kwaye nabahanisiwe benkonzo ye-ECD.
xh.duties: Nika abasebenzi basebe kwindawo yaseVhembe East District nasezikhungweni ze-ECD inkxaso yokuqala ngomsebenzi wokusebenzisa i-cases, ukungenisa iinkcukacha, nangokusombulula iingxaki. Nikezela ngenkxaso yobuchwepheshe kubasebenzisi ekuthathweni kweenkcukacha, ukulayisha amaxwebhu, ukuhlaziya ukubhaliswa, nakwiintshuxo zesixhobo. Ndulula iingxaki zobuchwepheshe ezingasombululekiyo kwizakhiwo zenkxaso ezikwisiganga okanye kwelizwe xa kufuneka. Xhasa ukuphuculwa ngokuqhubekayo kweendlela zokuzigqisa ngokusekwe kumbono wabasebenzisi nakwiimfuno zabasebenzisi basebe. Khuthaza isiko lokusebenzisa iinkcukacha, ukufunda, nokwenzela inxaxheba kwiintlangano ze-ECD ezisebenza kummandla. Nikezela ngenkxaso yolawulo nokuqokelela iinkcukacha kubasebenzisi basebe Lawula idathabhesi yeProvincial ECD yokufikelela nakumaziko e-ECD axhaswa ngeemali Uxanduva lokucoca iinkcukacha zabantwana ababhalisiweyo kwi-ECD Iindlela zokuqinisekisa Amava okuxhasa ukusetshenziswa kwezixhobo, ukuzigqisa, okanye inkxaso yabasebenzisi (ngakumbi kwimfundo okanye kwi-ECD). Ukubonakalisa ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nentembelo yokusebenza neesixhobo ezikwiliza elikhawulezayo. Ukulunga ukuhamba ngaphakathi kwesithili nokusebenza ngokuqondile nabasebenzisi kwindawo abakuyo.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundiges word gesoek vir verskeie spesiale skole oor Limpopo om gesondheidsassesserings te verskaf, medikasie toe te dien en leerders met chroniese siektes en spesiale behoeftes te ondersteun.
af.requirements: An NQF vlak 6 of 7 kwalifikasie in Verpleegkunde soos erken deur SAQA. Geldige en aktiewe registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Sertifikasie van registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Relevante verpleegkundige ondervinding. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie met uitsondering van persone met 'n gestremdheid. Bevoegdhede, Kennis en Vaardighede: Kennis van skoolgesondheidsdienste. Kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Rekordhouding en verslagskryf. Vermoë om met leerders met gestremdhede te werk.
af.duties: Verskaf funksionele en generiese verpleegbevoegdhede. Verskaf gesondheidsassessering vir leerders met spesiale behoeftes. Dien medikasie toe. Ondersteun en monitor leerders met chroniese siektes. Verskaf preventiewe sorg en bevorder goeie higiënepraktyke. Voer gereelde siftings uit om gesondheidsprobleme in die vroeë stadiums te ontdek. Netwerk en raak betrokke by belanghebbendes in die gemeenskap. Dateer leerderrekords op. Skryf verwysings na ander gesondheidspraktisyns en gemeenskapsgesondheidsentra vir ingryping. Remediering en opvolg. Neem aktief deel aan die multidissiplinêre ondersteuningsstrukture soos om 'n lid van die Skoolgebaseerde Ondersteuningspan (SBST) te wees. Bevorder gesondheids- en welstandsprogramme.

zu.title: UProfessional Nurse
zu.summary: Abanursi abingcwengi bafunwa izikole eziningi ezingqayizivele eLimpopo ukuba benze izivivinyo zezempilo, banikele namakhemikhali, futhi baseke abafundi abanobuhlungu bezingxenye zomzimba kanye nezifundo ezibalulekile ezithinteka kakhulu ngobumpumputhe nobukhulu bezinkinga ezibangelwa yizifo ezihlala isikhathi eside.
zu.requirements: Ithuba le-NQF level 6 noma 7 ekuNursing njengoba kuqashwe yi-SAQA. Ubulungu obusebenzayo obuvunyiwe eSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoba uProfessional Nurse. Isitifiketi sobhalo njengoProfessional Nurse. Okuhlangenwe nakho okuhambisana nokusebenza ekuNursing. Ifayili lesiqu yokushayela ngaphandle kwalabo abaphila nobuyisiwe. Amakhono, ulwazi namakhono: Ulwazi ngemisebenzi yezempilo yesikole. Amakhono okuxhumana nabantu. Ukugcina amarekhodi nokubhala imibiko. Ikono lokusebenza nabafundi abayisimo esingqayizivele.
zu.duties: Hlola izidingo zezempilo zezifundo eziyingqayizivele. Nikela namakhemikhali ezokwelapha. Sekela futhi ulalele abafundi abanezifo ezingaphelelwa lusiku. Nikela nokunakekelwa okuvikela futhi ukhuthaze izindlela ezinhle zokuhlanzeka. Yenza ukuhlola njalo ukuze kutholwe izinkinga zezempilo ekuqaleni. Xhumana nobandakanyeke nabanikeli besevisi emphakathini. Buyekeza amarekhodi abafundi. Bhala izincomo kabanikeli bezempilo abanye nasemikhakheni yezempilo yomphakathi yokuungcuphe. Ukulungiswa nokulandela. Yiba nomthelela obalulekile ohlelweni lwabanikeli besevisi bakwamanye amakhono njengoba ube lilungu leqembu lokusekela esikoleni (SBST). Khuthaza izinhlelo zezempilo nephiliso.

xh.title: Ugulagula oLungileyo
xh.summary: Kufunwa abagulagula abalungileyo ukuba basebenze kwizikolo ezininzi ezikhethekileyo kwiLimpopo ukwenza iintlolo-ngqondo eziphathelele impilo, ukunikela iyeza lenyongo, kunye nokuxhasa abafundi abagulayo ngesifo esingapheliyo kunye nabo namadinga akhethekileyo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga seNQF level 6 okanye 7 kwakhathalelo lwesigulagula njengokuqatshwa yiSAQA. Ubulungiso obusebenzayo kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengesiGulagula esilungileyo. Isatifikethi sobulungiso njengesiGulagula esilungileyo. Imfundo efanelekileyo kwikhathalelo lwesigulagula. Ilayisensi yomqhubi egunyazisiweyo ngaphandle kwabantu abaphila nokuwomzimba. Iikhompetensi, ulwazi nekhono: Ulwazi ngeenkonzo zeempilo ezikwisikolo. Ikhono lokunxibelelana nabantu nokuziphatha kahle. Ukuhloba iirekhodi kunye nokubala iingxelo. Ikhono lokusebenza nabafundi abalingiswa ngokungalunga kwemizimba yabo.
xh.duties: Nika iikhompetensi ezikumgangatho wemisebenzi yokhathalelo lwabantu abagulayo. Yenza iintlolo-ngqondo ezibhekise kubafundi abo namadinga akhethekileyo.nika iyeza lenyongo. nkxasela uphendle abafundi abagulayo ngesifo esingapheliyo. Yenze ukhathalelo oluthintela isifo ukhuthaze iziqhelo ezilungeleleneyo zengcamango Yenza iindwendwe ezizebhokhwe rhoqo ukutya iingxaki ezibangelwa yimpilo ekuqaleni. Zonxibelelwano nabantu abafuna intlalo oluhambelanayo. Nika isaziso ngeenkcukacha zabafundi. Bhala iindlela ezikuyo kubaguli babo kunye neziko lokhathalelo olusemzini ukunikela uncedo lolungiselelo. oluqwalaselwa lulandelelwa. Thatha inxaxheba eziqoqo zemisebenzi eluhambelaneyo njengomntu ohleli kwiqela elinceda esikolweni (SBST). Khuthaze iinkqubo ezibhekise kwe mpilo namagunya alungileyo.

jobs.summary: Drive learners to and from special schools in Polokwane, requiring a Grade 12 certificate and a valid Code 10 driver's licence with PDP.
jobs.requirements: Grade 12 Valid Code 10 driver’s licence with PDP. 3 years’ bus driving experience will be an added advantage. Driver’s competency test will be conducted before appointment.
jobs.duties: Responsible to transport learners in Special Schools to and from school by following designated routes and schedule. Follow traffic laws. Capable of communicating with learners, parents and school staff. Assist learners in safe loading and off - loading learners. Inform school’s personnel and parents of incidents to maintain proper procedures. Performs pre - and post - trip inspection. Supervise learners during transit for the purpose of maintaining safety and following Departmental policies. Conduct safety and operational inspection of assigned vehicle daily. Reports needed mechanical repairs when necessary Performs periodical safety drills as required by law, completing necessary reports upon request. Delivery and collections: Collect and deliver documents, correspondence, mail, packages, and other items from places such as the post office, other departments, and external stakeholders. Purchase and loading: buying and loading equipment, groceries for the institution. Health support: Taking learners to clinic and hospitals. Route Planning: Plan and follow the most efficient routes using maps or GPS to ensure timely delivery and avoid traffic delays. Vehicle Maintenance: Perform pre-trip and post-trip inspections, ensure the vehicle is fuelled, clean, and well- maintained, and report any issues or arrange for necessary repairs. Record Keeping: Complete and maintain all required records and logbooks regarding trips, mileage, fuel consumption, and goods handled. General Support: Assist with general office or clerical work, such as filing, photocopying, running errands, and loading and unloading items. Customer Service: Interact with clients and customers in a professional and courteous manner, potentially collecting payments or obtaining signatures for deliveries.

af.title: Bestuurder/boodskapper
af.summary: Vervoer leerders na en vanaf spesiale skole in Polokwane; benodig 'n Graad 12-sertifikaat en 'n geldige Code 10 bestuurderslisensie met PDP.
af.requirements: Graad 12 Geldige Code 10 bestuurderslisensie met PDP. 3 jaar se busbestuurservaring sal 'n voordeel wees. 'n Bestuursbevoegdheidstoets sal voor aanstelling gedoen word.
af.duties: Verantwoordelik om leerders in Spesiale Skole na en vanaf skool te vervoer deur aangewysde roetes en skedule te volg. Volg verkeerswette. In staat om met leerders, ouers en skoolpersoneel te kommunikeer. Help leerders met veilige laai en aflaai van leerders. Stel skoolpersoneel en ouers in kennis van voorvalle om behoorlike prosedures te handhaaf. Voer voor- en na-rit inspeksie uit. Hou toesig oor leerders tydens vervoer met die doel om veiligheid te handhaaf en Departementele beleid te volg. Voer daagliks veiligheids- en operasionele inspeksie van die toegewysde voertuig uit. Rapporteer nodige meganiese herstelwerk wanneer nodig Voer periodieke veiligheids-oefeninge uit soos deur die wet vereis, en voltooi nodige verslae op versoek. Aflewerings en versendings: Versamel en lewer dokumente, korrespondensie, pos, pakkies en ander items vanaf plekke soos die poskantoor, ander departemente, en eksterne belanghebbendes. Aankoop en laai: koop en laai toerusting, kruideniersware vir die instelling. Gesondheidsondersteuning: Neem leerders na kliniek en hospitale. Roetebeplanning: Beplan en volg die doeltreffendste roetes met behulp van kaarte of GPS om tydige aflewerings te verseker en verkeersvertragings te vermy. Voertuigonderhoud: Voer voor-rit en na-rit inspeksies uit, verseker dat die voertuig vol brandstof, skoon en goed onderhou is, en rapporteer enige probleme of reël nodige herstelwerk. Rekordhouding: Voltooi en hou alle vereiste rekords en logboeke by ten opsigte van ritte, kilometerstand, brandstofverbruik, en goedere hanteer. Algemene ondersteuning: Help met algemene kantoor- of klerkwerk, soos liasering, fotokopiëring, boodskappe doen, en laai en aflaai van items. Kliëntediens: Tree in 'n professionele en hoflike wyse met kliënte en klante in werking, moontlik betalings invorder of handtekeninge vir aflewerings verkry.

zu.title: Umdidiyeli / Umthunywa
zu.summary: Ushayele abafundi baye eziZikoleni EziKhethekile ePolokwane kubuye abuyisele, kudinga isitifiketi se-Grade 12 kanye nelaysense yomshayeli ye-Code 10 esemthethweni nePDP.
zu.requirements: Ithuluzi lesikhombi se-Grade 12 Amalayisense we-Code 10 okuyisikhathi esivela eqinisweni we-PDP. Okuhlangenwe nakho konke iminyaka emi-3 kokushayela ibhasi kuyobe kungezonya ezibalulekile. Ukuhlolwa kokukhombisa ukuthi umshayeli usebenzise kahle noma cha kuyobe kwenziwa ngaphambi kokumiswayo.
zu.duties: Ubhekele ukuthutha abafundi eziZikoleni EziKhethekile ezikolweni nasekubuyeleni ekhaya ngokulandela imigqa yendlela esikhethiwe neshejuli. Landela umthetho wezokuthutha. Akwake ayekwazi ukuxhumana nabafundi, abazali nakubasebenzi besikole. Siza abafundi ekulayishweni okuphephile nasekulayishweni kwabo phansi. Yazisa basebenzi besikole nabazali ngemikhawulo ukuze kugcinwe izindlela ezifanele. Yenza ukuhlola ngaphambi kokuhamba nangemva kokuhamba. Qaphasisa abafundi ngesikhathi behamba ngenjongo yokugcina ukuphepha nokulandela izinqubomgomo ze-Department. Yenza ukuhlola kokuphepha nokusebenza kwesimoto ekiwe yonke imihla. Bika ukulungiswa kwemishini okudingeka lapho kunesidingo. Yenza vivinyo lokuphepha njalo njalo njengoba kudingwa umthetho, upheda imibiko edingekayo lapho kucelwa. Ukuletha nokuthola: Thola futhi ulethe amadokhumenti, imibhalo yokuqondana, imeyili, amaphakheji, namanye izinto ezindaweni njengesikhwama selayisense, amanye amaphahla, nabalingani bangaphandle. Ukuthenga nasekulayisha: ukuthenga nokulayisha izisetshenziswa, izimpahla zokudla zesikhungo. Isekelo sezempilo: Ukuhamba nabafundi esikhungeni sokwelapha nasezibhedlela. Ukuhlela imugqa yendlela: Hlela futhi ulandele imigqa yendlela esebenza kahle kakhulu usebenzisa amamephu noma i-GPS ukuze uqinisekise ukuletha ngasikhathi sinye futhi ugweme ukubambezeleka ngokuthutha. Ukugcina isimoto ihlezi ihamba: Yenza ukuhlola ngaphambi nangemva kokuhamba, qinisekisa ukuthi isimoto igcwele amafutha, ihlanzekile, futhi igcinwe kahle, futhi ubike noma yiziphi izinkinga noma uhlele ukulungiswa okudingekayo. Ukugcina amarekhodi: Qedela futhi ugcine wonke amarekhodi namabhuku lokungena mayelana nokuhamba, ibanga elihanjwe, ukusetshenziswa kwamafutha, kanye nezinto eziphethwe. Isekelo elijwayelekile: Siza nomsebenzi ohlezi emahhovisi noma emisebenzini yamaphaphu, njengokufaka kumafayela, ukwenza amakhophi, ukwenza amaphutha, nokulayisha futhi ukhulule izinto. Inkonzomthengi: Xhumana nabakhiqizi nabathengi ngendlela ehloniphekile nesithobile, okungenzeka ukuthatha izimali noma ukuthola usayini mayelana nokulethwa.

xh.title: Umqhubi/thumba-nkqubo
xh.summary: Qhuba abafundi baye baye kwaye babuyisele kwiiikholeji eziZezikho ePolokwane, kufuneka iqabane leqatha leGrade 12 kunye nelayisensi yokuqhuba ye-Code 10 esemthethweni ene-PDP.
xh.requirements: Grade 12 Ilicensi yokuqhuba ye-Code 10 esemthethweni ene-PDP. Iminyaka ye-3 yamava okuqhuba ibhasi iya kuba yeyongezo. Ukuhlolwa kokuzama ukufaneleka komqhubi kuya kwenziwa phambi kokunikwa isithuba.
xh.duties: Ubexanduva lokuthutha abafundi kwiikholeji eziZezikho ebe ziyakuze kwaye zibabuyisele esikolweni ngokulandela iindlela ezichaziweyo kunye neshedyuli. Landela imithetho yeqela. Makaba namandla okunxibelelana nabafundi, abazali kunye nabasebenzi basezikolweni. Nceda abafundi ekulayishweni okhuselekileyo nokukhulula abafundi. Yaza abasebenzi besikolo kunye nabazali ngemiqobo ukuze kugcinwe iinkqubo ezifanelekileyo. Yenza ukuhlolwa phambi kokuhamba nangemva kokuhamba. Qondisa abafundi ngelixa behamba ngenjongo yokugcina ukhuseleko nokulandela iinkqubo zeSebe. Yenza ukuhlolwa kokhuseleko nokuqhuba kolunye usuku kwesithuthi esinikiweyo. Xela izilungiso zomatshini ezifunekayo xa kuyimfuneko Yenza iintonjana zokuzilolisa ngeenkqubo ezithintelwe umthetho, zigqibe iiripoti ezifunekayo xa kucelwa. Ukuletha nokuqokelela: Qokelela kwaye uzele amaxwebhu, iindaba, imeyile, iipakethe, nezinye izinto kwindawo ezinjengepost office, amanye amasebe, kunye namaxabiso angaphandle. Ukuthenga nolayisha: ukuthenga nolayisha izixhobo, ukutya kwesikhungo. Inkxaso yempilo: Ukusa abafundi kwikliniki nasezibashusheni. Ucango lweNdlela: Cwangcisa kwaye ulandele iindlela ezisebenzayo kakhulu usebenzisa iimephu okanye i-GPS ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuletha ngexesha elifanelekileyo nokuphepha ukubambezela koluhambo. Ukugcina iSithuthi: Yenza ukuhlolwa phambi kokuhamba nangemva kokuhamba, qinisekisa ukuba isithuthi sigcwele i gallons, sincinci, kwaye sigcinwe kakuhle, kwaye uxele nayan na iingxaki okanye ugcobe izilungiso ezifunekayo. Ukugcina amagqabantshintshi: Qedela kwaye ugcine onke amagqabantshintshi afunekayo kunye namabuku oqhagamshelo malunga nokuhamba, i-Khilomitha, ukusetyenziswa kwe gallons, kunye nezinto ezisetyenzisiweyo. Inkxaso jikelele: Nceda nomsebenzi weofisi jikelele okanye owebhaliyo, ofana nokufaka kwiifayili, ukutsala iikopi, ukwenza imisebenzi yasekhaya, nokulayisha nokukhulula izinto. Iinkonzo zoBukhwele: Qhagamshelana namaxabiso nakwabathengi ngendlela eprofessional nethembekileyo, kunokuthi uqokelele iimali okanye uzame ukufumana iisayiniselwa ekuletheni izinto.

jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 - 3: Anesthesiology
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R1 395 528 - R1 479 723 per annum Grade 2: R1 592 274 - R1 688 553 per annum Grade 3: R1 844 151 - R2 301 186 per annum
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Anesthesiology needed at Witbank Hospital, Mpumalanga, to manage and supervise anesthesiology services across Grade 1 to 3 levels.
jobs.requirements: Appropriate qualifications that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Anesthesiology (2026). A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). Minimum of one 1-year relevant experience after registration with a recognised Foreign Professions and/or the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Anesthesiology) for foreign qualified employees. Grade: 2: A minimum of five (5) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). A minimum of six (6) years’ relevant experience after registration with a recognized foreign health profession council and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Anesthesiology) for qualified foreign employees. Grade 3: A minimum of ten (10) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). Minimum of eleven (11) years’ relevant experience after registration with a recognized foreign health profession council and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist (Anesthesiology) for qualified foreign employees. Knowledge, skills, Training and Competences required. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Sound clinical knowledge. Competency and skills in general clinical domains. The ability to work independently and under pressure and beyond normal working hours and work with diverse team. Good communication, leadership, interpersonal, and engage when necessary. Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programs and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach and guide junior staff within the department. Behavioural Attributes: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationship.
jobs.duties: Supervising the management of and managing Anesthesiology and coordinate services. To execute duties and functions with proficiency, to support the aims and objectives of the institution that consistent with standards of patient care. Accept responsibility for the management of patients admitted in a level 2/3 package of service facility. Assist in the preparation and implementation of guidelines and protocols. Participate in academic and training programs. Assist with clinical audits actively participate in continuous professional development. Provide support to hospital management towards an efficient standard of patient care and services maintained. Comply with the performance Management and Development System (conducting quarterly reviews and final assessment).
jobs.enquiries: Mr. Emmanuel Makokoropo Tel No: (013) 766 3384 / Ms. Gugu Nkosi Tel No: (013) 766 3103 / Ms. Sebenzile Mthisi Tel No: (013) 766 3339, Mr. Mxolisi Maseko Tel No: (013) 766 3351, Mr. Samson Nyoni Tel No: (013) 766 3087 and IT related queries: Help desk Tel No: (013) 766 3018.

af.title: Mediese Spesialis Graad 1 - 3: Anesthesiologie
af.summary: Mediese Spesialis in Anesthesiologie benodig by Witbank Hospital, Mpumalanga, om anesthesiologie-dienste oor Graad 1 tot 3-vlakke te bestuur en toesig te hou.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasies wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Anesthesiologie (2026) toelaat. 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Degelike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Diens-regulasies en beleide. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Grade 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). Minimum van een 1-jaar relevante ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende Foreign Professions en/of die HPCSA as 'n Medical Specialist (Anesthesiology) vir buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Grade: 2: 'n Minimum van vyf (5) jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). 'n Minimum van ses (6) jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsprofessieraad en/of die HPCSA as 'n Medical Specialist (Anesthesiology) vir gekwalifiseerde buitelandse werknemers. Grade 3: 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar se ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA as Medical Specialist (Independent Practice). Minimum van elf (11) jaar se relevante ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende buitelandse gesondheidsprofessieraad en/of die HPCSA as 'n Medical Specialist (Anesthesiology) vir gekwalifiseerde buitelandse werknemers. Kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede vereis. Degelike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Degelike kliniese kennis. Bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk en buite normale werksure en met 'n diverse span te werk. Goeie kommunikasie, leierskap, interpersoonlike vaardighede, en om in te skakel wanneer nodig. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleide, wetgewing, programme en prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te lei. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Toesig hou oor die bestuur van en die bestuur van Anesthesiologie en die koördineer van dienste. Om pligte en funksies met vaardigheid uit te voer, om die doelstellings en oogmerke van die instansie te ondersteun wat ooreenstem met standaarde van pasiëntsorg. Verantwoordelikheid aanvaar vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3-dienspakkie-fasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen met die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning verleen aan hospitaalbestuur ten einde 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en -dienste in stand te hou. Voldoen aan die prestasiebestuurs- en ontwikkelingstelsel (voer kwartaallikse hersienings en finale assessering uit).

zu.title: Isikhulu Sezokwelapha Isigaba 1 - 3: Anesthesiology
zu.summary: Isikhulu sezokwelapha kwi-Anesthesiology sifuna e-Witbank Hospital, e-Mpumalanga, ukuphatha futhi kulawule izinsiza ze-Anesthesiology kuzigaba 1 kuya koku-3.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha (Anesthesiology) ngonyaka ka-2026. Ithiyetha yokusebenza evunyiwe izodingeka kubantu abangengona abantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle ngezimo zokuziphilisa komuntu. Ukuphathwa kwezinyanga ezahlukene nokusebenza njengeqembu, kanye namava kuleso sabuciko sezokwelapha. Ulwazi lomthetho wezempilo nomthetho wesevisi yomphakathi angokwamanje. Amakhono ekubonisana, ekuqoqa umlando, ekuhloleni, ekuqondeni okusesibangeni nasekuphathweni okusesibangeni. Isigaba 1: Akukho nkcazo emva kokuqanjwa kwegama kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha (Anesthesiology) (Independent Practice). Akukho ncwadi evunyiwe eminyakeni emithandathu (6) emva kokuqanjwa igama kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha (Anesthesiology) kubantu abangengona abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababhaliswe emva kokuqanjwa igama kubhalo lweziqu ezivunyiwe zezinyanga zezangaphandle kanye/kanyi noma i-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha (Anesthesiology) kubantu abafunde ezingaphandle. Isigaba 2: Akukho ncwadi evunyiwe eminyakeni emihlanu (5) emva kokuqanjwa igama kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha (Anesthesiology) (Independent Practice). Akukho ncwadi evunyiwe eminyakeni emithandathu (6) emva kokuqanjwa igama kubhalo lweziqu ezivunyiwe zezinyanga zezangaphandle kanye/kanyi noma i-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha (Anesthesiology) kubantu abafunde ezingaphandle. Isigaba 3: Akukho ncwadi evunyiwe eminyakeni eyishumi (10) emva kokuqanjwa igama kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha (Anesthesiology) (Independent Practice). Akukho ncwadi evunyiwe eminyakeni eyishumi nanye (11) emva kokuqanjwa igama kubhalo lweziqu ezivunyiwe zezinyanga zezangaphandle kanye/kanyi noma i-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezokwelapha (Anesthesiology) kubantu abafunde ezingaphandle. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa nokuqondana okudingekayo. Ulwazi oluhle ngemithetho yokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwezinyanga ezahlukene nokusebenza njengeqembu, kanye namava kuleso sabuciko sezokwelapha. Ulwazi oluhle lokusebenza esibangeni. Amandla namakhono kumkhakha jikelele wokusebenza. Ikhono lokusebenza kwakho ngokuya kwakho, ngaphansi kwegciwane, nangemva kwamahora okuqeda ukusebenza, futhi usebenze neqembu elihlukene. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ubuqhawe, ubuhle bokuxhumana nabantu, nokuthi uma kudingeka uhambe. Ulwazi ngemigomo yezempilo, umthetho, izinhlelo nangababalisi abalulekile ngokwamanje kuleso mkhakha. Ikhono lokufundisa nokuhola abasebenzi abancane kulelo phakade. Okubalulekile ngokuziphatha: ukubekezelela ukucindezeleka, ukusebenza eqenjini, ukuzethemba, nakhono lokwakha nokugcina ubuhle bokuxhumana.
zu.duties: Okubhekwayo ekuphathweni kwe-Anesthesiology nakugqamisa izinsiza. Ukwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukweseka amaphupho nemigomo yesikhungo ngokuqondana nezindinganiso zokunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukubekezelela ibhalansi ekuphathweni kwesiguli esingeniswe esikhungweni esinomthamo wesevisi wesigaba 2/3. Ukusiza ekulungiseni nasekuphoqeleleni imihlahlandlela namaphrotokholi. Ukubamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zezifundo zokwesaba ukufundisa nokholwa ekuthuthukiseni izisebenzi ngobuchwepheshe. Ukusiza ngokuhlola izimpilo, ukubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwabesifazane ngokusesabekelayo. Ukunika inkcaso ekuphathweni kwezikole ukuya ezindinganisweni ezisebenzayo zokunakekelwa kwesiguli nasekugcinweni kwezinsiza. Ukuthobela inkqubo yokuqonda nokusiza ekuphathweni kwabasebenzi ukwenza ukubuyekeza kwamakota amine ukugqiba nokuqoqa ukugqiba.

xh.title: Ugqirha oPheleleyo wokuQeqesha inqanaba 1 - 3: i-Anesthesiology
xh.summary: Kufuneka uGqirha oPheleleyo we-Anesthesiology eWitbank Hospital, Mpumalanga, ukulawula kwaye aphenye iinkonzo ze-anesthesiology ukusuka kumgangatho 1 ukuya kumgangatho 3.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwiKhonsele yeeNgqondo ezoBuphila eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengoGqirha oPheleleyo we-Anesthesiology (2026). Ipermiti yomsebenzi eseleyo izakufuneka kubantu abangesiwo abantu baseMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi olululo ngemigaqo yokuziphatha yezonyango. Ulawulo olunamasebe amaninana nokusebenza njengaqela kunye namava kwelona candelo lezonyango. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nemicimbi yona yam va kunye neNkonzo kaRhulumente. Amava okuvela kumaxesha amaninana, ukubutha imbali, ukuhlolwa, ukulinganiswa kwezempilo ulawulo lwezempilo. Inqanaba 1: Akukho nanye emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oPheleleyo (uQeqesho oluzimeleyo). Ubuncinane kunyaka omnye we-1 wamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwiKhonsele yamaphesheva egunyaziweyo kunye naye i-HPCSA njengoGqirha oPheleleyo (Anesthesiology) kubasebenzi abagqithisiweyo kwamanye amazwe. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oPheleleyo (uQeqesho oluzimeleyo). Ubuncinane beminyaka esithandathu (6) yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwiKhonsele yonyango lwamaphesheva egunyaziweyo naxe / okanye i-HPCSA njengoGqirha oPheleleyo (Anesthesiology) kubasebenzi bagqithisiweyo kwamanye amazwe. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi (10) yamava emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha oPheleleyo (uQeqesho oluzimeleyo). Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi elinanye (11) yamava afanelekileyo emva kokubhaliswa kwiKhonsele yonyango lwamaphesheva egunyaziweyo naye / okanye i-HPCSA njengoGqirha oPheleleyo (Anesthesiology) kubasebenzi bagqithisiweyo kwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi, amava, uQeqesho namakhondo afunekayo. Ulwazi olululo ngemigaqo yokuziphatha yezonyango. Ulawulo olunamasebe amaninana nokusebenza njengaqela kunye namava kwelona candelo lezonyango. Ulwazi olululo ngokuqondana nokunakekelwa. Ikhondo namava kumagcina ajikelezayo ezempilo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nangaphantsi koxinzelelo nangaphaya kweyure ezisezantsi ezisesikhundini sokusebenza kunye nokusebenza nqela elahlukeneyo. Isondzomthetho, ukulawula, nokunxibelelana nabantu, nokubandakanyeka xa kufuneka. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yam va ngokubaluleka kakhulu, umthetho, iinkqubo nemiqathango enkosi kubungakanani bakho. Ikhono lokufundisa nokukhokela abasebenzi abancinane kwelona candelo lezonyango. Iimpawu zokuziphatha: Ukunyamezela uxinzelelo, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kweqela, uqinaniso lokuzimela naye ukwakha ukulondoloza ubudlelwane obuhle.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ulawulo kwaye ulawule i-Anesthesiology kwaye ulungiselele iinkonzo. Ukwenza imisebenzi kwaye usebenze ngobuchule, ukuxhasa iinjongo nemiqathango yesi sixeko esihambelana nemigangatho yokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Ukamamkela isibhedlele sokunakekelwa kwabaguli bangenwe kwifasilithi yenqanaba 2/3 yekonzo. Uncede ekulungiseni nokuqeshweni imiqathango nemiyalelo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zefundo nokugqithisa. Uncede ngokuhlola ezibedlele ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokubandakanya ekuphuhlisenweni ngamakhondo abasebenzi. Unikeze inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele ngasentla komgangatho osebenzayo wokunakekelwa kwabaguli kunye neenkronzo ezigcinwayo. Uhambelane neNkqubo yoLawulo noPhuhliso lokuSebenza (ukwenza iimviwo zekwikota kunye nokuqwalasela ekugqibeleni).

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 3: General Surgery
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 3 in General Surgery at Witbank Hospital, requiring an MBChB degree with HPCSA registration for independent practice.
jobs.requirements: MBChB degree (qualification) that allows registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner n Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Practitioner (2026) (Independent Practice). A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Additional experience in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology and ENT will serve as recommendation. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Grade 1: No experience required after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Minimum of 1-year relevant experience after registration with a recognised Foreign Health Professions and / or the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice) for foreign qualified employees. Grade 3: A minimum of ten (10) years’ experience after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Sound clinical knowledge, competency and skills in general clinical domains. The ability to work under supervision as an efficient team member. Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programmes and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach, guide and junior staff within the department. Behavioural Attributes: Stress tolerance, to work within a team, self-confidence and the ability to build and maintain good relationship.

Ondersteuning bied aan hospitaalbestuur om 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en dienste te handhaaf.

zu.title: Medical Officer Grade 3: General Surgery
zu.summary: I-Medical Officer Grade 3 kwi-General Surgery e-Witbank Hospital, idinga iziqu ze-MBChB ezine-HPCSA registration yokuzijosha ngokuzimele.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-MBChB (isifundo) ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezempilo Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengodokotela Wezempilo (2026) (Independent Practice). Isiqiniseko esivela sezemisebenzi sizophoqelela kulabo abangesona izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nezomculo wokuba ngumuntu webunjalo. Ukuphathwa kwemikhakha eminingi nokusebenza njengeqembu, kanye namava kuleso sikhundla sezempilo. Ulwazi ngemithesho namapholisi okwamanha wezempilo kanye nezikhungo zikahulumeni. Amava engeziwe kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology kanye ne-ENT kuzoba yincomo. Amakhono mayelana nokubonisana, ukuthatha umlando wesiguli, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa ngokwezempilo kanye nokuphathwa ngokwezempilo. Grade 1: Akukho mava edingekayo emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezempilo (Independent Practice). Okuncane unyaka oyedwa (1) wamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-recognised Foreign Health Professions kanye noma i-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezempilo (Independent Practice) mayelana nabezisebenzo baseshashalazi abavela emakhaya. Grade 2: Okuncane iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yamava emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezempilo (Independent Practice). Okuncane iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-recognised foreign health profession council kanye noma i-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezempilo (Independent Practice) mayelana nabezisebenzo baseshashalazi abavela emakhaya. Grade 3: Okuncane iminyaka eyishumi (10) yamava emva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezempilo (Independent Practice). Okuncane iminyaka eyishumi nanye (11) yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-recognised foreign health profession council kanye noma i-HPCSA njengodokotela Wezempilo (Independent Practice) mayelana nabezisebenzo baseshashalazi abavela emakhaya. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqesha kanye Namakhono Adingekayo: Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nezomculo wokuba ngumuntu webunjalo. Ukuphathwa kwemikhakha eminingi nokusebenza njengeqembu kanye namava kuleso sikhundla sezempilo. Ulwazi oluhle mayelana nezempilo, amakhono nokuzijwayeza kumkhakha jikelele wezempilo. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kolawulo njengolungu elisebenzayo leqembu. Amakhono mahle okuxhumana, okuba ngumholi, kokuziphatheka kahle nabantu, kanye nokuqondisa. Ikhono lokuphatha iziguli ngokuzimele, ngokuzinakekelaisizondo, ngomxhaso kanye nenguquko uma kunesidingo. Ulwazi ngamapholisi wezempilo okwamanha, umthetho, izinhlelo kanye namaphuzu abalulekile kulowo mkhakha. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuqondisa kanye nobasebenzo abasha kulelo umnyango. Izici Zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela engcindezini, ukusebenza eqenjini, ukuzethemba kanye nakhono lokwakha kanye nokugcina ubudlelwano obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchwepheshe, ukuze sekela amaphuzu anhlobonhlobo nezinjongo zenhlangano, okuhambisana namazinga okunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukumcela ukuxakeka ngokuphathwa kwabaguli abangenwe esikhungeni se-level 2/3 semisebenzi. Ukusiza ekulungiseni nasekuqaliseni iziqondiso nemikhakha yawo. Ukuba yingxenye yohlelo lwezemfundo nokuqeqesha. Ukusiza ngokuhlola izinto ezithinta iziguli futhi ukubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni iziqu ngokuqhubeka. Ukunikeza inkuxolo ekuphathweni kwesibhedlela ukuze kugcinwe amazinga aphumelelayo okunakekelwa kwesiguli nemisebenzi.

Inqanaba 3: Okona mgangatho ufikelela kwiminyaka elishumi (10) yamava emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomGcini wezoNyango (uQeqesho oluzimeleyo). Okona mgangatho ufikelela kwiminyaka elishumi elinanye (11) yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA ejwayelekileyo yamaza ngaphandle nakwi-HPCSA njengomGcini wezoNyango (uQeqesho oluzimeleyo) kubasebenzi abavela kwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Uqeqesho namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi olumangalisayo ngeendlela zokwenza izigulana. Ukulawula iindidi ezahlukeneyo zomsebenzi kunye nokusebenza njengeqela kunye namava kwelinye igatya lokugqirha. Ulwazi olumangalisayo ngamaza, ukuzilolonga kunye namakhono kwimimandla yonke yamaza. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi kolawulo njengomzobo oqeqesheleyo weqela. Ikhono elihle lokuziphatha, ukulawula, ukusebenza nabantu, nokuqeqesha. Ikhono lokulawula izigulana ngokuzimeleyo, ngokuzinikela, ngokumanyeneyo nasekuzimiseleni xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngemigaqo yangoku yokhathalelo lwezonyango, kwimithetho, iinkqubo noko kugqithwa kwindawo ethile. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukuluncedisa abasebenzi abasha esebeni. Iimpawu zobuqu: Ukuzinza ngokuchasene nokuxinzelela, ukusebenza kwindawo yomzobo, ukuzigqiba ngokwakho nokuqonda nokuqwalasela, kunye nekhono lokwakha nokugcina uxulumano oluhle.
xh.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukuxhasa iinjongo nethemba leNhlangano ezihambelana nezinga lonakele lomngeni. Ukamela rexesha ukulawulwa kwabaguli abangenwe kwindawo yesebe lokwakha 2/3. Ukuncedisa ekulungiseni nasekuqwalaselweni iindlela ezahlukeneyo zomsebenzi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwiinkqubo ezahlukeneyo zokhathalelo lwamaza. Ukuncedisa ekuphandweni ngamava amakhulu kwaye ulibe iqhaza ekuphuhliseni ngokuqhubekayo ngobuchule. Ukunikela inkxaso ekulawulweni kwesibhedlele ngenjongo yokugcina izinga eliphilileyo lokhathalelo lomngeni nemisebenzi.

zu.title: Umongameli Wamakhono Izinga 1-3: Izifo Ezingqondo
zu.summary: Umongameli Wamakhono Izinga 1-3 ezisolweni sezifo ezithinta ingqondo esibhedlela i-Witbank, edinga ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA ulwazi oluhlobene nezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-MBChB (isiqu) ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomqeqeshi wezokwelapha eHPCSA Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomqeqeshi wezokwelapha (2026) (Independent Practice). Isiqinisekiso sokusebenza esivumelekile sizodingeka kubantu abangobantu baseNingizimu Afrika. Ukwazi kahle ngemigomo yezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kweminyango eyahlukene nokusebenza njengeqembu nomhlahlandlela olubalulekile oluhlobene nomkhakha wezokwelapha. Ulwazi ngemithetho namapholisi wezokunakekelwa kwempilo nezinsizakalo zomphakathi. Okunye okuhlolwayo kuzoba yimfundo eyongeziwe kwezokuqala nokwelapha kwezofuzo, izifo ezithinta ingqondo, i-anesthesia, i-urology kanye ne-ENT. Amakhono ahlobene nesikhulumi, ukuthatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukulinganisa kwamakhono amaningi nokuphathwa kwamakhono. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyisihlanu (5) yokuhlolwayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengomqeqeshi wezokwelapha (Independent Practice). Okungenani iminyaka eyisithupha (6) yomhlahlandlela oluhlobene nokuhlolwayo emva kokubhaliswa nabalingiswa abakhokhelwayo abavela emnyameni wezokwelapha kanye/noma i-HPCSA njengomqeqeshi wezokwelapha (Independent Practice) kubasebenzi abavela emazweni angaphandle. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukulungiselela namakhono ahiqwa: Ukwazi kahle ngemigomo yezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kweminyango eyahlukene nokusebenza njengeqembu nomhlahlandlela olubalulekile oluhlobene nomkhakha wezokwelapha. Ulwazi oluhle ngamakhono amaningi, amandla okwenza kanye namakhono kumikhakha yamakhono amaningi. Ikono lokusebenza ngaphansi komphathi njengomunye wabasebenzi abasebenza kahle. Amakhono athile okuxhumana, abaholi, abantu, kanye nokuphatha. Ikono lokuphatha abaguli ngokuzimela, ngokuzimisela, ngemfanelo futhi ukubamba iqhaza uma kunesidingo. Ulwazi ngamapholisi wezempilo asikhathini, umthetho, izinhlelo kanye nezigaba ebalulekile kuleso sikhundla. Ikono lokufundisa, ukuhola abasebenzi abasha kulelo phakathi. Izinkambiso zokuziphatha: Ukubekezelela inkinga, ukusebenza eqenjini, ukuzethemba kanye nekhono lokwakha kanye nogcine ubuhlobo obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukwenza imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukusekela amaphupho nemigomo yesikhungo ahambisana neningiwa yezokunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukuzithwala ngemfanelo ekuphathweni kwabaguli abangenwe esikhundleni sezokunakekelwa kwesikhundla 2/3. Ukusiza ekulungiseni nokuphumelelisweni emihlahlandlela namaphrotokholi. Ukubamba iqhaza kwezohlelo zezifundo nokolungiselela. Ukusiza ngokuhlola izoclinical futhi ubambe iqhaza ngokuzimisela ekuthuthukiseni amakhono abasebenzi. Ukunikeza inkxaso ebhalweni lezibhedlela ukuze kugcinwe izinga eliphumelelayo lezokunakekelwa kwesiguli nezinsiza.

xh.title: I-Ofisa yamayeza Inqanaba 1-3: i-Neuro Surgery
xh.summary: Iofisa yamayeza Inqanaba 1-3 kwi-Neuro Surgery e-Witbank Hospital, ifuna u-HPCSAregistration nolunyuko kwezamayeza.
xh.requirements: Idegree ye-MBChB (nqanaba lemfuno) evumela ubhaliso kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezonyango e Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengogqirha wezonyango (2026) (Ukwenzisa okuzimeleyo). Iparmiti yesebenzo esebenzayo iya kufuneka kubantu abangengabo abantu baseMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi olululo ngezomgaqo-nkqubo wezokonyanga. Ulawulo lwezithandanbabini nomsebenzi weqela nolunyuko kwesigaba sezokonyanga esihambelanayo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo-nkqubo yezeempilo eze ngxelo nangaphandle yangoku kanye namagqabantshintshi. Okunyukayo kokuhluza kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Neurosurgery, Anaesthesiology, Urology kunye ne-ENT kuya kubalwa njengesalathiso. Amakhono abakho ngesithuba sokubonisana, ukuthabatha imbali, ukuvavanya, isilinganiso sesigiki kunye nolawulo lwesigiki. Inqanaba 2: Ukusetyenziswa okuncinane kweminyaka emihlanu (5) emva kokuqeswa kwi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezonyango (Ukwenzisa okuzimeleyo). Ukusetyenziswa okuncinane kweminyaka emithandathu (6) ehambelanayo emva kokuqeswa kwikhonsele yamanye amazwe ezesiempilo evunyiweyo kunye/nokuba yi-HPCSA njengogqirha wezonyango (Ukwenzisa okuzimeleyo) kubasebenzi bokuqeswa kwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho namakhono afunekayo: Ulwazi olululo ngezomgaqo-nkqubo wezokonyanga. Ulawulo lwezithandanbabini nomsebenzi weqela nolunyuko kwesigaba sezokonyanga esihambelanayo. Ulwazi olululo ngesigiki, amakhono namandla kumacandelo ajikeleze esigiki. Imandla okusebenza phantsi kolawulo njengomntu osebenzayo eqelini. Isigqibo esihle, ukulawula, abantu abanjalo, namakhono olawulo. Imandla okulawula abaguli ngokuzimela, ngokukhathalelekayo, ngobubeke nokuthetha xa kufuneka. Ulwazi ngamagqabantshintshi amaza empilo, izithintela, iinkqubo namagqabantshintshi kule candelo. Imandla okufundisa, okukhokela abasebenzi abatsha kwisebe. Iimpawu zoMuzama: Ukumelana nokuxinzelela, ukusebenza eqelini, inkathazo ngokwakho kwaye ube nomandla okwakha ukuya kugcina ukuxhonyweka okuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze uzenze imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukuze uxhase iinjongo neenjongo zeNdlu yoGqirha ezihambelana neemigangatho yokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Wamkele ibhalo ekunakekelweni kwabaguli abangenwe kwifasiliti eneqela lenqanaba 2/3 yeseva. Ncede ekulungiseleleni nokusebenziseni iinkqubo nezikhokelo. Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zezifundo nokoluleko. Ncede ngevakishi yezesigiki ubuncinane uthathe inxaxheba kukuhlaziwa kwabuchule obungapheliyo. Yeza ncedo kulawulo lesibhedlele ukuze kugcinwe umgangatho osebenzayo wokunakekelwa kwabaguli neeseva.

xh.title: Medical Officer Grade 1-3: Indlu yabantu bayalelayo
xh.summary: Kufunwa i-Medical Officer Grade 1-3 kwindlu yabantu bayalelayo e-Bethal Hospital e-Mpumalanga, kwaye kufuneka abhaliswe kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga se-MBChB (nelayisensi) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo, eHPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo (2026) (Ukuqhubela phambili ngokuzimela). I-permit yomsebenzi egqithisiweyo iyakufuneka kubantu abangekelwa eMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle ngeziga zokuyilwa kwamalungiselelo ezempilo. Ukulawulwa kwemiSebenzi yamathambo kunye nokusebenza njengodidi lwethu kwaye nolwazi kwithuba elithile lezo ziga. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo namagunya abaphathi bompilo nabasebenzi besichengamazwe. Ulwazi olwengezewe kwi-Obstetrics & Gynaecology, i-Neurosurgery, i-Anaesthesiology, i-Urology kunye ne-ENT luya kubakho ngokubanzi. Amakhono anokusetyenziswa kwizinto ezifana nokubonisana, ukuthatha imbali, ukupanda, ukulinganisa ngokwempilo nokulawulwa kwemifuno. Inqanaba 1: Akukho lwazi ludliwayo lweemfuno emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo (Ukuqhubela phambili ngokuzimela). Ubuncinane benyanga elinye (1) elidluleyo kwesithuba sokuqhubela phambili emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo (Ukuqhubela phambili ngokuzimela) ukulawula abaguli bangabonki. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka emihlanu (5) yamava emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo (Ukuqhubela phambili ngokuzimela). Ubuncinane beminyaka emithandathu (6) yamava emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo (Ukuqhubela phambili ngokuzimela) kubasebenzi abavela ngaphandle. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi (10) yamava emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo (Ukuqhubela phambili ngokuzimela). Ubuncinane beminyaka elishumi elinanye (11) yamava emva kokubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengoGqirha wezempilo (Ukuqhubela phambili ngokuzimela) kubasebenzi abavela ngaphandle. Ulwazi, Amakhono, uQeqesho nokuQonda okuFunekayo: Ulwazi oluhle ngeziga zokuyilwa kwamalungiselelo ezempilo. Ukulawulwa kwemiSebenzi yamathambo kunye nokusebenza njengodidi lwethu kwaye nolwazi kwithuba elithile lezo ziga. Ulwazi oluhle ngokwempilo, amandla okwenza imisebenzi namakhono kwimimandla engqongqo yamaphulo. Amandla okusebenza phantsi kolawulo njengolungu elisebenzayo leqela. Amakhono amahlulwa ethu, abaphathi, abantu abanobulumko, namakhono okulawula. Amandla okulawula abaguli ngokuzimela, ngokuzimisela, ngokwamnxeba, naxa kufuneka. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo zamaphulo zamva, imithetho, iinkqubo namancedo phantsi kwesithili. Amandla okufundisa, okukhokela abasebenzi abatsha kwishishini. Iinkqubo zokuZiphatha: Ukuqina xesha kwexinzelelo, ukusebenza phakathi kweqela, uqinisekiso lwakho ngokwakho nolandolwazi lokwakha nokugcina ubudlelwane obuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze kuqatywe imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukuze kuxhaswe iinjongo nemiqobo zeNzululwazi ezihambelana namazinga enyango labaguli. Ukubamathara ixanduva lokulawula abaguli bageniswe kwisikhululo seenkonzo ngesiqhelo se-2/3. Ukunceda ekulungiseni nokuqhubisweni iziqendu zeenkhuthazo nemithetho yokwenza imisebenzi. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zokufundisa nokufunda. Ukunceda ngokutshintshwa kwezibango ezingangenwa ngokufundwa, ukuthatha inxaxheba ngokubandakanya kwizinto ezintsha zokuphuhliswa kwabasebenzi. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele ukuze kugcinwe amazinga afanelekileyo enyango labaguli nesezinye iinkonzo.

jobs.title: Medical Officer Grade 1
jobs.summary: Medical Officer Grade 1 sought for Daggakraal CHC in Mpumalanga to manage patients and deliver clinical care in a level 2/3 facility.

Current registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Practitioner (2026) (Independent Practice). NB: The appointed Medical Officer must be able to work shifts. A valid work permit will be required from non-South Africans. Sound knowledge of medical ethics. Multidisciplinary management and teamwork and experience in the respective medical discipline. Knowledge of current Health and Public Service regulations and policies. Skills in terms of consultations, history taking, examination, clinical assessment and clinical management. Grade 1: No experience required after registration with the HPCSA as Medical Practitioner (Independent Practice). Knowledge of current health policies, legislation, programmes and priorities within the domain. Ability to teach, guide and junior staff within the department. Participate in academic and training programmes. Assist with clinical audits actively participate in continuous professional development. Provide support to hospital management towards an efficient standard of patient care and services is maintained.
