af.title: Mediese Beampte Graad 1
af.summary: Mediese Beampte Graad 1 gesoek vir Daggakraal CHC in Mpumalanga om pasiënte te bestuur en kliniese sorg in 'n vlak 2/3-fasiliteit te lewer.
af.requirements: MBChB-graad (kwalifikasie) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practitioner toelaat. Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practitioner (2026) (Independent Practice). NB: Die aangestelde Mediese Beampte moet in staat wees om skofte te werk. 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Diensregulasies en -beleide. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Graad 1: Geen ervaring vereis na registrasie by die HPCSA as Mediese Practitioner (Independent Practice) nie. Minimum van 1-jarige relevante ervaring na registrasie by 'n erkende Foreign Health Professions en / of die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Practitioner (Independent Practice) vir buiteland gekwalifiseerde werknemers. Kennis, Vaardighede, Opleiding en Bevoegdhede Vereis: Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis, bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onder toesig as 'n doeltreffende spanlid te werk. Goeie kommunikasie-, leierskaps-, interpersoonlike en toesigvaardighede. Vermoë om pasiënte onafhanklik, ywerig, verantwoordelik te bestuur en wanneer nodig te raadpleeg. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleid, wetgewing, programme en prioriteite binne die domein. Vermoë om junior personeel binne die departement te onderrig en te begelei. Gedragskenmerke: Stresverdraagsaamheid, om binne 'n span te werk, selfvertroue en die vermoë om goeie verhoudings te bou en te handhaaf.
af.duties: Om pligte en funksies met bekwaamheid uit te voer om die doelstellings en oogmerke van die Instelling te ondersteun wat ooreenstem met standaarde van pasiëntesorg. Neem verantwoordelikheid vir die bestuur van pasiënte wat in 'n vlak 2/3-pakket van diensfasiliteit opgeneem is. Bystand verleen by die voorbereiding en implementering van riglyne en protokolle. Neem deel aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning bied aan hospitaalbestuur sodat 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntesorg en -dienste gehandhaaf word.

zu.title: Ihhizinhlolojululeko Lesigaba 1
zu.summary: Kufunwa Ihhizinhlolojululeko Lesigaba 1 esikhungweni se-Daggakraal CHC e-Mpumalanga ukuphatha iziguli nokunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelapha esikhungweni sesigaba 2/3.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ze-MBChB (isimakadebeshe) ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengogqoka wezokwelapha. Ukubhalisa kwamanje ku-HPCSA njengogqoka wezokwelapha (2026) (okuzimele enkoleni). OKUBALULEKILE: Ihhizinhlolojululeko oqokiwe kumele akwazi ukusebenza ngokushintshwa kweshifi. Isivume sokusebenza esisebenzayo sizodingeka kubantu abangeboni abaseNingizimu Afrika. Ukuqonda okuhle kwezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga ngokuhlanganisa izigaba eziningi nokusebenza njengeqembu nanokuhlanganyela emkhakheni wezokwelapha ohambisanayo. Ulwazi ngemithetho nemigomo yamanje yezeMpilo neseSebenza SawusoMuntu. Amakhono ohlelweni lokubonisana, ukuthatha umlando wesiguli, ukuhlola, ukuhlola ngokokwelapha nokuphathwa kwezokwelapha. Isigaba 1: Akukho njalo okudingekile ngemva kokubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengogqoka wezokwelapha (okuzimele enkoleni). Okuncane unyaka o-1 wohlu oluhambisanayo ngemva kokubhaliswa kuqashelwa okwamanye amazwe KobuNcwadi BezeMpilo noma ku-HPCSA njengogqoka wezokwelapha (okuzimele enkoleni) kubasebenzi abafunde kwamanye amazwe. Ulwazi, Amakhono, Ukuqeqeshwa Namakhono Adingekayo: Ukuqonda okuhle kwezokuziphatha kwezokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwezinkinga ngokuhlanganisa izigaba eziningi nokusebenza njengeqembu nanokuhlanganyela emkhakheni wezokwelapha ohambisanayo. Ulwazi oluhle lokwelapha, amakhono nokubekezela emkhakheni jikelele wokwelapha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kokuhlola njengolungu olusebenza kahle leqembu. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana, ukuhola, abantu, nokuhlola. Ikhono lokuphatha iziguli ngokuzimele, ngokuzibophezela, ngokwenza izibopho nokuqashela lapho kudingeka. Ulwazi ngemigomo yezempilo yamanje, umthetho, ohlelo futhi abahola emkhakheni. Ikhono lokufundisa, ukulawula futhi abasebenzi abasha kumnyango. Izici Zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela, ukusebenza eqenjini, inkuthazi nokwakha ukuze ugcine ubuhlobo.
zu.duties: Ukwenzela imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngokusebenza kahle, ukweseka amagugu nenhloso zesikhungo ahambisana nemigomo yamahemuhemu weziguli. Ukwenza izibopho zokuphathwa kweziguli ezifakwe ezikhungweni sesigaba 2/3. Ukusiza ekulungiseleleni nasekuqedeni imigomo nemithelela. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kuhlelo lokufunda nokuziphendula. Ukusiza ezinsizeni zokuqeqesha abasebenzi ezokwelapha futhi uthathe inxaxheba ekuthuthukisweni obungayeki. Ukunikeza inkusekelo kuhlelo lolusha ukugcina imigomo yesiguli kanye namasevisi.

xh.title: Um-Gqi wokufunda we-Grade 1
xh.summary: Kufunwa um-Gqi wokufunda we-Grade 1 we-Daggakraal CHC e-Mpumalanga ukuba alawule abaguli aze abonekele iinkonzo zokunyanga kwifasilithi yonqanaba 2/3.
xh.requirements: I-degree ye-MBChB (isidanga) evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengom-Gqi wokufunda. Ukubhaliswa ngoku kwi-HPCSA njengom-Gqi wokufunda (2026) (Ukuqhubela phambili Ngokuzimeleyo). NB: Um-Gqi wokufunda oqokiweyo makabe nokwazi ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ishishini. I-permit yokusebenza elungileyo iza kufuneka kubantu abangesi ngabaseMzantsi-Afrika. Ukuqonda okuhle ngeziga zobuchule bokunyanga. Olunye ulawulo nakwabanye abasebenzi nokusebenza njengeqela, kunye namava kwiloo ndlela yokunyanga. Ulwazi ngemithetho yangoku yezeempilo neseZizwe yeempilo, kunye neenkqazo. Ikhono malunga neengxoxo, ukuthatha imbali, ukuvavanya, ukuqwalasela okukliniki kunye nolawulo lokunyanga. Inqanaba 1: Akukho mava afuneka emva kokuibhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengom-Gqi wokufunda (Ukuqhubela phambili Ngokuzimeleyo). Ubuncinane bemva yonyaka om-1 ohambelana nalo emva kokuibhaliswa kwi-Foreign Health Professions evunyiweyo nokuba yi-HPCSA njengom-Gqi wokufunda (Ukuqhubela phambili Ngokuzimeleyo) kubaqeshi abangesi ngabaseMzantsi-Afrika abagqithiswe kumazwe ngaphandle. Ulwazi, Ikhono, uQeqesho neeNkomfa Ezifunekayo: Ukuqonda okuhle ngeziga zobuchule bokunyanga. Ulunye ulawulo nakwabanye abasebenzi nokusebenza njengeqela, kunye namava kwiloo ndlela yokunyanga. Ulwazi oluhle lokunyanga, ukuzinza nakwakhono kwimida ethile jikelele yokunyanga. Ikreleklele lokusebenza phantsi kolawulo njengomsebenzi ovela eqeleni elisebenzayo. Iikhono ezilungileyo zoluntu, bokulawula, bokuvakalisa, kunye nokuqonda imicimbi yabanye. Ukuba nakho ukulawula abaguli ngokuzimela, ngokuzinikela, ngoxanduva nokubakho xa kuyimfuneko. Ulwazi ngamagqabantshashi wezempilo, imithetho, iinkqubo kunye neenkqaba ezibalulekileyo kwelo candelo. Ikreleklele lokufundisa, ukukhokela abasebenzi abasha kwisebe. Iimpawu zokuziphatha: Ukunyamezela inqqalelo, ukusebenza eqeleni, ukuzithemba nokwazi ukwakha nokugcina ubudlelwane obuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze uphumeze imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukuze uxhase iinjongo nemiqathango zeNzululwazi ezihambelana neemigangatho yonakele lweviguli. Ukubeka ulwabiwo lokusingathwa kwabaguli abangenwe kwifasilithi evala inqanaba 2/3 lonkekelelo lwenkonzo. Ukunceda kwisilungiselelo kunye nokuqwalaselwa kweekhodi ezichaza imigaqo nemithetho. Ukubamba iqhaza kweenkqubo zokufunda nezoliko. Ukunceda ngokucingqingo kwezempilo kwaye ubambe iqhaza ekuphuhliseni ukhululeko lokusebenza ngobuchule. Ukunika inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele ukuba kuqhagamshelane nemigangatho elungileyo yonakele lweviguli, ukuba igcinwe.

af.title: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde (PN-B4): Kritiese Sorg / Trauma &
af.summary: Assistentbestuurder Verpleegkunde (PN-B4) pos by Witbank Hospitaal in Mpumalanga, verantwoordelik vir die toesig en koördinering van kritiese-sorg- en traumaverpleegdienste.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 plus basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die South African Nursing Council ingevolge Government Notice R425, (d.w.s. Diploma / Degree in Nursing) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige (2026) toelaat. 'n Minimum van tien (10) jaar gepaste/erkenningervaar in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleging. Ten minste ses (6) jaar van bogenoemde moet gepaste/erkenningervaar in die spesifieke spesialiteit wees na verkryging van die 1 jaar postbasiese kwalifikasie in Critical Care / Trauma & Emergency Care Nursing Science. Ten minste drie (3) van bogenoemde tydperk moet gepaste/erkenningervaar op bestuursvlak wees. 'n Diploma / Degree in Nursing Administration and Management sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Kennis/vaardighede: Basiese rekenaarvaardigheid, sterk leierskap, goeie kommunikasie en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk, eie tyd te bestuur, as 'n effektiewe leier van die verpleegspan te funksioneer. Verandering implementeer en bestuur. Bereidwilligheid om skofte en wagdienste te werk in ooreenstemming met die vereistes van die eenheid en verpleegdienste. Verslagdoeningsvaardighede.
af.duties: Delegeer, toesig hou en koördineer die voorsiening van effektiewe en doeltreffende pasiëntsorg deur voldoende gehalte-verpleegsorg. Inisieer en neem deel aan gesondheidsbevordering om konsekwente kommunikasie van relevante, akkurate en omvattende inligting oor gesondheidsorg te verseker. Ontwikkel/vestig en onderhou konstruktiewe werksverhoudings met verpleging en ander belanghebbendes. Neem deel aan die analise, formulering en implementering van verpleegriglyne, praktyke, standaarde, beleide, PMDS, prosedures, nood- en strategiese planne. Monitor en verseker behoorlike benutting van menslike, finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne. Kwaliteitsbestuur insluitend infeksiebeheer, inligtingsbestuur en kliniese oudits. Neem deel aan die analise, formulering en implementering van verpleegriglyne, praktyke, standaarde en prosedures. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne. Monitor en verseker behoorlike benutting van finansiële en fisiese hulpbronne. Implementeer alle relevante voorskrifte. Bestuur en monitor behoorlike benutting van menslike, finansiële en materiaalhulpbronne. Bestuur die begroting in ooreenstemming met die PFMA.

xh.summary: Isithuba se-Assistant Manager Nursing (PN-B4) e-Witbank Hospital e-Mpumalanga, sijolise nokulawula nohlelo lweenkonzo zenursing ezijolise nonakekelo lwesigulana esibalulekileyo nokuhlaselwa ngesandla.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi sesinqgexi / Grade 12 ngaphezulu kunanemfuno esisiseko eqinisekisiweyo namaKhomishani eNursing eMzantsi Afrika ngokweSomlimi kaRhulumente iSaziso R425, (oko kukuthi iDiploma / iDegree eNursing) okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivumela ubhaliso kunye ne-SANC njengoNesi oPhambili (2026). Isiphithiphithi seminyaka elishumi (10) yamava afanelekileyo/aqhelekayo kwinursing emva kobhaliso njengoNesi oPhambili kunye ne-SANC kuNursing jikelele. Ubuncinane iminyaka emithandathu (6) efunwa ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava afanelekileyo/aqhelekableyo kwicala elithile emva kokufumana isidanga sangemva kwesiqingqexhu somnyaka omnye kwi-Critical Care / Trauma & Emergency Care Nursing Science. Ubuncinane kwelixesha elithathu (3) elibiziweyo ngasentla kufuneka kube ngamava afanelekileyo/eqhelekayo kwinqanaba lolawulo. iDiploma / iDegree kwiNursing Administration and Management iya kuba lusizo olongeziweyo. Ulwazi/ amakhono: Ulwazi olusisiseko lokusebenza ngemigrongo, uLawulo oluNamandla, Unxibelelwano oluhle namaKhono aMfutshane phakathi kwabantu. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza phantsi koxinzelelo, ukulawula ixesha lakho, ukusebenza njengomlawuli osebenzayo weqela labasebenzi benursing. Zisebenzise ulawule itshintsho. Ilungelo lokusebenza iishifthi nokulinda ngokweemfuno zeuniti neenkonzo zenursing. Amakhono okubala iindaba.
xh.duties: Misela, ulawule uphinde uhlele ukunikwa konakezelo kwezigulana okusebenzayo nolusebenzayo ngokwenziswa kokunakekela okulinganisiweyo kolunyu lweemfuno. Qalisa uphinde uthathe inxaxheba ekukhuthazeni impilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukudlulisa rhoqo ulwazi olumayela noluchanekileyo nolubanzi malunga nonakekelo lwezempilo. Yakha/misa uphinde ulondoloze ubudlelwane obusebenzayo bokusebenza nabasebenzi bezempilo nabanye bantu abathintekayo. Thathe inxaxheba kwahlulwa-hlulo, ekubhaliweni nasekusetyenzisweni kwemigaqo, iinkqubo, iimilinganiselo, iinqobo-zethu, iinkqubo zokusebenza ze-PMDS, iinkqubo, iiplani ezingabikhoyo nezamacwangciso avakalayo. Qwalasela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwemithombo yabantu, eyimali nengokubakho. Ulawulo lolulinganiso lokunaka ukubandakanya ulawulo lotywala-bhubho, ulawulo lolwazi noqwalaselo lwezempilo. Ukuthatha inxaxheba kwahlulwa-hlulo, ekubhaliweni nasekusetyenzisweni kwemigaqo yokunakekela abagulayo, iinkqubo, iimilinganiselo neenkqubo zokusebenza. Lawula imithombo yabantu. Qwalasela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwemali nemithobo engokubakho. Zisebenzise zonke imiyalelo echaphazekayo. Lawula uphinde uqwalasele ukusetyenziswa okuchanekileyo kwemithombo yabantu, yemali nengokubakho. Lawula isabelo-mali ngokwe-PFMA.

jobs.summary: Ultrasound Radiographer Grade 1 sought for Witbank Hospital in Mpumalanga, requiring HPCSA registration and appropriate radiography qualification.

af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in óf Radiography, Radiation Oncology Radiography, Ultrasound Radiography óf Mammography Radiography (2026) toelaat. af.duties: Voer diagnostiese ultraklankbeeldondersoeke uit. Skryf verslae ooreenkomstig voorgeskrewe protokolle. Moet in staat wees om onafhanklik sonder toesig te werk. zu.title: Ultrasound Radiographer (SONOGRAPHER) Grade 1
zu.summary: I-Ultrasound Radiographer Grade 1 iyafunwa e-Witbank Hospital e-Mpumalanga, idinga ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA nesifundo sesifundo sezithombe esifanele.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 kahambisanana nesifundo esifanele esivumela ukubhaliswa ne-HPCSA egatshini leRadiography, Radiation Oncology Radiography, Ultrasound Radiography noma i-Mammography Radiography (2026). Ukubhaliswa kwamanje ne-HPCSA kunoma ikuphi egatshini le-Radiation Oncology Radiography, i-Ultrasound Radiography noma i-Mammography Radiography (2026). Okungenani iminyaka emine (4) yamava afanele ngemva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA njenge-Diagnostic Radiographer. Ikhono (Ulwazi/Amakhono): Ikono lokusebenza nokwedwa nangaphakathi kweqembu. Ikono lokuhlela futhi uqedele ukuhlolwa ngasesikhathini. Khombisa ukuqonda kwesakhiwo somzimba womuntu, i-physiology, i-pathology neminikelo yezokwelapha. Ikono lokwenza inani elikhulu lezinto zokuqoqa izithombe ngomsindo ezizingeni eliphezulu. Amakhono mahle wokuxhumana nabantu. Ulwazi ngemithetho, emthethweni namapholisi ahambisana nabasebenzi basezikhundleni zikahulumeni.
zu.duties: Yenza ukuhlolwa kwesifundo sezithombe ezitholakala ngokusebenzisa umsindo. Bhala imibiko ngokulandela imithetho ehlelwe ngokusemthethweni. Kufanele ukwazi ukusebenza kodwa ngaphandle kolawulo. Landela futhi waqinisekise ukuthi kuhambisana ne-Radiation Control Board ne-HPCSA, umthetho wokugcinwa kwemishini kanye nokwenza izibalo zenyanga ngamunye esigabeni sezithombe zomsindo. Bamba iqhaza futhi useke ukuthuthukiswa kwabasebenzi nabafundi. Bamba iqhaza ku-CPD njengoba kudingwa yi-HPCSA. Izinga eliphezulu lebresponsi. Qedela imibhalo ehlelekile. Landela iminikelo yokulawula ukutheleleka neminikelo yokuphepha. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa okufanele ekusetshenzisweni kemishini ye-x-ray nezimpahla. Yenza ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile kwesifundo sezithombe, ukuhlolwa kwe-CT scan, ukuhlolwa kwe-Fluoroscopy, kanye nekuhlolwa kwesifundo sezithombe e-Theatre nasemagumbi okulala. Nikeza izinsiza zokuhlola izithombe ngemvanemahora.

xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 ngesidima sayo esifanelekileyo esivumela ubhaliso kunye neHealth Professionals Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kwelinye lamagunya: Radiography, Radiation Oncology Radiography, Ultrasound Radiography okanye Mammography Radiography (2026). Ubhaliso lwangoku kunye ne-HPCSA kwelinye lamagunya: Radiation Oncology Radiography, Ultrasound Radiography okanye Mammography Radiography (2026). Inani elingaphantsi kweminyaka emine (4) yamava afanelekileyo emva kobhaliso kunye neHealth Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengomqwalaseli we-Diagnostic Radiographer. Iinkqubo (Izaziso/namava): Amandla okusebenza yenze ngokwakhe nakwingqungamsha yoluntu. Amandla okulungelelanisa nokuphumeza iindlela zokuqwalasela ngexesha elifanelekileyo. Bonisa ukuqonda kobume bomzimba bomntu, i-physiology, i-pathology nolwimi lwezokwelapha. Amandla okwenza isixa esikhulu seendlela zokuqwalasela i-ultrasound ngokulinganayo eliphezulu. Iimpawu ezilungileyo zokuquumbaana nomnxeba namava obuntu. Ulwazi ngemithetho yesebe loLuntu, iMithetho namepolisi ahlobene nalo.
xh.duties: Yenza iindlela zokuvavanya izifundo nge-ultrasound. Bhala iingxelo ngokwesinqe esibekiweyo esinamagunya afunyanwa ngumthetho. Makakwazi ukusebenza yenze ngokwakhe ngaphandle kolawulo lithile. Landele uze uqinisekise ukutyikitywa kweBroad yeLawulo leeRadili kunye ne-HPCSA, uGcino lweMithetho nokuZinza kolwelo, kwaye wenze izibalo ngenyanga kwicandelo le-ultrasound. Zibandakanye kwaye ukhuthaze uphuhliso labasebenzi nakwabafundi. Zibandakanye kwi-CPD njengoko kufunwa yi-HPCSA. Inqanaba eliphezulu lexabiso. Qedela izicwangciso ezifanelekileyo zoxwebhu. Landela iindlela eziseta isilumkiso sokulawula iintsholongwane nendlela yokhuseleko. Qinisekisa ukhathalo olufanelekileyo ekusetyenziseni iemoyibili zesini neemfuno ezahlukeneyo. Yenza iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokuqwalasela i-radiography ngokubanzi, iindlela zokuqwalasela i-CT scan, iindlela zokuqwalasela i-Fluoroscopy, kunye neendlela zokuqwalasela i-radiography kwisihlalo esikwisibhedlele kwanakumanangwe elungele iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo. Nikezela iinkonzo zokuqwalasela i-radiology emva kweyure ezisebenzayo.

Neem deel aan gehaliteitsverbeteringsprogramme. Oul en implementeer pasiëntsorgstandaarde. Implementeer en beoefen verpleegkunde-gesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die statutêre wette wat die verpleegprofessie, arbeid en gesondheidsorg regeer. Implementeer konstruktiewe werkverhoudinge met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes. Verseker nakoming van Infeksievoorkoming en Beheer-beleide. Verseker dat die toerusting te alle tye funksioneel en gereed is. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Neem deel aan personeelsonwikkeling en prestasiebestuur. Rapporteer pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle, uitdagings en tekortkominge binne die eenheid. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vriendelik saam met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. Verseker getrouheid aan Batho - Pele-beginsels en die Pasient se Regte Handves.

zu.title: Uqeqesho Lwemfundo ephakeme kwezokwelapha: Okuphambili kokukhulisa (Advanced Midwifery)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuba nguPjesiyonali Nesi Grade 1 kwi-Advanced Midwifery eWitbank Hospital, esidinga ukubhaliswa kwiSANC nefomeshoni yezokwelapha ngemva kwesikhundla esiyisisekelo.
zu.requirements: Ibhasikhali yokusebenza efanele ekuqinisekiswa yiSANC kuyinhloko kulesi sikhundla. Uphawu lokusebenza oluphambili lufanele ukuba ngaphezulu kancane kwehle (4) kweminyaka emihlanu ngemva kokubhaliswa njengomsebenzi weSANC. Kudingeka ukuba nokuhlakanipha okuphilile, ukubonakaliswa kwezinkomba nokuqonda izinkinga. Kudingeka imigqa yokuphatha, ukukhokha nokuhola abanye abasebenzi. Ibhalwe njengomsebenzi oyiSANC Professional Nurse and Midwifery (2026), noma uphawu olufanayo luvunyelwe ibhalwa njengomsebenzi ohlezi ethunjini, oluphambili lwe-1 (iDiploma/Degree General Nursing) noma uphawu olufanayo luvunyelwe ibhalwa njengomsebenzi ohlezi ethunjini, oluphambili lwe-1 (iDiploma/Degree General Nursing) noma uphawu olufanayo luvunyelwe ibhalwa njengomsebenzi ohlezi ethunjini, oluphambili lwe-1 (iDiploma/Degree General Nursing) noma uphawu olufanayo luvunyelwe ibhalwa njengomsebenzi ohlezi ethunjini, oluphambili lwe-1 (iDiploma/Degree General Nursing).
zu.duties: ukuhlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kwabaguli okuhlangene, okujulile, okunemizinga ehleliwe nokusemthethweni. Ukuhlinzeka ngamasevisi okunakekelwa kwempilo ohlelweni lokunakekelwa kwabakhulelwe oluthuthukisiwe. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle. Hlinzeka ngokunakekelwa kwabaguli okulinganiselwe kahle, landela imigaqo nemizinga. Bamba iqhaza ohlelweni lokuthuthukiswa kwemilinganiselo. Qondisa futhi usebenzise imizinga yokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Sebenzisa futhi wenzise ukunakekelwa kwezempilo ezokwelapha ngokuvumelana nemithetho elawula inqubo yokwelapha, abasebenzi nezempilo. Phinda uthuthukise izinkambisana ezinhle zokusebenza nabasebenzi bakhona. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa izinqubomgomo zokubeka nokuvimbela izifo ezelana nobungculaza. Qinisekisa ukuthi amabhuloho asebenza futhi alungele njalo. Ukhululeka ukucubungula futhi uhlele imisebenzi yakho kanye nengqikithi yabasekeli ukugqitha isikhathi eside sokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Bamba iqhaza ekuthuthukisweni kwabasebenzi nasekuphathweni kokusebenza kahle. Bika izingozi ezingase zenzeka kubaguli, izinkinga nobungenisa ohlelweni. Sebenza ngempumelelo, ngokubambisana kahle nabantu abahlukene ngemibono,amasiko, izinhlanga noma inkolo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa imigaqo yeBatho-Pele nehelayo lamalungelo abaguli.

xh.title: Umongikazi oGunyaziwe Oqeqeshwe Kakhulu Inqanaba 1 (PN-B1): Ukukhuliswa Kokuqhakambisa Ezabesezokusidiwa
xh.summary: Isithuba somongikazi oGunyaziwe oQeqeshwe Kakhulu kokuqhakambisa ezabesezokusidiwa esibhedlele iWitbank, kufuneka ubhaliswe kwiSANC ube nemvuyo yesiFundo nokuqeqesha okungasemva kwesiseko.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi Samabanga aphakamileyo / Isidanga sokugqibela 12 okulinganayo ngenani yaye nesiFundo nokuqeqesha esiseko esemvunywe yiSANC ngokweSaziso likaRhulumente R425 (oko kukuthi iDiploma / iNqanaba lokugqibela ekuQeqeshweni kokhathalelo lwengingqi) okulingana nesimemo esikuvumela ukuba ubhaliswe kwiSANC njengomongikazi ogunyaziwe noqhakambisi ezabesezokusidiwa (2026), isimemo sokugqibela sokuxhomeke ekusebenzeni ngemimandla emininzi yokusingatha ukufundwa, ngexesha elingentla kwengownye umnyaka, esemvunywe yiSANC ngokweSaziso likaRhulumente R212 kwelona candelo lithi Ukusetyenziswa kwamandla okugqitha kweMfundo yokusingatha imigqa yomngcipheko ekungeniseni iziko elikhulu lezingalo ekusethweni kwamakhadi ezibini apha ekulawuleni umthetho weenkqubo zemeko yexesha elihlala kwindalo kwaye kuqinisekiswa kukuba ngamakhadi abhalwe kunye nemithetho yolawulo lwezabasezokusidiwa.
xh.duties: Ukunika ukhathalelo olulungileyo, oluqulunqwe ngokukhulu ngokwezondalo nangaphezu kwazo ngokwemigaqo esebenzayo nemithetho yemisebenzi yesigqeba soluntu. Ukubonelela ngezibonelelo ezizezona zilungileyo ezisemthethweni kumaphezu kwenkqubela phambili kwiNgingqi yeKhadi leKhathalelo oluGqithisayo lweMeko yexesha elihlala kwindalo. Ukunika ukhathalelo olubandakanya wonke umntu ongumrhuulwa ngomsebenzi weRhulumente ekubeni ngumntu onokuthi athethe, ahambisane neenkqubo neenkqubo zomanyano lweRiphabhlikhi. Ukuqinisekisa ukulawulwa ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo nemithombo yolwazi. Ukubonelela ngokhathalelo oluhle lomrhuulwa, ulandelwe imithetho nemigaqo elungileyo. Ukuzibandakanya kwenkqubo zokuphucula izinga lomrhuulwa. Ukulawula nokusebenzisa imigaqo yokhathalelo lomrhuulwa. Ukusebenzisa nokwenza umsebenzi wokhathalelo lomongikazi ngokwesimo sabo ngokomthetho osezayo, wezabasezokusidiwa nezempilo. Ukwakha ubudlelwane obulungileyo nabasebenzi naye nabanye abantu abajongene nayo into. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zoLawulo lokuNikwa nokuQatshwa kwezigulo ezidluliswayo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zisebenza kwaye zilungele ngexesha lonke. Ukuba nakho ukucwangcisa nokuhlela umsebenzi wakho nakwabasebenzi abakuxhasa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalelo oluchanekileyo lokusingatha imigqa yomngcipheko. Ukuzibandakanya ekuphuculweni abasebenzi nakulawulweni kokusebenza. Ukubika ngokusilela kokhathalelo lomrhuulwa, iingxaki nangakungonwabanga kwingingqi leKhadi leKhathalelo oluGqithisayo lweMeko yexesha elihlala kwindalo. Ukusebenza kakuhle, ngokubambana nokwamkela abantu abahlukene ngokwengcinga, enkcubeko, ngobuhlanga okanye inkolo. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthobela iimPezulu zeBatho-Pele noMthetho weZigunya zeRhuulwa.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 (PN-B1): Operating Theatre
jobs.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 position at Witbank Hospital focusing on Operating Theatre care, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic nursing qualification.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 qualification or equivalent plus Basic qualification accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice R425 (i.e. Diploma / Degree in General Nursing) or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse and Midwifery (2026), a post-basic nursing qualification, with a duration of at least 1 year, accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice R212 specialty in Operating Theatre Nursing Science. Minimum of four (4) years appropriate / recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC. Ability to function independently and to prioritize work. Leadership and sound interpersonal skills, problem solving and decision-making skills. Good supervisory and teaching skills.
jobs.duties: Provision of optimal, holistic specialized nursing care with set standards and within a professional/legal framework. Provide comprehensive health care services in the Operating Theatre Unit. Ensure effective and efficient management of resources. Provide quality patient care, follow norms and standards. Participate in quality improvement programs. Supervise and implement patient care standards. Implement and practice nursing health care in accordance with the statutory laws governing the nursing profession, labour and health care. Implement constructive working relations with nurses and other stake holders. Ensure compliance of Infection Prevention and Control policies. Ensure that the equipment is functional and ready all the time. Able to plan and organize your own work and that of support personnel to ensure proper nursing care. Participate in staff development and performance management. Report patient safety incidence, challenges and deficiencies within the unit. Work effectively, co-operatively amicably with people of diverse intellectual, cultural, racial or religious differences. Ensure adherence to Batho - Pele Principles and Patient’s Right Charter.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 (PN-B1): Operasiesaal
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1-pos by Witbank Hospital wat op Operasiesaal-sorg fokus, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n na-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12-kwalifikasie of gelykwaardig plus Basiese kwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Goewermentskennisgewing R425 (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Vroedvrouskunde (2026) moontlik maak, 'n na-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Goewermentskennisgewing R212 spesialiteit in Operasiesaal-verpleegkunde. Minimum van vier (4) jaar gepaste / herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goeie toesighoudende en onderrigvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaffing van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg volgens vasgestelde standaarde en binne 'n professionele/wettige raamwerk. Verskaf omvattende gesondheidsorgdienste in die Operasiesaal-eenheid. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van hulpbronne. Verskaf gehalte-pasiëntesorg en volg norms en standaarde. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Hou toesig oor en implementeer pasiëntesorgstandaarde. Implementeer en beoefen verpleeggesondheidsorg in ooreenstemming met die statutêre wette wat die verpleegberoep, arbeid en gesondheidsorg regeer. Implementeer konstruktiewe werksverhoudings met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes. Verseker nakoming van Infeksievoorkoming en -beheerbeleide. Verseker dat toerusting altyd funksioneel en gereed is. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Neem deel aan personeelsonwikkeling en prestasiebestuur. Rapporteer pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle, uitdagings en tekortkominge binne die eenheid. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vriendelik met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. Verseker nakoming van Batho Pele-beginsels en die Handves vir Pasienteregte.

zu.title: Umhlengi Ochwepheshe i-Grade 1 (PN-B1): Operating Theatre
zu.summary: Isikhundla Somhlengi Ochwepheshe we-Grade 1 e-Witbank Hospital sigxile ekunakekeleni i-Theatre Yokusebenza, sifuna ukubhalwa kwi-SANC nenhla yokuhlengwa yesikhathi esingemuva.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi Samabanga Aphakeme / Isitifiketi se-Grade 12 noma okulinganayo kanye nenhla zokuhlengwa esemqoka egunyaziwe ne-SANC ngokusho kokuKutshwaywa Kwahulumeni R425 (okungukuthi iDiploma / I-Degree ekuhlengweni Jikelele) noma isitifiketi esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalwa ne-SANC njengomhlengi Ochwepheshe kanye Nobuhlengi (2026), inhla yokuhlengwa yesikhathi esingemuva, ehamba isikhathi esingaphezulu konyaka o-1, egunyaziwe ne-SANC ngokusho kokuKutshwaywa Kwahulumeni R212 ekukhethekile kwesayensi Yethiyetha Yokusebenza Yokuhlengwa. Ukuze kube khona okungaphezulu konyaka o-4 ubudala ohlelweni lokuhlengwa emva kokubhalwa njengomhlengi Ochwepheshe ne-SANC. Ukukwazi ukusebenza锌 ngokuzimela kanye nokubeka umsebenzo ohlele. Amandla okuhola kanye nobungcweti bokuxhumana nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye namandla okuthatha izinqumo. Amandla ahle okuqondisa nokufundisa.
zu.duties: Abikezela inakekelo eyisisekelo, ephelele, eboniswe ubuchwepheshe kanti futhi ihambisana nemigomo emisiwe nangaphakathi kwesikqindi sezomthetho/ezobungcweti. Abikezela izinsiza eziphelele zokunakekela impilo esiYunithini Yethiyetha Yokusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okusebenzayo nokuqondile kwemithombo. Abikezela inakekelo emnandi yomguli, landela imigomo nemigembu. Thatha inhlangothi ohleweni lwentuthuko yekhwalithi. Qondisa futhi usebenzise imigomo yokunakekela umguli. Sebenzisa futhi ukwenza inakekelo yezempilo yokuhlengwa ngokuhambisana nomthetho wesikqindi obusa inkundla yokuhlengwa, abasebenzi nokunakekelwa kwempilo. Yakha ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabahlengi kanye nanabanye abanomthelela. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nemigomo Yokuvikela Ukutheleleka kanye Nolawulo. Qinisekisa ukuthi amadayi asebenza futhi ayalungele noma ngasiphi isikhathi. Ukukwazi ukucubungula futhi ulungiselele umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabasebenzi abasiza ukuze kuqinisekiswe inakekelo ehle yokuhlengwa. Thatha inhlangothi ekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi nasekuphathweni kokusebenza. Bika ukuphikelela kokuphepha komguli, izinselelo kanye nezinto ezingezinhle ngaphakathi kweyunithi. Sebenza ngempumelelo, ube ngumakadebona ubuhle nabantu abahlukene ngobuchwepheshe, ngamasiko, ngobuhlanga nangokholo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana Nemigomo Yabo Batho - Pele kanye Neshadi Lamalungelo Omguli.

xh.title: Uposi lukarhulumente: INesi ePhathwa eNqanabeni lokuqala (PN-B1): i-Operating Theatre
xh.summary: Isithuba soNesi oPhatha ongunqanaba 1 kwisibhedlele saseWitbank sinomgqaliselo ekunyathiseni kwi-Operating Theatre, sifuna ukubhalwa kwiSANC nesifundo sobunesi se-post-basic.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSenior / iGrade 12 okanye isidingo esilinganayo esongeze isifundo esisisiseko esamkelwe yiSANC ngokwezaziso kaRhulumente R425 (okt iDiploma / iDegree kwiGeneral Nursing) okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalwa kwiSANC njengoNesi oPhatha nesi oQhwesha (2026), isifundo sobunesi se-post-basic, esithatha ubuncinane unyaka oyi1, samkelwe yiSANC ngokwezaziso kaRhulumente R212 ekukhethweni kwesayensi yokunyathisa kwi-Operating Theatre. Ubuncinane beminyaka emine (4) yamava ahambelanayo / avunyelwayo ekunyathiseni emva kokubhalwa njengoNesi oPhatha kwiSANC. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokuzimeleyo kwaye uphuhlise umsebenzi ngokutsho kubalulekileyo. Amava okuba ngumkhokeli namakhono obudlelwane obuhle, ukuxazulula iingxaki namakhono okwenza izigqibo. Amakhone amahle okulawula nokuqeqesha.
xh.duties: Kunikela unyango lwezempilo olungathanga lube lukhulu loluqwalaselweyo kwaye lusemthethweni. Kubonelele ngeenkonzo ezizezizonke zezempilo kwiiYunithi ye-Operating Theatre. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo nokusebenza kakuhle kwamathuba. Nikela ngenkonzo yomngeniso olungcono, landela imigaqo nemilinganiselo. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuphucula ubungakanani bolunyango. Phatha kwaye usebenzise imigaqo yonnyango lomngeniso. Sebenzisa kwaye uzilolonge unyango lwezempilo ngokwemithetho elawula ishishini lokunyathisa, abasebenzi nokunyathisa izempilo. Yakhe ubudlelwane obusebenzayo nabanye abasikhathalelayo. Qinisekisa ukuthobela iinkqubo zoLawulo nokuthintela iintsholongwane. Qinisekisa ukuba izixhobo ziyasebenza kwaye zilunge ngalo lonke ixesha. Makakwazi ukucwangcisa kwaye alungelelanise umsebenzi wakhe nawabasebenzi abamncedayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe unyango olufanelekileyo. Thatha inxaxheba kuphuhliso lwabasebenzi nokulawula ukusebenza. Ngxela ngemiqondo yokhuseleko lomngeniso, iingxaki nangapha kwayo kule yunithi. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokubambisana nokuhlonipha abantu abahlukeneyo ngokwengqondo, baso, ngesini okanye ngokwenkolo. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela kuMgaqo weBatho-Pele noMgaqo weZelungelo loMngeniso.

Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimela kanye nokubeka izinto ezibalulekile ngapambili. Amakhono obuholo nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo. Ukunikeza izinsizakalo ezeqiniswe ukunakekelwa kwempilo eYunithi Yokunakekelwa Kwezempilo Yezingane. Ukuqinisekisa ukuphathwa kwezinsiza ngempumelelo nangokusebenza kahle. Ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwabaguli okusezingeni eliphezulu, ukulandela imigomo naniqobo. Ukubamba iqhaza kuhlelo lokuthuthukisa izinga. Ukuphethe nokuphoqa izindinganiso zokunakekelwa kwabaguli. Ukuphoqa nokwenza ukunakekelwa kwempilo kokuqina ngokuhambisana nomthetho obala ocashelwa inqubo yokusingatha iziguli, abasebenzi kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Ukwakha ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza namanye oongoti bokuqina nalabo abanezinkimbinkimbi ezahlukene. Ukuphoqa ukuthobela izinqubomgomo zokuvinjelwa kokutheleleka nokulawula. Ukuthi izinto zokusebenza ziyasebenza futhi zilunge ngesikhathi sonke. Ikhono lokubeka izinto ezibalulekile ngapambili, ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwesigulu ngokuya emigomweni. Ukuba nakho ukuhlela futhi ulungelelanise umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabasekeli ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa kwesigulu okulungele. Ukubamba iqhaza ekuthuthukiseni izisebenzi nakwenqubo yokuphatha ukusebenza. Ukubika izenzakalo ezibucayi ngokuphephakwa kwesiguli, izinselelo nobungcola ngaphakathi kweyunithi. Ukusebenza ngempumelelo, ngokubambisana ngobuhle nabantu abahlukene ngengqondo,amasiko, izinhlanga noma izinkolo ezahlukene. Ukuthobela imigomo yeBatho - Pele kanye noMthetho Wezamalungelo Abaguli.

af.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 (PN-B1): Occupational Health
af.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 in Occupational Health gesoek vir Witbank Hospital in Mpumalanga, met vereiste van SANC-registrasie en 'n na-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12-kwalifikasie of ekwivalent plus Basiskwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC volgens Goewermentskennisgewing R425 (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige en Vrouetehulp (2026) toelaat, 'n na-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie, met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar, geakkrediteer by die SANC volgens Goewermentskennisgewing R212 in die spesialiteit Beroepsgesondheid-verpleegwetenskap. Minimum van vier (4) jaar gepaste/herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioriteer. Leierskap en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Goeie toesighoudende en onderrigvaardighede.
af.duties: Verskaffing van optimale, holistiese gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg binne vasgestelde standaarde en 'n professionele/regtelike raamwerk. Verskaf omvattende gesondheidsorgdienste in die Beroepsgesondheid-eenheid. Verseker effektiewe en doeltreffende bestuur van hulpbronne. Verskaf gehalte pasiëntsorg en volg norme en standaarde. Neem deel aan gehalteverbeteringsprogramme. Hou toesig oor en implementeer pasiëntsorgstandaarde. Implementeer en beoefen verpleegsorg ooreenkomstig die statutêre wette wat die verpleegberoep, arbeid en gesondheidsorg regeer. Bou konstruktiewe werkverhoudinge met verpleegkundiges en ander belanghebbendes. Verseker nakoming van Infeksievoorkoming en Beheer-beleide. Verseker dat toerusting te alle tye funksioneel en gereed is. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Neem deel aan personeelontwikkeling en prestasiebestuur. Rapporteer pasiëntveiligheidsvoorvalle, uitdagings en tekortkominge binne die eenheid. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vriendelik saam met mense van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienste verskille. Verseker voldoening aan Batho - Pele-beginsels en die Handves vir Pasiënteregte.

zu.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 (PN-B1): Occupational Health
zu.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 ko-Occupational Health Bedford ifuna i-Witbank Hospital e-Mpumalanga, kudingwa ukubhalwa kwi-SANC nesifundo sobudedobele sokunaka iziguli.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 qualification noma okulinganayo kanye nesifundo esisisekelo esamukelekwe yi-SANC ngokukaGovernment Notice R425 (okungukuthi iDiploma / iDegree kwi-General Nursing) noma isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalwa kwi-SANC njengoProfessional Nurse and Midwifery (2026), isifundo sokunaka abagule ngemva kwesikhathi esiyisisekelo, esithatha isikhathi esingangenani unyaka owodwa, esamukelekwe yi-SANC ngokukaGovernment Notice R212 ukuba ukhethe i-Occupational Health Nursing Science. Ubudala obungangenani iminyaka emi (4) yeminyaka yokusebenza okufanele/okuqashelwa kokunaka iziguli ngemva kokubhalwa njengoProfessional Nurse kwi-SANC. Ukuthwala ukusebenza nokuzibophezela. Amakhono obuholo nobuhlobo obuhle nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono okuthatha izinqumo. Amakhono obuhlakanipha obuhle bokuphatha nokuqugqela.
zu.duties: Nikela ngokunakekelwa kwabagule okusabalalisiwe okuphelele, okunokusondezwa ngokukhethekile nemikhuba emisiwe nangaphakathi kwesakhiwo esesisemthethweni/sobuchwepheshe. Nikela ngamasevisi ezenhlatho ezihlangabezayo njalo eziphelele kwi-Occupational Health Unit. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kwemithombo ngokusebenza kahle nangomphumela omuhle. Nikela ngokunakekelwa kwesiguli obuwumo oluhle, landela imigango nemizinga. Hlanganyela kuhlelo oluthuthukisa izinga. Qondisa futhi usebenzise imizinga yokunakekelwa kwesiguli. Sebenzisa futhi usebenzise izenzo zokunakekelwa kwesiguli ngokuhambisana nomthetho ohlola inqubo yokunaka iziguli, abasebenzi kanye nenhlekelele yezempilo. Zindlela ezinhle zokusebenza nabasebenzi bezokunaka kanye namanye abahlanganyeli. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonzeke imithetho yokuvikela ukutheleleka kanye nokulawula. Qinisekisa ukuthi izinto zokusebenza ziyasebenza futhi zilungele wonke isikhathi. Ukukwazi ukuhlela futhi ulungiselele umsebenzi wakho kanye nalowo basebenza ngokwesekela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukunakekelwa okuhle kwesiguli. Hlanganyela ekuthuthukiseni abasebenzi kanye nokulawula ukusebenza kahle. Bika izehlakalo ezingabekho khululekile kuthintekela kwesiguli, izinselelo futhi kubungako obungekhona ekusebenzeni. Sebenza kahle, ngokubambisana ngokwamano nomuntu ohlukaniswe ngezinga lokuhlakanipha, ngesiko, ngobuhlanga nangenkolo. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhanjwa ngemigango yeBatho - Pele kanye nesitifiketi samalungelo esiguli.

xh.title: Umhlengi wePhakamileyo weQondo 1 (PN-B1): iMpilo yabasebenzi
xh.summary: Kufunwa umhlengi oPhakamileyo weQondo 1 kwizoMpilo zabasebenzi eWitbank Hospital eMpumalanga, kufuneka abhaliswe kwiSANC abe nesidanga sokuhlengahlengisa esingemva kwesidanga.
xh.requirements: Iqondo lesiXhosa esiphakamileyo / Isatifikethi seQondo lesiXhosa 12 okanye esilinganayo negqithiswa ngesatifikethi esiphakathi somqondiso kaRhument R425 esikwaziwa yiSANC (okt. Isidanga / Isidanga kwakhoRhulumente ohlengahlengisiweyo) okanye isidingo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomhlengi oPhakamileyo weMfundo kaMzimba (2026), isatifikethi sokuhlengahlengisa esingemva kwesidanga, esithatha ubuncinane unyaka omnye, esikwaziwa yiSANC ngokomqondiso kaRhument R212 kwizifundo eziyiyo ezoMpilo babasebenzi bahlehlengi. Ubuncinane kwiminyaka emine (4) ehambelanayo /emoyikwayo isipili sokuhlengahlengisa emva kokubhaliswa njengomhlengi wePhakamileyo kwiSANC. Ukuba nakho ukusebenza ngokwakho nokuqwalasela umsebenzi. Amabali abe ngumphathi kunye namakhono abantu, ukusombulula iingxaki kunye namakhono okuthatha izigqibo. Amakhono abe ngumphathi omdala nokuba nguthotela.
xh.duties: Ukunikela ngamakhathalo ohlengahlengisiweyo, abhekisa kuye ngaphandle athundwe ngemilinganiselo emiselweyo kunye nolwandalo olusemthethweni olwemfundo. Ukunikela iinkonzo ezibanzi zempilo kwUlawulo lwezoMpilo babasebenzi. Qinisekisa ulawulo olusebenzayo kunye nolulingayo lwamathuluzi. Nikela ngamakhathalo abangumgangatho kumaguli, landela imigaqo kunye nemilinganiselo. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yokuphucula umgangatho. Lawula kwakhona nokuzeke imilinganiselo yokhathalelo lomaguli. Zalisa kwakhona usizeke ngamakhathalo empilo ohlengahlengisiweyo ngokwemithetho esebenza ohlebeni lwemfundo yabahlengi, uluntu kunye namakhathalo empilo. Zalisa ubudlelwane obusebenzayo obulungileyo nabahlengi nakwabanye abantu abanenxaxheba. Qinisekisa ukuzaliseka kweenkqubo zoLawulo loThintelo nokuQwalasela Iifo. Qinisekisa ukuba amathuluzi asebenza kwaye alungile ngalo lonke ixesha. Makakwazi ukuqamba rhoqo nokuqwalasela umsebenzi wakho nolwabalulekileyo abasekelayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalelo olufanelekileyo oluhlengahlengisiweyo. Thatha inxaxheba kuphuhliso abasebenzi nakulawulo inkqubo yemveliso. Mika ngemizinga yokhuseleko komaguli, iingxaki kunye noku kokusilelayo ngaphakathi kulawulo. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokusebenzisana ngokwamathemba nabantu abohlukeneyo ngokwezingqondo, basendulo, besini okanye bekholo. Qinisekisa ukuzinikela kwemigaqo yeBatho - Pele kunye noMtsetfo weMaliwe woMaguli.

jobs.title: Radiographer Grade 1
jobs.summary: Grade 1 Radiographer sought for Witbank Hospital to perform diagnostic imaging, ensure patient care, and maintain radiation protection standards.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus an appropriate qualification that allows for the required registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in the relevant profession (where applicable) (2026). Grade 1: SA Qualified employees: None after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession (where applicable) in respect of employees who performed Community Service, as required in SA. Foreign Qualified employees: One (1) year relevant experience after registration with the HPCSA in the relevant profession (where applicable) in respect of employees of whom it is not required to perform Community Service, as required in SA. Hospital experience and extensive knowledge in Occupational Health and Safety will be an added advantage. Good interpersonal Skills, written, verbal and presentation Skills. Accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to work under pressure. Ability and willingness to travel. Good interpersonal relationship, Leadership skill. Valid drivers’ licence.
jobs.duties: Ensure patient care during imaging for optimal diagnostic purpose: Explain procedures to patients, prepare patient for imaging, Assist and position patient for imaging, perform imaging. Practice radiation protection to minimize radiation dose to staff, patients and general public: Establish LMC status of female patients, adhere to radiation safety standards (secure area, lead aprons etc), Apply correct radiation/exposure factors (correct dosages), Exercise clinical responsibility to ensure optimal diagnostic imaging: Interpret clinical history of patients to determine the correct procedure, ensure correct positioning of patient to minimize radiation exposure to the patient, ensure correct identification of patient image (name, lead markers etc.). Participate in Education and training programs for continuous professional development and quality service delivery: Practical training and evaluation of students Implement quality assurance programs for quality service delivery, Check/test radiation equipment and report faults, apply reject analysis, Adhere to policies and protocols.

af.title: Radiograaf Graad 1
af.summary: Grade 1 Radiograaf gesoek vir Witbank Hospital om diagnostiese beelding uit te voer, pasiëntsorg te verseker, en stralingsbeskermingsstandaarde te handhaaf.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus 'n toepaslike kwalifikasie wat die vereiste registrasie by die Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) in die tersaaklike professie (waar van toepassing) moontlik maak (2026). Grade 1: SA gekwalifiseerde werknemers: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA in die tersaaklike professie (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van werknemers wat Gemeenskapsdiens gedoen het, soos in SA vereis nie. Buitelandse gekwalifiseerde werknemers: Een (1) jaar tersaaklike ervaring na registrasie by die HPCSA in die tersaaklike professie (waar van toepassing) ten opsigte van werknemers vir wie dit nie vereis word om Gemeenskapsdiens te doen nie, soos in SA vereis. Hospitaalervaring en uitgebreide kennis van Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees. Goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, skriftelike, mondelinge en aanbiedingsvaardighede. Akkuraatheid en aandag tot besonderhede. Vermoë om onder druk te werk. Vermoë en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Goeie interpersoonlike verhoudinge, leierskapsvaardigheid. Geldige bestuurderslisensie.
af.duties: Verseker pasiëntsorg tydens beelding vir optimale diagnostiese doeleindes: Verduidelik prosedures aan pasiënte, berei pasiënt voor vir beelding, Bied hulp aan en posisioneer pasiënt vir beelding, voer beelding uit. Pas stralingsbeskerming toe om stralingsdosis aan personeel, pasiënte en die algemene publiek te verminder: Bepaal LMC-status van vroulike pasiënte, hou by stralingsveiligheidsstandaarde (versekerde area, loodvoorskote ens), Pas korrekte stralings/blootstellingsfaktore toe (korrekte dosisse), Oefen kliniese verantwoordelikheid uit om optimale diagnostiese beelding te verseker: Interpreteer kliniese geskiedenis van pasiënte om die korrekte prosedure te bepaal, verseker korrekte posisionering van pasiënt om stralingsblootstelling aan die pasiënt te verminder, verseker korrekte identifikasie van pasiëntbeeld (naam, loodmerkers ens.). Neem deel aan opvoedings- en opleidingsprogramme vir deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling en gehalte dienslewering: Praktiese opleiding en evaluering van studente. Implementeer gehaltesekerheidsprogramme vir gehalte dienslewering, Kontroleer/toets stralingstoerusting en rapporteer foute, pas verwerpsingsanalise toe, hou by beleide en protokolle.

zu.title: Ithilikhasi le-Grade 1 Radiographer
zu.summary: Ithilikhasi le-Grade 1 Radiographer seliadingwa eWitbank Hospital ukuba lenze izithombe zokuxilonga, liqinisekise ukunakekelwa kwesiguli, futhi ligcine izindinganiso zokuvikela imisebe.
zu.requirements: Ithifikethi Eziphakeme / Ithilikhasi le-Grade 12 kanye nokuqeqeshwa okufanele okuvumela ukubhaliswa okudingekayo ne-Khomishani Yabachwepheshe Bempilo YaseNingizimu Afrika (HPCSA) esigabeni esihambisanayo (lapho kusebenza khona) (2026). I-Grade 1: Abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe eSA: Akukho okudingekayo ngemva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA esigabeni esihambisanayo (lapho kusebenza khona) ngabasebenzi abenze Inkonzo Yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eSA. Abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwamanye amazwe: Unyaka owodwa (1) wamava ahambisanayo ngemva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA esigabeni esihambisanayo (lapho kusebenza khona) ngabasebenzi abadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzo Yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eSA. Abasebenzi abaqeqeshiwe kwamanye amazwe: Unyaka owodwa (1) wamava ahambisanayo ngemva kokubhaliswa ne-HPCSA esigabeni esihambisanayo (lapho kusebenza khona) ngabasebenzi abadingeki ukuba benze Inkonzo Yomphakathi, njengoba kudingeka eSA. Iphuzu elihle emasekhinitsha nokwazi kakhulu ngezenzo Zokuphepha Nokuphila emsebenzini kuzoba yinto egeza amanzi. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, okubhala, okukhuluma nokubonisa. Ukunemba kunomthelela kuminingwane. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwezinga eliphezulu. Ikhono nesifiso sokuhamba. Ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, ikhono lobuholi. Ilayisensi yokushayela ethi ngempela yasezandleni.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwesiguli ngesikhathi kwenziwa izithombe ngenjongo efanele yokuxilonga: Chaza izinqubo kubaguli, lulungele isiguli sokwenziwa izithombe, Siza futhi ubeke kahle isiguli sokwenziwa izithombe, yenze izithombe. Zibeke emingweni yokusikeka kwemisebe ukuze kuncishiswe inani lemisebe kubasebenzi, iziguli nomphakathi jikelele: Hlola isimo se-LMC kubaguli besifazane, landela izindinganiso zokuphepha kwemisebe (indawo evikelekile, iziaproni zelethi njl), Faka izinto ezifanele zokusetshenziswa kwemisebe/okudingekayo (amadosi afanele), Zibeke emingweni wobuchwepheshe bokuxilonga ukuze kuqiniseke ukwenziwa izithombe ezifanele: Humusha umlando wezokwelapha wesiguli ukuze kuthathwe isinqumo esifanele senqubo, qinisekisa ubeko olufanele besiguli ukuze kuncishiswe ukubhekwa kwemisebe isiguli, qinisekisa ukubonwa kahle kwegama lesiguli (igama, izinkomba zelethi njl.). Bamba iqhaza ohlelweni lzemfundo nokuqeqesha ngohlelo lokuthuthukisa ngobungcweti ngokuqhubekayo nokuhanuliswa kwesevisi enkwalitini: Ukuqeqeshwa okusebenzayo nokuhlola izingane eziqeqeshiwe Hlela izinhlelo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi ukuze kuhambisane nesevisi enkwalitini, Hlola/ihlolve izibuciko zemisebe bese ubika amaphutha, faka ukuhlaziya okwenziwa kabusha, Landela izinqubomgomo nezinqubo.

xh.title: I-Radiographer inqanaba 1
xh.summary: Kufuneka i-Grade 1 Radiographer kwi-Witbank Hospital ukwenza izithombe zokuxilongwa, ukuqinisekisa ukhathalo lwesiguli, nokugcina amanqanaba okhuseleko lokushisa.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 kunye nefanelekileyo nelifuna ukubhalisa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) kulwaphulo-mthetho oluhambelanayo (apho kusebenza khona) (2026). I-Grade 1: Abasebenzi abazalwe ekuphumeleleni e-SA: Akukho nento emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kulwaphulo-mthetho oluhambelanayo (apho kusebenza khona) ngokubhekisele kubasebenzi abayenze iNkonzo yoBuntu, njengoko kufunekayo e-SA. Abasebenzi abaphumelele ngaphandle: Eyodwa (1) yeminyaka yamava ahambelanayo emva kokubhalisa kwi-HPCSA kulwaphulo-mthetho oluhambelanayo (apho kusebenza khona) ngokubhekisele kubasebenzi abangafunekiyo ukuba benze iNkonzo yoBuntu, njengoko kufunekayo e-SA. Amaxesha esibhedlele namabhala amaninzi kwi-Occupational Health and Safety aya kuba lusizo olongezelelweyo. Amabhalo amahle abantu, okubhaliweyo, okuthethwayo nokubonisa. Uchukuchu nokunaka iinkcukacha. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphantsi koxinzelelo. Ikhono nesimilo sokuhamba. Ubudlelwane obuhle obuwohloko, isakhono sobuqu. Ilayisenisi yomqeshi esebenzayo.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukhathalo lwesiguli ngelixa kusenziwa izithombe ngenjongo yokuxilonga ngokugqibeleleyo: Chaza iinkqubo kusiguli, lungiselela isiguli sokwenza izithombe, Nceda uze ulungise isiguli sokwenza izithombe, yenza izithombe. Zithobe ekwenzeni ukhuseleko lokushisa ukunciphisa inani lokushisa kubasebenzi, iziguli nakuhlala jikelele: Misela isimo se-LMC samasiguli abesifazana, landela amanqanaba okhuseleko lokushisa (indawo ekhuselekileyo, izikhwezelo ze-lead njl), Faka izinto ezifanelekileyo zokushisa/okuthayithe (i-dosages ezifanelekileyo), Zibophezele kwimithetho yamagqabantshishi ukuqinisekisa izithombe zokuxilonga ezilungileyo: Tolika imbali yamagqabantshishi yesiguli ukuze umisise inkqubo elungileyo, qinisekisa ukulungiswa okulungileyo kwesiguli ukunciphisa ukutshatyalaliswa kokushisa kwesiguli, qinisekisa ukuqondwa okulungileyo kwesithombe sesiguli (igama, izalathisi ze-lead njl.). Thatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo zemfundo nokuqeqesha ngenjongo yophuhliso lwangaphakathi obungwele ubuchwephesha nokunikezela inkonzo yemvela: Ukuqeqesha ngokubonisana nokuhlolwa kwabafundi Zisebenzisa iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa ikhwalithi ngenjongo yokunikezela inkonzo yemvela, Khangela/hlola izixhobo zokushisa uze uxele ngemiba, sebenzisa uhlalutyo lokwala, Zibophezele kumigqo nakuqondo-mthetho.

jobs.title: Environmental Health Practioner Grade 1: Malaria
jobs.summary: Environmental Health Practitioner Grade 1 needed to coordinate malaria programme field teams in disease surveillance, vector control and case management at Mbombela.
jobs.requirements: An appropriate National Diploma in Environmental Health / Public Health or equivalent qualification that allows registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as an Independent Environmental Health Practitioner (2026). Current registration with the HPCSA as an Independent Environmental Health Practitioner. A valid driver's licence. Computer literacy. Good verbal and written communication skills. Sound knowledge of communicable disease control, environmental health legislation and public health programmes. Ability to supervise and coordinate field teams, work independently and under pressure, and travel extensively within the province. Experience in malaria control, disease surveillance, outbreak response, vector control, entomology or health promotion will be an added advantage.

Huidige registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Onafhanklike Omgewingsgesondheidspraktisyn. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie. Rekenaarvaardigheid. Goede mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede. Deeglike kennis van oordraagbare siektebeheer, omgewingsgesondheidswetgewing en volksgesondheidsprogramme. Vermoë om veldspanne te bestuur en te koördineer, onafhanklik en onder druk te werk, en wyd binne die provinsie te reis. Ervaring in malariabeheer, siektesurveillance, uitbraakreaksie, vektorbeheer, entomologie of gesondheidsbevordering sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Koördineer en bestuur malaria-programveldspanne wat verantwoordelik is vir siektesurveillance, vektorbeheer, entomologiese surveillance, asook malaria-gevalbestuur en gesondheidsbevorderingsaktiwiteite. Beplan, implementeer, monitor en evalueer malaria-uitroeingsintervensies in ooreenstemming met Nasionale en Provinciale beleid, riglyne en operasionele planne. Koördineer en bestuur binnenshuise residuele spuitbewerings (IRS), insluitend beplanning, implementering, gehalteversekering en verslagdoening. Koördineer malaria-siektesurveillance-aktiwiteite, insluitend gevalkennisgewing, gevalondersoek, gevalklassifikasie, reaktiewe gevalopsporing, fokusondersoek en uitbraakreaksie. Neem deel aan gemeenskapsgebaseerde malaria-sifting, toetsing en behandelingsaktiwiteite in ooreenstemming met goedgekeurde malaria-gevalbestuursriglyne en staande operasionele prosedures. Ondersteun aktiewe gevalopsporing, huishoudingsifting en opvolg van malaria-gevalle om plaaslike oordrag te beëindig. Koördineer entomologiese surveillance-aktiwiteite, insluitend vektormonitering, muskietversamelings, insekdoderweerstandsurveillance en omgewingsassesserings. Koördineer en implementeer malaria-gesondheidsbevordering, gemeenskapsmobilisering en gedragsveranderingskommunikasie-aktiwiteite. Bestuur malaria-programpersoneel, monitor prestasie en verskaf tegniese leiding en mentorskap. Koördineer inkopingsbeplanning, voorraadbestuur en verspreiding van malaria-programverbruiksgoedere. Verseker behoorlike batebestuur, voorraadbeheer en instandhouding van programtoerusting. Monitor programprestasie deur roetine-data-insameling, datakwaliteitversekering, ontleding en verslagdoening met behulp van goedgekeurde malaria-inligtingstelsels. Voer enige ander pligte uit wat deur die toesighouer gedelegeer word.

zu.title: Umsebenzi weZempilo Yamandla Wezinga 1: Isimalariya
zu.summary: Kudingeka Umsebenzi weZempilo Yamandla Wezinga 1 ongcono ohlela amaqembu omsebenzi wesimiso sesimalariya ekugadeni izifo, ekulawulen izithwala ezibashekisa phansi kanye nokuphathwa kwezimo zeziguli eMbombela.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yezizwe yeZempilo Yamandla / yeZempilo Yokomphakathi noma iziqu ezingulinganayo ezivumela ukubhalisa kuHlelo LamaGosa eZezempilo eNingizimu Afrika (HPCSA) njengoGosa Ozingela Izempilo Yamandla (2026). Ukubhalisa kwamanje kuHPCSA njengoGosa Ozingela Izempilo Yamandla. Ilayisense yokushayela okusemthethweni. Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amandla okuxhumana kahle ngomlomo nangokubhala. Ukuqonda okuhle ngokulawula izifo ezelanisayo, umthetho wezempilo yamandla kanye namaprogramu wezempilo yokomphakathi. Ikhono lokuhlola nokuhlela amaqembu omsebenzi wangasese, ukusebenza ngokuzimela nakunqweni, kanye nokuhamba kakhulu ngaphakathi kwesifundazwe. Ukwazi ukusebenza ekulawulen isimalariya, ekugadeni izifo, ekuphenduleni ukuphahluka kwezifo, ekulawulen izithwala, kulezo eziphila ezinyakazisayo ekule noma ekukhuthazen izempilo kuzoba yinzuzo evediwe.
zu.duties: Hlela futhi uholele amaqembu omsebenzi wesimiso sesimalariya anebizinso ekugadeni izifo, ekulawulen izithwala, ekugadeni i-entomology, kanye nokuphathwa kwezimo zesimalariya nasezinhlelweni zokukhuthaza izempilo. Cweta, phuma, gqamisa futhi hlola imizamo yokugxothwa k wesimalariya ngokuhambisana namapholisi weZwe neSifundazwe, iziqondiso namapulani okusebenza. Hlela futhi uholele imisebenzi yokufukula phakathi kwamakhaya (IRS), okuhlanganisa ukucweta, ukuphuma, futhi.qinisekisa ikhwalithi nokubika. Hlela imisebenzi yokugada isimalariya, okuhlanganisa ukwazisa izimo, ukuphenya izimo, ukuhlukanisa izimo, ukutholakala kwezimo eziphendulayo, ukuphenya imithombo nokuphendula ukuphahluka. Thatha inxaxheba kumasebe okuhlola, ukuhlolwa nokwelashwa kwesimalariya esiphakamini kwomphakathi ngokuhambisana nezinqondiso ezamukelekwe zokuphathwa kwezimo zesimalariya kanye namaphethini okusebenza azele. Sekela ukutholakala kwezimo eziyikhodi, ukuhlolwa kwamakhaya kanye nokulandelwa kwezimo zesimalariya ukwenqaba ukudluliselwa kwendawo. Hlela imisebenzi yokugada i-entomology, okuhlanganisa ukulawula izithwala, ukuqoqa izimpukane, ukugada ukumelana namachitha kanye nokuhlola imvelo. Hlela futhi phuma imisebenzi yokukhuthaza izempilo ngesimalariya, ukuhlanganisa umphakathi kanye nemisebenzi yokushintsha ngokuziphatha. Hlola abantu baprogramu yesimalariya, gqamisa ukusebenza futhi nikeza isiqondiso esitheknishi kanye nokweseka. Hlela ukucweta ukuthenga, ukuphatha isitoko kanye nokwahlulelana kwezinto zeprogramu yesimalariya. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa okuhle kwezimpahla, ukulawula izinto ezibhalwe ngazo kanye nokugcina izimoto zeprogramu. Gqamisa ukusebenza kweprogramu ngokuqoqwa kwemininingwane yansuku zonke, ukuqinisekisa ikhwalithi yemininingwane, ukuhlaziya nokubiza kusetshenziswa amasistimu aqinisekisiwe omininingwane wesimalariya. Thatha inxaxheba ekucweten ukusebenza, ukucweta okuncane, ukugadanya nokuhlola, ucwaningo lokusebenza kanye nemizamo eqhubekayo yokuphucula ikhwalithi. Yenza namanye eminye imisebenzi ekunikezwe yilowo osekelayo.

xh.title: iPraktishani yeZempo YezeLuntu inqanaba 1: Ithambama
xh.summary: Kufuneka iPraktishani yeZempo YezeLuntu inqanaba 1 ukuze iqondanise amaqela abasebenzi abasesiteshinenohlelo lokulwa nethambama ekuqapheni izifo, ekulawuleni izinambuzane nasekulawuleni iimeko eMbombela.
xh.requirements: I-Diploma yaseLizwe esebenzayo kwiZempoYezoLuntu / iZempiloYoluntu okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiKhomishini yezeMisebenzi yeMpilo yaseMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengakoPraktishani weZempo YezeLuntu oZimeleyo (2026). Ukubhaliswa kwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengakoPraktishani weZempo YezeLuntu oZimeleyo. Ilayisensi yokushayela esebenzayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amabalawuni abalawuni abuchwepheshe bokuthetha nokubhala. Ulwazi oluzinzileyo malunga nokulawula izifo ezingatshintshiswa kwinani elingathintelwa, umthetho wezempo yoluntu kunye nezinkqubo zempilo yoluntu. Ikhalipa lokulawula nokuqondanisa amaqela abasebenzi abasesiteshini, ukusebenza uzimele kwaye ngaphantsi kwengcinezelo, kunye nokuhamba kakhulu ngaphakathi kwephondo. Iminyaka yokusebenza ekulawulenithambama, ekuqapheni izifo, ekuPhenduleeni iikhresi, ekulawuleni izinambuzane, kwizibongozo-nambuzane okanye eku khuthazeni impilo iya kuba luncedvo olongezelelweyo.
xh.duties: Qondanisa kwaye ulawule amaqela abasebenzi abasesiteshweni ohlelo lokulwa nethambama elibhekise kokuqapha izifo, ukulawula izinambuzane, ukuqapha izinambuzane ngendlela yezesayensi, ukulawula iimeko zeethambama, nemisebenzi yokukhuthaza impilo. Cwangcisa, ukhokele, ulawule kwaye ulinganise iintshukumo zokucima ithambama ngokwemigaqo yaseLizwe nakwiPhondo, iindlela ezichazileyo kunye neecwangciso zokusebenza. Qondanisa kwaye ulawule iintshukumo zokutshiza ngaphakathi kwezindlu (IRS), kuquka ucwangciso, ukuyiphatha, ukuqinisekisa umgangatho nokubika. Qondanisa imisebenzi yokugcina ilwazi ngeethambama njengesifo, kuquka ukwazisa iimeko, ukuphonononga iimeko, ukucwangcisa iimeko, ukufumana iimeko ngokuPhendula, ukuphonononga iindawo ezithile nokuphendula iikhresi. Thatha inxaxheba kwimisebenzi yokukhangelo kwithambama entsimeni, ukuhlolwa nokunyanga ngokwemigaqo egunyazisiweyo yolawulo lwamagxa athambama kunye neendlela ezimiyo zokusebenza. Xhasa ukufumanisa amagxa ngokuzimela, ukuqhatha amakhaya nokulandelela iimeko zeethambama ukuze kuyekeyo ukusasela kwendawo. Qondanisa imisebenzi yokugcina ilwazi ngezinambuzane ngendlela yezesayensi, kuquka ukuqapha izinambuzane, ukuqokelela amanambuzane, ukuqapha ukuchasa izitshibo kunye nokuhlolwa kwendalo. Qondanisa kwaye ukhokele imisebenzi yokukhuthaza impilo ngamathambama, ukuhlanganisa uluntu nokuqhuba inkqubo yokutshintsha indlela yokuziphatha. Lawule basebenzi behlelo lokulwa nethambama, qapha ukusebenza kwabo kwaye ubanike isikhokelo esasetyhini kunye nenkathalo. Qondanisa ucwangciso lokuthenga, ulawulo lwesitokhwe kunye nokusasaza izinto zohlelo lokulwa nethambama. Qinisekisa ukulawula izinto, ukulawula uluhlu lokubhaliswa kunye nokugcina izixhobo zohlelo. Qapha ukusebenza kohlelo ngokuthuthuza iindatha rhoqo, ukuqinisekisa umgangatho weendatha, ukuhlalutya nokubika usebenzisa iinkqubo eziginyiweyo zolwazi ngeethambama. Thatha inxaxheba kwicwangciso lokusebenza, ucwangciso oluncinci, ukulawula noku linganisa, uphononongo lokusebenza, kunye neentshukumo zokuphucula umgangatho ngokuqhubekayo. Yenza nayiphi na enye imisebenzi efunwa ngumlawuli.

zu.title: Umpraktisela WezoMpilo Bendawo Izinga 1: I-Malaria
zu.summary: Kudingeka umpraktisela wezoMpilo Bendawo eBushbuckridge ukuze ahlele futhi aqondise amaqembu asebenza ensimini ohlelweni lwemalaria abheke ekugcineni amaphuphu, ukulawula izithwanyana kanye nokuphathwa kwesiguli.
zu.requirements: I-Diploma yesizwe ebambekayo kwezoMpilo Bendawo / Impilo Yamaphakathi noma isifundo esingalinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengompraktisela wezoMpilo Bendawo ozimele (2026). Ukubhaliswa okwamanje ne-HPCSA njengompraktisela wezoMpilo Bendawo ozimele. Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala. Ukwazi kokuqinisekilwa ukulawula izifo ezingathathelani, umthetho wezoMpilo Bendawo kanye namaphulo impilo yomphakathi. Ukuba nakhono ukuqondisa nahlela amaqembu asebenza ngaphandle, ukusebenza ngokuzimele futhi ngaphansi koxinzelelo, futhi uhambe kabanzi esifundzeni. Ngemfundo yokulawula i-malaria, ukulawula izifo, ukusabela ekubhebhethekeni, ukulawula izinambuzane, i-entomology noma ukukhuthaza impilo kuyothswuzwa yinhlokoyela.
zu.duties: Hlela futhi qondise amaqembu asebenza ensimini ohlelweni lwemalaria abhekene nokugcina amaphuphu amagula, ukulawula izithwanyana, ukugcina amaphuphu ezinambuzane, kanye nokuphathwa kwamaphuphu malaria nemicimbi yokukhuthaza impilo yomphakathi. Cwangcisa, phumeza, ulule futhi uhlulele izinyathelo zokubhebhethekisa imalaria ngokuvumelana nemigango, izindlela zokusebenza namapuleini asebenzayo eZwelonke naseNtshonalanga KwaZulu. Hlela futhi qondise imisebenzi yokufutha phakathi kwakho ngenani elifana (IRS), okuhlanganisa ucwaningo, ukuphumeza, ukuqinisekisa izinga lokusebenza kanye nokubika. Hlela imisebenzi yokugcina amaphuphu ayesiguli somalaria, okuhlanganisa ukwazisa amaphuphu, ukuphenya, ukuhlukanisa, ukuthola ngokubhebhetheka, ukuphenya izinto ezingaba yisimo kanye nokusabela ekuphahleni. Thatha inxaxheba emicimbini yokuhlola, ukuhlola kanye nokwelapha i-malaria esigungwini ngokuvumelana nemigango evunyelwe yokuphathwa kwesigunjwane somalaria nendlela ezimiwe zokusebenza. Sekela ukuthola amaphuphu, ukuhlola amakhaya kanye nokuqhuba amaphuphu bese kuvinjelwa isidlaliso sendawo. Hlela imisebenzi yokugcina inambuzane, okuhlanganisa ukulawula izithwanyana,okuqoqa amamosquito, ukuhlola ukuzwela kwezitshwalalizwayo kanye nokuqashwa kwemvelo. Hlela futhi phumeza imicimbi yokukhuthaza impilo, ukuhlanganisa umphakathi kanye nokushintsha indlela yokukhuluma kanye nokuziphatha. Qondise abasebenzi bahlelo lwemalaria, ulule ukusebenza futhi unikeze imiqondo yobuchwepheshe kanye nokukhombisa. Hlela ucwaningo lokuthenga, ukulawula izitokhwe nokusatshalaliswa kwemikhiqizo yohlelo lwemalaria. Qinisekisa ukuphathwa kahle kwempahla, ukulawula izinto ezikhona kanye nokugcina izinsimbi zohlelo. Qapha ukusebenza kohlelo ngokuqoqa imininingwane njalo, ukuqinisekisa izinga lweniningwane, ukuhlaziya futhi ubike usebenzisa izinhlelo zemininingwane zamalaria ezivunyelwe. Thatha inxaxheba ekucwaningeni kwezinyathelo zokusebenza, ekucwaningeni okuncane, ekulawuleni ukuhlola, ucwaningo lokusebenza kanye nemigudu yokuthuthukisa izinga ngokuqhubekayo. Yenza noma yimiphi eminye imisebenzi enikwe umqondisi.

xh.title: UmPractitioner weMfundo yeNdalo inqanaba 1: Malaria
xh.summary: Kufuneka iNgcali yoMphilo weNdalo eBushbuckridge ukulungiselela kwaye ilawule amaqela abasebenzi begama ohlelo lwe-malaria abaphethe iindaba zokulandelela iisifo, ulawulo lwezinto ezingcangcazela isifo nolawulo lweemeko.
xh.requirements: iDiploma yesiLizwe ezifanelekileyo kuMphilo weNdalo / uMphilo woLuntu okanye isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhalisa kwiKhungo loBuchwepheshe beMfundo yeMfundo eNingwolwazi eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengokoNgcali eZimeleyo yoMphilo weNdalo (2026). Ukubhalisa okwangoku kwi-HPCSA njengokoNgcali eZimeleyo yoMphilo weNdalo. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esebenzayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha. Amakhono amabalulu okunxibelelana ngokuthetha nokubhala. Ulwazi oluqinileyo ngolawulo lwezifo ezingatshintshiswa phakathi kwabantu, imithetho yomphilo weNdalo nemiqathano yomphilo woluntu. Ikhono lokulawula kwaye ulungiselele amaqela abasebenzi abayinkundla, ukusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nangoxinzelelo, kwaye uhambe kakhulu ngaphakathi kwephondo. Imfundo yolawulo lwe-malaria, ukulandelela iisifo, impendulo eqhawuliweyo kwiqhuma lesifo, ulawulo lwezinto ezingcangcazela isifo, iinzalwane okanye ukuthuthuzela impilo iya kuba ngu tumblebe nila.
xh.duties: Lungiselela kwaye ulawule amaqela abasebenzi begama ohlelo lwe-malaria abaphethe iindaba zokulandelela iisifo, ulawulo lwezinto ezingcangcazela isifo, iindaba zokulandelela ngezinzalwane, nolawulo lweemeko ze-malaria nemisebenzi yokuthuthuzela impilo yabantu. Cwangcisa, phumeza, lulwazi kwaye uhlule ukungenelela kokutshatyalaliswa kwe-malaria ngokwemiqathango, iinkqubo nemiqathango yomsebenzi karhulu yoMphakathi nakuBuso. Lungiselela kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yoQhathazo lokuPhuza iMitha engaphakathi kwiNdlu (IRS), kuquka ucwangciso, ukuphumeza, kwaye uqinisekise umgangatho kwaye uxele. Lungiselela iindaba zokulandelela isifo se-malaria, kuquka isaziso seemeko, uphando ngeemeko, ukwahlukanisa iimeko, ukufumanisa iimeko ezingalindelekanga, uphando kumajelo aphakamileyo nempendulo kwiqhuma lesifo. Thatha inxaxheba kwimisebenzi yokukhangolwa, ukuvavanywa nokunyanga i-malaria esidlangalwini ngokwemiqathango egunyazisiweyo yolawulo lweemeko ze-malaria nemiqathango esemthethweni yokuqhuba. Xhasa ukufumanisa iimeko ngokuthanda, ukukhangolwa kweendlu nokuvela iimeko ze-malaria ukuze kuphule ukusasazwa kwendawo. Lungiselela iindaba zokulandelela ngezinzalwane, kuquka ukulawula izinto ezingcangcazela isifo, ukuqokelela iindziphambano, ukulandelela ukuchasa iintshabalalo nokuqwalasela indawo. Lungiselela kwaye uphumeze imisebenzi yokuthuthuzela impilo malunga ne-malaria, ukuhambisa uluntu nentshukumo yokutshintsha indlela yokuziphatha. Lawule abasebenzi bohlelo lwe-malaria, ululwazi umsebenzi kwaye unike imixholo yolwazi kunye nenkxaso. Lungiselela ucwangciso lokuthenga, ulawulo lwenkcitho yamathanga kunye nokusasazwa kwezinto ezifunekayo ohlelweni lwe-malaria. Qinisekisa ulawulo olulungileyo lwempahla, ulawulo lwesiko nokunyango kwemishini yohlelo. Lilulwazi inkqubo yomsebenzi ngokuthatha iinkcukacha ngamaxesha onke, ukuqinisekisa umgangatho weenkcukacha, ukuhlalutya kwaye uxele kusetyenziswa iinkqubo ezinikiweyo zelwazi nge-malaria. Thatha inxaxheba kulungiselelo lomsebenzi, ucwangciso olucutshunguliweyo, ukulunga nokuqwalasela, uphando lomsebenzi kwaye uqhubela phambili iindaba zokuphucula umgangatho. Yenza nayiphi na enye imisebenzi enikwa ngumlawuli.

At least a minimum of three (3) PERSAL courses is an inherent requirement. Extensive knowledge of PERSAL includes interpreting PERSAL reports. A Good understanding and Functional knowledge of the Public Service Act, Public Service regulations, Basic condition of employment Act, Employment Equity Act, Computer literacy, Good interpersonal skills, Good written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work under pressure. Sound communication and interpersonal skills. Analytical skills on problem solving, decision making and organizational skills. Computer literacy particularly MS, Excel, outlook & Word. A valid driver’s licence will serve as an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Implement and maintain human resource administration practices. Render administrative functions including the following: recruitment and selection of staff. HR provisioning (recruitment and selection, appointments, transfers, verification of qualifications, vetting of candidates, secretarial functions for interviews, absorptions of staff, probationary periods, etc. and also responsible for conditions of service and benefits: leave salaries, leave graduates, pensions, termination of services, procedure on Incapacity leave and ill-health, housing allowance, overtime, translations and writing reports etc.). Coordinate the Performance management system, address human resource administration enquiries to ensure the correct implementation of human resource management practices, inform, guide and advise the staff on human resource administration matters to enhance the correct implementation of human resource administration practices/policies. Assist with preparation of reports on human resource administration issues and statistics. Coordinate the implementation of recruitment and selection process. Provide support to Sub- district Manager.

'n Goeie begrip en funksionele kennis van die Public Service Act, Public Service regulations, Basic condition of employment Act, Employment Equity Act, rekenaarvaardighede, goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, goeie skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede. Rekenaarvaardighede veral MS, Excel, outlook & Word. 'n Geldige bestuurderslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien.
af.duties: Implementeer en handhaaf menslike hulpbron administrasiepraktyke. Verskaf administratiewe funksies insluitend die volgende: werwing en seleksie van personeel. HR voorsiening (werwing en seleksie, aanstellings, oorplasings, verifikasie van kwalifikasies, keuring van kandidate, sekretariële funksies vir onderhoude, opname van personeel, proeftydperke, ens. en ook verantwoordelik vir diensvoorwaardes en voordele: verlofsalarisse, verlofgrade, pensioene, beëindiging van diens, prosedure op ongeskiktheidsverlof en swak gesondheid, behuisingstoelaag, oortyd, vertalings en skryf van verslae ens.). Bystand verleen met die voorbereiding van verslae oor menslike hulpbron administrasiekwessies en statistieke. Koördineer die implementering van die werwing en seleksieproses. Verskaf ondersteuning aan Sub-distriksbestuurder.

zu.title: Principal Personnel Officer
zu.summary: I-Principal Personnel Officer e-Witbank Hospital, idinga i-Grade 12 noma i-diploma ehambisanayo kanye neminyaka emithathu yamava kwe-HR namakilasi e-PERSAL.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 noma okufanayo kanye neminyaka emithathu (3) yohlu lwamava engxenyeni ye-Human Resource noma Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) ku-Human Resource Management, Public Administration / Public Management njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Okungenani amakilasi amathathu (3) e-PERSAL yisidingo esiyisisekelo. Ulwazi olubanzi nge-PERSAL luhlanganisa ukutolika imibiko ye-PERSAL. Ukuqonda okuhle nolwazi olusebenzayo ngoMthetho wezeNkonzo kaZwelonke, imiyalo yezeNkonzo kaZwelonke, uMthetho wezimo eziyisisekelo zokusebenza, uMthetho weVumelwano yoMsebenzi, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha, amakhono ahle abantu ekuxhumaneni, amakhono ahle okubhala nokuKhuluma. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Amakhono ahle okuxhumana nabantu nokuxhumana ngomlomo. Amakhono okuhlaziya izinkinga, ukuthatha izinqumo kanye namakhono ohlelo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhomphyutha ikakhulukazi i-MS, Excel, kanye no-Word. Ilayisensi yokushayela eyavunyiwe izoba yinzuzo.
zu.duties: Phatha futhi zigcine izenzo zolawulo lweminye yabantu. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo ehlanganisa okulandelayo: ukubungaza nokukhetha abasebenzi. Ukwethula kweminye yabantu (ukubungaza nokukhetha, ukubeka emsebenzini, ukudlulisela, ukuqinisekisa izifundo, ukuhlola abafakwa-bhayo, imisebenzi yobunlomeli ekuhlanganisweni kwamava, ukumamukela abasebenzi, izikhathi zokuqeqeshwa, njalonjalo, futhi uphinde ubheke ngezimo zokusebenza nezinzuzo: amaholo ekhipha, iziqu eziyelelwe, imali yokuphumula, ukuphela kwezinsiza, inqubo ye-Incapacity leave nokugula, inkokho yendlu, isikhathi esengeziwe, ukutolika kanye nokubhala imibiko njalonjalo). Hlanganisa isistimu yokuphatha ukusebenza, phendula imibuzo yolawulo lweminye yabantu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphathwa okulungile kwezobulungiswa kweminye yabantu, umemezele, uhola uthsume abasebenzi ngemikhakha yolawulo lweminye yabantu ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphathwa okulungile kwezenzo/inqubo yolawulo lweminye yabantu. Siza ekulungiseni imibiko ngemikhakha yolawulo lweminye yabantu izibalo. Hlanganisa ukuphathwa kwenqubo yokubungaza nokukhetha. Nikeza usizo kuMphathi wesifunda.

xh.title: Principal Personnel Officer
xh.summary: I-Principal Personnel Officer e-Witbank Hospital, ifuna i-Grade 12 okanye i-diploma efanelekileyo kunye neminyaka emithathu yamava kwi-HR kunye ne-PERSAL courses.
xh.requirements: I-pension Committee / i-Grade 12 okanye isiqinisekiso esilinganayo kunye neminyaka elithathu (3) yamava kwicandelo le-Human Resource okanye i-Diploma / u-Masters (NQF Level 6/7) kwilawulo labasebenzi, ulawulo oluqhuba iqela elithile / ulawulo oluqhuba igumbi elithile njengoko kugunyaziswe yi-SAQA. Kufuneka kubekho i-PERSAL course encinci elishumi (3) njengoko kulindelekile. Kufuneka ulwazi oluqinileyo malunga ne-PERSAL, kuquka ukuqonda iingxelo ze-PERSAL. Kufuneka uqonde kakuhle kwaye ulazi inkqubo yaseburhulumenteni, iimiso yaseburhulumenteni, i-Basic condition of employment Act, i-Employment Equity Act, ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha, ukuba nomsebenzi ongcono wokuba nabantu, ukwazi ukubhala kakuhle nokuthetha kakuhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze kubekho iinkqubo ezichanekileyo kulawulo lwabantu abasebenzayo, zifakelwe kwaye ziqhutywe. Kwenziwe imisebenzi yolawulo ehlongophela oku kulandelayo: ubhaliso nokhetho lwabasebenzi. Ukubonelela ngabantu abasebenzayo (ubhaliso nokhetho, iinkqubo zokunikwa amagama, iindlu zokudluliselwa, ukuqinisekisa iimviwo, ukuhlolwa kwabagqatswa, imisebenzi yobhali wekomiti yabaphengululi, ukwamkelwa kwabasebenzi, iimaxesha esixhenxe sokusika inqwelo, njl. Kwaye nakwenzeka ukulawula iimeko zesebenza neenzuzo: amaholo ecxesha lokuphumla, izinzuzo zokuphumla, imibhalo yokuqeshwa kuqala, ukuqwalaselwa kweenkonzo, iinkqubo zokuvalwa kwangaphakathi ngezonyango, indlu, ukuphinda kwenziwe umsebenzi ngaphezulu, amanqanaba omtshato, ukubhalwa kweekhomishani njl.). Ukuqhuba inqubo yolawulo lwesiphithiphithi, kukwenzelwa ukuba kubekho iingxoxo ezichanekileyo malunga nokwenziwa kwayo nayiphi na into efunwayo ngolumba, kwakhokelelwe kwakhona kukunika isalathiso malunga naluphi na usuku olwahlulayo xa kunokwenzeka kusetyenziswa inkqubo entsha.

af.summary: Administratiewe Beampte word by Witbank Hospital benodig om hulpdienste te bestuur, insluitend draers, skakelbord, sekuriteits- en boodskapperdienste.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus drie (3) jaar se ervaring in Hulpdienste of Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Public Administration / Management. Kennis van PFMA, Public Service Act, regulasies en ander voorskrifte. Kennis van kantoorbestuur. Fasiliteer en verskaf algemene kantoorondersteuningsdienste (Draers, Lykhuis, Skakelborddienste, Sekuriteitsdienste en Boodskapperdienste).
