Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana nezilinganiso ezibalulekile kazwelonke namathuluzi okuhlola ahlelekile. Izindaba zokuhlala kungekho emsebenzini nokulawula isikhathi esingeziwe esikhokhelwa. Nikeza izeluleko abaphathi bamaphulendi. Qinisekisa ukuthi amasevisi okuvikela ase endaweni yakhe yomsebenzi umhlaka wonke, futhi igumbi lokulawola lisebenza njalo. Zungeza uqaphe amasevisi okuvikela, ithilomu lokufa, ababe porters, abasebenzi beswitchboard nabathunyi bemiyalezo benza imisebenzi edingekayo futhi bedinga ngesikhathi esibekiwe. Zibhekele ukushayisana noma ukudluliselwa kwamadumbu ezinto ezivela kumanyuvesi ahlukene, ubambisene namawadi nalomphathi wakho. Zibe nosho ekubhekeleni nabulawuleni imali yesabelomali yalezi yuniti. Qinisekisa ukuba khona kwezinyathelo zokonga sebenzisa izinyathelo zolimi uma kunesidingo. Faka amahhovisi amasha bese esebenza ukuze aqoqe futhi abeke iziqu zomsebenzi wobumnini nokuqhuba izinga labasebenzi. Bhala izinkomba ezenziwayo futhi unikeze umbiko ngomphumela. Qhuba izinga lamahhovisi bese uqamba amanye amahhovisi aphathekayo kulo msebenzi. Vakashe imihlangano futhi unikeze umbiko ngemiphumela. Linganisa imisebenzi yezinkundla nabasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho bese ubeka izindingo zemisebenzi ebalulekile futhi ubhekisele ebunzimeni bemisebenzi. Hlola ukuthi yini ephatha imisebenzi yalezi ngaphandle kwezinyathelo zokulawula isabelomali. Yenza imisebenzi yokulawula imali esebenzisa izinkomba namaphuzu wokusebenza emahhovisi nakubasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Zijwayeze nokulawula imisebenzi ehlukile kanye nokulawula imisebenzi yokulawula imisebenzi yokusebenzela izinto ezithile emahhovisi. Beka izidingo zokulawula imali esebenzisa izinkomba namaphuzu wokusebenza emahhovisi nakubasebenzi abangaphansi kwakho. Bazama ukulawula imisebenzi yokubeka izinto ezithile emahhovisi futhi uzame ukulawula imisebenzi yokusebenzela izinto ezithile emahhovisi. , receive and distribute materials and equipment for the units under your control. Manage performance and development of staff. Attend meetings and give feedback.

xh.title: I-Administrative Officer: Iinkonzo Ezinceda
xh.summary: Kufunekwa i-ofisa yomsebenzi wezendlu yoluntu e-Witbank Hospital ukulawula iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezingabantu abathwala abagulayo, abasebenza kwiifestile, abakhusela inkosazo nabaqhuba iinkonzo.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi esiphakamileyo / Igesheyidi 12 kunye neminyaka mithathu (3) yamava kwinkonzo ezinceda kwi-ofisi okanye iDiploma / I-Degree (NQF Level 6/7) kwintengiso yoluntu / ulawulo. Ulwazi malunga PFMA, Public Service Act, iimigqaliselo namanye amagqabantshathi. Ulwazi malunga nokulawula i-ofisi. Ukuba nobulumko lokusebenzisa iikhompyutha okanye isatifikethi esinesiqu ngokusebenzisa iinkqubo zeMicrosoft (Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Intanethi). Kufuneka ube nomthamo wokucinga, ukuqamba, ukulawula, ukuqwalasela nokujongana nomsebenzi boxhaso. Ulwazi malunga ne-OHS nolawulo lweetshidi. Ilayisenisi yokuqhuba esemthethweni iyimfuno. Amakhono amde wokunxibelelwana (ewabhalileyo nokuwothula).
xh.duties:
Phicotha iindlela eziquka iinkonzo ezinceda kwi-ofisi, ezingabantu abathwala abagulayo, abasebenza kwindlu yamakhwela, abajonge iifestile, abalimele amakhob' ukhuseleko, nabaqhuba iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezingowona msebenzi oyintloko.

Vikeleka ukuba kukho iinkonzo zokhuseleko iyure yonke (24/7) kwaye igumbi lokulawulo lihlala lisebenza.

Qinisekisa ukuba abantu abasebenza kwindlu yamakhwela, abathwala abagulayo, abajonge iifestile, nabaqhuba iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo benza imisebenzi ebidingwayo baze bagqibe ngeexesha ezimisiweyo.

jobs.title: Administrative Officer: Patient Administration
jobs.summary: Administrative Officer for patient administration at Witbank Hospital, managing revenue collection, debtor accounts, medical records filing, and outpatient administration.
jobs.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus three (3) years’ experience in Patient Administration or Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) in Public Administration / Public Management as recognized by SAQA. Extensive knowledge of outpatient administration, reception in and help desk functions. Extensive knowledge of PEIS, Billing system and UPFS user guide/procedure book. Knowledge of Revenue policies and understanding of sector financial administration and the provisions of PFMA. Knowledge of relevant prescripts such as Government Gazette. Good communication skill, report writing skills be computer literate and have ability to work under pressure. Be available to work extra hours in a 24-hour shift environment and be part of the hospital’s multidisciplinary committees. A valid driver licence will serve as an added advantage.
jobs.duties: Manage patient admin in 24 hours shift system, manage and sustain internal control for collection of revenue, process debtors account, banking of revenue collected, excising control over the maintenance and application of the filing system for medical records, facilitate proper classification and re-classification of patients, compile management, reports, manage archiving of patient records, evaluation of staff in terms of the performance management system. Prepare on / off duties for staff including ward clerk. Control overtime, stand- by and Sunday/public holiday claims. Control queue Marshall, porter and mortuary services. Handle enquiries relating to patient admin, assist with case management and compile daily, weekly and monthly statistics and reports.

af.title: Administratiewe Beampte: Pasiëntadministrasie
af.summary: Administratiewe beampte vir pasiëntadministrasie by Witbank Hospital, wat bestuur uitoefen oor inkomste-invordering, debiteurrekeninge, argivering van mediese rekords en buitepasiëntadministrasie.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12 plus drie (3) jaar se ervaring in Pasiëntadministrasie of Diploma / Graad (NQF Vlak 6/7) in Openbare Administrasie / Openbare Bestuur soos erken deur SAQA. Uitgebreide kennis van buitepasiëntadministrasie, ontsag en hulptoonbank-funksies. Uitgebreide kennis van PEIS, faktureerstelsel en UPFS-gebruikersgids/prosedureboek. Kennis van Inkomstebeleide en begrip van sektor finansiële administrasie en die bepalings van die PFMA. Kennis van tersaaklike voorskrifte soos die Staatskoerant. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede, verslagskryfvaardighede, wees rekenaargeletterd en die vermoë hê om onder druk te werk. Wees beskikbaar om ekstra ure te werk in 'n 24-uur skofomgewing en deel uit te maak van die hospitaal se multidissiplinêre komitees. 'n Geldige bestuurslisensie sal as 'n bykomende voordeel dien.
af.duties: Bestuur pasiëntadministrasie in 'n 24-uur skofstelsel, bestuur en handhaaf interne beheer vir die invordering van inkomste, verwerk debiteurrekeninge, bank van ingevorderde inkomste, oefen beheer uit oor die instandhouding en toepassing van die argiefstelsel vir mediese rekords, fasiliteer behoorlike klassifikasie en herklassifikasie van pasiënte, stel bestuursverslae op, bestuur argivering van pasiëntrekords, evaluering van personeel in terme van die prestasiebestuurstelsel. Berei diensroosters op/af voor vir personeel insluitend saalklerke. Beheer oortyd, stand-by en Sondag/openbare vakansie-eise. Beheer ry-marskalk, draer en lykhuisdienste. Hanteer navrae rakende pasiëntadministrasie, help met gevallebestuur en stel daaglikse, weeklikse en maandelikse statistieke en verslae op.

zu.title: Mlungisi Wokuphathwa: Ukuphathwa Kwabaguli
zu.summary: Inkundla yoluleke lokuphathwa kwabaguli e-Witbank Hospital, ukuphathwa kwesabelo samaphuzu abaguli, izikhwama zabantu, ukufaka amafayela kwamarekhodi wokwelashwa, kanye nokuphathwa kwabaguli abangenasikhathi.
zu.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / i-Grade 12 kanye neminyaka emithathu (3) yohlaka loluqeqesho kokuphathwa kwabaguli noma i-Diploma / i-Degree (NQF Level 6/7) kokuphathwa kahulumeni / ukuphathwa kwemisebenzi kahulumeni njengoba kuqashwa yi-SAQA. Ulwazi olubanzi ngokuphathwa kwabaguli abangenasikhathi, ukwamukelwa kanye nemisebenzi yesikhashana sokusiza. Ulwazi olubanzi nge-PEIS, isistimu yokubhuka kanye nesiqondisi somsebenzisi se-UPFS/incwadi yezinqubo. Ulwazi ngemigomo yemali engenayo ukuqonda ukuphathwa kwezimali zesigaba kanye nezinkulumo ze-PFMA. Ulwazi ngezibhalo ezihlobene ezifana ne-Government Gazette. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana, amakhono okubhala imibiko ukuba uyazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha kanye nenhlanhla yokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo. Ukuba ukhona ukusebenza amahora amaningi endaweni yamahora angu-24 yokusebenza futhi ube yingxenye yamakomidi ahlobene nezinkalo ezahlukene esibhedlela. Idrayivali yemoto evunyiwe izoba yizinhlebo ezingeziwe.
zu.duties: Phatha ukuphathwa kwabaguli kwisistimu yokusebenza amahora angu-24, phatha futhi gcina izilawulo zangaphakathi ezibuthweni kwemali ebiwayo, qhuba izikhwama zabantwini abamali ebantu abayedwa, faka imali ebiwayo ebhange, lawula ukugcinwa nokusetshenziswa kwesistimu yefayela lamarekhodi wesifo, siza ekuhlelweni okufanele nasekuhlukaniseni kabusha abaguli, hlela imibiko yabaphathi, phatha ukugcinwa kwamarekhodi abaguli, hlolisisa abasebenzi ngokwesistimu yokuqapha ukusebenza. Hlela amashifti abo bayangenayo nasabayaphuma kubasebenzi kuhlanganise nososlili beyaward. Lawula amahora amaningi okusebenza, ukuma ikhishi nokufaka izikhalazo zangaphezu kwesonto / iziholide zomphakathi. Lawula qonda bala bokuqonda ukuthi abantu bayaphuma ngaphi, abathwali besimila namasevisi ebhange lokuqedela imizimba yabafileyo. Phendula imibuzo ehlobene nokuqondiswa kwabaguli, siza nokuqondiswa kwamacasho ukuze ube yisabelo sethemba futhi uhlele izibalo nemibiko yansuku zonke, yamasonto nanyanga zonke.

xh.title: I-Administrative Officer: Patient Administration
xh.summary: I-Administrative Officer yolawulo lwabaguli e-Witbank Hospital, apho ulawula ukuthwetwa kwemali ingenzayo, i-akhawunti zamatyala, ukulayishwa kweekfayili zerekhodi yezokwelapha, nolawulo lwabaguli abangangeni esibhedlele.
xh.requirements: I-Senior Certificate / Grade 12 ngenani leminyaka emithathu (3) yamava kulawulo lwabaguli okanye i-Diploma / Degree (NQF Level 6/7) kwi-Public Administration / Public Management njengokunqatshwa yi-SAQA. Ukuqonda okubanzi ngolawulo lwabaguli abangangeni esibhedlele, ukwamkela abantu kwiziko lenkcitho nokusebenza kwe-desk yoncedo. Ukuqonda okubanzi nge-PEIS, inkqubo yokubila nengqiqo yomsebenzisi we-UPFS / incwadi yeenkqubo. Ulwazi lweenkqubo zemali ingenzayo ukuqonda ngolawulo lwezemali kwicala ngalinye nokuqonda oko kubekwe kwi-PFMA. Ulwazi ngemithetho enxulumeneyo efana no-Government Gazette. Amakhono amabini okunxibelelanisa, amabini okubhala iimbeko kwaye ube namandla okusebenza ngocingo. Ukuba ukhululekile ukusebenza amahora amaninzi kwinkqubo yeshiftha yama-24 hours kwaye ube ngumnyeni kumagatya amaninzi esibhedlele. I-licence yokuqhuba esemthethweni iya kubakho ngowonga ongongezwayo.
xh.duties: Phatha ulawulo lwabaguli kwinkqubo yeshifthi yama-24 hours, phatha kwaye ugcine ulawulo langaphakathi olutshintshayo ngokuthwetwa kwemali ingenayo, qhuba i-akhawunti zamatyala, faka imali ingenayo etywaleni, lawula ukugcinwa nokusetyenziswa kwendlela yokulayisha iifayili zerekhodi yezokwelapha, qxaxa uluntu kulwelulo oluchanekileyo nolutshintsho lwabo, lungisa iimbeko zolawulo, phatha ukugcina iirekhodi zabaguli kwindawo egcinwayo, linganisa abasebenzi ngokomthetho weenqanaba zokusebenza. Lungisa ukungena / ukuphuma kwemisebenzi yabasebenzi kuquka umlohi we-ward. Lawula amahora amaninzi, ukumila namanqaku olundi / mhla lweholide. Lawula i-queue Marshall, abahambeli neenkonzo zesidumbu. Phatha imibuzo enxulumene nolawulo lwabaguli, nceda nolawulo lweziqendu kwaye ulungise iibalo nemibiko yemihla ngemihla, yangaphakathi ngenyanga.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 (PN-A2): met Vroedkunde
af.summary: Professionele verpleegkundige met vroedvroukundige kwalifikasie benodig by Ndindiri Clinic in Mpumalanga om kliniese verpleegsorg te verskaf in ooreenstemming met professionele standaarde en omvang van praktyk.
af.requirements: Senior Sertifikaat / Graad 12-kwalifikasie of gelykwaardig plus Basiskwalifikasie geakkrediteer by die SANC ingevolge Staatskennisgewing R425 (d.w.s. Diploma / Graad in Algemene Verpleging) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat (2026). Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer 'n kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos bepaal deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde. Neem deel aan die implementering van die Nasionale Kernstandaarde en Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Toon doeltreffende kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing waar vereis. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om gehalteverpleegsorg te verseker. Werk doeltreffend, saamwerkend en vriendelik met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rasse- of godsdienstige verskille. In staat om eie werk en dié van ondersteuningspersoneel te beplan en te organiseer om behoorlike verpleegsorg te verseker. Toon besorgdheid vir pasiënte, bevorder en beywer behoorlike behandeling en sorg, insluitend bewustheid en bereidwilligheid om op pasiënte se behoeftes, vereistes en verwagtinge te reageer (Batho-Pele). Bestee effektief die hulpbronne wat aan u eenheid toegewys is.

zu.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 (PN-A2): with Midwifery
zu.summary: Kudingeka ugosi wezokwelapha onamakhono obudlelwane besifazane at Ndindiri Clinic eMpumalanga ukuze anikeze ukunakekelwa kokwelapha ngokuvumelana nezidinganiso zezokwelapha nomkhawulo wokwenza.
zu.requirements: Isitifiketi samabanga aphezulu / Isifundo se Grade 12 noma esilinganayo kanye nesifundo esisisisekelo esemtholashweni kwe SANC ngokuvumelana Nesaziso kahulumeni R425 (okungukuthi I-Diploma / I-Degree eNursing Jikelele) noma isifundo esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwe SANC njengogosi Wezokwelapha (2026). Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokuzimela futhi uhlele imisebenzi. Amandla okuhola kanye namakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo.
zu.duties: Yenza ukwenza ukhetho lwezokwelapha ngokuvumelana nomkhawulo wokwenza nezizinga zokwelapha njengoba kunqunyiwe isikhungo sezempilo. Khuthaza izinga lokunakekelwa kokwelapha njengokuqondiswa umkhawulo wezenzo zezokwelapha kanye nezindinganiso. Thatha inxaxheba ekusebenziseni Izindinganiso Eziyisisekelo Zwenkolo kanye Nohlelo Lokwenziwa Kwezibhedlela Ezingcono. Bonisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo neziguli, abaphathi kanye nalabo abanye abahlinzakile, okuhlanganisa ukubhala imibiko uma kudingeka. Sebenza njengengxenye yethimba elinabantu abahlukene emikhakheni ukuqinisekisa izinga elihle lokunakekelwa kokwelapha. Sebenza ngempumelelo, ngokubambisana kahle nabantu abahlukene ngengqondo, amasiko, izinhlanga noma izinkolo. Kwazi ukuhlela futhi uhle umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabasekeli ukuze kuqiniseke ukunakekelwa kokwelapha okufanele. Khombisa ukukhathalela iziguli, ukukhuthaza nokumela ukwelapha nokunakekelwa okufanele okuhlanganisa ukuzwa nokuzijabulisa ukuphendula izidingo, izidingo nezethemba leziguli (Batho- Pele). Lawula ngempumelelo izinsiza ezinikiwe ungamunxhumaneni wakho.

xh.title: Usesikari oyingcali Wokusingatha inqanaba 1 (PN-A2): onokusingatha kokuza komntwana
xh.summary: Ufachiletha wamakronki needed at Ndindiri Clinic in Mpumalanga to provide clinical nursing care in line with professional standards and scope of practice.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi seSekondari / isidanga se-12 okanye esilinganayo ngakunye nenqanaba elisisiseko elicandwe ngaphantsi kwe-SANC ngokwesaziso seRhulumente R425 (oko kukuthi iDiploma / iDegree kuNonyazo jikelele) okanye isidanga esilinganayo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengoNurse oyichwebu (2026). Amandla okusebenza ezentlalo-ntle nakumisela izinto ezibalulekileyo ngaphambili. Amandla okuba ngumkhokeli namakhono amninzi okusebenza nabantu nemicimbi yokusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo.
xh.duties: Qhuba unyazo lolunyanzeleko lokwengcolisa komzimba ngokwemida yenkonzo yonyazo lulungiselelwe yisikhululo sempilo. Khuthaza umgangatho wonyazo lwezempilo njengoko kulawulwa ummandla wemisebenzi yobuchule namagqabantshintshi. Zibandakanye ekusebenzeni iindlela ezisisiseko zeSizwe kunye neNkqubo yokuPhumeza iSibhedlele esiNgummangaliso. Bonisa unxibelelwano olusebenzayo nabagulayo, oosupaviza nakwezinye iingcali zonyazo, kuquka noku bhala iingxelo xa kufuneka. Sebenza njengenxalenye yeqela labasebenzi abangenangakumbi ukuqinisekisa umgangatho wonyazo lwezempilo. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokusebenzisana ngokubulungisa nabantu abahlukeneyo ngengqondo, ngesiko, ngobuhlanga nangokholo. Bakwenza ukucwangcisa nokuqamba umsebenzi wakho nalawo basekelo ukwenza uqinisekiso oluchanekileyo lonyazo lwezempilo. Khombisa inkathazo kubagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela unyazo oluchanekileyo nolunakekelo kuquka nokuqonda nokulungela ukuphendla iimfuno, iimfuno nemigqaliselo yomgulayo (Batho- Pele). Lawula ngokusebenzayo amacebo abekiweyo kwicandelo lakho.

Diploma / Degree in General Nursing) of 'n gelykwaardige kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professional Nurse (2026) toelaat. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede.
af.duties: Voer 'n kliniese verpleegpraktyk uit ooreenkomstig die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde soos deur die gesondheidsfasiliteit bepaal. Bevorder kwaliteit van verpleegsorg soos gerig deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde. Neem deel aan die implementering van die National Core Standards en Ideal Hospital Realization Framework. Toon effektiewe kommunikasie met pasiënte, toesighouers en ander klinici, insluitend verslagskrywing wanneer vereis. Werk as deel van die multidissiplinêre span om gehalte-verpleegsorg te verseker. Werk effektief, saamwerkend en vriendelik met persone van uiteenlopende intellektuele, kulturele, rassige of godsdienstige verskille. zu.title: Usesi Wezempilo Ohlelwe Ngesikhathi Esi-1 (PN-A2): Obelethe Umsebenzi Wezabele
zu.summary: Kudingeka Usesi Wezempilo Ohlelwe Ngesikhathi Esi-1 obelethe umsebenzi wezabele e-Witbank Hospital e-Mpumalanga ukunikeza ukunakekelwa kwezokwelaphwa ngokuvumelana nomkhakazokwenza ka-SANC.

Ikono lokusebenza ngokuzimele nokubeka uhlelo emsebenzini. Amakhono okuba ngumholi nabantu, nokuxazulula izinkinga nokwenza izinqumo.
zu.duties: Yenza umsebenzi wezokwelapha wezokusiza ngokuvumelana nomkhakazokwenza namazinga okusiza njengokuqunywe isikhungo sezempilo. Khuthaza ikhwalithi yonakekelo ngokuhola umkhakazokwenza owongiweyo namazinga. Thatha inhlathi ekusetshenzisweni kwamazinga abalulekwe Zwe lonke nakuHlelo Lokufeza Ihhospithheli Eliyiphupho. Khombisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo nabayigulayo, abaphathi kanye nalabo abanye osozitsha bezokwelapha, okuhlanganiswa nokubhala imibiko uma kudingeka. Sebenza njengesigaxa setimu ehlukene amakhono ukuze uqiniseke ikhwalithi yonakekelo. Sebenza ngokusebenzayo, ngokubambisana ngokuhle nabantu abehlukene ngokwegama, ngesiko, ngobuhlanga noma ngenkolo. Kwazi ukuhlela futhi ulungise umsebenzi wakho kanye nowabasizi ukuze uqiniseke ukunakekelwa okuhle. Khombisa ukukhathazeka ngabayigulayo, ukukhuthaza nokukhosela ukwelashwa nokunakekelwa okuhle okuhlanganise ukwazile nokuzimisela ukuphendula izidingo nezinkulelo zabayigulayo (Batho-Pele). Phatha ngokusebenzayo izinsiza ezinikiwe esigxabheni sakho.

Ulwazi lokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nokubeka kuqala umsebenzi. Amava okuqhatha kunye namava okunxibelelana nabantu, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuThatha izigqibo.
xh.duties: Qhuba umthambo lwekhliniki yokhathalelo lwesikho esinomlinganiselo womthambo nemiqathango yokhathalelo njengoko kumiswe isixibo sempilo. Khuthaza umgangatho wekhliniki yokhathalelo njengoko kulawulwa ngumlinganiselo womthambo womsebenzi nemiqathango. Thatha inxaxheba ekusebenzeni kwemiQathango YeZizo Eyintloko yaseLizwe kunye neNkqubo YokuPhumeza iSibedlele esiNgcangcazelo. Bonisa ukunyaniseka ekunxibelelaneni nabaguli, abaphathi abaphezulu nabanye oogqirha bekhliniki, kuquka nokubhaliwe kweerekhoda xa kufuneka. Sebenza njengesahlulelo senqobo ekuthathweni kweqela elinabantu abahlukeneyo ngokwengqondo, basekwenzi, ngobuhlanga okanye inkolo ukuze kuqinisekiswe umgangatho wekhliniki yokhathalelo. Sebenza ngokusebenzisekayo, ngokusebenzisana ngokuhambelana nabantu abahlukeneyo ngokwengqondo, basekwenzi, ngobuhlanga okanye inkolo. Yiba nokuba ukwazi ukuqamba ulwahlulo nokuhlela umsebenzi wakho nalawo abantu abakuncedayo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukhathalelo olufaneleyo lwesikho. Bonisa inkathazo ngabaguli, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela ukwelaphwa nokhathalelo olufaneleyo kuquka nokuqonda nokulungelelanisa ukuphendula iimfuno, iimfuno nolindilelwelo labaguli (Batho-Pele). Lawula ngokusebenzisekayo amacebo abekiweyo kwelungu lakho.

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 (PV-A2): Algemene Verpleegkunde
af.summary: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 benodig in Nkomazi Sub-distrik om malariatoetsing, -behandeling, -diagnose en pasiëntopvolgingsaktiwiteite te bestuur.
af.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus 'n basiese kwalifikasie wat deur die SANC geakkrediteer is in terme van Regeringskennisgewing (d.w.s. Diploma/ Graad in Algemene Verpleegkunde) of 'n ekwivalente kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat (2026). Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 0-10 jaar se toepaslike / erkende ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige by die SANC in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Vermoë om onafhanklik te funksioneer en werk te prioritiseer. Leierskap en goeie interpersoonlike vaardighede, probleemoplossing en besluitnemingsvaardighede. Kennis van Openbare Diensbeleid, Wette en regulasies. Kennis van SANC-reëls en regulasies. Kennis van die Distriksgesondheidsorgstelsel en verwysingsroetes. Goede kommunikasie. Leierskap, interpersoonlike en besluitnemings- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Kennis van Gedragskode, Arbeidsverhoudinge, Konflikbestuur en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Vermoë om goed binne 'n span te funksioneer. Vaardighede in organisering, beplanning en toesig. Kennis van Batho Pele-beginsels en die handves vir pasiënteregte. Kennis van Arbeidsverhoudinge en die hantering van griewe en dissiplinêre prosedures. Duidelike begrip van malariabestuur. Begrip van kliniese behandelingsriglyne en protokolle. Goeie kennis van Malaria-elimineringsstrategieë. Geldige code 10 (C1) bestuurderslisensie (Las asseblief 'n afskrif aan). Ervaring in malariabeheer sal 'n bykomende voordeel wees.
af.duties: Beplan en bestuur ter plaatse malariatoetsing en -behandelingaktiwiteite. Voer kliniese assessering van tekens en simptome van Malaria uit. Sift en diagnoseer. Kennisgewing van alle positiewe gevalle. Administrasie van ACT aan positiewe kliënte. Voer opvolgbesoeke uit om pasiënte te behandel. Bestuur en monitor Menslike Hulpbronne-aktiwiteite binne die malariasector. Voer Gesondheidsopvoeding en -opleiding uit binne die sector se lokaliteite en fasiliteite. Beoefen kliniese verpleegkunde in ooreenstemming met die omvang van praktyk en verpleegstandaarde. Bevorder gehalte van verpleegsorg soos bepaal deur die professionele omvang van praktyk en standaarde. Werk as deel van die malaria multidissiplinêre span om goeie malariabestuur te verseker. zu.title: INesi Yensimu Yesi-1 (PN-A2): Ukunakekelwa Jikelele
zu.summary: Kudingeka iNesi yeNsimu yesi-1 eNkomazi Sub-district ukuphatha imisebenzi yokuhlola, ukwelapha, ukuhlonza kanye nokulandela iziguli ye-malaria.
zu.requirements: Senior Certificate / Grade 12 plus Basic qualification accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice (I.E. Diploma/ Degree in General Nursing) equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse (2026). Grade 1: A minimum of 0-10 year's appropriate / recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Ikhono lokusebenza zendividawo kanye nokubeka phambili imisebenzi. Amandla okubusa kanye namakhono ahle emphanisweni nabantu, ukuxazulula izinkinga kanye namakhono okwenza izinqumo. Ulwazi ngemigomo, emiThethweni nemithetho ye-Public Service, ulwazi ngemithetho nemigomo ye-SANC, ulwazi ngamasystem e-District Health Care kanye nezindlela zokuqondisa. Ukuxhumana kahle. Amandla okubusa, amakhono emphanisweni nabantu kanye nokwenza izinqumo nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi loMthetho wokuZiphatha, ubudlelwano basebenzi, uphatho lwezinkinga namakhono okuxoxisana, ikhono lokusebenza kahle ngaphakathi kweqembu, amakhono okuhlela, ukulungiselela nokuhlola, ulwazi ngemigomo ye-Batho Pele kanye nomqulu wamalungelo abaguli. Ulwazi ngobudlelwano basebenzi nokuphathwa kwezikalava kanye nendlela yesigameko, ukuqonda kahle uphatho lwe-malaria, ukuqonda iziqondiso zokwelapha ngokwesifo nemikhawulo. Ulwazi oluhle ngezindlela zokuqeda i-Malaria. Valid code 10 (C1) drivers' license (Please attach copy), Isipiliwo sokulawula i-malaria sizoba yinonuso.
zu.duties: Hlela uphathe imisebenzi yokuhlola nokwelapha i-malaria esikhundleni. Yenza isibonelo sezifo ezibonakalayo nezimpawu ze-Malaria. Ukuhlola kanye nokuhlonza. Ukwazisa zonke izimo ezitholakele zivezwe. Ukupha ama-ASE kubatholakale beziguli. Yenza izivakashi zokulandela ukuze uphulukise iziguli. Phatha ulawule imisebenzi yabasebenzi ngaphakathi kwesigaba se-malaria, Yazaqeqeshe ngemfundo yezenempilo ngaphakathi kwendawo nezikhungo sesigaba. Yenza umsebenzi wezokunakekelwa kwezempilo ngokuhambisana nomkhakha wokusebenza kanye nemigomo yokunakekelwa. Khuthaza izinga eliphezulu lenakekelwa ngokulawulwa umkhakha wokusebenza nemigomo. Sebenza njengenhlenge ye-team elandelanayo ye-malaria ukuze kuqinisekiswe uphatho oluhle be-malaria. Khombisa inhliziyo ezithandayo ezigulini, ukukhuthaza nokuvikela ukwelashwa okufanele kanye nenakekelwa okuhlanganisa ukwaziswa nokuqaphela ukuphendula izidingo, izidingo nethemba labaguli (Batho Pele). Qapha ulawule idatha ye-malaria ngaphakathi nomkhakha wemisebenzi. Siza ngokuqinisekisa izinga le-data.

xh.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 (PN-A2): General Nursing
xh.summary: Professional Nurse Grade 1 needed in Nkomazi Sub-district to manage malaria testing, treatment, diagnosis and patient follow-up activities.
xh.requirements: Isatifikethi samabanga aphantsi / Grade 12 plus Basic qualification accredited with the SANC in terms of Government Notice (I.E. Diploma/ Degree in General Nursing) equivalent qualification that allows registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse (2026). Grade 1: A minimum of 0-10 year's appropriate / recognizable experience in nursing after registration as a Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokuzimeleyo nokuqwalasela umsebenzi. Ikhono lokuba ngumkhokeli nokuquka nabaninzi abantu, isakhono sokusombulula iingxaki nokwenza izigqibo. Ukwazi ngeNkqubo, iMithetho yentlalo yeSizwe, nemiQatho, iMithetho neMiqatho esuka kumazwe, ulwazi lwemithetho yoluntu, ulwazi lweenkqubo zeNtlalo yeMpilo yoMmandla ngeendlela ezithunyelwa kuyo. Unxibelelwano oluhle. Iinkalo zokuba ngumkhokeli, nxibelelwano nabaninzi abantu, ukwenza izigqibo, nokusombulula iingxaki. Ulwazi lweNkqubo yoNtla yomanyano wokusetyenziswa kwemiNthetho, Ukuhlongo, Ukwengca, Ulwazi ngabasebenzi, nemiThetho yoManyano, Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi ejolise ekubeni iyilwe, ilungelelanisiwe, inomyolo-msebenzi ongathengi nangaphandle kwekhusi lokuqonda iinkqubo zabo, nokubathathela ingqalelo iinkalo zoCwangco-Nkqubo, Ulwazi ngemithetho yoluntu, iinkqubo zoManyano, nemiThetho, nokusebenza njengenxalenye yeqela, iinkalo zokuCwangcisa, iQhinga eliphezulu nelunga ngokomsebenzi weNtlangano.
xh.duties: Cwangcisa kwaye ulawule imisebenzi yokuvavanya nokwelapha i-malaria kwendawo. Yenza isiqendu sezigulo ze-malaria ngokweempawu nezibeko. Ukuhlolwa nokuqwalasela isifo. Isexwayo sazo zonke iimeko ezithintelweyo. Ukunikwa kwe-ACT kubathengi abathintelweyo. Yenza iindwendwe zokulandela ngakumbi ukugcina ukwelapha abagulayo. Lawula kwaye ulinde imisebenzi yoLawulo lweZabantu kwicala le-malaria, Yaza nokuba ngumngenisi-mfundo nolungiselelo lwempilo kwindawo neziqendu zalo. Yenza ukunyangeka kolunye usetyenziso lweempilo ngokwemigiqo yayo nemiqathango yokunyanga. Khuthaza izinga lonyango lokwengcaphephe ngokwalayishwa lilophu yokunyanga nemiqathano. Sebza njengenxalenye yeqela labasebenzi abangawo amagatya amaninzi kwindawo le yokubaqokelela kunye nokuqwalasela imisebenzi ye-malaria. Bonisa ingathandlelo kubagulayo, ukukhuthaza nokukhusela ukwelapha kolunye usetyenziso nendlela yokukhathaleka okuquka nokuqonda nokulungelelanisa ukuphendula iimfuno, iingcamango nemiqatho yabagulayo (Batho Pele). Lilinde kwaye ulawule iingcombolo zomthendeleko we-malaria ngokommandla wemisebenzi yakho. Nceda ngemigqathiso yoluntu nococo lweenkcukacha.

af.title: Sessionele Mediese Beampte Graad 1: (20 Sessies)
af.summary: Sessionele Mediese Beampte Graad 1-pos by Waterval Boven Hospitaal in Mpumalanga, wat HPCSA-registrasie as 'n Mediese Beampte vereis.
af.requirements: Toepaslike kwalifikasies wat registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n Mediese Beampte (2026) moontlik maak. 'n Geldige werkpermit sal van nie-Suid-Afrikaners vereis word. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Kennis van huidige Gesondheids- en Openbare Diens-regulasies en beleide. Vaardighede ten opsigte van konsultasies, anamnese, ondersoek, kliniese assessering en kliniese bestuur. Vereiste kennis, vaardighede, opleiding en bevoegdhede. Deeglike kennis van mediese etiek. Multidissiplinêre bestuur en spanwerk en ervaring in die onderskeie mediese dissipline. Deeglike kliniese kennis. Bevoegdheid en vaardighede in algemene kliniese domeine. Die vermoë om onafhanklik en onder druk te werk, buite normale werksure te werk en met 'n diverse span saam te werk. Goeie kommunikasie, leierskap, interpersoonlike vaardighede, en om wanneer nodig betrokke te raak. Kennis van huidige gesondheidsbeleid, wetgewing, programme en prioriteite binne die domein. Deelneem aan akademiese en opleidingsprogramme. Bystand verleen met kliniese oudits en aktief deelneem aan deurlopende professionele ontwikkeling. Ondersteuning bied aan hospitaalbestuur sodat 'n doeltreffende standaard van pasiëntsorg en dienste gehandhaaf word. zu.title: Onjiniyela Wezokwelapha Wesikhathi Esithile Izinga 1: (Amaseshini Angu-20)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaOnjiniyela Wezokwelapha Wesikhathi Esithile Izinga 1 esibhedlela i-Waterval Boven Hospital e-Mpumalanga, esifuna ukubhaliswa ku-HPCSA njengoNjiniyela Wezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Iziqu ezifanele ezivumela ukubhaliswa ku-Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengoNjiniyela Wezokwelapha (2026). Isivumelwano sokusebenza esisebenzayo sizodingwa kubantu abangewona abakwaZulu-Afrika. Ulwazi oluhle ngokuziphatha kokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwezinyanga eziningi kanye nokusebenza ohlakenini kanye nenkokhelo enkomanzeni yokwelapha ehambisana nalokho. Ulwazi ngemithetho nezinqubomgomo zamanje zezeMpilo kanye nezeNkonzo Yomphakathi. Amakhono ahlobene nezinkomishi, ukuthathwa komlando, ukuhlolwa, ukulinganisa ngokwelapha kanye nokuphathwa ngokwelapha. Ulwazi, amakhono, ukuqeqeshwa kanye namakhono adingekayo. Ulwazi oluhle ngokuziphatha kokwelapha. Ukuphathwa kwezinyanga eziningi kanye nokusebenza ohlakenini kanye nenkokhelo enkomanzeni yokwelapha ehambisana nalokho. Ulwazi oluhle ngokwelapha. Ikhono namakhono emikhakheni ejwayelekile yokwelapha. Ikakhulukazi ukukwazi ukusebenza yedwa nangaphansi kokucindezelwa kanye nangaphezu kwamahora ajwayelekile okusebenza nokusebenza nqhala ohlakeni oluhlukahlukene. Ukuxhumana okuhle, ukuba ngumholi, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, kanye nokuxhumana uma kunesidingo. Ulwazi ngezinqubomgomo zamanhe zezempilo, umthetho, izinhlelo kanye nezindima eziyinhloko enkabeni. Ikakhulukazi ukukwazi ukufundisa futhi uhlole abasebenzi abasha kumnyango. Izici Zokuziphatha: Ukubekezela ekucindezelekeni, ukusebenza ohlakenini, ukuzethemba kanye nentsondo yokuba ukhande futhi ugcine ubudlelwano obuhle.
zu.duties: Ukuze usebenze ngokusebenza ngokuchithe okuhle futhi usekelo izinhloso nezinhlelo zesikhungo eziyisimo, ezigcina zinhlobonhlobo ezingxenyeni ezahlukene zesikhungo ezinganisela izigaba zokukhuluma ngokwelapha kanye nokulawula amaphulo wesikhungo. Ukusebenza kahle kweziqu ekulawuleni amaphulo wesikhungo. Ukuphendula isikhungo ngokusebenza kahle kwezinhlelo nezinkomba ezithintekile. Kuhlangene nokuvakashela futhi ufake izinhlelo eziningi zokubhalwa kwemisebenzi kanye nokugqamisa izimo zezinhlelo ezizolotshiwe esibhedlela.

xh.title: Rhulumente wezeMpilo weQela 1: (20Iikhomishani)
xh.summary: Isithuba sika rhulumente wezeMpilo inqanaba 1 eWaterval Boven eMpumalanga, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengesikhulu sezeMpilo.
xh.requirements: Izifundo ezifanelekileyo ezivumela ukubhaliswa kwiBhunga lezeMpilo yoMsebenzi eMzantsi Afrika (HPCSA) njengesikhulu sezeMpilo (2026). Iya kufuneka ilayiseniswe ilayisense yomsebenzi evumelekileyo kubantu abangeyiwo abantu baseMzantsi Afrika. Ulwazi olululo ngemigaqo yemfanelo yezempilo. Ulawulo lwamahlathi amaninzi nokusebenza njengqela nempilo yekhondo elungeleleneyo kwishishini lempilo. Ulwazi ngemigaqo nopoliso eza ngoku ezezeMpilo nakomsebenzi kaRhulumente. Amakhono obuxhathu, ukuthabatha umlando, ukuhlola, ukuqwalasela oklinikhi nolawulo loklinikhi. Ulwazi, amakhono, uQeqesho neMfundo nokuSebenza okufunekayo. Ulwazi olululo ngemigaqo yemfanelo yezempilo. Ulawulo olunamahlathi amaninzi nokusebenza njengqela nempilo yekhondo elungeleleneyo kwishishini lempilo. Ulwazi olululo ngamangqangqamsha ezeMpilo. Ikhono namakhono kumangqangqamsha jikelele wezeEmpilo. Ikhono lokusebenza nokuzimeleyo naphantsi koxinzelelo nayongaphaya kweyure ezenzima ngokwesiqhelo nasekusebenzeni neqela elahlukeneyo. Unxibelelwano oluhle, abakhoki, abanxibelelwano, nokubandakanyeka xa kufuneka. Ulwazi ngeenkqubo, imigaqo, iinkqubo nemiqathango yoluntu ngokubanzi. Ikhono lokufundisa nokukhokela abasebenzi abatsha kwisebe. Iimpawu zoGuquko: Uxinzelelo lweemvakalelo, ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwesiqhenga, ukuzigqatsa nokwakha nokugcina unxibelelwano oluhle.
xh.duties: Ukuze kuphunyeze imisebenzi nemisebenzi ngobuchule, ukuze uxhase iinjongo nemiqathango esenyenzweni ahambelana namazinga okhathalelo lwesiguliso. Yamkela izigqibo ngokulawula abaguli bageniselwe kwisebe senkonzo elinqanaba 2/3. Nceda kwilungiselelo nokuphunyezwa kwemiqatho nemigaqo. Thatha inxaxheba kwinkqubo yezemfundo nokusingathwa kweenkqubo zokuzilolonga. Nceda nokuhlola iziguliso kwizezekeliso ezenza ixesha elide ukuzilolonga ngobuchule. Nikezela inkxaso kulawulo lesibhedlele ngenjongo yokugcina amazinga aphumeleleyo okhathalelo lwesiguliso namacenonceso. Hamba nemigaqo yeNkqubo yoLawulo nokuPhuhlisa ukuSebenza (ukwenza okuqwalaselwa kwikota nokugqiba isiqwalaselo).

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Pacs/risk (E-HEALTH Clinical Systems)
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed to lead the eHealth Clinical Systems programme, overseeing PACS, RIS and other clinical digital health systems at the Western Cape Department of Health.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate three-year National Diploma or Degree. Experience: Appropriate experience in clinical information systems, health informatics, or information management. Appropriate experience managing and leading clinician-facing digital health systems and programmes. Proven experience in the implementation and operational management of clinical systems and/or specialised clinical platforms. Appropriate experience managing complex clinical workflows, interoperability, and healthcare standards in a regulated environment. Proven experience in project and programme management across the full system lifecycle, including procurement, implementation, and operational support. Experience working within the public health sector or similarly regulated healthcare environments. Inherent requirements of the job: In-depth knowledge of clinical workflows, particularly within diagnostic and specialist clinical services. Strong understanding of digital imaging systems, PACS/RIS/VNA and related clinical technologies. Knowledge of international healthcare interoperability standards. Ability to work closely with clinicians, technical teams, vendors, and governance structures. Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence and willingness to travel. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Strong clinical systems and health informatics knowledge. Project and programme management expertise in clinical IT environments. Knowledge of IT, clinical and medico-legal governance frameworks. Experience with SCM, contract management, and SLA oversight. Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication, and negotiation skills. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities. Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams in complex, high-risk environments.
jobs.duties: Lead and manage the eHealth Clinical Systems programme, including clinician-facing digital health initiatives mandated by the executive. Oversee the planning, implementation, and operational management of PACS, RIS, VNA and other specialised clinical systems. Apply and enforce IT, clinical, and medico-legal governance across all eHealth clinical projects and operations. Manage procurement, contracts, and service level agreements in collaboration with SCM, SITA, and strategic partners. Ensure compliance with national and provincial policies, healthcare standards, and regulatory requirements. Provide strategic input into the digital health strategy, clinical interoperability, analytics, and innovation initiatives (including AI-enabled clinical solutions). Lead, manage, and develop the eHealth Clinical Systems team, including performance management, capacity building, and succession planning. Manage budgets, financial controls, and reporting for the eHealth Clinical Systems portfolio. Act as a key liaison between IT, clinical services, governance structures, and external partners. Collaborate with the broader IT ecosystem stakeholders and managers to implement departmental digital strategy.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Dlamini Tel No: (021) 483-8945
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Pacs/risk (E-HEALTH-kliniese stelsels)
af.summary: Adjunkdirekteur benodig om die eHealth-kliniese stelselsprogram te lei, met toesig oor PACS, RIS en ander kliniese digitale gesondheidsstelsels by die Western Cape Department of Health.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike driejaar Nasionale Diploma of Graad. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in kliniese inligtingstelsels, gesondheidsinformatika, of inligtingsbestuur. Toepaslike ervaring in die bestuur en leiding van klinikusgerigte digitale gesondheidsstelsels en -programme. Bewese ervaring in die implementering en operasionele bestuur van kliniese stelsels en/of gespesialiseerde kliniese platforms. Toepaslike ervaring in die bestuur van komplekse kliniese werksvloeie, interoperabiliteit en gesondheidsorgstandaarde in 'n gereguleerde omgewing. Bewese ervaring in projek- en programbestuur oor die volle stelsellewensiklus, insluitend verkryging, implementering en operasionele ondersteuning. Ervaring in werk binne die openbare gesondheidssektor of soortgelyk gereguleerde gesondheidsorgomgewings. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Diepgaande kennis van kliniese werksvloeie, veral binne diagnostiese en spesialis-kliniese dienste. Sterk begrip van digitale beeldingstelsels, PACS/RIS/VNA en verwante kliniese tegnologieë. Kennis van internasionale gesondheidsorg-interoperabiliteitsstandaarde. Vermoë om nou met klinici, tegniese spanne, verskaffers en beheerstrukture saam te werk. Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Sterk kliniese stelsel- en gesondheidsinformatikakennis. Projek- en programbestuurskundigheid in kliniese IT-omgewings. Kennis van IT-, kliniese en medies-regtelike beheerraamwerke. Ervaring met SCM, kontrakbestuur en SLA-toesig. Uitstaande belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, kommunikasie en onderhandelingsvaardighede. Sterk analitiese, probleemoplossings- en besluitnemingsvermoëns. Vermoë om multidissiplinêre spanne in komplekse, hoërisiko-omgewings te lei.
af.duties: Lei en bestuur die eHealth-kliniese stelselsprogram, insluitend klinikusgerigte digitale gesondheidsinisiatiewe wat deur die uitvoerende gesag gemandaat word. Hou toesig oor die beplanning, implementering en operasionele bestuur van PACS, RIS, VNA en ander gespesialiseerde kliniese stelsels. Pas IT-, kliniese en medies-regtelike beheer toe en handhaaf dit oor alle eHealth-kliniese projekte en operasies. Bestuur verkryging, kontrakte en diensvlakooreenkomste in samewerking met SCM, SITA en strategiese vennote. Verseker nakoming van nasionale en provinsiale beleide, gesondheidsorgstandaarde en reguleringsvereistes. Verskaf strategiese insette tot die digitale gesondheidsstrategie, kliniese interoperabiliteit, analise en innovasie-inisiatiewe (insluitend AI-geaktiveerde kliniese oplossings). Lei, bestuur en ontwikkel die eHealth-kliniese stelselspan, insluitend prestasiebestuur, kapasiteitsbou en opvolgbeplanning. Bestuur begrotings, finansiële kontroles en verslagdoening vir die eHealth-kliniese stelselsportefeulje. Tree op as sleutelverbinding tussen IT, kliniese dienste, beheerstrukture en eksterne vennote. Werk saam met die belanghebbendes en bestuurders van die breër IT-ekosisteem om die departementele digitale strategie te implementeer.

zu.title: I-Deputy Director: Pacs/risk (E-HEALTH Clinical Systems)
zu.summary: Kudingeka i-Deputy Director ukuze iholele uhlelo lwe-eHealth Clinical Systems, eqaphela ama-PACS, i-RIS kanye nezinye izinhlelo zezempilo yedijithali ezokwelapha e-Western Cape Department of Health.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi kwezivela: I-National Diploma noma i-Degree yeminyaka emithathu efanelekile. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanelekile ezinhlelweni zolwazi ngokwelapha, ezempilo yedijithali, noma ekuphatheni ulwazi. Isipiliyono esifanelekile ekuphatheni nokuholeni izinhlelo zezempilo yedijithali ebonelela ngokusiza abashibi abaphatha iziguli. Isipiliyono esiqinisekisiwe ekuphatheni ukusetshenziswa kanye nokuphatha imisebenki yezinhlelo zezokwelapha kanye/noma izinkundla zezokwelapha ezikhethekile. Isipiliyono esifanelekile ekuphatheni izinhlela zezokwelapha ezibanzi, ukusebenzisana kwezinhlelo, kanye namapholisi wezempilo endaweni egqamiswe umthetho. Isipiliyono esiqinisekisiwe ekuphatheni imiklamo yezinhlelo kulo lonke isikhathi sezulu sezinhlelo, okuhlanganisa okuthengwayo, ukuphatha ukusetshenziswa, kanye nokwesekela ukusebenza. Isipiliyono sokusebenza emkhakheni wezempilo kahulumeni noma kwindawo efanayo egqamiswe umthetho. Izidingo ezibangelwe umsebenzi: Ulwazi oluqondile ngezinhlela zezokwelapha, ikakhulukazi kulezo ezisebenza nokuqathaniswa izifo ezikhethekile. Ukuqonda okuqinile ngemifanekiso yedijithali, ama-PACS/RIS/VNA kanye nobuchwepheshe obuhlobene nempilo. Ulwazi ngamapholisi wezempilo wezwe lonke. Ikhono lokusebenza eduze nabashibi bezokwelapha, amaqembu obuchwepheshe, abathengisi, kanye nezinkalo zokuphatha. Ilayisense yomshayeli (Code B/EB) elungile kanye nokulungele ukuhamba. Ikhono (ulwazi/ikhono): Ulwazi oluqinile ngezinhlelo zezokwelapha nempilo yedijithali. Isipiliyono ekuphatheni imiklamo yezinhlelo ezindaweni ze-IT zezokwelapha. Ulwazi lwe-IT, izokwelapha, kanye nezinkalo zokuphatha imithetho. Isipiliyono ngo-SCM, ukuphatha izinkontileka, kanye nokuphatha i-SLA. Ikhono elihle lokuzibandakanya nabalingani, ukuxhumana, kanye nokuxoxa. Ikhono elihle lokuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga, kanye nokuthatha izinqumo. Ikhono lokuhola amaqembu aphathekayo ngokwezinhlobo-zinhlobo ezindaweni ezibanzi ezingabozingo.
zu.duties: Hola uphathe uhlelo lwe-eHealth Clinical Systems, okuhlanganisa imizamo yezempilo yedijithali ebonelela ngokusiza abashibi abaphatha iziguli ehaywe abaphathi abaphezulu. Qaphela ukulungelelisa, ukuphatha ukusetshenziswa, kanye nokuphatha imisebenzi ye-PACS, RIS, VNA kanye nezinye izinhlelo zezokwelapha ezikhethekile. Faka phansi nokuphoqa ubulungiswa be-IT, ezokwelapha, kanye nokuphatha imithetho yezokwelapha kulo lonke uhlelo lwe-eHealth clinical. Phatha okuthengwayo, izinkontileka, kanye neminikelo yezinsiza ehlanganyelwa no-SCM, i-SITA, kanye nabalingani ababalulekile. Qinisekisa ukuthi kuhambisana namapholisi wesifundazwe nasengqongqosheni, amapholisi wezempilo, kanye nemithetho yokuphatha imisebenzi. Nikeza umbono oholelayo ohlelweni lwezempilo yedijithali, ukusebenzisana kwezinhlelo zezokwelapha, ukuhlaziya ulwazi, kanye nemizamo yokuthuthukisa okusha (okuhlanganisa izixazululi ezenziwe yi-AI). Hola, phathe, futhi uthuthukise iqembu le-eHealth Clinical Systems, okuhlanganisa ukulawula ukusebenza kahle, ukwakha amandla, kanye nokulungelelisa ukushintshwa kwabaphathi. Phatha izabelomali, ukulawula imali, kanye nokubika ngohlelo lwe-eHealth Clinical Systems. Yiba nomdanso phakathi kwe-IT, izinkonzo zezokwelapha, izakhiwo zokuphatha imisebenzi, kanye nabalingani bangaphandle. Sebenzisana nabalingani bezinhlelo zokusebenza kwe-IT kabanzi namaphathi ukuphatha uhlelo lwendijithali lomnyango.

xh.title: UMlawuli oNgenelecwa: I-PACS/I-Phondo (Iinkqubo zezeKliniki eze-E-HEALTH)
xh.summary: Kufuneka ibe nguMlawuli ongenelecwa ukuba abhe iqela leNkqubo zezeEmpilo zeDijithali eziKliniki, kwaye alawule i PACS, RIS nakwezinye iinkqubo zedijithali kwi Western Cape Department of Health.
xh.requirements: Isidanga somfundo esingowona mgangatho: Isidanga seQondo leNyanga ezintathu okanye i-Degree. Isipiliwo: Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo kwinkqubo yolwazi ekliniki, inzululwazi lolwazi ngempilo, okanye ulawulo lolwazi. Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo ekulawulen iinkqubo zedijithali ezijolise ekliniki nakuqhagamshelwano nakwinkqubo yekliniki ethile. Isipiliwo esiqinisekisiweyo ekusebenzeni nakulawulweni kwangaphakathi iinkqubo zekliniki nakwizinga elithile leenkqubo zekliniki ezikhethekileyo. Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo ekulawuleni iindlela ezikrayityha ekliniki, ukusebenzisana, kunye namagqabantshintshi okuqinisekisa amanqanaba ombane ngemfuyo kwinkqubo elawulwayo. Isipiliwo esiqinisekisiweyo ekulawuleni iiprojekthi nenkqubo ukwenza inkqubo iphelele, kuquka ukuthenga, ukwenza, kwaye inkxaso yokuqhuba. Isipiliwo ngokusebenza kwinkqubo yamagqabantshintshi ezoEmpilo okanye apho kubakho imigaqo efanayo yezempilo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwalo msebenzi: Ukuqonda okonzima iindlela ezikliniki, ngakumbi kwinkonzo yamayeza iindlela ezikhethekileyo. Ukuqonda okuqinileyo ngeendlela ezidityaniswa, PACS/RIS/VNA, neteknoloji yamanye amayeza eKliniki. Ulwazi kwamagqabantshintshi e-International zeMfuyo ekusebenzisweni. Amandla okusebenza kobunye nabantu baseKliniki, amaqela eTeknoloji, abathengi, kunye namanye amagqabantshintshi. I layisensi yokushova (Code B/EB) eqinisiweyo nethamsanqa lokuhamba. Amandla (ulwazi/iskhondo): Ulwazi oluzinzileyo ngeenkqubo ekliniki nakuzo eempilo zedijithali. Isipiliwo esikumgangatho ophezulu ekulawuleni iiprojekthi kwi-IT ekliniki. Ulwazi lwe-IT, amagqabantshintshi weKliniki kwaye neMedico-legal. Isipiliwo nge-SCM, ukulawula iinkontrakthi, kwaye nokulawula i-SLA. Amandla aphezulu ekuchazeni iindaba, kwabathengi, kwaye kumaxesha okulula. Isipiliwo esinamandla kwindlela yokuxazula iingxaki, kwaye ekwenzeni izigqibo. Amandla okubumba amaqela abantu abasuka kumagatya ngamagatya kwindlela ethambekileyo, ixesha elinzima.
xh.duties: Bumba uphando lweeNkqubo zezeEmpilo zeDijithali ezeKliniki, kuquka nezindaba zokuphila ezijolise kubaguli ezidalwe ngabaphathi. Qonda, yenze uphando, nokulawula ukulandelwa kwezinye iinkqubo ezikliniki ezinjenge PACS, RIS, VNA kwaye nezinye iinkqubo ezikliniki ezikhethekileyo. Sebenzisa kwaye uqinisekise uLawulo lwe-IT, lweKliniki, kunye neMedico-legal kuzo zonke iiprojekthi kunye nokuqhuba okusempilweni kwedijithali. Lawula ukuthengwa, iinkontrakthi, kunye neendibano zenkonzo elingana nomyinge nokusebenzisana ne SCM, SITA, kunye nabalingane abasemgangathweni ophezulu. Qinisekisa ukuthobela imigaqo-mbutho yonke karhulu, namanye amagqabantshintshi, kunye nemfuneko yomgaqo wezoEmpilo. Nikezela ngengcapheko etshintshayo kumgaqo wezoEmpilo wedijithali, ukusebenzisana ekliniki, ukuqonda, iindlela ezitsha ezidijithali (kuquka ne-AI ngesisombululo sezempilo). Bumba, qonde kwaye uphuhlise iqela leNkqubo zezeKliniki ezeKliniki, kuquka ukulawula imisebenzi, ukwakha amandla iqela kunye nokulungiselela isixa sabantu abazakuba ngaphandle. Lawula iimali zokusebenza, ukulawula imali kwaye uchaze iinkqubo ngokuphathelele kwindima yeNkqubo zezeKliniki eziDijithali. Yiba ngumthunywa ophakathi phakathi kwe-IT, iinkonzo zekliniki, iinkqubo zolawulo, kunye nabalingane bangaphandle. Sebenzisana nabantu abanomdla kunye nabaphathi kwinkqubo ye-IT ebanzi ukugqiba umgaqo we-dijithali wesebe.

jobs.title: Deputy Director: Stakeholder Engagement
jobs.centre: Office of the Chief Director: Metro Health Services
jobs.salary_text: R932 292 per annum, (A portion of the package can be structured according to the individual's personal needs.)
jobs.summary: Deputy Director needed to lead stakeholder engagement for Metro Health Services in the Western Cape, coordinating partnerships with NPOs, donors and intergovernmental bodies.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An Appropriate 3-year national diploma/ degree. Experience: Appropriate managerial experience in stakeholder engagement, partnership management or programme coordination within the public sector. Appropriate experience working within a health service delivery environment. Proven experience in engaging with external stakeholders, including NPOs, donors, intergovernmental partners and service providers. Appropriate experience supporting or coordinating governance structures, committees and formal decision-making processes. Appropriate experience working with digital or stakeholder facing platforms (e.g. NPOMS/HSPP or similar). Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Willingness to travel and work extended hours when required by service needs. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Strong strategic stakeholder management and facilitation skills. Sound understanding of government governance and decision-making processes. High level written and verbal communication skills, including drafting of submissions, briefing notes and reports for senior management. Ability to manage politically and operationally sensitive engagements. Strong organisational, analytical and coordination skills. Digital literacy, particularly in relation to stakeholder facing systems and data enabled decision making. Exposure to system reform and provincialisation initiatives.
jobs.duties: Lead and coordinate structured stakeholder engagement in support of Metro Health Services strategic priorities and service delivery. Serve as the primary interface between Metro Health Services and external stakeholders, including NPOs, donors, intergovernmental partners, academic institutions and private sector partners. Establish, coordinate and support governance structures, including steering committees, technical working groups and task teams linked to key programmes and platforms. Provide leadership for stakeholder facing components of NPOMS/HSPP, including onboarding, communication, change management and compliance support. Support provincialisation and system reform initiatives, ensuring alignment between Metro, Rural and Provincial stakeholders. Draft and coordinate strategic communication, submissions and briefing material for EXCO, Service Connect and other governance forums. Supervision and management of personnel that reports to this post. Identify opportunities to improve stakeholder coordination through digital enablement, innovation and improved processes. Maintain oversight of stakeholder related risks, ensuring compliance with departmental policies, governance requirements and audit standards. Provide regular progress reports to senior management and relevant governance structures.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A Janse van Rensburg Tel No: (021) 815-8699
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Adjunkdirekteur: Belanghebbende-betrokkenheid
af.summary: 'n Adjunkdirekteur word benodig om belanghebbende-betrokkenheid vir Metro Health Services in die Western Cape te lei, deur vennootskappe met NPO's, skenkers en interregeringsliggame te koördineer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar nasionale diploma/graad. Ervaring: Toepaslike bestuurservaring in belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, vennootskapsbestuur of programkoördinering binne die openbare sektor. Toepaslike ervaring wat binne 'n gesondheidsdienslewering-omgewing opgedoen is. Bewese ervaring in betrokkenheid by eksterne belanghebbendes, insluitend NPO's, skenkers, interregeringsvennote en diensverskaffers. Toepaslike ervaring in die ondersteuning of koördinering van bestuursstrukture, komitees en formele besluitnemingsprosesse. Toepaslike ervaring in die werk met digitale of belanghebbende-georiënteerde platforms (bv. NPOMS/HSPP of soortgelyk). Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis en oortyd te werk wanneer diensbehoeftes dit vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Sterk strategiese belanghebbende-bestuur en fasiliteringsvaardighede. Deeglike begrip van regeringsbestuur en besluitnemingsprosesse. Hoë vlak skriftelike en mondelinge kommunikasievaardighede, insluitend die opstel van voorleggings, kennisgewings en verslae vir senior bestuur. Vermoë om polities en operasioneel sensitiewe betrokkenheidsake te bestuur. Sterk organisatoriese, analitiese en koördineringsvaardighede. Digitale geletterdheid, veral ten opsigte van belanghebbende-georiënteerde stelsels en data-gedrewe besluitneming. Blootstelling aan stelselhervorming en provinsialiseringinisiatiewe.
af.duties: Lei en koördineer gestruktureerde belanghebbende-betrokkenheid ter ondersteuning van Metro Health Services se strategiese prioriteite en dienslewering. Tree op as die primêre skakel tussen Metro Health Services en eksterne belanghebbendes, insluitend NPO's, skenkers, interregeringsvennote, akademiese instellings en privaatsektorvennote. Stel goedgekeurde bestuursstrukture op, koördineer en ondersteun dit, insluitend stuurgroepe, tegniese werkgroepe en taakspanne wat verbind is met sleutelprogramme en platforms. Verskaf leierskap vir belanghebbende-georiënteerde komponente van NPOMS/HSPP, insluitend integrasie, kommunikasie, veranderingsbestuur en nakomingsondersteuning. Ondersteun provinsialisering en stelselhervormingsinisiatiewe, en verseker belyning tussen Metro-, Landelike en Provinsiale belanghebbendes. Opstel en koördineer strategiese kommunikasie, voorleggings en inneemateriaal vir EXCO, Service Connect en ander bestuursforums. Toesig en bestuur van personeel wat aan hierdie pos verslag doen. Identifiseer geleenthede om belanghebbende-koördinering te verbeter deur digitale bemagtiging, innovasie en verbeterde prosesse. Handhaaf toesig oor belanghebbende-verwante risiko's, en verseker nakoming van departementele beleide, bestuursvereistes en ouditstandaarde. Verskaf gereelde vorderingsverslae aan senior bestuur en relevante bestuursstrukture.

zu.title: UMqondisi Ophethe: Ukuxhumana Nabathintekayo
zu.summary: Kudingeka uMqondisi Ophethe ukuba ahole ukuxhumana nabathintekayo kwe-Metro Health Services e-Western Cape, ahyalize izinhlangano ezihlanganyelene nama-NPO, abanikeli beminikelo nabasimama kahulumeni.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezibekiwe: I-diploma/degree yezwe eneminyaka engu-3 efanelekile. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele sokuphatha ekuxhumaneni nabathintekayo, ekuphathweni kwezinhlangano ezihlanganyene noma ekuhleleni izinhlelo ngaphakathi kwesigaba sikahulumene. Isipiliyoni esifanele sokusebenza ngaphakathi kwendawo enikeza izinkonzo ezingokwezempilo. Isipiliyoni esiqinisekisiwe ekuxhumaneni nabathintekayo bangaphandle, okuhlanganisa ama-NPO, abanikeli beminikelo, abahlanganyeli bahulumene nabahlinzeki bezinkonzo. Isipiliyoni esifanele sokusekela noma ukuhyalisa izakhiwo zokuphatha, amakomidi nenqubo yokuqumba izinqumo ezisemthethweni. Isipiliyoni esifanele sokusebenza namapulatifomu ezimatshini noma abhekene nabathintekayo (okwenziwa. NPOMS/HSPP noma okufanayo). Isidingo esingaphakathi emsebenzini: Ilayisensi yokuqasha ehlelekile (i-Code B/EB). Ukuze ukubekezela ekuhambahambeni nokusebenza amasikhathi angethembele lapho kudingwa yizidingo zezinkonzo. Izakhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Izikhali ezinamandla zokuqamba izinhlelo zokuphatha nabathintekayo nokuba umhlanganisi. Ukuqonda okusempilweni ngokuphathwa kahulumene kanye nenqubo yokwenza izinqumo. Amakhono aphakeme okubhala nokukhuluma, okuhlanganisa nokubhala kwemibhalo yesibonelo, amanotsi okufundisa nokubika kwabaphathi abaphezulu. Isikhono sokuphata izinkinga ezibucayi ngokwezombusazwe nangokwemisebenzi. Amakhono amakhulu ohlelweni, ukuhlaziya ukuqonda nokuhlanganisa. Ulwazi lokusebenzisa izinto zesimanjemanje, ikakhuluzi ngokuhlobene namasistimu abhekene nabathintekayo kanye nokwenza izinqumo ngokusekelwe kwimininingwane. Ukuthinta izinhlelo zokulungisa izinto ezingezinhle kanye nezinhlelo zokwenza izinto ngokwesisifunda.
zu.duties: Ukuhola futhi uhyalise ukuxhumana nabathintekayo ngendlela ehleliwe ukuze usekele izinhloso ezibalulekile kanye nokuletha izinkonzo kwe-Metro Health Services. Ukuba yisixhumi esibalulekile phakathi kwe-Metro Health Services kanye nabathintekayo bangaphandle, okuhlanganisa ama-NPO, abanikeli beminikelo, abahlanganyeli bahulumene, izikhungo zezemfundo nabahlanganyeli besekhthi yangasese. Ukusungula, ukuqamba nokusekela izakhiwo zokuphatha, okuhlanganisa amakomidi ohlela umsebenzi, amagruphu asebenza ngezobuchwepheshe namathimu wemisebenzi ahlobene ngezinhlelo ezibalulekile kanye namapulatifomu. Ukunikeza inhloli emphakathini wamaphathi abhekene nabathintekayo we-NPOMS/HSPP, okuhlanganisa ukungenisa abantu ohlelweni, ukuxhumana nokwazisa, ukuphatha izinguquko kanye nokusekela ukuziphendulela. Ukusekela imizamo yokwenza izinto ngokwesisifunda nokulungisa izinto ezingezinhle, ukuqinisekisa ukuhambisana phakathi kwabathintekayo be-Metro, e-Makhaya ne-Ngingqi. Ukubhala nokuhlanganisa ukuhumusha ngendlela ehleliwe, okuhlanganisa nokubhala kwemibhalo yesibonelo namanotsi okufundisa i-EXCO, i-Service Connect kanye nezinye izinkundla zokuphatha. Ukuqapha nokuphatha abantu ababika kule sikhundla. Ukubona ithuba lokuphucatha ukuhlanganisa nabathintekayo ngokusebenzisa izinto zesimanjemanje, ukwakhiwa kwezinto ezintsha kanye nokuqoqa izinqubo ezinhle. Ukugcina ulwazi ngemithwalo yonakele ebandakanya ukuxhumana nabathintekayo, ukuze uqiniseke ukuziphendulela ngokuhambisana namapholisi omnyango, izidingo zokuphatha kanye nemigomo yokuhlola. Ukunikeza okuzayo ngokuvame kokuqinisekisa abaphathi abaphezulu ngokuqhubekayo nezakhiwo zokuphatha ezifanele.

xh.title: UMlawuli oNgenela Ikhaya: UkuNxibelelana nabathathi-nxaxheba
xh.summary: Kufuneka abe nguMlawuli ongumnuxa ozele abeke phambili ukuzibandakanya nabathathi-nxaxheba kwiinkonzo zezeempilo ze Metro Health Services kwi Western Cape, ngokulungelelanisa amanyathelo okusebenzisana ne-NPOs, abanikeli nemiqathango yokurhwebo phakathi kolawulo.
xh.requirements: Isikhokelo sobuncwane obuncinane: I-diploma/idigri yeminyaka emi-3 esemthethweni. Isipiliwo: Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo sokulawula kwindawo yokuzibandakanya nabathathi-nxaxheba, ulawulo lwamanyathelo okusebenzisana okanye ulungelelwaniso lweenkqubo ngaphakathi kwicandelo lolawulo lwentlangano. Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo sokusebenza kwimeko yonikezelo lweenkonzo zezeempilo. Isipiliwo esiqinisekisiweyo sokuzibandakanya nabathathi-nxaxheba bangaphandle, kuquka iintsho zodlulo lwabantu, iinkonzo ezingenamaxhamaz (NPOs), abanikeli, abalingane bokurhwebo phakathi kolawulo kunye neenkonzo ezinika abantu abafuna ukusebenza. Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo sokuxhasa okanye ukulungelelanisa izakhiwo zolawulo, iikomiti kunye neenkqubo ezisemthethweni zokuthathwa kwezigqibo. Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo sokusebenza ngeenkqubo ezisezantsi ezibonakalayo okanye ezibonwa ngabathathi-nxaxheba (umzekelo i NPOMS/HSPP okanye ezifanayo). Isipiliwo esisesikweni somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yomqhubi (Code B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukulungele ukuhamba nokusebenza iiyure ezongezelelekileyo xa kufuneka ngemfuno yonikezelo lweenkonzo. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Amakhono anamandla okulawula ngokwe-strategy abathathi-nxaxheba nokunceda ukuba kubekho uvuyo-phakathi. Ukuqonda okusesikweni ngolawulo lolawulo nokuthathwa kwezigqibo kurrhulumente. Amakhono aphakamileyo okubhala nokuthetha, kuquka ukubhala izibhalo ezithunyelwa kumagunya, iindaba ezimfutshane ezinika ulwazi olufutshane nengxelo ezinikezelwa kubaphathi abaphezulu. Ukuba nakho ukulawula ukuzibandakanya okuziva ngezoopolitiki nakwezokusebenza. Amakhono anamandla okulungelelanisa, ukuhlalutya nokubamba iqhaza ekulungelelwaniseni. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa iinkqubo ezinamandla okusebenza ngokombane, ngokukodwa ngokuphathelele kwiinkqubo ezibonwa ngabathathi-nxaxheba kunye nezigqibo ezithathwa ngokusekwe kwiidata. Ukubonwa kwezinto ezintsha kwindalo yolawulo nakwiinkqubo zokulawula iindawo zengingqi.
xh.duties: Hamba phambili kwaye ulungelelanise unikezelo lwabathathi-nxaxheba olulunjweyo ngokusekwa ziinquento ezibalulekileyo kunye nenkqubo yokunikezela iinkonzo ze Metro Health Services. Ukuba ngumphathi oyintloko ongummiselwano phakathi kwe Metro Health Services kunye nabathathi-nxaxheba bangaphandle, kuquka iintsho zodlulo lwabantu, iinkonzo ezingenamaxhamaz (NPOs), abanikeli, abalingane bokurhwebo phakathi kolawulo, iindawo zemfundo ezingowolulo lwentsapho kunye nabalingane bobhuti asebenza ngokutsha kwinkqubo yorhwebo. Misela, ulungelelanise kwaye uncedise iindawo zolawulo eziyintloko, kuquka iikomiti eziphatha iindaba, amaqela osebenzo anothechincala kunye namaqela abakho ngxamisekelo kwizikhokelo ezingundoqo notheyibhile. Yiba ngumlawuli wezinto eziphathwa ngabathathi-nxaxheba kwiziqulatho ze NPOMS/HSPP, kuquka ukungenisa abantu abasha, unyanzeliswa kolwazi, ulawulo lwezitshintsho nokuxhaswa kokuthobela imigaqo. Xhasa iinkqubo zorhwebo lwengingqi nakwindalo yolawulo, ukuqinisekisa ukuba kukho uvuvo-phakathi kwabathathi-nxaxheba base Metro, base Mazahlathi nakwesebe ngokusesiko. Bhala ulungelelanise ulwazi oluchanekileyo olunolwazi oluyimfuno, izifundo ezizaliswe ulwazi nolunikezelwa kuma EXCO, Service Connect nakwezinye iindawo ezilawulwayo. Ukulawula nokulawula abantu abaxela kule sithuba. Phawula amathuba okuphucula ulungelelwaniso lwabathathi-nxaxheba ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezisezantsi zenkcubeko, usetyenziso olutsha oluqinileyo kunye neenkqubo ezingcono. Gcina ulawulo olupheleleyo lwengozi ezinxulumene nabathathi-nxaxheba, ukuqinisekisa ukuzithoba ngokomthetho wezitshixo zolawulo, iimfuno zolawulo namagqabantshishi okuqinisekisa ukuba kwenziwe imisebenzi ehambelana nomgaqo-nkquno. Nikeza iingxelo zentshukumo ezizezantsi kumaphakathi amakhulu ekiqondo elingagqitywanga kwixesha elifanelekileyo nakumagunya obulungisa.

jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R882 816 per annum Grade 2: R954 339 per annum Grade 3: R1 041 402 per annum
jobs.summary: Pharmacist positions at Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital involving pharmaceutical service delivery, medicine supply management and cold chain oversight.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic qualification accredited with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) that allows registration with the SAPC as a Pharmacist. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) as a pharmacist. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration as a pharmacist with the SAPC in respect of SA qualified employees. 1-year relevant experience after registration as pharmacist with a recognized foreign Health Professional council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community service as required in South Africa. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience after registration as a pharmacist with the SAPC in respect of SA qualified employees. 6-years relevant experience after registration as pharmacist with a recognized foreign Health Professional council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community service as required in South Africa. Grade 3: A minimum of 13 years’ appropriate experience after registration as a pharmacist with the SAPC in respect of SA qualified employees. 14-years relevant experience after registration as pharmacist with a recognized foreign Health Professional council in respect of foreign qualified employees, of whom it is not required to perform Community service as required in South Africa. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s license. Willingness to perform regular after-hours duties. Willingness to perform standby duties and call-out duties when required to do so. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook). Ability to work accurately under pressure and maintain a high standard of professionalism. Ability to work in a multi-disciplinary team with excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Appropriate knowledge of National and Provincial Health Policies, Medicines Act 101of 1965, the Pharmacy Act 53 of 1974 and Public Finance Management Act. Appropriate clinical and pharmaceutical knowledge. Innovative analytical thinking and the ability to initiate, co-ordinate, manage and sustain systems. Ability to manage and supervise staff in the absence of the manager and to conduct all administrative functions required.
jobs.duties: Pharmaceutical service delivery includes services within the boundaries of RWMCH and improving continuity of care within the Ecosystem it serves. Effective medicine supply management (Procurement, storage, control and distribution of pharmaceuticals) including cold chain management in all areas where medications are kept. Quality assurance and clinical governance including rational medicine use. Assist with corporate governance functions including financial control, implementation and evaluation of budgetary control measures, human resource management and development and information management. Ensure compliance with policy and legislative requirements and Good Pharmacy Practice Guidelines. Assist with the implementation and management of Antimicrobial Stewardship (AMS).
jobs.enquiries: Mr E Williams Tel No: (021) 658-5031

Vermoë om akkuraat onder druk te werk en 'n hoë standaard van professionaliteit te handhaaf. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk met uitstekende interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Bystand met korporatiewe bestuursfunksies insluitend finansiële beheer, implementering en evaluering van begrotingsbeheermaatreëls, menslike hulpbronbestuur en -ontwikkeling en inligtingsbestuur. zu.title: Isikhemisi Izinga 1 kuya ku-3 (UKUKHIQIZA)
zu.summary: Izikhundla zezikhemisi eRed Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital ezibandakanya ukuhanjiswa kwenkonzo yamakhemisi, ukuphathwa kokuhanjiswa kwemithi nokuphathwa kwecheni elibandayo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi: Isidingo semfundo esisisekelo esamukelwe yi-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) esivumela ukubhalisa ne-SAPC njengesikhemisi. Ukubhalisa nenhlangano yezisebenzi ezechizi: Ukubhalisa ne-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) njengesikhemisi. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho esipiliyono emva kokubhalisa njengesikhemisi ne-SAPC mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyono esingeyomunyaka wezinsiza emva kokubhalisa njengesikhemisi nenhlangano yezokwelapha yamanye amazwe ebonakalayo ukuthi isisebenzi samanye amazanga, okungeyona efunwa ukuthi yenze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 2: Okuncane eminyakeni engu-5 yesipiliyono esifanelekile emva kokubhalisa njengesikhemisi ne-SAPC mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyono esingeminyaka eyi-6 yezinsiza emva kokubhalisa njengesikhemisi nenhlangano yezokwelapha yamanye amazwe ebonakalayo ukuthi isisebenzi samanye amazanga, okungeyona efunwa ukuthi yenze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izinga 3: Okuncane eminyakeni engu-13 yesipiliyono esifanelekile emva kokubhalisa njengesikhemisi ne-SAPC mayelana nabasebenzi abathole izifundo eNingizimu Afrika. Isipiliyono esingeminyaka eyi-14 yezinsiza emva kokubhalisa njengesikhemisi nenhlangano yezokwelapha yamanye amazwe ebonakalayo ukuthi isisebenzi samanye amazanga, okungeyona efunwa ukuthi yenze isevisi yomphakathi njengoba kudingwa eNingizimu Afrika. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komshebenzi: Ilayisense yokushayela (Code B/EB) esevisi. Ukuzithoba ukwenza imisebenzi ngevamisa nangemva kwezibekiwe. Ukuzithoba ukwenza imisebenzi yesikhundla sokulinda kanye nemisebenzi yokubizwa uma kudingeka ukuba yenziwe. Amakhono (ulwazi/izindlela): Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint kanye ne-Outlook). Ikhono lokusebenza ngokucophelela ngaphansi koxinzelelo nogcina izinga eliphakeme lobungcweti. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini elihlangene kwamakhono ahlukene ngekhono elihle lokuxhumana nabantu nokukhuluma. Ulwazi olufanelekilo lemigomo yezempilo Yezwelonke neYasifundazwe, umthetho wezidakamizwa 101 ka-1965, umthetho wezokwelapha 53 ka-1974 kanye noMthetho Wokuphathwa Kwemali Yomphakathi. Ulwazi olufanelekile lwezokwelapha nezidakamizwa. Ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya ngendlela eyisihluthulelo ngenhlanhla kanye nekhono lokuqala, ukuhlanganisa, ukuphatha nokugcina izinhlelo. Ikhono lokuphatha nokulawula abasebenzi engasebekho umphathi kanye nokwenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo edingekayo.
zu.duties: Ukuhanjiswa kwenkonzo yamakhemisi kuhlanganisa izinsiza ngaphakathi kwemingcele ye-RWMCH nokuthuthukisa ukuqhubeka kokwelashwa ngaphakathi kwesistimu eYomphakathi ekukhonza kuyo. Ukuphathwa okusebenzayo kokuhanjiswa kwezidakamizwa (Ukuthenga, ukugcina, ukulawula nokwabiwa kwezidakamizwa) okuhlanganisa ukuphathwa kwecheni elibandayo kuzo zonke izindawo lapho kugcinwa khona imithi. Ukuqinisekiswa kwkhwalithi nobulungiswa bezokwelapha okuhlanganisa ukusetshenziswa kwezidakamizwa ngokwemvelo. Ukusiza emisebenzini yokubusa kwenhlangano okuhlanganisa ukulawula imali, ukuqashwa nokuhlola izinyathelo zokulawula izabelomali, ukuphathwa nokuthuthukiswa kobuhlakani bento nokuphathwa kolwazi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuhambiswa nemigomo nezidingo zomthetho kanye Nemihlahlandlela Yokwenza Umsebenzi Wezokwelapha Ohlelekile. Ukusiza ngokuqashwa nokuphathwa kokuqondiswa kwezidakamizwa ezibulala amagciwane (AMS).

jobs.title: Assistant Manager Nursing: (HEAD of Nursing)
jobs.summary: Lead and coordinate nursing services as Head of Nursing at Vredendal Hospital, managing clinical governance, resources, training and nursing research.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR A 3 year Diploma in Nursing (R171) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a General Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse or General Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 8 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration as Professional Nurse with the SANC in General Nursing. At least 3 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognisable experience at management level. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Willingness to travel and to attend to community needs after hours. Ability to work in a high stress environment. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to function/make decisions independently and as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Experience in change management, people management, conflict management, problem solving, negotiation, and strategic planning. Good communication, interpersonal relationships, exceptional leadership and conflict resolution skills. Expertise in quality improvement, infection prevention and control strategies and in-depth knowledge and application of Ideal Hospital. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook). Extensive knowledge and understanding of the District Health System and the implementation thereof, relevant nursing legislation, policies and protocols of the Department of Health, Western Cape as well as experience in office administration, human resource management, financial management, supply chain and procurement processes.

Manage and monitor the cost-effective utilisation of human, financial and physical resources Manage nursing research, nursing practice development and training programmes.
