Bestuur die gehalteversekeringsprogram vir verpleging en ontwikkel verpleegbeleid.

zu.title: Umphathi ongumncedis: (UHleli wokuNakekelwa)
zu.summary: Nika bukhoshi futhi uhlanganise izinkonzo zokunakekelwa njengoHleli weNzinkonzo zokunakekelwa esibhedlela iVredendal Hospital, ulawula ubusemthethweni bokwelapha, imitho yokusebenza, ukolotsha kanye nocwaningo lokunakekelwa.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesibili: Ithuluzi lesisekelo R425 (okusho ukuthi idiploma/izinhlamvu kuye kokwelapha ngokunakekelwa) noma isidingo esifanayo (R683) esivumela ukubhaliswa eNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika yoBunhlengi (SANC) njengoNesi oPhelele NGE-Fomu leminyaka yane leGijima yeziBhalo eZinhle ekunakekelweni (R174) esivumela ukubhaliswa eNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika yoBunhlengi (SANC) njengoNesi oPhelele NGE-Fomu leminyaka emithathu leDiploma ekunakekelweni (R171) esivumela ukubhaliswa eNyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika yoBunhlengi (SANC) njengoNesi oJikelele. Ukubhaliswa kwabhali: Ukubhaliswa eNyuvesi (SANC) njengoNesi oPhelele noma njengoNesi oJikelele. Ukhonza: Imali yeminyaka engu-8 yamava afanele/awaziwayo kuyo kwelapha ngokunakekelwa emva kokubhaliswa njengoNesi oPhelele eNyuvesi (SANC) kwelapha ngokunakekelwa okuJikelele. Okungenani iminyaka engu-3 yaleso sikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele kube amava afanele/awaziwayo ezingeni lokuqondisa. Izidingo ezingokwemvelo zomsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (ikhowudi B/EB) esemthethweni. Ukuzithoba ukuhamba nokuba khona ezidingweni zomphakathi ngemva kwamahora womsebenzi. Ukuba namandla okusebenza endaweni ephezulu yokucindezelwa. Amakhono (ulwazi/izakhono): Ukuba namandla okusebenza/okuthatha izinqumo ngokuzimele futhi njengengxenye yetimu eyahlukene kwamakhono ezenzululwazi. Amava ekushintshweni kwezenzo, ekuphatheni abantu, ekuphatheni izinkinga, ekuxazululeni izinkinga, ekuxoxisweni nasekuhleleni okusemgangathweni. Izindlela ezinhle zokuxhumana, ubudlelwano obuhle nabantu, abakhokhelwa kakhulu abakhokhela izenzo kanye namakhono ekuqedeni izinkinga. Ulwazi lokuphucula izinga ekutholeni amathuba, ukuvikela isifo futhi kuzinza amaqhinga nokwazi okunjengomhlathi nokusebenzisa iNyuvesi eNgcwele. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint & Outlook).
zu.duties: Nika bukhosi futhi uhlanganise ngendlela ehlelekile insiza yokwelapha ngokunakekelwa ezazingeni ezishiwo zokunakekelwa. Phatha futhi ulawule ukusetshenziswa okugcinayo izindleko kwemithombo yabantu, yezezimali nangokomzimba. Phatha ucwaningo lwaso kwelapha ngokunakekelwa, intuthuko yomsebenzi wokwelapha ngokunakekelwa namaprogramu okolotshi. Ubusemthethweni okwelapha kanye nokufeza imigomo ebalulekile nemiqondo ehlosiwe yesigaba Sokunakekelwa. Phatha iphrojekthi yeqiniso lokuphatha amaningi okwelapha ngokunakekelwa futhi uthuthukise izinqubomgomo zokwelapha ngokunakekelwa.

xh.title: Umphathi oncedisayo weVukuringa: (INTATHI yeVukuringa)
xh.summary: Qonda ubomi buka Ncinci iZiko, Tyumie, igosa kwaye uncedise nalawula iinkonzo ezikwisikhululo seVukuringa.
xh.requirements: IsiGANezi esingenamgangatho: IsiGANezi iBasiki R425 (njengokuthi ngesiNgesi, isidanga degri kwakhona) okanye esiNgqangisela (R683) esivumela ukubhalisa kwisikhululo saseNingizimu Afrika sikaVukuringa (SANC) njengomVukuringa ohlonithekileyo okanye igosa elibhaliswe kwisikhululo sikaVukuringa saseNingizimu Afrika (SANC). IsiGANezi esiBhalwe kwikhomishini: Ukubhaliswa kwiSANC njengomVukuringa ohlonithekileyo okanye omVukuringa jikelele. Imiba yamava: Inani elingenamva lonyaka oyi-8 kwimisebenzi ehloniphekileyo/eqwalaselwa ngamava emva kokubhaliswa njengomVukuringa ohlonithekileyo kwiSANC kwVukuringa jikelele. Inani elingenamva lonyaka oyi-3 kule minyaka idityaniswe kwindlela ethile kufuneka abe ngumLawuli weMisebenzi ngenqanaba elawulwa kakhulu nguMmeli weNkundla (iKhowudi B/EB). Uyakwazi ukusebenza kwindawo enzima kakhulu.
xh.duties: Kunika iNkqubo nokuQonda ekuQondiseni imisebenzi yokuLawula nekuQhagamshela kwiNkonzo yokuQhagamshela ezingeni elibekiweyo. Ulawula kwaye ulandele iindlela ezibiza ngemali yokusebenzisa abantu, imali namanzi. Ulawula uphando lokuLawula, ukuziphatha nokwenziwa kweNkqubo yokuQeqshwa. Ulawula iNkqubo yoQhagamshelo kweNkqubo yokulawula iNqanaba, amaphupha nemiQongo yoQhagamshelo kweNkqubo elawulwayo. Ulawula iNkqubo yoQinisekiso lomgangatho weNkqubo elungiselelweyo kwaye umQondise iNkqubo yokulungelelanisa iinkqubo ezahlukeneyo.

jobs.title: Operational Manager Nursing Grade 1 (GENERAL Nursing)
jobs.salary_text: R571 161 per annum, (Plus non pensionable rural allowance of 8% of your annual basic salary).
jobs.summary: Operational Manager Nursing Grade 1 position at Ladysmith Hospital, requiring a basic nursing qualification with SANC registration and offering R571,161 per annum plus rural allowance.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the South African Nursing Council as a Professional Nurse. Experience: A minimum of 7 years appropriate/recognisable experience in nursing after registration with SANC as Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid (Code B/EB) driver’s licence. Willingness to perform overtime, after- hours, weekends, standby duties, and assist with shift work when needed. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to promote quality patient care through the setting, implementation and monitoring of standards. Knowledge and understanding of Nursing legislation, related legal ethical nursing practices and framework, as well as labour legislation and relevant public sector policies, guidelines and protocols. Ability to function under pressure, independently and as well as part of a multi-disciplinary team. Good organisational, interpersonal, leadership, decision making, and conflict resolution skills. Basic computer literacy.
jobs.duties: Manage the clinical services and rostering of staff. Responsible for planning, managing, coordinating and maintaining an optimal quality Nursing Service as an Operational Manager in a hospital setting. Participative management and utilization of Human Resources, to fulfil operational and developmental functions in the area. Manage and monitor the Financial Resources, consumables and equipment of the clinical area. Initiate and participate in training, development and research within the nursing department. Deliver a support service to the Nursing Service Department and the institution. Maintain ethical standards and promote professional growth and self-development.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A Laubscher Tel No: (028) 551-1010
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates may be subjected to a competency test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Operational Manager Nursing Grade 1 (GENERAL Nursing)
af.summary: Operational Manager Nursing Grade 1-pos by Ladysmith Hospital, wat 'n basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met SANC-registrasie vereis en R571,161 per jaar plus landelike toelaag bied.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. OF 'n 4-jarige Bachelorsgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die South African Nursing Council as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: 'n Minimum van 7 jaar gepaste/herkenbare ervaring in verpleging na registrasie by SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleging. Inherente vereiste van die werk: 'n Geldige (Code B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk, buite kantoorure, naweke, standby-pligte, en om met skofwerk te help wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om gehalte-pasiëntsorg te bevorder deur die instelling, implementering en monitering van standaarde. Kennis en begrip van verpleegwetgewing, verwante wettige etiese verpleegpraktyke en raamwerk, asook arbeidswetgewing en tersaaklike openbare-sektorbeleid, riglyne en protokolle. Vermoë om onder druk te funksioneer, onafhanklik en asook as deel van 'n multidissiplinêre span. Goeie organisatoriese, interpersoonlike, leierskaps-, besluitnemings- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede. Basiese rekenaargeletterdheid.
af.duties: Bestuur die kliniese dienste en diensrooster van personeel. Verantwoordelik vir beplanning, bestuur, koördinering en die handhawing van 'n optimale gehalte Verpleegdiens as 'n Operasionele Bestuurder in 'n hospitaalomgewing. Deelnemende bestuur en benutting van Menslike Hulpbronne om operasionele en ontwikkelingsfunksies in die area na te kom. Bestuur en monitor die Finansiële Hulpbronne, verbruikbare items en toerusting van die kliniese area. Inisieer en neem deel aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en navorsing binne die verpleegdepartement. Lewer 'n ondersteuningsdiens aan die Verpleegdienste-departement en die instelling. Handhaaf etiese standaarde en bevorder professionele groei en selfontwikkeling.

zu.title: Umphathi Wokusebenza Wezokuhlaliswa Kwesiguli Izinga 1 (EZOKUHLALISWA KWESIGULI JIKELELE)
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaMphathi Wezokusebenza Izinga 1 esibhedlela iLadysmith, sidinga iqualifikheyishini ezezokuhlaliswa kwesiguli ngokomthetho nebhaliwe nabhalile eSANC sinikeza R571,161 ngonyaka kanye nensalo yasezandlwini.
zu.requirements: Imininingwane yemfundo edingekayo: Iqualifikheyishini eyisiseko R425 (okukuthi idiploma/idegri ezokuhlaliswa kwesiguli) noma iqualifikheyishini efanayo (R683 kanye no R254) evumela ukubhaliswa eSigungwini SaseNingizimu Afrika Sezokuhlaliswa Kwesiguli (SANC) njengesiGuli seMisebenzi. Noma Idegri yeminyaka e 4 eNokuhlalisweni Kwesiguli (R174) noma iqualifikheyishini efanayo (R683 kanye no R1497 noma R171 kanye no R1497) evumela ukubhaliswa eSigungwini SaseNingizimu Afrika Sezokuhlaliswa Kwesiguli (SANC) njengesiGuli seMisebenzi. Ukubhaliswa esigungwini somsebenzi: Ukubhaliswa eSigungwini SaseNingizimu Afrika Sezokuhlaliswa Kwesiguli njengesiGuli seMisebenzi. Isipiliyoni: Isikhathi esingaphansi kweminyaka e 7 isipiliyoni esifanele/esiye saphawuleka ezokuhlalisweni kwesiguli emva kokuqanjwa ibhalo eSANC njengesiGuli seMusebenzi Ezokuhlalisweni Jikelele. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (iKhodi B/EB) esevisi. Ukulungele ukwenza isikhathi esinge-nsimi, ngemva weyure, ngezimpelasonto, imisebenzi yokuma iqhaza, kanye nosizo kumsebenzi weshifthi uma kudingeka. Izinkanuko (ulwizi/izkhiworldi): Ikhono lokukhuthaza ukunakekelwa kwesiguli kwizinga eliphezulu ngokuhlela, ukuphefumula nokulawula amazinga. Ulwazi kanye neqondiso loMthetho Wezokuhlaliswa Kwesiguli, izindlela ezihlobene nomthetho zokuhlaliswa ezomoya kanye nosimiso, kanye nomthetho webasebenzi kanye nemigomo, izinkomba namasiko ohulumeni abaningi balowo mbuso. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi kwengcindezi, ngokuzimeleyo nakuba ingxenye yeqembu lezinsizakalo ezibanzi. Amakhono amahle okuhlela, abantu, abaphathi, ukwenza izinqumo, kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ulwazi lomsindo oluyisiseko.
zu.duties: Iphathe amasevisi ezokwelapha kanye nokubeka abasebenzi ohlwini. Ibhekele ukucubungula, ukuphatha, ukulungisa kanye nokugcina isevisi ezinga eliphezulu lezokuhlaliswa kwesiguli njengoMphathi Wezokusebenza esibhedlela. Ukuphathwa ngokubambisana nokusebenzisa abantu, ukufeza imisebenzi yokusebenza nentuthuko endaweni. Iphathe ilungise ummombo wezimali, izinto ezisetyenziswayo nezixhobo zendawo yokwelapha. Qalisa ubambe iqhaza ekufundiseni, entuthukweni nakophandweni ngaphakathi kwabahlaliswa abagulayo. Nikeza isevisi yesekelo kuSevisi Yezokuhlaliswa Kwesiguli nakulesisikhungo. Gcina amazinga okuziphatha ngokomoya futhi ukhuthaze ukukhula komsebenzi nokuzithuthukisa.

xh.title: Umlawuli woKusebenza iNursing inqanaba 1 (iNursing jikelele)
xh.summary: Isithuba sokulawula ukusebenza kweNursing inqanaba 1 esibhedlele iLadysmith, sifuna isidanga esiyingujujvu seNursing ngokubhaliswa kwiSANC sithengisa iR571,161 ngonyaka ngaphezulu kwesixa sokuhlala kwindawo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokufundela esingaphantsi: Isidanga seR425 (oko kukuthi idiploma/isidanga kwiNursing) okanye isidanga esilinganayo (R683 negama R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha weNursing. OKWENZE Isidanga seBachelor kwiminyaka engama4 kwiNursing (R174) okanye isidanga esilinganayo (R683 negama R1497 okanye R171 negama R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengogqirha weNursing. Ukubhaliswa kolawulo lobugcisa: Ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council njengogqirha weNursing. Iimpazamo: Okungenani iiminyaka elishumi elikhulu (7) yamava akufanelekileyo/awasemqamweni kwiNursing emva kokubhaliswa kwiSANC njengogqirha weNursing kuNursing jikelele. Imfuno ekude ikho: Ilayisensi yomqhubi (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ilungelo lokusebenza ngaphezulu kweyure efunekayo, nangaphandle kweeyure ezisesikhundleni, nangaphezu kweekhaya ekuphela kweveki, ukulungelelanisa iinkonzo zokulindileyo, nokunceda ngokuphindaphinda iinkonzo xa kufuneka. Iinkanuko (ulwazi/amakhono): Isipheselelo sokukhuthaza ukhathalo lugula ebungcali ngokumisela, ukuphumeza nokulawula iinqanaba. Ulwazi nokuqonda ukulawulwa kwesoNursing, izenzo ezingafanelekanga ezilawulwa ngumthetho wezokucinga nobugcisa kwindikimba yomthetho, kunye nomthetho wabasebenzi namagqabantshintshi olawulo lomphakathi acethelekileyo, iinkqobo namagqabantshintshi. Isipheselelo sokuqhuba phantsi kwexinzelelo, ngokuzimela nokuba yinxalenye yeqela elinabachwephesha abahlukeneyo. Amakhono alungelelanisa abantu, oonxibelelwano, abalawuli, abathatha izigqibo, nokusombulula iingxaki. Isikhokelo sohlaziyo lolwazi kwiikhompyutha.
xh.duties: Qonda iinkonzo zobuchwephesha zezempilo kwaye ulungelelanise abasebenzi. Uxanduva lokucwangcisa, ukulawula, ukulungelelanisa nokugcina inkonzo ebungcali yeNursing njengeNtatho ulawulo kwizibhedlele. Ulawulo olubandakanyayo nokusebenzisa iZabantu, ukuze kufezeke iinkonzo zokuqhuba nezophuhliso kwindawo elo. Lawula kwaye ulindele AziXhobo ziMali, izinto ezithengwayo nezixhobo zendawo yokwamkela iigulana. Qalisa kwaye uthathe inxaxheba kwiziqendu zokuqeqesha, zokuphuhlisa nenzwolvo kwisebe leNursing. Yiba ngumncedi weNkonzo yeNursing kwisebe nakwisikhululo. Gcina iinqanaba zobugcisa kwaye ukhuthaze ukhula kobuchwephesha nokuziphuhlisa.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 2 (SPECIALTY: Psychiatry)
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R495 423 per annum Grade 2: R607 350 per annum
jobs.summary: Provide holistic psychiatric nursing care at Groote Schuur Hospital in Observatory, requiring SANC registration and a post-basic qualification in advanced psychiatric nursing.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: R425 qualification (i.e. diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R880 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post-basic nursing qualification with a duration of at least 1 year accredited with the SANC in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OR A 4 year Bachelor Degree in Nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. A post graduate diploma (R635) accredited with the SANC in Mental Health Nursing. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: A Minimum of 4 years appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 2: A minimum of 14 years appropriate/ recognisable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse in General Nursing. At least 10 years of the period referred to above must be appropriate/recognizable experience after obtaining the one-year post-basic qualification (R212) or a post graduate diploma (R635) in the relevant specialty. Inherent requirements of the job: To work shifts and after-hours including weekends, public holidays and night duty. To rotate to other departments within the psychiatry unit. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Sound knowledge and understanding of nursing and health service related acts, legislation, policies and practices. Problem solving, report writing, liaison and facilitation skills. Basic computer skills in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and use of Internet. Ability to lift and turn patients, stand for long hours and lift heavy equipment.
jobs.duties: Provide an optimal, holistic, specialised Nursing Care within set standards and within a professional, legal framework as a Professional Nurse in Mental Health wards/units. Maintain a constructive working relationship with nursing and other stakeholders. Utilise human, material and physical resources efficiently and effectively. Participate in research and training and development of community, staff and students to achieve optimal health care and rehabilitation of Mental Health patients. Deliver an effective outreach service. Assist with administrative duties, e.g., data collation and reporting.
jobs.enquiries: Ms A Meiring Tel No: (021) 404-3172
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Short-listed candidates may be subjected to a compulsory competency test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in the post- basic qualification or post-graduate qualification in the relevant specialty. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 2 (SPESIALITEIT: Psigiatrie)
af.summary: Verskaf holistiese psigiatriese verpleegsorg by Groote Schuur-hospitaal in Observatory, wat SANC-registrasie en 'n post-basiese kwalifikasie in gevorderde psigiatriese verpleegkunde vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R880 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Post-basiese verpleegkwalifikasie met 'n duur van ten minste 1 jaar wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). OF 'n 4-jarige Baccalaureusgraad in Verpleegkunde (R174) of gelykwaardige kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige moontlik maak. 'n Nagraadse diploma (R635) wat by die SANC geakkrediteer is in Mental Health Nursing. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as Professionele Verpleegkundige. Ervaring: Graad 1: 'n Minimum van 4 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 14 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Ten minste 10 jaar van bogenoemde periode moet toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring wees na verkryging van die eenjaar post-basiese kwalifikasie (R212) of 'n nagraadse diploma (R635) in die tersaaklike spesialiteitsrigting. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Werk skofte en buite-kantoorure insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae en nagdiens. Roteer na ander departemente binne die psigiatrie-eenheid. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Deeglike kennis en begrip van verpleeg- en gesondheidsdiens-verwante wette, wetgewing, beleide en praktyke. Vaardighede in probleemoplossing, verslagskrywing, skakeling en fasilitering. Basiese rekenaarvaardighede in MS Word, Excel, Outlook en gebruik van die Internet. Vermoë om pasiënte op te tel en om te draai, vir lang ure te staan en swaar toerusting op te tel.
af.duties: Verskaf optimale, holistiese, gespesialiseerde verpleegsorg binne vasgestelde standaarde en binne 'n professionele, regsraamwerk as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Mental Health-afdelings/eenhede. Onderhou 'n konstruktiewe werksverhouding met verpleegpersoneel en ander belanghebbendes. Benut menslike, materiële en fisieke hulpbronne doeltreffend en effektief. Neem deel aan navorsing en opleiding en ontwikkeling van die gemeenskap, personeel en studente om optimale gesondheidsorg en rehabilitasie van Mental Health-pasiënte te bereik. Lewer 'n effektiewe uitbreidingsdiens. Help met administratiewe pligte, bv. data-insameling en verslagdoening.

zu.title: Isebenza njengesiKhundla seBhedeshi Esiphakeme esiBhedeshi seBhedeshi kuya kwesiBhedeshi 2 (INkokhelo: Izezinguqondo)
zu.summary: Ukunikela ngokunakekelwa kwengqondo okuhlanganisiwe eGroote Schuur Hospital eObservatory, kufuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC kanye nesifundo semva kwesidingo ekuhlengweni kwengqondo ephakeme kakhulu.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ezingaphansi: R425 qualification (okungukuthi idiploma/idigri ekuhlengweni) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 plus R880 plus R254) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo-Qakambhekwa. Isifundo sokuhlenga semva kwesidingo esincane senyanga eyodwa esamukelekwe yi-SANC kwi-Advanced Psychiatric Nursing Science (R212). Noma I-digri yeminyaka emi-4 ekuhlengweni (R174) noma isifundo esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengo-Qakambhekwa. I-diploma yesikhundla esiphezulu semfundo (R635) esamukelekwe yi-SANC ekuhlengweni kwezempilo yengqondo. Ukubhaliswa kwabhebhi abangcweli: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengo-Qakambhekwa. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-4 yesipiliyoni esifanele/sesabalele ekuhlengweni emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengo-Qakambhekwa ekuhlengweni jikelele. Izinga 2: Okungenani iminyaka eyi-14 yesipiliyoni esifanele/ sesabalele ekuhlengweni emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengo-Qakambhekwa ekuhlengweni jikelele. Okungenani iminyaka eyi-10 yesikhathi esishiwo ngenhla kumele ibe yisipiliyoni esifanele/esesabalele emva kokuthola isifundo semva kwesidingo senyanga eyodwa (R212) noma i-diploma yesikhundla esiphezulu semfundo (R635) enkoleni ebandakanyekayo. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukusebenza ngokushintshashintsha kwesikhathi nangemva kwamasikhathi okuqasha kuhlanganise izinsuku zokuphumula, izinsuku zomphakathi zokuphumula kanye nomsebenzi wesikhathi esbusuku. Ukujikelezela kwabanye eminyangweni ngaphakathi kwecandelo lezokuqina kwengqondo. Izindlela (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi olujulile nokuqonda komthetho wezokuhlenga kanye nomthetho wezinsizakusebenza zezempilo, umthetho, imigomo kanye namasu. Amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukubhala imibiko, ukuxhumana kanye nokukhuthaza. Izikhali eziyisisekelo zekhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel, Outlook kanye nokusebenzisa i-Internet. Ikakhulu ukuphakamisa kanye nokujikeleza abaguli, ukuma isikhathi eside kanye nokuphakamisa izinto ezinzima.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa kwabaguli okusezingeni eliphezulu, okuhlanganisiwe, okukhethekile kokuhlengwa kanti kuhambisana nemigomo emisiwe nangaphakathi kwesakhiwo esisemthethweni, esikhundweni sobhededeli njengo-Qakambhekwa bokuhlinzeka kwempilo yengqondo kumagumbi/amacandelo abaguli. Gcina ubudlelwano obuhle bokusebenza nabahlengi kanye nabanye abahlosiwe. Sebenzisa izinsizakusebenza zobuntu, izinto kanye nemizuzu ngokusebenza kahle nangempumelelo. Yiba yingxenye kolwazi lokufunda nokucutshungulwa kolwazi, kanye nentuthuko yomphakathi, abasebenzi kanye nabafundi ukuze kufinyelelwe ekunakekelweni kwempilo yengqondo nokulungisweni kwemfanelo kwabaguli bezezinguqondo. Nikeza insiza yokuhibua ephumelelayo. Siza imisebenzi yolawulo, njengokuqoqa ukwaziswa nokubika.

xh.title: Inesi yoNqanaba 1 ukuya ku-2 (INDAWO: Ukulunyanga kolunyango lwengqondo)
xh.summary: Nika unyango lweNesi lwepyschiyatri olubandakanya yonke imicimbi eGroote Schuur Hospital eObservatory, kufuneka abhaliswe kwiSANC abe nesigqibo sobudlelwane beNursing emva kwesiseko kwinkqubo ephantsi yolunyango lwepyschiyatri oluphakamileyo.
xh.requirements: IsiNgqiqo sobudlelwane bemfundo esingaphantsi: Isigqibo seR425 (okt. idiploma/idigri ekunyangesi) okt. isigqibo esilinganayo (R683 plus R880 plus R254) esivumela ubhaliso ngeSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNesi weNqanaba eliphezulu. Isigqibo sokunyangesi emva kokufunda okuyimfuneko esithatha ubuncinane unyaka o-1 oqatyiweyo ngeSANC ekunyangesi ePhakamileyo leSayensi yePsychiatric (R212). OKT. Idigri yeBachelor yeminyaka e-4 ekunyangesi (R174) okt. isigqibo esilinganayo (R683 plus R1497 okt. R171 plus R1497) esivumela ubhaliso ngeSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengoNesi weNqanaba eliphezulu. Idiploma yemfundo ephezulu (R635) eqatyiweyo ngeSANC kuNursing yeMental Health. Ubhaliso koluntu olusesigqibele: Ubhaliso ngeSANC njengoNesi weNqanaba eliphezulu. Isipili sokusebenza: Inqanaba 1: Ubuncinane beminyaka emi-4 yamava obudlelwane/okuqatyiweyo ekunyangesi emva kobhaliso ngeSANC njengoNesi weNqanaba eliphezulu kuNursing eQobo. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane beminyaka eli-14 yamava obudlelwane/okuqatyiweyo ekunyangesi emva kobhaliso ngeSANC njengoNesi weNqanaba eliphezulu kuNursing eQobo. Ubuncinane iminyaka eli-10 yexesha elithethwe ngasentla kufuneka ibe ngamava obudlelwane/okuqatyiweyo emva kokufumana isigqibo sonyaka o-1 sokunyangesa emva kwesiseko (R212) okt. idiploma yemfundo ephezulu (R635) kule ndawo ichanekileyo. Iimfuno ezifuzekileyo zale misebenzi: Ukusebenza ngokutshintsha iishifti nangeminye yemiyehzo ithatha ixesha elide kuquka iweekends, iholide zabantu kunye nobuso bomtsha. Ukujikeleza kumanye amasebe ngaphakathi kweyuniti yePsychiatric. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluzinzileyo lokuqonda ngokucacileyo kwemithetho yolawulo, iindlela zomthetho, iinkqubo nomzobo ekunyangesi nakwinkonzo yeempilo. Amakhono okuxazulula iingxaki, ukubhala iingxelo, unxibelelwano nokukhokela. Amakhono obuchwephesha abhalayo asezantsi kwiMS Word, Excel, Outlook nasekusetyenzisweni kwe-Internet. Amandla okuphakamisa ajikeleze abaguli, ukuma ixesha elide nokuphakamisa izixhobo ezinzima.
xh.duties: Nika unyango lweNesi olulungileyo, olubandakanya yonke imicimbi, oluchanekileyo ngaphakathi kwemigangatho elungisiweyo nakulwimeko olusesigqibele, olusemthethweni njengoNesi weNqanaba eliphezulu kumagumbi/iiyuniti zeMental Health. Gcina ubudlelwane obusebenzayo obukhuselekileyo nabasebenzi beNesi nakwabanye bachaphela kule misebenzi. Sebenzisa ngokusebenziseka kunye nokuvela amandla abantu, izinto ezibonakalayo nezingabonakaliyo. Thatha inxaxheba kutyhalo-malo, nakwimfundo nophuhliso loluntu, abasebenzi naba-fundi ukuze kufikelelwe konyango olulungileyo nelungisa abaguli beMental Health. Zisa inkonzo ethintela abantu endawini zisebenze ngokuchanekileyo. Nceda nemisebenzi yolawulo, umz., ukuqokelela idatha nokubika.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Change Management
jobs.summary: Lead change management initiatives at the Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office, ensuring alignment with departmental strategies and DPSA frameworks.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate 3-year National Diploma/B- Degree (NQF 6 or higher) in Human Resource Management, Organisational Development, Industrial Psychology or a related field. A recognised Change Management accreditation or certification (e.g. Prosci or similar) will be advantageous. Experience: Appropriate experience in change management, organisational development or a related environment. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid Code 8 (B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Knowledge of change management principles, models and methodologies. Knowledge of organisational culture and leadership theory and models. Good verbal and written communication skills, including facilitation and report writing. Diagnostic and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret organisational data and identify emerging themes. Good interpersonal, stakeholder engagement and influencing skills. Sound practical computer skills in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook and Teams. Preparedness to work overtime, travel and stay overnight when required.
jobs.duties: Ensure change management activities align with departmental strategies, DPSA frameworks and policies through research, analysis, interpretation and advisory support, and contribute to the translation of these frameworks into practical implementation approaches. Facilitation and implementation of Change Interventions and initiatives through stakeholder engagement, coaching and structured facilitation to drive adoption. Co-ordinate and execute organisational surveys to track organisational transformation change and participate in procurement processes. Reporting, Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E) on change management activities and ensure accurate and consolidated information for departmental decision making. Operational planning, People Management and Financial Management responsibilities i.e. day-to-day supervision of staff, workflow and operations management, procurement, contract and asset management, compliance monitoring with departmental policies.
jobs.enquiries: Ms F Heunis Tel No: (021) 483-6531
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates will be subjected to a practical test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Assistent-direkteur: Veranderingsbestuur
af.summary: Neem die leiding oor veranderingsbestuursinisiatiewe by die Hoofkantoor van die Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness en verseker belyning met departementele strategieë en DPSA-raamwerke.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike 3-jarige Nasionale Diploma/B-Graad (NQF 6 of hoër) in Menslike Hulpbronbestuur, Organisasie-ontwikkeling, Bedryfsielkunde of 'n verwante veld. 'n Erkende veranderingsbestuursakkreditasie of sertifikaat (bv. Prosci of soortgelyk) sal voordelig wees. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in veranderingsbestuur, organisasie-ontwikkeling of 'n verwante omgewing. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Geldige Code 8 (B/EB) bestuurslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Kennis van veranderingsbestuursbeginsels, modelle en metodologieë. Kennis van organisatoriese kultuur en leierskapsteorie en modelle. Goeie mondelingse en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede, insluitend fasilitering en verslagskrywing. Diagnostiese en analitiese vaardighede, insluitend die vermoë om organisatoriese data te interpreteer en opkomende temas te identifiseer. Goeie interpersoonlike, belanghebbende-betrokkenheids- en beïnvloedingsvaardighede. Klank praktiese rekenaarvaardighede in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook en Teams. Bereidwilligheid om oortyd te werk, te reis en oor te bly wanneer nodig.
af.duties: Verseker dat veranderingsbestuursaktiwiteite belyn is met departementele strategieë, DPSA-raamwerke en beleide deur navorsing, analise, interpretasie en adviesondersteuning, en dra by tot die vertaling van hierdie raamwerke in praktiese implementeringsbenaderings. Fasilitering en implementering van veranderingsingrypings en inisiatiewe deur belanghebbende-betrokkenheid, afrigting en gestruktureerde fasilitering om aanvaarding te bevorder. Koördineer en voer organisasie-opnames uit om organisatoriese transformasieverandering op te spoor en neem deel aanverkrygingsprosesse. Rapportering, monitering en evaluering (M&E) van veranderingsbestuursaktiwiteite en verseker akkurate en gekonsolideerde inligting vir departementele besluitneming. Operasionele beplanning, personeelbestuur en finansiële bestuursverantwoordelikhede d.w.s. daaglikse toesig van personeel, werksvloei- en operasionele bestuur, verkryging, kontrak- en batesbestuur, nakomingsmonitering met departementele beleide.

zu.title: Umjadi Weziqu: Eziphathwa Inguquko
zu.summary: Hola izinhlela zokuphatha inguquko e-Head Office yase- Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness, ukuqinisekisa ukuvumelana nezindlela zomnyango nezinhlelo zika-DPSA.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi: I-National Diploma/B-Degree (NQF 6 noma ngaphezulu) ehambisana neminyaka eyi-3 kwi-Human Resource Management, Organisational Development, Industrial Psychology noma isikhundla ohlobene naso. Isitifiketi noma iziqu ezedlule ezingashukumisi okuthile sokuphatha inguquko (isb. Prosci noma okufanayo) kuzoba umusa. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esihambisana nokuphatha inguquko, intuthuko yenhlangano noma endaweni ehlobene nayo. Isidingo esingaphakathi kwemisebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code 8 (B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukwaziswa/Amakhono: Ulwazi ngezinhlelo, izifanekiso kanye nezindlela zokuphatha inguquko. Ulwazi ngamasiko enhlangano kanye nolithiyori namafomula wobuholi. Amakhono amahle okukhuluma nokubhala, ahlanganisa ukubusa umbhinqo kanye nokubhala imibiko. Amakhono okuhlola nokuhlaziya, ahlanganisa ikhono lokutshula imininingwane yenhlangano nokubona izihloko eziphuma. Amakhono amahle ohlotshaniswa nabantu, okuxhuma nabantu abahlukene kanye nokuqinisekisa okuhle okwembula. Amakhono esikhompiya aqinisekileyo ekuqoqweni kwe-MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Outlook kanye ne-Teams. Ulungelelweni lokusebenza ngaphezu kwesikhathi, ukuhamba kwaye uhlale ebusuku xa kudingeka.
zu.duties: Qinisekisa ukuzivumelanisa kokusebenza kwezokusonta ekuqoqweni kwamasu omnyango, izakhiwo kanye nemigomo ka-DPSA ngokucwaninga, ukuhlola, ukuqonda kanye nokuqinisekisa ingxoxo, kwaye ungenele ekuguqulweni kwale mithetho ibe ziindlela zokuzisebenzela ezisebenzayo. Ukubusa kwaye kuqatshwe ngokuhamba phambili kwezinto ezinguqukayo ngokubamba abantu, ukufundisa nokubusa ngokuhlelo ukuze kugqitywe. Hlanganisa kwaye wenze izibali zenhlangano ukuze ulandelele inguquko yenhlangano kwaye ungenelele ezinkundleni zokuthenga. Iimfundo ngokusuka nokubuyela kwaye kuqatywe isimo (M&E) kwemisebenzi yokuguqukayo kwaye uqinisekise ukuba yimininingwane echankcileyo neqotywe ngokuhambela kumagqibo womnyango. Ukuqoqa izicwangciso, ukulawula abantu kwaye kubekho iMali kwaye kugqitywe ngemisebenzi ngokulawula i-aphehliwe, ukulungelelanisa umsebenzi, ukuqamba nokulawula ukuthenga, iinketho namaxwebhu okulawula, ukuqinisekisa ukutshatyalaliswa kolwazi ngemithetho yomnyango.

xh.title: Ikomkhulu Encedisayo: ULawulo Lwotshintsho
xh.summary: Khokela iinkqubo zolawulo lotshintsho eWestern Cape Department of Health and Wellness Head Office, kuqinisekiswa ukuhambelana neenjongo zesebe neenkqubo ze-DPSA.
xh.requirements: Isidingo somgangatho wemfundo: I-National Diploma/B- Degree (NQF 6 okanye ngaphezulu) yeminyaka emi-3 efanelekileyo kuLawulo LweZabantu, uQuqumbo lweSebe, iNtshontsho yeNgqondo yoShishino okwalo naliphi na icebo elidibana nalo. Iqinisekiso okanye isatifikethi esamkelweyo soLawulo loTshintsho (umz. iProsci okwaSafane nako) siza kubakho nzuzo. Imfundo: Imfundo efanelekileyo kulawulo lotshintsho, uququmbo lwisebe okwalo naliphi na icebo elidibana nalo. Isidingo esingenisa umsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela ye-Code 8 (B/EB) esemthethweni. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi ngeemvisiswano, iimodeli neendlela zolawulo lotshintsho. Ulwazi ngamasiko elsebe nolwazi ngabaphathi namamodeli. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelanisela nokubhala ngomlomo nakubhalwe, kuquka nokulunga nokubhala iingxelo. Ikhono lokuxilonga nokuqamba, kuquka nakhono ukutolikira iingcombolo zesebe nokuqaphela iimbonakaliso ezisanda kuvela. Ikhono elihle lokunxibelelana nabantu, ukuzibandakanya nabahlomuli nokuba namandla okuthonya. Ikhono elisebenzayo lekhompyutha ku-MS Office (iWord, iExcel, iPowerPoint), iOutlook kunye neeTeams. ulungelelwaniso lokusebenza ixesha elide, ukuhamba kwaye ulale ngaphandle kwekhaya xa kufuneka.
xh.duties: Qinisekisa ukuba imisebenzi yolawulo lotshintsho ihambelana neenjongo zesebe, iinkqubo ze-DPSA namagunya ngophando, lonxulumaniso, inkcukacha nezixelo, kwaye ungenelele ekuguqulweni ezi nkqubo zibe ngendlela ezisebenzayo yokuziphumeza. Qondisa kwaye usebenzise ukungenela kolawulo lotshintsho nemiqobo ngokuzibandakanya nabahlomuli, ukulunga nokukhokela ngendlela echanekileyo ukuze kugqitywe kukusetyenziswa. Lungisa kwaye uqhube imibuzo yesebe ukulandela iinguquko zolawulo lwesehlo kwaye ungenelele kwiinkqubo zokuzelelwa koluntu. Iingxelo, Ulawulo Lolwazi nokuLinganisa (M&E) kwimisebenzi yolawulo lotshintsho kwaye uqinisekise ulwazi oluchanekileyo noludityanisiweyo malunga nokwenza izigqibo zesebe. Uqhelaniso lwezicwangciso, uLawulo labaBantu noLawulo leeMali, oko kukuthi, ulawulo lwemihla ngemihla labasebenzi, ulawulo lwemisebenzi nokusebenza, ukuzelelwa koluntu, ulawulo lweentengiso kunye namafa, nokuqwalasela ukuthobela iinkqubo zesebe.

jobs.title: Assistant Director: Expenditure Analysis and Management
jobs.centre: Head Office, Cape Town, stationed at Bellville Health Park in Bellville
jobs.summary: Assistant Director for expenditure analysis and management at the Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness, based in Bellville, requiring a relevant diploma or degree and financial data analysis experience.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: An appropriate 3-year National Diploma/Degree (e.g. IT, Data Science, Finance, Accounting, or others subject with numerical orientation) (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate experience in financial data analysis, management accounting, financial administration, budgeting, costing or financial reporting. Appropriate experience in the advanced use of Microsoft Excel. Appropriate experience in the use of database management and analytics tools such as Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, Power Query and VBA programming. Inherent requirements of the job: Valid Code B/EB driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills); Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Demonstrated ability to analyse large, complex datasets, perform data cleaning and transformation, and generate actionable insights to support decision-making. Knowledge of management accounting, budgeting, financial modelling, data analytics and business intelligence, with the ability to analyse and interpret complex financial and operational information. Advanced computer literacy, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel (advanced functions, Power Query and/or Power Pivot), Microsoft Access, SQL Server, Power BI and other data analytics and reporting tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical thinking skills, with the ability to develop practical, evidence-based solutions. Proven people management, coaching and staff development skills. Excellent interpersonal, communication, stakeholder engagement and conflict resolution skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across all organisational levels and independently where required.
jobs.duties: Lead financial modelling and database management activities that support strategic planning, budgeting and decision-making. Analyse and interpret complex financial and non-financial information, providing evidence-based insights and recommendations to management. Oversee data governance, including data extraction, validation and quality assurance, to ensure the integrity and quality of financial and management information. Continuously review the effectiveness of existing databases and financial reporting models and develop automated reporting solutions. Monitor expenditure, cash flow and budget performance through forecasting and variance analysis to promote sound financial management. Prepare cost estimates, financial assessments and supporting analyses to inform planning, budgeting and resource allocation. Build organisational analytical capability by providing technical guidance and training to Sectors and Institutions on forecasting methodologies, financial reporting and the interpretation of management information. Manage and develop staff to ensure the effective delivery of financial analytical services.

It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Assistentdirekteur: Bestedingsanalise en -bestuur
af.summary: Assistentdirekteur vir bestedingsanalise en -bestuur by die Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness, gebaseer in Bellville, wat 'n toepaslike diploma of graad en ervaring in finansiële data-analise vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Toepaslike 3-jaar Nasionale Diploma/Degraad (bv. IT, Datawetenskap, Finansies, Rekeningkunde, of ander vak met 'n numeriese oriëntasie) (of ekwivalent). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in finansiële data-analise, bestuursrekeningkunde, finansiële administrasie, begroting, kosteberekening of finansiële verslagdoening. Toepaslike ervaring in die gevorderde gebruik van Microsoft Excel. Toepaslike ervaring in die gebruik van databasisbestuur en analitiese gereedskap soos Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, Power Query en VBA-programmering. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige Code B/EB-bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede); Gevorderde vaardigheid in Microsoft Excel. Agetoonde vermoë om groot, komplekse datastelle te analiseer, datasuiwering en -transformasie uit te voer, en bruikbare insigte te genereer om besluitneming te ondersteun. Kennis van bestuursrekeningkunde, begroting, finansiële modellering, data-analitiek en besigheidsintelligensie, met die vermoë om komplekse finansiële en operasionele inligting te analiseer en te interpreteer. Gevorderde rekenaarvaardigheid, insluitend vaardigheid in Microsoft Excel (gevorderde funksies, Power Query en/of Power Pivot), Microsoft Access, SQL Server, Power BI en ander data-analitiek- en verslagdoeningsgereedskap. Ster analitiese, probleemoplossings- en kritiese denkvaardighede, met die vermoë om praktiese, bewysgebaseerde oplossings te ontwikkel. Bewese personeelsbestuurs-, afrigtings- en personeelsontwikkingsvaardighede. Uitstekende interpersoonlike, kommunikasie, belanghebbende-betrokkenheids- en konflikoplossingsvaardighede, met die vermoë om samewerkend oor alle organisatoriese vlakke te werk en onafhanklik waar nodig.
af.duties: Lei finansiële modellering en databasisbestuursaktiwiteite wat strategiese beplanning, begroting en besluitneming ondersteun. Analiseer en interpreteer komplekse finansiële en nie-finansiële inligting en verskaf bewysgebaseerde insigte en voorstelle aan bestuur. Hou toesig oor data-goeweransie, insluitend data-onttrekking, -validering en -kwaliteitsversekering, om die integriteit en kwaliteit van finansiële en bestuursinligting te verseker. Hersien voortdurend die doeltreffendheid van bestaande databasisse en finansiële verslagdoeningsmodelle en ontwikkel outomatiese verslagdoeningsoplossings. Monitor besteding, kontantvloei en begrotingsprestasie deur middel van vooruitskatting en variansie-analise om gesonde finansiële bestuur te bevorder. Berei kosteskattings, finansiële assesserings en ondersteunende analise voor om beplanning, begroting en hulpbrontoewysing te inlig. Bou organisatoriese analitiese vermoë deur tegniese leiding en opleiding aan Sektore en Instellings te verskaf oor vooruitskattingsmetodes, finansiële verslagdoening en die interpretasie van bestuursinligting. Bestuur en ontwikkel personeel om die doeltreffende levering van finansiële analitiese dienste te verseker.

zu.title: Ngumlungise-assistant: Ukuhlaziya nokuphathwa kwezimali
zu.summary: Ngumlungise-assistant ohola ukuhlaziya nokuphathwa kwezimali Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness, ohlezi e-Bellville, ofuna i-diploma noma izebe ezifanele kanye nesipiliyono sokuhlaziya idatha yemali.
zu.requirements: Izidingo ezincane zemfundo: I-diploma/izebe leqembu lelizwe kwiminyaka elingama-3 (isb. IT, Data Science, Finance, Accounting, noma enye into enemigcoce eqondene nezibalo) (noma okulingana). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele ekuhlaziyeni idatha yemali, ekubhalweni kwezibalo zokuphathwa kwezimali, ekuphathweni kwezengxenye zemali, ekwakheeleni izabelo, ekuqondeniseni izindleko noma ekubikenweni ngemali. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekusetshenzisweni okuphambili kwe-Microsoft Excel. Isipiliyoni esifanele ekusetshenzisweni kokuphathwa kwezindaba zenano lemininingwane nezixhobo zokuhlaziya njenge-Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, Power Query kanye ngenqubo yokuhlela i-VBA. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisense yomshayeli ebekwe ngokomthetho ye-Code B/EB. Amandla (ulwazi/izikilla); Ubuqotho obuphambili kwi-Microsoft Excel. Ikhono elibonisiwe lokuhlaziya idatha enkulu enobungako obuyinkimbinkimbi, ukwenza ukuhlela idatha kanye nokuguqula idatha, futhi ukhiqize izibonelelo ezenza umsebenzi ukuxhasa ukuthathwa kwezinqumo. Ulwazi ngokubhala izibalo zokuphathwa kwezimali, ukwakheela izabelo, ukwakheela izibalo ezimali, ukuhlaziya idatha kanye nolwazi ngoshintsho lohwebo, ngekhono lokuhlaziya nokuchaza ulwazi oluyinkimbinkimbi ngemali nolusebenzayo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha ngezinga eliphezulu, okuhlanganisa ubuqotho kwi-Microsoft Excel (imisebenzi eyisilingo, Power Query kanye/noma i-Power Pivot), Microsoft Access, SQL Server, Power BI nezinye izixhobo zokuhlaziya idatha nokubika. Amandla amakhulu okuhlaziya, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokucabanga ngokujulile, ngekhono lokuthuthukisa izixazululo ezisebenzayo, eziyisizindalwazi. Amandla abonisiwe okuphatha abantu, ukwelisa kanye nophuhliso lwabasebenzi. Amandla aphezulu wokuxhumana nabantu, ukuxhumana, ukubamba iqhaza kubahloximba kanye noxhaxha lokuxazulula izinkinga, ngekhono lokusebenza ngokubambisana kumazinga onke ahleliwe kanye nokusebenza kodwa lapho kudingeka khona.
zu.duties: Hola imisebenzi yokwakheela izibalo ezimalini nokuphathwa kwezindaba zenani lemininingwane exhasa ukuhlelelwa ngokomgomo, ukwakheela izabelo nokuthathwa kwezinqumo. Hlaziya futhi umchaze ulwazi oluyinkimbinkimbi ngemali nolungeho iye emalini, unikeze izincomo nezibalo eziyisizindalwazi ezixhasa ukuthathwa kwezinqumo kubaphathi. Qaphela ukuphathwa kwezobulungisi benaningwane, okuhlanganisa ukukhipha, ukuqinisekiswa kanye nenani elihle lenani lemininingwane yemali nokuqondiswa kwayo. Phindaphinda ubuke impilo yezinhlaka zenaningwane ezikhona namaphathihibhidi ezibalo ezimalini, uphinde ucacise izixazululo ezizenzakalayo zokubika. Landa ukusetshenziswa kwemali, ukuhamba kwenani lemali nokusebenza kwesabelo ngezinhlolo eziyisibonakaliso nokuhlaziya okuhlukahlukene ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukuphathwa kahle kwezimali. Lungiselela izilinganiso ezimalini, izibalo eziyisilinganiso kanye nohluko oluxhasayo ukuze kuxhaswe ukuhlelelwa, ukwakheela izabelo nokuhlela abasebenzi. Yakha ikhono lokuhlaziya elisezingeni eliphezulu ngokunikeza inkombandlela yolwazi lwemisebenzi nokolunye uhlelo kumango namasiko mayelana nezindlela zokubikeka, ukubika ngemali kanye nokuchaza ulwazi oluphathwayo. Phatha futhi uphuhlise abasebenzi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukulethwa okusebenzayo kwezinsiza zokuhlaziya izimali.

xh.title: Umncedisi woMlawuli: Ulwazi lwokuCwayiza nokuLawula
xh.summary: Umncedisi woMlawuli wolwazi lokucwayiza nolawulo kwisebe leRhwebo loMhlaba jikelele lezeMpilo nokuZinza, esekwa Bellville, lifuna i-diploma okanye i-degree edibelayo namava wolwazi lwezimali.
xh.requirements: Isifundo esingakumbi: I-National Diploma/Degree yeminyaka eli-3 edibelayo (umzekelo IT, Data Science, Finance, Accounting, okanye enye into enamanani) (okanye ezingaqabanisiyo). Amava: Amava adibelayo kulwazi lokuhlola iidatha zezimali, ukuqulunqa i-akhawunti kolawulo, ulawulo lwezimali, uqokelelo lwetyala, ukubala iindleko okanye iingxelo zezimali. Amava adibelayo ekusebenziseni ngobugcisa iMicrosoft Excel. Amava adibelayo ekusebenziseni izixhobo zolawulo nedatha ezinje ngoMicrosoft Azure, SQL Server, Power Query nokulungiselela iVBA. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwomsebenzi: Ilayisenisi yomqhubi ye-Code B/EB esebenzayo. Ikhono (ulwazi/amaxhoba); Ulwazi olugqithisileyo kwiMicrosoft Excel. Ulawulo olubonakaliswayo lokuhlola iidatha ezinkulu nezintsokothileyo, ukucoca iidatha nokutshintsha, nokwenza iziphakamiso ezinceda ekwenzeni izigqibo. Ulwazi lokuqulunqa i-akhawunti kolawulo, uqokelelo lwetyala, ukwakhiwa kwemodeli yezimali, uhlalutyo lwedatha nokuqonda kwamashishino, anelokhuselo lokuhlola nokutolika ulwazi olutsokothileyo lwezimali nolwemisebenzi. Ulwazi olugqithisileyo lwekhompyutha, kuquka ulwazi kwiMicrosoft Excel (iinkqubo ezugqithisileyo, Power Query kwaye/okanye iPower Pivot), iMicrosoft Access, SQL Server, Power BI nezinye izixhobo zohlalutyo lwedatha nokuvelisa iingxelo. Ikhono eliqinileyo lokuhlola, ukusombulula iingxaki nokuqonda ngokuningi, nelokwakhiwa izisombululo ezisekelwe kwiziqinisekiso ezisebenzayo. Ikhono elibonisiweyo lokulawula abantu, ukuba ngumceli mfunyezo nokuqhutywa kwabasebenzi. Ikhono elingcamla lokusebenzisana nabantu, nokuthetha naye nabani na, nokuzibandakanya nabanikelo basemngciphekweni nokusombulula iingxabano, nelokusebenza ngokubambisana nakuzo naziphi na iinqanaba zoluntu nakwimeko edingekayo ngokwodwa.
xh.duties: Qhubele phambili ukwakhiwa kwemodeli yezimali nemisebenzi yolawulo lwedatha exhasa uqoqosho, uqokelelo lwezimali nokuqamba iigqibo. Hlola nokutolika ulwazi olutsokothileyo lwezimali nolungewazimali, unikeze iziphakamiso ezisekelwe kwiziqinisekiso kuqeqesho. Qwalasela ulawulo lwedatha, kuquka ukutsalwa kwedatha, ukuqinisekisa nokuqinisekisa umgangatho, ukuqinisekisa ukuzinza nomgangatho wolwazi lwezimali nolawulo. Phinda ubuyekeze ukusebenza kwee-database ezikhoyo nakuze iimodeli zengxelo yezimali, uze uphehlele iindlela ezizenzekelayo zokuvelisa iingxelo. Qhathanisa iindleko, ukuhamba kwemali kanye nokuqokelelwa kwezimali ngokohlolo nangezinto ezingqamileyo ukuze kukhuthazwe ulawulo oluhle lwemali. Lungiselela ukulinganisela iindleko, iintlupelo zezimali nokuhlalutya okuxhasayo ukuze kuqondwe uqoqosho, uqokelelo lwetyala nolwandiso lwezibonelelo. Yakha ikhono loluntu lokuhlalutya ngokunika ingcebiso yobugcisa noqeqesho kumacandelo nakuBumba ngendlela zokuqikelela, iingxelo zezimali nokutolika kolawulo lwedatha. Lawula uphuhlise abasebenzi ukuqinisekisa ukufikelelwa ngokuchanekileyo iinkonzo zohlalutyo lwezimali.

jobs.title: Industrial Technician Supervisor: Clinical Engineering (X
jobs.summary: Supervise clinical engineering at Tygerberg Hospital, performing electro-mechanical repairs and maintenance on medical imaging and X-ray equipment.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: A National Diploma, (T, S or N Stream in Light Current Electrical- Engineering Field) or a B-tech degree in Electronic or Mechanical engineering. Experience: Appropriate proven previous repair and maintenance knowledge and experience in Medical Imaging Equipment (including X-rays). Appropriate experience in the installation of medical X-ray equipment and QA assessment. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid Code B (Code 08) driver's license. Perform standby and after hour call-out duties. Perform overtime functions when required. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Well-developed electronic, electrical and mechanical technical service and repair skills and knowledge. Ability to carry out basic mechanical repairs. Possess accurate technical ability and insight in order to identify and solve technical problems. Ability to perform fault finding down to component level by means of circuit diagrams and test gear. Ability to make use of various basic and sophisticated hand tools, power tools, machinery and test equipment to carry out functions. Computer literate (MS -Word, -Excel and -Access). -Good communication skills (written and verbal). Ability to perform administrative functions. Ability to work as a team member and on occasions on own initiative with the minimum supervision. Ability to organize and plan tasks and functions. Ability to provide on the job training and monitoring of junior technicians. Ability to perform supervisory functions. Sound knowledge of medical Imaging equipment. Ability to draft specifications of medical equipment. Have first-hand installation experience. Ability to plan and control budgets.
jobs.duties: Perform Electro-Mechanical repairs, routine maintenance, inspections, quality assurance testing and evaluation of relevant Medical equipment belonging to Tygerberg Hospital and any institutions under its control. Perform acceptance inspection and testing for new or donated equipment. Inform on serviceability of equipment. Ensuring that the equipment meets the legal and safety requirements of the manufacturers, users, and statutory bodies. Evaluate, investigate, monitor and advise on suitability of equipment, costs of repairs and running cost of equipment. -Perform incident investigations and inform supervisor of any hazards and/or recall and act on notifications. Maintain a detailed and accurate administrative system for example service history, expenditure, and tracking inventory. Responsible for the day to day functioning of the human and other resources under the post's control for example work distribution, prioritizing work and other supervisory functions. Training and monitoring of junior technical staff. Specification drafting. Provide detailed preventative maintenance schedules. Be on call for after hour services and repairs. Administrative functions as required by the Clinical Engineering Department. Ensuring compliance of the OHS Act of 1993. Liaison with hospital personnel and private sector representatives. Responsible to the Unit Manager of the workshop.
jobs.enquiries: Ms M Rossouw Tel No: (021) 938-4634
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical assessment. A full detailed job description is available on request. Orientation to the functioning of the Electronic Unit and Clinical Engineering Department will be provided to the successful candidate. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Industrial Technician Supervisor: Clinical Engineering (X
af.summary: Superviseer kliniese ingenieurswese by Tygerberg Hospital, en voer elektro-meganiese herstelwerk en onderhoud op mediese beeld- en X-ray-toerusting uit.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n National Diploma, (T, S of N Stroom in Light Current Electrical- Engineering Field) of 'n B-tech graad in Electronic or Mechanical engineering. Ervaring: Toepaslike bewese vorige herstel- en onderhoudskennis en -ervaring in Medical Imaging Equipment (insluitend X-rays). Toepaslike ervaring in die installasie van mediese X-ray-toerusting en QA-assesserings. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Geldige Code B (Code 08) bestuurslisensie. Voer standby- en buite-kantoorure oproeppligte uit. Voer oortydfunksies uit wanneer vereis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goed ontwikkelde elektroniese, elektriese en meganiese tegniese diens- en herstelvaardighede en -kennis. Vermoë om basiese meganiese herstelwerk uit te voer. Beskik oor akkurate tegniese vermoë en insig om tegniese probleme te identifiseer en op te los. Vermoë om foutopsporing tot op komponentvlak uit te voer deur middel van stroombane en toetsapparatuur. Vermoë om verskeie basiese en gesofistikeerde handgereedskap, kraggereedskap, masjinerie en toetsapparatuur te gebruik om funksies uit te voer. Rekenaargeletterd (MS -Word, -Excel en -Access). -Goeie kommunikasievaardighede (skriftelik en mondeling). Vermoë om administratiewe funksies uit te voer. Vermoë om as 'n spanlid te werk en by geleentheid op eie inisiatief met die minimum toesig. Vermoë om take en funksies te organiseer en te beplan. Vermoë om op die werk opleiding te verskaf en junior tegnici te monitor. Vermoë om toesighoudende funksies uit te voer. Deeglike kennis van mediese beeldtoerusting. Vermoë om spesifikasies van mediese toerusting op te stel. Het eerstehandse installasie-ervaring. Vermoë om begrotings te beplan en te beheer.
af.duties: Voer elektro-meganiese herstelwerk, roetine-onderhoud, inspeksies, gehaltversekeringstoetsing en evaluering van tersaaklike mediese toerusting wat aan Tygerberg Hospital en enige instellings onder sy beheer behoort, uit. Voer aanvaardingsinspeksie en -toetsing vir nuwe of geskende toerusting uit. Stel inligting verskaf oor die diensbaarheid van toerusting. Verseker dat die toerusting aan die wettige en veiligheidsvereistes van die vervaardigers, gebruikers en statutêre liggame voldoen. Evalueer, ondersoek, monitor en gee advies oor geskiktheid van toerusting, herstelkoste en bedryfskoste van toerusting. Voer voorvalondersoeke uit en stel toesighouer in kennis van enige hazard en/of terugroep en tree op op kennigswings. Onderhou 'n gedetailleerde en akkurate administratiewe stelsel byvoorbeeld diensgeskiedenis, besteding en voorraadopvolging. Verantwoordelik vir die dag-tot-dag funksionering van die menslike en ander hulpbronne onder die pos se beheer byvoorbeeld werkverspreiding, prioritisering van werk en ander toesighoudende funksies. Opleiding en monitering van junior tegniese personeel. Spesifikasieopstelling. Verskaf gedetailleerde preventiewe onderhoudskedules. Wees op roep vir buite-kantoorure dienste en herstelwerk. Administratiewe funksies soos vereis deur die Clinical Engineering Department. Verseker nakoming van die OHS Act van 1993. Skakeling met hospitaalpersoneel en privaatsektorverteenwoordigers. Verantwoordelik aan die Eenheidsbestuurder van die werkswinkel.

xh.title: Mlawuli Wecejhezio Bengcali Kolusu: Clinical Engineering (X
xh.summary: Lawula ulungelelwaniso lwebhanti yolwazi kwi-Tygerberg Hospital, wenza izilungiso ze-electro-mechanical ulungelelwaniso kumajombe okuvakalisa umzimba nasemajombe okuvakalisa kwiinkonzo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esingaphantsi kwesimumo yefundo: Isidanga se-National Diploma, (T, S okanye N Stream kwicala le-Light Current Electrical- Engineering Field) okanye isidanga se-B-tech kwicala le-Electronic okanye Mechanical engineering. Isipho sendalo somsebenzi: Ukuqonda okuqinisekisiweyo kolwazi ngohlobo lokulungisa nokuqhuba imisebenzi yohlolojlo lwakudlulo lwamaziko obuchwepheshe bezesondlo nakwizixhobo zokulinganisa umzimba ezingamajombe ezokuvakalisa ngaphakathi ezibetheence ebuhlophweni nakwiinkonzo zokubeka izixhobo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsbenzi: Ibsantya, iphezulu kakhulu, elawulwayo ukuze kwenziwe imisebenzi emininzi. Amava kwiinkonzo zokubeka izixhobo zokuvakalisa umzimba ngaphakathi ezingamajombe kwizibhedlele kwaye kuphandwe ngokwakho ukulingana kwezixhobo nangakumbi ukuvakalisa umzimba kakhulu ekusebenzeni koluntu abasebenzayo. Isimo esimfuneko sonyuso: Ibsantya ngexesha elizeleyo. Isidanga sefundo: Qeqshwa kwaye wenze imisebenzi yohlobo lokusebenzisa izixhobo zokuvakalisa umzimba, izixhobo zomch esebenzisa, izixhobo ezinomkhondo, nezinomgangatho ophezulu wobunye nokubakho kwezixhobo ezilungiselelwa ukuba kwezokusika kwiindlela ezahlukeneyo. Amava kubakho, ikakhulu ukungalingwa kokusika izixhobo ezikumgangatho ophezulu wobuchwepheshe. Iimfuno (izazisi): Isidanga esingaphantsi kwesimumo sokufunda endaweni yokusebenza. Amava ekubakho ngokwasemva nangokusika izixhobo ukuya kwelinye icala. Amava wokusebenzisa izixhobo zangaphantsi kakhulu. Amava wokulinganisa nokulinganisa ukusebenza koluntu. Amava ngokusika izixhobo ezinomkhondo. Amava wokuqonda kwangaphakathi nokulawula izikwere.
xh.duties: Yenza izilungiso ze-Electro-Mechanical, ulungelelwaniso olwesiqhelo, iinkqubo zokuqinisekisa, ukuvavanya ukhuseleko lwekhwalithi nokuhlola eqela lezixhobo zezesondlo ezingowakwa Tygerberg Hospital nayanayo na isebe eliphezulu kulo. Yenza ukuqinisekisa nokuvavanya ukwamkelwa kwezixhobo ezintsha okanye ezifikiweyo ezinikelwe njengesipho. Yaziisa ngesimo sokusebenza kwezixhobo. Qinisekisa ukuba izixhobo zihambelana neemfuno ezizezomthetho nezokhuseleko zabakhiqizi, abasebenzisi, namagunya achaziweyo aphantsi komthetho. Hlola, phanda, lilise, unike icebiso malunga ukufaneleka kwezixhobo, iindleko zokulungisa kunye neendleko ezingaphilayo zokusebenza kwezixhobo. -Yenza iinkqubo zokuphanda ngemicimbi yachwayo kwaye ulumkise umlawuli ngayo nayiphi na ingozi okanye isikhokelo sokuabuyiswa kwezixhobo kwaye uthathe inyathelo ngokusetyenziswa kolwazi olufunyenweyo. Gcina inkqubo yolawulo eneenkcukacha ezichanekileyo ngokomzekelo imbali yesevisi, iindleko ezitshixwayo, nokulandela izinto ezikhoyo. Nyamezela ukusebenza ngemihla ngemihla koluntu olusebenzisayo nanye imithombo engaphantsi kolawulo lwesithuba ngokomzekelo ukwahlulela umsebenzi, ukubeka izinto ngemigangatho yokuqalisa umsebenzi kwaye wenze eminye imisebenzi yolawulo. Qeqsha ulilise abasebenzi abangenamava kwicala lobuchwepheshe. Bhala iinkqubo zokuchaza iimfuno nezibhalo ezifunekayo ezisetyenziswa kwizixhobo zezesondlo. Nikeza iinkqubo zobomi bexesha elizeleyo zokugcina ulungelelwaniso lwangaphambili echanekileyo lungasebenza njengesikhokelo. Falwa ufikelele emva kweyure ezizezigqibo zemini xa kusetyenziswa iinkonzo nokulungisa izixhobo. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo njengoko kufunwa ngu-Clinical Engineering Department. Qinisekisa ukuthobela umthetho we-OHS Act ka-1993. Sebenzisana nabasebenzi besibhedlele kwaye nommelwane abamela ingcali kwishishini langesiquphela. Phendula kwisebe kwaye ulalele iNtloko yesebe le-Clinical Engineering Department kunye nonobumba wesikhululo somsebenzi.

zu.title: Umphathi Wezobuchwepheshe Bezimboni: I-Clinical Engineering (X
zu.summary: Lawula izamaphakathi zobuchwepheshe ezokwelapha kwaTygerberg Hospital, ukwenza ukulungiswa kwe-Electro-mechanical nokunakekelwa kwezinsiza zomdwebi wezokwelapha nama-X-ray.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esincane: I-National Diploma, (T, S or N Stream in Light Current Electrical- Engineering Field) noma i-degree ye-B-tech kwe-Electronic noma i-Mechanical engineering. Isipiliyoni: Ulwazi lwangaphambili olufanele lokulungisa nokunakekelwa kanye nesipiliyoni kwi-Medical Imaging Equipment (kuhlanganise ama-X-rays). Isipiliyoni esifanele ekufakeni amaphakathi ezokwelapha nama-X-ray kanye nokuqondisa ukubuyekezwa kwe-QA. Isidingo esingaphakathi somsebenzi: Amalayisense we-Code B (Code 08) oshayela ohlelekile. Yenza imisebenzi yokulinda bese ubizwa ngemva kwamahora asebenzayo. Yenza imisebenzi yesikhathi esengeziwe uma kudingeka. Izinkomba ezisebenzayo (ulwazi/amakhono amakhono): Amakhono obuchwepheshe namakhono okulungisa izinsiza zobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha, kagesi nenyansiyo. Ikono lokwenza ukulungiswa kwemishini ecomingingili. Ubuchwepheshe obuchanekile kanye nokuqonda ukuze ukwazi ukubona futhi usolve izinkinga zobuchwepheshe. Ikono lokuqaphela inkinga futhi ulungise bese usuka kwelinguqulo elisezansi ngezikimu zamaphakathi agesi kanye nezinsiza zokuhlola. Ikono lokusebenzisa izinsiza zomsindo eziyisisekelo kanye nombhalo ohlushwa ngobukhulu, amaphakathi anamandla, izinsiza kanye nezinsiza zokuhlola ukwenza imisebenzi. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (MS -Word, -Excel and -Access). -Amakhono wobunjiniyela obuhle (okubhaliwe kanye namazwi). Ikono lokwenza imisebenzi yolawulo bhalo. Ikono lokusebenza njengelungu lqembu futhi ngezikhathi ngokuqonda okwakho ngokulawula okuncane. Ikono lokuqamba futhi ucabange imisebenzi kanye nemisebenzi. Ikono lokunika ukulolonga umsebenzi kanye nokuphatha abakhiqizi bezamaphakathi. Ikono lokwenza imisebenzi yolawulo. Ulwazi oluwumculo wezamaphakathi e-Imaging. Ikono lokubhala izindinganiso zobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha. Unesipiliyoni sokufaka. Ikono lokuqamba futhi ulawule imikhakha.
zu.duties: Yenza ukulungiswa kwe-Electro-Mechanical, ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo, ukuhlola, ukuhlola ukwethembeka kwekhwalithi nokubuyekezwa kolwelwazi lwezokwelapha oluhlobene oluseTygerberg Hospital nasezinye izikhungo eziphansi kwalo. Yenza ukuhlola nokuhlolwa kwemikhuba yamaphuzu wokwamukela emisha noma ezinikelwe ngabantu. Yezisa ngokusebenziseka kolwelwazi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulwelwazi luhambisana nemithetho yezokuphepha kanye nezidingo zabakhiqizi, abasebenzisayo, nabasemthethweni. Hlola, phenya, qaphula futhi unikeze izeluleko ngokufaneleka kolwelwazi, izindleko zokulungisa kanye nezindleko zokusebenza kolwelwazi. -Yenza iziphenyo ngemicimbi yezehlakalo futhi umyaleze umphathi nganoma yiziphi izingozi futhi noma izaziso zokubuyiswa bese uthatha isinyathelo ngokwezaziso. Gcina uhlelo olubalulekile futhi oluchanekile lolawulo njengomlando wokusebenza, izimalo ezisetshenzisiwe, kanye nokulandelwa kwezimpahla. Nxibelelanaye ngemisebenzi yansuku zonke yabantu kanye nezinye izinsiza ezingaphansi kolawulo lwalesi sikhundla njengokwaba umsebenzi, ukubeka ubuciko kumsebenzi kanye nezinye imisebenzi yolawulo. Ukugcina nokuphatha abasebenzi abancane bezobuchwepheshe. Ukubhala izindinganiso. Nikeza amashebuleli abalulekile okunakekelwa okuvikelayo. Ibalele njengoba kudingekile ukwenza izinsiza nokulungisa emva kwamahora asebenzayo. Imisebenzi yolawulo njengoba kudingwa umnyango wezamaphakathi wobuchwepheshe bezokwelapha. Ukulandelwa kwezidingo kwe-OHS Act of 1993. Ukuxhumana nabasebenzi besibhedlela kanye namalungu esiqandamningi yangasese. Nxibelelanaye ngemisebenzi kosobala wezinsiza kulowo mnyango.

jobs.title: Industrial Technician (PRODUCTION): Electronics
jobs.summary: Industrial technician required for the clinical engineering electronics section in Goodwood to maintain, repair and install medical equipment.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: National Diploma in Electrical (LC) Engineering (T; S or N stream), or National Diploma in Mechatronics, or registration as an Engineering Technician in terms of the Engineering Profession of South Africa Act (Act 46 of 2000). Experience: Appropriate experience after qualification with repairs, maintenance and installation of electronic or related medical equipment. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid driver’s licence (Code B/EB) and willing to travel throughout the Western Cape. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Proven knowledge of health technology principles. Ability to compile technical specifications for medical equipment. Excellent ability to do fault finding on equipment. Good written and verbal skills. Proven experience computer literacy (i.e. MS Word, Excel). Product specific technical training Advanced knowledge of managing, planning and organizing maintenance schedules.
jobs.duties: Carry out advanced maintenance, repairs, calibration, modifications and installations of medical (electronic) equipment. Train junior technicians and users on equipment. Ensuring that the equipment meets legal and safety requirements of the manufacturers and statutory bodies. Perform all administrative functions as required by the Clinical Engineering Department, managers and health Technology prescripts while ensuring compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993. Liaison with hospital and private sector staff while reporting to the manager of the relevant workshop. Manage the workshop in the absence of supervisor in charge of relevant workshop and be willing to work within all Clinical Engineering disciplines.
jobs.enquiries: Mr W Padayachee Tel No: (021) 590-5008
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a competency test on day of interview and will also need to sign a form allowing background, criminal, qualification, credit and driver's license verification. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Nywerheidstegnikus (PRODUKSIE): Elektronika
af.summary: Nywerheidstegnikus benodig vir die kliniese ingenieurswese-elektronika-afdeling in Goodwood om mediese toerusting te onderhou, te herstel en te installeer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Nasionale Diploma in Elektriese (LC) Ingenieurswese (T; S of N stroom), of Nasionale Diploma in Megatronika, of registrasie as 'n Ingenieurstegnikus ingevolge die Engineering Profession of South Africa Act (Act 46 of 2000). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring na kwalifikasie met herstelwerk, onderhoud en installasie van elektroniese of verwante mediese toerusting. Inheemse vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie (Kode B/EB) en gewillig om deur die hele Western Cape te reis. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Bewese kennis van gesondheidstegnologie-beginsels. Vermoë om tegniese spesifikasies vir mediese toerusting op te stel. Uitstekende vermoë om foutopsporing op toerusting te doen. Goeie skriftelike en mondelinge vaardighede. Bewese ervaring van rekenaarvaardigheid (d.w.s. MS Word, Excel). Produkspesifieke tegniese opleiding. Gevorderde kennis van bestuur, beplanning en organisering van onderhoudskedules.
af.duties: Voer gevorderde onderhoud, herstelwerk, kalibrering, wysigings en installasies van mediese (elektroniese) toerusting uit. Lei junior tegnici en gebruikers oor toerusting. Verseker dat die toerusting aan wetlike en veiligheidsvereistes van die vervaardigers en statutêre liggame voldoen. Voer alle administratiewe funksies uit soos vereis deur die Clinical Engineering Department, bestuurders en gesondheidstegnologie-voorskrifte terwyl aan die Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993 voldoen word. Skakel met hospitaal- en privaatsektorpersonel terwyl aan die bestuurder van die betrokke werkswinkel gerapporteer word. Bestuur die werkswinkel in die afwesigheid van die toesighouer in beheer van die betrokke werkswinkel en wees gewillig om binne alle Clinical Engineering-dissiplines te werk.

zu.title: Indlusthi yobuchwepheshe (OKUKHIQIZWAYO): IziNhluThi
zu.summary: Kudingwa indlusthi yobuchwepheshe enganela isigaba sezinhlelwe zokusebenza ezingokwelaphwa kwezobunhluthi e-Goodwood ukugcina, ukulungisa nokufaka imishini yezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Izifundo ezingenhla ezingakaniswe: i-National Diploma kwi-Electrical (LC) Engineering (T; S noma N stream), noma i-National Diploma kwi-Mechatronics, noma ukubhaliswa njengo-Engineering Technician ngokomthetho we-Engineering Profession of South Africa Act (Act 46 of 2000). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele ngemva kokuthola izifundo ngokulungisa, ukugcina kanye nokufakwa kwezinhlelwe zokusebenza zamakhompyutha ezedwelwa noma eminye imishini yezokwelapha. Isidingo sokwenza umsebenzi: Ilicence yokushayela (Code B/EB) nokuba sobala ukuhamba kuyo yonke i-Western Cape. Ikhono (ulwazi/izindlela): Ulwazi olubonisiwe ngemigomo yobuchwepheshe bemitholampilo. Ikono lokubhala izinkomba zobuchwepheshe zemishini yezokwelapha. Ikono elihle ekutholeni iziphazamiso kwimishini. Izindlela ezinhla zokubhala nokukhuluma. Isipiliyoni esibonisiwe sokusebenzisa ikhompyutha (okth i-MS Word, Excel). Uqeqesho lobuchwepheshe olubhekene nomkhiqizo Olwazi oluthuthukisiwe lokuphatha, ukulungelelisa kanye nokuhlela izikhathi zokugcinwa.
zu.duties: Qhuba ukugcinwa, ukulungiswa, ukulinganiswa, ukushintshwa kanye nokufakwa kwemishini yezokwelapha (yeziNhluthi). Qeqesha abahlakaniphi abancane kanye nabo basebenzisa imishini. Qinisekisa ukuthi imishini ihambelana nezidingo zomthetho kanye nezekuphepha ezibalwa ngabakhiqizi kanye namabhodi omthetho. Yenza yonke imisebenzi yabaphathi njengoba kudingwa yiClinical Engineering Department, abaphathi kanye nemiyalo yezobuchwepheshe bemitholampilo ngesikhathi uqinisekisa ukuthi kuhlonishwa umthetho i-Occupational Health and Safety Act of 1993. Xhumana nabasebenzi besibhedlela kanye nabaningizimu yangasese ngenkathi ubika kumphathi wesitolo somsebenzi ohambisanayo. Phatha isitolo somsebenzi ekungabeni komphathi ohola isitolo somsebenzi ohambisanayo futhi ube sobala ukusebenza ngaphakathi kwawo wonke amabhungcwepheshe eClinical Engineering.

xh.title: Iqeqeshi leZentimba (UKUQULUNQA): IzaLabantu
xh.summary: Kufuneka iqeqeshi lezentimba kwicandelo lezedumente zobuchwepheshe zokliniki kwi-Goodwood ukugcina, ukulungisa nokufakela isixhobo sokuhlolwa kwempilo.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho wemfundo: National Diploma kwi-Electrical (LC) Engineering (T; S okanye N stream), okanye National Diploma kwi-Mechatronics, okanye ubhaliso njengoQeqeshi weNzululwazi ngokweMithetho yeQela leNzululwazi loMzantsi Afrika (Act 46 ka-2000). Imfundo: Iimfuno ezifanelekileyo zangemva kokugqiba izidanga ngeelungiso, ulungiso nokufakela iisixhobo ezakheliweyo ezinxulumene namacandelo okuhlolwa kwempilo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi kwesithuba somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela (Code B/EB) nangathanda ukuhamba kuyo yonke i-Western Cape. Ikhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olubonwayo ngeengcombolo zobuchwepheshe bezempilo. Ikhono lokubhala iinkcazelo zobuchwepheshe zamacandelo okuhlolwa kwempilo. Ikhono elihle lokukhangela iingxaki kumacandelo. Amakhono abhalwayo nokuThethwayo aluhle. Ulwazi olubonwayo lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (umz. i-MS Word, Excel). Ulwazi olubanzi lokulawula, ukuqamba kunye nokuqwalasela iinkqubo zolungiso.
xh.duties: Zenza ulungiso oluphezulu, ziilungiso, uqwalaselo lwesixhobo, iinguqu ezintsha kunye nefakelo lwesixhobo sokuhlolwa kwempilo (sezikhongozeli). Qeqesha abaqeqeshi abancinane kunye nabasebenzisi ngemacandelo. Qinisekisa ukuba isixhobo siyahambelana neemfuno zamthetho nezokhuseleko zamvelisi kunye nabamiselo ngokomthetho. Zenza yonke imisebenzi yolawulo njengoko kufunwa liSebe leNzululwazi loKliniki, abaphathi kunye nemithetho yeNzululwazi yoKliniki ngezeMpilo ngelixa uqinisekisa ukuzinikela kwiMithetho yeMisebenzi eNgcono nokuKhuseleka ka-1993. Ukuhlobana nabasebenzi besibhedlele kunye nabasebenzi besekhwameni labucala ngelixa ubika kumlawuli wendawo yokusebenza elungelayo. Lawula indawo yokusebenza engekho kwayo umlawuli ofanelekileyo wendawo yokusebenza elungelayo kwaye ube butyityimba bokusebenza kuzo zonke iindidi zeNzululwazi loKliniki.

jobs.title: Personal Assistant to the Chief Director
jobs.centre: Office of the Chief Director (Mossel Bay)
jobs.summary: Provide executive secretarial and administrative support to the Chief Director at the Department of Health and Wellness in Mossel Bay.

Qualification on a higher level may also be accepted on condition that the subjects of the qualification align to the functions of the job. Experience: Appropriate experience in rendering secretarial/ administrative support services to management/ senior management. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid SA driver’s licence (Code B/EB). Good interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills (including telephone and email etiquette). High-level reliability and ability to function in a team and or independently. Ability to analyse information and draft reports. Self- Management and motivation, including good grooming and presentation. Sound organisational skills. Maintain a high level of professionalism and confidentiality. The ability or experience to effectively manage the diary and related support functions remotely when required.

Render Administrative support services to the Chief Director, including procurement of goods and services. Support the Chief Director with the Administration of the budget in the office of the Chief Director. Provide support to the Chief Director regarding meetings, including minute taking and presentations. Support the Chief Director with the administration of all People Management/Human Resource aspects. Render an administrative service to staff within the office of the Chief Director Studies the relevant Public Service and departmental prescripts/ policies and other documents and ensure that the application thereof is understood properly.
