af.title: Persoonlike Assistent van die Hoofdirekteur
af.summary: Verskaf uitvoerende sekretariële en administratiewe steun aan die Hoofdirekteur by die Department of Health and Wellness in Mossel Bay.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: 'n Geakkrediteerde sekretariële diploma en/of administratiewe kwalifikasie op die vlak van NQF level 5 ('n sertifikaat van voltooiing moet verskaf word). 'n Kwalifikasie op 'n hoër vlak kan ook aanvaar word op voorwaarde dat die vakke van die kwalifikasie ooreenstem met die funksies van die werk. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in die lewer van sekretariële/administratiewe steundienste aan bestuur/ senior bestuur. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige SA bestuurderslisensie (Kode B/EB). Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid, met kennis van die MS Office Suite (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) en AI-toepassings. Goeie interpersoonlike, mondelinge en skriftelike kommunikasievaardighede (insluitend telefoon- en e-posetiket). Hoë-vlak betroubaarheid en vermoë om in 'n span en/of onafhanklik te funksioneer. Vermoë om inligting te ontleed en verslae op te stel. Selfbestuur en motivering, insluitend goeie versorging en aanbieding. Degelike organisatoriese vaardighede. Handhaaf 'n hoë vlak van professionaliteit en vertroulikheid. Die vermoë of ervaring om die dagboek en verwante steunfunksies doeltreffend op afstand te bestuur wanneer dit vereis word.
af.duties: Verskaf uitvoerende sekretariële steun persoonlik of op afstand aan die Hoofdirekteur (d.w.s. dagboekbestuur, administratiewe steun en rekordbestuur). Lewer administratiewe steundienste aan die Hoofdirekteur, insluitend die verkryging van goedere en dienste. Ondersteun die Hoofdirekteur met die administrasie van die begroting in die kantoor van die Hoofdirekteur. Verskaf steun aan die Hoofdirekteur rakende vergaderings, insluitend die neem van notule en aanbiedings. Ondersteun die Hoofdirekteur met die administrasie van alle Menslike Bestuur/Menslike Hulpbronbelange. Lewer 'n administratiewe diens aan personeel binne die kantoor van die Hoofdirekteur. Bestudeer die tersaaklike Openbare Diens- en departementele voorskrifte/beleide en ander dokumente en verseker dat die toepassing daarvan behoorlik verstaan word.

zu.title: Onozane Omuntu kaMqondisi Ohamba Phambili
zu.summary: Nikeza inkonzo egunyaziwe yezokhokho nezokuphathwa kwezokqASHIshwa kuMqondisi Ohamba Phambili eDipatmenteni yeHealth and Wellness eMossel Bay.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esincane: Isitifiketi sokhokho esamukelekile noma isithuba sokuphathwa kwezokqASHIshwa esisingeni se-NQF level 5 (isitifiketi sokuphothula kufanele sithunyelwe). Isithuba esizingeni eliphezulu nasezimukwa ngaphandle kwesimo sokuthi izihloko zesithuba zihambisana nemisebenzi yomsebenzi. Uhambo: Okuhlangenwe nakho okufanele ekunikeni inkonzo yokhokho/ yokuphathwa kwezokqASHIshwa ebalulekile abaphathi/ abaphathi abaphezulu. Isidingo esibonakalayo somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile yase-SA (Code B/EB). Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhali): Ulwazi lokusebenza ngamakompyutha, olunolwazi ku-MS Office Suite (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) nezinhlelo ze-AI. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu, okukhuluma nokubhala (okuhlanganisa isiko lokukhuluma nefoni nokubhala ama-imeyili). Ukuzethemba okuphezulu nendlela yokusebenza eqenjini noma ngokwakho. Ikhono lokuhlaziya ulwazi nokubhala amabhikidi (imibiko). Ukuzilawula nokuzikhandla, okuhlanganisa ukubukeka kahle nokuzinhlela. Amakhono ahle wokuhlela. Ugcine izinga eliphezulu lokuziphatha kanye nobumfihlo. Ikhono noma okuhlangenwe nakho ekulawuleni idayari nemisebenzi ehubekayo yesekele ukude uma kudingeka.
zu.duties: Nikeza inkonzo egunyaziwe yezokhokho ngokwamanomfana noma ukude noMqondisi Ohamba Phambili (okungukuthi ukulawula idayari, inkonzo yokuphathwa kwezokqASHIshwa nokulawula amarekhodi). Nikeza inkonzo yokuphathwa kwezokqASHIshwa kuMqondisi Ohamba Phambili, okuhlanganisa ukuthenga izimpahla nankonzo. Sekela uMqondisi Ohamba Phambili ngokuphathwa kwebhajethi enhlokweni yesikhungo sikaMqondisi Ohamba Phambili. Nikeza isekele kuMqondisi Ohamba Phambili ngokuhlukaniswa kwemihlangano, okuhlanganisa ukubhala imizuzu nezinkulumo zomumathathu. Sekela uMqondisi Ohamba Phambili ngokuphathwa kwakho konke okuphathelene nokulawula abantu/Izinsiza Zabantu. Nikeza inkonzo yokuphathwa kwezokqASHIshwa kubasebenzi endlini yesikhungo sikaMqondisi Ohamba Phambili. Ufunda imithelela/ izinqubomgomo ezibalulekile zeZinkonzo Zikahulumenu nomnyango namanye amadokhumenti, futhi uqinisekisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwazo kuyaqondwa kahle.

xh.title: Umlingiseleli kuMlawuli oPhezulu
xh.summary: Nikezela inkxaso yolawulo kunye nesebe ezingunaphakade kumyaleli weNkundla kwisebe leZempilo nakwindalo eMossel Bay.
xh.requirements: Isiqu somfundo esingaphantsi: Isidiploma sokwamkela esivunyiweyo kunye nokuba nesiqu solawulo kumazinga ama-NQF level 5 (isatifikethi sokugqibela kufuneka sithunyelwe). Isiqu kwelinye izinga eliphezulu singamkelwa nangona kunjalo nangona izihloko zesiqu zihambelana nomsebenzi owenziwayo. Irla: Inqondo yokwenza umsebenzi olinganelayo kwininkxaso yolawulo/urhwebo kurhulumente kubasebenzi bakurhulumente/abaphathi abaphezulu burhulumente.
xh.duties: Nikezela inkxaso ezingqondweni yokwamkela kwindawo okanye kude kumyaleli weNkundla (o.k.t ulawulo lweyure, inkxaso yolawulo lolulo nolawulo lemiba). Zenza iinkonzo zolawulo kunye nenkxaso kuMyaleli weNkundla, kuquka ukuthenga izinto ezahlukeneyo nezenzo. Xhasa uMyaleli weNkundla ngolawulo lweNyuvuzo kwiofisi kaMyaleli weNkundla. Nikezela inkxaso kuMyaleli weNkundla ngokuphathelele neminyinganiselo, kuquka ukubhala iingqantshisi zamaminithi nezendabuko ezingagqibanga. Msela inkxaso kuMyaleli weNkundla ngokuphathelele nolawulo lwakuthe ngalo nawuphi na amacandwoubomi/Abasebenzi abantu. Zenzela inkonzo yolawulo kubasebenzi bendlwini kaMyaleli weNkundla Ufunda ngenkululeko yolwazi ngamagama agqithiswayo/pholisi zalo nyazaniso lwaseburhulumenteni nakwisebe nakwezinye iinxwelo ukuqinisekisa ukuba ukusetyenziswa kwezi ayicacile kakuhle.

jobs.title: Professional Nurse Grade 1 to 3 (GENERAL Nursing: PHC) (X2
jobs.centre: Skurweberg Mobile and Bella Vista Clinic, Witzenberg Sub-district
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R337 359 per annum Grade 2: R411 978 per annum Grade 3: R495 423 per annum (Plus an 8% rural allowance of your annual basic salary)
jobs.summary: Two Professional Nurse positions (Grade 1 to 3) providing primary healthcare at Skurweberg Mobile and Bella Vista Clinic in Witzenberg Sub-district.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Basic R425 qualification (i.e., diploma/degree in nursing) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R254) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse OR a 4-year bachelor’s degree in nursing (R174) or equivalent qualification (R683 plus R1497 or R171 plus R1497) that allows registration with the South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Professional Nurse. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years of appropriate/recognisable nursing experience after registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years of appropriate/recognizable experience in nursing after registration with the SANC as a Professional Nurse in General Nursing. Inherent requirements of the job: Prepared to work at different facilities within the Sub District, inclusive of Mobile facilities, when needed within the community (COPC concept). Valid (code B/EB) driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to effectively communicate (verbally and in writing). Knowledge and insight of relevant legislation and policy related to nursing within the public sector. Basic computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, and Outlook) to be able to communicate, capture patient information, check results, capture data, and track referrals on the different electronic systems. Ability to promote quality patient care through the implementation of protocols, guidelines, and standards.
jobs.duties: Provision of quality basic nursing patient centred care in a Clinic setting. Provision of optimal, holistic clinical and elementary nursing care with set standards and within a professional/legal framework. Effective utilisation of human and financial resources, Information management and support services. Improving quality of health services. Community participation, outreach and support. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self- development.
jobs.enquiries: Ms N Tyesi Tel No: (023) 316-9600
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements, may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. af.title: Professionele Verpleegkundige Graad 1 tot 3 (ALGEMENE Verpleegkunde: PHC) (X2
af.summary: Twee Professionele Verpleegkundige posisies (Graad 1 tot 3) wat primêre gesondheidsorg bied by Skurweberg Mobile en Bella Vista Clinic in Witzenberg Sub-district.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Basiese R425-kwalifikasie (d.w.s. diploma/graad in verpleegkunde) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R254) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat OF 'n 4-jarige bachelorsgraad in verpleegkunde (R174) of ekwivalente kwalifikasie (R683 plus R1497 of R171 plus R1497) wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige toelaat. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare verpleegervaring na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar se toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in verpleegkunde na registrasie by die SANC as 'n Professionele Verpleegkundige in Algemene Verpleegkunde. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Bereid om by verskillende fasiliteite binne die Sub-distrik te werk, insluitend Mobiele fasiliteite, indien nodig binne die gemeenskap (COPC-konsep). Geldige (kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondelings en skriftelik). af.title: Aptekersassistent (POST Basic) Graad 1 tot 3
af.summary: Aptekersassistent Post-Basic pos by Vredenburg Hospital in die Western Cape, wat SAPC-registrasie vereis, met salarisse wat wissel van R275,340 tot R343,761 per jaar.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Soos vereis deur die opleidingsfasiliteit en die Suid-Afrikaanse Aptekersraad (SAPC) plus Post-Basic Aptekersassistent-kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die SAPC as 'n Aptekersassistent (Post-Basic) of Aptekersassistent (Post-Basic) Institusioneel toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SAPC as 'n Aptekersassistent (Post Basic) (Institusioneel) of Aptekersassistent (Post Basic). Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie as Aptekersassistent (Post Basic) by die SAPC. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Aptekersassistent na registrasie as 'n Aptekersassistent (Post-Basic) by die SAPC. Graad 3: 'n Minimum van 13 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Aptekersassistent na registrasie as 'n Aptekersassistent (Post-Basic) by die SAPC. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om gereelde buite-kantoorure pligte te verrig. Bereidwilligheid om buite-kantoorure- en vrystellingspligte binne die ekostelsel van Saldanha Subdistrik te verrig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint en Outlook). Vermoë om akkuraat onder druk te werk en 'n hoë standaard van professionaliteit te handhaaf. Vermoë om in 'n multidissiplinêre span te werk met uitstekende interpersoonlike en kommunikasievaardighede. Toepaslike kennis van Nasionale en Provinciale Gesondheidsbeleid, Medicines Act 101of 1965, die Pharmacy Act 53 of 1974 en Public Finance Management Act. Toepaslike kliniese en farmaseutiese kennis. Kennis van JAC/WellSky verstrekkingstelsel. Tydbestuur, strategiese beplanning, prioritisering van take.
af.duties: Doeltreffende beheer van farmaseutiese voorraad. Verseker doeltreffende Farmaseutiese Sorg (Verstrekking) insluitend die Chroniese Verstrekkingseenheid binne die Subdistrik. Bystand met die versameling van Apteeke data en rekordhouding. Bevorder en help met optimale Farmaseutiese Adviserende Dienst met die tersaaklike multidissiplinêre spanne. Verseker doeltreffende gehalte van gesondheidsdienst. Verskaf ondersteuning aan toesighouer en verrig vrystellingspligte wanneer gevra in klinieke binne die Subdistrik.

zu.title: Umsizi wePharmacist (POST Basic) izinga 1 kuya ku-3
zu.summary: Isikhundla sikaPharmacist Assistant Post-Basic esibhedlela iVredenberg esifundazweni seWestern Cape, okudinga ukubhalisa kwiSAPC, lapho kuhlolwa khona phakathi kukaR275,340 kuya kuR343,761 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi kakhulu: Njengoba kudingwa isikhungla sokulolonga kanye neSouth African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) okuhlanganese nethuli yokuba nguPost-Basic Pharmacist Assistant evumela ukubhalisa kwiSAPC njengoPharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) noma iPharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) Institutional. Ukubhalisa kunhlangano yezobuhlule: Ukubhalisa kwiSAPC njengoPharmacist Assistant (Post Basic) (Institutional) noma iPharmacist Assistant (Post Basic). Isipiliyoni: izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emuva kokubhalisa njengoPharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) kweSAPC. Izinga 2: Ucingo olungaphansi kuka 5 eminyakeni yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoPharmacist Assistant emuva kokubhalisa njengoPharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) kwiSAPC. Izinga 3: Ucingo olungaphansi kuka 13 eminyakeni yesipiliyoni esifanele njengoPharmacist Assistant emuva kokubhalisa njengoPharmacist Assistant (Post-Basic) kwiSAPC. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Idrayiva lesibhambo esisebenzayo (iB/EB). Ukuzithoba ukwenza imisebenzi ngesikhathi esingemuva kwesikhathi ngesikhathi. Ukuzithoba ukwenza imisebenzi ngesikhathi esingemuva kwesikhathi nokuzele emhlabeni ohlukene weSaldanha Sub District. Izindlela zokwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/izikhombi): Ukukwazi ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha (iMS Office: iWord, Excel, iPowerPoint kanye neOutlook). Ukukwazi ukusebenza ngokunembile ngaphansi komfutho nokugcina izinga elihle lomsebenzi. Ukukwazi ukusebenza ethimbeni elihlukene kakhulu ngobuhlakani bokusebenza nabanye nokuxhumana kabanzi. Ulwazi olufanele ngezinqubomgomo eZikazwonga kweZempilo namaphrovinshi, umthetho weMithi 101 ka 1965, umthetho wePharmacy 53 ka 1974 kanye nomthetho wokuqondisa imali yomphakathi. Ulwazi olufanele ngokwelapha ngezithiyo. Ulwazi ngohlelo lokukhipha imithi (iJAC/WellSky). Ukuphatha isikhathi, ukweluleka amasu, kanye nokubeka ngaphambili imisebenzi.
zu.duties: Ukulawula okusebenzayo izitokhwe sezithiyo. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa okusebenzayo kwezithiyo (Ukukhishwa kwemithi), okuhlanganisa iChronic Dispensing Unit ngaphakathi kweSub District. Siza ekubutheni idatha lePharmacy nasekugcineni imirekhodi. Khuthaza futhi usize nge-Pharmaceutical Advisory Service ehambisana namathimba ahlukene ahlotshaniswe ndawonye. Qinisekisa izinga elihle lokunakekelwa kwezempilo. Nikeza usizo omlawuli bese uthi yomisebenzi yokusiza lapho kudingeka emaklinikhini ngaphakathi kweSub District.

xh.title: Umncedi wePharmacist (POST Basic) inqanaba 1 ukusa ku-3
xh.summary: Isithuba soMncedi wePharmacist Post-Basic esibhedlele i-Vredenburg e-Western Cape, esifuna ukuqatshelwa kwi-SAPC, nomvuzo oqala ukusuka kwi-R275,340 ukuya kwi-R343,761 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Imininigunya yemfundo ephanayo: Njengoko kufunwa sisikhululo sokuzifundisa kunye ne-South African Pharmacy Council (SAPC) kwaye ngaphezu koko inabangela le mininigunya yoMncedi wePharmacist Post-Basic evumela ukuqatshelwa kwi-SAPC njengoMncedi wePharmacist (Post-Basic) okanye uMncedi wePharmacist (Post-Basic) Institutional. Ukuqatshelwa kolunge lobuchwepheshe: Ukuqatshelwa kwi-SAPC njengoMncedi wePharmacist (Post Basic) (Institutional) okanye uMncedi wePharmacist (Post Basic). Isipilo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho nto emva kokuqatshelwa njengoMncedi wePharmacist (Post Basic) kwi-SAPC. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka engama-5 yamava afanelekileyo njengoMncedi wePharmacist emva kokuqatshelwa njengoMncedi wePharmacist (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-13 yamava afanelekileyo njengoMncedi wePharmacist emva kokuqatshelwa njengoMncedi wePharmacist (Post-Basic) kwi-SAPC. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi zomsebenzi: Ilayisense yokuqhuba (Code B/EB) esebenzayo. Ukulungelelana ukwenza imisebenzi yemiyalelo yemihla ngemihla nangemva kwesikhathi. Ukulungelelana ukwenza imisebenzi yemiyalelo yemihla ngemihla nangemva kwesikhathi nokubalela kumisebenzi ngaphakathi kwendalo yeSaldanha Sub District. Iikhompthensi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha (MS Office: Word, Excel, PowerPoint ne-Outlook). Amandla okusebenza ngokuchanekileyo xakekileyo ngaphantsi koxinzelelo nokugcina inqanaba eliphezulu lobungcali. Amandla okusebenza kwindyamano equlunqe iindawo ezininzi ngamakhono amabalwe ahle ochazamnye nobuchazimnye. Ulwazi olufanelekileyo lweNational and Provincial Health Policies, Medicines Act 101of 1965, i-Pharmacy Act 53 of 1974 nePublic Finance Management Act. Ulwazi lokuchaza nokulunga iimeko zomzimba nezamayeza. Ulwazi ngendlela yokwabelwa iimeko zeJAC/WellSky. Ukuqulunqa ixesha, ukuceba iindlela, nokubeka phambili imisebenzi.
xh.duties: Ukuqulunqa ngokusebenzayo isitokhwe sezamayeza. Qinisekisa ukunakekelwa ngokusebenzayo kweZamayeza (Ukunika) kuquka iChronic Dispensing Unit ngaphakathi kwi-Sub District. Nceda ngokusongwa kweedatha zePharmacy nokugcina iirekhodi. Khuthaza ube ncedo ekunikezelweni kwezoLwazi ngo-Optimal Pharmaceutical Advisory Service kumadoda amaninzi anolunge kwindyamano equlunqe iindawo ezininzi. Qinisekisa umgangatho osebenzayo weeNkonzo zeMpilo. Nikeza inkxaso kumlawuli uze wenze imisebenzi yokubalela xa kufuneka kwiikliniki ngaphakathi kwi-Sub District.

jobs.title: Artisan Production Grade a to C (ELECTRICAL)
jobs.salary_text: Grade A: R253 341 per annum Grade B: R297 249 per annum Grade C: R345 342 per annum
jobs.summary: Electrical artisan needed at Tygerberg Hospital for maintenance and repair of electrical systems, with salaries graded by experience from R253 341 to R345 342 per annum.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate Trade Test Certificate in Electrical field. Experience: Grade A: No experience required. Grade B: At least 18 years appropriate/recognisable experience in an area after obtaining the relevant Trade Test Certificate. Grade C: At least 34 years appropriate/recognisable experience in an area after obtaining the relevant Trade Test Certificate. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid (Code B/EB) drivers’ licence and willingness to travel. Willingness to be available after hours and perform standby duties. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Ability to do fault finding and repairs to electrical equipment and installations. Knowledge of the Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 and its relevant regulations.
jobs.duties: General maintenance and repair of electrical items such as lights, plugs, distribution boards, circuit breakers, motors and industrial equipment. Manage the control of tools, equipment and stock. Ability to maintain minor mechanical and electrical installation’s, fault finding, as well as all General Maintenance work. Perform new installation work or expand existing electrical services. Render assistance to the Artisan foreman and Chief artisan and effective supervision and training of subordinates. The ability to perform basic duties and record-keeping of logbooks. Maintenance on UPS systems and Generators. Assist Artisan foreman and Chief Artisan in compiling of specifications for electrical projects and project coordination. General substation maintenance.
jobs.enquiries: Mr W Krüger Tel No: (021) 938-4240
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Ambagsman Produksie Graad A tot C (ELEKTRIES)
af.summary: Elektriese ambagsman benodig by Tygerberg Hospital vir instandhouding en herstel van elektriese stelsels, met salarisse gegradeer volgens ervaring van R253 341 tot R345 342 per annum.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Toepaslike Handelstoetssertifikaat in die Elektriese veld. Ervaring: Graad A: Geen ervaring vereis nie. Graad B: Ten minste 18 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in 'n gebied na verkryging van die tersaaklike Handelstoetssertifikaat. Graad C: Ten minste 34 jaar toepaslike/erkenbare ervaring in 'n gebied na verkryging van die tersaaklike Handelstoetssertifikaat. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige (Kode B/EB) bestuurslisensie en bereidwilligheid om te reis. Bereidwilligheid om buite kantoorure beskikbaar te wees en wagdienspligte te verrig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Vermoë om foutopsporing en herstelwerk aan elektriese toerusting en installasies te doen. Kennis van die Wet op Beroepsgesondheid en Veiligheid, 1993 en die tersaaklike regulasies daarvan.
af.duties: Algemene instandhouding en herstel van elektriese items soos ligte, proppe, verspreidingspanele, stroombrekers, motors en industriële toerusting. Bestuur die beheer van gereedskap, toerusting en voorraad. Vermoë om geringe meganiese en elektriese installasies se instandhouding te doen, foutopsporing, asook alle algemene instandhoudingswerk. Voer nuwe installasiewerk uit of brei bestaande elektriese dienste uit. Bied bystand aan die Ambagsman-voorman en Hoof-ambagsman en effektiewe toesig en opleiding van ondergeskiktes. Die vermoë om basiese pligte te verrig en joekaleboeke te hou. Instandhouding van UPS-stelsels en generatore. Ondersteun Ambagsman-voorman en Hoof-ambagsman by die opstel van spesifikasies vir elektriese projekte en projekkoördinering. Algemene substasie-instandhouding.

zu.title: Umsekileli Wokukhiqiza izinga A kuye ku-C (KAGESI)
zu.summary: Kudingeka umsekileli wegesi eTygerberg Hospital ukugcina futhi kulungulwe izinhlelo zagesi, ngeholo elihlolwa ngolwazi kusukela ku-R253 341 kuye ku-R345 342 ngonyaka.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi kwale kudingekayo: Isitifiketi Sokuhlolwa Kobungcweti esifanele enkundleni yagesi. Ulwazi: Izinga A: Akukho olwazi oludingekayo. Izinga B: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-18 ulwazi olufanele/oluhlofayo enkundleni ngemuva kokuthola Isitifiketi Sokuhlolwa Kobungcweti esihambisana nayo. Izinga C: Okungenani eminyakeni engu-34 ulwazi olufanele/oluhlofayo enkundleni ngemuva kokuthola Isitifiketi Sokuhlolwa Kobungcweti esihambisana nayo. Isidingo sasemzimbeni somsebenzi: ilayisensi yokuqasha ehamba phambili (i-Code B/EB) nentando yokuhamba. Ukuthanda ukutholakala ngemva kwezinsuku zomsebenzi kanye nokwenza imisebenzi yokulinda. Amandla (ulwazi/izikhombisi): Ikono lokuthola izinkinga nokulungisa izinto zagesi nezimpahla ezifakwayo. Ulwazi ngomthetho we-Occupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 kanye nemithetho ehambisana nawo.
zu.duties: Ukugcina futhi kulungiswe ngokuvamile izinto zagesi njengokukhanya, izidxhobo ezifakiwe, amabhodi okuqondisa, abahlukhi bemizingo, izimoto zomcephe kanye nezinto zomsebenzi zomgando. Ukuqaphela ukulawula izinsiza, izimpahla kanye nesitoko. Amandla okugcina futhi kufakwe eminye imisebenzi yamashini nezagesi, ukuthola izinkinga, kanye nayo yonke imisebenzi yokugcina ngokuvamile. Ukwenzela imisebenzi yokufakwa okusha noma ukwandisa amasevisi agesi akhona. Ukusiza undunankulu wabasekileli nomsekileli oyinhloko kanye nokuphathwa ngempumelelo nokwesikwa abangaphansi. Amandla okwenza imisebenzi yansuku zonke nokugcina izinkomba zabukhosi. Ukugcina izinhlelo ze-UPS namaJenetha. Ukusiza undunankulu wabasekileli nomsekileli oyinhloko ekwakheni izinkomba ezimalunga namaphrojekthi agesi kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwaphrojekthi. Ukugcina ngokuvamile isiteshi segesi.

xh.title: Isithuba Somsesbenzi Wokukhiqiza Grade a to C (ELECTRICAL)
xh.summary: Kufuneka umsebenzi wezandla zombane kwiTygerberg Hospital ukugcina nokulungisa iinkonzo zombane, ngemivuzo evalwa ngokwesipiliwo ukusuka kwiR253 341 ukuya kwiR345 342 ngonyaka.
xh.requirements: Isiphithiphithi semfundo esincinci: Ithifikethi yovavanyo lwesikhwebvu elifanelekileyo kwinkalo yombane. Isipiliwo: Grade A: Akukho sipiliwo sifunekayo. Grade B: Ubuncinane iya 18 isipiliwo esifanelekileyo/esiqondakalikayo kwithuba emva kokufumana iThifikethi yovavanyo lwesikhwebvu elifanelekileyo. Grade C: Ubuncinane iya 34 isipiliwo esifanelekileyo/esiqondakalikayo kwithuba emva kokufumana iThifikethi yovavanyo lwesikhwebvu elifanelekileyo. Isimfuno ngokungaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yomqhubi (Code B/EB) esebenzayo nentando yokuhamba. Intando yokuba kukho emva kweeyure zomsebenzi nokwenza imisebenzi yokuma kwindawo. Ikhono (ulwazi/obu Buchule): Ikhono lokufumana amaphula nokulungisa eqquipment noku faker okusebenza ngombane. Ulwazi ngeOccupational Health and Safety Act, 1993 nemigaqo yayo efanelekileyo.
xh.duties: Ukulungisa ngokubanzi nokulungisa izinto ezisebenza ngombane ezifana namalights, iiplagi, amabodi okusasaza, ii-circuit breakers, amamotha neqequipment yoshishino. Lawula ulawulo lwamathuluzi, eqquipment nestok. Ikakhulu ukugcina ukufakwa kwezinto ezincinci ezisebenza ngomzimba nangombane, ukufumana amaphula, nayo yonke imisebenzi yokulungisa ngokubanzi. Yenza umsebenzi wokufaka okutsha okanye wandise iinkonzo eziseleyo zombane. Nikela nenceba kumanija we-Artisan nakuChief artisan kwaye ulawule ngokusebenzayo uze ulatise abangaphantsi kwakho. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi esisiseko nokugcina irekhodi kwiilogbook. Ukulungisa ii-UPS systems namaGenerator. Nceda manija we-Artisan noChief Artisan ekwenziwa iispecifications zamaprojekthi zombane nakooyordineeshi amaprojekthi. Ukulungisa ngokubanzi kwesiteshi esingaphantsi.

jobs.title: Administration Clerk: HRM (PEOPLE Management)
jobs.centre: Western Cape College of Nursing, Central Administration office, Stikland
jobs.summary: Administrative clerk needed at the Western Cape College of Nursing in Stikland to handle personnel administration tasks including appointments, transfers, leave and salary administration.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Senior Certificate (or equivalent). Experience: Appropriate People Management experience. Appropriate PERSAL experience and Recruitment and Selection. Inherent requirement of the job: Prepared to work overtime when required. Candidate must have a valid Driver’s License. The incumbent will be expected to support multiple campuses with HR processes, when operational needs dictate. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good interpersonal, decision making and problem-solving skills. Good communication skills. Ability to work in a team as well as independently. Ability to work under pressure.
jobs.duties: Perform all administrative duties pertaining to the personnel administration section e.g. appointments, service terminations, transfers, pension administration, salary administration, leave, housing, injury on duty, debt management and verification of documents. Responsible for capturing transactions on PERSAL and audit personnel- and leave records. Handle all personnel enquiries and correspondence (written and verbal) and file personnel data, policies, regulations and circulars. Maintain registers, i.e. PILIR, RWOPS, appointment and service terminations. Recruitment and selection.
jobs.enquiries: Mr DP Bending Tel No: (021) 831-5829
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates may be subjected to a practical and competency test as part of the interview process. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Administrasieklerk: HRM (PEOPLE Management)
af.summary: Administratiewe klerk benodig by die Western Cape College of Nursing in Stikland om personeeladministrasieligte te hanteer, insluitend aanstellings, oorplasings, verlof en salarisadministrasie.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig). Ervaring: Toepaslike Personeelbestuurservaring. Toepaslike PERSAL-ervaring en Werwing en Seleksie. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Bereid om oortyd te werk wanneer vereis. Kandidaat moet 'n geldige Bestuurderslisensie hê. Die ampsdraer sal verwag word om veelvuldige kampusse met HR-prosesse te ondersteun, wanneer operasionele behoeftes dit dikteer. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie interpersoonlike, besluitneming- en probleemoplossingsvaardighede. Goeie kommunikasievaardighede. Vermoë om in 'n span sowel as onafhanklik te werk. Vermoë om onder druk te werk.
af.duties: Voer alle administratiewe pligte met betrekking tot die personeeladministrasieseksie uit, bv. aanstellings, diensbeëindigings, oorplasings, pensioenadministrasie, salarisadministrasie, verlof, behuising, besering op diens, skuldbestuur en verifikasie van dokumente. Verantwoordelik vir die vaslegging van transaksies op PERSAL en die oudit van personeel- en verlofrekords. Hanteer alle personeelnavrae en korrespondensie (skriftelik en mondelings) en lê personeeldata, beleide, regulasies en sirkulêre weg. Onderhou registers, d.w.s. PILIR, RWOPS, aanstellings en diensbeëindigings. Werwing en seleksie.

zu.title: Ongumsebenzi wezokuphathwa: HRM (PEOPLE Management)
zu.summary: Kudingeka ongumsebenzi wezokuphathwa e-Western Cape College of Nursing e-Stikland ukuphatha imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwabasebenzi ehlanganisa ukubekwa emsebenzini, ukudluliselwa kwabasebenzi, ukuphumula kanye nokuphathwa kweholo.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esingaphansi kwesiqu: Isitifiketi somatriki (noma okulinganayo). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele sokuphathwa kwabantu. Isipiliyoni esifanele se-PERSAL kanye nokubungeleli nokukhethwa. Isidingo esingokwemvelo somsebenzi: Ukulungele ukusebenza ngaphezulu kwesikhathi uma kudingeka. Umfunwayo kumele abe nelayisense yokushayela evumelekile. Lowo oseqhingini kuzomele axhase amakhampasi amaningi ngemikhuba ye-HR, lapho kudingeka khona ngenxa yezidingo zokusebenza. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhathi): Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana nabantu, ukwenza izinqumo kanye nokuxazulula izinkinga. Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini kanye nokusebenza wedwa. Ikhono lokusebenza ngaphansi koxinzelelo.
zu.duties: Zenza yonke imisebenzi yokuphathwa kwezinto ebhekene nesebe labasebenzi njengokubekwa emsebenzini, ukupheliswa kwenkonzo, ukudluliselwa kwabasebenzi, ukuphathwa kwezezimali zokuphumela ohlazini, ukuphathwa kweholo, ukuphumula, izindlu, ukulimala esebenzini, ukuphathwa kwesikweletu kanye nokugunyaziswa kwamadokhumenti. Ubabelwe ukungena kwezinsiza kwi-PERSAL kanye nokuqinisekisa amarekhodi abasebenzi nesikhathi sokuphumula. Ubelele imibuzo yonke ngabasebenzi kanye nokuhambisana nalokho (okubhaliwe nokuvezwa ngomlomo) bese ugcina idatha yabasebenzi, izinqubo, imithetho kanye namasetshenzelwa. Ukugcina amarekhodi, okungawona i-PILIR, i-RWOPS, ukubekwa emsebenzini nokupheliswa kwenkonzo. Ukubungeleli nokukhethwa.

xh.title: Useshexheshe woLawulo: i-HRM (uLawulo lwabaNTU)
xh.summary: Kufuneka kuxhonywe useshexheshe wolawulo e-Wester Cape College of Nursing eStikland ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo lwabasebenzi ehlanganisa ukumiswa kwabasebenzi, ukudluliselwa kwabasebenzi, iholo nokulawulwa komvuzo.
xh.requirements: Isidanga esincinci semfundo: Isatifikethi sebanga eliphakamileyo (okanye esilinganayo). Isipiliwo: Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo soLawulo lwabantu. Isipiliwo esifanelekileyo se-PERSAL nokuQokelela nokukhetha abantu. Isimfuno esingaphakathi kwesithuba: Ulungelelaniswa lokusebenza ixesha elidlulileyo xa kufuneka. Izidingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukwenza imisebenzi yokweseka ngaphakathi kwesimiso sokuphatha izinsiza esibhedlela. Ukuzwa ukuthanda ukusebenza amahora ambalwa phakathi namaphelanga nangosuku olungomphumela khulu khulu lwesizwe. Amakhono (ulwazi/ikhono): Ikhono lokwakha ubudlelwano obuhle nabasebenzi kanye nomhlinzeki wenkonzo. Amakhono amahle okubala. Ulwazi nekhono lokuhlola umthetho we-Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness Hospital Linen Management Policy.

Ukuqapha futhi usize nemithelela yamayunithi wezinsiza ekuqashwe ngaphandle kwesibambiselo semithetho yokusebenza yomthengisi wezinsiza ekuqashwe ngaphandle kanye nomthengisi wokuhlamba izingubo. Ukulawula ngokusebenzelayo izinga lezinsiza ngokusebenzisa abasebenzisi bokugcina esibhedlela njengoba kunikezwa umthengisi. Ukuphatha ngokusebenzelayo ingxenye yokuphatha izinsiza nokuphatha abaphathi bezinsiza.

Lindeleke ukuthi lowo othathayo isikhundla asize/athathe isikhundla kumanye amawadi ngokusekelwe ezidingweni zokusebenza. Amakhono (ulwazi/izikhombi): Amakhono okusebenza ngokwekhompyutha ku-MS Office. Amakhono amahle okuxhumana nabantu nokuqhathanisa ulwazi, ikakhulu ukusebenza ngodwa, futhi njengengxenye yeqembu. Ikakhulu ukugcina imfihlo, ukuxazulula izinkinga nokuphathwa kwezinkinga ngamakhono amahle okuhlela izinto.
zu.duties: Ukunika inkulelo/ukuthatha isikhundla kubasebenzi nogqwayi njengoko kudingeka ngokusebenza mayelana nesiluhlu sokulinda nokuphathwa kweziguli. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokuphathwa kweziguli ngaphakathi kwewadi okubandakanya ukungenisa, ukudlulisela, ukukhipha iziguli, ukubhuka iziThuthi, imibuzo yeziguli, ukuhlola ukunyezelwa ngeziguli. Ukunika inkulelo yokuphattha ngokuvamile emawadi nas esibhedlela kubandakanya ukuphathwa kwezibhebhu nemisebenzi ngayinye yawo amawadi. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza ngaphakathi kwewadi zisetshenziswa ngempumelelo, ukugezanswa kwamathoko nokuphathwa kwamathoko. Ukwenza ukuqoqa ulwazi nokuhlanganisa imisebenzi yawo amawadi njamvale.

Ikhono lokugcina iimfihlo nokusombulula iingxaki nolawulo lwemaxabano ngeenkcuba-mbalo ezilungileyo zolawulo.
xh.duties: Nika inkxaso/inkonzo ekhawulezayo abasebenzi nabalawuli njengoko kufunekwe ngokomsebenzi mayela noludwe lolindeka lolawulo lwabaguli. Yenza imisebenzi yolawulo lwabaguli kwigumbi lokulalisela abaguli, equka ukungenisa, ukudlulisa, nokukhulula abaguli, ukubeka izithuthi, imibuzo yabaguli, nokuhlola ulwazi lwabaguli. Qokelela iingcombolo uze uqokelele imisebenzi yamanyanga egumbi lokulalisela abaguli.

af.title: Administrasieklerk: Toeleweringskettingbestuur
af.summary: Administrasieklerk benodig vir toeleweringskettingbestuurspligte insluitend vraag- en verkrygingsbestuur, ouditnakoming en SCM-evaluerings binne die Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met Wiskunde en/of Rekenkunde as geslaagde vak en/of Senior Sertifikaat (of gelykwaardig) met ervaring/kompetensies wat fokus op die Kernprestasiegebiede (KPG's) van die pos. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring. Inherentse vereiste van die werk: Geldige bestuurderslisensie. Bereidwilligheid om te reis. Kompetensies (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaargeletterd in Microsoft Office. Kennis van Toeleweringskettingbestuurprosesse, PFMA en AOS. Kennis van LOGIS en EPS. Vermoë om doeltreffend te kommunikeer (mondeling en skriftelik).
af.duties: Vraag- en verkrygingsbestuur van goedere en dienste. Bystand met die voorbereiding van insette vir die jaarlikse finansiële state (AFS) en die verseker van ouditnakoming. Adverteer versoeke op die EPS en die uitvoer van SCM-evaluerings volgens SCM-voorskrifte. Voorbereiding van groepe, opstel van notules vir KW- en keuringskomitee. Plaas bestellings by verskaffers en handhaaf akkurate lêerstelsels. Hanteer verskaffer- en gebruikersnavrae. Maandelikse verslagdoening. Verrig bystand- en verligtingspligte binne die SCM-komponent.

zu.title: Inhloli Yolawulo: Ukuphathwa Kwe-Supply Chain Management
zu.summary: Kudingeka unhloli yolawulo abazakwenza imisebenzi eyahlukeneyo yokuphathwa kwesinto kuhlanganise nokuphathwa kwesidingo nokutholwa, ukuhambisana nomcimbi wokuqinisekiswa kanye nokuhlolwa kwe-SCM ngaphakathi kwe-Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo okuncane eziyidingekayo: Isitifiketi sabamfundi nabaphile (noma okulinganayo) esinobalo futhi/noma izibalo ezidlule njengesifundo esidlule noma Isitifiketi sabamfundi nabaphile (noma okulinganayo) esinomuzwa/amacasho abheqe kwezindawo eziyisisekelo zokuqhutywa kwemisebenzi (KRA) yesikhundla. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanele. Isidingo esingaphakathi emsebenzini: Ilayisensi yokushayela ethi ngempela. Ukuzithanda ukuhamba. Amakhono (ulwazi/izindlela): Ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kwi-Microsoft Office. Ulwazi ngeminyakazo ye-Supply Chain Management, i-PFMA kanye ne-AOS. Ulwazi nge-LOGIS nakwe-EPS. Ikhono lokuxhumana ngempumelelo (ngomlomo nakubhalwayo).
zu.duties: Imicimbi yokuphathwa kwesidingo nokutholwa kwempahla nezinsiza. Ukusiza ekulungiseni izinto ezizofakwa emiyalezweni yaminyaka yonke yezimali (AFS) kanye nekuqinisekiseni ukuthi kuhambisana nomcimbi wokuhlola. Ukushicilela izicelo ku-EPS kanye nokwenza ukuhlolwa kwe-SCM ngokusho komyalo we-SCM. Ukulungisa amaphakethe, ukubhala amaminithi we-QC kanye nkomidi yokuhlola. Ukubeka amaphasiza kubakhiqizi kanye nokugcina izinhlelo ezibalulekile zefayela. Ukuphendula imibuzo yabakhiqizi nabasebenzisayo. Okubiko nyanga zonke. Ukwenza imisebenzi yokusiza nokweseka ngaphakathi kwesigaba se-SCM.

xh.title: Inkonkono Yolawulo: Supply Chain Management
xh.summary: Kufuneka inkonkono yolawulo ukwenza imisebenzi yolawulo lwesikolo esithengiswayo equka ulawulo lokufuneka nokufumaniswa, ulwahlulo olusemthethweni nokulinganiswa kwe-SCM ngaphakathi kwi-Western Cape Department of Health and Wellness.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno ezingowona mgangatho wemfundo: Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo (okanye esingekho ngqo) kunye neMathematics kunye/noma i-Accountancy njengesifundo esiphasiweyo kunye/noma Isatifikethi Esiphakamileyo (okanye esingekho ngqo) enamava/amandla ogqoziyo kuwo wonke amaveni Oyinyani (KRA’s) esithuba. Amava: Amava afanelekileyo. Iimfuno ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ilayisensi yomqhubi eseleyo. Ukulungele ukuhamba. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ukuba nolwazi lokusebenza ngekhompyutha kwi-Microsoft Office. Ulwazi ngemisebenzi ye-Supply Chain Management, i-PFMA kunye ne-AOS. Ulwazi nge-LOGIS ne-EPS. Ukuba mandla okuchazwa ngomlomo nangokubhalwayo.
xh.duties: Ukulawula ukufuneka nokufumaniswa kwezinto kunye neenkonzo. Unceda kwilungiselelo lezinto ezingenayo leminyaka yezigqibo zezimali (AFS) kuqinisekiswa ulwahlulo olusemthethweni. Ukubhengeza iicelo kwi-EPS nokwenza okulinganiselwayo kwe-SCM ngokwezimiso ze-SCM. Ukulungisa amaqela, ukubhala imizuzu ye-QC nekomiti eliqinisekisayo. Ukubeka iiodolo kubafornishi kugcino kunye nokugcina iindlela ezichanekileyo zokulungiselela iifayile. Ukuphendula iimbuzo zabafornishi kunye nabasebenzisi. Iingxelo zenyanga. Ukwenza imisebenzi yoncedo nenkokhelo ngaphakathi kwecandelo le-SCM.

jobs.title: Sterilization Operator Supervisor (CSSD)
jobs.summary: Supervise sterilisation, cleaning, packing and distribution of instruments at George Regional Hospital, requiring CSSD operator experience and a Grade 9 qualification.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC/Grade 9 (Std 7). Experience: Appropriate experience as a CSSD operator. Inherent requirement of the job: Be willing to work overtime, which may include weekends. The ability to handle heavy equipment and perform heavy duty functions, e.g. transport of heavy stock trolleys. The ability to report defects (test data), to do elementary stock control. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate knowledge, skills and competencies required to supervise and manage staff effectively, including leadership, planning, communication and interpersonal skills. Must have numeracy skills and should be able to think analytically. Be able to supervise and be assertive. Sound knowledge of steam sterilisation practices and decontamination processes. Strong leadership, strategic, interpersonal, negotiation, facilitation, counselling, operational contingency planning, and organisational skills. Computer literacy (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Independent effective decision making and problem-solving skills within the limits of the Public Sector policy framework.
jobs.duties: Supervise service in terms of control, cleaning, sterilizing, packing, and collecting of instruments and distribution of sterile instruments. Ensure continues monitoring and evaluation of staff reporting to you. Supervise and implement the cleaning control and testing of washing machines, autoclaves and other equipment in the department. Optimal support to operational manager and colleagues. Ensure maintenance of standards for quality and safety. -Manage financial, physical and human resources. Manage human resources. Maintain growth and development of self and others. Display of core values of the Department of Health WCG in the execution of duties.
jobs.enquiries: Ms LK De Goede Tel No: (044) 802-4352
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates may be subjected to a practical test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Sterilisasie Operateur Toesighouer (CSSD)
af.summary: Hou toesig oor sterilisasie, skoonmaak, verpakking en verspreiding van instrumente by George Regional Hospital, wat CSSD-operateurervaring en 'n Graad 9-kwalifikasie vereis.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC/Grade 9 (Std 7). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring as 'n CSSD-operateur. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Wees bereid om oortyd te werk, wat naweke kan insluit. Die vermoë om swaar toerusting te hanteer en swaardiensfunksies uit te voer, bv. vervoer van swaar voorraadtroie. Die vermoë om defekte te rapporteer (toetsdata), om elementêre voorraadbeheer te doen. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Toepaslike kennis, vaardighede en bevoegdhede wat vereis word om personeel doeltreffend te bestuur en te oversee, insluitend leierskap, beplanning, kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Moet numeriese vaardighede hê en in staat wees om analities te dink. Wees in staat om toesig te hou en assertief te wees. Deeglike kennis van stoomsterilisasiepraktyke en dekontamineringsprosesse. Sterk leierskap-, strategiese, interpersoonlike, onderhandelings-, fasiliterings-, beradings-, operasionele kontingensiebeplannings- en organisatoriese vaardighede. Rekenaargeletterdheid (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Onafhanklike doeltreffende besluitneming en probleemoplossingsvaardighede binne die perke van die openbare sektor se beleidsraamwerk.
af.duties: Hou toesig oor diens ten opsigte van beheer, skoonmaak, sterilisasie, verpakking en insameling van instrumente asook verspreiding van gesteriliseerde instrumente. Verseker deurlopende monitering en evaluering van personeel wat aan u verslag doen. Hou toesig oor en implementeer die skoonmaakbeheer en toetsing van wasmasjiene, outoklave en ander toerusting in die departement. Bied optimale ondersteuning aan operasionele bestuurder en kollegas. Verseker die handhawing van standaarde vir kwaliteit en veiligheid. -Bestuur finansiële, fisiese en menslike hulpbronne. Bestuur menslike hulpbronne. Onderhou groei en ontwikkeling van uself en ander. Toon die kernwaardes van die Department of Health WCG in die uitvoering van pligte.

zu.title: Umphathi Womsebenzisi Wokuqothulwa Kwezifo (CSSD)
zu.summary: Ukuqapha ukuqothulwa kwezifo, ukuhlanza, ukupaka nokusatshulwa kwezinto zokusebenza e-George Regional Hospital, okudinga isipiliyono somsebenzisi we-CSSD kanye nesitifiketi se-Grade 9.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi elibheke phansi: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC/Grade 9 (Std 7). Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyono esifanele njengomsebenzisi we-CSSD operator. Isidingo esibalulekilo somsebenzi: Ukuba ukulungele ukusebenza amahora amaningi, okungafaka phakathi iintsuku zokuphola. Ikono lokuphatha izinto ezisindayo nokwenza imisebenzi esindayo, njengokuthutha amathrola ezimpahla ezisindayo. Ikono lokubika amaphutha (idatha yohlolo), ukwenza ukulawula kwesisekelo sezimpahla. Amandla (ulwazi/amasu): Ulwazi, amasu namandwa afanele adingekayo ukuze qapha futhi uphathe abasebenzi ngempumelelo, okuhlanganisa ubuholo, ukuhlela, ukuxhumana nemisebenzi yokuxhumana nabantu. Kufanele ube namandla ezezibalo futhi ukwazi ukucabanga ngokuhlaziya. Ukwazi ukuqapha futhi ube nesibindi. Ulwazi oluhle ngemisebenzi yokuqothulwa kwezifo ngomswakama kanye nenzinkambiso zokususwa kwezifo. Amandla amakhulu obuholo, amasu okuhlela, okuxhumanayo, okuxoxiswayo, okusiza, okwelulekayo, okuhlela amasu okusebenza ezenzakalayo, kanye namandla e-organisational. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Ukuthatha izinqumo ngokuzimela ngempumelelo namasu okuxazulula izinkinga ngaphakathi kwemikhawulo yokuhlela komphakathi wabasebenzi basesikhundleni sabantu.
zu.duties: Qapha isevisi mayelana nokulawula, ukuhlanza, ukusetshenziswa kokuqothulwa kwezifo, ukupaka, nokuqoqa izinto zokusebenza kanye nokusatshulwa kwezinto zokusebenza ezingenasifo. Qinisekisa ukubuka nokuhlola ngokuqhubekayo abasebenzi ababika kumina. Qapha futhi usebenzise ukulawula ukuhlanza kanye nokuhlola imishini yokuhlanza, ama-autoclave kanye neminye imishini emnyangweni. Ukusekela okuhle kakhulu komphathi wokusebenza nakubasebenzi naye. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kwezinga lomgangatho wekhwalithi nokuphepha. -Phatha izinsiza zemali, ezingokwemvelo nabantu. Phatha izinsiza zabantu. Gcina ukukhula nokuthuthuka kwakho nakwabanye. Bonisa amagugu abalulekile eDepartment of Health WCG ekwenzeni imisebenzi.

xh.title: Omlandeli Womsebenzisi Wokutshatyalalisa Izixhobo (CSSD)
xh.summary: Ukulawula ukutshatyalaliswa, ukucocekiswa, ukupakisha nokusasazwa kwezixhobo kwiGeorge Regional Hospital, kufuna amava njengomsebenzisi we-CSSD operator nesidanga seGrade 9.
xh.requirements: Isidanga sokufunda esingaphantsi: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC/Grade 9 (Std 7). Isipho: Amava afanelekileyo njengomsebenzisi we-CSSD operator. Ixabiso lesimo esingangenwa ngaphakathi kwesithuba: Makabe lukhululeka lokusebenza ihours ezongezelelweyo, elokunokubandakanya iintsuku zokuphola. Amandla okusingatha izixhbo ezisindayo yaye ukwenza imisebenzi esindayo, umzekelo usasazo lweetrolley ezisindayo zamashishini. Amandla okuchaza iingxaki (iingcombolo zovavanyo), ukuqhuba ulawulo olulula lwamashishini. Iimpawu zokwazisa (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi, amakhono namava afanelekileyo efunwa ukulawula yaye ulawule abasebenzi ngokusebenzayo, kuquka ukulawula iindlela zokuqonda izinto, iplani, nokuqondana nabantu. Kufuneka ube namakhono okubala yaye ukuba nendlela yokucinga ngezinto ngokuchanekileyo. Makabe nomandla wokulawula yaye uzibe ngalowo ofuna into ethile. Ulwazi oluchanekileyo ngendlela zokutshatyalalisa ngesixhobo somsi yaye iinkqubo zokucocekisa izinto. Amandla amakhulu okuqonda izinto, aze afake ingqondo kwindlela ezisetyenziswayo, aqondane nabantu, azweleni, aze afake isixa esithile kwindlela azenza ngayo izinto, aluleke, alungise iinkqubo ezize ngokuziqhuba ngemiyalezo ethile, yaye alawule izixhobo ezahlukeneyo. Ulwazi lwekhompyutha (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Amandla okuzenza ukuzigqiba ekubeni yonke iinkqubo zokwenza izigqibo ezingenantsebenziswano namakhono okusombulula iingxaki ngaphakathi kwemigqatho yeenkqubo zeNdzimu yoLawulo lwmaSebe.
xh.duties: Omandla esikhokelo ekulawulweni, ukucocekisa, ukutshatyalaliswa, ukupakisha, nokuqokelelwa kwezixhobo nokusasazwa kwezixhobo ezingcolisekileyo. Qinisekisa ukulandelelwa ngokuqhathaniswa okuqhubekayo kunye nokuhlolwa kwabasebenzi abachaza kuwe. Phatha yaye usebenzise ukulawula ukucocekisa kunye nokuvavanya imishini yokuhamba, i-autoclaves nezinye izixhobo kwisebe. Nika inkxaso eqelelene kumlawuli wemisebenzi kunye nabo bandakanyekayo. Qinisekisa ukugcinwa kweenqanaba zomgangatho wobulungu nokhuseleko. -Lawula izixhobo zemali, ezoBuntu nezixhobo ezingatshintshiyo. Lawula izixhobo zoBuntu. Zigcine inkqubela phambili nokuphuhliswa kwakho nakwabanye. Bonisa iinxabiso eziphakamileyo zeSebe leZempilo WCG ekwenzeni imisebenzi.

jobs.title: Emergency Care Officer Grade 1 and 3 (VARIOUS Institutions)
jobs.centre: Metropole District Cape Winelands District Central Karoo District Garden Route District Overberg District West Coast District Emergency Medical Services
jobs.city: Metropole District Cape Winelands District Central Karoo Dis

jobs.summary: The Department of Health and Wellness seeks Emergency Care Officers Grade 1 and 3 to provide roadside to bedside emergency medical care across Western Cape districts.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Grade 3: Successful completion of the Intermediate Life Support (ILS) that allows registration with the HPCSA as Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 1: Successful completion of an appropriate Basic Life Support (BLS) course that allows registration with the HPCSA as Basic Ambulance Assistant (BAA). Registration with a professional council: Grade 1: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as an BAA. Grade 3: Registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa as an AEA. Experience: None after registration with the Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a BAA or AEA. Inherent requirement of the job: Valid code C1 driver’s license. -Valid professional driver’s permit (PrDP). Physical and mental fitness. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Excellent knowledge of all levels of emergency care protocols. -Good communication and interpersonal skills.
jobs.duties: Provide quality and efficient roadside to bedside definitive emergency care within defined emergency time frames within and across geographic and clinical service platforms. Make use of all communication tools as provided by the Employer to facilitate safe communication in relation to patient care protocols. Effectively maintaining Admin Function: complete manual and electronic patient care reports and trip authority log sheets. Maintenance of Emergency Vehicles and Equipment. Ensure effective communication with regards to patients, colleagues, other services and members of the Public. Provide effective support to the supervisor and participate in own wellbeing.
