af.title: Emergency Care Officer Vlak 1 en 3 (Diverse Inrigtings)
af.summary: Die Department of Health and Wellness soek Emergency Care Officers Vlak 1 en 3 om nood­sorg van padkant tot bedkant dwarsoor Western Cape distrikte te lewer.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Vlak 3: Suksesvolle voltooiing van die Intermediate Life Support (ILS) wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA) toelaat. Vlak 1: Suksesvolle voltooiing van 'n toepaslike Basic Life Support (BLS) kursus wat registrasie by die HPCSA as Basic Ambulance Assistant (BAA) toelaat. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Vlak 1: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n BAA. Vlak 3: Registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa as 'n AEA. Ervaring: Geen na registrasie by die Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as 'n BAA of AEA. Inherente vereiste van die werk: Geldige kode C1-bestuurderslisensie. -Geldige professionele bestuurderspermit (PrDP). Fisiese en geestelike fiksheid. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Uitstekende kennis van alle vlakke van nood­sorg­protokolle. -Goed kommunikasie- en interpersoonlike vaardighede.
af.duties: Lewer gehalte- en doeltreffende definiewe nood­sorg van padkant tot bedkant binne gedefinieerde nood­tydskrames binne en oor geografiese en kliniese diens­platforms. Maak gebruik van alle kommunikasie­instrumente soos deur die Werkgewer verskaf om veilige kommunikasie te vergemaklik met betrekking tot pasiënt­sorg­protokolle. Doeltreffende handhawing van Administratiewe Funksie: voltooi hand- en elektroniese pasiënt­sorg­verslae en rit­magtiging­logblaaie. Onderhoud van Nood­voertuie en Toerusting. Verseker doeltreffende kommunikasie met betrekking tot pasiënte, kollegas, ander dienste en lede van die Publiek. Lewer doeltreffende ondersteuning aan die toesighouer en neem deel aan eie welsyn.

zu.title: Iofisa lezeNdaba yezeMpilo Grade 1 kanye no 3 (Ezihlukene EzeSikhungo)
zu.summary: Umnyango we Health and Wellness ufuna abaphathi bokuPhutha kweBantwana abaningi abangesiNkinga Grade 1 kanye no Grade 3 ukuze babe ngabaphathi bezokwelapha abangaphezu komphakathi jikelele e Western Cape.
zu.requirements: Isidingo semfundo esincane: Grade 3: Ukuphela ngokuphumelelayo kwesifundo se Intermediate Life Support (ILS) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi HPCSA njengoba Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA). Grade 1: Ukuphela ngokuphumelelayo kwesifundo esifanele se Basic Life Support (BLS) esivumela ukubhaliswa kwi HPCSA njengoba Basic Ambulance Assistant (BAA). Ukubhaliswa kubhungana labasebenzi: Grade 1: Ukubhaliswa ku Health Professions Council of South Africa njengo BAA. Grade 3: Ukubhaliswa ku Health Professions Council of South Africa njengo AEA. Isipiliyoni: Akukho okuphaya kokubhaliswa ku Health Professions Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengo BAA noma AEA. Isidingo sangaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilaysensi yokushayela ye code C1 evunyiwe. -Ivazi yokushayela ngobungcweti (PrDP) evunyiwe. Ukuzijwayeza emzimbeni nasengqondweni. Amakhono (ulwazi/amandla): Ulwazi oluhle ngawo wonke amazinga amaphrotokholi okunakekelwa okuphutha. -Amakhono okuxhumana kahle nabantu nokuhlobana nabo.
zu.duties: Nikeza ukunakekelwa okushibhile kanye nokusebenza kahle kusuka esigxabheni siye esibhedeni ngaphakathi kwesikhathi esinqunyiwe sokuphutha emgwaqeni nase kubuso bezemigeqo namasevisi ezokwelapha. Sebenzisa wonke amathuluzi okuxhumana anikezwe umqashi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuxhumana okuphephile ngokuphathelene namaphrotokholi okunakekelwa kwesiguli. Ukugcina ngempumelelo Imisebenzi Yohlelo: qedela imibiko yokunakekelwa kwesiguli ebhalwe ngesandla nangekhomphyutha kanye namaphepha okubhala igunya lohambo. Ukugcina Izimoto Nokubakhipha Phansi. Qinisekisa ukuxhumana okusebenzayo ngokuphathelene namaguli, abasebenzi naye, ezinye izinsiza kanye nalabo bonke abantu. Nikeza inkxaso ebiyimpumelelo kumlawuli futhi ubambe iqhaza ekuzelelweni kwakho.

xh.title: NothathaNgcono kwiZiko lezeNdalo esiBuhlungwini inqanaba 1 naka-3 (Iziko elinje ngelishwa)
xh.summary: Isebe lezeMpilo nokuNconotha lifuna abaThathiNgcono kwiZiko lezeNdalo esiBuhlungwini inqanaba 1 naka-3 ukubanikela ngokunakekelwa kokugula okungxamayo kumgama ongaphakathi kwedolophu nakumagumbu eempilo kulo lonke elakwa Western Cape.
xh.requirements: Umfundo osekupheleni onganceda kwangaphambili ngokwemigaqo yokuqala: Inqanaba 3: Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kwe-Intermediate Life Support (ILS) ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomncedi weziko lezempo zokugula ezingxamileyo (Ambulance Emergency Assistant (AEA)); Inqanaba 1: Ukuqedwa ngempumelelo kweenkqubo ezifanelekileyo ze-Basic Life Support (BLS) ekuvumela ukubhalisa kwi-HPCSA njengomncedi weziko lezempo zokugula ezingxamileyo (Basic Ambulance Assistant (BAA)); Ubhaliso kulawulo lwemisebenzi yobugcisa: Inqanaba 1: Ubhaliso kwi-South African Health Professions Council njenge-BAA; Inqanaba 3: Ubhaliso kwi-South African Health Professions Council njenge-AEA; Inqanaba lomsebenzi oluthathwayo: Ilayisensi yokushayela ekhoyo yekhodi ye-C1; -Ivumelwano elikhoyo lokushayela ngokobugcisa (PrDP); Ukuhambelana ngokomzimba nengqondo; Iimpawu zokwenza umsebenzi (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi olugqithisileyo ngamagqabantshintshi onke amanqanaba; -Amakhono amabalathise ngokuziphatha nabantu.
xh.duties: Nika ngokukhululekileyo nangempumelelo ukunakekelwa okugqithisileyo kokugula okungxamileyo kwixesha elichaziweyo kwaye kungagqithiswa ngamagumbu eemveliso zolwazi, kwaye kungakwazi ukugqithiswa ngamagumbu eemveliso zolwazi; Sebenzisa zonke izixhobo zokuthethana njengoko zinikiwe ngumNikelo-niBambele ukwenza lula ukuthetha kukho ukhuselekileyo malunga namagqabantshintshi wokunakekelwa komntu ogulayo; Ukugcina ngokusebenzisekayo imisebenzi yokuCupha: gcwalisa iiripoti zokunakekelwa komntu ogulayo ngokwenyandidi nangemizobo yekhompyutha neeripoti zeendlela ezazisiweyo; Ukugcina izithuthi ezingxamileyo kunye nezixhobo; Qinisekisa ukuthetha okusebenzisekayo malunga nabagulayo, abasebenzi nabo, ezinye iinkonzo kunye namalunga eNtlolongo; Nikela ngokusebenzisekayo inkxaso kumlawuli kunye nokubamba iqhaza kulungisa isimo sakho.

jobs.title: Nursing Assistant Grade 1 to 3
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R181 230 per annum Grade 2: R211 401 per annum Grade 3: R249 141 per annum
jobs.summary: Nursing Assistant position at Clanwilliam Hospital offering three grade levels, requiring SANC registration as a Nursing Assistant and involvement in patient care and clinical support.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Qualification that allows registration with South African Nursing Council (SANC) as a Nursing Assistant. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the SANC as a Nursing Assistant. Experience: Grade 1: None. Grade 2: A minimum of 10 years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration with the SANC as Nursing Assistant. Grade 3: A minimum of 20 years appropriate/recognisable experience after registration with the SANC as Nursing Assistant. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to rotate to other wards in the facility. Must be prepared to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Computer literacy in MS Word, Excel & PowerPoint and knowledge of recordkeeping procedures. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Good organisational skills and the ability to function under pressure and as part of a team. Ability to accept accountability and responsibility and to work independently.
jobs.duties: Assist patients with activities of daily living (Physical care). Provide elementary clinical nursing care. Maintain professional growth/ethical standards and self- development. Effective functioning within multi-disciplinary team. Effective utilisation of resources.
jobs.enquiries: Mr. NM Goeieman Tel No: (027) 482 2166
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical test. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable on health professionals who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status). It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Nursing Assistant Grade 1 tot 3
af.summary: Nursing Assistant-pos by Clanwilliam Hospital wat drie graadvlakke bied, SANC-registrasie as 'n Nursing Assistant vereis, en betrokkenheid by pasiëntversorging en kliniese ondersteuning behels.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: Kwalifikasie wat registrasie by die South African Nursing Council (SANC) as 'n Nursing Assistant moontlik maak. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die SANC as 'n Nursing Assistant. Ervaring: Grade 1: Geen. Grade 2: 'n Minimum van 10 jaar gepaste/erkende ervaring na registrasie by die SANC as Nursing Assistant. Grade 3: 'n Minimum van 20 jaar gepaste/erkende ervaring na registrasie by die SANC as Nursing Assistant. Inherente vereistes van die pos: Bereidwilligheid om na ander sale in die fasiliteit te roteer. Moet bereid wees om skofte, naweke en openbare vakansiedae te werk. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Rekenaarvaardigheid in MS Word, Excel & PowerPoint en kennis van rekordhoudingsprosedures. Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Goeie organisatoriese vaardighede en die vermoë om onder druk en as deel van 'n span te funksioneer. Vermoë om verantwoordelikheid en aanspreeklikheid te aanvaar en onafhanklik te werk.
af.duties: Assisteer pasiënte met daaglikse lewensaktiwiteite (Fisiese versorging). Verskaf elementêre kliniese verpleegsorg. Handhaaf professionele groei/etiese standaarde en selfontwikkeling. Effektiewe funksionering binne 'n multidissiplinêre span. Effektiewe benutting van hulpbronne.

zu.title: Umncedi Wezokunakekela Isikhundla Esuka KuGrade 1 kuya KuGrade 3
zu.summary: Isikhundla somncedi wezokunakekela esesibhedlela i-Clanwilliam sinikeza amanani amathathu ezinga, sidinga ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezokunakekela nokubandakanyeka ekuhlangenwe nakho kwesiguli kanye nokwesekwa kwezokwelapha.
zu.requirements: Izindingo zemfundo: Iqualification ekuvumela ukubhaliswa ku-South African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomncedi wezokunakekela. Ukubhaliswa komkhandlu wezokunakekelwa: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezokunakekela. Isipiliyoni: Grade 1: Akukho. Grade 2: Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele/ezikhonwayo emva kokuqokwa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezokunakekela. Grade 3: Okungenani eminyakeni eyi-20 yesipiliyoni esifanele/ezikhonwayo emva kokuqokwa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezokunakekela. Izindingo ezingaphakathi komsebenzi: Ukulungele ukujikelezela kumanye amawadi esikhungweni. Kumele ukulungele ukusebenza ngokujwayelekile ngeshifts, ngevasa, nangamaholide asiwo womuntu wonke. Ikhono (ulwazi/amasayensi): Ukubhalisele kumakhompyutha kwi-MS Word, Excel & PowerPoint kanye nalwazi mayelana nezinqubo zokugcina amarekhodi. Ikhono elihle lokuxhumana nabantu nendlela yokusebenza. Ikhono elihle lokuhlela nokuba nokuthula nokusebenza ngaphansi kwegcindezi kanye nokuba yingxenye yeqembu. Ikhono lokwamukela inxibelelwano kanye nomthwalo futhi nokusebenza ngokuzimele.
zu.duties: Usize abesiguli ngemisebenzi yansuku zonke yokuphila (Ukunakekelwa komzimba). Nikeza ukunakekelwa okuyisisekelo kwezokunakekela ezokwelapha. Gcina ukukhula okungokwengqondo/izinga elihle futhi uze ngezinye izindlela ukuziphile. Ukusebenza ngempumelelo ngaphakathi kweqembu elihlangene izihlowa. Ukusetshenziswa ngempumelelo kwezinsiza.

xh.title: Umncedi wezokhathalelo lwezigulane inqanaba 1 ukuya ku-3
xh.summary: Isithuba somncedi wezokhathalelo lwezigulane eClanwilliam Hospital esinika amathuba eminqanaba emithathu, sifuna ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezokhathalelo lwezigulane nokuthatha inxaxheba ekukhathaleleni izigulane nasekuncedeni ngokwelwa kwamasebe ezempilo.
xh.requirements: Izigqibo zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isigqibo esivumela ukubhaliswa kwiSouth African Nursing Council (SANC) njengomncedi wezokhathalelo lwezigulane. Ukubhaliswa koluntu lwabagunyazi: Ukubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezokhathalelo lwezigulane. Imfundo ngokwemiyalelo: Inqanaba 1: Akukho. Inqanaba 2: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-10 yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezokhathalelo lwezigulane. Inqanaba 3: Ubuncinane leminyaka eli-20 yamava afanelekileyo/awaziwayo emva kokubhaliswa kwi-SANC njengomncedi wezokhathalelo lwezigulane. Iimfuno ezinzima zendalo yomsebenzi: Ulwelo lokujikeleza kwezinye iigumbi ezinokhwelwa izigulane kule ndawo. Kufuneka ukhululeke ukusebenza ngokutshintsha ixesha lokusebenza, iintsuku zokuphumla, namaphondo okuhamba kodwa alusebenzi. Iimpawu zokuziphumeza (ulwazi/ amakhono): Ulwazi lokusebenza ngemithombo yolwazi kwi-MS Word, Excel & PowerPoint nolwazi ngemigaqo yokugcina iirekhodi. Amakhono amahle wonxibelelwano nakumaxa obomi phakathi kwabantu. Amakhono amahle olungiselelo nokuqhwesha ukusebenza ngantsime njengetyeshi elisebenza njengelinye iqela. Amandla okwamkela ixlakaxo nemesa nokuqhwesha ukuzisebenzela ngokuzimela.
xh.duties: Kunceda izigulane kumashishini obomi abawenza yonke imihla (ukhathalelo lwamathambo). Kunikela ngokukhathalela ngokwelwa kwesiseko sezokhathalelo lwezigulane. Kugcina inzukanyana yokukhula ngokubonelelwa kwamagunya / iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezikumgangatho ophezulu nangokuziphucela. Ukusebenza ngokusebenza ngokuchanekileyo kwente ebuswa ngamakhosi ahlukeneyo abanamakhono ahlukeneyo. Ukusetyenziswa okuyimpumelelo kwezibonelelo.

jobs.title: Sterilisation Operator Production (CSSD)
jobs.summary: Sterilisation operator at Tygerberg Hospital responsible for decontaminating, packing and sterilising instruments and supplies.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Experience: Appropriate experience in a Central Sterilization Service Department. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work in a co-operative way within a team context. Basic understanding of disinfection, decontamination and sterilisation. Inherent requirements of the job: Willingness to work shifts including weekends, public holidays and night duty. Willingness to rotate within the CSSD department.
jobs.duties: Effective application of sterilisation processes and techniques. Promote/adhere to infection control, as well as health and safety regulations. Check, decontaminate, pack and sterilise instruments, linen and supplies. Assist with cleaning and testing of sterilisation equipment, disinfectant washers and autoclaves, lift and pushing heavy equipment. Maintain equipment in an optimum working condition and utilise resources. Use autoclaves, disinfectant washers and equipment/consumables in a cost-effective manner. Ensure surgical instrument trays is packed and marked correctly. Monitor, control and maintain adequate stock levels, report and assist with the investigation of lost instruments/ equipment.
jobs.enquiries: Ms V Dubase Tel No: (021) 938-4000
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Shortlisted candidates will be subjected to a practical assessment. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Sterilisasie-operateur Produksie (CSSD)
af.summary: Sterilisasie-operateur by Tygerberg Hospital verantwoordelik vir die dekontaminasie, verpakking en sterilisasie van instrumente en voorraad.
af.requirements: Minimum opvoedkundige kwalifikasie: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n Central Sterilization Service Department. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Goeie kommunikasie en interpersoonlike vaardighede. Vermoë om op 'n samewerkende wyse binne 'n spankonteks te werk. Basiese begrip van ontsmetting, dekontaminasie en sterilisasie. Inherente vereistes van die werk: Bereidwilligheid om skofte te werk insluitend naweke, openbare vakansiedae en nagdiens. Bereidwilligheid om binne die CSSD-departement te roteer.
af.duties: Doeltreffende toepassing van sterilisasieprosesse en -tegnieke. Bevordering van en voldoen aan infeksiebeheer, asook gesondheids- en veiligheidsregulasies. Kontroleer, dekontamineer, pak en steriliseer instrumente, linne en voorraad. Bystand verleen met skoonmaak en toetsing van sterilisasietoerusting, ontsmettingswassers en outoklawe, asook lig en stoot van swaar toerusting. Onderhou toerusting in 'n optimale werkende toestand en benut hulpbronne. Gebruik outoklawe, ontsmettingswassers en toerusting/verbruikbare items op 'n kostedoeltreffende wyse. Verseker dat chirurgiese instrument skinkborde korrek gepak en gemerk is. Monitor, beheer en handhaaf voldoende voorraadvlakke, rapporteer en help met die ondersoek na verlore instrumente/toerusting.

zu.title: Umbhali Wokukhiqiza Kokubuyisa Ekuqhubekisweni (CSSD)
zu.summary: Umbhali wokubuyisa esibhedlela i-Tygerberg Hospital ongumthatshabi ekusulelweni, ekuphatheni futhi ekubuyisweni kwemikhiqizo nezimpahla.
zu.requirements: Iziqu zemfundo ezingaphansi: General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Isiphiwo: Isiphiwo esifanele kumnyango we-Central Sterilization Service Department. Ikhono (ulwazi/izikhombi): Izikhombi ezinhle zokuxhumana nabantu. Ikono lokusebenza ngokubambisana ngaphakathi kothi. Ukuqonda okuyisisekelo kokuhlanza, ukususa ukungcola nokubuyisa. Izidingo ezibhalwe kulesi sikundla: Ukuzithoba ukusebenza kusikhathi okuhlanganisa amasonto, amaholide omphakathi nokusebenza ebusuku. Ukuzithoba ukujikeleza ngaphakathi komnyango we-CSSD.
zu.duties: Ukusetshenziswa okusebenzayo kwezinqubo nokubuyisa. Ukukhuthaza/okuhambisana nokulawula ukusulelwa, kanye nemithetho yezempilo nokuphepha. Ukuhlolwa, ukuhlanzwa, ukupakwa nokubuyiswa kwemikhiqizo, izindwana nezimpahla. Ukusiza ekuhlanzweni nasekuhlolweni kwemikhiqizo yokubuyisa, konke okuhlanzwa ngokususa ukungcola kanye namaklabhu-ntshube, ukuphakamisa nokushova imikhiqizo emindindi. Ukugcina imikhiqizo isimo esihle sokusebenza futhi ukusebenzisa izinsiza. Ukusebenzisa amaklabhu-ntshube, okuhlanzwa ngokususa ukungcola namathuluzi/izinto ezidayiswayo ngendlela engathathi malini. Kuqinisekiswe ukuthi amatrayi ezinketho zokuhlinza aphakwe futhi afakwe uphawu ngendlela efanele. Ukubuka, ukulawula kanye nokugcina izinga elifanele lezimpahla ezikhona, ukubika kanye nokusiza ekuphenyeni ngemikhiqizo/impahla ezilahlekile.

xh.title: Umsebenzi Wokwenziwa Kobuthi kunye Nokukhawulezisa Nokuvela Kobuthi kwisebe Lokuvela Kobuthi (CSSD)
xh.summary: Umsebenzisi wokwenza ukususwa kobuthi esibhedlele i-Tygerberg oqhelekileyo ekutshatyalaliseni ubuthi, ekupakisheni nasekususweni nobukhawuleza ubuthi kwiinstrumenti nezinto ezisetyenziswa.
xh.requirements: Iimfuno zemfundo ezingaphantsi: Isatifikethi se-General Education and Training Certificate (GETC)/ Grade 9 (Std 7). Isiphaluka: Isiphaluka esifanelekileyo kwisebe Lokuvela Kobuthi eMbindini. Iikhompetensi (ulwazi/ amakhono): Amakhono mahle onxibelelwano nokuhlangana nabantu. Ikhono lokusebenza ngokubambisana kwicala lesiqophi. Ukuqonda ukusetyenziswa kolwazi lokutshatyalalisa obuthi, ukususwa kobuthi nokwenziwa kobuthi. Iimfuno zendalo yomsebenzi: Ukuzimela ukusebenza ngokutshintsha amashishini kuquka iiveki zikonki, iintsuku zikahulumende namashifi abusuku. Ukuzimela ukujikeleza ngaphakathi kwesebe le-CSSD.
xh.duties: Ukusetyenziswa ngempumelelo kweenkqubo zobugcisa bokwenza ubuthi nokwenziwa kobuthi. Ukukhuthaza nokulandelana kolawulo lokutshatyalalisa obuthi, nakwilawulo loqeqesho loluntu nolwengingqi. Ukutsheka, ukutshatyalalisa ubuthi, ukupakisha nokwenza ubuthi kumalungu, nasekwenzeni izinto ezahlukeneyo. Ukuncedisa ekucoceni nasekuvavayeni iinkqubo zokwenza obuthi, kwindlu yokuhlamba izinto ezitshatyalalisayo nasekuhleni i-autoclave, nokuphakamisa nokududaza izinto ezinditho. Ukugcina izixhobo zisendleleni esemgangathweni kwaye zisebenza kakuhle nokusebenzisa izinto ezikwisikhongozeli. Ukusebenzisa i-autoclave, izinto ezihlambwayo ezitshatyalalisayo nezixhobo/izinto ezisebenza ngokungalahlanga mali. Kuqiniseke ukuba iitreysi zamalungu abadwelwe aphantsi, azihlohlwe ngokuchanekileyo. Ukulawula nokugcina amanqanaba abungakanani besithosa esilingeneyo, nokuchaza ngokuphononongwa kwamalungu/ izixhobo ezilahlekileyo.

jobs.title: Household AID
jobs.summary: Cleaner position at Mossel Bay Hospital requiring basic literacy and prior cleaning experience in a health facility, with shift and weekend work.
jobs.requirements: Minimum requirement: Basic numeracy and literacy skills. Experience: Appropriate experience in a household / cleaning environment in a health facility. Inherent requirement of the job: Willingness to work weekends, shifts, overtime, public holidays and night duty. The ability to do physical tasks and operate heavy duty cleaning and household equipment. Willingness to assists in other wards when needed. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Basic knowledge of cleaning equipment. Support to housekeeping supervisor and adhere to policies and cleaning practices. Appropriate knowledge of stock, assets, linen and equipment control.
jobs.duties: Deliver an effective cleaning service such as dusting, washing, scrubbing, polishing, washing and refuse removal. Adhere to safety measures and ensure adherence to occupational health and safety policies and Infection prevention control measures. Render assistance to the supervisor with general housekeeping duties such as control of cleaning and household equipment, care and control of linen and serving of meals to patients.
jobs.enquiries: Ms JA Mahlangu Tel No: (044) 604-6104
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates may be subjected to a competency test. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. OTHER POSTS

af.title: Huishoudelike hulp
af.summary: Skoonmakerpos by Mossel Bay Hospital wat basiese geletterdheid en vroeëre skoonmaakervaring in 'n gesondheidsfasiliteit vereis, met skof- en naweekwerk.
af.requirements: Minimum vereiste: Basiese syfer- en geletterdheidsvaardighede. Ervaring: Toepaslike ervaring in 'n huishoudelike / skoonmaakomgewing in 'n gesondheidsfasiliteit. Inherente vereiste van die pos: Bereidwilligheid om naweke, skofte, oortyd, openbare vakansiedae en nagskof te werk. Die vermoë om fisiese take uit te voer en swaardiens skoonmaak- en huishoudelike toerusting te bedryf. Bereidwilligheid om in ander sale te help wanneer nodig. Bevoegdhede (kennis/vaardighede): Basiese kennis van skoonmaaktoerusting. Ondersteuning aan huishoudelike toesighouer en nakoming van beleide en skoonmaakpraktyke. Toepaslike kennis van voorraad-, bates-, linne- en toerustingbeheer.
af.duties: Verskaf 'n effektiewe skoonmaakdiens soos afstof, was, skrop, poleer, was en vullisverwydering. Hou by veiligheidsmaatreëls en verseker nalewing van beroepsgesondheids- en veiligheidsbeleide asook infeksievoorkomingsbeheermaatreëls. Bied bystand aan die toesighouer met algemene huishoudelike pligte soos beheer van skoonmaak- en huishoudelike toerusting, sorg en beheer van linne en bediening van maaltye aan pasiënte.

zu.title: Usizo Lwasekhaya
zu.summary: Isikhundla sokuhlanza eMossel Bay Hospital esidinga ukwazi ukufunda nokubala okuyisisekelo kanye nesipiliyoni sokuqeda ukungcola esikhungweni sezempilo, nensebenzo ngokushintshana nangemaphelasonto.
zu.requirements: Isidingo esincane: Amakhono amabili okubala nokufunda. Isipiliyoni: Isipiliyoni esifanele emkhakheni wokuhlanzwa indlu / ukucocwa kwendlu esikhungweni sezempilo. Isidingo esibalulekile somsebenzi: ukuzikhethela ukusebenza ngezimpelasonto, ngokushintshana, isikhathi esengeziwe, ngezinsuku zomholo, kanye nasebusuku. Ikhono lokwenza imisebenzi edinga amandla komzimba nokuqhuba amaphini anzima wokuhlanza nentshiza yasekhaya. Ukuzikhethela ukusiza emagumbini amanye lapho kudingeka khona. Amandla (ulwazi/amakhono): Ulwazi oluyisisekelo ngamaphini wokuhlanza. Usizo ongqongqoshe wokugcina indlu kanye nokulandelwa kwezinqubomgomo kanye nezindlela zokuhlanza. Ulwazi olufanele ngokulawula izinto, izimpahla, imisindo, namaphini.
zu.duties: Nikela ngesevisi elihle lokuhlanzwa njengokushova izintshiya, ukugeza, ukususa amafutha, ukukhanyisa, ukugeza kanye nokususa izintshiya. Zilandele izindlela zokuvikela futhi qinisekisa ukulandelwa kwezinqubomgomo zezempilo nokuphepha emsebenzini kanye nezindlela zokuvinzezelwa ukutheleleka. Nikeza usizo ongqongqoshe ngemisebenzi ejwayelekile yokugcina indlu njengokulawla amaphini wokuhlanza nentshiza yasekhaya, ukunakeka nokulawula imisindo kanye nokuphakela ukudla kwesiguli.

xh.title: Isebe loluntu
xh.summary: Isithuba sokucoca eMossel Bay Hospital esifuna ukufunda okusesikweni nangaphezulu kokuba namava. Abantu abadinga ukubakho kwiindawo zokuphumla.
xh.requirements: Isidingo esikhulu: Amakhono amababisayo embalo noku(funda. Abambehando: Abambehando afanelekileyo kwimeko yokucoca ekhusi elibonelela ngokhathalelo loluntu. Isidingo esingaphakathi kobumsebenzi: Ukulungele ukusebenza iintsuku zokuphumla, iishifti, ixesha elongezelelekileyo, iintsuku zikaRhulumente kwaye usebenze ebusuku. jobs.title: Medical Specialist Grade 1 to 3 (ANAESTHETICS) (10 Sessions
jobs.salary_text: Grade 1: R671 per hour Grade 2: R766 per hour Grade 3: R887 per hour
jobs.summary: Medical Specialist in Anaesthetics sought for Mowbray Maternity Hospital, Western Cape, to provide comprehensive anaesthesia and critical care services.
jobs.requirements: Minimum educational qualification: Appropriate qualification that allows registration with the Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthesia. Registration with a professional council: Registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthesia. Experience: Grade 1: None after registration with the HPCSA as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthesia. Grade 2: A minimum of 5 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employees) as Medical Specialist in Anaesthesia. Grade 3: A minimum of 10 years’ appropriate experience as Medical Specialist after registration with the HPCSA (or recognised foreign Health Professional Council in respect of foreign qualified employee) as a Medical Specialist in Anaesthesia. Inherent requirement of the job: A valid driver’s licence. Competencies (knowledge/skills): Appropriate experience in obstetric anaesthesia. Ability to work in a team and with all levels of staff. Interest in training junior anaesthetists and students in a career in anaesthesia. Computer literacy.
jobs.duties: To deliver comprehensive anaesthesia and critical care services to patients in theatre and the wards at Mowbray maternity Hospital. Pre-operative, intraoperative and post-operative anaesthetic management of surgical patients. Perform clinical teaching and training of interns, students and nursing colleagues. Rotating through the hospitals affiliated with the University of Cape Town, namely Groote Schuur Hospital, New Somerset Hospital and Mowbray Maternity Hospital. Management duties such as statistics, presentations and research. Management of the epidural and pain service at Mowbray Maternity Hospital.
jobs.enquiries: Dr C Pfister Tel No: (021) 404-5001
jobs.applications: Applications are submitted online via www.westerncape.gov.za/health-jobs (click “online applications”).
jobs.notes: No payment of any kind is required when applying for this post. Candidates who are not in possession of the stipulated registration requirements may also apply. Such candidates will only be considered for appointment on condition that proof of application for registration to register with the relevant council and proof of payment of the prescribed registration fees to the relevant council are submitted on or before the day of the interview. This concession is only applicable to candidates who apply for the first time for registration in a specific category with the relevant council (including individuals who must apply for change in registration status)”. It will be expected of candidates to be available for selection interviews on a date, time and place as determined by the Department. Kindly note that excess personnel will receive preference. All shortlisted candidates, including the SMS, shall undertake two pre-entry assessments. One will be a practical exercise to determine a candidate’s suitability based on the post’s technical and generic requirements and the other must be an integrity (ethical conduct) assessment. Registrasie by 'n professionele raad: Registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Narkose. Ervaring: Graad 1: Geen na registrasie by die HPCSA as 'n Mediese Spesialis in Narkose. Graad 2: 'n Minimum van 5 jaar se toepaslike ervaring as Mediese Spesialis na registrasie by die HPCSA (of erkende buitelandse Health Professional Council ten opsigte van buitelands gekwalifiseerde werknemers) as Mediese Spesialis in Narkose. zu.title: Iqhaza lezokwelapha lezinga 1 kuye ku-3 (ANAESTHETICS) (10 Sessions
zu.summary: Kufunwa Iqhaza lezokwelapha ezitheni i-Anaesthetics le Mowbray Maternity Hospital, Western Cape, ukunikela izinsizakalo ezibandakanya i-anaesthesia kanye nezokunakekelwa okubalulekile.
zu.requirements: Izidingo zemfundo ephansi: Izifundo ezifanele ezivumela ukubhalisa ku-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njenge-Iqhaza lezokwelapha ezitheni i-Anaesthesia. Ukubhalisa eqhilikweni lezisebenzi: Ukubhalisa ku-HPCSA njenge-Iqhaza lezokwelapha ezitheni i-Anaesthesia. Isipiliyoni: Izinga 1: Akukho okudingekile emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA njenge-Iqhaza lezokwelapha ezitheni i-Anaesthesia. Izinga 2: U kube neminyaka engu-5 yesipiliyoni esifanele njenge-Iqhaza lezokwelapha emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA (noma eqhilikieni lezempilo oluvunyelwe lwangaphandle maqondana neziguli ezikwazisiwe zangaphandle) njenge-Iqhaza lezokwelapha ezitheni i-Anaesthesia. Izinga 3: U kube neminyaka engu-10 yesipiliyoni esifanele njenge-Iqhaza lezokwelapha emva kokuqashwa ku-HPCSA (noma eqhilikieni lezempilo oluvunyelwe lwangaphandle maqondana neziguli ezikwazisiwe zangaphandle) njenge-Iqhaza lezokwelapha ezitheni i-Anaesthesia. Isidingo sangaphakathi somsebenzi: Ilayisensi yokushayela evumelekile. Amakhono (ulwazi/amakhono): Isipiliyoni esifanele kwi-obstetric anaesthesia. Ikhono lokusebenza eqenjini nakulo onke amazinga abasebenzi. Ukwaziswa ekuloleni abayi-anaesthetist abasha nabafundi ngesikhathi sezokwelapha kwi-anaesthesia. Ukuzazi ukuqamba ngekhompiyutha.
zu.duties: Ukunikeza izinsizakalo ezibandakanya i-anaesthesia kanye nezokunakekelwa okubalulekile kubantu abagulayo bayo yonke indawo ethatha ukwelashwa kanye nezifundo zokwelashwa Mowbray maternity Hospital. Ukuphathwa kwe-anaesthesia ngaphambi kokusebenza, ngesikhathi sokusebenza futhi emva kokusebenza kweziguli ezithathwa isibhedlela. Ukufundisa futhi ukhulise ngokwelapha abaqeqeshwa ngaphansi kwabasebenzi abasha, abafundi kanye nabasebenzi bokhunye obuhlonza ngokwabo. Ukujikeleza izibhedlela eziqhakamshelwe neNyvesi yaseCape Town, okuyilowo Groote Schuur Hospital, New Somerset Hospital kanye neMowbray Maternity Hospital. Imisebenzi yokuphatha efana nokuqoqa izibalo, izinkombiso kanye nocwaningo. Ukuphathwa kwe-epidural nesezinsizakalo zobuhlungu eMowbray Maternity Hospital.

xh.requirements: Iminikelo yokufunda efunekayo: Iminikelo yokufunda efanelekileyo evumela ukubhaliswa kwi-Health Professional Council of South Africa (HPCSA) njengongcaliabuchwephesha we-Anaesthesia. Ukubhaliswa kwikomiti yabachwephesha: Ukubhaliswa kwi-HPCSA njengongcaliabuchwephesha we-Anaesthesia. Iimfuno zokuba ngumsebenzisi oqotho: I-South African ID okanye i-permanent residence permit. Iminikelo yokugqibela: Isatifikethda esivakalisiweyo. Iingcaphephezo ezifunekayo kulo msebenzi: Ikhadi elivumelekileyo lokushova. Iimpawu ezifunekayo ngokomthetho wolawulo lwemisebenzi: Ukuba nakho ukufunda nokuqonda iindlela ezahlukeneyo zokubonelela ngengqondo.

Ulawulo lwe-anesthetic phambi kokusebenza, ngexesha lokusebenza, nangemva kokusebenza kwezigulana ezilungele ukwenza izicwangciso. Ukwenza imfundiso yezobuchwepheshe nokubakhusela abaphathi kwimizamo yezokulungisa izigulana, abafundi kunye nabasebenzi bakwiliziko. Ukujikelela kwiibhedlele ezidityaniswa ne-University of Cape Town, ezinjengokuba yi-Groote Schuur Hospital, New Somerset Hospital ne-Mowbray Maternity Hospital. Imisebenzi yolawulo efana nokuqokelela iindlela, iinkcazelo kunye nophando. Ulawulo lwe-epidural nesevisi yokuphatha iindistress e-Mowbray Maternity Hospital.
